text.服务器无法保存秘卷投稿，请稍后重试。: The server could not save your scroll idea. Please try again later.
text.秘卷投稿库已满，请联系管理员。: Scroll submissions are full. Please contact the administrator.
text.写下你想设计的秘卷效果，最多150字。: Describe your scroll idea in up to 150 characters.
text.秘卷设计想法最多150字。: Scroll ideas can contain up to 150 characters.
text.请先填写秘卷设计想法。: Please enter your scroll idea first.
text.玩家名字最多16字。: Player names can contain up to 16 characters.
text.服务器未连接，可先填写，草稿会保存在本机。: You are offline. You can write now; your draft is saved on this device.
text.服务器暂不支持秘卷投稿，请稍后再试。: Scroll submissions are not available on the server yet. Please try again later.
text.投稿成功，感谢你的设计想法！: Submitted! Thank you for your idea.
text.投稿请求超时，想法已保留，请重试。: The request timed out. Your idea is saved; please retry.
text.反熵诅咒与宇宙法则背道而驰，会抽离周遭的热量并汇集到穿戴者身上。这会使穿戴者短暂: The Anti-entropy curse works against the forces of the universe, pulling energy into the wearer and away from their surroundings. This briefly sets the wearer on fire, but freezes everything around them!
text.臃肿诅咒的护甲看上去更加厚重，但实际上防御力并没有增强。硕大的体积反而让使用者难: Armor of bulk looks larger and more imposing, but doesn't actually have enhanced defense. Even worse, the added size makes moving into doorways very difficult.
text.腐蚀诅咒的护甲会喷溅出腐蚀性液体，为区域内的所有东西盖上一层黏糊糊的酸性淤泥。: Armor of corrosion is capable of bursting with corrosive fluid, coating everything in the area with sticky acidic ooze.
text.定相诅咒会在穿戴者受到攻击时试图将其传送到安全地带。不过，过强的威力反倒会导致使: The curse of displacement attempts to move the wearer to safety when they are attacked. It is a bit too effective however, randomly teleporting the user around the level.
text.代谢诅咒在穿戴者受伤时能直接将饱腹度转化为生命值，提供额外的治疗，但你会很快陷入: The metabolism curse directly converts satiety into health when the wearer is injured, providing a boost of healing, but quickly causing starvation.
text.带有分身诅咒的防具含有一种危险的复制魔法。有时候它会复制出穿戴者的镜像，但也有同: Armor cursed with multiplicity contains dangerous duplication magic. It will sometimes create a mirror image of the wearer, but is equally likely to duplicate the attacker!
text.丛生诅咒的护甲上生长着各种植物。从美学的角度来讲颇为有趣，但这些花花草草对防御力: Armor of overgrowth is covered in various blooming plants. While this effect certainly looks interesting, it does nothing for defense, and these plants will randomly activate in combat!
text.带有恶臭诅咒的防具会释放出团团毒雾，对一切来不及逃离的对象造成伤害。: Armor cursed with stench will release clouds of noxious gas, which is hazardous to everything caught in the cloud.
text.这个强力的刻印能够操控攻击者的心智，暂时地魅惑他们。: This powerful glyph manipulates the mind of attackers, charming them temporarily.
text.这个强力的刻印能使护甲在防御物理伤害的同时抵御魔法伤害。这种魔法防御不受护甲等阶: This powerful glyph allows armor to defend its wearer against magical attacks as well as physical ones. This magical defence is not affected by the armor's tier.
text.这个刻印会保护穿戴者和其所有物免受火焰的伤害及其他影响。: This glyph shields the wearer and their belongings from fire, completely nullifying its damage and negative effects.
text.这个刻印能让使用者与高草融为一体，得到短暂的隐形效果。: This glyph allows the wearer to blend into tall grass, granting them temporary invisibility.
text.这个刻印会在使用者周围生出能吸收伤害的地根护甲。这种地根护甲会在使用者移动后散落: This glyph grows earthen armor around the wearer to absorb damage, but this armor will break if the wearer moves.
text.这个刻印能操控使用者周身的水流，让使用者在水中移动时速度大大加快。: This glyph manipulates the flow of water around the wearer, making them much faster when moving through it.
text.这个刻印会掩盖使用者的气息，让使用者更难以被发现。: This glyph obscures the wearer, making them more difficult to detect.
text.这个刻印在被击中时会积蓄能量，在生效时为使用者的法杖充能。: This glyph builds energy when struck, granting charge to the wearer's wand when it activates.
text.这个刻印会将敌人攻击的冲击力反弹回去，使攻击者飞至远处。: This glyph rebounds force against attackers, sending them flying back.
text.这个刻印使用沉重的魔法石包裹了整个铠甲让使用者无法闪避，但会根据原有的闪避能力吸: This glyph surrounds the armor with heavy magical stone that makes dodging impossible, but blocks damage in proportion with evasion.
text.这个刻印会在近范围内没有敌人时提高使用者的移动速度。: This glyph enhances the speed of the wearer whenever they aren't near to an enemy.
text.这个强力的刻印会伤害那些攻击穿戴者的敌人，使它们缓慢流血。: This powerful glyph harms attackers, causing them to slowly bleed when they attack the wearer.
text.瞬时的伤害被延缓，随着时间慢慢释放。\n\n剩余的延迟伤害：%d:
Damage is being dealt slowly over time instead of immediately.

Deferred damage remaining: %d.
text.这个刻印可以储存对使用者造成的伤害，让使用者缓慢受伤而不是一下子受到重击。: This glyph is able to store damage dealt to the wearer, dealing it to them slowly rather than all at once.
text.你将纹章从护甲上摘了下来。: You detach the seal from your armor.
text.这件护甲生疼地勒住了你。: The armor constricts around you painfully.
text.你对你的护甲已经足够熟悉并且可以因此将其完全鉴定。: You are now familiar enough with your armor to identify it.
text.这件护甲上的硬化效果已被损耗！: The hardening on this armor has worn off!
text.不同属性的魔法相冲突，消除了护甲上的刻印！: Interaction of different types of magic has erased the glyph on this armor!
text.这件_%1$d阶_护甲能抵挡_%2$d~%3$d点伤害_并且需要_%4$d点力量: This _tier-%1$d_ armor blocks _%2$d-%3$d damage_ and requires _%4$d strength_ to use properly.
text.一般情况下这件_%1$d阶_护甲能抵挡_%2$d~%3$d点伤害_并且需要_%4: Typically this _tier-%1$d_ armor blocks _%2$d-%3$d damage_ and requires _%4$d strength_ to use properly.
text.由于你的力量不足，使用这件护甲会降低你的移动、闪避以及防御能力。: Because of your inadequate strength wearing this armor will decrease your ability to move, evade, and defend.
text.这套护甲对你来说或许太重了。: Probably this armor is too heavy for you.
text.你的额外力量使你穿戴着这件护甲时_更易闪避_。: Because of your excess strength, you are _more evasive_ while wearing this armor.
text.这件护甲已被_硬化_，但目前没有携带刻印。: This armor has been _hardened,_ but is not currently inscribed with a glyph.
text.这套护甲被诅咒了，你无法卸下它。: Because this armor is cursed, you are powerless to remove it.
text.你能感觉到这套护甲里潜伏着一股充满恶意的魔力。: You can feel a malevolent magic lurking within this armor.
text.虽然这件护甲有诅咒，但是你可以脱下它。: Despite the curse, you are able to unequip this armor.
text.这件护甲没有被诅咒。: This armor is free of malevolent magic.
text.战士的破损纹章被贴附于这件护甲上，当战士将要受伤至生命值半数以下时，纹章会为战士: The Warrior's broken seal is attached to this armor. When he is about to be injured below half health, it will grant him _%d shielding_.
text.战士的破损纹章必须贴附在他当前穿戴的护甲上方可生效。你是否愿意将破损纹章从卸下的: The Warrior's broken seal must be affixed to his currently worn armor in order to benefit him. Would you like to automatically detach the seal from the armor you are removing and affix it to the armor you are equipping?
text.你可在地牢中概率找到带有该效果的物品，或尝试自行使物品获得该效果。: You can find an item with this effect randomly in the dungeon, or try to apply it to an item yourself.
text.你的护甲当前没有技能，快去选一个吧！: Your armor currently has no ability, you should choose one!
text.你需要穿戴这套护甲才能使用它的特技！: You need to be wearing this armor to use its special power!
text.此护甲没有足够的能量来释放特技！: The armor does not have enough charge to use its special power!
text.现在使用该能力将消耗_%s_的充能。: Using the ability right now will consume _%s_ charge.
text.矮人王冠中蕴藏的魔法可以被转移到另一件护甲中去。注意，此过程中原先的护甲会被销毁: The magic of the dwarf king's crown can be transferred to another set of armor. Note that the original armor will be destroyed in the process.
text.你的英雄铠甲的特殊技能已被转移！: Your heroic armor's properties have been transferred!
text.你可通过某位英雄击败20层的boss之后找到该物品。: You can find this item after defeating the floor 20 boss with a specific hero.
text.穿着这套内着重甲的祭服时，牧师能够施展一项特殊技能。: While wearing this mixture of cloth and plate, the Cleric can perform a special ability.
text.这件轻便的护甲能提供最基本的防御。: This lightweight armor offers basic protection.
text.某位英雄初始携带该物品。: One of the heroes starts with this item.
text.装备这套护胸甲与披风时，决斗家能够施展一项特殊技能。: While wearing this plate armor and cape, the Duelist can perform a special ability.
text.披着这件朴实无华的披风，女猎手能够使出一个华丽的招式。: While wearing this cloak, the Huntress can perform a special ability.
text.用鞣制的兽皮制成的护甲。没有布甲轻，但提供更好的防御。: Armor made from tanned monster hide. Not as light as cloth armor but provides better protection.
text.穿着这件华贵的法袍时，法师可以释放一项特殊的技能。: While wearing this gorgeous robe, the Mage can perform a special ability.
text.由金属链环环相扣制成的一套结实又不失灵活的护甲。: Interlocking metal links make for a tough but flexible suit of armor.
text.厚重的金属板拼接到一起，为能承受其骇人重量的冒险家提供无与伦比的防御。: Enormous plates of metal are joined together into a suit that provides unmatched protection to any adventurer strong enough to bear its staggering weight.
text.裹着这身与黑暗融为一体的斗篷时，盗贼能够施展一项特殊技能。: While wearing this dark garb, the Rogue can perform a special ability.
text.在厚实的皮背心中缝入金属鳞片，形成了灵活而高防御的护甲。: The metal scales sewn onto a leather vest create a flexible, yet protective armor.
text.装备这套重型板甲时，战士能够施展一项特殊技能。: While wearing this heavy plated armor, the Warrior can perform a special ability.
text.你的炼金工具箱还没有准备好。: Your toolkit has not finished warming up.
text.被诅咒的炼金箱正在阻止你炼金！: Your cursed toolkit prevents you from using alchemy!
text.你需要至少6点能量才能那么做。: You need at least 6 energy for that.
text.每6个能量晶体可供炼金工具箱进行一次升级，这能增加工具箱随时间自然产生的能量。并:
Every 6 energy crystals will give the toolkit enough energy to gain a level, which increases the rate that the toolkit generates energy over time, and how quickly it warms up.

How much energy would you like to use?
text.这套工具箱内存放着各式各样的试剂，草药和一个小混合瓶，让使用者能够随时随地进行炼: This toolkit contains a number of reagents and herbs along with a small mixing vial, allowing for alchemy on-the-go. The vial contains what looks like alchemical energy crystals in liquid form.
text.被诅咒的工具箱将自己紧紧固定在你的身上，抑制你使用炼金工具的能力。: The cursed toolkit has bound itself to your side, and refuses to let you use alchemy.
text.工具箱正在预热中，过一会儿才能再次使用。: The toolkit is currently warming up, and will be ready to use after a little while.
text.手中的工具箱正随着你获得经验值缓慢生成炼金能量。混合瓶中的液体似乎能通过添加能量: The equipped toolkit is slowly generating alchemical energy as you gain experience. It looks like the mixture in the vial could be enhanced by adding energy crystals to it.
text.你不能装备两件相同的神器。: You cannot wear two of the same artifact.
text.这件神器令人痛苦地缠住了你的灵魂。: The artifact painfully binds itself to you.
text.你能感觉到在这个神器上潜伏着一股充满恶意的魔力。: You can feel a malevolent magic lurking within the artifact.
text.这件神器没有被诅咒。: This artifact is free of malevolent magic.
text.你需要装备神器才能进行该操作。: You need to equip your artifact to do that.
text.这些从DM-300崩解而出的金属碎片构成了一件坚硬的斗篷。它似乎能储存很多能量，: These collapsed sheets of metal from the DM-300 have formed together into a rigid cape. It seems to store a deep energy, perhaps it has some of the DM-300's power?
text.斗篷令人安心的沉重压在你的肩上，它似乎能从你受的伤里获得能量。: The cape feels reassuringly heavy on your shoulders, it seems to be gaining energy from the damage you take.
text.斗篷似乎在释放其存储的能量，并将其辐射出一种防护力场。: The cape seems to be releasing stored energy, it is radiating a protective power.
text.你的斗篷正在释放存储的能量，你感到自己正在被保护着！: Your Cape begins radiating energy, you feel protected!
text.你的斗篷在你周围辐射能量，产生了一个偏斜力场！\n\n该效果下你受到的所有伤害都:
Your cape is radiating energy, surrounding you in a field of deflective force!

All damage you receive is reduced while the thorns effect is active. Additionally, if the attacker is next to you, the reduced amount is deflected back at the attacker.

Turns of thorns remaining: %s.
text.是的，我知道我在做什么: Yes, I know what I'm doing
text.你每使用一次圣杯都会使它吸取你更多的生命力，但圣杯也会进而强化你的自然生命回复速:
Each time you use the chalice it will drain more of your life energy, but will further enhance your natural health regeneration in exchange.

Currently pricking yourself will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_, although this damage can be reduced by _both physical and magical blocking or damage reduction._ Without considering damage reduction effects, pricking yourself currently has a _%3$s%% chance_ to drain your life force completely.

Are you sure you want to offer the chalice more life energy?
text.你刺破了自己的手指，使你的生命精华流入了圣杯。: You prick yourself, and your life essence drains into the chalice.
The Chalice sucks your life essence dry...
text.这个闪闪发光的银质圣杯在边沿突兀地装饰着几颗造型尖锐的宝石。: This shining silver chalice is oddly adorned with sharp gems at the rim.
text.被诅咒的圣杯将自己固定在你手上，抑制着你回复生命的能力。: The cursed chalice has bound itself to your hand, and is inhibiting your ability to regenerate health.
text.握住圣杯的那一刻，你涌起一股想在那些尖锐宝石上刺伤自己的奇特冲动。: As you hold the chalice, you feel oddly compelled to prick yourself on the sharp gems.
text.你的一些血液汇集到圣杯里，你可以隐约感受到杯子在为你送来生命能量，提高了你的自然: Some of your blood is pooled into the chalice, you can subtly feel the chalice feeding life energy into you, increasing your natural health regeneration. You still want to cut yourself on the chalice, even though you know it will hurt.
text.圣杯已经被你的生命精华填满。你可以感觉到圣杯正将生命能量倾泻般回馈给你。: The chalice is filled to the brim with your life essence. You can feel the chalice pouring life energy back into you.
text.你的斗篷还需要%d回合来重新激活。: Your cloak needs %d more rounds to re-energize.
text.你不能使用被诅咒的斗篷。: You cannot use a cursed cloak.
text.你的斗篷充能不足无法使用。: Your cloak hasn't recharged enough to be usable yet.
text.这是盗贼多年前从皇家军械库窃取的一件无价的魔法斗篷。穿上时，可令穿戴者在短时间完:
A priceless magical cloak, stolen from the royal armory many years ago by the Rogue. When worn, it can be used to turn completely invisible for a short time.

The more the cloak is used, the stronger it will become, allowing the Rogue to become invisible more frequently and for longer durations.
text.你的斗篷耗尽了能量。: Your cloak has run out of energy.
text.你身上的暗影斗篷正给予你隐形效果。你会一直拥有该状态，直到你自行取消或斗篷耗尽充:
Your cloak of shadows is granting you invisibility while you are shrouded by it. You will remain cloaked until it is cancelled or your cloak runs out of charge.

While you are invisible enemies are unable to attack or follow you. Physical attacks and magical effects (such as scrolls and wands) will immediately cancel invisibility.

Turns until charge use: %d.
text.你已经召唤出幽灵了。: You have already summoned the ghost.
text.你的玫瑰尚未充能完毕。: Your rose isn't fully charged yet.
text.你不能使用被诅咒的玫瑰。: You cannot use a cursed rose.
text.你附近没有可用于召唤的空地。: There is no free space near you.
text.这就是那朵在幽灵消失前被提及的玫瑰吗？它似乎拥有某种精神力量，也许能以此为媒介触: Is this the rose that the ghost mentioned before disappearing? It seems to hold some spiritual power, perhaps it can be used to channel the energy of that lost warrior.
text.一株因岁月而干枯却没有完全凋零的玫瑰。\n\n它上面看起来残留了一些精神力量，但:
A dried aged rose that is somehow still holding together despite its age.

It seems to have some spiritual power, but you have no idea how to use it right now.
text.它似乎缺少了一些花瓣。也许把花瓣拼回来可以增强玫瑰。: It seems to be missing some petals. Perhaps reattaching them will strengthen the rose.
text.被诅咒的玫瑰被绑在了你的手上，你感觉到它出奇的冷。: The cursed rose is bound to your hand, it feels eerily cold.
text.你没有玫瑰来添加这片花瓣。: You have no rose to add this petal to.
text.你的玫瑰已经放不下这片花瓣了，所以你无视了它。: There is no room left for this petal, so you discard it.
text.你将花瓣放在了玫瑰上。: You add the petal to the rose.
text.一片干枯脆弱的花瓣，它居然能够在这么深的地牢之中幸存下来。: A frail dried up petal, which has somehow survived this far into the dungeon.
text.幽灵本身十分脆弱，但她的形体已经完整到足以装备一件武器和防具。她可以和你一样自如:
The ghost is weak on their own, but their form is solid enough to be equipped with a weapon and armor. They will be able to use these items just like you do.

The ghost can currently equip items requiring up to _%d strength._
text.幽灵无法使用特殊装备。: The ghost can't use unique items.
text.幽灵只能使用你已确定无诅咒的装备。: The ghost can only use equipment that you're sure isn't cursed.
text.幽灵的形体可能不够强大，无法装备此物品。: The ghost may not be strong enough to use that.
text.幽灵的形体还不够强大，无法装备此物品。: The ghost is not strong enough to use that.
text.你可通过某件神器遇到该单位。: You can find this character with a specific artifact.
text.我的灵魂与这朵玫瑰相连，它对我非常珍贵，是我在地面上相别的爱人送给我的礼物。\n:
My spirit is bound to this rose, it was very precious to me, a gift from my love whom I left on the surface.

I cannot return to him, but thanks to you I have a second chance to complete my journey. When I am able I will respond to your call and fight with you.

As long as you have the rose I can hear your voice, so you can use it to direct me from afar.

Hopefully you may succeed where I failed...
text.下水道以前是安全的，人们甚至会住进来过冬。: These sewers used to be safe, people even lived here in the winter.
text.不知道这里的守卫怎么了，他们放弃这里的防务了吗？: I wonder what happened to the guard patrols, did they give up?
text.我在地牢外还有家人，希望他们一切安好。: I had family on the surface, I hope they're safe.
text.守卫没能解决这些怪物，但也许我们能。: The guards couldn't defeat these monsters, but maybe we can.
If even the sewers are this dangerous, I wonder what's below...
text.这些老鼠和螃蟹是怎么长这么大的？: What could have caused these rats and crabs to grow so large?
text.我听过不少关于这里的传闻，没有一个是好消息。: I've heard stories about this place, nothing good.
text.虽说这里是座监狱，但怎么看都更像个地牢。: This place was always more of a dungeon than a prison.
text.我都不敢想象，这里被遗弃之后究竟发生过什么。: I can't imagine what went on when this place was abandoned.
text.看来这里的囚犯和狱卒都被变成怪物了。: It seems both the prisoners and guards have been turned into monsters.
text.这么多骷髅都是怎么搞来的？: What could be responsible for all these skeletons?
These people didn't have to end up like this...
text.看起来这里已经很久未被人类和矮人踏足了。: No human or dwarf has been here for a very long time.
text.究竟是什么原因让矮人放弃这一整座黄金矿脉的？: What would cause the dwarves to abandon a gold mine?
text.这里的黄金在地表上没什么用，真是太可惜了。: It's a shame all the gold here is useless on the surface.
text.就像下水道里的一样，这些生物也都被扭曲了。: The creatures here are twisted, just like in the sewers.
text.这里连蝙蝠都这么狂暴嗜血。: Even the bats are bloodthirsty here.
text.没有看到任何采矿设备，它们都被矮人回收了吗？: No sign of any mining equipment, did the dwarves reclaim it all?
text.矮人一族勤奋，稳重且守信，但他们既贪婪又容易记仇。: The dwarves were industrious, but greedy.
text.看来，矮人都城确实没落了。: So the dwarven metropolis really has fallen.
text.我真心希望地表上永远不会变成这副样子。: I hope the surface never ends up like this place.
text.矮人的皮肤不应该这么苍白的。: Dwarves aren't supposed to look so pale.
text.矮人，还有他们的造物，说不好哪种更差劲。: I don't know what's worse, the dwarves, or their creations.
text.看来矮人也成了没有思维的怪物。: It seems the dwarves are mindless monsters now as well.
text.矮人到底怎么想的，试图将这种力量玩弄于股掌？: What were the dwarves thinking, toying with power like this?
text.这里的怪物太诡异了，它们究竟从何而来？: The monsters here are otherworldly, where did they come from?
text.感觉到了吗？好像有什么东西在盯着我们。: Can you feel it? It's like something is watching us.
text.还好有火把，这里太暗了！: Thank goodness there are torches, it's so dark here!
text.为什么会发生这样的事情，我们不是成功了吗？: Why is this happening, I thought we succeeded?
text.那个怪物...怎么还能继续影响这个世界？: How is that thing still able to influence this world?
text.我希望你明白你正在用那个护符做什么。: I hope you know what you're doing with that amulet.
text.我想我们还没结束。: I suppose we're not done just yet.
text.已经走了这么远，我们可以结束这一切了！: We've come so far already, we can finish this!
text.再往前走一点，我们就可以离开这里了！: Just a little further, we can make it out of here!
text.有太多朋友死在这个家伙手上了，此仇必报！: Many of my friends died to this thing, time for vengeance!
text.绝不能让这个鬼东西活着！: Such an abomination cannot be allowed to live!
The one prisoner left is a deadly assassin. Of course...
I've heard horror stories about that mask...
text.让挖矿的机器追杀外来者这种事只有矮人才干得出来。: Only dwarves would build a mining machine that kills intruders.
text.这东西怎么弄的，能运作这么久？: How has this thing stayed active for so long?
text.“权力导致腐败”的说法指的就是这种情况。: When people say power corrupts, this is what they mean.
text.什么国王，根本就是个巫妖。: He's more of a lich than a king now.
text.就算死了，这些矮人仍听令于他们的旧主。: Even in death the dwarves obey their master.
text.原来神是长这样的？: So that's what a god looks like?
I wish I had one of those...
text.看起来很脆弱的人型幻影，身形飘渺。它的力量似乎与你手上的玫瑰有关。\n\n这个幽:
A frail looking ethereal figure with a humanoid shape. Their power seems tied to the rose you have.

This ghost may not be much, they seem to be your only true friend down here.
text.锁链无法拉动被缠绕的你。: Your chains cannot pull you while you are rooted.
text.你的锁链充能不足。: Your chains do not have enough charge.
text.你的锁链不能拉动那个目标。: Your chains cannot pull that target.
text.你的锁链仅能带你穿过墙壁，而非穿入墙壁。: Your chains can only pull you through walls, not into them.
text.目标区域没有可供抓取的物件。: There is nothing to grab there.
text.这些巨大但轻盈的锁链散发着灵魂能量。它们可以用来把你拉向一些地形，或将敌人拉向你: These large yet lightweight chains glow with spiritual energy. They can be used to pull you towards terrain, or pull enemies toward you. The ethereal nature of the chains even allows them to extend through walls!
text.被诅咒的锁链将自己锁在了你的身边，不断地在周围晃动，试图绊倒或绑住你。: The cursed chains are locked to your side, constantly swinging around, trying to trip or bind you.
text.锁链围绕在你的身边，缓慢地收集被你击败者的精神能量。每一发充能都是锁链中的一环，: The chains rest around your side, slowly siphoning the spiritual energy of those you defeat. Each charge is a link in the chain, which will extend out exactly one tile.
text.你现在不足以施放该法术。: You're not able to cast that spell right now.
text.你不能使用被诅咒的圣典。: You cannot use a cursed tome.
text.这本圣典能够帮助牧师引导、聚焦自身的神圣魔法，从而使牧师能够施放一系列的法术。\:
A holy tome that acts as a focus for the Cleric's divine magic. Using the tome lets the Cleric cast a variety of magical spells.

The tome will steadily get more powerful as the Cleric uses it, giving the Cleric more maximum charges and slightly increasing the recharging speed.
text.你的号角里没有食物可供食用！: Your horn has no food in it to eat!
text.你的号角装满了食物！: Your horn is full of food!
text.你的号角并不接受未经烹煮的无味果。: Your horn rejects the uncooked blandfruit.
text.你的号角已经吞噬了尽可能多的食物！: Your horn has consumed all the food it can!
text.号角吞噬了你提供的食物，变得更加强大了。: The horn consumes your food offering and grows in strength!
text.号角吞噬了你提供的食物。: The horn consumes your food offering.
text.这个号角不能用于吹奏，不过会随着你深入地牢获得经验而逐渐填充食物。你可以一点点慢: This horn can't be blown into, but instead seems to fill up with food as you adventure and gain experience. You can consume each charge individually as a snack, or eat until you're full.
text.也许可以通过给予它食物的能量来增加号角的力量。: Perhaps there is a way to increase the horn's power by giving it food energy.
text.被诅咒的号角把自己绑在了你的身边，它似乎在渴望得到食物而不是制造食物。: The cursed horn has bound itself to your side, it seems to be eager to take food rather than produce it.
text.你的信标现在并没有足够的能量支撑发射传送魔法。: Your beacon does not have enough energy right now.
text.这里强大的魔力流使你无法使用时空道标！: Strong magic aura of this place prevents you from using the lloyd's beacon!
text.邻近生物的心灵信号正在干扰你的时空道标并使其无法被使用。: Psychic aura of neighbouring creatures doesn't allow you to use the lloyd's beacon at this moment.
text.时空道标被成功设置在了你的当前位置，现在你可以随时返回这里。: The lloyd's beacon is successfully set at your current location, now you can return here anytime.
text.时空道标是一个赋予使用者控制传送魔法能力的复杂魔法装置。该信标可以用来返回一个预: Lloyd's beacon is an intricate magical device which grants the user control of teleportation magics. The beacon can be used to return to a set location, but can also expel bursts of random teleportation magic once it has charged from being equipped. This magic can be directed at a target or at the user themselves.
text.信标被设置在了像素地牢第%d层的某处。: This beacon was set somewhere on the level %d of Pixel Dungeon.
text.你的袖章充能不足。: Your armband does not have enough charge.
text.你不能使用被诅咒的袖章。: You can't use a cursed armband.
text.你只能选择一个邻近你的敌人！: You must target an enemy that is adjacent to you.
text.你不能直接从店主那里窃取物品。: You can't steal from shopkeepers directly.
text.这个敌人身上没什么好偷的。: That enemy has nothing to steal.
text.你什么也没偷到。: You didn't manage to steal anything.
text.这个紫色的天鹅绒袖标是盗贼大师的标志。它不属于你，但它也不属于你拿到这个袖标时击: This purple velvet armband bears the mark of a master thief. This doesn't belong to you, but it probably didn't belong to its last user either.
The cursed armband is bound to your wrist, and somehow your pouch of gold seems to be slowly getting lighter...
text.每当获得经验值，你都感到手腕上的袖章中有一股力量在积蓄。你不仅可以运用这股力量在:
You feel power building in the armband on your wrist as you gain experience. You can use this power to steal from shops, or to rob enemies!

Robbing enemies happens instantly, briefly disorients them, and gives you a chance to get whatever loot they have! This power is more effective against unaware enemies. Robbing the same enemy multiple times does not give more chances at loot.
text.鞋子吸收了种子，看起来更健康了。: The footwear absorbs the seed, they seem healthier.
text.你必须先给你的鞋子喂食一粒种子。: You must feed a seed to your footwear first.
text.你的鞋子还没有足够的能量。: Your footwear don't have enough energy for that.
text.那个位置超出了范围。: That location is out of range.
text.初看像是用麻绳编成的草履实际上是两株植物！它们看上去既虚弱又苍白，也许它们需要一: What initially seem like sandals made of twine are actually two plants! They seem very weak and pale, perhaps they need to be given nutrients?
text.这双鞋子已经长大了，现在更像是一双量身定制的鞋子。它们已经没那么苍白了，也许还可: The footwear has grown and now more closely resemble two tailored shoes. Some colour has returned to them, perhaps they can still grow further?
text.这两株植物又长大了。像是一双树皮制成的厚靴子。植物似乎已经恢复了它们的力量，但也: The plants have grown again and now resembles a pair of solid boots made from bark. The plants seem to have regained their strength, but perhaps they can still grow further?
text.植物们似乎已长到最大，就像是一对装甲护腿。这对深棕色护腿看上去仿如一棵非常坚毅的: The plants seem to have reached their maximum size, they resemble a pair of armored greaves. The greaves are a deep brown and resemble a very sturdy tree.
text.穿上这件神器时你感到更加亲近自然了。: You feel more attuned with nature while wearing this artifact.
text.被诅咒的草履切断了一切你与自然的联系。: The cursed sandals are blocking any attunement with nature.
text.鞋子泛起你喂给它们的最后一粒种子颜色的涟漪。它可以在地面上暂时扎根并在3格距离内:
The footwear ripples with the color of the last seed you fed them. They can briefly root into the ground and produce that plant's effect anywhere in a 3 tile radius.
Seed: _%s_
Charge needed: _%d%%_
text.你已经给鞋子喂食了%d粒种子。: You have fed the footwear %d seeds.
text.你不能使用被诅咒的骷髅钥匙。: You can't use a cursed skeleton key.
text.那里没有东西可上锁或解锁。: There's nothing to lock or unlock there.
text.你不能将一个单位锁在门内！: You can't lock a character inside of a door!
text.解开一把锁需要消耗1点充能。: Opening a regular lock requires 1 charge.
text.解开一把金锁需要消耗2点充能。: Opening a gold lock requires 2 charges.
text.创造一面临时墙壁需要消耗2点充能。: Creating a temporary wall requires 2 charges.
text.解开一把水晶锁需要消耗5点充能。: Opening a crystal lock requires 5 charges.
text.钥匙出于某种原因拒绝适配这把锁。: The key refuses to fit into this lock for some reason.
text.这扇门已被你的骷髅钥匙上锁。: That door was locked by your skeleton key.
text.骷髅钥匙不在你身上，你用力把这把锁掰开了。: The lock has weakened without your skeleton key. You manage to force it open.
text.一把匙柄处塑有头骨，与众不同的钥匙。你每次观察匙齿时其外形似乎都有不同。: An important-looking key with a head shaped like a skull. Its teeth seem to be different every time you look at them.
text.不同于地牢中的其他钥匙，这把魔法钥匙似乎能随着你不断使用它而获得力量。它几乎可被:
This magical key seems to gain power as you use it instead of the dungeon's regular keys. It can be inserted into almost any of the dungeon's locks to either open or close them, including doors that were never locked previously.

The key can even be used on empty space in a cardinal or diagonal direction to 'lock' the air in front of you, creating a 3 tile wide solid wall that lasts for 10 turns. Locking will push away enemies if there is space to do so.
text.被诅咒的钥匙似乎在全力避免适配任何一把锁，并使你更难以使用其他钥匙（但并非不能使: The cursed key seems to be actively avoiding fitting into any lock, and is even making it difficult (but not impossible) for you to use your other keys.
text.一面被骷髅钥匙创造的临时魔法墙壁。: A temporary magical wall has been placed here by the skeleton key.
text.护符至少要充能5%才能探查。: The talisman requires at least 5% charge to scry.
text.一块雕着奇怪刻纹的光滑石头。它好像是在观察着你周围的一切，留意任何不寻常的东西。: A smooth stone with strange engravings on it. You feel like it's watching everything around you, keeping an eye out for anything hidden.
text.手里拿着护符时，你感到五感都更敏锐了。护符正随着时间慢慢积攒能量，当你发现被隐藏:
When you hold the talisman you feel like your senses are heightened. The talisman is slowly building charge as time passes and when you discover hidden doors or traps.

The talisman can expend its charge to 'scry' in a cone shape, which reveals all tiles and secrets in the scanned area, and will grant you vision of enemies and items for a short time.
text.被诅咒的护符深刻地凝视着你，使你的感知钝化。: The cursed talisman is intently staring into you, dulling your senses.
text.你感到非常焦虑，仿佛周遭有未被发现的危险。: You feel very nervous, as if there is nearby unseen danger.
text.你的沙漏充能还不足以用来激活。: Your hourglass hasn't recharged enough to be usable yet.
text.你不能使用被诅咒的沙漏。: You cannot use a cursed hourglass.
text.你周遭的世界似乎就在这一瞬间变化了。: The world seems to shift around you in an instant.
text.你想要如何使用沙漏的魔法？\n\n停滞你自己的时间，周遭的时间会继续正常流动，而:
How would you like to use the hourglass's magic?

While in stasis, time will move normally while you are frozen and completely invulnerable, consumes up to 2 charges at a time.

When time is frozen, you can move as if your actions take no time. This can be deactivated at any time by using the hourglass or attacking.
text.这只大型的华贵沙漏看起来却并不怎么起眼，但你仍觉得它精雕细刻的框架内蕴含着某种强: This large ornate hourglass looks fairly unassuming, but you feel a great power in its finely carved frame. As you rotate the hourglass and watch the sand pour you can feel its magic tugging at you, surely using this magic would give you some control over time.
The hourglass seems to have lost some sand, if only you could find some...
text.被诅咒的沙漏把它自己锁在了你的身边，你可以感觉它试图操纵你的时间流动。: The cursed hourglass is locked to your side, you can feel it trying to manipulate your flow of time.
text.外界的时间已被冻结，现在你可以在一瞬间完成任何行动。该状态会一直持续下去，除非你:
Time is frozen around you, allowing you to perform actions instantly. The effect will last until it is cancelled or your hourglass runs out of charge. Attacking or using magic will break this effect as well.

Turns until charge use: %s.
text.你将沙子填入到你的沙漏中。: You add the sand to your hourglass.
text.你的沙漏填满了魔法沙子！: Your hourglass is filled with magical sand!
text.你没有沙漏来存放这些沙子。: You have no hourglass to place this sand into.
text.这一小包细沙应该能够在你的沙漏上完美使用。\n\n每次当你需要这种东西时，店主刚:
This small bag of fine sand should work perfectly with your hourglass.

It seems odd that the shopkeeper would have this specific item right when you need it...
text.你不能在失明的时候阅读书籍。: You cannot read from the book while blinded.
text.你的咒语书耗尽了能量。: Your spellbook is out of energy for now.
text.被诅咒的魔典锁死了书页，你无法阅读它。: You cannot read from a cursed spellbook.
text.你将卷轴的能量注入了书中。: You infuse the scroll's energy into the book.
text.你无法将这个卷轴添加到书中。: You are unable to add this scroll to the book.
text.你仍然不清楚这个卷轴的种类。: You're not sure what type of scroll this is yet.
text.这本魔典就其年岁而言被保养得异常好。当你翻动页面时它不断地噼啪作响并发出嘶嘶声，: This Tome is in surprising good condition given its age. It fizzes and crackles as you move the pages, surging with unstable energy. If you read from this book, there's no telling what spell you might cast.
text.被诅咒的魔典将自己绑在了你身上，并在抑制你使用大部分卷轴的能力。: The cursed book has bound itself to you, it is inhibiting your ability to use most scrolls.
text.这本魔典的目录并不完整，目录指向的白页上写着：: The book is incomplete. Its index is currently pointing to the following blank pages:
text.被你放进书中的卷轴闪耀着魔力的微光。你能够利用魔典进一步激发卷轴能力，展现出秘卷: The scrolls that you've added to the book are glowing with power. You will be able to choose the exotic version of these scroll's effects, but at the cost of an additional charge.
text.被你放入魔典的卷轴都充满了魔法能量。你可以自主选择导引出该卷轴的正常或秘卷能力。:
The scroll you added to the spellbook surges with energy. You are able to channel either the regular, or exotic version of this scroll's effect.

Choosing the exotic variant will cost 2 charges instead of 1.
text.你可在商店中购买该物品。: You can buy this item in a shop.
text.这副厚实的挎带能像肩带一样缠在身上，上面有许多用来放药剂、水袋和液金的隔热皮带。:
This thick bandolier fits around your chest like a sash, it has many insulated straps on it to hold potion vials, your waterskin, or liquid metal vials.

While inside the bandolier, your potions should be protected from the cold.
text.这个管状的容器看起来可以装下一整份天文学家的手书，不过你的卷轴也刚好能放在里面。:
This tubular container looks like it would hold an astronomer's tools and charts, but your scrolls will fit just as well. There's even a few side compartments which would nicely fit spell crystals, arcane styli, and arcane resin.

The holder doesn't look very flammable, so your scrolls should be safe from fire inside it.
text.这个小锦囊能装下许多诸如种子、符石与炼金原材料此类的小物件。: This small velvet pouch can store many small items in it, such as seeds, runestones, and some alchemy ingredients.
text.这款细长的皮制筒袋由某种异域动物的毛皮制成。强大的附魔使其拥有能收纳大量远程类武:
This slim holster is made from some exotic animal hide, and possesses powerful magic which lets it store a massive amount of ranged weapons.

You can simply reach into the bag and will always grab the item you were looking for.

Due to the holster's magic, wands will charge slightly faster and thrown weapons will last slightly longer inside of it.
text.这枚炸弹里灌注了奥术能量，当其爆炸时会释放出类似于粘咕蓄力攻击的强力冲击，在2格: This bomb has been imbued with arcane properties. It will explode into a powerful blast similar to Goo's pumped up attack, dealing _%1$d-%2$d magical damage_ to anything within 2 tiles.
text.你可通过炼金合成该物品。: You can craft this item via alchemy.
text.你迅速掐灭了炸弹引线。: You quickly snuff the bomb's fuse.
text.一枚颇大的黑火药炸弹。爆炸时，这枚炸弹会对所有临近单位造成_%1$d~%2$d点: A fairly hefty black powder bomb. An explosion from this bomb deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ to anything adjacent to it, and will destroy some adjacent terrain or items.
text.看起来引信在点燃后还能烧几回合。: It looks like the fuse will take a couple rounds to burn down once it is lit.
text.引信快烧完了，保持距离或者赶紧掐灭！: The bomb's fuse is burning away, keep your distance or put it out!
text.两枚装的黑火药重装炸弹，看起来多出来的那个是免费送你的！: A stack of two hefty black powder bombs, looks like you get one free!
text.这枚改造过的炸弹的爆炸范围更大，在2格范围内造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_并释: This bomb has been modified to explode in a larger area, dealing _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and spreading sustained flame within 2 tiles.
text.这枚改造过的炸弹在爆炸时会爆发出一阵电闪雷鸣。在2格范围内的所有单位不仅会受到爆: This customized bomb will erupt into a blast of light, sound, and electricity when it explodes. Anything within 2 tiles will take _%1$d-%2$d damage_ from the explosion, an additional 25%% damage from the electricity, and be stunned for 10 turns.
text.这枚改造过的炸弹的爆炸范围更大，在2格范围内造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_并释: This bomb has been modified to explode in a larger area, dealing _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and spreading a sustained gust of freezing air within 2 tiles.
text.这枚改造过的炸弹会在爆炸时在大范围内闪耀出圣光。在2格范围内的所有单位会受到爆炸: This bomb has been modified to flash holy light in a larger area when it explodes. Anything within 2 tiles will take _%1$d-%2$d damage_ from the explosion, and undead or demonic enemies will take an additional 50%% damage from the holy light.
text.这枚改造过的炸弹会周而复始地发出噪音，直到其引信燃烧殆尽。当有什么东西碰到炸弹时: This customized bomb will repeatedly make noise when its fuse runs out. When something touches the bomb, it will explode and deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_ to anything within 2 tiles!
text.噪音地雷引信已点燃，有东西接近就会爆炸！: The noisemaker is ticking away, it'll explode when something gets near!
text.这枚改造过的炸弹会在爆炸时释放出一阵浓厚的气体烟云。炸弹会在2格范围内造成_%1: This bomb has been modified to spew a thick cloud of gas at the same time as exploding. It will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and spread shrouding fog within 2 tiles.
text.这枚改造过的炸弹不会爆炸，而会在3格范围内四处溅射再生药液。被药液影响的区域会迅: This customized bomb will splash life-giving liquid everywhere within 3 tiles instead of exploding. The area caught in the blast will rapidly sprout grass and plants. Yourself and any allies caught in the blast will be healed as if they had drank a potion of healing.
text.这枚改造过的炸弹的外壳由DM-300的金属残骸制成，当其爆炸时外壳会碎裂为破片并: This bomb has been modified with scraps of DM-300's metal, which will fragment and fly everywhere when it explodes, dealing _%1$d-%2$d damage_ in a huge range around the bomb. You had better hide behind something when using it...
text.这枚改造过的炸弹会在爆炸后创造出魔法羊群。爆炸会对2格范围内的所有单位造成_%1: This customized bomb will create a wide field of magical sheep after exploding. The explosion will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_ to anything within 2 tiles. The sheep will block movement and persist for a very long time! The sheep will not last as long in the presence of powerful enemies though, and can be manually dispelled sooner by interacting with them.
text.这颗小浆果是女猎手在地牢的植被里找到的，它可以被快速食用以获得少量饱腹感，还可能: This small berry was found by the Huntress among the dungeon's vegetation. It can be eaten quickly, restores a small amount of satiety, and might contain a usable seed!
text.你可使用某项英雄天赋找到该物品。: You can find this item using a specific hero talent.
text.你没法忍受生吃这玩意儿。: You can't bear to eat it raw.
text.干燥且脆弱，或许加点其他材料再煮能够增强它的效果。: So dry and insubstantial, perhaps stewing it with another ingredient would improve it.
text.这个果实已经因为吸收锅中的汤而鼓胀，并且吸收了其中种子的属性。它具有这粒种子对应: The fruit has plumped up from its time soaking in the pot and has even absorbed the properties of the seed it was cooked with. It will have the effect of whatever potion the seed corresponded to.
text.看起来已经可以吃了！: It looks ready to be eaten!
text.它似乎性质很不稳定，最好作为武器丢出去。: It seems pretty volatile, it might be best to throw it.
text.无味果触地爆炸，碎成了一地的普通果块。\n\n尽管上面沾上了尘土，这些大块的熟制:
The blandfruit has exploded on impact, leaving inert chunks behind.

Despite a bit of dirt, these large chunks of cooked blandfruit seem perfectly edible.
text.看起来像块好肉排。: It looks like a decent steak.
text.你可使用另一种食物制作该物品。: You can create this using another food item.
text.里面都是些寻常玩意：一片肉干，几块饼干——诸如此类。: Nothing fancy here: dried meat, some biscuits - things like that.
text.你看到自己的手隐形了！: You see your hands turn invisible!
text.这是份速冻生肉，只能切成薄片取食，而且意外的好吃。: It's a piece of frozen raw meat. The only way to eat it is by cutting thin slices of it. And this way it's surprisingly good.
text.一份填满了美味肉馅的诱人大饼。吃下它后你会获得远高于其他食物的饱足感。: A delicious pie filled with savoury meat. This will satiate you far more than any other meal.
text.你可从某种敌人的掉落物中获得该物品。: You can get this item as a drop from certain enemies.
text.这块从幻影食人鱼身上切下的大块鱼肉呈半透明状，闪烁着奇光。这块充满魔力的肉无须烹: A large glistening translucent steak, cut from a phantom piranha. This magical meat doesn't need to be cooked and grants a number of defensive benefits in addition to fully satiating you. When eaten it will grant invisibility, barkskin, some healing, and cures many harmful effects.
text.这是份正宗康郡肉馅饼，内含牛肉加土豆的传统馅料。美味十足！: An authentic Cornish pasty with a traditional filling of beef and potato. Delicious!
text.被荷叶包裹，以法术贮藏的清蒸鲈鱼。逢此年月，有将鱼剩下的习俗，取年年有余之意，于:
A whole steamed fish, magically preserved on a bed of greens. It's tradition to save some fish for later around this time of year, so you'll keep some leftovers instead of eating it all at once.

Happy Lunar New Year!
text.你终于找到它了，神奇的护...噢不，这只是一块以箔纸包装的巧克力而已，它只是看起:
You've finally found it, the magical amulet of - wait a minute, this is just a foil-wrapped chocolate made to look like the amulet! It won't grant you limitless power, but at least it'll fill you up and give you a little artifact charge.

April Fools!
text.一个硕大的巧克力蛋，被五彩斑斓的箔纸包装着。这种体量的巧克力可以轻松将你填饱，其:
A great big chocolate egg, wrapped in colorful yellow foil. There's easily enough chocolate here to fill you up, and the sugar might give your artifacts a tiny bit of extra charge.

Happy Easter!
text.这瓶多彩的药剂是一种液态食物。它不仅可以充饥，其中还蕴含着能魅惑一名相邻非bos:
This colorful potion is a kind of liquid food. In addition to satisfying your hunger, it has a little magic in it which will calm an adjacent non-boss enemy, making them temporarily hesitant to fight you.

Happy Pride!
text.这一大块香草蛋糕上裹上了一层绿色糖霜，其上洒满各色糖碎。这样的蛋糕被用于庆祝某人:
This large slice of vanilla cake has colorful sprinkles and green frosting. The cake was made to celebrate years of experience, and will grant a small amount of that experience to you when eaten.

Shattered Pixel Dungeon was first released on August 5th 2014. Happy birthday Shattered Pixel Dungeon!
text.好大的一块南瓜派！甘甜又微辣，它会填饱你的肚子并让你恢复少量生命。\n\n万圣节:
A great big slice of pumpkin pie. Its sweet and spicy flavor will fill you up and give you a tiny bit of healing.

Happy Halloween!
text.这一大块香草蛋糕上裹上了一层蓝色糖霜，其上洒满各色糖碎。这样的蛋糕被用于庆祝某人:
This large slice of vanilla cake has colorful sprinkles and blue frosting. The cake was made to celebrate years of experience, and will grant a small amount of that experience to you when eaten.

The original Pixel Dungeon was first released on December 4th 2012. Happy birthday Pixel Dungeon!
text.甜度爆表的巨型拐杖糖！大到够你一次吃饱，其中的糖分或许还能让你的法杖获得少量额外:
A huge sugary sweet candy cane. It's big enough to fill you up, and the sugar might give your wands a tiny bit of extra charge too.

Happy Holidays!
text.这瓶起泡的药剂是一种液态食物。这种果腹之物尝起来和气泡酒别无二致，但实际上并不含:
This sparkling potion is a kind of liquid food. It satisfies hunger and simulates sparkling wine, but isn't actually alcoholic. The warm feeling in your belly will grant a little bit of shielding.

Happy New Year!
text.你上一顿吃剩的鱼。你可以随时把它吃完，这能恢复你少量的饱食度。: Some surplus fish from your previous meal. You can eat it any time you like to restore a little hunger.
text.它看起来和普通口粮一样，就是小了点。: It looks exactly like a standard ration of food but smaller.
text.烹煮的过程中杀死了肉上面可能携带的任何病菌或是寄生虫。现在应该可以安全的食用它了: Stewing the meat has cleansed it of any disease or parasites. It should be safe to eat.
text.这是一包由盗贼公会存放，供其成员取用的口粮。这包口粮专门被设计成可快速食用的样式:
This ration was left in the dungeon by and for members of the thieves guild. It's specifically designed to be eaten on the go, and aid with general skullduggery.

While it doesn't fill you up as much as a regular ration, it can be eaten quickly, provides a little direct healing, and will restore a charge to the Rogue's cloak of shadows.
text.你可使用某项特定的英雄天赋找到该物品。: You can find this item using a specific hero talent.
text.一张被遗弃的书页，似乎是从一本书上撕下来的。你需要捡起它才能阅读上面的内容。: A lone page, probably torn from a book of some sort. You'll need to pick it up to read it.
text.从一本炼金指南书上撕下来的一页。\n\n在远处你只能看到一行行密密麻麻的小字，不:
A torn page from a guidebook on alchemy.

Most of the text is too small to read at a distance, but you can make out the title of the page:

_"%s"_
text.你的指南有新的建议要告诉你！点击屏幕右上角闪烁的日志按钮进行阅读。: Your guidebook has advice for you! Tap the flashing journal button on the top-right to read it.
text.你的指南有新的建议要告诉你！选择屏幕右上角闪烁的日志按钮(%s)进行阅读。: Your guidebook has advice for you! Select the flashing journal button (%s) on the top-right to read it.
text.一本静静躺在地上的地牢探索指南，不知被谁遗弃在此。看来冒险不是很适合它的旧主人！:
An adventurer's guidebook, left here by someone who decided adventuring wasn't for them! This particular book is magical, and can prompt adventurers to read a page at the right moment.

Despite that functionality, the book is most popular because of the big words "Don't Panic!" written in large friendly letters on the cover.
text.从一本冒险指南书上撕下来的一页。\n\n在远处你只能看见一行行密密麻麻的小字，不:
A torn page from an adventuring guidebook.

Most of the text is too small to read at a distance, but you can make out the title of the page:

_"%s"_
text.看起来像是一封信，写在一张沾满灰尘的纸上。你需要把它捡起来才能看清上面写着什么。: What looks to be a letter, written on a dirt-stained piece of paper. You'll need to pick it up to be able to make out what's written on it.
text.写在老旧纸张上的日记条目或其他记录。这似乎比你在下水道里找到的信看起来好一些，但: A journal entry, or some other kind of record, written on an old piece of paper. It seems to have fared better than the letters you found in the sewers, but you'll still need to pick it up to read it.
text.看起来是探险家日志中的一个条目，尽管它肯定很旧，但保存得出奇得好。捡起它来阅读上: What looks to be an entry in an explorer's logbook, preserved surprisingly well despite how old it must be. Pick it up to read it.
text.一块生锈的小金属板，上面神奇地刻着一条信息。尽管它年代久远，可字母仍然清晰，但你: A small rusted metal tablet with a message magically etched into it. The letters are still clear despite the tablet's age, but you'll have to pick it up to read it.
text.一块黑色的小板，上面刻有发光的绿色字母。发光的字母在远处模糊成一团薄雾，你必须捡: A small black tablet with glowing green letters etched into it. The glowing letters blur together into a haze at a distance, you'll have to pick it up to read it.
text.这把黄金钥匙的齿纹精妙而复杂。或许可以用它来打开某个上锁的宝箱？: The notches on this golden key are tiny and intricate. Perhaps it will open a locked chest?
text.这把水晶钥匙在黑暗中反射着光芒。或许可以用它来打开某样水晶制品？: The cut surfaces of this crystalline key shimmer in the darkness. Perhaps it will open something made of crystal?
text.这个铁钥匙的匙齿已经严重磨损；皮制系带也久经年岁摧残。它对应的是哪扇门呢?: The notches on this ancient iron key are well worn; its leather lanyard is battered by age. What door might it open?
text.这把磨损而褪色的钥匙看起来非同寻常。大概它可以打开附近某道非同寻常的门。: This key is worn and discolored, but looks serious. Probably it can open some serious door nearby.
text.瓶子里装着些不断打旋的彩色液体。谁知道饮用或投掷它时会有什么效果呢？: This flask contains a swirling colorful liquid. Who knows what it will do when drunk or thrown?
text.你确定要饮用它吗？大多数情况下你该把它扔向敌人的。: Are you sure you want to drink it? In most cases you should throw such potions at your enemies.
text.你确定要投掷它吗？大多数情况下把它喝下去会更有用。: Are you sure you want to throw it? In most cases it makes sense to drink it.
text.药瓶碎裂开，溅出了无害的液体。: The flask shatters and the liquid splashes harmlessly.
text.你可在地牢中概率找到该物品，或通过炼金合成该物品。: You can find this item randomly in the dungeon, or craft it via alchemy.
text.众多战斗积累而来的经验被浓缩为液态，这种药剂能够瞬间提升你的等级。: The storied experiences of multitudes of battles reduced to liquid form, this draught will instantly raise your experience level.
text.一旦暴露在空气里，这种化学药剂会挥发成为一片冰冷的气雾。: When exposed to air, this chemical evaporates into a cloud of freezing mist.
text.喝下这甜到掉牙的奇怪液体后，体内会爆发一股巨大的能量，让你可以短时间内飞速奔跑。: Drinking this oddly sweet liquid will imbue you with tremendous energy for a short time, allowing you to run at high speeds.
text.一支让你快速回满生命值并清除毒素的万能药剂。: This elixir will rapidly restore your health and instantly cure many ailments.
text.你看到你的手隐形了！: You see your hands turn invisible!
text.饮用这种药剂会使你暂时隐形。隐形期间，敌人将无法看见你。使用物理攻击或魔法效果(: Drinking this potion will render you temporarily invisible. While invisible, enemies will be unable to see you. Physical attacks and magical effects (such as scrolls and wands) will immediately cancel invisibility.
text.饮用这种古怪的药剂能让你漂浮到空中，从而轻易地越过陷阱和深渊。扔出它会产生一片未: Drinking this curious potion makes you float in the air, allowing you to cross traps and chasms with ease. Throwing it creates a cloud of unrefined gas that disorients all creatures within it.
text.该药瓶里装着一种不稳定的化合物，一旦暴露在空气中就会猛烈地燃烧起来。: This bottle contains an unstable compound that bursts into fierce flames when exposed to air.
text.你可以感受到其他生物的存在！: You can somehow feel the presence of other creatures' minds!
text.你能判定现在本层内就只有你一个人。: You can somehow tell that you are alone on this level at the moment.
text.喝下这个，你的心智将与大范围内的生物精神同调，让你能感受到围墙背后的生体所在。该: After drinking this, your mind will become attuned to the psychic signature of distant creatures, enabling you to sense biological presences through walls. Also this potion will permit you to see through nearby walls and doors.
text.暴露于空气时，烧瓶里的液体会气化成一片令人失去知觉的黄色云雾。任何吸入气体的生物: Upon exposure to open air, the liquid in this flask will vaporize into a numbing yellow haze. Anyone who inhales the cloud will be paralyzed instantly, unable to move for some time after the cloud dissipates. This item can be thrown at distant enemies to catch them within the effect of the gas.
text.你闻到了空气中不寻常的清新气息。: You feel uncommon freshness in the air.
text.这种魔法试剂能迅速中和掉大范围内的各种有害环境。饮用它将使你暂时免疫这种环境。: This magical reagent will quickly neutralize all harmful area-bound effects in a large area. Drinking it will give you temporary immunity to such effects.
text.新生的力量在你体内喷薄而出，你现在拥有%d点力量！: Newfound strength surges through your body, you now have %d strength!
text.这种强力的液体会洗刷你的肌肉，永久性增加1点力量值。: This powerful liquid will course through your muscles, permanently increasing your strength by one point.
text.打开或摔碎这个密封的药瓶将导致内容物爆发成一团剧毒的绿色云雾。你应该选择从远处将: Opening or shattering this sealed bottle releases a cloud of highly toxic green gas. You should throw it at enemies from a distance rather than open it by hand.
text.当这瓶药剂破裂时，会在原地迸发高压水浪。水浪仅对火属性敌人造成有效伤害，但同时会: When shattered, this brew will release a burst of pressurized water at its location. It's only forceful enough to damage fiery enemies, but it also spreads water to nearby terrain, disables traps, douses fires, and knocks back characters near the burst.
text.当瓶子破裂时，这瓶魔药会释放出一阵像气体一样扩散的旋流冰暴。: When shattered, this brew will unleash a swirling blizzard which quickly spreads like a gas.
text.这瓶魔药在打碎时会大范围地溅出腐蚀淤泥。被腐蚀淤泥影响的单位将会缓慢融化，除非他: This brew will spread corrosive ooze in a wide area around the location it shatters in. Anything caught by the ooze will slowly melt if it can't wash it off in water.
text.当瓶子破裂时，这瓶魔药会释放出一阵像气体一样扩散的狂暴炼狱。: When shattered, this brew will unleash a raging inferno which quickly spreads like a gas.
text.当瓶子破裂时，这瓶魔药会向周围释放一阵闪电风暴。: When shattered, this brew will unleash an electrical storm in a wide area around the location it breaks at.
text.这瓶魔药泛着不断流转变化的彩虹光芒。\n\n饮用它将随机获得一种有益的药剂效果，:
This magical brew glows with shifting colors of the rainbow.

When drank or thrown it will trigger the effect of a random potion. The potion effect will always be beneficial if it is drank, and will always be harmful if it is thrown.
text.这瓶秘药会赋予饮用者持续时间很长的魔法抗性。: This elixir will grant the drinker a long lasting resistance to magical damage.
text.这瓶秘药中包含着被粘咕力量强化的治疗液体。它不会为你提供立即的治疗效果，而会当你: This elixir contains the remains of Goo enhanced with a healing potion. While it will not provide immediate healing, it will steadily restore a greater amount of health while you are standing in water.
text.你暂时获得了如同粘咕一样的恢复能力。\n\n当站在水面上时，你每回合都能够恢复少:
You have temporarily gained restorative properties similar to that of Goo.

While standing in water, you will recover a small amount of health per turn. The effect is paused when you are at full health or are out of water.

Healing left: %d.
text.饮用后，这瓶秘药会使饮用者的血管里充斥着烈焰的力量。这个效果能让饮用者对火焰完全: When consumed, this elixir will send fiery power coursing through the drinker's veins. This effect will make the drinker immune to fire, and allow them to set enemies aflame with physical attacks.
text.你觉得自己身轻如燕！: You feel light as a feather!
text.这瓶秘药可为你提供更弱但更可控的悬浮效果，在短时间内使你身轻如燕，即便跳下悬崖深: This elixir offers a weaker but more controlled levitation effect, allowing the drinker to fall great distances without harm for a little while.
text.你正处于羽落秘药的作用效果之下，可以跳进深渊并坠落至下一层而不受到任何伤害！\n:
You are under the effects of a feather fall elixir, allowing you to fall into chasms without taking damage!

Turns remaining: %s.
text.这瓶秘药不仅有着治愈效果，还混杂了蜂蜜的甜香。饮用后，它会触发与治疗药剂一样的效:
This elixir combines healing with the sweetness of honey. When drank, it will apply the same effect as a potion of healing and satisfy a small amount of hunger, but it can also be thrown to heal an ally.

Creatures with an affinity for honey might be pacified if this item is used on them.
text.饮用后，这瓶秘药会使饮用者获得从敌人身上抽取热量的能力。这样的效果让使用者能够在: When consumed, this elixir will allow the drinker to sap the heat from enemies they attack. This effect will make the drinker immune to the cold, and allow them to chill enemies with physical attacks.
text.这种强力的液体会冲刷你的根骨，永久性增加1点力量值并在一段时间内增加%d点生命上: This powerful liquid will course through your muscles, permanently increasing your strength by one point and temporarily increasing maximum health by %d points. The health boost scales with your maximum health, but will slowly wear off as you gain levels.
text.你觉得自己不同寻常的强壮与健康。\n\n你的最大生命在一段时间内会有所提升。生命:
Your body feels unnaturally strong and healthy.

Your maximum health is boosted for an extended period of time. As you gain levels, the boost will steadily fade.

Current boost amount: %d.
Levels remaining: %d.
text.这瓶秘药能够向使用者注入强大的毒素之力，饮用者在持续时间内将会在周身不断释放出致: When consumed, this elixir will imbue the drinker with toxic energy. The drinker will continuously spread toxic gas as they move, and will be immune to toxic gas and poison for slightly longer than the duration of the effect.
text.这口圆底瓶里装着些有沉淀物的彩色液体。它似乎并不属于这个世界，谁知道饮用或投掷它: This round flask contains a grainy colorful liquid. It seems to be foreign to this land, who knows what it might do when drunk or thrown?
text.你真的想终止这瓶药剂的使用？它仍会被消耗掉。: Do you really want to cancel this potion usage? It will be consumed anyway.
text.当这种合剂被饮用时，它可以令饮用者短时间内对所有负面状态效果的免疫。它同样可以被: This powerful reagent will render the drinker immune to all harmful status effects for a few turns when quaffed. It can be thrown at a target to cleanse them as well.
text.这个角色暂时免疫所有的负面状态效果！\n\n剩余时长：%s:
This character is temporarily immune to all harmful status effects!

Turns remaining: %s.
text.打开或摔碎这个密封的药瓶将导致内容物爆发成一团强腐蚀性的锈色酸雾。这种酸雾的扩散: Uncorking or shattering this pressurized glass will cause its contents to explode into a deadly cloud of corrosive rust-colored gas. The gas spreads more quickly than toxic gas and is more deadly, but also won't last as long.
text.瓶子内奇特的化合物会在接触口腔后爆燃。迅速吐出液体就能让使用者从口中喷射火焰！: This flask contains an unusual compound which bursts into flame shortly after mixing with saliva. Quickly spitting the liquid will allow the user to spew flame from their mouth!
text.与麻痹药剂不同的是，饮用这瓶合剂能够使使用者的皮肤硬化，在一段时间内形成一道天然: Rather than paralyze, this liquid has a hardening effect on the skin which will turn it into temporary natural armor.
text.你无法再获得更多的额外天赋点了。: You can't gain any more bonus talent points.
text.选择一个天赋以获得两个额外点数。该天赋所在的层阶必须已被解锁。: Select a talent tier to gain two bonus points in. You must have unlocked the tier to be able to spend the points.
text.这股神圣的力量会化作液态，灌注进饮用者的身体，赋予其钟意的天赋两个额外天赋点。\:
The power of holy energy reduced to liquid form, this draught will imbue the drinker with divine power, granting them two bonus talent points in a tier of their choosing.

This potion can only be used once for each talent tier.
text.饮用这瓶合剂后，你的五感将被提高到一种无法想象的地步，使你能看穿12格以内的墙壁: After drinking this, your senses will be briefly heightened to incredible levels, allowing you to see through walls in a 12 tile radius!
text.你的武器变得前所未有的顺手！: Your weapon becomes easier to wield!
text.你的护甲变得前所未有的合身！: Your armor becomes easier to wear!
text.这个合剂不会直接增强你的力量，但却会为你建立使用特定物品的肌肉记忆。使你对其的运:
Rather than granting raw strength, this potion will instead attune the muscles of the user to a particular item. This will make that item easier to use, as if the drinker had practised with it and built muscle memory.

The chosen weapon or armor will require 2 less strength to use. This potion can only be used once on each item.
text.与治疗药剂不同的是，饮用这瓶合剂能够使周身被护盾环绕，抵挡所受到的伤害。: Rather than heal, this potion will instead project a durable shield around the user's body, blocking a considerable amount of damage.
text.瓶中的液体遇到空气就会迅速爆发出一团能完全阻挡敌人视线的浓雾。: When exposed to air, the liquid in this flask will produce a thick smoky fog which quickly spreads and blocks the vision of your enemies.
text.一旦暴露在空气里，这种化学混合物会瞬间冻结并缠绕范围内一切对象。: The chemical contained in this potion will rapidly react with the air, instantly freezing and rooting all within its effect.
text.喝下这甜到掉牙的奇怪液体后，体内会爆发一股巨大的能量，让你可以在长时间内飞速奔跑: Drinking this oddly sweet liquid will imbue you with a long-lasting boost of energy, allowing you to run at a quickened pace for an extended period of time.
text.这瓶合剂被丢出后会形成一团快速膨胀的浓厚水汽，并迅速凝结为雨水降下。受雨水覆盖的: Throwing this potion will create a quickly-spreading cloud of concentrated vapor, which will condense and pour down onto the environment. Most terrain will be converted to water, fiery enemies will take damage, fire will be doused, and traps will be overwhelmed and break.
text.一套配套的蜡烛，在使用中融化在了一起。\n\n单独看来它们毫无价值，但与其它蜡烛:
A set of candles, melted down and fused together through use.

Alone they are worthless, but used with other candles in a pattern, they can focus the energy for a summoning ritual.
text.你可在某个任务中找到该物品。: You can find this item during a specific quest.
text.一股寒意穿透了你的脊背。: A chill runs down your spine.
text.在外观上这团尸尘和普通灰尘差不多。而你却能够感受到其中潜伏着一股充满恶意的魔力。:
The ball of corpse dust doesn't differ outwardly from a regular dust ball. But you can feel a malevolent energy lurking within it.

Getting rid of it as soon as possible would be a good idea.
text.你现在拥有%d个暗金矿。: You now have %d dark gold ore.
text.这种金属名中的暗并非源于其色泽(它看起来和普通黄金一样)，而是因为它会在阳光下熔: This metal is called dark not because of its color (it doesn't differ from the normal gold), but because it melts under the daylight, making it useless on the surface.
text.一块形状奇特的金属片，被宝库中的矮人守卫随身携带。或许这徽记也是将守卫禁锢于这座: A strange shaped piece of metal that was being held by a denizen of the dwarven vault. Perhaps it is part of the magic that was binding it to the vault? Best to hold onto it, it might have some use.
text.很多矮人和他们的造物都携带着这种小块金属，理由不详。兴许它是装饰物或什么身份识别: Many dwarves and some of their larger creations carry these small pieces of metal of unknown purpose. Maybe they are jewelry or maybe some kind of ID. Dwarves are strange folk.
text.只能从新生火焰元素身上采集到的特殊余烬.。它们散发着温暖的能量。: Special embers which can only be harvested from young fire elementals. They radiate thermal energy.
text.一块似乎内含着传送魔法的细长棱晶。你随时都可以使用这块棱晶离开宝库，但若是提早离: A thin magical spell crystal that seems to contain teleportation magic. You can use the crystal at any time to leave the dwarven vault, but if you leave early you won't get the full reward!
text.时间的流逝似乎放缓了些，与此同时你听见了小恶魔的声音：\n\n“天哪，看起来你伤:
Time seems to slow down as you hear the Imp's voice:

"Hey, you seem to be pretty injured, is everything going alright down there? I want my statue but not badly enough for you to die trying to get it!"
text.“如果你现在处境不妙的话，可以先用_初始房间里的传送道具_想办法回到那边去，休整: "If you're stuck in a nasty situation you can use one of those _teleport items from the starting room_ to escape back there and try again."
text.“假如情况实在严峻到你根本没法解决了，那你还是_用我给你的棱晶逃出宝库_吧。不过: "If things are looking really dire, you can _escape using that crystal I gave you._ I'm not going to give you the full reward but it's certainly better than dying!"
text.时间的流逝似乎放缓了些，与此同时你听见了小恶魔的声音：\n\n“听着，我完全理解:
Time seems to slow down as you hear the Imp's voice:

"Listen, I understand if you're nervous but please at least leave the first room!"

"You don't need to worry about your gear, I'm an Imp of my word, I promise it will all be waiting for you when you get back. I also promise that I'll let you use the crystal to escape if you're actually in danger."
text.时间的流逝似乎放缓了些，与此同时你听见了小恶魔的声音：\n\n“真的假的，这就打:
Time seems to slow down as you hear the Imp's voice:

"Really, fleeing already!? You know you can run away from most of the enemies in that place right?"

"Look, if your life is in danger I can pull you out, but I'm not letting you take anything back with you. I expected a lot more from you =("
text.时间的流逝似乎放缓了些，与此同时你听见了小恶魔的声音：\n\n“喔，你打算回来了:
Time seems to slow down and you hear the Imp's voice:

"Oh, are you leaving already? Well I suppose you've helped chart the place out, and that's better than nothing."

"Still, I had expected more from you =(. Of course I'll pull you out if you need me to. I'll let you take something like a potion or scroll with you I suppose."
text.时间的流逝似乎放缓了些，与此同时你听见了小恶魔的声音：\n\n“要我把你带回来？:
Time seems to slow down and you hear the Imp's voice:

"Need to leave? Well, you've explored the vault a decent amount at least. I was hoping you'd fare better with actually pilfering it, but I've got a much better idea of how the place works now."

"I'll let you bring something out with you, but nothing magically upgraded!"
text.时间的流逝似乎放缓了些，与此同时你听见了小恶魔的声音：\n\n“真不错啊，你已经:
Time seems to slow down and you hear the Imp's voice:

"I had hoped you might get my statuette, but you have done a great job of exploring and clearing most of the vault!"

"Tell you what, I'll let you keep an item as long as it's not enhanced past +1, and I'll still set up shop further in the dungeon. I'll need some time to plan my next steps anyway."
text.时间的流逝似乎放缓了些，与此同时你听见了小恶魔的声音：\n\n“干得漂亮！！你准:
Time seems to slow down and you hear the Imp's voice:

"Excellent work!! Are you ready to leave? I'll take the statue from you when you return."

"As promised I'll set up shop further down and I'll let you take anything you like back out with you! Take your time choosing if you want, everything else will stay inside the vault."
text.你确定这就是你想带走的物品吗？: Are you sure this is the item that you want to take with you?
text._贴附在这件护甲上的破损纹章与宝库中的黑镜紧密联系，你无法将它带出宝库。_离开时: _The Broken Seal attached to this armor is tied to the mirror and cannot be taken with you._ The seal will be automatically removed from the armor. This will reduce the armor's level by 1 but will not remove any glyph it has.
text._这把法师魔杖与宝库中的黑镜紧密联系，其本身无法被带出宝库，但你可以带走其中原本: _This Mage's Staff is tied to the mirror and cannot be taken with you, but the wand imbued in it can._ The wand will be automatically removed from the staff, and given to you at the staff's level -1.
text.似乎你并不处于宝库层中！可能是bug或崩溃导致的。: It looks like you aren't in the Vault level! This might have happened due to a bug or crash.
text.你还没有把物品存放好，棱晶已经从你的背包中移除。: None of your items are being stored, so the crystal has been removed from your inventory.
text.你背包里的物品已经存放好了，现在可以再度进入宝库以开始委托任务。存起来的物品会在: Your items are currently being stored, so you should attempt to descend into the vault again to begin the quest. Your stored items will be returned to you when the quest ends.
text.一团晃动着的黏糊糊球体，是从粘咕尸体上崩解下的一部分。看起来像是一个大果冻球，不:
A jiggly blob of goop, split off from Goo as it died. It's almost like a big ball of jelly, though you wouldn't dare eat it.

It does nothing on its own, but it might be useful when combined with certain potions, or a bomb. At the very least it should convert into a decent amount of energy.
text.一块小小的漆黑雕塑，由黑曜石雕成。它的外表与委托你进入宝库的那位小恶魔神似，连那: A small jet-black statue carved out of obsidian. It resembles the Imp who sent you down here, it even has their glowing green eyes. There is an inscription on the base of the statue in a language you've never seen before.
text.这个信标内含的魔法似乎能带你回到一个特定的位置，目的地很可能就是你找到它的那个房:
This beacon of returning spell seems to already have a location set, probably to the entry room you found it in.

You could use it to save time while exploring, or as a way to escape if you're in danger.
text.一块被诅咒的金属锈片，它是DM-300的装甲外壳被击碎时分离出来的。你能感受到某:
A shard of rusted cursed metal, which broke off DM-300 as it was destroyed. You can feel an inactive malevolent magic within it.

It does nothing on its own, but it might be useful when combined with certain scrolls, or a bomb. At the very least it should convert into a decent amount of energy.
text.决斗家可使用镐子_穿刺_一个敌人。穿刺必定命中，同时施加3回合的易伤效果，且会对: The Duelist can _pierce_ an enemy with a pickaxe. This is guaranteed to hit, applies vulnerable for 3 turns, and deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ to enemies with rigid skin.
text.这是一件笨重但十分耐用的凿岩工具。不需要装备上就能作为挖掘工具使用，但在紧要关头: This is a sturdy and heavy tool for breaking rocks. You don't need to equip the pickaxe to mine with it, but it can probably be equipped as a weapon in a pinch.
text.你可从上一局某位英雄的遗骸中找到该物品。: You can find this item in the remains of a specific hero from a previous lost run.
text.这块枯木曾经是一位殒落于此的女猎手所持灵能弓的一部分。你仍可以感受到枯木中残留的: This broken fragment of wood was once part of a lost Huntress' spirit bow. You can still feel a little nature energy left in the fragment, you can use the fragment to grow some high grass around you. Doing this will destroy the fragment however.
text.这把断折剑柄曾经应是一名败于此地的决斗者随身武器。即使如今你仍可感受到剑柄其上残: This broken hilt looks like it came from a defeated Duelist's weapon. You can still feel a little martial power left in the hilt, you can use it to get a little bonus damage on your next two melee hits. Doing this will destroy the hilt however.
text.这把法师魔杖在其主死后也断做两截。你仍可以感受到魔杖中残余的魔力波动，你可以用它: This Mage's staff has been broken in half after its owner met their demise. You can still feel some magical energy left in the staff, you can use it to give your wands a little charge boost. Doing this will destroy the staff however.
text.这块半透明的织物残片似是源于一位盗贼同行的暗影斗篷。你可以感受到一丝神秘的能量仍: This scrap of translucent fabric looks like it came from a late Rogue's cloak of shadows. You can still feel a little mystical energy left in it, you can use it to give your artifacts a little charge boost. Doing this will destroy the fabric however.
text.这些细碎的红色蜡块似是源于一名葬身于此战士的纹章。你可以感受到其上仍残留的一缕执: These tiny shards of red wax look like they came from the seal of a fallen Warrior. You can still feel a bit of willpower clinging to the seal, you can use it to give yourself a bit of shielding. Doing this will destroy the seal shards however.
text.这片书页看起来是从一位已安息主怀的牧师的圣典上撕扯下来的。其上依旧残存有一丝神力: This page looks like it was ripped out of an expired Cleric's holy tome. There's still a little divine energy clinging to it, you can use it to regain a little bit of health. Doing this will destroy the torn page however.
text.这枚戒指突然紧缩，箍住了你的手指！: The ring tightens around your finger painfully!
text.这枚金属环镶嵌着一颗在黑暗中闪烁光芒的大块宝石。谁知道戴上后会有什么效果？: This metal band is adorned with a large gem that glitters in the darkness. Who knows what effect it has when worn?
text.你对你的戒指已经足够熟悉并且可以因此将其完全鉴定。: You are now familiar enough with your ring to identify it.
text.由于这个戒指被诅咒，你无力将其除下。: Because this ring is cursed, you are powerless to remove it.
text.你能感觉到这件戒指里潜伏着一股充满恶意的魔力。: You can feel a malevolent magic lurking within this ring.
text.这枚戒指没有被诅咒。: This ring is free of malevolent magic.
text.佩戴这枚戒指时，你的精准属性会增加_%s%%_。: When worn, this ring will increase your accuracy by _%s%%._
text.佩戴这枚戒指时，你的精准属性通常会增加_%s%%_。: When worn, this ring will typically increase your accuracy by _%s%%._
text.你已装备的戒指正联结它们的力量，一共增加了你_%s%%_的精准。: Your equipped rings are combining their power, increasing your accuracy by _%s%%_ in total.
text.这枚戒指提高了你的专注力，使敌人难以躲闪你的攻击。被诅咒的戒指则会让你的攻击更易: This ring increases your focus, making it easier for your attacks to find their mark. A cursed ring will instead make it harder for your attacks to connect.
text.佩戴这枚戒指时，你的附魔和刻印效果会提升_%s%%_。: When worn, this ring will increase the power of enchantments and glyphs by _%s%%._
text.佩戴这枚戒指时，你的附魔和刻印效果通常会提升_%s%%_。: When worn, this ring will typically increase the power of enchantments and glyphs by _%s%%._
text.你已装备的戒指正联结它们的力量，一共增强了_%s%%_的附魔与刻印效果。: Your equipped rings are combining their power, increasing the power of enchantments and glyphs by _%s%%_ in total.
text.这枚戒指增强了武器上的附魔和护甲上的刻印，也包括诅咒！戒指会先提高它们的触发概率: This ring enhances magical enchantments on weapons and glyphs on armor, including curses! It first increases activation chance, and then increases the strength of the effect once activation chance is 100%. A cursed ring will instead weaken enchantments, glyphs, and curses.
text.当佩戴这枚戒指时，你会获得_%s%%_的元素抗性。: When worn, this ring will provide _%s%%_ elemental resistance.
text.佩戴这枚戒指时，你通常会获得_%s%%_的元素抗性。: When worn, this ring will typically provide _%s%%_ elemental resistance.
text.你已装备的戒指正联结它们的力量，一共提供了_%s%%_的元素伤害抗性。: Your equipped rings are combining their power, providing _%s%%_ elemental resistance in total.
text.这枚戒指能为佩戴者提供抗性，降低大部分元素和魔法效果的伤害和持续时间。被诅咒的戒: This ring provides resistance to most elemental and magical effects, decreasing damage and debuff duration. Naturally a cursed ring will instead worsen these effects.
text.佩戴这枚戒指时，你持有的法杖，神器及英雄护甲充能速度将提高_%s%%_。: When worn, this ring will increase wand, artifact, and heroic armor charge speed by _%s%%._
text.佩戴这枚戒指时，通常情况下，你持有的法杖，神器及英雄护甲充能速度将提高_%s%%: When worn, this ring will typically increase wand, artifact, and heroic armor charge speed by _%s%%._
text.你已装备的戒指正联结它们的力量，一共增加了_%s%%_的充能速度。: Your equipped rings are combining their power, increasing charge speed by _%s%%_ in total.
text.在戒指的奥术领域笼罩下，你持有的所有魔法装备充能速度都会得到提升。被诅咒的戒指反: Your magical equipment will recharge more quickly in the arcane field that radiates from this ring. A cursed ring will instead slow recharge.
text.佩戴这枚戒指时，你的闪避属性会提升_%s%%_。: When worn, this ring will increase your evasion by _%s%%._
text.佩戴这枚戒指时，你的闪避属性通常会提升_%s%%_。: When worn, this ring will typically increase your evasion by _%s%%._
text.你已装备的戒指正联结它们的力量，一共增加了_%s%%_的闪避。: Your equipped rings are combining their power, increasing your evasion by _%s%%_ in total.
text.这枚戒指会加快佩戴者的反应速度，令其更难被敌人击中。被诅咒的戒指反而会让佩戴者更: This ring quickens the wearer's reactions, making it harder to land blows on them. A cursed ring will instead make the user easier to strike.
text.赤手空拳时，以你目前的力量，佩戴这枚戒指能够造成_%1$d~%2$d伤害_。当装: When unarmed, at your current strength, this ring will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage._ With a weapon equipped, this ring will increase damage by _%3$d._
text.赤手空拳时，以你目前的力量，佩戴这枚戒指通常能够造成_%1$d~%2$d伤害_。: When unarmed, at your current strength, typically this ring will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage._ With a weapon equipped, typically this ring will increase damage by _%3$d._
text.你已装备的戒指正联结它们的力量，在不使用武器时一共造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害: Your equipped rings are combining their power, dealing a total of _%1$d-%2$d damage_ without a weapon, or increasing damage by _%3$d_ with one.
text.决斗家可通过这枚戒指进入_拳击架势_，使得决斗家哪怕装备了其它武器也会用这枚戒指: The Duelist can adopt a _brawler's stance_ with this ring, causing her regular attacks to always use this ring even with a weapon equipped. These attacks will typically deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and will also inherit the weapon's enchantment and augmentation. This stance slows weapon recharging speed by 50%%.

The Duelist can adopt a _brawler's stance_ with this ring, causing her regular attacks to always use this ring even with a weapon equipped. These attacks will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and will also inherit the weapon's enchantment and augmentation. This stance slows weapon recharging speed by 50%%.
text.这枚戒指能够增强佩戴者的打击力度。这份额外的力量在挥舞武器时相当有限，而徒手攻击: This ring enhances the force of the wearer's melee blows. This extra power is fairly weak when wielding weapons, but an unarmed attack will be made much stronger. A cursed ring will instead weaken the wearer's blows.
text.在这种架势下，决斗家将使用装备着的武力戒指进行普通攻击，哪怕她已经装备了其他武器:
While in this stance the Duelist's regular attacks will use an equipped ring of force even when she has a weapon equipped. These attacks gain bonus damage and will still use the weapon's augmentation and enchantment.

Maintaining this stance takes focus however, reducing weapon ability recharge speed by 50%.

This stance can be toggled on or off by using a ring of force, but the reduction in charge speed will persist for a little while if the stance is quickly activated and deactivated.
text.佩戴这枚戒指时，你的攻击速度会提升_%s%%_。: When worn, this ring will increase the speed of your attacks by _%s%%._
text.佩戴这枚戒指时，你的攻击速度通常会提升_%s%%_。: When worn, this ring will typically increase the speed of your attacks by _%s%%._
text.你已装备的戒指正联结它们的力量，一共增加了_%s%%_的攻击速度。: Your equipped rings are combining their power, increasing the speed of your attacks by _%s%%_ in total.
text.这枚戒指会激发佩戴者内心的怒火，使其能够更迅猛地攻击。被诅咒的戒指则会导致佩戴者: This ring grants the wearer an inner fury, allowing them to attack more rapidly. A cursed ring will instead slow the wearer's speed of attack.
text.佩戴这枚戒指时，你的移动速度会提升_%s%%_。: When worn, this ring will increase your movement speed by _%s%%._
text.佩戴这枚戒指时，你的移动速度通常会提升_%s%%_。: When worn, this ring will typically increase your movement speed by _%s%%._
text.你已装备的戒指正联结它们的力量，一共增加了_%s%%_的移动速度。: Your equipped rings are combining their power, increasing your movement speed by _%s%%_ in total.
text.这枚戒指减轻了佩戴者在移动时的负担，使其能够飞速奔跑。被诅咒的戒指则会使佩戴者倍: This ring reduces the stress of movement on the wearer, allowing them to run at superhuman speeds. A cursed ring will instead weigh the wearer down.
text.佩戴这枚戒指时，你的力量会增加_%1$d_，你的最大生命值会增加_%2$s%%_: When worn, this ring will increase your strength by _%1$d_ and your max HP by _%2$s%%._
text.佩戴这枚戒指时，你的力量通常会提升_%1$d_点，并且最大生命值通常会增加_%2: When worn, this ring will typically increase your strength by _%1$d_ and your max HP by _%2$s%%._
text.你已装备的戒指正联结它们的力量，一共提高了你_%1$d_点力量与_%2$s%%_: Your equipped rings are combining their power, boosting your strength by _%1$d_ and max HP by _%2$s%%_ in total.
text.这枚戒指会增强佩戴者的体质，使其拥有更强的力量与体格。被诅咒的戒指则会使人虚弱。: This ring enhances the physical traits of the wearer, granting them greater physical strength and constitution. A cursed ring will weaken the wearer.
text.佩戴这枚戒指时，你的投掷武器伤害会获得_%1$d_级的提升，耐久度则会提升_%2: When worn, this ring will boost the damage of your thrown weapons as if their level was increased by _%1$d_, and will increase their durability by _%2$s%%._
text.佩戴这枚戒指时，你的投掷武器伤害通常会获得_%1$d_级的提升，耐久度则会提升_: When worn, this ring will typically boost the damage of your thrown weapons as if their level was increased by _%1$d_ and will increase their durability by _%2$s%%._
text.你已装备的戒指正联结它们的力量，一共提高了_%1$d_级投掷武器等级，并且增加了: Your equipped rings are combining their power, boosting effective thrown weapon level by _%1$d_ and increasing their durability by _%2$s%%_ in total.
text.这枚戒指会加强佩戴者的瞄准能力，使投掷武器变得更加致命且耐用。被诅咒的戒指则会起: This ring enhances the wearer's precision and aim, which will make all projectile weapons more damaging and durable. A cursed ring will have the opposite effect.
text.佩戴这枚戒指时，你受到的伤害至多减少_%s%%_。: When worn, this ring will reduce the damage you take by up to _%s%%._
text.佩戴这枚戒指时，你受到的伤害通常至多减少_%s%%_。: When worn, this ring will typically reduce the damage you take by up to _%s%%._
text.你已装备的戒指正联结它们的力量，一共减少了你受到伤害的最多_%s%%_。: Your equipped rings are combining their power, reducing the damage you take by up to _%s%%_ in total.
text.这枚戒指使佩戴者能够抵御本应致命的打击。佩戴者受伤越重，对伤害的抗性就越高。被诅: When worn, this ring will allow the wearer to resist normally mortal strikes. The more injured the user is, the more resistant they will be to damage. A cursed ring will instead make it easier for enemies to execute the wearer.
text.佩戴这枚戒指时，你的整体幸运程度会提升_%s%%_。: When worn, this ring will increase your luck by _%s%%._
text.佩戴这枚戒指时，你的整体幸运程度通常会提升_%s%%_。: When worn, this ring will typically increase your luck by _%s%%._
text.你已装备的戒指正联结它们的力量，一共增加了你_%s%%_的幸运。: Your equipped rings are combining their power, increasing your luck by _%s%%_ in total.
text.这枚戒指有如磁石般的招财功效，佩戴者有更大的机率从敌人身上或各类宝箱中取得较有价: This ring acts like a magnet for treasure, increasing the likelihood that enemies and containers will be carrying valuable items. A cursed ring will instead reduce your chance of receiving loot.
text.这张羊皮纸上写满了难以破译的魔法符文。大声念出来会发生什么？: An indecipherable magical rune is written on this parchment. Who knows what it will do when read aloud?
text.你不能在失明时阅读卷轴。: You can't read a scroll while blinded.
text.你不能在魔法免疫时阅读卷轴。: You can't read a scroll while magic immune.
Your cursed spellbook prevents you from invoking this scroll's magic! A scroll of remove curse might be strong enough to still work though...
text.你真的想终止这张卷轴的施放？这张卷轴之前未被鉴定，因此它仍会被消耗掉。: Do you really want to cancel this scroll usage? The scroll wasn't previously identified, so it will be consumed anyway.
text.该卷轴能永久揭示一件物品的所有秘密。: All items are already identified. Reading consumes one scroll and plays the original reading animation and effects.
text.卷轴发出了某种舒缓的旋律。你觉得非常困倦。: The scroll utters a soothing melody. You feel very sleepy.
text.阅读这张卷轴会释放出一段舒缓的旋律，让所有听到它的生物深陷魔法睡眠。这种睡眠有益: Reading this scroll emits a soothing melody which will lull all who hear it into a deep magical sleep. For the reader and their allies the sleep is restorative.
text.你熟悉了这层的地形。: You are now aware of the level layout.
text.阅读这张卷轴时，一副明晰的景象会刻入你的记忆中，告知你整个楼层的精确布局并揭开所: When this scroll is read, an image of crystal clarity will be etched into your memory, alerting you to the precise layout of the level and revealing all hidden secrets. The locations of items and creatures will remain unknown.
text.卷轴生成了你的镜像。: The scroll forms mirror images of you.
text.卷轴尝试创造你的镜像，但是它们没有空间出现。: The scroll attempts to create mirror images of you, but they have nowhere to go.
text.卷轴上的咒文会创造使用者的两个镜像。这些像使用者的弱化版克隆体的镜像会对敌人展开: The incantation on this scroll will create two illusory twins of the reader. These mirror images act as weaker clones of the reader, and will chase down their enemies. They have no durability however, and will fade upon taking damage.
text.强大的魔力从卷轴中爆发！: Powerful magical energy erupts from the scroll!
text.这张卷轴可以将使用者的所受的伤痛转化为能量释放而出。使用者的伤势越重，所释放的能:
This scroll contains destructive energy which channels the reader's suffering outward into a blast of power. The weaker the reader is, the more damage they will deal. At very low health this scroll can kill most enemies instantly.

Using the scroll takes a toll on the user however, blinding and weakening them.
text.卷轴产生的激怒咆哮在地牢中回荡！: The scroll emits an enraging roar that echoes throughout the dungeon!
text.大声诵读内容时，卷轴将释放出一声轰响的咆哮，将所有敌人引向你并激怒附近的单位。: When read aloud, this scroll will unleash a great roar that draws all enemies to the reader, and enrages nearby ones.
text.一股能量在体内奔腾而过，使你的法杖力量充沛！: A surge of energy courses through your body, invigorating your wands!
text.纯正的魔法能量被禁锢在羊皮纸内，当这股能量被释放时会在短时间内持续为阅读者的所有: Pure magical energy is bound within this parchment. When released, it continuously recharges all of the reader's wands for a short time.
text.你的道具闪耀着净化的光芒，一股恶毒的能量从中消散。: Your item glows with a cleansing light, and a malevolent energy disperses!
text.你的道具闪耀着净化的光芒，不过什么也没发生。: Your item glows with a cleansing light, but nothing happens.
text.你的卷轴让咒缚灵得以解脱！: Your scroll frees the tormented spirit!
text.卷轴上的咒语能够瞬间清除指定的一件武器、护甲、法杖、戒指或神器上的诅咒。: The incantation on this scroll will instantly strip any curses from a single weapon, ring, wand, armor, or artifact.
text.眨眼之间你就被传送到本层的另外一个位置。: In a blink of an eye you were teleported to another location of the level.
text.羊皮纸上的咒语能立刻让阅读者传送到本层的另一处。卷轴会优先选择阅读者还未探索的地: The spell on this parchment instantly transports the reader to a different location on the dungeon level. The scroll prioritizes areas the reader hasn't been to before, though it is not able to teleport past locked doors or barricades. It can, however, reveal hidden doors that lead to new areas.
text.这个卷轴产生了一阵明亮的红色闪光。: The scroll emits a brilliant flash of red light.
text.这个卷轴产生了一阵明亮的红色闪光的同时%s逃跑了！: The scroll emits a brilliant flash of red light and the %s flees!
text.这个卷轴产生了一阵明亮的红色闪光的同时怪物们逃跑了！: The scroll emits a brilliant flash of red light and the monsters flee!
text.被阅读的时候，该卷轴会爆射出一道可怖的红色闪光，以恐惧压垮使用者视野范围内生物的: When read, this scroll will emit a flash of red light that will overwhelm all enemies in your field of view with terror, and they will turn and flee. Attacking a fleeing enemy will shorten the effect.
text.你的道具变成了另一样东西！: Your item morphs into something different!
text.卷轴内存着强力的嬗变魔法，用在可行的物品上会将其转变成同类型的另一样物品。嬗变魔: This scroll contains powerful transmutation magic that transforms a suitable item into another item of the same type. Transmutation preserves the original item's upgrades, enchantments and glyphs. Scrolls and potions are converted into their exotic counterparts, and vice versa.
text.升级卷轴减弱了物品上的诅咒。: The scroll of upgrade weakens the curse on your item.
text.升级卷轴净化了物品上的诅咒！: The scroll of upgrade cleanses the curse on your item!
text.这张卷轴可以升级一件物品或一组投掷武器。法杖可获得更高的效能与更多的充能，武器与:
This scroll will upgrade a single item or set of thrown weapons. Wands will increase in power and number of charges, weapons and armor will deal and block more damage, thrown weapon sets will be fully repaired and more durable, and the effects of rings will intensify.

It can even weaken or sometimes totally dispel curses, though it is not as potent as a scroll of remove curse. Unfortunately, the upgrading magic can also erase enchantments or glyphs on higher level gear.
text.这张漆黑的羊皮纸上刻满了闪耀着魔力光芒的晦涩符文。看起来这不是这个世界的物品。大: A glowing indecipherable magical rune is written on this black parchment. It seems to be foreign to this land, who knows what it will do when read aloud?
text.这张秘卷在没有目标的情况下激活了。: The scroll activates without a target.
text.阅读此卷轴将播放出摄人心魄的音律，令目标敌人沉沦于你，永久地变成盟友！听到这歌声:
Reading this scroll emits an alluring melody which will enthrall a targeted enemy, permanently turning them into an ally! Other enemies who hear it will be temporarily charmed.

Particularly strong enemies can resist the enthrall effect, and will be charmed instead.
text.这个生物已因魅音秘卷的效果而沉沦。\n\n沉沦的单位将永远忠心于你，并主动攻击其:
This creature has been bewitched by the magic of a scroll of siren's song.

An enthralled character is permanently your ally, and will fight any enemies they encounter.
text.使用这张秘卷会让你被包裹在一个能够屏蔽所有魔法效果的魔力结界中，无论它是有利或是: The incantation on this scroll will surround you with a magical aura that temporarily blocks all magical effects, harmful or helpful. This includes most magical item effects such as wands, scrolls, rings, artifacts, enchantments, and curses. Heroic armor abilities are strong enough to work regardless however.
text.大声诵读此卷轴时，它将发出巨大的吼声，将敌人吸引到诵读者身边，同时在它们周围创建:
When read aloud, this scroll will unleash a great roar that draws enemies to the user while simultaneously creating a small arena around them.

As long as the reader stays in this arena they will take 33% less damage from all sources (this is applied before other forms of damage reduction), and they will not lose satiety.

The size of the arena will scale with the size of the area the reader is in. It will be particularly small in some boss areas.
text.一个由魔力构筑的竞技场在你周围浮现，其中翻腾着一阵猩红血雾。\n\n当你站在雾中:
A magical arena has appeared around you, denoted by a billowing red fog.

While standing in the fog, your hunger will not increase and you will take 33%% less damage from all sources. If you have any other sources of damage reduction (such as armor), they will apply after the 33%% reduction.

Turns remaining: %d.
text.没有可以鉴定的道具了！: There is nothing left to identify!
