text.这张秘卷会随机鉴定四种你尚未明确的道具。它可能帮你鉴定出某药剂的颜色，某卷轴的符: This scroll will randomly identify four types of item that you don't currently know. The types identified can be a potion's color, a scroll's rune, or a ring's gem. The items identified won't necessarily be ones you're carrying.
text.你的预知秘卷鉴定了下列道具：: Your scroll of divination has identified the following items:
text.诵读的时候，梦魇秘卷会爆射出一道极度可怖的红色闪光，其中的杀气仿佛已经凝成实体。:
When read, this scroll will emit a flash of red light that will instill incredible terror in all enemies in your field of view. So great is this effect that they will rapidly try to flee from the entire dungeon, never to be seen again!

Just like with terror, this effect can expire with time, or if the enemy is attacked.

Strong-willed enemies, such as bosses, will be inflicted with regular terror instead.
text.为你的武器选择附魔。: Select an enchantment to apply to your weapon.
text.为你的防具选择刻印。: Select a glyph to apply to your armor.
text.取消该行动仍然会消耗你的注魔秘卷，你确定吗？: Cancelling will still consume your scroll of enchantment, are you sure?
text.这张秘卷可以为武器或护甲注入强大的魔力。使用者甚至可以在一定程度上选择注入哪种魔: This scroll will infuse a weapon or armor with powerful magical energy. The reader even has some degree of control over which magic is imbued.
text.在阅读了这幅卷轴后，附近地形的细节将自发不断地映入阅读者的脑海。这种效果会持续相: After reading this scroll, the detail of nearby terrain will be constantly fed to the reader's mind in crystal clarity. This effect lasts for a considerable amount of time, and will reveal all hidden doors or traps, making searching unnecessary.
text.选择你希望蜕变出的天赋: Choose a new talent to replace your metamorphosed talent with.
text.取消该行动仍然会消耗你的蜕变秘卷，你确定吗？: Cancelling will still consume your scroll of metamorphosis, are you sure?
text.这张秘卷充满了嬗变的魔力，不过与一般的嬗变卷轴不同。这股魔力将作用于释放者本身而:
This scroll contains powerful transmutation magic, which will apply to the caster instead of to an item. The magic of this scroll will let you select one talent, and replace it with one of five talents of the same tier from different hero classes!

This effect can only apply to class talents, not talents gained from subclasses or armor abilities. Talents that you cannot use will not be given as options.
text.奇异的魔法能量被禁锢在秘卷羊皮纸内，当这股能量被释放时会在短时间内持续为阅读者的: The raw magical power bound up in this parchment will, when released, charge a user's equipped artifacts over time.
text.这张羊皮纸上的咒语能瞬间将读者传送到楼上与之距离最近的区域首层。想去商店的话，用: The spell on this parchment instantly transports the reader to the nearest region first floor above them. Very handy for quickly getting to a shop.
text.这张秘卷上的咒文会创造使用者的一个虹光守卫。这个像使用者的弱化版克隆体的幻像有着:
The incantation on this scroll will create a colorful illusory twin of the reader. This prismatic image acts as a weaker clone of the reader, with similar defence but lower hp and damage.

The prismatic image will show itself when enemies are present, and will attempt to defend the reader.

If a prismatic image already exists, using this scroll will fully heal it.
The Psionic Blast tears your mind apart...
text.这张秘卷封存着惊人的毁灭性能量，一旦被释放出来可摧毁视野内所有生物的心智。\n\:
This scroll contains incredible destructive energy that can be channeled to destroy the minds of all visible creatures.

There is significant feedback however, and the reader will also be damaged, blinded, and weakened. The more targets the scroll hits, the less self-damage will be taken.
text.这个菱晶包含的转化能力与炼金釜类似。允许使用者将一件物品(或一堆物品)转化为金币:
This spell contains transmutative powers similar to those found in an alchemy pot. Each cast allows the user to turn an item (or stack of items) into gold or alchemical energy. Turning potions or scrolls into energy will even identify them!

A few Alchemize uses are sold from shops, but many more can be made using alchemy by combining a seed, runestone, and a little alchemical energy.
text.这里强大的魔力流阻止了你的晶柱效果！: The strong magic aura of this place prevents you from using the spell!
text.临近生物的心灵信号干扰不允许你在此刻进行传送。: The Psychic aura of neighbouring creatures doesn't allow you to teleport at this moment.
text.信标设置在了你现在的位置。: The beacon was set at your current location.
text.新的设置会覆盖原来的信标设置的位置。\n\n返回将会让你回到上一个设置的位置并且:
Setting will override the location the beacon was previously set to.

Returning will return to your last set location and consume one use of the spell.
text.信标被设置在了第%d层的某处: This beacon was set somewhere on floor %d.
text.这个复杂的晶柱给予了使用者无视距离返回到设定地点的能力。该晶柱只会在返回时消耗。: This intricate spell grants the user the ability to return to a set location, regardless of distance. The spell will only be consumed by returning, it can be set as many times as you like, but it will only remember the most recent location it was set to.
text.这个菱晶可以向一件装备注入和DM-300内部相同的的邪恶魔法。目标物品会立刻被诅:
This spell infuses a piece of equipment with the same powerful malignant magic present within DM-300. The item it is used on will immediately be cursed, and any enchantment or glyph it may have had will be overridden.

In the case of weapons, armor, and wands, the item will gain upgrades in addition to being cursed. Curse infusion upgrades do not stack, and the upgrades are lost if the item becomes uncursed.

Multiple curse infusions can also be used to change the curse on a weapon or armor.
text.你无法在魔法免疫的情况下使用法术结晶。: You can't cast spells while magic immune.
text.你的物品充满了奥术能量！: Your item is infused with arcane energy!
text.这个菱晶蕴含着和升级卷轴同样强大的魔力，不过这种魔力更为稳定。\n\n这个菱晶在:
This spell possesses the same magical power as a scroll of upgrade, but in a more stable form.

In addition to upgrading an item as normal it will never erase an enchantment, glyph, or curse.
text.没有传送物品的目标地点。: There is nowhere for you to port an item to.
text.这个结晶能够通过魔法传送任何成为施法目标的物品。但不同于商人信标，这些物品会被传: This spell will magically transport any item it is cast on. Unlike a merchant's beacon however, the items will be transported to the entrance of the next boss floor.
text.那里没什么可传送的东西。: There is nothing to teleport there.
text.这个充满混沌能量的结晶会将目标单位传送到本层随机位置。被传送的角色会被麻痹相当长: This chaotic spell will teleport any character it is aimed at to a random location on the current floor, and stun them for a significant amount of time. Powerful foes will be able to resist the stunning effect. This spell can be directed at a target or at the user themselves.
text.施放晶柱将在目标位置产生一次_%s_的效果。: The spell is currently ready to trigger a _%s._
text.这个晶柱蕴含着DM-300残余的机械能量。当对一个未触发的陷阱使用时，陷阱的力量:
This spell contains remnants of the mechanical energy of DM-300. When cast on an active trap, the power of the trap will become attached to you, allowing you to use the spell again to expel this power and trigger the trap's effect at any location you like.

However, some traps may not function in all places, and only one trap can be stored at a time.
text.这个菱晶蕴含着弱化的嬗变魔力。虽然不能对装备使用，但它能将卷轴、药剂、种子、符石: This spell contains a lesser form of transmutation magic. While it won't work on equipment, this spell will transform a scroll, potion, seed, runestone, or tipped dart into a random item of the same type.
text.这个晶柱联系着用于制造它的元素余烬的能量，能够召唤出一个友好的元素助你战斗！同一: This spell channels the energy of the elemental embers used to make it, and will allow you to summon a friendly elemental to fight with you! Only one elemental can be summoned at a time, but the spell can be re-cast to return the elemental to you at no cost.
text.这个晶柱尚未被灌注，只能召唤一个不会远程攻击的_新生元素_。你可以用已鉴定的液火: The spell is currently unimbued, and will summon a _newborn elemental_ without a ranged attack. You can imbue an identified potion of liquid flame, potion of frost, scroll of recharging, or scroll of transmutation to power the spell up, causing future summons to be a full power elemental!
text.这个晶柱触感灼热，可用来召唤出一个_火焰元素_。你可以通过灌注的方法覆盖当前的充: The spell is currently hot to the touch, it will summon a _fire elemental_. You can imbue a different item, but the spell will lose its current imbue.
text.这个晶柱触感冰冷，可用来召唤出一个_冰霜元素_。你可以通过灌注的方法覆盖当前的充: The spell is currently cold to the touch, it will summon a _frost elemental_. You can imbue a different item, but the spell will lose its current imbue.
text.这个晶柱散发着静电能量，可用来召唤出一个_电光元素_。你可以通过灌注的方法覆盖当: The spell is currently radiating static energy, it will summon a _shock elemental_. You can imbue a different item, but the spell will lose its current imbue.
text.这个晶柱散发着混沌能量，可用来召唤出一个_混沌元素_。你可以通过灌注的方法覆盖当: The spell is currently radiating chaotic energy, it will summon a _chaos elemental_. You can imbue a different item, but the spell will lose its current imbue.
text.这个结晶允许使用者远程抓取一格所有的物体，或从敌人身上取回卡住的投掷武器！\n\:
This spell allows the caster to remotely grab all items at a location, or all thrown weapons stuck to an enemy!

It can't be used to grab items that someone else owns, or to grab containers like chests.
text.这块黑色方形小水晶的每个面都浮动着变幻莫测的符文。\n\n激活时，它将随机触发一:
This small black square crystal has shifting runic symbols on each of its surfaces.

When activated, it will trigger the effect of a random scroll. The scroll effect will always be combat focused if there are enemies in your field of view, and will always be non-combat focused otherwise.
text.这个结晶中含有部分驱动DM-300的诅咒之力。当施放时，它会为你的法杖与佩戴着的: This spell contains some of the cursed energy which powered DM-300. When cast, it will recharge your wands and worn artifacts, while also triggering a random cursed wand effect. You are able to choose a direction for this cursed magic to shoot in, however.
text.当把这颗符石丢向一个盟友或敌人时，附近所有敌人都会在短时间内优先攻击该单位。\n:
When this stone is thrown at an ally or enemy, all nearby enemies will prefer to attack that character for a short time.

Boss enemies cannot be targeted by this effect directly, but it does work on their minions.
text.支配魔法正使附近所有敌人优先攻击该单位。\n\n剩余回合数：%s:
Manipulative magic is making all nearby enemies prefer to attack this character.

Turns remaining: %s.

text.这团泛着微光的金色粉尘在暗无边际的地牢中熠熠生辉。魔能触媒可被置入炼金釜中，结合:
This ball of magical golden dust glimmers in the darkness of the dungeon. This catalyst can be used at an alchemy pot with a little alchemical energy to produce a unique trinket item.

Trinkets provide various different effects that slightly alter the dungeon or its inhabitants. Trinkets can be upgraded with more energy to make their effect more powerful, or dropped to forego the effect entirely.
text.就近的一件物品被塞进了一个你打不开的包裹内。\n\n炼金反应可以将包裹溶解，但是:
One nearby item is stuck inside a pouch that you can't get open.

The alchemy process will dissolve the pouch away, but you won't know what trinket you'll get until you do it!
text.该物品在你通过炼金合成饰物时有概率作为选项。: This item has a chance to be an option whenever you craft a trinket via alchemy.
text.你死于自己的%s。: You were killed by your own %s.
text.明耀的光芒从你的法杖迸射而出！: Brilliant light erupts from your wand!
text.你的法杖变化成了另一样东西！: Your wand transmogrifies into a different item!
text.你的道具变化成了另一样东西！: Your item transmogrifies into something different!
text.你的外貌在你眼前发生了变化！: Your appearance changes before your eyes!
text.一颗灼热的能量球开始膨胀。情况不妙，走为上计！: A blazing ball of energy starts to grow. You might want to run!
text.一颗灼热的能量球开始膨胀，但不知何故它似乎很安全。: A blazing ball of energy starts to grow, but it feels safe somehow.
text.你周围的地板在迅速崩塌！: The ground starts to give way around you!
text.地板在迅速崩塌，但你感觉脚下足够结实。: The ground starts to give way, but feels solid enough beneath you.
text.重力突然开始向随机方向牵引！: Gravity suddenly starts to pull in random directions!
text.重力突然开始向随机方向牵引，但这对你没有影响。: Gravity suddenly starts to pull in random directions, but this doesn't seem to affect you.
text.你的法杖滋滋作响；一定是没能量了。: Your wand fizzles; it must not have enough charge.
text.你的法杖滋滋作响；你不能在魔法免疫时使用法杖。: Your wand fizzles; you cannot use wands while magic immune.
text.你对你的法杖已经足够熟悉并将其完全鉴定。: You are now familiar enough with your wand to identify it.
text.这根法杖已经从奥术树脂获得了_1_次升级。: This wand has gained _1 level_ from arcane resin.
text.这根法杖已经从奥术树脂获得了_%d_次升级。: This wand has gained _%d levels_ from arcane resin.
text.这根法杖受到了诅咒，导致它的魔法混乱而随机。: This wand is cursed, making its magic chaotic and random.
text.这根法杖没有被诅咒。: This wand is free of malevolent magic.
You killed yourself with your own Wand of Blast Wave...
text.这根法杖由一种大理石石材制成，嵌有金饰并在顶部镶着一个浑圆的黑宝石。它在你手中的: This wand is made of a sort of marbled stone, with gold trim and a round black gem at the tip. It feels very weighty in your hand.
text.这根法杖能射出在目标地点剧烈爆炸的魔法飞弹。爆炸的威力通常会造成_%1$d~%2: This wand shoots a bolt which violently detonates at a target location. The force of this blast typically deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and is strong enough to send most enemies flying.
text.这根法杖能射出一股能量，在目标位置引发强烈的爆炸。爆炸的力量会造成_%1$d~%: This wand shoots a bolt which violently detonates at a target location. The force of this blast deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and is strong enough to send most enemies flying.
text.当_战斗法师_以冲击波魔杖近战攻击已经被麻痹的目标时，将消耗目标身上剩余的麻痹回: When _the Battlemage_ strikes a paralyzed enemy with a staff of blast wave, it will consume the paralysis to deal a burst of bonus magic damage. This has a short cooldown per-enemy.
text.冲击波魔杖的元素风暴造成67%伤害，并将所有目标弹出影响区域。: An elemental blast with a staff of blast wave deals 67% damage and knocks all enemies outside of the blast area.
text.这根法杖的灰色主干顶端镶嵌着一颗明亮的橙色宝石。: This wand has an ashen body which opens to a brilliant orange gem.
text.这根法杖能射出一颗会在目标位置爆炸成一团腐蚀酸雾的法球。进入酸雾的任何单位都会持: This wand shoots a bolt which explodes into a cloud of highly corrosive gas at a targeted location. Anything caught inside this cloud will take increasing damage over time, starting at _%d damage._
text.当_战斗法师_以酸蚀魔杖近战攻击目标时，有概率使其沾染腐蚀淤泥。: When _the Battlemage_ strikes an enemy with a staff of corrosion, the enemy has a chance to become oozed.
text.酸蚀魔杖的元素风暴对所有目标造成起始伤害为6点的4回合酸蚀。: An elemental blast with a staff of corrosion inflicts enemies with 4 turns of corrosion, starting at 6 damage.
text.这个角色已经被你腐化。: That character cannot be influenced further.
text.这根法杖能发射混乱的黑暗能量，法杖尖端的那个小头骨装饰很是应景。: This wand radiates chaotic dark energy, if that weren't already obvious from the small decorative skull shaped onto its tip.
text.这根法杖会释放腐坏的能量，能削弱敌人并最终将他们扭曲为你的奴仆。敌人能抵抗腐化，: This wand will release a blast of corrupting energy which will debuff enemies and eventually bend them to your will. Enemies are able to resist the corruption, but weakened enemies are much easier to corrupt than healthy ones.
text.当_战斗法师_以腐化魔杖近战攻击目标时，有概率使其陷入狂乱。: When _the Battlemage_ strikes an enemy with a staff of corruption, the enemy has a chance to become amoked.
text.腐化魔杖的元素风暴对所有目标造成5回合狂乱。: An elemental blast with a staff of corruption inflicts enemies with 5 turns of amok.
text.这根法杖由一整块光滑的黑曜石制成，深紫色的光自其边缘流向法杖顶端。它闪烁着破坏性: This wand is made from a solid smooth chunk of obsidian, with a deep purple light running up its side, ending at the tip. It glows with destructive energy, waiting to shoot forward.
text.这根法杖射出的光束能穿透任何障碍物，并将随着法杖等级的提升而射得更远。光束会造成: This wand shoots a beam that pierces any obstacle, and will go farther the more it is upgraded. The beam deals _%1$d-%2$d damage,_ and will also deal bonus damage for each enemy and wall it penetrates.
text.当_战斗法师_以解离魔杖作为近战武器时，魔杖会像索敌附魔一样获得额外的攻击距离。: When wielded by _the Battlemage_, a staff of disintegration has increased attack range, as if it had a projecting enchantment.
text.解离魔杖的元素风暴无视墙壁并对所有目标造成100%的伤害。: An elemental blast with a staff of disintegration deals 100% damage and pierces through walls.
text.这根法杖由红漆木制成，饰以金叶，这使它看起来相当庄严。它的顶端噼啪作响嘶嘶而鸣，: This wand is made from red-lacquered wood with golden leaf used liberally to make it look quite regal. It crackles and hisses at the tip, eager to unleash its powerful magic.
text.这根法杖在使用时会产生一股强大的焰浪，延伸出一个锥形区域。下一次使用它将消耗_%: This wand blasts out a cone of fire when used. Its next attack will consume _%1$d charges_ and deal _%2$d-%3$d damage._ The more charges the wand uses, the larger and stronger the effect.
text.当_战斗法师_以焰浪魔杖近战攻击目标时，有概率吸收所有邻近的火焰并制造出一场爆炸: When _the Battlemage_ strikes an enemy with a staff of fireblast, there is a chance for it to produce an explosion that damages enemies and consumes all nearby fire! This chance increases the more fire is adjacent to the enemy.
text.焰浪魔杖的元素风暴造成100%伤害，冲开范围内的门，并使目标与地形起火。: An elemental blast with a staff of fireblast deals 100% damage, bursts open doors, and sets enemies and terrain on fire.
text.这根法杖似乎由某种魔法冰块制成。它的圆顶闪着亮光。握起来很冰，但不知为何你的手仍: This wand seems to be made out of some kind of magical ice. It grows brighter towards its rounded tip. It feels very cold when held, but somehow your hand stays warm.
text.这根法杖能向你的敌人射击冰霜能量，造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_并冻伤目标，在: This wand shoots blasts of icy energy toward your foes, dealing _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and chilling. The effect seems stronger in water. Enemies that are already chilled or frozen take less damage from this wand.
text.当_战斗法师_以冰霜魔杖近战攻击目标时，有概率将其直接冻结。目标冻伤越严重，被冻: When _the Battlemage_ strikes a chilled enemy with a staff of frost, they have a chance to instantly freeze. This chance becomes greater the more chilled they are.
text.冰霜魔杖的元素风暴造成100%伤害，冻结敌人并熄灭火焰。: An elemental blast with a staff of frost deals 100% damage, freezes enemies, and puts out fires.
You killed yourself with your own Wand of Lightning...
text.这根法杖由实心金属制成，这使它惊人地沉重。电弧在顶端两个内弯的叉齿间跳跃。: This wand is made out of solid metal, making it surprisingly heavy. Two prongs curve together at the tip, and electricity arcs between them.
text.这根法杖能向任何瞄准的地方射出强大的电弧，造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_。这道: This wand sends powerful lightning arcing through whatever it is shot at, dealing _%1$d-%2$d damage._ This electricity will arc to nearby characters, and spreads more easily in water. The arcs from this wand can damage you, but won't hurt your allies.
text.当_战斗法师_以雷霆魔杖近战攻击目标时，有概率获得10回合起电效果。起电状态下的: When _the Battlemage_ strikes an enemy with a staff of lightning, he has a chance to electrically charge himself for 10 turns. While charged the Battlemage is immune to lightning damage and will arc lightning further.
text.雷霆魔杖的元素风暴造成100%伤害，击晕目标5回合并使水带电。: An elemental blast with a staff of lightning deals 100% damage, stuns enemies for 5 turns, and electrifies water.
text.战斗法师现已被充能，获得了对其雷霆魔杖的伤害免疫并扩大了其电弧的连锁范围。\n\:
The Battlemage is currently charged with energy, granting him immunity to his staff of lightning and increasing the range that lightning can arc from it.

Turns Remaining: %s.
text.这根法杖由一种奇妙的石头组成，你能从几道微微发光的黄色条纹中感受到能量波动。握住: This wand is made from a curious rock, with bands of glowing yellow energy. The rocks seem to shift slightly as you grip the wand, as if they can feel your hand.
text.这根法杖能向敌人发射魔法泥石，造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_。泥石随后会回归使: This wand sends bolts of magical rock at enemies, dealing _%1$d-%2$d damage._ The rocks will then re-form around the user, granting them armor in proportion to the damage dealt. If enough armor is built, it will form into a rock guardian when the wand is next zapped.
text.当_战斗法师_以灵壤魔杖近战攻击目标时，能将部分近战伤害转化为灵壤护甲。: When _the Battlemage_ strikes an enemy with a staff of living earth, some of the damage dealt is returned as rock armor.
text.灵壤魔杖的元素风暴造成50%伤害，每击中一个目标，治疗已激活的灵壤守卫一次。: An elemental blast with a staff of living earth deals 50% damage, and heals an active earthen guardian for each enemy hit.
text.魔法泥石环绕在你身边，当你被攻击时泥石会尽其所能进行格挡，从而为你抵消50%%所:
Magical rocks are surrounding your body, when you are attacked they will attempt to block for you, and will reduce the damage you take by 50%%. Each damage blocked scrapes away some of the rock however.

Remaining Armor: %1$d.

If enough rock is built around you, the next zap from your wand of living earth will cause the rocks to form up into a guardian which will fight with you.

Armor needed for Guardian: %2$d.
text.该灵壤守卫已被万物一心强化。剩余回合数：%d: This earthen guardian is also benefitting from Power of Many. Turns Remaining: %d.
text.灵壤法杖发射的魔法泥石组成了一尊灵壤守卫！这个有棱有角的大块头会攻击附近的敌人，: The rocks from your wand of living earth have formed into a protective earthen guardian! This rocky protector will attack nearby enemies, which will force them to attack the guardian instead of you. When all nearby threats are gone, the guardian will re-form around you, and will return when you next use your wand.
text.守卫的防御力与你的法杖等级相关。它当前能抵挡_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_。: The guardian's defensive power is tied to the level of your wand. It currently blocks _%1$d-%2$d damage._
text.你可通过某根法杖遇到该单位。: You can find this character with a specific wand.
text.这根十分普通的法杖能发射由纯魔法能量构成的飞弹。尽管法杖本身没有什么花哨的特效，: This fairly plain wand launches missiles of pure magical energy. While the wand itself lacks any special effects, it has more available charges and can briefly empower other wands when upgraded.
text.从法杖中发出的魔法飞弹会对单个目标造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_，如果被升级则: Each bolt from this wand deals _%1$d-%2$d damage,_ and will briefly empower other wands if it is upgraded.
text.当_战斗法师_以魔弹魔杖近战攻击目标时，魔杖外的所有的法杖都会恢复一定的充能。: When _the Battlemage_ strikes an enemy with a staff of magic missile, all of his wands will gain charge in addition to his staff.
text.魔弹魔杖的元素风暴造成50%伤害，并使法师获得15回合的法杖充能效果。: An elemental blast with a staff of magic missile deals 50% damage, and grants the mage 15 turns of recharging.
text.你的魔弹法杖向其他法杖回馈了一股能量，提升着下一次施法的有效等级。\n\n其他法:
Your wand of magic missile has fed power back into your wands, boosting the effective level of the next zap they make.

Your wands are boosted to: +%d.

Turns of magic charge remaining: %s.
text.这根法杖由一块实心半透明水晶构成，就像一块厚长光滑的玻璃。一粒粒彩色的光点在法杖: This wand is made of a solid piece of translucent crystal, like a long chunk of smooth glass. Small bits of colorful light dance around the tip of the wand, eager to burst forth.
text.这根法杖射出的光线能刺破地牢的黑暗，揭露隐藏的区域和陷阱。光线能致盲敌人并造成_: This wand shoots rays of light which cut through the darkness of the dungeon, revealing hidden areas and traps. The beam can blind enemies, and deals _%1$d-%2$d damage._ Demonic and undead foes will burn in the bright light of the wand, taking bonus damage.
text.当_战斗法师_以棱光魔杖近战攻击目标时，能使目标陷入随魔杖等级提升而延长的残废效: When _the Battlemage_ strikes an enemy with a staff of prismatic light, they will be crippled for a duration that scales with staff level.
text.棱光魔杖的元素风暴造成67%伤害，揭示区域内所有地形，致盲所有目标5回合。: An elemental blast with a staff of prismatic light deals 67% damage, reveals all terrain in the blast, and blinds enemies for 5 turns.
text.这根法杖由一根细长木枝巧琢而成。不知为何，它还活着而且生机盎然，像一株树苗的嫩芽: This wand is made from a thin shaft of expertly carved wood. Somehow it is still alive and vibrant, bright green like a young tree's core. "When life ceases new life always begins to grow... The eternal cycle always remains!"
text.在施放时，这根法杖将向一个扇形区域倾洒出再生的能量。这种魔法会让草、根系甚至稀有: When used, this wand will blast magical regrowth energy outward in a cone, causing grass, roots, and rare plants to spring to life. Its next zap will consume _%1$d charges_. The more charges the wand uses, the larger and stronger the effect.
text.法杖的再生魔力将在释放_%d点充能_后开始消退，那时它将难以再次使植物或高草复生: After another _%d charges_ this wand will start failing to produce plants and fresh grass. This limit is increased by leveling up or upgrading the wand.
text.当_战斗法师_以再生魔杖近战攻击目标时，如果一方站在草地上，则战斗法师能获取伤害: When _the Battlemage_ strikes an enemy with a staff of regrowth, and either are standing on grass, he will gain herbal healing in proportion with the damage dealt.
text.再生魔杖的元素风暴使所有目标被缠绕，并令范围内随机长出高草。: An elemental blast with a staff of regrowth roots enemies and grows grass randomly over the blasts area.
text.结露草是一种蓄满了魔法露水的奇妙植物。它们想将自己伪装成杂草来避开注意，但其鼓胀: Dewcatchers are wondrous plants that fill themselves with magical dew. They attempt to camouflage as grass to avoid attention, but their bulges of collected dew give them away.
text.你可通过某根法杖找到该植物。: You can find this plant with a specific wand.
text.种子荚是一种会结出其他各类植物种子的魔法植物。它们没有自己的种子，却还是以某种方: Seed Pods are magical plants that produce seeds from other plant types, rather than any seeds of their own. They somehow manage to spread despite having no seed of their own.
text.黄金莲是一种只能被强大的再生法杖创造的神秘植物。它的光环会增强所有植物相关效果，: The golden lotus is a mystical plant that can only be conjured by a powerful wand of regrowth. Its aura enhances all plants and plant effects, but it burns through its energy and dies after a short time.
text.这株黄金莲由一根_%1$d级_的再生法杖产出。在其作用范围内，所有被种植到某单位: This lotus was produced by a _+%1$d_ wand of regrowth. All plants in its effect will _instantly trigger_ if they are planted on a character. Plants will also have a _%2$d%% chance_ to drop their seed, and tipped darts will use _%3$d%% less durability_.
text.你可通过经数次升级后的某根法杖找到该植物。: You can find this plant with a specific wand, after upgrading it several times.
You killed yourself with your own Wand of Transfusion...
text.敌人的生命能量流进了你的魔杖！: Your staff is charged with the life energy of your enemy!
text.这根法杖形状很普通，是那暗红的色泽和镶在顶端的漆黑宝石让它显眼起来。: A fairly plainly shaped wand, it stands out due to its magenta hue and pitch black gem at the tip.
text.这根法杖对盟友或被魅惑的敌人释放时会消耗你_%1$d点生命_并赋予目标_%2$d: When used on allies or charmed enemies, this wand will sap _%1$d of the user's health_ to heal or shield the ally for _%2$d health._ When used on enemies, the wand briefly charms them while applying _%3$d shielding_ to the user. Hostile undead will take _%4$d-%5$d damage_ instead of being charmed.
text.当_战斗法师_以注魂魔杖近战攻击被魅惑的目标时，能获取一定的护盾且下次释放不消耗: When _the Battlemage_ strikes a charmed enemy with a staff of transfusion, he will gain shielding and his next zap with the staff will not cost any health.
text.注魂魔杖的元素风暴会在范围内魅惑所有敌人、治疗所有友军，对敌对亡灵生物造成100: An elemental blast with a staff of transfusion charms enemies, heals allies, and deals 100% damage to undead enemies.
text.你的法杖无法维持更多的哨卫。: Your wand can't sustain any more wards.
text.你不能在那里设置一个哨卫。: You can't place a ward there.
text.这根短小的金属法杖尖端上有一颗亮紫色宝石悬空浮动。: This short metal wand has a bright purple gem floating above its tip.
text.这根法杖并不能直接攻击敌人，但可以召唤出哨卫元素与哨卫结晶。你可以在视野中的任何: Rather than directly damaging an enemy, this wand will summon stationary wards and sentries. Wards can be summoned anywhere, even through walls if you have vision. This wand can sustain _%d energy_ worth of wards at a time.
text.当_战斗法师_以哨卫魔杖近战攻击目标时，有概率为所有哨卫元素和哨卫结晶恢复一定生: When _the Battlemage_ strikes an enemy with a staff of warding, all active wards and sentries have a chance to be healed.
text.哨卫魔杖的元素风暴会治疗范围内的所有哨卫元素和结晶。: An elemental blast with a staff of warding heals all wards and sentries in the blast area.
text.这个哨卫元素会自动攻击进入视野的目标。\n\n使用哨卫法杖向该哨卫施法能使其升级:
This ward will automatically zap any enemy which comes into its range of vision.

Zapping this ward with your wand of warding will upgrade it.

Wards have a limited number of zaps before dissipating.
text.这个哨卫结晶攻击力与哨卫元素相同，但以生命值取代了有限的发动次数。它的样子有点像:
This sentry has the same firepower as a ward, but has health instead of a set number of charges. It resembles the gem at the tip of your wand of warding.

Zapping this sentry with your wand of warding will upgrade and heal it.

This sentry will spend some health each time it zaps an enemy, but can be healed by using your wand of warding on it.
text.这个最基本的哨卫元素会自动攻击进入视野的目标，造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害。_:
This basic ward will automatically zap any enemy which comes into its range of vision, dealing _%1$d-%2$d damage._

Zapping this ward with your wand of warding will upgrade it.

This ward will only zap a single time before dissipating.

Your wand of warding is using _%3$d energy_ to sustain this ward.
text.这个升级过的哨卫元素结构更精致，而且在攻击数次后才会消散。它每次发动攻击能造成_:
This upgraded ward has a more intricate pattern, and can attack multiple times. Each zap from this ward will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage._

Zapping this ward with your wand of warding will upgrade it.

This ward will zap three times before dissipating.

Your wand of warding is using _%3$d energy_ to sustain this ward.
text.这个满级的哨卫元素能发动更多次攻击，而且攻击速度更快。它每次发动攻击能造成_%1:
This fully upgraded ward is able to attack more times than its predecessors. Each zap from this ward will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage._

Zapping this ward with your wand of warding will upgrade it.

This ward will zap five times before dissipating.

Your wand of warding is using _%3$d energy_ to sustain this ward.
text.这个小小的哨卫结晶攻击力与大哨卫元素相同，但以生命值取代了有限的发动次数。它的样:
This smaller sentry has the same firepower as a greater ward, but has health instead of a set number of charges. It resembles the gem at the tip of your wand of warding. Each zap from this sentry will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage._

Zapping this sentry with your wand of warding will upgrade and heal it.

This sentry will spend some health each time it zaps an enemy, but can be healed by using your wand of warding on it.

Your wand of warding is using _%3$d energy_ to sustain this sentry.
text.这个升级过的哨卫结晶比小哨卫结晶体积更大，形体也更结实。它每次发动攻击能造成_%:
This upgraded sentry is larger and more durable than a lesser sentry. Each zap from this sentry will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage._

Zapping this sentry with your wand of warding will upgrade and heal it.

This sentry will spend some health each time it zaps an enemy, but can be healed by using your wand of warding on it.

Your wand of warding is using _%3$d energy_ to sustain this sentry.
text.这个满级的哨卫结晶比之前的坚固了不少。它每次发动攻击能造成_%1$d~%2$d点:
This fully upgraded sentry is significantly more durable than its predecessors. Each zap from this sentry will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage._

Zapping this sentry with your wand of warding will heal it.

This sentry will spend some health each time it zaps an enemy, but can be healed by using your wand of warding on it.

Your wand of warding is using _%3$d energy_ to sustain this sentry.
text.不想让法杖继续维持这个哨卫的话，你可以选择驱散它立即将其破坏移除。\n\n要驱散:
You can dispel this ward if you no longer want your wand to maintain it. Doing so immediately destroys the ward.

Dismiss this ward?
text.现在是打BOSS的时间吗！？: ARE WE AT THE BOSS YET!?
text.我去，别这么用力！: OUCH, DON'T SWING ME SO HARD!
text.我曾经不想成为武器，而是想成为伐木工人的斧头。: I didn't want to be a weapon, I wanted to be a lumberjack's axe.
text.要时刻警醒：骄傲自满是位缓慢却阴险的杀手。: Remember, overconfidence is a slow and insidious killer.
text.敌羞，吾去脱他衣！: ALL YOUR BASE ARE BELONG TO US!
text.喧闹诅咒的武器真的是想帮你，只不过它的吵闹无比的“帮助”总是会吸引大量敌人。: Annoying weapons are capable of speech, but they're a bit too energetic. They will often draw attention to you without meaning to.
text.武器拥有喧闹诅咒时，元素打击对范围内的每个敌人都有20%概率造成持续6回合的狂乱: An elemental strike with an annoying curse has a 20% chance to amok each enemy in range for 6 turns.
text.炫目武器会不时释放刺目的强光，致盲所有视野范围内的单位。: Dazzling weapons will sometimes flash with dazzling light, blinding everything that can see them.
text.武器拥有炫目诅咒时，元素打击对范围内的每个敌人都有50%概率造成持续6回合的失明: An elemental strike with a dazzling curse has a 50% chance to blind each enemy in range for 6 turns.
text.转移诅咒的武器被灌注了混乱的传送魔法，会将敌人传送到当前层的随机位置。: Displacing weapons are infused with chaotic teleportation magic, possessing the ability to warp enemies around the floor randomly.
text.武器拥有转移诅咒时，元素打击对范围内的每个敌人都有50%概率进行传送。: An elemental strike with a displacing curse has a 50% chance to teleport each enemy in range.
text.易爆诅咒的武器会缓缓积累能量并最终爆炸，爆炸会对所有邻近单位造成伤害。: Explosive weapons steadily build up power and explode, damaging anything nearby.
text.你的武器目前触感冰凉，尚属正常。: Your weapon is currently cool to the touch.
Your weapon is building energy and getting warm...
text.你的武器已灼热烫手！要爆炸了！: Your weapon is hot! It's about to explode!
text.武器拥有易爆诅咒时，元素打击有着50%的概率在范围内随机一个敌人身上产生爆炸。: An elemental strike with an explosive curse has a 50% chance to cause an explosion to appear on a random enemy in range.
text.友善诅咒的武器会偶尔触发让战斗无法进行的魔法，非常适合和平主义者。: Friendly weapons are best suited for pacifists, occasionally triggering magic that makes it impossible to fight.
text.武器拥有友善诅咒时，元素打击对范围内的每个敌人都有50%概率造成持续6回合的魅惑: An elemental strike with a friendly curse has a 50% chance to charm each enemy in range for 6 turns.
text.极化武器受到诅咒魔力的影响，在攻击时只会出现1.5倍伤害或完全没有伤害的情况。: A polarized weapon is affected by magic that causes its attack to either deal 50% more damage, or no damage at all.
text.武器拥有极化诅咒时，元素打击对范围内的每个敌人都有50%概率造成24~36点伤害: An elemental strike with a polarized curse has a 50% chance to deal 24-36 damage to each enemy in range.
text.激流诅咒的武器可以喷流出强劲的水爆，击退包括你在内的一切事物。: Pressurized weapons are capable of erupting with a forceful geyser of water which knocks everything away, including you.
text.武器拥有激流诅咒时，元素打击会创造破坏地形并击退范围内所有敌人的巨浪。: An elemental strike with a pressurized curse will create a wave of water that destroys terrain and knocks back every enemy in range.
text.血祭诅咒会向使用者索求血液作为攻击的回报，你的状态越健康，诅咒索取的也就越多。: Sacrificial weapons will demand blood from the wearer in return for attacking foes. The more healthy the wearer is, the more blood the curse will take.
text.武器拥有血祭诅咒时，元素打击对英雄自身与范围内的每一个敌人都造成初始值为12点的: An elemental strike with a sacrificial curse causes the hero and each enemy in range to bleed for 12 HP.
text.妄为诅咒的武器会时常变得极其不精准。触发时这种魔法会持续一小会，但会在成功使用妄: Wayward weapons will sometimes become extremely inaccurate. This magic lasts for a little while when it activates, but can be dispelled by landing a blow with the wayward weapon.
text.武器拥有妄为诅咒时，元素打击对范围内的每个敌人都有50%概率造成持续6回合的幻惑: An elemental strike with a wayward curse has a 50% chance to hex each enemy in range for 6 turns.
text.你的妄为武器上的魔法已被触发，现在它已变得极度不精准。这个魔法无法影响如伏击等必:
Your wayward weapon's magic has activated, making it extremely inaccurate for a short time. Note that this does not affect attacks which are guaranteed to hit, such as surprise attacks. Successfully attacking with the wayward weapon will clear this effect immediately.

Turns remaining: %s.
text.奇迹诅咒的武器内含与诅咒法杖同源的混沌魔力。没人知道这个诅咒触发时到底会发生些什: Wondrous weapons contain the same chaotic magic found in cursed wands. There's no telling what will happen when this curse triggers!
text.武器拥有奇迹诅咒时，元素打击有概率对范围内的所有敌人施放一种不同的诅咒法杖效果。: An elemental strike with a wondrous curse has a chance to apply a different cursed wand effect to every enemy in range.
text.这个附魔会使火焰从武器中喷薄而出，能够点燃敌人并对正在燃烧的敌人造成额外伤害。: This enchantment causes flames to spit forth from a weapon, igniting enemies and dealing bonus damage to enemies that are already aflame.
text.武器拥有烈焰附魔时，元素打击会将火焰扩散到范围内全部地块，持续8回合。: An elemental strike with a blazing enchantment spreads fire to every tile in range, which lasts 8 turns.
text.招架附魔的武器在攻击后有几率短暂为你提供保护。: Blocking weapons have a chance to briefly shield you after attacking with them.
text.武器拥有招架附魔时，元素打击范围内每有一个敌人，决斗家就会获得6点护盾。: An elemental strike with a blocking enchantment grants the Duelist an extra 6 shielding for each enemy in range.
text.你的武器的招架附魔短时间内增强了你的防御能力！\n\n护盾剩余：%d\n\n剩余:
Your weapon's blocking enchantment has granted you a brief boost to your defensive power!

Shielding remaining: %d

Turns remaining: %s.
text.繁茂武器具有催生植物的魔力，在攻击目标时能使目标或周围的植被发芽生长。: Blooming weapons contain magic which will cause vegetation to sprout on or around those struck by them.
text.武器拥有繁茂附魔时，元素打击会在范围内最多8个地块上生成高草，并使范围内所有敌人: An elemental strike with a blooming enchantment spreads grass to up to 8 tiles in range, and roots all enemies in range for 6 turns.
text.受该附魔成功影响的敌人会被冻伤，导致移动和攻击速度降低。: Enemies struck with this enchantment are chilled, slowing their movement and attacks.
text.武器拥有寒霜附魔时，元素打击会将寒气扩散到范围的全部地块，持续8个回合。: An elemental strike with a chilling enchantment spreads chilling air to every tile in range, which lasts 8 turns.
text.你的魔晶武器崭新如初！: Your crystal weapon is fully repaired!
text.幽灵的魔晶武器崭新如初！: The ghost's crystal weapon is fully repaired!
text.你的魔晶武器上的缺损得到了修复。: Your crystal weapon is no longer flawed.
text.幽灵的魔晶武器上的缺损得到了修复。: The ghost's crystal weapon is no longer flawed.
text.你的魔晶武器上的裂纹弥合了。: Your crystal weapon is no longer cracked.
text.幽灵的魔晶武器上的裂纹弥合了。: The ghost's crystal weapon is no longer cracked.
text.你的魔晶武器略有缺损。: Your crystal weapon has become slightly damaged.
text.幽灵的魔晶武器略有缺损。: The ghost's crystal weapon has become slightly damaged.
text.你的魔晶武器已经布满裂纹，马上就要粉碎了！: Your crystal weapon cracks, it's about to break!
text.幽灵的魔晶武器已经布满裂纹，马上就要粉碎了！: The ghost's crystal weapon cracks, it's about to break!
text.你的魔晶武器化为了齑粉！: Your crystal weapon shatters into pieces!
text.幽灵的魔晶武器化为了齑粉！: The ghost's crystal weapon shatters into pieces!
text.这种强力的附魔可以造成额外的魔法伤害并提升武器的价值，但是，如果不加以维修或给其: This powerful enchantment deals extra magic damage and enhances a weapon's value. However, the enchanted weapon can shatter if the crystals aren't repaired, or given time to self-repair.
text.魔晶投掷武器的耐久度相当低，但其可随时间流逝而自我修复。: Crystal thrown weapons have much less durability, but regain it slowly over time.
text.这把魔晶武器目前品相完美。: This crystal weapon is currently in perfect condition.
text.这把魔晶武器目前品相不错。: This crystal weapon is currently in good condition.
text.这把魔晶武器已有缺损，但暂无粉碎的风险。: This crystal weapon has a flaw, but isn't about to break.
text.这把魔晶武器上已经布满裂纹，有永久粉碎的风险！: This crystal weapon is cracking, it's at risk of permanently breaking!
text.武器拥有魔晶附魔时，元素打击会对范围内除主要目标外的每个敌人造成10~20点伤害: An elemental strike with a crystal enchantment deals 10-20 damage and repairs the weapon for every enemy in range, except the primary target.
text.使用恒动附魔的武器击杀敌人时，武器会储存溢出的威力并在下一次成功攻击时释放。: When an enemy is killed with a kinetic weapon, any excess force is stored in the weapon and will be applied to the next successful attack.
text.武器拥有恒动附魔时，元素打击会对范围内除主要目标外的每个敌人都造成伤害，数值为储: An elemental strike with a kinetic enchantment applies 40% of stored damage to each enemy in range, except the primary target.
text.你的武器储存了上个杀敌一击的过剩能量，用来加强你的下次攻击以造成额外伤害。这份能:
Your weapon has stored the excess force from a previous killing blow, and will apply it as bonus damage to your next attack. The energy will slowly fade over time, however.

Conserved Damage: %d.
text.这种强力的附魔拥有将敌人扭曲为你的奴仆的能力。使用腐化附魔的武器击杀敌人时有概率: This powerful enchantment possesses the ability to turn enemies to your will. When an enemy is killed with this weapon, there is a chance they will become corrupted instead of dying.
text.武器拥有腐化附魔时，元素打击范围内除主要目标外的每个敌人都有5~25%的几率被腐: An elemental strike with a corrupting enchantment has a 5-25% chance (based on missing HP) to corrupt each enemy in range, except the primary target.
text.异质附魔的武器会使目睹其攻击的附近敌人心生恐惧，使其狂乱逃离攻击者。: Eldritch weapons strike fear into nearby enemies that witness their strikes, causing them to flee from the attacker.
text.武器拥有异质附魔时，元素打击会为范围内包括主目标的所有敌人施加更为持久的恐惧效果: An elemental strike with an eldritch enchantment applies extended fear to every enemy in range, including the primary target.
text.弹性武器在攻击时有几率把敌人击退较短的距离。: Elastic weapons have a chance to send enemies flying back short distances.
text.武器拥有弹性附魔时，元素打击会将范围内的所有敌人都击退5格。: An elemental strike with an elastic enchantment knocks all enemies in range back 5 tiles.
text.这个强力的附魔拥有瞬间斩杀敌人的力量。敌人越弱，附魔的触发几率越大。: This powerful enchantment possesses the power to instantly execute an enemy. The effect is more likely to occur the weaker the enemy is.
text.武器拥有死神附魔时，元素打击范围内除主要目标外的每个敌人都有6~30%的几率被秒: An elemental strike with a grim enchantment has a 6-30% chance (based on missing HP) to kill each enemy in range, except the primary target.
text.被幸运附魔武器击杀的敌人有几率掉落额外的宝物。: Enemies which are killed by a lucky weapon have a chance to drop extra loot.
text.武器拥有幸运附魔时，对于范围内的每个敌人，元素打击都有12.5%概率在其脚下生成: An elemental strike with a lucky enchantment has a 12.5% chance to spawn loot under each enemy in range. This effect can only trigger once per enemy.
text.这个附魔会使近战武器获得额外的攻击距离。远程武器则能够在瞄准附近目标时穿透墙壁。: With this enchantment melee weapons will gain extra reach. Ranged weapons will penetrate walls when aimed at nearby targets.
text.武器拥有索敌附魔时，元素打击对范围内除主要目标外的每个敌人都造成30%的伤害。: An elemental strike with a projecting enchantment deals 30% damage to each enemy in range, except the primary target.
text.电弧在这个武器上不断地闪烁震荡，能够对邻近所有敌人造成额外伤害。: Electricity arcs from a shocking weapon, dealing extra damage to all nearby enemies.
text.武器拥有电击附魔时，元素打击会将电火花扩散到范围的全部地块，持续8个回合。: An elemental strike with a shocking enchantment spreads electricity to every tile in range, which lasts 8 turns.
text.紊乱附魔的武器散发着混乱能量，每一击都视作具有另一种随机附魔。: This enchantment radiates chaotic energy, acting as a different enchantment with each hit.
text.武器拥有紊乱附魔时，元素打击会对范围内除主要目标以外的其他敌人都造成一种随机附魔: An elemental strike with an unstable enchantment applies a random enchantment effect to each enemy in range, except the primary target.
text.这个强力的附魔能在攻击敌人时吸取其生命能量并恢复使用者的生命。当使用者生命较少时: This powerful enchantment leeches life force from enemies with each blow, funneling it back into the wearer. The effect is stronger the lower the wearer's health.
text.武器拥有血饮附魔时，元素打击范围内每有一个敌人，决斗家就会恢复2.5点生命值。: An elemental strike with a vampiric enchantment heals the Duelist for 2.5 HP for each enemy in range.
text.猛毒附魔的武器可以施加延迟却致命的中毒效果，其每次触发都会使毒性更猛烈。: Venomous weapons inflict a delayed but deadly poison, which becomes more severe each time it is applied.
text.武器拥有猛毒附魔时，元素打击会对范围内除主目标外的敌人会施加额外的延迟中毒效果。: An elemental strike with a venomous enchantment applies additional delayed poison to every enemy in range, except the primary target.
text.锋锐附魔的武器极其致命，其干净利落的攻击有概率对可流血的敌人施加流血效果而非造成: Vorpal weapons are especially deadly, they have a chance to strike so cleanly that they inflict bleed instead of damage to enemies that can bleed.
text.武器拥有斩杀附魔时，元素打击会对范围内出主目标外的所有敌人施加额外的流血效果。: An elemental strike with a vorpal enchantment applies additional bleeding to every enemy in range, except the primary target.
text.这件武器对未察觉你的敌人更有效。: This weapon is stronger against unaware enemies.
text.决斗家握持暗杀之刃时可以_潜行_。这个武技能够使决斗家立即闪现最多3格远，并一般: The Duelist can _sneak_ while wielding an assassin's blade. This ability lets the Duelist instantly blink up to 3 tiles away and typically grants her _%d turns of invisibility._
text.决斗家握持暗杀之刃时可以_潜行_。这个武技能够使决斗家立即闪现最多3格远，并给予: The Duelist can _sneak_ while wielding an assassin's blade. This ability lets the Duelist instantly blink up to 3 tiles away and grants her _%d turns of invisibility._
text.黑曜石制的波浪形短刃，虽轻便但不易用，如果能击中要害足以致命。: A small wavy blade made of obsidian, difficult to use despite being lightweight, but deadly if it finds the right mark.
text.这是一件比较精准的武器。: This is a rather accurate weapon.
text.决斗家可以用战斧使出_重击_。这用尽全力的一击如果是在伏击敌人，则一般会造成_%: The Duelist can perform a _heavy blow_ with a battle axe. This concentrated attack typically deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ if it surprised the enemy, and dazes them for 5 turns which reduces accuracy and evasion by 50%%. Heavy blow always hits but deals regular damage if it does not surprise the enemy.
text.决斗家可以用战斧使出_重击_。这用尽全力的一击如果是在伏击敌人，则会造成_%1$: The Duelist can perform a _heavy blow_ with a battle axe. This concentrated attack deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ if it surprised the enemy, and dazes them for 5 turns which reduces accuracy and evasion by 50%%. Heavy blow always hits but deals regular damage if it does not surprise the enemy.
text.这把有着硕大钢制头部的战斧能将庞大的力量倾注在每次挥舞之中。: The enormous steel head of this battle axe puts considerable heft behind each wide stroke.
text.通常，这件武器在被装备时会强化飞镖以造成_%1$d~%2$d_点伤害，甚至能将其: Typically this weapon enhances thrown darts to deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_ when it is equipped, and will even grant its enchantment to them.
text.这件武器在被装备时会强化飞镖以造成_%1$d~%2$d_点伤害，甚至能将其附魔赋: This weapon enhances thrown darts to deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_ when it is equipped, and will even grant its enchantment to them.
text.决斗家可以为十字弩_蓄势_。这个武技能使下一次攻击必定命中，并将视情况触发以下三: The Duelist can _charge_ her crossbow, causing her next regular attack with it to always hit and apply one of three effects: melee attacks will knock enemies away, untipped darts will typically deal _+%1$d damage_, and tipped darts will apply their effect in a 7x7 area and typically last for _%2$d more uses_.

The Duelist can _charge_ her crossbow, causing her next regular attack with it to always hit and apply one of three effects: melee attacks will knock enemies away, untipped darts will deal _+%1$d damage_, and tipped darts will apply their effect in a 7x7 area and last for _%2$d more uses_.
text.这是一件看起来相当精密复杂的装置，能够将飞镖一样的小型箭矢以极高的速度射出。这把: A fairly intricate weapon which shoots bolts at exceptional speeds. While it isn't designed for it, this crossbow's heft and sturdy construction make it a decent melee weapon as well.
text.决斗家正将能量集中于她的十字弩。这个武技能使她的下一次攻击必定命中，并将视情况触:
The Duelist is focusing power into her crossbow. The next attack she makes with it will always hit and apply one of three effects:
- Melee attacks will knock enemies a few tiles away.
- Untipped darts will deal bonus damage.
- Tipped darts will gain extra uses and apply their effect in a 7x7 area. Positive dart effects will only affect allies, and harmful effects will only apply to enemies. The Duelist cannot use this ability to apply positive dart effects to herself.
text.决斗家可以用权杖使出_重击_。这用尽全力的一击如果是在伏击敌人，则一般会造成_%: The Duelist can perform a _heavy blow_ with a cudgel. This concentrated attack typically deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ if it surprised the enemy, and dazes them for 5 turns which reduces accuracy and evasion by 50%%.
