text.决斗家用矛尖_刺退_在射程内但不与决斗家相邻的敌人，造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤: The Duelist can use the tip of a spear to _spike_ an enemy that is in range but not adjacent. This deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_, knocks the enemy back, and is guaranteed to hit.
text.这是一根装着锋锐铁刺的细长木杆。: A slender wooden rod tipped with sharpened iron.
text.决斗家可以用单手剑_顺劈_敌人。这一般会造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_且必定命: The Duelist can _cleave_ an enemy with a sword. This typically deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and is guaranteed to hit. If cleave kills an enemy it is instantaneous and the Duelist can use cleave again within 5 turns for free.
text.决斗家可以用单手剑_顺劈_敌人，造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_且必定命中。如果: The Duelist can _cleave_ an enemy with a sword. This deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and is guaranteed to hit. If cleave kills an enemy it is instantaneous and the Duelist can use cleave again within 5 turns for free.
text.平衡性良好的剑。不算太大，但是依然比短剑长上不少。: A nicely balanced sword. Not too large, but still notably longer than a shortsword.
text.决斗家已经准备好进行连续的顺劈。这一次顺劈将不会消耗武技充能。\n\n剩余回合数:
The Duelist is ready to follow up on her previous cleave. The next use of cleave will not cost any weapon ability charge.

Turns remaining: %s.
text.决斗家可以用战锤使出_重击_。这用尽全力的一击如果是在伏击敌人，则一般会造成_%: The Duelist can perform a _heavy blow_ with a war hammer. This concentrated attack typically deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ if it surprised the enemy, and dazes them for 5 turns which reduces accuracy and evasion by 50%%. Heavy blow always hits but deals regular damage if it does not surprise the enemy.
text.决斗家可以用战锤使出_重击_。这用尽全力的一击如果是在伏击敌人，则会造成_%1$: The Duelist can perform a _heavy blow_ with a war hammer. This concentrated attack deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ if it surprised the enemy, and dazes them for 5 turns which reduces accuracy and evasion by 50%%. Heavy blow always hits but deals regular damage if it does not surprise the enemy.
text.很少有生物能抵挡这铅铁巨块的辗压，但也只有最强壮的冒险家才能有效使用它。: Few creatures can withstand the crushing blow of this towering mass of lead and steel, but it takes great strength to use effectively.
text.决斗家可以用战镰来_收割_敌人，这破坏性的一击必定命中，一般会造成_%d点伤害_: The Duelist can _harvest_ an enemy with a war scythe. This devastating attack is guaranteed to hit and typically deals _%d damage_. This damage is applied as bleeding if the target isn't immune.
text.决斗家可以用战镰来_收割_敌人，这破坏性的一击必定命中，并会造成_%d点伤害_。: The Duelist can _harvest_ an enemy with a war scythe. This devastating attack is guaranteed to hit and deals _%d damage_. This damage is applied as bleeding if the target isn't immune.
text.这件巨大又笨重的农具被加固了。现在比起收割庄稼，它更适宜于收割敌人。: This large and unwieldy tool has been reinforced to make it better at cutting foes than crops.
text.决斗家可以用长鞭_狠抽_她周围的所有敌人。这一武技一般会对当前每个处于攻击距离内: The Duelist can _lash_ all enemies around her with a whip. This ability typically deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_, attacks all enemies within attack range, and is guaranteed to hit.
text.决斗家可以用长鞭_狠抽_她周围的所有敌人。这一武技对当前每个处于攻击距离内的敌人: The Duelist can _lash_ all enemies around her with a whip. This ability deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_, attacks all enemies within attack range, and is guaranteed to hit.
text.虽然这把武器另一端带倒刺的绳子伤害不高，但它的攻击范围是数一数二的。: While the barbed length of rope at the end of this weapon deals poor damage, its reach cannot be matched.
text.决斗家可以用破旧的短剑_顺劈_敌人。这一般会造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_并且: The Duelist can _cleave_ an enemy with a worn shortsword. This typically deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and is guaranteed to hit. If cleave kills an enemy it is instantaneous and the Duelist can use cleave again within 5 turns for free.
text.决斗家可以用破旧的短剑_顺劈_敌人。造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_并且必定命中: The Duelist can _cleave_ an enemy with a worn shortsword. This deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and is guaranteed to hit. If cleave kills an enemy it is instantaneous and the Duelist can use cleave again within 5 turns for free.
text.一把十分短的剑，在大量使用后有一定的磨损。它比正常情况的短剑更轻，也更弱。: A quite short sword, worn down through heavy use. It is both weaker and a bit lighter than a shortsword in better condition.
text.这些飞镖上涂着一种由速行蓟制成的药物。当目标为友方时，其移动速度和攻击速度都会有: These darts are tipped with a swiftthistle-based compound which will boost the movement and attack speed of allies, or briefly lower the movement speed of enemies. The dart itself is still harmful to enemies, but will not harm allies.
text.这些飞镖上涂着一种由致盲草制成的药物，能让目标失明一小段时间。药效比新鲜的致盲草: These darts are tipped with a blindweed-based compound which will blind their target for a short time. They do not disorient however, so an enemy will still know where they last saw you.
text.这些飞镖上涂着一种由冰冠花制成的药物，能显著地冻伤目标。: These darts are tipped with an icecap-based compound which will significantly chill their target.
text.这些飞镖上涂着一种由魔皇草制成的药物，能使友军暂时对所有负面效果免疫，也可以清除: These darts are tipped with a mageroyal-based compound which will temporarily make allies immune to all negative effects, or will cleanse positive effects from enemies. Enemies may even briefly forget that they are attacking or fleeing from you. The dart itself is still harmful to enemies, but will not harm allies.
text.一粒种子可以为1~2枚飞镖涂药。每种种子都能产生对应的，具有独特效果的一次性涂药:
A seed can be combined with one or two darts to tip them. Each type of seed produces its own type of tipped dart, with a unique single-use effect.

Tipping a dart with these seeds will produce a _%s._
text.由短木杆和金属尖头简易制成，手腕轻抖就会精准地飞向目标。使用种子可以为飞镖涂药，: These simple shafts of spike-tipped wood are weighted to fly true and sting their prey with a flick of the wrist. They can be tipped with seeds to gain bonus effects when thrown.
text.由于其极简的构造，飞镖可永久使用而不损坏。: Due to their simple construction darts will effectively last forever.
text.这些飞镖上涂着一种由消逝草制成的药物，能把目标传送走一小段距离。: These darts are tipped with a fadeleaf-based compound which will teleport their target a short distance away.
text.这些飞镖上涂着一种由阳春草制成的药物，能强效治疗目标的伤势。这只飞镖仍能对敌人造: These darts are tipped with a sungrass-based compound which grants a burst of healing to their target. The dart itself is still harmful to enemies, but will not harm allies.
text.这些飞镖上涂着一种由星陨花制成的药物，能向目标体内注入神圣能量。友方或常规敌人将: These darts are tipped with a starflower-based compound which infuses holy energy into their target. Allies and regular enemies will become blessed, but undead or demonic enemies will take heavy damage. The dart itself is still harmful to enemies, but will not harm allies.
text.这些飞镖上涂着一种由烈焰花制成的药物，命中后会燃起烈焰。: These darts are tipped with a firebloom-based compound which will burst into brilliant flames on impact.
text.这些飞镖上涂着一种由地缚根制成的药物，能让目标无助地麻痹一小段时间。: These darts are tipped with an earthroot-based compound which will paralyze their target for a short time.
text.这些飞镖上涂着一种由断肠苔制成的药物，能使目标中毒。: These darts are tipped with a sorrowmoss-based compound which will poison their target.
text.这种恶毒的飞镖上涂着一种由腐莓制成的酸蚀毒膏，能够蚀穿飞镖触及的任何事物。其上的: These wicked darts are tipped with an acidic rotberry-based compound, which will aggressively eat through anything the dart comes into contact with. Powerful foes will resist most of the effect, but the corrosion is strong enough to easily kill most standard enemies. These last longer than other tipped darts, but their durability cannot be boosted.
text.你可使用某个任务中的种子制作该物品。: You can create this item using a seed from a specific quest.
text.这些飞镖上涂着一种由风暴藤制成的药物，能让目标受到强烈的电击。: These darts are tipped with a stormvine-based compound which will deliver a nasty shock to their target.
text.这项操作会去除飞镖上的涂药，将其变回普通飞镖。: This action will remove the seed tipping on your darts, reverting them back to regular darts.
text.这些涂药飞镖再使用_%d/%d_次就会有一个失去药效。: This stack of darts has _%d/%d_ uses left before one tip wears off.
text._但精良的做工令其经久耐用，不会因为使用过度而损坏。_: _But these are of such high quality that they will effectively last forever._
text.你飞镖上的涂药快要失效了。: Your dart's tip is about to expire.
text.你可在商店中中购买或用种子制作该物品。: You can buy this item in a shop, or create it using a seed.
text.这件武器能使目标残废。: This weapon inflicts cripple on its target.
text.这种造型特殊的远程武器造成的伤害不高，但能够有效迟滞目标的移动。: These unusual ranged weapons aren't very damaging, but do an excellent job of slowing their target.
text.被投向敌人后，这把扁平的曲状木制投掷武器能够自动回到投掷者手中。: Thrown to the enemy this flat curved wooden missile will return to the hands of its thrower.
text.这个回旋镖造得非常结实，使用后不会产生损耗。: Due to its solid construction, this boomerang will not break from use.
text.本用于捕鱼，但作为武器也相当趁手的短投矛。: Tiny throwing spears that work well as an improvised weapon despite being designed for fishing.
You killed yourself with your own Force Cube...
text.这件武器释放出一阵小范围的能量，冲击邻近的所有单位。: This weapon spreads the force of its impact over a small area, hitting everything nearby.
text.这些奇形怪状的魔力方块小到可以握在你的手里，但出乎意料地非常重。: These oddly-shaped magical cubes are small enough to hold in your hand, but are incredibly heavy.
text.这件武器会在被掷出的五回合后旋回至原位置。: This weapon circles back to the location it was thrown from after five turns.
text.这把大号回旋镖笨重难用，但能造成可观的伤害。: This large boomerang is difficult to wield effectively, but will deal considerable damage.
text.这些大号投掷用长枪上的配重保证它们会以尖端为首飞向目标。: These larger throwing spears are weighted to keep the spike at their tip foremost as they sail through the air.
text.技巧高深者能用这种小刀造成可观的伤害。: These small knives are very powerful in the hands of a skilled user.
text.这组_%1$d阶_的投掷武器能造成_%2$d~%3$d点伤害_并且需要_%4$d: This set of _tier-%1$d_ thrown weapons deals _%2$d-%3$d damage_ and requires _%4$d strength_ to use.
text.通常，这组_%1$d阶_投掷武器能造成_%2$d~%3$d点伤害_并且需要_%4: Typically this set of _tier-%1$d_ thrown weapons deals _%2$d-%3$d damage_ and requires _%4$d strength_ to use.
text.远程使用投掷武器更为精准，而近距离使用则反之。: Thrown weapons are more accurate at range, but less accurate up close.
text.投掷武器在使用过程中会磨损并最终损坏。: Thrown weapons will wear out and break as they are used.
text.这组投掷武器再使用_%d/%d_次就会损坏一件。: This set of thrown weapons has _%d/%d_ uses left before one breaks.
text.这组投掷武器品质极高，可以永久使用而不损坏。: This set is of such high quality that it will effectively last forever.
text.通常，这组投掷武器每使用_%d_次就会损坏一件。: Typically this set of thrown weapons will have _%d_ uses before one breaks.
text.你的投掷武器快要损坏了。: Your thrown weapon is about to break.
text.你的一件投掷武器已经损坏了。: One of your thrown weapons has broken.
text.你一碰这件投掷武器就化为了尘土。: The thrown weapon crumbles to dust as you touch it.
text.如果一组投掷武器的最后一件损坏，这组投掷武器就会永远消失。你确定还要投掷这件武器: If the last thrown weapon in your enhanced thrown weapon set breaks, the set will be permanently lost. Are you sure you want to throw it?
text.手里剑每经20回合可以不消耗回合地投掷一次。: Shurikens can be thrown instantly with a 20 turn cooldown.
text.一些轻便到可以在移动时快速掷出的锋利星形金属刃片。: These star-shaped pieces of metal with razor-sharp blades can be quickly thrown while on the move.
text.你近期不消耗回合地投掷了一个手里剑，必须等待冷却结束才能再次瞬间投掷手里剑。在此:
You have recently thrown a shuriken instantly, and must wait before doing it again. Shurikens can still be thrown, but at normal weapon speed.

Turns Remaining: %s.
text.这件武器不会卡在敌人身上并可被立即收回。: This weapon doesn't stick to enemies and can be collected instantly.
text.简单粗暴但耐用的投掷武器，实际上就是一块插着根木棍的大石头。: A fairly simple but durable thrown weapon, essentially a large rock fastened to a stick.
text.这些重锤是用来扔向敌人的。其光滑的全金属构造让它们非常耐用。: These hefty hammers are designed to be thrown at an enemy. Their smooth all-metal construction means they are quite durable.
text.这些轻便的小刀不同于普通的匕首，平衡的配重使其能在飞行后准确地刺穿目标。: These lightweight knives are balanced to arc through the air right into their target.
text.这些有着非常纤细的木杆的轻便短矛是一种投掷武器，不适合用于近战。: These lightweight spears have thin frames which are designed to be thrown, and not thrusted.
text.这些尖尖的金属箭是用来扔向远处的敌人的。: These durable pointed shafts of metal are meant to be thrown into distant enemies.
text.这些石头被人用砂纸打磨成趁手的形状，比普通石头更适合大力投向目标。: These stones are sanded down to make them able to be thrown with more power than a regular stone.
text.这件武器对其目标施加_%1$d~%2$d点流血_。: This weapon inflicts _%1$d-%2$d bleed_ to its target.
text.这件武器通常对其目标施加_%1$d~%2$d点流血_。: This weapon typically inflicts _%1$d-%2$d bleed_ to its target.
text.这些飞斧的锯刃只要卡在敌人身上就能造成流血的撕裂伤口。: These throwing axes have a serrated edge that tears as they stick to an enemy.
text.一把尖端有着三根致命尖叉的特大号投掷用长枪。威力极大，但也很重。: Massive throwing spears with three deadly prongs on the end. They are powerful, but quite heavy.
text.这把弓不能直接升级，但是会随着你等级提升而逐渐增强。以你目前的等级，这把弓射出的: The bow cannot be directly upgraded, but will instead steadily grow stronger as you level up. At your current level, arrows shot from the bow will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and require _%3$d strength_ to use properly.
text.一把由远古灵木制成的弓，弓弦和弓身的刻纹散发着苍蓝色的幽光。拉开弓弦时，一发魔法: A bow made out of ancient magical wood. The bow's string and etchings glow with a pale blue light. When the string is pulled this bow will conjure a magical arrow which can be fired at an enemy.
text.你对手中的武器已经足够熟悉并将其完全鉴定。: You are now familiar enough with your weapon to identify it.
text.因为你的力量不足，该武器会降低你的攻速和精准，并让你无法偷袭。: Because of your inadequate strength this weapon will hinder your attack speed, accuracy, and ability to surprise attack.
text.你的额外力量会使你在使用这件武器时造成_0~%d点额外伤害_。: Because of your excess strength, you will deal _0-%d bonus damage_ with this weapon.
text.你武器上的硬化效果被损耗掉了！: The hardening on this weapon has worn off!
text.不同属性的魔法相冲突，消除了武器上的附魔！: Interaction of different types of magic has negated the enchantment on this weapon!
text.由于这件武器被诅咒，你无法将其放下。: Because this weapon is cursed, you are powerless to remove it.
text.你能感觉到这件武器里潜伏着一股充满恶意的魔力。: You can feel a malevolent magic lurking within this weapon.
text.虽然这件武器有诅咒，但是你可以脱下它。: Despite the curse, you are able to unequip this weapon.
text.这件武器没有被诅咒。: This weapon is free of malevolent magic.
text.这件武器已被_硬化_，但目前没有携带附魔。: This weapon has been _hardened,_ but is not currently enchanted.
text.Yendor护符是人类与矮人所知的最强大的神器。其上镶嵌的晶石奇光辉映、气象非常: The Amulet of Yendor is the most powerful artifact known to human or dwarf kind. Its shimmering crystals contain incredible and wondrous power.
text.护符的起源与种种过去无人知晓。据历史记载，矮人国王曾夸口说他在矮人文明与外界切断: The origins of the amulet are unknown. History says that the King of Dwarves boasted that he had discovered the artifact shortly before the Dwarven civilization cut off all contact. How did he find it? How did Yog-Dzewa take it from him? Questions for another time perhaps, all that matters now is the amulet is yours!
text.护符的起源与种种过去无人知晓，但显然它已在古神的力量下受到了极大的侵蚀。你在地牢: The origins of the amulet are unknown, but clearly it has been heavily influenced by Yog-Dzewa's power. The dungeon seems to be bending to Yog's will as you move through it, making enemies much more plentiful and powerful! You're also no longer able to activate or discard the amulet, almost as if it is cursed.
text.你开始感受到古神强大可怖的力量自护符中泛溢而出。凭凡人的区区肉身自这地牢之底向上:
You begin to feel Yog-Dzewa's great and terrible power radiating from the amulet. Ascending back through the dungeon as a mortal might be more difficult than you thought!

If you continue ascending with the amulet the dungeon will become more dangerous, teleports between floors will be disabled, and you will only be able to win the game by defeating enemies as you ascend through the dungeon!

You can leave the amulet here for now if you want to ascend without starting this challenge, or activate the amulet before ascending to end the game normally.
You can find this item at the bottom of the dungeon...
text.你用散发着治愈魔力的清水祝福了这枚重生十字架。: You bless the ankh with magical water.
text.这枚象征不朽的古老饰物能使人起死回生。不过大部分物品将会被遗落在死亡的地点，等待: This ancient symbol of immortality grants the ability to return to life after death. Most items will be dropped where you died, but can be reclaimed if you return to it. Using a full waterskin, the ankh can be blessed with extra strength.
text.这枚象征不朽的古老饰品能够让人起死回生。这枚十字架已被祝福而变得更加强大。它会在: This ancient symbol of immortality grants the ability to return to life after death. The ankh has been blessed and is now much stronger. The Ankh will sacrifice itself to save you in a moment of deadly peril.
text.这根法杖过于强大，树脂已经不足以对其进行进一步强化了。: That wand is too powerful for resin to improve.
text.你的树脂不够了！: You don't have enough resin for that!
text.你将树脂包被于法杖的表面。法杖的能量愈发凝练了！: You coat your wand with resin, increasing its power!
text.这团细腻的粉末闪烁着紫与白的微光。奥术树脂可用于增强法杖魔能，提升法杖等级！\n:
This fine powder shimmers between shades of purple and white. It can act as an amplifier to magical energies, increasing the level of wands when it is applied to them!

Upgrading a wand costs 1, 2, or 3 resin depending on the wand's initial level. Resin can upgrade wands to a maximum of +3.

Resin upgrades are _overridden by other upgrade sources_ however (such as scrolls of upgrade), and do not apply when imbuing a wand into the Mage's staff.
text.你需要先鉴定那件护甲有无诅咒。: You must identify whether that armor is cursed or not first.
text.纹章不能贴附于被诅咒的盔甲。: The seal won't apply to cursed armor.
text.你将纹章佩挂在了护甲上！: You affix the seal to your armor!
text.一枚蜡制纹章，作为勇气的象征而贴附在护甲之上。纹章上刻有磨损的防御符咒，并从中碎:
A wax seal, affixed to armor as a symbol of valor. It has a faded rune of protection engraved in the center, and is cracked in half across the middle.

A memento from his home, the seal helps the warrior persevere. While wearing the seal the warrior will instantly gain shielding when he is about to be damaged to half health or lower.

The seal can be _affixed to armor,_ and moved between armors. It can carry a single upgrade with it, so long as that upgrade was applied to the armor while the seal was attached to it.
text.纹章刻有_%s_。: The seal is inscribed with a _%s._
text.这件护甲与破损纹章均刻有刻印。请选择一个想保留的刻印。\n\n护甲刻印：%1$s:
Both this armor and the broken seal are carrying a glyph. Pick which glyph should be kept.

Armor Glyph: %1$s
Broken Seal Glyph: %2$s

Note that if you pick the glyph that is currently on the armor, the seal will not be able to transfer it later.
text.战士的破损纹章正使他变得不屈不挠，使其获得在生命值之上的护盾。在护盾首次触发后其:
The Warrior's broken seal is currently helping him persevere, granting him shielding on top of his health. There is a cooldown after the shielding initially triggers before it can be used again.

This shield does not decay over time, but will end if no enemies are nearby for a few turns. When it ends, any unused shielding will reduce the cooldown, up to a max of 50%%.

Shield remaining: %1$d.

Current Cooldown: %2$d.
text.战士近期已经从他的破碎纹章获得了护盾，而他必须等待直至他可从其护盾效果中再次获益:
The Warrior has recently gained shielding from his broken seal, and must wait until he can benefit from its shielding effect again.

Turns Remaining: %d.
text.战士护盾的冷却时间当前为负值，意味着当他的护盾生效时，冷却时间会比通常的150回:
The Warrior's shield cooldown is currently negative, meaning that when his shield activates the cooldown will be lower than the usual 150 turns. The shield cooldown can be reduced to as low as -150 turns, which means it will immediately be available again once it is activated.

Current cooldown: %d.
text.一颗晶莹剔透的露珠。\n\n受这片区域的魔力影响，净水有着少量的治疗效果。:
A crystal clear dewdrop.

Due to the magic of this place, pure water has minor restorative properties.
text.在你装备上这件物品前，你感知到了物品的诅咒！: You sense that the item is cursed just before you equip it!
text.你无法移除一件被诅咒的物品！: You can't remove a cursed item!
text.一些小巧玲珑的能量晶体，充盈着炼金能量。\n\n这些晶体是炼金配方中最常见的原料:
A collection of small magical crystals, filled with alchemical energy.

These crystals are the most common ingredient in alchemy recipes and can be produced at an alchemy pot by scrapping consumable items.
text.一堆金币。收集金币以在随后的商店中消费。: A pile of gold coins. Collect gold coins to spend them later in a shop.
text.打开前你是看不见里面有什么的！: You won't know what's inside until you open it!
text.打开前你是看不见里面有什么的！你需要一枚金钥匙才能打开它。: You won't know what's inside until you open it! But to open it you need a golden key.
text.你看得见里面的_%s_，但你需要一枚水晶钥匙才能打开它。: You can see _%s_ inside, but to open the chest you need a crystal key.
text.这个坟墓里或许埋葬着一些有用的东西，但墓主肯定是不会让你拿走的。: This ancient tomb may contain something useful, but its owner will most certainly object to checking.
text.某个不幸的冒险家存在过的唯一证明。或许可以找找里面有什么值钱的东西。: This is all that's left of some unfortunate adventurer. Maybe it's worth checking for any valuables.
text.你的某个先辈存在过的唯一证明。或许能找到点什么值钱的东西。: This is all that's left from one of your predecessors. Maybe it's worth checking for any valuables.
text.这个巨型蜜罐只是薄薄地涂了一圈蜂蜜，作为替代里头住着一只巨型蜜蜂！这种大型蜜蜂一: This large honeypot is only really lined with honey, instead it houses a giant bee! These sorts of massive bees usually stay in their hives, perhaps the pot is some sort of specialized trapper's cage? The bee seems pretty content inside the pot with its honey, and buzzes at you warily when you look at it.
text.这个罐子已经被打碎，仅靠罐沿的粘稠蜂蜜勉强维持形状，而且正在缓缓解体。\n\n尽:
The pot has been shattered, only the sticky honey that lines its walls is holding it together, and it is slowly coming apart.

Despite its broken state, the bee still seems to want to protect the pot.
text.你为这类物品写下了备注：“_%s_”: This type of item has a custom note: "_%s_"
text.你为这件物品写下了备注：“_%s_”: This item has a custom note: "_%s_"
text.你可在地牢中概率找到该物品。: You can find this item randomly in the dungeon.
text.你必须先取下一件装备。请选择要替换的物品。: You must unequip one of these items first. Select an item to swap with.
text.你的手不受控制地握紧了这件武器。: Your grip involuntarily tightens around the weapon.
text.你想将这把武器装备至哪个武器栏位？\n\n勇士仅会使用主武器进行攻击，但主、副武:
Which weapon slot would you like to equip this item to?

The Champion directly attacks with her primary weapon, but can use the ability of either weapon. Both weapons share the same charge count.

The Champion can also swap her primary and secondary weapon instantly.
text.非常遗憾，皇冠的魔力无法强化你的内衣。: Unfortunately, the crown cannot transform your underwear.
text.皇冠熔为曜日般的金光，而你的护甲在照耀下开始逐渐变形！: The crown glows brightly and then disintegrates as your armor transforms!
text.鼠王挥爪便召出了万丈光芒，而你的护甲在照耀下开始逐渐变形！: Rat King's paws glow brightly as your armor transforms!
text.末代矮人国王的皇冠，至强的魔法能量以光芒的形式从中辐射而出。\n\n如果你有决心:
The crown of the last dwarven king, it glows with tremendous magical energy.

When worn, the crown's magic will flow into the armor you're currently wearing, transforming it into a _unique epic armor with special abilities._ The new armor will keep all the properties of the original armor.
text.这件投掷武器已经完好无损了！: That thrown weapon is already in perfect condition!
text.你为修复该投掷武器消耗了%d滴液金。: You use %d liquid metal to repair your thrown weapon.
text.这种神奇的液体可以修补投掷武器的破损之处，使之焕然一新！若有一组武器完好无损但缺:
This magical liquid can fill into the cracks and tears on a thrown weapon, restoring it to perfect condition! If a set of weapons is missing a weapon but otherwise fully repaired, then liquid metal can even be used to replace a missing weapon from the set!

A tier 1 weapon requires 10 liquid metal to be fully repaired, a tier 5 weapon requires 30. Each upgrade also increases the amount of metal needed by 35%.

Liquid metal cannot be used to repair the tips on tipped darts.
text.你的遗物，包含你遗留在此的所有物品。快快重新拥有它们吧！: This is your lost inventory. Collect it to reclaim all the items you lost!
text.这件矮人科技的奇特产物能够让你和遥远的地方通讯。\n\n激活时，这枚信标可以让你:
This odd piece of dwarven technology allows you to communicate from great distances.

After being activated, this beacon will let you sell items to Pixel Mart from anywhere in the dungeon.

However, the magic within the beacon will only last for one session, so use it wisely.
text.奥术刻笔的力量无法作用在被诅咒的护甲上。: The stylus's magic will not work on cursed armor.
text.你用刻笔雕刻了盔甲。: You inscribed your armor with the stylus.
text.这支奥术刻笔由一种暗黑色的坚硬石料制成。你能用它在护甲上刻下魔法刻印，不过你无法: This arcane stylus is made of some dark, very hard stone. Using it you can inscribe a magical glyph on your armor, but you have no power over choosing what glyph it will be, the stylus will decide it for you.
text.面具瓦解了，它所蕴含的能量涌入了你的身体。: The mask disintegrates as its power flows into you!
text.天狗死时，这幅面具像褪皮般从他的脸上失落地滑下。你能感受它在波动着一股神妙的魔力:
This mask fell off Tengu's face as he died, you can feel great magical power emanating from it. Was the mask Tengu's source of strength?

When worn, the tremendous power of the mask will be transferred into you, enabling you to _choose a subclass for your hero._

Which subclass will you choose?
text.冒险必备物品，每当地牢陷入黑暗之时，火把能让你走上正确的道路。: An adventuring staple, when a dungeon goes dark, a torch can help lead the way.
text.你将一滴露珠收集到了水袋里。: You collect the dewdrop into your waterskin.
text.牛皮缝制的液体容器，被软木塞牢牢密封着。在激烈的搏斗中也不会漏出一滴内容。: A container for liquid, made from leather and string, sealed with a cork stopper.
text.你的水袋里只有普普通通的饮用水，地牢中肯定会有更值得装的东西。: Right now the waterskin just contains some plain drinking water. Surely there is something in the dungeon that the waterskin could store instead.
text.水袋里现在装着有治愈魔力的露水。水袋越满，你在饮用时瞬间恢复的生命也会越多。你每: The waterskin is currently being used to store healing water. The more full the waterskin is, the more you will be instantly healed when drinking from it. You will only drink as much as you need.
text.装满了的水袋散发着一股能量，也许能够用来祝福其他的生存道具？: The full waterskin seems to radiate energy, perhaps it can be used to bless another survival item?
text.这里盘绕着一片致眩气体。: A cloud of confusion gas is swirling here.
text.火花在这片电场中不断闪烁着。: A field of electricity is sparking brightly here.
text.光柱刺破了地下花园中的黑暗。: Shafts of light pierce the gloom of the underground garden.
text.这里的空气寒冷刺骨，很不寻常。: The air is unnaturally frigid here.
text.黑暗能量正在这里涌动！: Specks of dark energy are swarming here!
text.这里盘绕着一片麻痹气体。: A cloud of paralytic gas is swirling here.
text.这是一个承载着献祭之火的祭坛。在此殒命的生物都将成为献给地牢幽魂的祭品。\n\n:
There is an altar here with a sacrificial fire burning atop it. Any creature that's killed here will be consumed as an offering to the spirits of the dungeon.

Perhaps a reward will be given if enough sacrifices are made?
text.火焰吞噬了你的祭品，燃烧得愈加旺盛。: The fire consumes your offering and grows stronger.
text.火焰吞噬了你的祭品，然而没有任何变化。: The fire consumes your offering, but doesn't change.
text.火焰骤然升腾，继而消散，并留下一份奖励！: The fire flares and then dissipates, leaving a reward behind!
text.这里翻腾着一团浓密的黑烟。: A cloud of thick black smoke is swirling here.
text.这里盘绕着一片腐烂的臭气。: A cloud of fetid stench is swirling here.
text.这里盘绕着一片翻腾的水汽。: A cloud of billowing water vapor is swirling here.
text.这里盘绕着一片发绿的毒气。: A greenish cloud of toxic gas is swirling here.
You died from the toxic gas...
text.这里盘绕着一片致命的腐蚀酸雾。: A cloud of deadly caustic gas is swirling here.
text.在你小酌一口时，你感觉到知识涌入了你的头脑。: As you take a sip, you feel knowledge pour into your mind.
text.知识的力量正在从这口井的水里涌出。饮下井中的水将会鉴定所有已装备的物品、探测背包: Power of knowledge radiates from the water of this well. Drinking from the well will fully identify all equipped items, identify curses on all items in your inventory, and reveal all items on the current floor.
text.你小酌一口后，立刻感到所有伤口都痊愈了。: As you take a sip, you feel your wounds heal completely.
text.生命的力量正在从这口井的水里涌出。饮下井中的水可以治疗伤口、解除饥饿并净化所有已: Power of health radiates from the water of this well. Drinking from this well will heal your wounds, satisfy hunger, and cleanse curses on any worn items.
text.这里所有东西都被厚厚的蜘蛛网覆盖着。任何接触或丢向蛛网的东西都会打破它，但也都会: A thick web is covering everything here. Anything that touches or is thrown through the web will break it, but will also be stuck in place.
text.由肾上腺素带来的纯粹的潜能爆发，激素涌动能够增强一名角色的移动和攻击速度。\n\:
A surge of physical power, adrenaline enhanced both attack and movement speed.

Adrenaline allows its target to run at 2x speed, and attack at 1.5x speed.

Turns remaining: %s.
text.一股强大的力量，不过很可惜不是永久的。\n\n力量加成：+%d\n距离效果衰减还:
A surge of great might, but sadly not permanent.

Strength boost: +%d.
Turns until boost weakens: %s.
text.狂乱会导致目标陷入极度愤怒和混乱的状态。\n\n狂乱的生物会不分敌我地攻击任何靠:
Amok causes a state of great rage and confusion in its target.

When a creature is amoked, they will attack whatever is near them, whether they be friend or foe.

Turns of amok remaining: %s.
text.一层淡薄的护盾环绕着你，可为你抵挡一定的魔法伤害。\n\n当前你的魔法护甲为：0:
A thin shield is surrounding you, blocking some of the damage from magical attacks.

Your magical armor is currently boosted by: 0-%d.

Turns until arcane armor weakens: %s.
text.魔力在你体内奔腾而过，提高你手中神器的充能速率。\n\n每件神器受到的影响都不尽:
Energy is coursing through you, increasing the rate your equipped artifacts charge.

Each artifact is affected a little differently, but they will all gain charge much faster than normal.

Turns remaining: %s.
text.不知为何古神仍能借护符维系自己对这个世界的影响，祂正借此设法阻止你向上返程！\n:
Somehow Yog-Dzewa is maintaining influence on this world through the amulet, and is trying to stop your ascent!

Yog's power is making the dungeon much more dangerous, increasing the number of enemies and making them stronger! This power will keep building if left unchecked, it can be weakened by defeating enemies that have been enhanced by Yog's power.
text.护符中散发出的黑暗能量现今已被最大程度的削弱了。: The dark energy radiating from the amulet has been weakened as much as possible for now.
text.护符正在_呼唤远处的敌人_，向它们通告你的位置。: The amulet is currently _calling out to distant enemies,_ alerting them to your position.
text.护符正在_为远处的敌人加速_，令它们得以更快接近你！: The amulet is currently _hastening distant enemies,_ letting them reach you faster!
text.护符正在_使你减速_，并阻止了一切加速效果！: The amulet is currently _slowing you down,_ and negating speed boosting effects!
text.护符中涌动的黑暗能量已极为强大，它正在_直接对你造成伤害_！: The energy from the amulet has gotten so strong that it's _directly harming you!_
text.护符开始呼唤远处的敌人前来。: The amulet begins calling out to distant enemies.
text.护符开始为周遭的敌人提升移速！: The amulet begins hastening distant enemies!
text.你背包中的护符此刻恍如重逾千钧！: The amulet starts to feel like a lead weight in your inventory!
text.护符开始释放黑暗能量。此物灼烫难忍！: The amulet begins radiating dark energy. It burns!
text.护符的诅咒可通过击败更多敌人来削弱。: The amulet's curse can be weakened by defeating more enemies.
text.如果你击败敌人，护符的诅咒就会被削弱！: If you defeat enemies the amulet's curse will weaken!
text.你能感受到护符上的诅咒正缓慢地消退。: You can feel the amulet's curse weaken slightly.
text.你稍作喘息，感受到身上的伤口开始愈合！: You take a moment to catch your breath and feel your wounds begin to close!
text.你能感觉到古神对护符的掌控愈发微弱了起来，胜利的曙光已然在你面前！: You feel Yog's grip on the amulet begin to weaken, you're almost there!
text.你的皮肤硬化了，摸起来如同树皮般粗糙而坚固。\n\n硬化的皮肤增强了你的护甲，使:
Your skin is hardened, it feels rough and solid like bark.

The hardened skin increases your effective armor, allowing you to better defend against physical attack.

Your armor is currently increased by: 0-%d.
Turns until barkskin weakens: %s.

If you receive barkskin from multiple sources, only the strongest one will apply.
text.一团可以抵挡全部伤害的能量屏障。\n\n只要奥术屏障的能量仍然存在，它将完全抵挡:
A durable bubble of force which blocks all damage.

The barrier will take damage for whatever it is protecting so long as there is shielding left. The shielding will also slowly decay over time.

Shielding remaining: %d.
text.狂战士受伤的严重程度会增强他的攻击。每当狂战士受到物理伤害时，他会积累怒气并获得:
The severity of the Berserker's injuries strengthen his blows. As the berserker takes physical damage, his rage will build, granting him bonus damage. Damage which is blocked by armor still counts towards building rage.

Rage will fade over time. The lower the berserker's health, the longer it will last.

At 100%% rage, the Berserker can go berserk, granting him shielding based on the level of his armor and his missing health. While berserking, his shielding decays over time and once it runs out he will have to rest before building rage again.

Current Rage: _%1$.0f%%_
_+%2$.0f%%_ damage

Berserk shield at current armor and HP: _%3$d_
text.恐惧与疑虑已然随流出的鲜血一齐消散，此身惟余满腔怒火。在这种狂暴状态下，狂战士将:
Fear and uncertainty bleed away, leaving only anger. In this state the Berserker is extremely powerful, _dealing +50%% damage and gaining bonus shielding,_ but also losing shielding every turn.

When all of his shielding is reduced to 0, berserking will end.

After raging, the Berserker will need to recover before being able to build rage again.

Shield Remaining: %d
text.内在潜力是有限的。狂战士必须充分休息才能再次释放他的怒火。\n\n恢复状态下的狂:
Inner strength has its limits. The Berserker must rest before using his rage again.

While recovering the Berserker does not build any rage from taking damage.
text.你需要破损纹章才能进入狂暴！: You need your broken seal to berserk!
text.伤口正在令人不安地涌出大量血液。\n\n流血每回合都会造成伤害。每回合这个伤害数:
That wound is leaking a worrisome amount of blood.

Bleeding causes damage every turn. Each turn the damage decreases by a random amount, until the bleeding eventually stops.

Current bleed damage: %d.
text.你的集中力正在喷薄而出，有人说这是神赐的礼物。\n\n赐福状态能够提高自己25%:
A great burst of focus, some say it is inspired by the gods.

Blessing increases accuracy and evasion by 25%%, making the blessed much more effective in combat.

Turns of bless remaining: %s.
text.失明使周遭的一切陷入黑暗。\n\n失明时，单位的视距被减少至一格，致使远程攻击难:
Blinding turns the surrounding world into a dark haze.

While blinded, a character's vision range is reduced to one tile, rendering ranged attacks useless and making it very easy to lose track of distant enemies. Additionally, a blinded hero is unable to read scrolls or books.

Turns of blindness remaining: %s.
text.没什么比被火焰吞没更痛苦了。\n\n火焰每回合都会造成伤害，直到它被液体扑灭或者:
Few things are more distressing than being engulfed in flames.

Fire will deal damage every turn until it is put out by water or it expires. Fire can be extinguished by stepping into water, or from the splash of a shattering potion.

Additionally, the fire may ignite flammable terrain or items that it comes into contact with.

Turns of burning remaining: %s.
text.烈焰精英造成25%额外近战伤害，会点燃攻击目标，免疫火焰，且会在死亡时引燃周遭。: Blazing champions deal 25% more melee damage, ignite enemies they attack, are immune to fire, and spread fire around them as they die. They can't spread fire onto water however.
text.索敌精英拥有25%额外近战伤害，且拥有额外的3格近战攻击距离。: Projecting champions deal 25% more melee damage and have +3 attack range.
text.敌法精英拥有50%的伤害减免，且完全免疫所有魔法效果。: Antimagic champions take 50% less damage and are completely immune to magical effects.
text.巨型精英拥有80%的伤害减免与额外的1格近战攻击距离，但无法进入狭窄的空间。: Giant champions take 80% less damage and have +1 attack range, but cannot move through enclosed spaces.
text.天佑精英拥有4倍精准与闪避。: Blessed champions have 4x accuracy and evasion.
text.成长精英可额外获得稳定增长的精准、闪避、物理伤害与伤害减免。\n\n当前精准/闪:
Growing champions gain a steadily increasing bonus to accuracy, evasion, physical damage, and a reduction to damage taken.

Current acc/eva/dmg boost: %1$d%%
Current damage reduction: %2$d%%
text.你被目标敌人魅惑了，因此无法对其发起攻击。: You are charmed by that enemy and can't attack them.
text.魅惑是一种能让一对夙敌暂时陷入互相倾慕的控制类魔法。\n\n被魅惑的单位将无法对:
A charm is manipulative magic that can make enemies temporarily adore each other.

Characters affected by charm are unable to directly attack the enemy they are charmed by. Attacking other targets is still possible however. The shock of pain will lessen the duration of charm.

Turns of charm remaining: %s.
text.还没有完全冻住，不过已经非常冷了。\n\n冻伤的目标所有行动都会更加缓慢，减速程:
Not quite frozen, but still much too cold.

Chilled targets perform all actions more slowly, depending on how many turns are left in the effect. At its worst, this is equivalent to being slowed.

Turns of chill remaining: %1$s.
Speed is reduced by: %2$s%%
text.你的目标必须是攻击距离以内的敌人。: You must target an enemy in attack range.
text.角斗士在成功击中对手时会积累战斗气势。每次攻击命中都会增加1次连击，但长时间不进:
The gladiator builds momentum as he lands successful blows. Each attack increases the combo counter by one, but taking too long between hits will reset the combo counter to 0. While the gladiator has combo any shielding he has from his broken seal will not start to fade.

Building combo unlocks special combo attacks that cannot miss! A different attack is unlocked at 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 combo count. Some moves reset combo and some do not, but each move can only be used once per combo session.

Current combo: %1$d.

Turns until Combo is lost: %2$s.
text.将一名敌人击退2格，但不造成伤害，也不能将其击落深渊。提升1点连击数。: Knocks an enemy back 2 tiles, but deals no damage and cannot knock into pits. Increments combo by 1.
text.将一名敌人_击退3格，施加眩晕，并且可以将其击落深渊_，但不造成伤害。提升1点连: Knocks an enemy back _3 tiles, inflicts vertigo, and can knock into pits,_ but deals no damage. Increments combo by 1.
text.造成等同于自身防御%d%%(连击数x20%%)的额外伤害。使用后重置连击数。: Deals %d%% (combo*20%%) of your damage blocking power as bonus damage. Resets combo when used.
text._跳跃最多%1$d格以接近目标_，并对其造成等同于自身防御%2$d%%(连击数x: _Leaps up to %1$d tile(s)_ and deals %2$d%% (combo*20%%) of your damage blocking power as bonus damage. Resets combo when used.
text.使用后，招架下一回合内受到的首次攻击，并立即进行反击。若未触发招架，则重置连击数: Blocks the next attack within 1 turn when activated, and instantly retaliates to it. Resets combo if nothing is parried.
text.使用后，招架下一回合内受到的_所有攻击_，并立即进行反击。若未触发招架，则重置连: Blocks _all attacks_ within 1 turn when activated, and instantly retaliates to them. Resets combo if nothing is parried.
text.对目标造成%d%%(连击数x25%%)的伤害，并对7x7范围内的其它敌人造成一半: Deals %d%% (combo*25%%) damage to the primary target, and half that damage to all other enemies in a 7x7 AOE. Resets combo when used.
text._跳跃最多%1$d格以接近目标_，对主要目标造成%2$d%%（连击数x25%%）: _Leaps up to %1$d tile(s)_ and deals %2$d%% (combo*25%%) damage to the primary target, and half that damage to all other enemies in a 7x7 AOE. Resets combo when used.
text.你每有1点连击数便对一个敌人攻击一次，每次攻击造成60%伤害，并可触发武器附魔。: Hits an enemy once for each combo you have, each hit deals 60% damage and can trigger enchantments. Resets combo when used.
text._跳跃最多%d格以接近目标_，并根据你当前的连击数对敌人发动同等次数的攻击，每次: _Leaps up to %d tile(s)_ and hits an enemy once for each combo you have, each hit deals 60%% damage and can trigger enchantments. Resets combo when used.
text.腐化魔法会侵入生物体的生命本质，扭转他们原有的天性。\n\n被腐化的生物会攻击他:
Corruption seeps into the essence of a being, twisting them against their former nature.

Corrupted creatures will attack their allies, and ignore their former enemies. Corruption is damaging as well, and will slowly cause its target to succumb.

Corruption is permanent, its effects only end in death.
text.你很确定自己的腿不该折成那样。\n\n残废会减半移动速度，移动一格会消耗二回合而:
You're pretty sure legs aren't meant to bend that way.

Crippled halves movement speed, making moving a tile usually take two turns instead of one.

Turns of cripple remaining: %s.
text.耳畔嗡鸣，视野模糊，战斗因此变得十分困难。\n\n在恍惚状态下，精准和闪避都会减:
Ringing ears and blurred vision make it difficult to fight.

While dazed, accuracy and evasion are reduced by 50%%, making both landing and evading blows much harder.

Turns of daze remaining: %s.
text.强大的黑暗魔法正在吞噬升级卷轴注入你装备的魔力！\n\n降级状态下的装备会被视作:
Powerful dark magic is sapping the strength that scrolls of upgrade have applied to your equipment!

While degraded, upgraded gear will be treated as if it is a lower level than it actually is. _Every upgrade after +3 becomes exponentially weaker than the last one._ The descriptions of your items will change to reflect their reduced power level.

Degradation does not affect strength requirements, wand charges, durability of thrown weapons, or artifacts.

Turns of degradation remaining: %s. Using a scroll of upgrade or remove curse will end degradation immediately.
text.当整个宇宙都看起来想置你于死地时，继续斗争还有什么意义呢？\n\n被定命的角色受:
It's hard to keep going when it seems like the universe wants you dead.

Doomed characters will receive +67% damage from all sources.

Doom is permanent, its effects only end in death.
text.令人魂飞魄散的恐慌正在驱使目标尝试逃出这座地牢！\n\n魂飞魄散状态下的生物将快:
A terror so great that it will cause its target to flee the dungeon entirely!

Creatures affected by dread will run from their opponent at high speed, and will disappear from the dungeon entirely once they are out of sight. Enemies that are defeated this way award half experience and drop no items. The shock of pain will lessen the duration of dread.

Turns of dread remaining: %d.
text.一股魔法力量使目标很难保持清醒，几个回合后，目标将会深陷魔法睡眠。\n\n对于英:
A magical force is making it difficult to stay awake, after a few turns, the target will fall into a deep magical sleep.

The hero can resist drowsiness by taking damage or by being at full health.

Turns until sleep: %s.
text.你被灌注了大地的力量！\n\n直到该效果结束前，你所有的物理攻击都会使敌人脚下的:
You are imbued with the power of earth!

All physical attacks will shift the earth under the enemy, crippling them for a short time.

Turns of earth imbue remaining: %s.
text.盗贼在使用神器时强化了他的戒指，使它们获得+1升级。\n\n剩余回合数：%s:
The Rogue's recently used artifact is empowering his rings, granting them +1 level.

Turns remaining: %s.
text.你被灌注了烈焰的力量！\n\n所有物理攻击都有机会使敌人燃烧。与此同时你对火焰完:
You are imbued with the power of fire!

All physical attacks will have a chance to light enemies ablaze. Additionally, you are completely immune to the effects of fire.

Turns of fire imbue remaining: %s.
text.不知为何，你的脑海中映射出了周遭的地形。\n\n危险预知状态持续时，你周遭大范围:
You are somehow able to see the layout of surrounding terrain with your mind.

While under the effect of foresight all tiles in a wide radius are revealed to you, including any secret traps or doors.

Turns of foresight remaining: %s.
text.不要与冻成冰雕混淆，这种温和的冰冻只是把目标包裹在冰里。\n\n冻结效果类似于麻:
Not to be confused with freezing solid, this more benign freezing simply encases the target in ice.

Freezing acts similarly to paralysis, making it impossible for the target to act. Unlike paralysis, freezing is immediately cancelled if the target takes damage, as the ice will shatter.

Turns of freeze remaining: %s.
text.你被灌注了寒霜的力量！\n\n所有的物理攻击都会在敌人身上累加冻伤效果。与此同时:
You are imbued with icy power!

All physical attacks will steadily stack chill on enemies. Additionally, you are completely immune to the cold.

Turns of frost imbue remaining: %s.
text.你非常暴怒，很明显敌人并不喜欢这样的你。\n\n一股猛烈的怒火在你体内燃烧，增加:
You are angry, enemies won't like you when you're angry.

A great rage burns within you, increasing the damage you deal with physical attacks by 50%%.

This rage will last as long as you are injured below 50%% health.
text.一种奇怪的能量环绕在你的周围，为你阻挡有害的环境效果。\n\n在净化屏障的持续时:
Some strange force is encasing you in a thin protective barrier, blocking out all harmful airborne effects.

You are immune to all area-bound effects while this barrier lasts.

Turns of immunity remaining: %s.
text.每经几回合，当前楼层的所有单位都会被抛向某个随机方向。: Every few turns all characters on the current dungeon floor will be thrown in a random direction.
text.然而你和你的盟友似乎对此免疫。: You and your allies seem to be immune though.
text.重力混乱会持续多久不得而知，但其不会一直持续下去。: It's not clear how long the effect will last for, but it can't last forever.
text.惊人的速度加成效果使得一切都好像在此刻静止了。\n\n在飞影的效果下，移动完全不:
An incredible boost of speed, for a moment it feels as if everything else is standing still.

While under the effects of greater haste moving actions take no time at all, but other actions are still performed at normal speed. Each step of movement consumes a turn of greater haste.

Turns of greater haste remaining: %d.
text.强大的能量灌入到你的双腿肌肉上，允许你以不可思议的速度移动！\n\n在极速状态下:
Energy courses through your muscles, allowing you to run at incredible speeds!

While under the effects of haste you will run at 3x speed, but will perform all other actions at normal speed.

Turns of haste remaining: %s.
text.一股治愈魔力让你的伤口开始愈合。\n\n你的生命将逐回合稳定回复，直到治疗效果终:
A magical remedy is causing wounds to close and flesh to knit.

Every turn health will steadily regenerate until the healing effect expires. The amount of healing may fade over time.

Next heal: %d.

Healing remaining: %d.
text.幻术魔法改变了你的外貌！虽然此效果是完全装饰性的，但无论如何感觉起来还是很奇怪。:
Illusory magic has altered your physical appearance! The effect is purely cosmetic, but feels very strange regardless.

Turns of disguise remaining: %s.
text.干扰集中力的黑暗魔法，使目标无法准确地判断方位。\n\n幻惑状态会降低目标20%:
Dark magic which saps focus, making the target slightly disoriented.

Hexing reduces accuracy and evasion by 20%%, making the target less effective in combat.

Turns of hex remaining: %s.
text.战士正在据守此处，提升其%1$d~%2$d点护甲并将连击与护盾的衰减速度减缓%3: The Warrior is holding his position, increasing his armor by %1$d-%2$d and slowing the decay rate of some buffs by %3$d%%. This will last until he moves.
text.就在你吃东西的时候被诅咒的号角偷走了一部分食物的能量。: The cursed horn steals some of the food energy as you eat.
text.你能感受到自己的肚子在不断寻求食物，不过还不算那么严重。: You can feel your stomach calling out for food, but it's not too urgent yet.
text.\n\n饥饿会在你在地牢里花费时间的同时缓慢累计，直到你饿得难以忍受。在你极度饥:
Hunger slowly increases as you spend time in the dungeon, eventually you will begin to starve. While starving you will slowly lose health instead of regenerating it.

Rationing is important! If you have health to spare starving isn't a bad idea if it means there will be more food later. Effective rationing can make food last a lot longer!
text.你和周围的地形完全融为一体，使你不可能被看到。\n\n当你在隐形时敌人无法追踪或:
You are completely blended into the surrounding terrain, making you impossible to see.

While you are invisible enemies are unable to attack or follow you. Physical attacks and magical effects (such as scrolls and wands) will immediately cancel invisibility.

Turns of invisibility remaining: %s.
text.这个单位充满了金刚不坏之力，获得了短暂的无敌效果！\n\n剩余回合数：%s回合:
This character is suffused with great protective power, granting them a brief period of invulnerability!

Turns remaining: %s.
text.一股魔力把你从地面托起，让你觉得自己身轻如燕。\n\n飘浮中的角色能够悄无声息地:
A magical force is levitating you over the ground, making you feel weightless.

Levitating characters move silently and ignore all ground-based effects. Traps won't trigger, water won't put out fire, plants won't be trampled, roots will miss, and pits will be hovered over. Be careful, as all these things can come into effect the second the levitation ends!

Turns of levitation remaining: %s.
The life linked damage killed you...
text.该单位的生命力与附近的另一个单位相连。双方会共同承担所有所受伤害。\n\n每当该:
This character's life force is linked to another character nearby. Any damage taken is shared between them.

Whenever this character takes damage, half of it will be dealt to the life link target instead.

Turns of life link remaining: %s.
text.即使是在最黑暗的地牢中，身边有一个稳定的光源也总是令人欣慰。 \n\n光照能驱散:
Even in the Darkest Dungeon, a steady light at your side is always comforting.

Light helps keep darkness at bay, allowing you to see a reasonable distance despite the environment.

Turns of illumination remaining: %s.
text.当前楼层被彻底封锁，你无法离开这里！\n\n封锁持续期间，你不会更加饥饿，或因极:
The current floor is locked, and you are unable to leave it!

While a floor is locked, you will not gain hunger or take damage from starving. In addition, if you do not work towards defeating this floor's boss, passive regeneration effects will also stop.

Additionally, if you are revived by an unblessed ankh while the floor is locked, then it will reset.

Kill this floor's boss to break the lock.
text.你的行囊被遗落在了地牢中的某处！\n在找回你的行囊之前，你将无法拾起或使用绝大多: Your inventory has been lost somewhere in the dungeon! You won't be able to pick up or use most items until you retrieve it.
text.不知为何，即使闭上眼睛你也可以用心灵洞察到周围发生的一切。\n\n当处于魔能透视:
Somehow you are able to see with your mind, rather than your eyes.

While magical sight is active you will be able to see through all terrain in a 12 tile radius.

Turns of magical sight remaining: %s.
text.你十分健康，因此抵抗住了强烈的嗜睡感。: You are too healthy, and resist the urge to sleep.
text.你深深地陷入了魔法睡眠。: You fall into a deep magical sleep.
text.你醒来后，感觉浑身清爽并且十分健康。: You wake up feeling refreshed and healthy.
text.目标已深深陷入了魔法睡眠，不会自然醒来。\n\n魔法睡眠与一般的睡眠基本一样，但:
This character has fallen into a deep magical sleep which they will not wake from naturally.

Magical sleep is similar to regular sleep, except that only damage will cause the target to wake up.

For the hero and their allies, magical sleep has some restorative properties, allowing them to rapidly heal while resting.
text.任何魔法都奈何不了你，你对魔法完全免疫。\n\n在魔法免疫状态下，所有魔法效果无:
All magical effects have lost their hold on you, you are completely impervious to them.

While magic immune all harmful and helpful magical effects will not apply to you, including curses, enchants, wands, scrolls, rings, artifacts, etc. Heroic armor abilities are strong enough to work regardless of this effect.

Turns of magic immunity remaining: %s.
text.你可以在脑海中以某种方式看到这一层的所有生物。这种感觉非常奇异。\n\n只要灵视:
Somehow you are able to see all creatures on this floor through your mind. It's a weird feeling.

All characters on this floor are visible to you as long as you have mind vision. Seeing a creature through mind vision counts as it being seen or nearby for the purposes of many magical effects.

Turns of mind vision remaining: %s.
text.移动的时候，疾行者会逐渐积蓄动量。疾行者可以消耗动量以开启逸动状态。\n\n每一:
As he moves, the Freerunner builds momentum, which he can spend to start freerunning.

Each charge of momentum grants two turns of freerunning, and the Freerunner can build up to 10 charges. Momentum is rapidly lost when the Freerunner stops moving.

Current momentum charge: %d.
text.移动的时候，疾行者会逐渐积蓄动量。疾行者可以消耗动量以开启逸动状态。\n\n处于:
As he moves, the Freerunner builds momentum, which he can spend to start freerunning.

While freerunning, the Freerunner moves at double speed and gains bonus evasion based on his level.

Turns remaining: %d.
text.移动的时候，疾行者会逐渐积蓄动量。疾行者可以消耗动量以开启逸动状态。\n\n疾行:
As he moves, the Freerunner builds momentum, which he can spend to start freerunning.

The Freerunner needs time to regain his stamina before building momentum again.

Turns remaining: %d.
text.每当武僧击败一个敌人，她都会获得可用于施展多门武功的内力。击败大多数种类的敌人时:
As she defeats enemies, the Monk gains energy that she can use on a variety of abilities. Most enemies grant 1 energy when defeated, and the Monk does not lose energy over time.

Current energy: %1$d/%2$d.
text.武僧刚刚才施展过一次武功，再次施展前必须等待。\n\n剩余冷却时间：%d回合:
The Monk has recently used an ability, and must wait before using another.

Current cooldown: %d turns.
text.两次不耗回合的攻击，每次造成%1$d~%2$d点伤害并且忽略护甲。这门武功不能被: Two instant strikes that deal %1$d-%2$d damage and ignore armor. This ability cannot be used repeatedly.
text.两次不耗回合的攻击，每次造成%1$d~%2$d点伤害，_可触发武器上的附魔_并且: Two instant strikes that deal %1$d-%2$d damage, ignore armor, _and use your weapon's enchantment._ This ability cannot be used repeatedly.
text.武僧消耗一回合来进入凝神状态，招架下一次受到的攻击。: The Monk takes a turn to focus, letting her parry the next attack made against her.
text.武僧_立即进入凝神状态_，招架下一次受到的攻击。: The Monk _instantly focuses,_ letting her parry the next attack made against her.
text.武僧正专注于她周遭的一切，可以预料到对她发起的下一次攻击。当处于凝神状态时，她将: The Monk is focused on her surroundings, anticipating the next attack made against her. While focused, she is guaranteed to parry the next incoming attack.
text.立刻冲向一个最多4格远的位置。这一武功可以越过危险地形，但不能穿过敌人或者坚实墙: An instant dash up to 4 tiles away. This ability can go over hazards, but not through enemies or solid terrain.
text.立刻冲向一个最多_8格_远的位置。这一武功可以越过危险地形，但不能穿过敌人或者坚: An instant dash up to _8 tiles_ away. This ability can go over hazards, but not through enemies or solid terrain.
text.一次致命的踢击，造成%1$d~%2$d点伤害，无视护甲，并将敌人击退，还会对敌人: A devastating kick that deals %1$d-%2$d damage and ignores armor. The kick knocks the target away and paralyzes them for each tile they travel.
text.一次致命的踢击，造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_，无视护甲，并将_所有邻近目标_: A devastating kick that deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and ignores armor. The kick knocks _all adjacent targets_ away and paralyzes them for each tile they travel.
text.武僧消耗5回合来运转内力，将大部分的负面效果逼出体外，并获得8回合的法杖和神器充: The Monk focuses energy into her body for 5 turns. This clears most negative effects and grants her 8 turns of wand and artifact recharging.

The Monk focuses energy into her body for 5 turns. This clears most negative effects and grants her 8 turns of wand and artifact recharging. _She also gains 80% damage resistance while meditating, and slowly heals for 20% of her missing HP._
text.淤泥在腐蚀你的身体。洗掉它！: Caustic ooze eats your flesh. Wash it away!
text.这种粘稠的酸性淤泥正在紧贴你的骨肉，并缓慢地将它们腐蚀融化。\n\n腐蚀淤泥会对:
This sticky acid clings to flesh, slowly melting it away.

Ooze will deal consistent damage over time, but can be immediately washed off in water.

Turns of ooze remaining: %s.
text.通常最坏的事就是什么事都做不出来。\n\n麻痹会制止目标的一切行动，迫使目标静等:
Oftentimes the worst thing to do is nothing at all.

Paralysis completely halts all actions, forcing the target to wait until the effect wears off. The pain from taking damage can cause characters to resist paralysis, breaking them out of the effect.

Turns of paralysis remaining: %s.
text.你的攻击已被强化，接下来的几次物理攻击击中敌人时将会造成额外伤害。\n\n额外伤:
Your blows have been empowered, increasing the amount of damage you can deal when you hit enemies with physical attacks.

Bonus damage: %1$d.
Hits remaining: %2$d.
text.你击中这个角色的投掷武器正卡在他们身上，打败他们后投掷武器将会掉在地上。\n\n:
The thrown weapons you have used against this character are currently stuck to them and will fall to the floor after they are defeated.

The following items are currently attached:
text.毒素传遍全身，缓慢地损伤着各个脏器。\n\n毒素每回合造成的伤害与其剩余的回合数:
Poison works its way through the body, slowly impairing its internal functioning.

Poison deals damage each turn proportional to how long until it expires.

Turns of poison remaining: %s.
text.刺客正耐心地等待着，准备从暗影中给出致命一击。: The Assassin is waiting patiently, preparing to strike from the shadows.
text.他的下一次攻击会造成_%1$d%%的额外伤害_，并斩杀生命低于_%2$d%%_的: His next attack will deal _%1$d%% bonus damage_, and will execute regular enemies below _%2$d%% health_, or bosses below _%3$d%% health_.
text.这一击也更有可能造成偏高的伤害。: The attack will also be more likely to deal a larger amount of damage.
text.他可以瞬间冲刺到敌人身边再攻击，最大冲刺距离为%d格。: He is able to blink towards an enemy before striking them, with a max distance of _%d._
text.选择一个攻击的目标！\n最大冲刺距离：%d格:
Select a target to attack!
Max blink distance: %d
text.你无法冲刺到目标距离。: That target is out of reach.
text.你正在被一个目前看不见的虹光守卫所保护。当有敌人出现时这个虹光守卫将出现并为你战:
You are being guarded by a prismatic image which is currently inactive. When enemies are present the prismatic image will spring to action and protect you!

While inactive, the prismatic image will steadily recover from any damage it has taken.

Current HP: %d/%d.
text.该虹光幻像已被万物一心强化。剩余回合数：%d: This prismatic image is also benefitting from Power of Many. Turns Remaining: %d.
text.魔力在你体内奔腾而过，提高你的法杖与魔杖的充能速率。\n\n此效果将会在正常充能:
Energy is coursing through you, improving the rate that your wands and staffs charge.

Each turn this buff will increase current charge by one quarter, in addition to regular recharge.

Turns of recharging remaining: %s.
text.揭示地牢中一片区域的视野，无论你身处这层中的何处都能对那里一览无遗。\n\n效果:
An area of the dungeon has been temporarily revealed to the hero, They will see it no matter where they are.

Turns remaining: %s.
text.这个单位已被揭示，无论它在哪里都将是可见的。\n\n效果剩余时长：%s回合。:
This character is revealed to the hero, They will be visible no matter where they are.

Turns remaining: %s.
text.一些根系(不论是自然或魔法产生)缠到了脚上，牢牢将其缚在地面。\n\n根系会让目:
Roots (magical or natural) grab at the feet, forcing them down to the ground.

Roots lock a target in place, making movement and most movement abilities impossible. Other actions are not affected, including teleportation effects.

Turns of root remaining: %s.
text.法师阅读卷轴时产生的能量会暂时强化他的法杖！\n\n法杖强化：+%1$d级\n剩:
The energy from the Mage's recently read scroll is empowering his wands!

Level Boost: +%1$d.
Zaps remaining: %2$d.
text.你和周围的阴影融为一体，使你隐形并减缓你的新陈代谢。\n\n当你在隐形时敌人无法:
You are blended into the shadows around you, granting you invisibility and slowing your metabolism.

While you are invisible enemies are unable to attack or follow you. Most physical attacks and magical effects (such as scrolls and wands) will immediately cancel invisibility. Additionally, while shadowmelded, your rate of hunger is slowed.

You will remain shadowmelded until you leave the shadows or an enemy comes into contact with you.
text.减速魔法影响了目标的时间流速，在目标眼中所有的事物都移动得飞快。\n\n迟缓下的:
Slowing magic affects the target's rate of time, to them everything is moving super-fast.

A slowed character performs all actions in twice the amount of time they would normally take.

Turns of slow remaining: %s.
text.狙击手专注于最近射击的目标。她能够用灵能弓进行一次特殊攻击，攻击方式取决于弓的强:
The Sniper is honed in on the target she most recently attacked. She is able to perform a special attack with her bow which will vary based on how the bow is augmented.

An unaugmented bow will fire a _snapshot,_ which deals reduced damage but does not take any time to fire.

A bow augmented for speed will fire a _volley_ of three arrows. Each arrow will deal reduced damage, but can still activate enchantment. This volley takes 1 turn to shoot.

A bow augmented for damage will fire a _sniper shot._ This shot is guaranteed to hit, deals bonus damage based on distance from the target, and takes 2 turns to fire.

Turns remaining: %s.
text.术士已经击穿了目标的灵魂。其在受到物理伤害时将会恢复术士的生命。\n\n灵魂标记:
The warlock has tapped into the soul of this creature, allowing him to heal as it takes physical damage.

Turns of soul mark remaining: %s.
text.你感受到了体内无尽的精力，让你可以以更快的速度移动！\n\n当你处于体力充沛状态:
You have unending stamina, allowing for faster movement!

While under the effects of stamina you will run at +50%% speed, but will perform all other actions at normal speed.

Turns of stamina remaining: %s.
text.集群智能会使敌人在发现你或你的盟友时吸引其他敌人至你所在的位置。\n\n集群智能:
Swarm Intelligence causes enemies to attract other enemies to your position when they see you or your allies.

This attracting has a limited range, but the longer you are seen the higher this range grows, to a max of 12. Breaking sight even for a moment resets the range.

Current largest attraction range: %d.
text.易伤魔法会使得目标受到所有被护甲减免过的物理伤害增加33%%。\n\n易伤效果剩:
Vulnerability magic increases all physical damage that a character takes by 33%%, after that damage has been reduced by armor.

Turns of vulnerable remaining: %s.
text.恐惧是使敌人陷入不可控制的恐慌的操纵性魔法。\n\n恐惧中的角色会远离自己的敌人:
Terror is manipulative magic which forces its target into an uncontrollable panic.

Terrified characters are forced to run away from their opponent, trying to put as many doors and walls between them as possible. The shock of pain will lessen the duration of terror, however.

Turns of terror remaining: %s.
text.你被灌注了毒素的力量！\n\n在你移动时毒气会从你的身体中翻腾而出，伤害你的敌人:
You are imbued with poisonous energy!

As you move around toxic gas will constantly billow forth from you, damaging your enemies. You are immune to toxic gas and poison for the duration of the effect, as well as for a few turns afterward.

Turns of toxic imbue remaining: %s.
text.强酸能以惊人的速度腐蚀掉血肉、金属和骨头。\n\n目标被腐蚀的时间越长，酸蚀伤害:
Powerful acid melts away flesh, metal, and bone at an alarming rate.

Corrosion damage increases over time, as the target continues to melt away.

Turns of corrosion remaining: %1$s.
Current corrosion damage: %2$d.
text.如果整个世界都在旋转的话，想走直线会变得十分困难。 \n\n眩晕效果持续时，目标:
Walking in a straight line can be difficult when the whole world is spinning.

While under the effects of vertigo, characters who attempt to move will go in a random direction, instead of the one they intended to go in.

Turns of vertigo remaining: %s.
text.你的伤害型法杖已被强化，接下来的几次攻击会造成额外伤害。\n\n额外伤害：%1$:
Your damage-dealing wands have been empowered, increasing the amount of damage they deal for a few hits.

Bonus damage: %1$d.
Hits remaining: %2$d.
text.你感觉自己的装备突然变得沉重起来。\n\n虚弱魔法会减弱角色的肉体力量，使其造成:
Everything suddenly seems much heavier.

Weakening magic reduces a character's physical strength, causing them to deal 33%% reduced damage.

Turns of weakness remaining: %s.
text.你感觉自己吃的非常饱。\n\n当你处于饱腹状态时，你的饥饿值不会增加，并且会随着:
You feel quite satisfied and full.

While well fed, your hunger will not increase, and you will heal an additional amount of health over time.

Turns remaining: %d.
text.战士能向指定地点使用_英勇之跃_，越过所有的敌人与危险地形。: The Warrior performs a _Heroic Leap_ towards a targeted location, sailing above enemies and hazards.
text.战士向指定地点跳跃，越过路径上的所有敌人与危险地形。不过战士无法越过墙壁或是其它: The Warrior leaps toward a targeted location, going over any enemies or hazards in the way. He cannot leap over walls or other solid terrain however.
text.战士大力锤击地面，向一个锥形区域施以_震地冲击_。被冲击波击中的敌人会受到一定伤: The Warrior releases a _Shockwave_ in a conical AOE by slamming the ground. Enemies caught in the shockwave are damaged and crippled.
text.战士大力锤击地面产生冲击波，震击前方60度扇形范围5格距离内的区域。\n\n被冲:
The Warrior slams the ground, producing a shockwave that travels up to 5 tiles in a 60 degree cone.

Enemies caught in this shockwave are crippled for 5 turns. They also take 5-10 damage, plus an additional 1-2 damage for every point of strength the Warrior has above 10.
text.战士将忍受的原始伤害织成愤怒，将大量的额外伤害倾泻给敌人。\n\n额外伤害：%1:
The Warrior is now dealing bonus damage based on the damage he endured.

Bonus Damage: %1$d
Hits Left: %2$d
text.战士_苦痛坚忍_，跳过若干回合并大幅抵抗伤害。接下来战士会根据忍受的原始伤害造成: The Warrior _Endures_, skipping several turns but gaining high damage resistance. He then deals bonus damage based on what he endured.
text.战士首先忍耐3回合，将任何受到的伤害减少一半。此减伤效果优先于其它减伤计算。\n:
The Warrior endures for 3 turns, taking half damage from all sources. This reduction is applied before damage resisting effects like armor.

After enduring, the warrior's next hit within 10 turns gains bonus damage. This bonus damage is equal to half of all the damage inflicted on him while enduring, before any damage reduction effects!

If the Warrior has any combo, using this ability increases its remaining time by 3 turns.
text.你不能在没有魔杖的情况下使用这个能力。: You can't use this ability without your staff.
text.法师从魔杖中释放_元素风暴_，席卷以自身为中心的一大片圆形区域，基于灌注的法杖引: The Mage emits an _Elemental Blast_ from his staff, covering a large area around him in an effect that varies based on the wand in his staff.
text.法师释放出风暴般的魔力，席卷半径为4的圆形区域，对其中的目标造成15~25点伤害: The Mage emits a blast of magic, which covers a circular region up to 4 tiles away and deals up to 15-25 damage. The specific effect of elemental blast will vary by the wand imbued in the Mage's staff.
text.元素风暴引发的效果与法杖向目标施法的效果类似。: The effect of elemental blast will be similar to the effect of the wand when zapped at an enemy or ally.
text.你没有法杖可供施法！: You have no wands to zap with!
text.法师引导出法杖中的_狂野魔法_，在单回合内对指定目标随机释放这些法杖多次。: The Mage unleashes the _Wild Magic_ contained in his wands, randomly firing them multiple times at a chosen target over a single turn.
text.法师引导出法杖的魔力，在一回合内随机释放法杖至多4次。该能力不会释放法师魔杖。\:
The Mage unleashes the power in his wands, randomly firing them up to 4 times in a single turn. The Mage's staff is not included in this effect.

Each wand also has its level boosted by 2, up to +3. This ability uses half a wand charge for each zap, and no one wand can be fired more than 2 times.
text.楼层被封锁了，你无法离开！: You cannot leave a locked floor!
text.你不能将信标放在那里！: You can't place a beacon there!
text.你的信标目前设置在了第%d层。: Your beacon is currently placed on floor %d.
text.法师在当前位置设置了一个_空间信标_，他能瞬间传送回信标所在位置。: The Mage places a _Warping Beacon_ at his current location, which he can instantly teleport back to.
text.法师设置了一个可以随时返回的信标。信标设置需要1回合，但传送回不消耗时间。\n\:
The Mage places a beacon, which can then be warped to at will. Placing the beacon takes 1 turn, but warping to it is instantaneous.

The Mage cannot warp between floors by default, or use the beacon to reach inaccessible places such as locked rooms. The Mage can teleport into enemies, which will push them aside.
text.你只能跳到视野范围内的空格子里。: You can only jump to an empty location in your field of view.
text.选择要跳到的位置: Choose a location to jump to
text.不知为何敌人坚信这就是盗贼本身。: Somehow, enemies are easily convinced that this wooden decoy is the real Rogue!
text.你可通过某个英雄护甲技能遇到该单位。: You can find this character with a specific hero armor ability.
text.盗贼在原地制造一场_烟幕爆炸_后闪现离去，并使原点周围的敌人失明。: The Rogue throws down a _Smoke Bomb_ while blinking away. He blinds enemies near his old location.
text.盗贼在原地制造一场烟幕爆炸，并闪现最多6格的距离。闪现无视敌人与危险地形，但仍会:
The Rogue throws down a smoke bomb and blinks up to 6 tiles away. He can blink through hazards and enemies, but not through solid terrain like walls.

Enemies that are adjacent to the Rogue's old position will be blinded for 5 turns.
text.盗贼向选中的敌人施加_夺命印记_。被标记的敌人将受到额外伤害，但不会在标记期间死: The Rogue places a _Death Mark_ on a chosen enemy. Marked enemies take bonus damage, but cannot die until the mark ends.
text.盗贼标记选中的敌人，使其受到额外25%的伤害。标记不耗费时间且持续5回合。\n\:
The Rogue places a mark on a chosen enemy, causing them to take 25% extra damage. The mark is applied instantly and lasts for 5 turns.

Marked enemies take bonus damage but are unable to die until the mark expires. If an enemy has 0 HP when the mark ends, they will immediately die.
text.这名被标记的敌人受到25%%的额外伤害，但不会在标记期间死亡。\n\n标记剩余时:
This enemy has been marked, causing them to take 25%% bonus damage, but also rendering them unable to die until the mark ends.

Turns remaining: %s.
text.盗贼召唤一个_暗影映像_，并能使唤其帮助自己战斗。: The Rogue summons a _Shadow Clone_, which can be directed to aid him in combat.
text.盗贼召唤一个暗影映像，并可以指使它作战。指使映像不会消耗充能。\n\n映像拥有8:
The Rogue summons a shadowy mimic of himself, which can be directed to aid him in combat. Directing the shadow clone does not cost any charge.

The clone has 80 HP, no armor, and deals 10-20 damage. All of these traits can be improved with talents, such that the clone benefits from weapons and armor the hero has.
text.你的映像去了那个位置。: Your clone moves to that position.
text.你的映像正在跟随你。: Your clone moves to follow you.
text.一具无形暗影塑造出的盗贼复制体，它一动不动双目空空，烟雾般的黑暗在周围缓缓升腾。:
A copy of the Rogue, made from shadowy darkness. It stands stock still, with empty eyes and tiny wisps of darkness rising from it like steam.

The clone is not a perfect copy of the Rogue, but is still a decent fighter, and can benefit from the Rogue's equipment with the right talents.
text.女猎手向一个目标掷出_灵魂飞刃_，根据装备的近战武器造成伤害。: The Huntress throws _Spectral Blades_ at a target, inflicting damage depending on her currently equipped melee weapon.
text.女猎手向一名敌人掷出灵能飞刃，就像用近战武器进行远程攻击。该攻击保留包括附魔的所: The Huntress throws out a spectral blade at an enemy, which acts like a ranged strike from her melee weapon. All of the normal effects of a melee weapon will activate, including enchantments.
text.女猎手呼唤_自然之力_的协助，在短时间内增加其移动速度与灵能弓射击速度。: The Huntress calls upon _Nature's Power_, increasing her movement speed and her bow's rate of fire for a short time.
text.女猎手与她的弓注入了自然的力量！这种力量持续8回合。\n\n在自然之力的加持下，:
The Huntress temporarily empowers herself and her bow with the power of nature! This lasts for 8 turns.

During this time, the Huntress moves at 2x speed, and attacks 33% faster with her bow. The bonus bow effects do not trigger if the Sniper is using her special attacks.
text.女猎手拥有了暂时的自然之力，增加其移动速度与灵能弓射击速度。\n\n剩余回合数：:
The Huntress is briefly empowered, increasing her movement speed and attack speed with her bow.

Turns remaining: %s.
text.女猎手召唤一只_灵能飞鹰_使魔，协助侦查并吸引敌人注意。: The Huntress summons a _Spirit Hawk_ familiar, which can help her scout locations and distract enemies.
text.女猎手召唤一只灵能飞鹰，飞鹰存在时使用此能力可指引其行动。飞鹰将存在100回合，:
The Huntress summons a spirit hawk familiar, which can be directed by using the ability again while it is summoned. The hawk lasts for 100 turns, directing the hawk does not cost any charge.

The hawk has minimal health and attacking power, but is fast, evasive, and accurate. It shares its entire field of vision with the Huntress at all times. It is immune to all area-bound effects, such as fire and poison gas. It will not attack unless specifically directed to.
text.你的灵能飞鹰移动到了那个位置。: Your hawk moves to that position.
text.你的飞鹰正在跟随你。: Your hawk moves to follow you.
text.一只女猎手召唤的灵能飞鹰，全身散发着明亮而空灵的蓝光。它不断扭头探查着周围环境。:
A magical hawk, summoned by the Huntress. It glows a bright ethereal blue, its head constantly shifts around as it surveys the area.

While it isn't much of a fighter its speed and vision make it excellent for scouting and distracting enemies.
text.你在同一时间里只能进行一场决斗。: You can only be in one duel at a time.
text.你不能选择无法接近的目标。: You must be able to reach your target.
text.那个敌人离得太远，无法发起决斗。: That enemy is too far away to challenge.
text.决斗家向一名附近的敌人发起_公平决斗_，在短时间内停止所有其它敌人的时间。: The Duelist _Challenges_ a nearby enemy to a duel, temporarily freezing all other enemies.
text.决斗家向一名附近的敌人发起决斗。被选中的敌人会被迫应战，而其它敌人暂时陷入时间冻:
The Duelist challenges a nearby enemy to a duel. That enemy is compelled to fight her while all other enemies are temporarily frozen in time.

The target must be reachable and within 5 tiles of the Duelist. The duel lasts until 10 turns pass, the enemy dies, or the Duelist is more than 5 tiles away from the enemy.

Frozen enemies are invulnerable. The Duelist's allies are not frozen by this ability, but if a boss is targeted its minions will not be frozen either.
text.这个角色正处于一场决斗之中。决斗双方及它们的友方单位或随从能够正常活动，其它角色:
This character is participating in a duel. They, and any of their allies or minions, are allowed to act normally while others are frozen.

The duel will last for a set amount of time, until one participant dies, or until the participants move more than 5 tiles away from eachother.

Turns remaining: %d.
text.决斗家施展一次_元素打击_，基于所持武器的附魔在扇形范围内施加效果。: The Duelist performs an _Elemental Strike_, spreading an effect in a conical AOE based on her weapon enchantment.
text.决斗家打击一名敌人或一个地点，进行一次必定命中的普通攻击，并在65度角4格半径的: The Duelist strikes an enemy or location, performing a regular attack that's guaranteed to hit and spreading a magical effect that travels up to 4 tiles in a 65 degree cone. This magical effect varies based on the enchantment on the Duelist's primary weapon.
text.不带有附魔的元素打击将会造成一次小型的魔力爆发，对范围内的所有敌人造成6~12点: An elemental strike with no enchantment will release a small burst of magic, dealing 6-12 damage to all enemies in range.
text.选择要冲到的位置: Choose a location to dash to
text.那个位置不与你相邻。: That location is not adjacent to you.
text.你无法移动到那个位置。: You can't move to that location.
text.决斗家_虚晃一招_，在假装进行攻击的同时冲向一个邻近位置。诱导敌人攻击她的残影，: The Duelist _Feints_, faking an attack while dashing to an adjacent tile. Enemies will attack her afterimage, leaving them open to a counterattack.
text.决斗家在假装进行攻击的同时冲向一个邻近位置，在原位留下一个残影。正在攻击决斗家的:
The Duelist fakes an attack while dashing to an adjacent tile, leaving behind a momentary afterimage of herself. Enemies that were attacking the Duelist will attack her afterimage instead.

Enemies that attack the afterimage become confused, which cancels their next action and leaves them open to a surprise attack.
text.牧师_超凡升天_而进入神格，可获得全新法术、攻击距离与护盾。: The Cleric assumes an _Ascended Form_, gaining new spells, attack range, and shielding.
text.牧师释放神圣能量，进入持续10回合的神格。在此形态下，牧师可施放全新法术，增加2:
The Cleric projects holy energy from themselves, assuming an extended radiant form for 10 turns. While in this form the Cleric can cast new spells, gains 2 attack range, 30 shielding, and any additional spells they cast will grant 10 shielding per holy tome charge used.

The shielding from ascended form and its spells does not decay normally, but will immediately fade once ascended form ends. The ability can be re-used to refresh ascended form's duration.
text.神圣能量自牧师周身流转。进入神格时，牧师可通过其神圣能量索敌以获得2格攻击距离，:
Radiant energy is emanating from the Cleric's body. While in this form the Cleric gains 2 attack range (from the holy energy projecting from them), and 10 shielding whenever they spend a holy tome charge. They are also able to cast the spells which are unlocked via ascended form's talents.

The shield granted by ascended form and its spells will not decay normally, but will instantly fade when ascended form ends.

Current shielding: %1$d.
Turns remaining: %2$d.
text.三位一体当前尚未获得任何位格的效果集，使用位格法术以使其获得效果集！: Trinity has no effect set for any of its forms currently, use one of its spells!
text.三位一体无法复制你已经装备的装备效果！: Trinity cannot duplicate an effect that you already have equipped!
text.三位一体会消耗_%2$s充能_以获得该附魔或刻印的效果_%1$d回合_。: Trinity will apply this effect for _%1$d turns_ at the cost of _%2$s charge._
text.三位一体会消耗_%2$s充能_以获得该_强力_附魔或刻印的效果_%1$d回合_。: Trinity will apply this _powerful_ effect for _%1$d turns_ at the cost of _%2$s charge._
text.三位一体会消耗_%2$s充能_以使用该法杖的_%1$d级_效果。: Trinity will zap this wand at _+%1$d_ at the cost of _%2$s charge._
text.三位一体会消耗_%2$s充能_以使用该_复充能_法杖的_%1$d级_效果。: Trinity will zap this _multi-charge_ wand at _+%1$d_ at the cost of _%2$s charge._
text.三位一体会消耗_%2$s充能_以使用该投武的_%1$d级_效果。: Trinity will throw this weapon at _+%1$d_ at the cost of _%2$s charge._
text.三位一体会消耗_%2$s充能_以获得20回合_%1$d等级_该戒指的效果。: Trinity will apply this ring's effect at _+%1$d_ for 20 turns, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
text.三位一体会消耗_%2$s充能_以使用该神器的远端炼金效果。: Trinity will apply this artifact's remote alchemy effect, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
text.三位一体会消耗_%2$s充能_以获得该神器的_%1$d级_被动生命回复效果20回: Trinity will apply this artifact's passive health regen effect at _+%1$d_ for 20 turns, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
text.三位一体会消耗_%2$s充能_以使用该神器召唤_%1$d级_幽灵生命值的友好腐化: Trinity will use this artifact's effect to summon a corrupted friendly wraith with the HP of a _+%1$d_ ghost, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
text.三位一体会消耗_%2$s充能_以使用该神器_%1$d格_范围的锁链施放效果。: Trinity will apply this artifact's chain-casting effect with reach at _+%1$d_, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
text.三位一体会消耗_%2$s充能_以使用该神器的小吃一口效果。: Trinity will apply this artifact's snacking effect, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
text.三位一体会消耗_%2$s充能_以使用该神器的_%1$d级_敌人窃取效果。: Trinity will apply this artifact's enemy robbing effect at _+%1$d_, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
text.三位一体会消耗_%2$s充能_以使用该神器的随机有害种子扎根效果。: Trinity will apply this artifact's root effect with a random harmful seed, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
text.三位一体会消耗_%2$s充能_以使用该神器的插入效果。: Trinity will apply this artifact's insert effect, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
text.三位一体会消耗_%2$s充能_以使用该神器的_%1$d级_探查效果。: Trinity will apply this artifact's scry effect at _+%1$d_, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
text.三位一体会消耗_%2$s充能_以获得该神器持续_%1$d_回合的时间冻结效果。: Trinity will apply this artifact's time freeze effect with a _%1$d_ turn duration, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
text.三位一体会消耗_%2$s充能_以使用该神器_%1$d/10_无额外消耗使用秘卷概: Trinity will apply this artifact's random scroll effect with a _%1$d/10_ chance to offer the exotic version at no additional cost, at the cost of _%2$s charge._

Each of these spells focuses on emulating the effects of different kinds of equipment that the Cleric has identified during this run: body form (weapons and armor), mind form (wands and thrown weapons), and spirit form (rings and artifacts).

While empowered by Power of Many, any ally deals +25% damage, takes -25% damage, and shares their vision with the Cleric. They also gain 25 shielding when the ability is used.

The Cleric also gains three new spells that can only be cast with an empowered ally. Power of Many won't end while one of these spells is active.
