text.圣骑士为一次致命的近战攻击注入正义之力。\n\n在造成正常近战伤害的基础上，至圣:
The Paladin infuses a melee strike with righteous destructive power.

In addition to dealing normal melee damage, Smite makes non-encumbered attacks guaranteed to hit, has +300%% enchantment power, and deals %1$d - %2$d bonus magic damage.

Smite's bonus magic damage scales with the Paladin's level, and it will always deal maximum bonus magic damage against undead or demonic foes.
text.将盟友移出地牢并凝滞其状态。: Removes ally from dungeon and preserves them.
text.牧师将其与盟友的联系集中于自身，使盟友暂时化为牧师体内的某种凝滞状态的能量。盟友:
The Cleric focuses their connection with their ally toward themselves, causing the ally to be temporarily held in a sort of energy stasis within the Cleric. The ally will be preserved for up to %d turns, with all positive effects on them being unaffected by their time in stasis.

The ally will appear next to the Cleric when stasis ends naturally or they can instantly re-cast the spell at no cost to end the effect early. Stasis can even move immobile allies, but cannot transfer them between floors.
text.你无法移动的盟友被落在了后面。: Your immobile ally is left behind.
text.牧师当前已有盟友被星界投射凝滞状态。该盟友包括万物一心在内的所有正面效果都会被凝:
The Cleric currently has an ally stored in stasis. All positive effects on this ally are preserved, including Power of Many, and they will reappear next to the Cleric when the effect ends. The effect can also be ended early by re-casting Stasis.

Ally in stasis: %1$s.
Turns Remaining: %2$s.
text.造成远程魔法伤害并致盲目标一次。: Deals ranged magic damage and blinds a target once.
text.牧师向目标发射致盲光束，造成%1$d~%2$d伤害并使其失明%3$d回合。阳炎射:
The Cleric fires a ray of blinding light at a target, dealing %1$d-%2$d damage and blinding them for %3$d turns. Sunray always deals maximum damage to undead and demonic targets.

After being struck with this spell an enemy's vision will adjust, preventing them from being blinded by it again. However, if they are struck again while blinded by this spell, then the light is overwhelming and paralyses them instead.
text.创造一面阻挡敌人的屏障。: Creates a wall that blocks enemies.
text.圣骑士将圣光凝聚为墙壁，在自身面前创造一面1格厚，%1$d格宽，持续20回合的神:
The Paladin creates a wall made out of panels of solid light directly in front of themselves which is 1 tile thick, %1$d tiles wide, and lasts for 20 turns.

This wall acts just like a regular one, except it can be seen through. Enemies that are caught in the wall when its created will be momentarily stunned and pushed back if possible. Anything stuck in the wall will be able to move out of it.

The wall can be cast in any of the four cardinal or four diagonal directions. If a wall is already active, the spell can be re-used for free to instantly clear the wall.
text.你驱散了神圣屏障。: You dispel the wall of light.
text.神圣屏障阻挡了此处的通路。: Shimmering panels of light are blocking passage here.
text.现在还不能离去，埋藏在地牢之下的名利正呼唤着你！: You can't leave yet, the rest of the dungeon awaits below!
text.你不能变得更强了，不过你的经验给了你一股力量！: You cannot grow stronger, but your experiences do give you a surge of power!
text.箱子锁着而你没有对应的钥匙。: This chest is locked and you don't have a matching key.
text.你没有对应的钥匙。: You don't have a matching key.
text.你没办法集中精力，探索周边异常费力。: It's hard to concentrate, searching is exhausting.
text.你没能打开这把锁，还得再试试。: You can't quite get the lock open, you'll have to keep trying.
text.疼痛使你得以抵抗睡意。: The pain helps you resist the urge to sleep.
text.重生十字章迸裂出苏生的能量！: The ankh explodes with life-giving energy!
text.战士用他的_破损纹章_生成护盾以额外减免伤害。纹章可以在护甲之间转移，并且可以_: The Warrior endures extra damage with shielding granted by his _broken seal._ The seal can be moved between armors and _transfers a single upgrade._
text.战士初始携带一枚_独特的破损纹章_，可使他在生命值半数以下时获得爆发性护盾。纹章:
The Warrior starts with a _unique broken seal_ that grants him a burst of shielding when he is below half health. The seal can be moved between armors, and can _transfer a single upgrade_ with it.

The Warrior also starts with a _worn shortsword_, _three throwing stones_, cloth armor, a waterskin, and a velvet pouch.

The Warrior automatically identifies:
_-_ Scrolls of Identify
_-_ Potions of Healing
_-_ Scrolls of Rage
text.法师是一位奥术专家，开局持有一根强于法杖的_魔杖_。魔杖可以灌注法师找到的_任何: The Mage is an arcane expert and carries a _magical staff_ that's stronger than a wand. The staff can be _imbued with any wand_ the Mage finds.
text.法师初始携带一根_独特的魔杖_。魔杖的自动充能速度显著快于一般法杖，并且有1点额:
The Mage starts with a _unique staff_, which recharges significantly faster than a wand and has 1 more charge. The staff _can be imbued with any wand_ the Mage finds in the dungeon.

The Mage also starts with a _wand of magic missile_ imbued in his staff, cloth armor, a waterskin, and a velvet pouch.

The Mage automatically identifies:
_-_ Scrolls of Identify
_-_ Potions of Liquid Flame
_-_ Scrolls of Upgrade
text._使用一张升级卷轴强化一个物品_以解锁法师。: To unlock the Mage _use a scroll of upgrade to make an item stronger._
text.盗贼能借助他的_暗影斗篷_来躲避和偷袭敌人。他还可以从更远的距离_探测秘密与陷阱: The Rogue can evade enemies and strike from invisibility using his _cloak of shadows._ He also _detects secrets and traps_ from a greater distance.
text.盗贼初始携带一件_独特的暗影斗篷_。披上后，盗贼可以随时隐形。\n\n盗贼能从更:
The Rogue starts with a _unique Cloak of Shadows_, which he can use to become invisible at will.

The Rogue can _detect secrets and traps_ from a greater distance.

The Rogue also starts with _a dagger_, _three throwing knives_, cloth armor, a waterskin, and a velvet pouch.

The Rogue automatically identifies:
_-_ Scrolls of Identify
_-_ Potions of Invisibility
_-_ Scrolls of Magic Mapping
text._在一场游戏中进行十次伏击_以解锁盗贼。: To unlock the Rogue _perform 10 surprise attacks in one game._
text.女猎手精通投掷武器，并且具有一把能无限射击的_灵能弓_。女猎手可以穿过高草丛而_: The Huntress is a master of thrown weapons and has a _magical bow_ with infinite arrows. She also travels through tall grass _without trampling it._
text.女猎手初始携带一把_独特的灵能弓_，可以无限发射魔法箭矢。\n\n女猎手可以穿过:
The Huntress starts with a _unique spirit bow_, which can fire an infinite number of conjured arrows.

The Huntress can travel through tall grass _without trampling it_.

The Huntress also starts with _studded gloves_, cloth armor, a waterskin, and a velvet pouch.

The Huntress automatically identifies:
_-_ Scrolls of Identify
_-_ Potions of Mind Vision
_-_ Scrolls of Lullaby
text._在一场游戏中使用投掷武器命中十次敌人_以解锁女猎手。: To unlock the Huntress _hit enemies with thrown weapons 10 times in one game._
text.决斗家是一名武器大师，她能够用武器使出_独特的武技_。使出的武技_依不同武器而异: The Duelist is a weapons master who can use her weapon to trigger a _special weapon ability._ This special ability is _different for every weapon._
text.决斗家初始携带一柄_独特的刺剑_，拥有随时间自然充能的特殊武技。\n\n决斗家持:
The Duelist starts with a _unique rapier_ with a special ability that recharges over time.

Every weapon in the game has a _different special ability_ that the Duelist can use.

The Duelist also starts with _two throwing spikes_, cloth armor, a waterskin, and a velvet pouch.

The Duelist automatically identifies:
_-_ Scrolls of Identify
_-_ Potions of Strength
_-_ Scrolls of Mirror Image
text._在力量达到需求的情况下装备一把2阶或更高阶的武器_以解锁决斗家。: To unlock the Duelist _equip a tier 2 or higher weapon with no strength penalty._
text.牧师是一名使用其独特的_神圣法典_引导神圣魔法的神圣施法者。其能通过天赋_学习并: The Cleric is a divine spellcaster who uses their unique _holy tome_ to channel divine magic. They can _learn and upgrade spells_ via talents.
text.牧师初始携带一本_独特的神圣法典_，可以使其施放各种各样的法术。\n\n牧师的大:
The Cleric starts with a _unique holy tome_, which they can use to cast various spells.

Most of the Cleric's talents are focused around learning or upgrading spells.

The Cleric also starts with _a cudgel_, cloth armor, a waterskin, and a velvet pouch.

The Cleric automatically identifies:
_-_ Scrolls of Identify
_-_ Potions of Purity
_-_ Scrolls of Remove Curse
text._完全净化任何一件被诅咒装备的诅咒_以解锁牧师: To unlock the Cleric _fully cleanse the curse on any piece of cursed equipment._
text._狂战士_在受到伤害的时候会积累怒气，怒气能提高狂战士的攻击力，并可在其达到10: The _Berserker_ builds rage as he takes damage. Rage increases his damage and can be activated at 100% for bonus shielding.
text.狂战士会在他受到物理伤害时获得怒气，甚至包括被其护甲所格挡的伤害！怒气会随时间稳:
The Berserker gains rage as he takes physical damage, including damage that gets blocked by his armor! Rage steadily fades away over time, but fades more slowly if he is at low HP.

Rage can cause the Berserker to deal up to +50% damage. At max rage he can go berserk, gaining a burst of shielding and keeping his rage as long as he has shielding left. The shielding scales with the level of the berserker's armor, and can be massively boosted if he is at low health. The Berserker needs time to recover after he goes berserk.
text._角斗士_会在成功进行攻击时积累连击数。角斗士可以消耗连击数以使用特殊战技。: The _Gladiator_ builds combo when he makes successful attacks. He can spend combo to use unique abilities.
text.每当角斗士以近战武器或投掷武器成功击中目标时，他都会积累一点连击。如果角斗士在5:
The Gladiator builds one point of combo every time he makes a successful attack with a melee or thrown weapon. If the Gladiator does not make a successful attack within 5 turns (15 turns after a kill), his combo is reset.

As he builds combo the Gladiator can use a variety of abilities that are guaranteed to hit:
2 Combo: knock enemy back, preserves combo
4 Combo: deal damage based on armor
6 Combo: parry, preserves combo
8 Combo: damage target and nearby enemies
10 Combo: attack once for each combo
text._战斗法师_在使用魔杖近战攻击时会附带额外的法术效果。这些效果取决于魔杖内灌注的: The _Battlemage_ conjures bonus effects when fighting in melee with his staff. These effects depend on the wand his staff is imbued with.
text.战斗法师使用魔杖近战时会附带类似附魔的额外效果，效果取决于魔杖所灌注的法杖种类，: The Battlemage gains a bonus effect whenever he strikes in melee with his staff, as if his staff had an additional enchantment. These effects depend on the wand his staff is imbued with, every wand has its own effect. In addition to the wand effects, the Battlemage's staff will also gain 0.5 charges when he strikes with it.
text._术士_在使用法杖时有概率标记敌人的灵魂。每当术士对被标记的敌人造成物理伤害，自: The _Warlock_ has a chance to soul mark enemies with his wands. He will heal whenever he deals physical damage to marked enemies.
text.术士在对角色使用法杖时有概率为其施加灵魂标记。施加灵魂标记的概率与标记的持续时间:
The Warlock has a chance to inflict a soul mark on characters when he uses wands on them. The chance to apply a soul mark and its duration increase with wand level.

When an enemy is soul marked, the Warlock will heal 2 hp for every 5 damage he deals to them, but only with attacks from melee or thrown weapons, not from wands!
text.隐形时，_刺客_会准备一次致命的攻击。耐心等得越久，这一击的威力越强。: The _Assassin_ can prepare a deadly strike while he is invisible. The longer he waits, the more powerful the attack will be.
text.刺客会在隐形时准备强力的一击。他准备的时间越长，下次攻击就越致命。准备阶段最多累:
The Assassin prepares his next strike when he becomes invisible. The longer he prepares for, the more powerful his next attack will be. Preparation builds for up to 9 turns.

After preparing, the Assassin deals bonus damage on his next attack, can blink to his target, and can even instantly kill enemies who are weak enough.
text._疾行者_在奔跑时会累积动量。动量可以用于开启逸动效果，使他在短时间内获得速度和: The _Freerunner_ builds momentum as he runs, which can be used to start freerunning. This grants him bonus speed and evasion for a short while.
text._疾行者_在奔跑时会累积动量。他每次移动获得1点动量，最多累积10点，在不移动时:
As the Freerunner moves he builds stacks of momentum. He can gain up to 10 momentum after running for 10 turns, but rapidly loses it if he stops moving. The freerunner can use up his momentum to start freerunning, for 2 turns per point of momentum.

When freerunning the Freerunner moves at 2x speed, and gains bonus evasion in proportion to his level. Once freerunning ends there is a cooldown before momentum can be built again.
text._狙击手_的远程攻击能穿透护甲。用投掷武器击中目标后，狙击手能以灵能弓进行一次特: The _Sniper_ can pierce armor with her ranged attacks. After striking with a thrown weapon she can follow up with a special attack from her bow.
text.狙击手是远程战斗大师，她的远程攻击无视敌人护甲。使用投掷武器击中敌人后，女猎手能:
The Sniper is a master of ranged combat, whose ranged attacks pierce enemy armor. When she attacks an enemy with a thrown weapon, she places a sniper's mark on them, which lets her follow up with a special attack from her bow. This special attack varies based on how her bow is augmented.

An unaugmented bow will fire a snapshot which deals reduced damage but fires instantly. A speed bow will fire a volley of three arrows which deal reduced damage, can still activate enchantments, and take 1 turn to fire. A damage bow will fire a sniper shot which is guaranteed to hit, deals bonus damage based on distance, and takes 2 turns to fire.
text._守望者_具有穿透高草的视野，而且在种植和踩踏植物时会获得额外效果。: The _Warden_ can see through tall grass and gains bonus effects when she plants seeds and tramples plants.
text.守望者与自然之力有强大的联结，这赋予了她多项有关植物的能力。守望者具有穿透高草与:
The Warden has a strong connection to nature which grants her a variety of bonus effects relating to grass and plants. She is able to see through tall and furrowed grass as if it were empty space.

The Warden causes grass to sprout up around any seed she throws or plants, and gains special effects when trampling plants. These special effects replace the regular plant effects, meaning that no plant is harmful for her to step on.
text._勇士_可以双持武器，并拥有更多武技充能。她用主武器进行普通攻击，但她也可以自如: The _Champion_ can wield two weapons and gets more weapon charges. Her regular attacks use her primary weapon, but she can swap weapons and use either weapon's ability.
text.勇士善使近战武器，除了主武器，她还能再装备一件副武器。勇士用主武器进行普通攻击，:
The Champion is a master of melee weapons who can equip a secondary weapon in addition to her primary one. Her regular attacks use her primary weapon, but she can swap her primary weapon instantly and use either weapon's ability.

She also gains 2 more max weapon ability charges and +50% weapon ability recharge speed.
text._武僧_在战斗时能够积蓄内力，这些内力可用于施展诸多武功。: The _Monk_ builds energy while fighting. This energy can be spent on a variety of unique abilities.
text.武僧的武术造诣十分深厚。她在击败敌人时能够积蓄内力，并用于施放诸多防御性和功能性:
The Monk is a master of physical technique. As she defeats enemies, she gains energy which can be used on a variety of defensive and utility-focused abilities. This energy does not fade over time, but has a cap based on the Monk's level.

1 Energy: quickly strike with fists
2 Energy: focus to dodge next attack
3 Energy: instantly dash nearby
4 Energy: kick an enemy away
5 Energy: meditate to clear statuses and restore wand & artifact charge
text._祭司_会获得全新的远程法术和强化版神导之光。: The _Priest_ gains new long-range spells and an empowered version of guiding light.
text.祭司获得一系列全新升级的法术，其主要强调远程攻击与魔法物品兼容。\n\n祭司每经:
The Priest gains a variety of new and upgraded spells that emphasize ranged combat and synergy with magical items.

The Priest can cast _Guiding Light_ for free once every 50 turns, illuminates enemies directly targeted by any of their spells, and can consume the illumination debuff with allies, wands, and some artifacts for bonus damage equal to their level + 5.

The Priest also gains the _Radiance_ spell, which dispels darkness and affects all visible enemies, triggering and applying illuminate and briefly stunning them at the cost of 2 charges.
text._圣骑士_会获得全新的近程法术和强化版神圣武器、神圣护甲。: The _Paladin_ gains new short-range spells and empowered versions of holy weapon and ward.
text.圣骑士获得一系列全新升级的法术，其主要强调近战攻击与武器护甲兼容。\n\n圣骑士:
The Paladin gains a variety of new and upgraded spells that emphasize melee combat and synergy with weapons and armor.

The Paladin's _Holy Weapon_ and _Holy Ward_ spells grant larger bonuses, no longer override existing enchantments and glyphs, and can be extended by casting other spells.

The Paladin also gains the _Smite_ spell, which lets them perform a guaranteed melee hit with bonus damage and enchantment power.
text.战士刚刚失去护盾，他的下一次物理攻击将造成额外伤害。\n\n剩余回合数：%s:
The Warrior has recently lost his shielding, his next physical attack will deal bonus damage.

Turns remaining: %s.
text.法师刚刚使用了魔杖或法杖，他的下一次物理攻击将造成额外伤害。\n\n剩余回合数：:
The Mage has recently used a staff or wand, his next physical attack will deal bonus damage.

Turns remaining: %s.
text.女猎手最近使用投掷武器发动过一次攻击，她对同一目标发动的下一次近战攻击将获得伤害:
The Huntress has recently attacked an enemy with a thrown weapon, her next melee attack against the same target will have boosted damage.

Turns remaining: %s.
text.决斗家刚刚等待了一回合，她的下一次近战攻击将会造成额外伤害。: The Duelist has just spent a turn waiting, her next melee attack will deal bonus damage.
text.你刚刚发动过这个天赋，需要稍等才能再次发动。\n\n剩余冷却：%s回合:
You have recently used this talent, and must wait before using it again.

Turns remaining: %s.
text.决斗家的下一次普通近战攻击将获得额外精准。\n\n剩余回合数：%s:
The Duelist's next regular melee attack will gain bonus accuracy.

Turns remaining: %s.
text.决斗家的下一次普通近战攻击将获得精准加成。\n\n剩余回合数：%s:
The Duelist's next regular melee attack will gain bonus accuracy.

Turns remaining: %s.
text.决斗家最近使用投掷武器命中了一个敌人，她对同一目标发动的近战攻击将获得伤害加成。:
The Duelist has recently attacked an enemy with a thrown weapon, her melee attacks against the same target will have boosted damage.

Turns remaining: %s.
text.牧师下一次施法会为其提供少量护盾。: The next spell the Cleric casts will grant them a small amount of shielding.
text._+1：_ 战士在生命值不高于33%时进食将恢复_4点生命_。\n\n_+2：_:
_+1:_ Eating food heals the Warrior for _4 HP_ when he is at or below 33% health.

_+2:_ Eating food heals the Warrior for _6 HP_ when he is at or below 33% health.
text._+1：_战士鉴定武器的速度提升至原来的_1.75倍_，鉴定护甲的速度提升至原来:
_+1:_ The Warrior identifies weapons _1.75x faster_ and armor _2.5x faster_.

_+2:_ The Warrior identifies weapons _2.5x faster_ and armor _when he equips it_.
text._+1：_当 战士所获的任何护盾效果被伤害击碎时，他的下一次物理攻击将造成_3点:
_+1:_ When any shielding buff applied to the Warrior is broken by damage, his next physical attack will deal _3 bonus damage_.

_+2:_ When any shielding buff applied to the Warrior is broken by damage, his next physical attack will deal _5 bonus damage_.
text._+1：_战士的纹章所提供的护盾_增加1点_。\n\n_+2：_战士的纹章所提供:
_+1:_ The shield provided by the Warrior's seal is _increased by 1_.

_+2:_ The shield provided by the Warrior's seal is _increased by 2_.
text._如果这个天赋被其它英雄获得_，那么它会提供1或2点最大护盾版本的战士的破损纹章: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will passively grant a 1 or 2 max shield version of the Warrior's broken seal effect.
text._+1：_战士进食只花费1回合，并在进食过程中获得_75%的伤害抗性_。\n\n:
_+1:_ Eating food takes the Warrior 1 turn and grants him _75% damage resistance_ while eating.

_+2:_ Eating food takes the Warrior 1 turn and grants him _100% damage resistance_ while eating.
text._+1：_当战士饮用或投掷一瓶药剂、魔药或秘药时，他会获得他_最大生命值6.5%:
_+1:_ The Warrior gains _6.5% of his max HP in shielding_ when drinking or throwing a potion, brew, or elixir.

_+2:_ The Warrior gains _10% of his max HP in shielding_ when drinking or throwing a potion, brew, or elixir.

The shield amount is doubled when using potions of strength, experience, or alchemy items that must be crafted using those potions.

For alchemy items with higher output quantities (e.g. aqua brew), this talent has a chance to trigger based on how many of that item is produced.
text._+1：_战士的破损纹章可以像携带一层升级一样携带_常见刻印_。\n\n_+2：:
_+1:_ The Warrior's broken seal can transfer _regular glyphs_ in the same way it transfers an upgrade.

_+2:_ The Warrior's broken seal can transfer _regular, powerful, and curse glyphs_ in the same way it transfers an upgrade.

The seal can only transfer glyphs if they were applied to the armor when the seal was attached.
text._如果这个天赋被其它英雄获得_，那么它会使护甲刻印必定不会被升级卷轴消除的上限等: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead help glyphs on your armor resist being removed by scrolls of upgrade. Glyphs will begin to be lost when upgrading from level 6(up from 4) at +1, or level 7(up from 4) at +2. The level where glyphs are guaranteed to be lost is unchanged at +8.

_+3:_ The Paladin can cast _Wall of Light,_ a spell that creates a _7 tile wide_ solid wall in front of the Paladin that pushes away enemies and lasts for 20 turns, at the cost of 3 charges.

The wall can be placed cardinally or diagonally, only one wall can exist at a time.
text._+1：_开启超凡升天时，牧师可以施放法术_神圣干预_，以强化牧师与所有盟友的护:
_+1:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Divine Intervention,_ which boosts the Cleric and all allies up to _150 shielding_ and extends Ascended Form by _3 turns._

_+2:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Divine Intervention,_ which boosts the Cleric and all allies up to _200 shielding_ and extends Ascended Form by _4 turns._

_+3:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Divine Intervention,_ which boosts the Cleric and all allies up to _250 shielding_ and extends Ascended Form by _5 turns._

_+4:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Divine Intervention,_ which boosts the Cleric and all allies up to _300 shielding_ and extends Ascended Form by _6 turns._

Divine Intervention costs a whopping 5 tome charges, and can only be cast once in the same ascended form.
text._+1：_开启超凡升天时，牧师可以施放法术_终末天启_，以对视野内所有敌人造成_:
_+1:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Judgement,_ which deals _10-20 damage_ to all visible enemies.

_+2:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Judgement,_ which deals _15-30 damage_ to all visible enemies.

_+3:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Judgement,_ which deals _20-40 damage_ to all visible enemies.

_+4:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Judgement,_ which deals _25-50 damage_ to all visible enemies.

Judgement costs 3 tome charges. Judgement deals +33% damage for every spell the Cleric has cast since entering ascended form or since the last cast of Judgement.
text._+1：_开启超凡升天时，牧师可以施放法术_天堂阶梯_，以传送至最多_3格_外。:
_+1:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Flash_ to teleport up to _3 tiles_ away.

_+2:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Flash_ to teleport up to _4 tiles_ away.

_+3:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Flash_ to teleport up to _5 tiles_ away.

_+4:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Flash_ to teleport up to _6 tiles_ away.

Flash costs 2 tome charges initially, and 1 more charge for each use in the same ascended form.
text.牧师可以施放法术_体之位格_，消耗2点充能以使三位一体模拟牧师本局已鉴定的附魔或:
The Cleric can cast _Body Form_, which imbues Trinity with the power of an enchantment or glyph that the Cleric has identified this run, at the cost of 2 charges.

_+1:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric gains the chosen effect for _20 turns._

_+2:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric gains the chosen effect for _27 turns._

_+3:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric gains the chosen effect for _33 turns._

_+4:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric gains the chosen effect for _40 turns._

Trinity can only be imbued with one body effect at a time. Trinity's armor charge cost is higher if the chosen glyph is rare and powerful.
text.牧师可以施放法术_智之位格_，消耗3点充能以使三位一体模拟牧师本局已使用的法杖或:
The Cleric can cast _Mind Form_, which imbues Trinity with the power of a wand or thrown weapon that the Cleric has used this run, at the cost of 3 charges.

_+1:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric uses the zap or throw effect of the chosen item, as if it were _+3._

_+2:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric uses the zap or throw effect of the chosen item, as if it were _+4._

_+3:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric uses the zap or throw effect of the chosen item, as if it were _+5._

_+4:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric uses the zap or throw effect of the chosen item, as if it were _+6._

Trinity can only be imbued with one mind effect at a time.
text.牧师可以施放法术_魂之位格_，消耗4点充能以使三位一体模拟牧师本局已鉴定的戒指或:
The Cleric can cast _Spirit Form_, which imbues Trinity with the power of a ring or artifact that the Cleric has identified this run (except the holy tome), at the cost of 4 charges.

_+1:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric will gain a ring's effect at _+1_ for 20 turns, or will trigger an artifact's effect at _+4._

_+2:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric will gain a ring's effect at _+2_ for 20 turns, or will trigger an artifact's effect at _+6._

_+3:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric will gain a ring's effect at _+3_ for 20 turns, or will trigger an artifact's effect at _+8._

_+4:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric will gain a ring's effect at _+4_ for 20 turns, or will trigger an artifact's effect at _+10._

Trinity can only be imbued with one spirit effect at a time. Artifacts have varied effects and armor charge costs when triggered by Trinity.
text.牧师可以施放法术_光灵召唤_，消耗1点充能以使强化盟友释放传送光束。光束可穿透墙:
The Cleric can cast _Beaming Ray_ from an empowered ally at the cost of 1 charge. This ray can go through walls and teleports the ally to a targeted location. If an enemy is at that location, the ally appears next to the enemy and will target them. Beaming Ray can even teleport normally immobile allies, but has half range when doing so.

_+1:_ Beaming Ray has a max range of _4 tiles,_ and increases Power of Many's bonus to _+35% damage_ against the closest enemy for 10 turns.

_+2:_ Beaming Ray has a max range of _8 tiles,_ and increases Power of Many's bonus to _+40% damage_ against the closest enemy for 10 turns.

_+3:_ Beaming Ray has a max range of _12 tiles,_ and increases Power of Many's bonus to _+45% damage_ against the closest enemy for 10 turns.

_+4:_ Beaming Ray has a max range of _16 tiles,_ and increases Power of Many's bonus to _+50% damage_ against the closest enemy for 10 turns.
text.牧师可以施放法术_血色羁绊_，消耗2点充能以使牧师自身与强化盟友之间建立生命联结:
The Cleric can cast _Life Link_ between themselves and an empowered ally at the cost of 2 charges. This spell causes damage to be shared between the Cleric and their ally, and causes beneficial cleric spells of tier 3 or lower to apply to both if either is being affected.

_+1:_ Life Link lasts for _10 turns_ and increases Power of Many's bonus to _-35% damage taken._

_+2:_ Life Link lasts for _13 turns_ and increases Power of Many's bonus to _-40% damage taken._

_+3:_ Life Link lasts for _17 turns_ and increases Power of Many's bonus to _-45% damage taken._

_+4:_ Life Link lasts for _20 turns_ and increases Power of Many's bonus to _-50% damage taken._
text.牧师可以施放法术_星界投射_，消耗2点充能以凝滞强化盟友。该法术会将盟友临时移出:
The Cleric can cast _Stasis_ on an empowered ally at the cost of 2 charges. Stasis temporarily removes the ally from the dungeon and preserves the remaining time on all buffs, including Power of Many. The ally will reappear next to you when the effect ends. Stasis can be re-cast instantly and at no cost to end the effect early. Stasis works on immobile allies, but cannot move them between dungeon floors.

_+1:_ Stasis lasts for a max of _60 turns._

_+2:_ Stasis lasts for a max of _90 turns._

_+3:_ Stasis lasts for a max of _120 turns._

_+4:_ Stasis lasts for a max of _150 turns._

The Cleric can also cast Beaming Ray when an ally is in stasis to resummon them, or cast Life Link to pre-emptively apply its effect. Allies do not benefit from Life Link while in stasis however.
text._+1：_发动英雄护甲能力的充能消耗_减少12%_。\n\n_+2：_发动英雄护:
_+1:_ The hero's armor ability has a _12% reduced_ charge cost.

_+2:_ The hero's armor ability has a _23% reduced_ charge cost.

_+3:_ The hero's armor ability has a _32% reduced_ charge cost.

_+4:_ The hero's armor ability has a _40% reduced_ charge cost.
text._+1：_被鼠化的敌人造成的伤害会降低_10%_。\n\n_+2：_被鼠化的敌人:
_+1:_ Hostile ratmogrified enemies deal _-10% damage_.

_+2:_ Hostile ratmogrified enemies deal _-19% damage_.

_+3:_ Hostile ratmogrified enemies deal _-27% damage_.

_+4:_ Hostile ratmogrified enemies deal _-35% damage_.
text._+1：_对被鼠化的敌人再次使用鼠化术会固化老鼠形态并将其永久转化为友军。\n\:
_+1:_ Using ratmogrify on a ratmogrified enemy makes them friendly and makes the transformation permanent.

_+2:_ Using ratmogrify on a ratmogrified enemy makes them friendly, makes the transformation permanent, and gives them _2 turns_ of adrenaline.

_+3:_ Using ratmogrify on a ratmogrified enemy makes them friendly, makes the transformation permanent, and gives them _4 turns_ of adrenaline.

_+4:_ Using ratmogrify on a ratmogrified enemy makes them friendly, makes the transformation permanent, and gives them _6 turns_ of adrenaline.
text._+1：_以自身为目标使用鼠化术会在身边_召唤1只_友军啮齿小鼠。\n\n_+2:
_+1:_ Using ratmogrify on yourself _spawns 1_ ally marsupial rat next to you.

_+2:_ Using ratmogrify on yourself _spawns 2_ ally marsupial rats next to you.

_+3:_ Using ratmogrify on yourself _spawns 3_ ally marsupial rats next to you.

_+4:_ Using ratmogrify on yourself _spawns 4_ ally marsupial rats next to you.
text.嘿，人类！你看起来还挺强悍的。: Hey Human! You look like a tough one.
text.嘿，人类！你看起来还挺聪明的。: Hey Human! You look like a smart one.
text.嘿，人类！你看起来还挺鬼祟的。: Hey Human! You look like a sneaky one.
text.嘿，人类！你看起来还挺敏捷的。: Hey Human! You look like a quick one.
text.嘿，人类！你看起来还挺勇猛的。: Hey Human! You look like a brave one.
text.嘿，人类！你看起来还挺正经的。: Hey Human! You look like an important one.
text.不想当个没用的废物，对吗？正好，我这有活给你干。我在一座旧矿井上建造了这间铁匠铺:
Wanna be useful, eh? Yeah I got something you could do. I built dis workshop ontop of an old mine, it's just down dat ladder. Take dis pickaxe and mine me some _dark gold ore. 40 pieces_ should be enough. The rock down der is nice and soft so _you'll be able to mine through the walls with some effort._

What do you mean, how am I gonna pay? You greedy...

Ok, ok, I can do some smithin' for you. Consider yourself lucky, I'm the only blacksmith around.
text.不过小心点，矿井对于你这种弱不禁风的人类来说太危险了。矿井被废弃有一段时间了，还:
Careful though, the mine's dangerous for a little human like you. It's been abandoned for a while, and bunch of crystals have started growing. They're shiny, but too fragile to be worth anythin', and they've got some magic things protecting 'em. They're pretty strong, so _be careful where you mine_ or you'll get their attention.

There's a _giant crystal_ somewhere too. It's a lot tougher, so be prepared for a fight if you start breakin' it. I'll bet smashing it will slow all the crystal growth down though, so I'll pay extra if you can do it.
text.不过小心点，矿井对于你这种弱不禁风的人类来说太危险了。一群豺狼人也想弄点暗金，正:
Careful though, the mine's dangerous for a little human like you. Some gnolls want the gold too and now they're wreckin' the place. They're stupid things, so their mining has caused all sorts of collapses and cave-ins. You'll have to mine through it, so _look for recently disturbed rock._

I think one of the gnolls is causing most of the trouble, probably a _geomancer shaman_ or somethin'. I'll pay extra, if you can find and kill it, but I'm sure it'll fight back.
text.不过小心点，矿井对于你这种弱不禁风的人类来说太危险了。下面有某种魔菇长了出来。它:
Careful though, the mine's dangerous for a little human like you. There's some sorta fungus monster that's been growing down there. It's got mushroom sentries that're really deadly if they see you, but they can't get up and chase you at least. _Keep out of sight_ if you want to stay alive.

I'll pay extra if you can manage to take down the _biggest mushrom,_ but it'll take some real effort. It's connected to a bunch of mycelium nodes that're hidden in the walls. You'll have to break most of 'em before you can really damage it.
text.还要接着浪费我的时间？矿井入口就在那呢。: You done wastin' my time? The mine entrance is over there.
text.暗金多多益善，最好再拆了巨型水晶。: Bring me as much gold as you can, and try to break the big crystal too.
text.暗金多多益善，最好再杀了豺狼地卜师。: Bring me as much gold as you can, and try to kill the gnoll geomancer too.
text.暗金多多益善，最好再杀了巨型蘑菇。: Bring me as much gold as you can, and try to kill the giant mushroom too.
text.你在逗我？我的镐子呢？！: Are you kiddin' me? Where is my pickaxe?!
text.你准备好下去了？记得给包里留出暗金的位置。\n\n_我只准你下去一次！_:
You ready to go down? Make sure you've got some free space for the gold.

_I'm only lettin' you down der once!_
text.这就完了？你才挖到了几块暗金！怎么说你也能挖个_40块_。\n\n_别忘了，你爬:
You done already? You've hardly got any gold at all! You should be able to get _40 pieces._

_Remember, I'm not lettin' you back in once you come up._
text.这就完了？看起来你挖到的暗金不多。怎么说你也能挖个_40块_。\n\n_别忘了，:
You done already? Doesn't look like you've got a lot of gold. You should be able to get _40 pieces._

_Remember, I'm not lettin' you back in once you come up._
text.完了？你是挖到了几块暗金，不过下面肯定不止这点。怎么说你也能挖个_40块_。\n:
You done? You've got some gold at least, but there's definitely more in the mine. You should be able to get _40 pieces._

_Remember, I'm not lettin' you back in once you come up._
text.完了？看起来你挖到的暗金不少，不过对我来说还是多多益善。怎么说你也能挖个_40块:
You done? Looks like you've got a good amount of gold, but I could use a bit more. You should be able to get _40 pieces._

_Remember, I'm not lettin' you back in once you come up._
text.完了？你是挖到了挺多暗金，不过可千万别在下面丢了什么东西。\n\n_别忘了，你爬:
You done? You've got lots of gold, but make sure you haven't left any of your gear behind.

_Remember, I'm not lettin' you back in once you come up._
text.那个巨型水晶还在下面。你要是能拆了它，我会再多给你点报酬。: That giant crystal's still down there too. I'll pay extra if you destroy it.
text.那个豺狼地卜师还在下面。你要是能杀了它，我会再多给你点报酬。: That gnoll geomancer's still down there too. I'll pay extra if you kill it.
text.那个巨型蘑菇还在下面。你要是能杀了它，我会再多给你点报酬。: That giant mushroom's still down there too. I'll pay extra if you kill it.
text.那片区域在这场游戏中不可用。创建一个新游戏以尝试新任务！: That area is not accessible on this run. Play a new game to try the new quest!
text.这个巨魔铁匠看起来和任何其他巨魔一样：又高又瘦，皮肤的色泽和纹理都像是石头。这位: This troll blacksmith looks like all trolls look: he is tall and lean, and his skin resembles stone in both color and texture. The troll blacksmith is tinkering with disproportionally small tools.
text.你好，%s...曾几何时，我也如你这般——既强大又自信...直到被一只邪恶的野兽:
Hello %s... Once I was like you - strong and confident... But I was slain by a foul beast... I can't leave this place... Not until I have my revenge... Slay the _fetid rat,_ that has taken my life...

It stalks this floor... Spreading filth everywhere... _Beware its cloud of stink and corrosive bite, the acid dissolves in water..._
text.请帮助我...杀了那个令人憎恶的东西...\n\n_在水附近与它战斗...躲开它:
Please... Help me... Slay the abomination...

_Fight it near water... Avoid the stench..._
text.你好，%s...曾几何时，我也如你这般——既强大又自信...但我被一个狡猾的敌人:
Hello %s... Once I was like you - strong and confident... But I was slain by a devious foe... I can't leave this place... Not until I have my revenge... Slay the _gnoll trickster,_ that has taken my life...

It is not like the other gnolls... It hides and uses thrown weapons... _Beware its poisonous and incendiary darts, don't attack from a distance..._
Please... Help me... Slay the trickster...

_Don't let it hit you... Get near to it..._
text.你好，%s...曾几何时，我也如你这般——既强大又自信...但我被一个古老的生物:
Hello %s... Once I was like you - strong and confident... But I was slain by an ancient creature... I can't leave this place... Not until I have my revenge... Slay the _great crab,_ that has taken my life...

It is unnaturally old... With a massive single claw and a thick shell... _Beware its claw, you must surprise the crab or it will block with it..._
text.请帮助我...杀了那个甲壳类...\n\n_如果它发现你...就会挡住你所有的攻:
Please... Help me... Slay the Crustacean...

_It will always block... When it sees you coming..._
text.这个幽灵几乎不可见。它看起来像是由一片无定形的昏暗光斑和一张悲痛的面孔所组成的。: The ghost is barely visible. It looks like a shapeless spot of faint light with a sorrowful face.
text.你是个冒险家吗？我爱冒险家！如果需要杀掉什么东西的话，他们永远都能把活干好。我说: Are you an adventurer? I love adventurers! You can always rely on them if something needs to be killed, am I right? For a bounty of course ;)
text.总之，我需要你杀一些_魔像_。你看，我要在这里开始搞点小本生意，但这些愚蠢的魔像: In my case it's _golems_ that need to be killed. You see, I'm going to start a little business here, but those stupid golems are bad for business! It's very hard to negotiate with wandering lumps of granite, damn them! So please kill... let's say _4 of them_ and a reward is yours.
text.总之，我需要你杀一些_武僧_。你看，我要在这里开始搞点小本生意，但这些疯子不单什: In my case it's _monks_ who need to be killed. You see, I'm going to start a little business here, but those lunatics don't buy anything themselves and will scare away other customers. So please kill... let's say _5 of them_ and a reward is yours.
text.你的魔像狩猎做的怎么样了？只要别忘了拿来那些魔像的徽记就好。: How is your golem safari going? Just don't forget to grab those tokens.
text.喔，你还活着！我就知道你的功夫比他们更好。;) 只要别忘了拿来那些武僧的徽记就好: Oh, you're still alive! I knew that your kung-fu would be stronger ;) Just don't forget to grab those tokens.
text.哦你好啊，我猜你该是位冒险家？我最爱冒险家了！在需要人搭把手的时候，你们这些冒险:
Oh hello, are you an adventurer? I love adventurers! You can always rely on them when you need a hand. With an appropriate reward, of course ;).

There's a big dwarven vault in front of me that's got a bunch of rare artifacts inside of it. I'm a collector of sorts, and there's a statuette in that vault that I want very much.

The vault is full of guardians and traps though, so I could use a little help!
text.宝库入口被魔法封印了。我早准备了一道魔法可以把你传送进去，不过_我没法把你的装备:
The vault's magically sealed. I can teleport you in with a spell I've been preparing, but _I can't teleport your gear with you._ There should be plenty of loot inside of the vault to help you along though! _You'll probably want to start out by avoiding enemies and looking for items that aren't as well protected._

I can recall you with two items from the vault. One will be my statuette, and the other can be _anything from the vault that you like!_

I've collected a bunch of valuables that you might be interested in too! If you help me here I'll _set up shop a little further down_ and we can trade.
text.只要你准备好了就走到宝库入口中间去，然后我就把你传送进去。: Just step into the center of the vault entrance when you're ready to go and I'll teleport you inside.
text.准备好了？你的东西先放我这，_等你回来再还你_。\n\n先穿上这件_布甲_，这块:
Are you ready? I'll keep your items safe up here, _you'll get everything back when you return._

Take this _cloth armor_ and _teleport crystal_ with you though. Use the crystal when you have my statuette. ...I suppose _you can use it early too if you're in trouble_, but don't expect the full reward!

The vault hasn't been disturbed for a long time, so enemies in it should be more sluggish than usual. It should be easier than normal to avoid detection, especially if _you stay behind the direction enemies wander in._ If any enemy does see you they _shouldn't chase you if they only see you for a moment._ You'll probably also be able to _sense nearby footsteps_ if you pay attention.
text.好吧，至少感谢你的时间。\n\n我用的传送魔法还需要很长时间才能再次发动，好走不:
Well, thanks for trying.

The spell I used to access the vault will take a very long time to prepare again, so you'd better be on your way.
text.感谢你的帮助！\n\n准备好传送魔法还要点时间，这期间我得用你提供的信息给接下来:
Thanks for your help!

It'll take me some time to get my teleportation spell ready, and I'll need to plan things out based on the information you've given me as well.

I'll get packed up and see you a bit further into the dungeon. Afraid I do still need gold, so my wares won't be free ;).
text.干得漂亮，非常感谢！\n\n现在万事俱备，我打包好行李就去楼下，待会请您务必来店:
Great job down there, thanks so much!

I've got everything I need here, so I'll get packed up and see you a bit further into the dungeon. Afraid I do still need gold, so my wares won't be free ;).

What was so important about the statue? Nothing you might think, it's actually a pretty mundane object. It comes from a faraway land that no longer exists; it might be the last of its kind. If it weren't for these greedy dwarves it would have probably been destroyed along with everything else...
text.这个红色的小东西看起来像个小恶魔。小恶魔是一种低等恶魔，力量不强但头脑精明。\n:
This little red person look like an Imp. Imps are lesser demons, notable for their intelligence and not their strength.

You've only heard about demons in ancient folk tales though, which usually describe them as travelers from another world. You've never seen any evidence demons actually exist, but this Imp is clearly real and seems very happy to see you.
text.%s你都做了些什么？要做买卖就快点，我可不想在这里久留！: What did you do %s? Shop quickly, I've got to get out of here!
text.我本以为我可以相信你！: I thought I could trust you!
text.小恶魔爽快地退还了你的物品。: The imp cheerily returns your item.
text.小恶魔在恶魔大厅的入口前摆了个小摊。在这能看到一张友好的面孔是挺不错的，但它商品: The imp has set up a little shop on the border of the inner halls. It's nice to see a friendly face, but his prices certainly don't seem friendly.
text.这个幻像和你非常相似，甚至还装备着你当前的武器和护甲。\n\n镜像会猎寻敌人，并:
This illusion bears a close resemblance to you, even seeming to wield your current weapon and armor.

Mirror images will seek and attack enemies using their mimicked weapon, which behaves the same as yours, but deals less damage. They start out nearly invisible, but must take on a form that's more easily seen in order to attack.

While their offensive power can be potent, mirror images have no durability, and will fade the moment they take damage.
text.你可通过某张卷轴遇到该单位。: You can find this character with a specific scroll.
text.你可在某个地牢区域中遇到该单位。: You can find this character in a specific region of the dungeon.
text.这个闪烁着虹光的幻像和你非常相似，甚至还装备着你当前的武器和护甲。\n\n虹光守:
This shimmering illusion bears a close resemblance to you, even seeming to wield your current weapon and armor.

Prismatic images will attempt to seek and draw focus from enemies, using their enhanced defense and health to protect you. While they do not have the same offensive power as mirror images, they have enhanced durability, including receiving benefits from your armor.

When reduced to 0 hp, prismatic images will fade over several turns, and can still be healed during this time. When no enemies are present, prismatic images will fade and rejoin their master.
text.你这是想干什么？我可没时间管这些破事。我的王国可不会自己运转下去！: What is it? I have no time for this nonsense. My kingdom won't rule itself!
text.这...我这是在哪？我的王国需要我！: Wha... Where am I? My kingdom needs me!
text.把衣服穿上！会见皇室的礼仪都不懂吗！: Put some clothes on! You're in no state to talk to royalty!
text.哇，那个皇冠是要给本王的吗！？它看上去比我的皇冠更闪更亮，那我就好心好意地接受了:
Oooh, is that crown for me!? It looks much shinier than mine, so I graciously accept!

In fact, I think I can offer you something as a reward for this crown. A tremendous power befitting a hero such as yourself! Would you like that?
text.嘿嘿嘿嘿，多谢了！不要让本王失望了，去宣扬我的威名吧！: Hehehe, thank you! Now go and make your king proud!
Fine! It's not like I wanted it anyway...
text.新衣服穿着合身吗？诚信交易，概不退换！: Enjoying your new armor? No take-backsies!
text.这只老鼠比普通的啮齿小鼠大一点。它戴着矮人国王的皇冠。: This rat is a little bigger than a regular marsupial rat. It's wearing dwarf king's crown on its head.
text.这只老鼠比普通的啮齿小鼠大一点。它戴着一顶小小的绿色派对帽，而不是它常戴的皇冠。: This rat is a little bigger than a regular marsupial rat. It's wearing a tiny green party hat instead of its usual crown. Happy birthday Rat King!
text.这只老鼠比普通的啮齿小鼠大一点。它戴着一顶小小的节日帽，而不是常戴的皇冠。假日快: This rat is a little bigger than a regular marsupial rat. It's wearing a tiny festive hat instead of its usual crown. Happy Holidays!
text.这只老鼠比普通的啮齿小鼠大一点。它戴着一顶小小的皇冠。: This rat is a little bigger than a regular marsupial rat. It's wearing a tiny crown on its head.
text.你可在某个地牢区域中的终点遇到该单位。: You can find this character at the end of a specific region of the dungeon.
text.这是一只魔法绵羊。为什么叫它魔法绵羊？因为你杀不死它。它只会站在那里直到它消失，: This is a magic sheep. What's so magical about it? You can't kill it. It will stand there until it magically fades away, all the while chewing cud with a blank stare.
text.你可通过某个物品或陷阱遇到该单位。: You can find this character with a specific item or trap.
text.小心！我不会警告你第二次了。: Watch it! I won't warn you again.
text.店主不情不愿地退还了你的物品。: The shopkeeper reluctantly returns your item.
text.我这有你成功冒险所需的一切东西！: I have everything you need for a successful adventure!
text.你的那个纹章挺有意思的嘛，它们通常来讲都是一整个的。难不成你是一位蒙受了耻辱的英: That's an interesting seal you've got there, they're usually in one piece. You a disgraced hero or something? Well whatever you've done is none of my business, your coins are still good.
text.嘻嘻，我想我在城里的什么地方有见过你的通缉令。在逃亡对吧？哦？你说你是无辜的，真: Hehe, I think I've seen a wanted poster with your name on it somewhere in the city. On the run are we? Oh you're innocent are you? Of course, of course... Don't fret, I've got better things to do than report on you, but perhaps you should buy something to be sure?
text.你是盗贼公会指派来清理这片区域的吗？不是？只是来购物的？你能来到这说明你确实杀了: Have you come from the thieves guild to clear the area? No, just shopping? Well kill a few monsters while you're here anyway. Don't expect a discount either, I pay good protection money to you people and you're barely keeping me safe down here.
text.小姐，这似乎不是你该待的地方。狭窄的地牢走廊想来不如城镇大厅或者市郊森林那样宽敞: You seem to be out of your element miss. Tight dungeon corridors aren't as spacious as grand halls or the forests surrounding the city are they? Hehe, oh don't mind my rambling, why not buy something?
text.哇偶，这不是闯荡天下的大英雄嘛！如果你在尝试着拯救又一个小镇，那我只能说祝你好运: Well if it isn't the travelling hero! If you're trying to save another town then good luck, the dangers here are much worse than petty bandit gangs. I'm sure you'll do better than anyone else could, just try to not die right outside my store.
text.哦您好陛下，或许现在该尊称您为“圣上”了？呵呵，无论如何这可不是您这种大人物该来: Well hello there Your Highness, or is it Your Holiness now? Hehe, either way this is no place for you, a lot of people would be quite distraught if you wound up dead. Surely you have some coins though, why not buy something to help prevent that?
text.花钱，你才能活得更久。\n\n哦，如果你看到那个巨魔铁匠，代我向他问好。顺便提醒:
Spend money, live longer.

Oh and say hello to that Troll blacksmith for me if you see him. Remind the lug that he still owes me money for that hammer I sold him last week!
text.我的货可以保你平安。\n\n...另外，劳烦您别在这瞎晃悠。我花了很长很长时间才:
My wares can keep you safe down here.

...And don't loiter if you please. It took forever to get the locals down here to leave me alone, I don't want you attracting any trouble!
text.嘿，那边那位！我为恶魔猎人提供特别优惠！\n\n哦还有，在下面可要当心！底下的恶:
Hey there, I've got special prices for demon hunters!

Oh and be careful down there! The demons below are even worse than what you saw in the vault, and there's no escape crystal to save you. You can't come back up and spend more money if you're dead! ;)

Are the demons like me? Hehe, not at all. I'm just a small fellow, not much of a fighter, and I've managed to keep my mind intact. The demons below are much stronger things, and they've all been enslaved by... well... just be careful down there.
text.无论你打算用那个护符做什么，我都不想掺和。买点东西，然后赶紧离开，咱俩都该闪人了: I don't know what you're planning to do with that amulet but I want no part of it. Buy something and move on, we both need to leave this place!
text.这个矮胖的家伙看起来更适合在某些大城市里做买卖而不是在这种地牢。这些商品的价格说: This stout guy looks more appropriate for a trade district in some large city than for a dungeon. His prices explain why he prefers to do business here.
text.哦，你好！能在这片压抑的地方遇见一位北境战士可真是个惊喜！想必你走了很远才来到此: Oh, hello there! What a pleasant surprise to meet a warrior from the north in such a depressing place! You must have travelled quite far to get here. If you're looking for adventure, I may have a task for you.
text.天哪，你吓了我一跳！在这里这么久你是我见过的第一个尚有理智的强盗，所以你肯定是从: Oh Goodness, you startled me! I haven't met a bandit from this place that still has his sanity, so you must be from the surface! If you're up to helping a stranger out, I may have a task for you.
text.哦，你好啊%s！我好像听说你在法师学院那里搞了不少麻烦？算了这没关系，反正我也不: Oh, hello %s! I heard there was some ruckus regarding you and the wizards institute? Oh never mind, I never liked those stick-in-the-muds anyway. If you're willing, I may have a task for you.
text.啊，你好啊姑娘！能在这下面见到一张友善的面孔真是太惊喜了，你说是吧？咦，说来，我: Oh, hello miss! A friendly face is a pleasant surprise down here isn't it? In fact, I swear I've seen your face before, but I can't put my finger on it... Oh never mind, if you're here for adventure, I may have a task for you.
text.哦，小姐你好！多么压抑的地方，多么美妙的偶遇！如果你有兴趣帮助一位糟老头子的话，: Oh, hello miss! What a pleasant surprise to meet a hero in such a depressing place! If you're up to helping an old man out, I may have a task for you.
text.哦，您好陛下！能在如此压抑之地与您相遇实为一件幸事！我虽无意打扰，但我有一事请您: Oh, hello Your Highness! What a pleasant surprise to meet you in such a depressing place! I hate to impose, but I may have a task for you.
text.\n\n我在这里是为了寻找一个制作法杖需要的稀有材料，但我迷了路，而且身上的魔法: I came here to find a rare ingredient for a wand, but I've gotten myself lost, and my magical shield is weakening. I'll need to leave soon, but can't bear to go without getting what I came for.
text.我在寻找一些_尸尘_。这是一种通常出现在这种地方的被诅咒的特殊骨灰。它应该就在附: I'm looking for some _corpse dust._ It's a special kind of cursed bone meal that usually shows up in places like this. There should be a barricaded room around here somewhere, I'm sure some dust will turn up there. Do be careful though, the curse the dust carries is quite potent, _get back to me as fast as you can_ and I'll cleanse it for you.
text.我在寻找能从新生火焰元素身上获得的_元素余烬_。元素生物通常出现在失控的召唤仪式: I'm looking for some _fresh embers_ from a newborn fire elemental. Elementals usually pop up when a summoning ritual isn't controlled, so just find some candles and a ritual site and I'm sure you can get one to pop up. You'll want to _avoid boxing yourself in_ while fighting it though, or you could _keep some sort of freezing item handy._ Newborn Elementals are pretty powerful and chaotic, but they can't stand the cold.
text.这个监狱以前的典狱长养着一株_腐莓_，我想要一粒它的种子。现如今，这株植物的长势: The old warden of this prison kept a _rotberry plant,_ and I'm after one of its seeds. The plant has probably gone wild by now though, so getting it to give up a seed might be tricky. Its garden should be somewhere around here. Try to _keep away from its vine lashers_ if you want to stay in one piece. Using fire might be tempting but please don't, you'll kill the plant and destroy its seeds.
text.\n\n如果你能把它带给我，我愿意用一根我精心制作的法杖当做酬劳！我带了两根过来: If you can get that for me, I'll be happy to pay you with one of my finely crafted wands! I brought two with me, so you can take whichever one you prefer.
text.尸尘找的怎么样了，%s？试着寻找一些_障碍物_。: Any luck with corpse dust, %s? Look for some barricades.
text.余烬找的怎么样了，%s？你需要找到_四根蜡烛_和一个_仪式场地_。: Any luck with those embers, %s? You'll need to find four candles and the ritual site.
text.腐莓种子找的怎么样了，%s？它就在一个_充满植被的房间_里。: Any luck with a Rotberry seed, %s? Look for a room filled with vegetation.
text.这位精神矍铄的老先生神情有些困扰。他周身有着魔法屏障的保护。: This old yet hale gentleman wears a slightly confused expression. He is protected by a magic shield.
text.你可在某个任务中遇到该敌人。: You can find this enemy during a specific quest.
text.作为矮人召唤术的巅峰之作，这个巨大的元素周围翻涌着无定形的力量，这份无常的力量似: Representing the pinnacle of dwarven summoning magic, this massive elemental's unstable power seems to be regulated by the equally impressive circle that summoned it. This gives it the ability to _swap forms!_ Each form has unique attacks, resistances, and weaknesses.
text.巨型元素目前处于熔融的_火焰形态_。在此形态下，巨型元素可以发射火球并召唤焰浪横:
The elemental is currently assuming a molten hot _fiery form_. In this form it can shoot fireballs and summon waves of flame that sweep across the arena. It will try to aim fireballs in the direction you are moving, and the fire waves always have a gap. If you're hit by either you'll be _ignited_.

In this form it is _resistant to magic_, which only serves to fuel the flames. Its vulnerable molten core could probably be easily hit with _ranged weapons_ however.
text.巨型元素吸收了你大部分的魔法攻击，炽焰也燃烧的更亮了！: The flames grow as the elemental absorbs most of your magic attack!
text.你的投掷武器正中巨型元素的熔融核心，造成了额外伤害！: Your thrown weapon strikes the elemental's core, dealing extra damage!
text.巨型元素目前处于极寒的_冰霜形态_。在此形态下，巨型元素可以发射扇形寒流横扫战场:
The elemental is currently assuming a frigid _frost form_. In this form it can shoot a sweeping cone of cold and summon a vortex of moving frigid air. Both of these attacks can be stepped around with good timing, but the cone is especially deadly at a distance. If you're hit by either you will _freeze solid_.

In this form it is also _resistant to thrown weapons_, which will just stick to its icy shell. The shell doesn't look especially durable though, so a hit with a _melee weapon_ should be especially damaging.
text.投掷武器卡在了巨型元素的冰霜盾壳上！: The thrown weapon sticks to the elemenental's frost shell!
text.你的近战攻击震裂了冰霜盾壳，造成了额外伤害！: Your melee strike shatters some of the frost shell, dealing extra damage!
text.巨型元素目前处于流电的_电光形态_。在此形态下，巨型元素可以向你所在的位置发射集:
The elemental is currently assuming an electric _shock form_. In this form it can fire a bolt of lightning at your location, or summon lines of sparks from the sides of the arena. These attacks are a bit easier to dodge, but it can do them more frequently. If you're hit by either you will be _momentarily stunned_.

In this form it is also _resistant to melee attacks_, which will cause a painful jolt. The energy surrounding it will be destabilized by _magic_ however, inflicting additional damage.
text.武器命中元素的一瞬间，电流给你带来一阵剧痛！: As you try to strike you receive a painful jolt!
text.魔法攻击扰乱了巨型元素的电场，造成了额外伤害！: The magic disrupts the elemental's electric field, dealing extra damage!
text.这些DM-100看起来和你在监狱里见过的那些差不多，但它们的眼睛闪着明亮的青光，:
These DM-100s look almost identical to ones you'd find in the prison, but with a bright teal glow coming from their eye. Probably they have been retrofitted to use some more modern dwarven power source.

They act just like regular DM-100s. Their ability to arc lightning at a distance is still present despite the power source change, and their cleaner condition makes them a bit more durable.
text.这些DM-200看起来和你在矿洞里见过的那些差不多，但它们的眼睛闪着明亮的青光，:
These DM-200s look just like their counterparts from the caves, but with glowing teal eyes. They have probably been retrofitted with a more modern dwarven power source.

Just like in their caves counterparts, these DM-200s are too large to fit into enclosed spaces, and are still capable of spewing gas.
text.这只老鼠行为有些许变化，以测试全新的宝库敌人AI：\n_-_其移动可透过墙壁而被:
This rat has some behaviour changes to test out new vault enemy AI:
_-_ Its movement can be 'heard' through walls
_-_ It will wander along a pre-set patrol
_-_ While wandering it has sharply reduced detection range behind the direction it moves in.
_-_ While sleeping its detection range is also reduced
_-_ When it detects you it will 'investigate' before swapping to hunting. Investigating enemies move toward you but don't attack and are easier to lose behind doors and corners.
text.如果不是那浓密得惊人的胡须，这些骷髅看起来和你在监狱里见过的那些差不多。看来即使:
These would look like normal skeletons from the prison if it weren't for their stunning amount of facial hair. It seems like some dwarves weren't above necromancy even before their new King took over.

They act just like regular skeletons, including exploding into bone shards on death. Paradoxically, their beards seem to offer them a little more protection too.
text.这些面覆着矮人一样的怪异金属面具的豺狼萨满显然是从洞穴被抓来的。面具紧勒在萨满们: These gnoll shamans are clearly from the caves, but have a strange metal mask that looks dwarven. The fit on the mask is extremely tight, and the shamans move in an awkward stilted manner. Is the mask made to control them?
text.这些豺狼萨满肯定还是会用魔法飞弹攻击你，但由于面具没有涂装，无法分辨它们会使用什: These gnolls are surely still capable of zapping you with magic, but without a mask color there's no telling what kind of magic they will use. The metal mask also seems to protect them a bit more than a wooden one, and there's significantly more force behind their attacks than a regular gnoll shaman.
text.这种巨大的节肢类恶魔生物不会选择近身缠斗，它们更擅长在远处发射能够致残的锯齿钉刺: These huge arachnid-like demonic creatures avoid close combat, preferring to fire crippling serrated spikes from long distances. This one appears to be dripping with corrosive ooze.
text.这是一种珍稀的啮齿小鼠，有着纯白色的毛皮和锯齿状的牙齿。: This is a rare breed of marsupial rat, with pure white fur and jagged teeth.
text.你可在某个地牢区域中中碰巧遇到该敌人。: You can rarely find this enemy in a specific region of the dungeon.
text.你本以为这只是地牢里又一尊静伫的石像，但它泛着红光的眼睛出卖了它。\n\n石像装:
You would think that it's just another one of this dungeon's inanimate statues, but its red glowing eyes give it away.

It seems to be in great condition because of the armor it's wearing, it might be very hard to kill.
text.虽然雕像本身是石制的，但它装备着的_%1$s_和_%2$s_看起来是真家伙。: While the statue itself is made of stone, the _%1$s_ and _%2$s_ it's wielding look real.
text.一位小偷中的精英，因其身着更为昂贵的的紫色长袍而与众不同。尽管他们偷技高超，却仍:
An elite thief, distinguished by their more opulent purple robe. Despite their greater skill, they've become just as mindless as regular thieves.

In addition to stealing from you, crazed bandits will briefly blind, cripple, and poison you! They're much more likely to be carrying extra loot than a regular thief though.
text.这些敏捷且坚韧的洞穴穹顶生物比看上去可怕地多。它们会通过每次成功的攻击来恢复生命: These brisk and tenacious inhabitants of the caves are much more dangerous than they seem. They replenish their health with each successful attack, which allows them to defeat much larger opponents.
text.尽管金色蜜蜂体型不大，但它们也会尽全力守卫自己的家园。这只蜜蜂受过你的安抚，似乎: Despite their small size, golden bees tend to protect their home fiercely. This one has been placated, and seems to want to follow you.
text.尽管金色蜜蜂体型不大，但它们也会尽全力守卫自己的家园。这只蜜蜂非常疯狂，你最好和: Despite their small size, golden bees tend to protect their home fiercely. This one is very mad, better keep your distance.
text.你可通过某个道具遇到该单位。: You can find this character with a specific item.
text.暴徒是体型最大，力量最强且生命力最坚韧的一种豺狼人。受到致命伤时，他们会狂暴化，: Brutes are the largest, strongest, and toughest of all gnolls. When mortally wounded, they go berserk, gaining temporary shielding and a large boost to damage.
text.这个豺狼暴徒已经濒临死亡，但它想拉你作为陪葬品！\n\n时间的推移和外界的伤害都:
This gnoll brute is dying, but wants to take you with it!

The brute will die when its shielding wears off, either due to time or if it is damaged. In the meantime, it will deal hugely increased damage, so watch out!

Shield remaining: %d.
text.这个史莱姆似乎已经被下方渗透的黑暗能量完全侵蚀了。它已经失去了体表原有的绿色光泽: This slime seems to have been tainted by the dark magic emanating from below. It has lost its usual green color, and drips with caustic ooze.
text.这些巨型的螃蟹位居下水道食物链的顶端。它们行动极其迅速且其厚重的甲壳能承受沉重的: These huge crabs are at the top of the food chain in the sewers. They are extremely fast and their thick carapace can withstand heavy blows.
text.这种巨大的水晶守卫若不是眼中泛着明光，看起来和雕像几乎没有区别。因为身体由硬化的:
These large crystalline guardians almost look like statues, if it weren't for their bright glowing eyes. The hardened crystal they're made out of causes them to be sluggish but very tough, so _it's best to leave them to sleep in their crystal nest for as long as possible._

Due to their size, crystal guardians will move much more slowly in enclosed spaces. They're also so durable that they're impossible to kill outright. They can be beaten down and temporarily disabled, but they'll just get back up again after a little while.
text.你可在某个的任务中遇到该敌人。: You can find this enemy during a specific quest.
text.宝箱怪是一种能随意改变外形的魔法生物。在地牢里它们几乎总会以宝箱形态出现，因为这:
Mimics are magical creatures which can take any shape they wish. In dungeons they almost always choose a shape of a treasure chest, in order to lure in unsuspecting adventurers.

Crystal mimics are trickier than their regular cousins, and prefer to avoid conflict while stealing loot. They will attempt to sprint away once discovered, and have the ability to reposition enemies when they attack.
The crystal vibrates as you strike it. Keeping this up is bound to draw attention to you...
text.水晶的颤动愈演愈烈，隆隆声响彻整个矿洞！: The vibration grows and rumbles through the whole cave!
text.这座巨型尖塔由无比坚硬的水晶构成，很可能是矿洞中所有奇怪水晶生物的来源。常规武器:
This gigantic spire of ultra hard crystal is probably the source of all the strange crystalline creatures in this cave. Your regular weapons are ineffective against it, so you'll need to use your pickaxe if you want to destroy it.

_Make sure you're prepared before you start breaking it._ Such a big crystal is likely to take a while to mine through, and you probably won't be able to do it undisturbed. The spire itself may even have some means of defending itself as well. _Perhaps the spire's own attacks could be used against its minions._
The beam of light killed you...
text.一小块愤怒的硬化水晶飘浮在空中，泛着明亮的光。它虽然不算强，但只要有机会，就会射:
A small angry floating chunk of hardened crystal that's producing a bright glow. While not especially strong, crystal wisps will shoot a damaging beam of light at you if they have a clear shot.

Wisps are small enough to easily move through the various crystal outcroppings, but they aren't able to shoot through them.
text.此处的恶魔能量似乎随着血巢的毁灭而有所减弱。: The demonic energy here seems to lessen as the spawner dies.
text.这一团蠕动着的矮人血肉在利用惨死于这一区域的矮人源源不断地制造恶魔撕裂者。看来恶:
This twisting amalgam of dwarven flesh is responsible for creating ripper demons from the dwarves that have died in this region. Clearly the demons see no issue with using every resource they can against their enemies.

While visually terrifying, demon spawners have no means of moving or directly defending themselves. Their considerable mass makes them hard to kill quickly however, and they will spawn ripper demons more quickly when they are under threat.

_Demon spawners seem to be connected to some central source of demonic power. Killing them may weaken it._
text.DM-100是一种矮人“防卫机械”的早期机型，用来保护下层矿洞中的矮人矿工。然而: The DM-100 is an early model of dwarven 'defense machine' which was designed to protect dwarven miners in the caves below this prison. Their electrical shocks proved too weak however, and so they were gifted to the human city above. They went unused for years and eventually found their way to the prison, where the warden initially deemed them too cruel to use. However, as the prisoners became more unruly they became a necessity.
text.DM-200喷射了一团有毒的废气！: The DM-200 fires a jet of toxic exhaust!
text.DM-200是矮人研发的第二代“防卫机械”，最初用来保护矿洞中的矮人矿工与下方的:
The DM-200 is the second generation of dwarven 'defense machine', which was designed to protect dwarven miners in the caves and city below. They are much larger and bulkier than their predecessors, and attack with devastating hydraulic fists.

Their increased size is also their primary weakness, as they are unable to fit into the narrow tunnels and doorways of the dungeon. The dwarves were able to compensate for the DM-200's lack of mobility by allowing them to vent their toxic exhaust fumes at distant enemies, or enemies they cannot reach.
text.DM-201投出了一枚酸蚀榴弹！: The DM-201 lobs a corrosive grenade!
text.矮人曾做过一些围绕DM-200的机动性缺陷展开的实验，并据此设计制造了一批完全固:
The dwarves briefly experimented with more heavily emphasizing the DM-200's lack of mobility and created some DM models that are entirely stationary. The DM-201 is a retrofitted DM-200 which acts as a sentry turret that has no movement ability. In exchange for the lack of mobility, DM-201s have significantly more durability and attacking power.

As DM-201s have no engine to vent exhaust from, the dwarves instead outfitted them with corrosive gas grenades! DM-201s are careful with these grenades however, and will only lob them when attacked from a distance.
text.DM-300从地表导线汲取电力并生成护盾！: DM-300 pulls power from the exposed wires and shields itself!
text.DM-300在接受能量塔供电时无法受到伤害！: DM-300 is invulnerable while it is being energized by a pylon!
text.能 量 塔 损 坏 ！切 换 至 本 地 供 能 模 式 ！: PYLON DESTROYED! REVERTING TO LOCAL POWER!
text.警 告 ！检 测 到 电 网 故 障 ！: ALERT! INSTABILITY DETECTED IN POWER GRID!
text.DM-300是矮人有史以来发明的最强大的“防卫机械”。这般强大的机械极难量产，所:
The DM-300 is the largest and most powerful 'defense machine' that the dwarves ever built. Such an awesome machine is difficult to manufacture, so the dwarves only ever made a few to guard the entrances to their underground metropolis.

It is equipped with vents to jet its toxic exhaust fumes and a high power drill that it can use both to attack and disrupt the earth. DM-300 can also connect to an energy grid, further enhancing its power.
text.DM-300电力盈满，功率全开。此形态下的DM-300能免疫一切伤害，并具有两倍:
DM-300 is currently charged full of electrical energy. In this form DM-300 cannot be damaged and moves at double speed! Additionally, its drill now spins fast enough for it to _tunnel through solid rock,_ though it moves much more slowly when doing this.

Attacking DM-300 directly is pointless while it is supercharged, but _something in the area must be providing it with this energy,_ destroying that may weaken it.
text.汝竟敢进犯皇家重地！不知天高地厚！: How dare you! You have no idea what you're interfering with!
text.献身护驾，奴隶们！: I have need of your essence, slave!
text.汝休想得逞，%s。朕 即 不 朽！: You cannot kill me %s. I. AM. IMMORTAL!
No! You can't do this... you have no idea what lies below...
text.屈服在矮人国王御前: Fell Before the King of Dwarves
text.许多年前，矮人议会中一名最强的巫师洞察了凌驾于生死之上的秘术。很快他就借助这种强:
Many years ago one of the highest wizards in the dwarven court uncovered secrets which gave him tremendous power over life and death. He soon put this power to use, subjugating and corrupting his peers, his king, and eventually every dwarven citizen. Now he is king, ruler over a legion of undead subjects.

The King of Dwarves is an aggressive foe, who will attempt to surround and overwhelm his enemies with his horde of undead minions.
text.那里似乎有什么东西，但它几乎是完全透明的。: There seems to be something here, but it's almost totally transparent.
text.宝箱怪是一种能随意改变外形的魔法生物。在地牢里它们几乎一直以宝箱形态出现，因为这:
Mimics are magical creatures which can take any shape they wish. In dungeons they almost always choose a shape of a treasure chest, in order to lure in unsuspecting adventurers.

Ebony mimics are stealthy mimics with the ability to make themselves almost invisible. They lurk on things that adventurers are likely to interact with, but do contain loot of their own as well. They aren't any tougher than a regular mimic once discovered, but their surprise bite is devastating.
text.你可通过某件饰物遇到该敌人。: You can find this enemy with a specific trinket.
text.元素是一类狂暴的生物，通常诞生于失控的强力魔法仪式当中。元素生物智力极低，它们通:
Elementals are chaotic creatures that are often created when powerful occult magic isn't properly controlled. Elementals have minimal intelligence, and are usually associated with a particular type of magic.

Fire elementals are a common type of elemental which deals damage with fiery magic. They will set their target ablaze with melee attacks, and can occasionally shoot bolts of fire as well.

Elementals are chaotic creatures that are often created when powerful occult magic isn't properly controlled. Elementals have minimal intelligence, and are usually associated with a particular type of magic.

This fire elemental is freshly summoned, but still quite dangerous!
text.被新生火焰元素烤焦: Charred by a Newborn Fire Elemental
text.由于其本质是狂暴的召唤物，这个元素的火攻方式只有通过1回合的蓄能喷出不精准的焰浪: Because of the chaotic nature of its summoning, this elemental can only spread fire in inaccurate blasts after charging for a turn.
text.由于这个元素是由晶柱召唤而来，故而对火焰有更好的控制。它没法施展远距离攻击，但仍: Because this elemental was summoned by a spell, it has a little more control over its flame. It's incapable of making ranged attacks, but will ignite enemies it attacks in melee.
text.元素是一类狂暴的生物，通常诞生于失控的强力魔法仪式当中。元素生物智力极低，它们通:
Elementals are chaotic creatures that are often created when powerful occult magic isn't properly controlled. Elementals have minimal intelligence, and are usually associated with a particular type of magic.

Frost elementals are a common type of elemental which weakens enemies with chilling magic. They will chill their target with melee and occasional ranged attacks. Their magic is much more effective in water.

Elementals are chaotic creatures that are often created when powerful occult magic isn't properly controlled. Elementals have minimal intelligence, and are usually associated with a particular type of magic.

Shock elementals are a less common type of elemental which disrupts its enemies with electricity and flashes of light. In melee they will arc electricity to nearby enemies, and deal bonus damage to their primary target if they are in water. They will also occasionally focus a ranged blast of light at their target, temporarily blinding them.

Elementals are chaotic creatures that are often created when powerful occult magic isn't properly controlled. Elementals have minimal intelligence, and are usually associated with a particular type of magic.

Chaos elementals are rare and dangerous elementals which haven't stabilized to a particular element. They will unleash wild unpredictable magic when they attack.
text.邪眼是一种充斥着恶魔能量的飘浮球形生物。它具有近战能力，但其真正的杀招暗藏于其魔:
Evil Eyes are floating balls of pent up demonic energy. While they are capable of melee combat, their true strength comes from their magic.

After building energy for a short time an Evil Eye will unleash a devastating beam of energy called the _deathgaze._ Anything within the Evil Eye's sights will take tremendous damage, wise adventurers will run for cover.
text.这只老鼠很不对劲。它油腻的黑毛和腐烂的皮肤与你之前见过的健康老鼠很不同。浅绿色的:
Something is clearly wrong with this rat. Its greasy black fur and rotting skin are very different from the healthy rats you've seen previously. Its pale green eyes make it seem especially menacing.

The rat carries a cloud of horrible stench with it, it's overpoweringly strong up close.

Dark ooze dribbles from the rat's mouth, it eats through the floor but seems to dissolve in water.
text.这株硕大无比的蘑菇想必就是洞穴中异常蘑菇活性的源头了。: This gigantic mushroom must be the source of all the fungal activity in this cave.
text.屹立于此的高大蘑菇是整个洞穴中更大的菌丝网络的防御节孢。\n\n它无法移动，但会:
This especially tall mushroom acts as a point of defense for the larger fungal network living in this cave.

It is immobile, but will shoot precise blasts of poison at anything that gets within its line of sight. While the impact of these blasts is fairly weak, _they can stack up deadly amounts of poison very quickly._ While it can be killed, it's probably best to avoid it.
text.这只矿洞蜘蛛似乎被一种寄生真菌控制。真菌改变了宿主的能力，以真菌生长替换了宿主的:
This cave spinner appears to be being controlled by a parasitic fungus. The fungus has also changed its abilities, replacing its web and venom sacks with fungal growth.

The fungal spinner will spit plant life at you instead of webs, spreading fungal vegetation and potentially rooting you. While it can't poison, the fungal spinner will gain substantial damage resistance if it is adjacent to any mushrooms.
text.由于矮人社会的衰亡和矮人新王的独权专行，那些位微言轻和反抗新王的矮人都没落得什么:
As dwarven society slowly began to collapse, and the current king of the dwarves seized absolute power, those who were weak or who resisted him were not treated well. As the king grew more adept at wielding dark magic, he bent these dwarves to his will, and now they make up the footsoldiers of his army.

Ghouls are not especially strong on their own, but always travel in groups and are much harder to kill in large numbers. _When a ghoul is defeated, it will rise again after a few turns as long as another ghoul is nearby._
text.豺狼人是鬣狗状的类人生物。它们在下水道和地牢里游荡，不时向上行动试图向地表发起进: Gnolls are hyena-like humanoids. They dwell in sewers and dungeons, venturing up to raid the surface from time to time. Gnoll scouts are regular members of their pack, they are not as strong as brutes and not as intelligent as shamans.
text.这只灰毛豺狼人在其肩处刺有一个显眼的标记，作为其被已流放的标志。豺狼人通常会因无: This grey-furred gnoll has a large mark on its shoulder, denoting it as an exile. Gnolls are usually exiled from their society for ignoring orders or breaking laws. Exiles have to be strong and shrewd to survive, this one looks like it knows how to use the spear it's holding.
text._豺狼流寇目前暂无攻击意图。_它似乎并不像此处的其他豺狼人那样好斗，也许它认为与: _The gnoll exile isn't moving to attack._ It doesn't seem as aggressive as the other gnolls here, and probably doesn't think that fighting you is worth it. You could just let it pass, but it has a backpack that might be full of useful items...
text._豺狼流寇虎视眈眈地环顾四周。_看来终究还是有什么使它下定决心出手进攻了。小心那: _The gnoll exile looks around angrily._ It seems something has made it decide to fight after all. Watch out for that spear!
text.持矛的豺狼人警戒地看着你，但其并无攻击意图。: The spear-wielding gnoll looks at you warily, but doesn't move to attack.
text.持矛的豺狼人准备进行攻击！: The spear-wielding gnoll moves to attack!
text.地卜师快醒了，先确保你已准备万全再继续！: The geomancer begins to stir. Make sure you're ready before you continue!
text.地卜师已被惊醒！整个矿洞的结构似乎都随着它癫狂尖啸着的跃离改变了！: The geomancer awakens! The entire cave seems to shift as it leaps away while laughing madly!
text.这只身形魁梧的老豺狼人必定是此处豺狼人的领袖，还是此处土灵魔法的根源。与豺狼工兵: This impressively tall senior gnoll must be the source of the various earth-moving magic around here, and the organizer of all the gnoll activity. Unlike the gnoll sappers in the area, the geomancer is quite adept with its magic, and cannot be damaged by thrown or falling rocks. It doesn't have any way to fight in melee combat though.
text.地卜师周身环绕着一层磐岩护盾。_你必须用镐子近身破坏岩盾才能进一步伤害地卜师本体: The geomancer is currently encased in a layer of rock armor. _You'll need to get up close and break it away with your pickaxe before you can damage the geomancer._
text._一旁的豺狼工兵正握持着一个看起来能强化地卜师磐岩护盾的装置，现在的地卜师免疫一: _A nearby gnoll sapper is holding a device that is empowering the geomancer's rock armor. You won't be able to damage it at all right now!_
text.这只身形魁梧的豺狼萨满周身环绕着一层磐岩，看似一尊雕像。然而仔细观察才发现，这些:
This impressively tall gnoll shaman is surrounded by a layer of rock, and looks almost like a statue. Looking closely you can see the rock magically move in time with the senior gnoll's breathing. It can't be harmed while encased in rock like this, and it appears to be enjoying a literal dirt nap.

You can probably break through the layers of rock with your pickaxe, but _be sure you're ready for a fight when you do so._ The geomancer must be the source of the various earth-moving magic around here, and the organizer of all the gnoll activity. _Defeating the gnolls scattered around here before fighting it might be a good idea._
text.豺狼人用矛尖打出残暴的一击！: The gnoll lands a vicious blow with the tip of its spear!
text.这只高大健壮的豺狼人操使着长矛和盾牌，但没有戴头盔。这些守卫似乎在为晋升成暴徒而:
A large and tough looking gnoll wielding a spear and a shield, but no helmet. These guards are likely brutes in training, roped into helping protect the mine from encroaching wildlife.

The gnoll guard is strong enough to wield the spear in one hand, but can't use it very well. _It will need fairly open space to attack at a distance, and will do notably less damage to you if you get up close._
text._一旁的豺狼工兵正握持着一个看起来能赋予这个守卫大地护甲的装置，大幅减少它受到的: _A nearby gnoll sapper is holding a device that is granting this guard earthen armor, heavily reducing the damage it takes._
text.这只豺狼人矮小虚弱但机智。它长有浅色皮毛，携带着装满各种小工具的挎包。它们似乎在:
A small and weak but intelligent gnoll with pale fur and a satchel full of various gadgets. They are likely here to assist with prospecting and mining dark gold, and have a nearby guard for protection. They are capable of fighting, but their attacks are pitifully weak, no stronger than a gnoll scout.

Instead of fighting directly, sappers prefer to use the various gadgets they have to make the rocky environment attack for them. They don't know earth-moving magic themselves though, and so are pretty likely to use their gadgets recklessly. _There should be lots of ways to use their attacks against them, or their guard._
text.即使以豺狼人的标准来看，这个生物也非常的诡异。它佝偻着腰，鬼鬼祟祟地行进着，大嘴:
A strange looking creature, even by gnoll standards. It hunches forward with a wicked grin, almost cradling the satchel hanging over its shoulder. Its eyes are wide with a strange mix of fear and excitement.

There is a large collection of poorly made darts in its satchel, they all seem to be tipped with various harmful substances.
text.宝箱怪是一种能随意改变外形的魔法生物。在地牢里它们几乎一直以宝箱形态出现，因为这:
Mimics are magical creatures which can take any shape they wish. In dungeons they almost always choose a shape of a treasure chest, in order to lure in unsuspecting adventurers.

Golden mimics are tougher mimics which try to attract the strongest adventurers. They have better loot, but are also much stronger than regular mimics.
text.魔像是矮人们试图利用魔法的新应用弥补机械设备长久以来的缺陷的产物。它们虽不似DM:
Golems are an attempt to correct the previous flaws in dwarven machinery via the dwarves newfound use of magic. They are much more compact and efficient compared to the DM-300 while still being very deadly.

While golems are still too large to fit into passageways, the dwarves have given them new magical abilities to compensate. Golems can teleport themselves between rooms, and teleport enemies to them when they are out of reach.
text.我们对粘咕所知甚少。它甚至很有可能不是一个生物，而是下水道表面聚集的邪恶物质得到:
Little is known about The Goo. It's quite possible that it is not even a creature, but rather a conglomerate of vile substances from the sewers that somehow gained basic intelligence. Regardless, dark magic is certainly what has allowed Goo to exist.

Its gelatinous nature has let it absorb lots of dark energy, you feel a chill just from being near. If Goo is able to attack with this energy you won't live for long.
text.巨蟹用它硕大的钳子格挡了这次攻击。: The crab blocks with its massive claw.
text.这只螃蟹可以称得上是下水道螃蟹中的巨无霸。它的蓝色甲壳上布满了裂纹和藤壶，足以证:
This crab is gigantic, even compared to other sewer crabs. Its blue shell is covered in cracks and barnacles, showing great age. It lumbers around slowly, barely keeping balance with its massive claw.

While the crab only has one claw, its size easily compensates. The crab holds the claw in front of any threat, shielding itself behind an impenetrable wall of carapace. However, the crab cannot block attacks it doesn't see coming, or attacks from multiple enemies at once.
text.这些守卫虽曾是监狱的管理者，但现在已经和那些罪犯没什么区别了。它们蹒跚的步伐如同:
Once keepers of the prison, these guards have long since become no different than the inmates. They shamble like zombies, brainlessly roaming through the halls in search of anything out of place, like you!

They carry chains around their hip, possibly used to pull in enemies to close range.
text.出于某种原因，这只下水道螃蟹决定把一个破桶戴在头上！额外的负重使其移速降到了一般: For one reason or another, this sewer crab has decided to wear the broken upper part of a barrel on its head! The extra weight has slown it down to regular speed, but has also granted it considerably more defence. You think you can hear something bouncing around inside the barrel though...
text.这个宝箱看上去有些不对劲...上前直接打开似乎不太合适。: Something about this chest feels off... Walking up and trying to open it might be a bad idea.
text.宝箱怪是一种能随意改变外形的生物。在地牢里它们几乎一直以宝箱形态出现，因为这样总:
Mimics are magical creatures which can take any shape they wish. In dungeons they almost always choose a shape of a treasure chest, in order to lure in unsuspecting adventurers.

Mimics have a nasty bite, but often hold more treasure than a regular chest.
text.你可在任何地牢区域中遇到该敌人。: You can find this enemy anywhere in the dungeon.
text.这些黑暗魔法的学徒大量涌入监狱，因为这里是它们磨练死灵法术的最佳地点。\n\n死:
These apprentice dark mages have flocked to the prison, as it is the perfect place to practise their evil craft.

Necromancers will summon and empower skeletons to fight for them. Killing the necromancer will also kill the skeleton it summons.
text.这个骷髅是被死灵法师召唤出来的。它的能力与习性和普通的骷髅一样，只是会在召唤者被: This skeleton has been summoned by a necromancer. It behaves just like a regular skeleton, and will die when the necromancer which summoned it is slain.
text.你依稀听到远处有什么东西死掉了。: You hear something die in the distance.
text.你可在某个地牢区域中遇到该敌人。: You can find this enemy in a specific region of the dungeon.
text.这些僧侣皆是狂热的信徒，倾其所能从一切异族手中保护国王的安全。狂热的信仰使得他们:
These monks are fanatics, who have devoted themselves to protecting their king through physical might. So great is their devotion that they have totally surrendered their minds to their king, and now roam the dwarven city like mindless zombies.

Monks rely solely on the art of hand-to-hand combat, and are able to use their unarmed fists both for offense and defense. When they become focused, monks will parry the next physical attack used against them, even if it was otherwise guaranteed to hit. Monks build focus more quickly while on the move, and more slowly when in direct combat.
text.这个武僧已经完全集中于目标的一举一动，似乎能预料到目标的下一步动作。\n\n处于:
This monk is perfectly honed in on their target, and seem to be anticipating their moves before they make them.

While focused, the next physical attack made against this character is guaranteed to miss, no matter what circumstances there are. Parrying this attack will spend the monk's focus, and they will need to build it up again to parry another attack. Monks build focus more quickly while they are moving.
text.幻影食人鱼是巨型食人鱼的一个罕见变种，具有诡异的半透明身体和魔法能力。它能够在受:
Phantom piranhas are a rare breed of piranha with magical abilities and eerie translucent bodies. They are capable of teleporting as they are being attacked, either to escape or to quickly get close to their enemy!

While they are annoying to fight, their meat is prized for its magical properties.
text.这些食肉的鱼类是为了专门保护水涝区域而培育的。它们的撕咬相当致命，避免与它们正面: These carnivorous fish are bred specifically to protect flooded areas. Their bite is deadly, so it's best to avoid confronting them directly.
text.这是一座用于分配区域内机械用电的能量塔。\n\n这座能量塔未被激活，目前无法受到:
A power pylon, meant to help regulate the electricity which powers the machinery in this area.
