The pylon is currently inactive and immune to damage.
text.这是一座用于分配区域内机械用电的能量塔。此刻能量塔电能涌动，定是它在支持DM-3:
A power pylon, meant to help regulate the electricity which powers the machinery in this area. The pylon is currently surging with electrical energy, this must be what's supercharging DM-300!

In this state pylons are vulnerable, but will arc electricity to nearby cells in a clockwise pattern. Due to their heavy metal construction, pylons are resistant to large amounts of damage.
text.虽说啮齿小鼠们具有攻击性，可它们依旧是下水道居民里的弱者。它们的啮咬非常烦人，但: Marsupial rats are aggressive but rather weak denizens of the sewers. They have a nasty bite, but are only life threatening in large numbers.
text.恶魔撕裂者正准备扑杀！: The ripper demon prepares to leap!
text.这种恐怖的生物是恶魔利用这里残留的众多矮人尸骸组成的。恶魔撕裂者外观类似瘦弱的矮:
These horrific creatures are the result of the many dwarven corpses in this region being put to use by demonic forces. Rippers are emaciated ghoulish creatures that resemble dwarves, but with broken bodies and long sharp claws made of bone.

Ripper demons are not particularly durable, but they are agile and dangerous. They are capable of leaping great distances to quickly reach targets before goring them with their claws.
text.腐莓的果实与众不同。一般的果实会腐败并化作养分，但腐莓果实会生长、硬化，并包裹住: A Rotberry's fruit is very unique. Instead of rotting away and providing nutrients, the fruit grows, hardens, and encompasses the seed. It provides protection for the internal organs which grow inside the fruit. This giant orb is referred to as the heart of an adult rotberry plant.
text.腐莓触手是成熟腐莓根系的一部分，也是其主要自卫手段。触手没有视力，且固扎土中不能: The rot lasher is a part of a mature rotberry plant's root structure, and also their primary means of defense. Lashers are blind and stuck into the ground, but will violently assault any nearby threat after taking a moment to detect them. When there is no nearby enemies, they stand motionless, attempting to blend in with surrounding vegetation.
text.这种巨大的节肢类恶魔生物不会选择近身缠斗，它们更擅长在远处发射能够致残的锯齿钉刺: These huge arachnid-like demonic creatures avoid close combat, preferring to fire crippling serrated spikes from long distances.
text.这些僧侣皆是狂热的信徒，倾其所能从一切异族手中保护国王的安全。狂热的信仰使得他们:
These monks are fanatics, who have devoted themselves to protecting their king through physical might. So great is their devotion that they have totally surrendered their minds to their king, and now roam the dwarven city like mindless zombies.

This monk has mastered the art of hand-to-hand combat, and is able to gain focus while moving much more quickly than regular monks. When they become focused, monks will parry the next physical attack used against them, even if it was otherwise guaranteed to hit. Monks build focus more quickly while on the move, and more slowly when in direct combat.
text.豺狼萨满比大多数豺狼人更具智慧，它们会用战斗法术来弥补力量上的不足。尽管豺狼萨满: Gnoll shamans are intelligent gnolls who use battle spells to compensate for their lack of might. They have a very respected position in gnoll society, despite their weaker strength.
text.佩戴红色面具的萨满会利用魔法_弱化你的攻击力_。: This shaman is wearing a red mask, and will use magic that temporarily _weakens your attacking power._
text.佩戴蓝色面具的萨满会利用魔法_增加你受到的伤害_。: This shaman is wearing a blue mask, and will use magic that temporarily _increases the damage you take._
text.佩戴紫色面具的萨满会利用魔法_削减你的精准与闪避_。: This shaman is wearing a purple mask, and will use magic that temporarily _reduces your accuracy and evasion._
text.这些最顶级的豺狼暴徒通常靠装备强力的护甲来彰显其身份。暴徒身上的护甲会倍增它们的: The most senior gnoll brutes often wear powerful armor to show their status. The armor makes these brutes much more resilient to physical damage, and their greater discipline means they can rage for much longer before succumbing to their wounds.
You were killed by the explosion of bones...
text.骷髅本是倒霉的冒险家和监狱原住民的尸骨，因地牢深处邪恶魔力的影响而苏醒。骷髅被摧: Skeletons are composed of the bones of unlucky adventurers and inhabitants of the prison, animated by emanations of evil magic from the depths below. After they have been damaged enough, skeletons will disintegrate in an explosion of bones. The shrapnel from this explosion is harmful to anything nearby, but armor is very effective at mitigating it.
text.史莱姆是一种具有胶质外形与液态内核的奇特魔法生物。城市的下水道为它们提供了充分的:
Slimes are strange, slightly magical creatures with a rubbery outer body and a liquid core. The city sewers provide them with an ample supply of water and nutrients.

Because of their elastic outer membrane, it is difficult to deal more than _6 damage_ to slimes from any one attack.
text.试试点击检查按钮再选择蛇，以了解如何击败它们。: Try using the examine button on a snake to learn how to counter them.
text.这些大号的蛇能通过快速滑行以闪避攻击，所以很难命中。不过伏击与魔法攻击能打它们个:
These oversized serpents are capable of quickly slithering around blows, making them quite hard to hit. Magical attacks or surprise attacks are capable of catching them off-guard however.

You can perform a surprise attack by attacking while out of the snake's vision. One way is to let a snake chase you through a doorway and then _strike just after it moves into the door._
text.死灵法师们通常对召唤骷髅欲罢不能，但其中某些个体却偏爱使唤更为缥缈无形的造物。幽:
While Skeletons are a necromancer’s bread and butter, some prefer to look into other less corporeal minions. Spectral necromancers have chosen wraiths as their minion of choice!

Individual wraiths aren't as strong as skeletons, but these necromancers aren't afraid to summon a bunch of them!
text.这种长着绿毛的矿洞蜘蛛会试着避免正面交战。它更喜欢呆在远处，等着困在蛛网中的猎物: These greenish furry cave spiders try to avoid direct combat. Instead they prefer to wait in the distance while their victim struggles in their excreted cobweb, slowly dying from their venomous bite. They are capable of shooting their webs great distances, and will try to block whatever path their prey is taking.
text.你本以为这只是地牢里又一尊静伫的石像，但它泛着红光的眼睛出卖了它。: You would think that it's just another one of this dungeon's inanimate statues, but its red glowing eyes give it away.
text.虽然雕像本身是石制的，但它装备着的_%s_看起来是真家伙。: While the statue itself is made of stone, the _%s_ it's wielding looks real.
text.魅魔是一种善于操纵敌人的精神的变形恶魔。这一只化为了哥特风的苍白人形，或许是为了:
Succubi are shapeshifting demons that manipulate the minds of their prey. This one has taken the form of a pale gothic humanoid, perhaps to attract dwarven warlocks?

Succubi may temporarily charm their enemy when they attack, making their enemy unable to directly attack them. When succubi attack a charmed enemy, they will steal some of their life essence.
text.致命的飞蝇群愤怒地发出嗡嗡声。每次非魔法攻击都会把它分割成两群更小但同样危险的飞: The deadly swarm of flies buzzes angrily. Every non-magical attack will split it into two smaller but equally dangerous swarms.
text.一位著名的神秘刺客，其名源于紧贴在他脸上的面具。\n\n天狗的手腕和膝下都带着镣:
A famous and enigmatic assassin, named for the mask grafted to his face.

Tengu is held down with large clasps on his wrists and knees, though he seems to have gotten rid of his chains long ago.

He will try to use traps, deceptive magic, and precise attacks to eliminate the only thing stopping his escape: you.
text.这里翻滚着一片过热的烟尘。当心，要爆炸了！: A cloud of superheated smoke is billowing here. Watch out, it's going to explode!
text.它固定在地面上，你无法搬动它！: It's stuck to the ground, you can't move it!
text.天狗往这里扔了一个奇形怪状的，不断鼓出滚烫浓烟的炸弹。它在滴答作响，似乎是爆炸的:
Tengu has thrown a strange looking smoke bomb here, which is billowing a thick hot smoke. It's making a loud ticking noise, as if its counting down to an explosion!

The bomb has anchored itself to the ground, so you can't pick it up.
text.天狗往这里洒了一把开始起烟的细腻粉末，要烧起来了！: Tengu has thrown a fine powder that seems to be catching into steam here, it's about to ignite!
text.这里正积蓄着电能，站在这里的任何单位都会在下回合受到电击！: Electrical energy is building here, anything standing on this tile will be shocked next turn!
text.它放出电能太强了，你无法触碰它！: It's putting out too much electricity, you can't grab it!
text.天狗往这里扔了一个奇怪的装置，好像是用DM-100的零件拼凑出来的。装置在持续地:
Tengu has thrown a curious machine here, which seems to be made of DM-100 parts. The machine is constantly arcing electricity around it, but it seems to be going in a predictable pattern.

With all the electricity arcing around it, there's no way you can pick this up.
text.\n\n这个小偷携带着一个_%s_。明显是偷来的。: The thief is carrying a _%s._ Stolen obviously.
text.小偷带着你的%s逃走了！: The thief gets away with your %s!
text.这些囚犯逃出了他们的牢房，却没能逃出这座监牢。随着时间流逝，这座监牢彻底摧毁了他:
Though these inmates roam free of their cells, this place is still their prison. Over time, this place has taken their minds as well as their freedom. Long ago, these crazy thieves and bandits have forgotten who they are and why they steal.

These enemies are more likely to steal and run than they are to fight. Make sure to keep them in sight, or you might never see your stolen item again.
text.咒缚灵是本性善良却受诅咒折磨的魂灵。只要诅咒仍在，它们就会像更强的怨灵一样攻击你:
Tormented spirits are otherwise good-natured spirits that have been afflicted by a curse. So long as they are cursed they will attack just like a wraith, and are more powerful as well!

It may be possible to cleanse the curse by using the right item while next to the spirit. If the curse is lifted the spirit will surely be grateful...
You were killed by the disintegration ray...
text.这些哨卫会以固定或者半随机的周期发射解离光束。尽管解离光束看起来很危险，不过至少: These sentries fire rays of disintegration magic at regular or semi-random intervals. The beams look quite hazardous, but they always seem to go to the same place at least. It doesn't look like there's any way to resist the disintegration beams, so _you'll have to avoid them in some way_.
text.这种哨卫会以固定的模式扫描区域。它们看起来很危险，要是被扫描到你肯定会遭受电击。: These sentries scan the area in a pre-set pattern. They look quite hazardous, you'll surely be zapped if you are detected by the scan. The pattern can often be avoided, but the sentries also have to visually see you in order to detect you, so _anything that obscures vision is effective against them_.
text.这扇门看似没有上锁，凭你的力量却难以移动分毫。门的表面有一道不同寻常的机关，其上: This seemingly unlocked door won't budge, and has an unusual mechanism along its surface. There are ten indentations that look like some sort of flat diamond-shaped object would fit into them.
text._也许你能在宝库里找到什么可以契合进凹槽的东西？_: _Perhaps something you can find in the vault might fit here?_
text._你的矮人徽记与凹槽完美契合_，但徽记的数量还不够。: _Your dwarven tokens fit the indentations perfectly_, but you don't have enough of them.
text._你有足够的矮人徽记以填入所有凹槽_，要把它们放进去吗？: _You have enough dwarven tokens to fill every indentation_, do you want to place them into the door?
text.徽记渐渐与门融为一体，与此同时你听到了远处门锁打开的声音。: The tokens seem to merge into the door and you hear the distinct click of a lock opening.
text.这面巨大的黑镜刻有各式各样闪闪发光的矮人符文，它轻微地的鸣响着，却不显出任何倒影: This large mirror is inscribed with various glowing dwarven runes, it hums gently but doesn't seem to actually reflect anything.
text.一面巨大的镜子伫立在你的面前，其厚重的石质边框上刻着闪闪发光的矮人符文。远看时镜: Before you stands a large mirror with thin glowing runes etched into its opulent golden frame. The mirror's surface is pitch black, until you get close. As you lean toward the mirror the runes flash brightly and a shockingly familiar scene appears behind the glass.
text.你看见了你那红色的_蜡质纹章_，其依旧对半裂开，却已遭弃置、半掩雪中。这幅景象与: You see your red _wax seal_, chopped in half and partly buried in the snow. The scene is almost like a memory, but the details are different. You could never bear to throw the seal away, keeping it felt like a part of your punishment. You've also spent a long time looking at it, and the break is at a slightly different angle.
text.你看见了你的_魔杖_静静的待在一间书房的桌子上。这幅景象与你的记忆相去无几，但在: You see your _magical staff_ resting on a table in a study. The scene is almost like a memory, but the details are different. This was your public office at the southern wizarding institute; far too visible of a location to keep the staff. The office looks more lived in than it should be as well, you never cared to do real work there.
text.你看见了_暗影斗篷_，静静地挂在皇家军械库里的架子上。这幅景象与你的记忆相去无几: You see the _Cloak of Shadows_, gently resting on a stand in the royal armory. The scene is almost like a memory, but the details are different. The armory is still and quiet, and the guard on duty is calmly scanning over the room with a kind look in his eyes. There's a familiar twinge of guilt as you see him standing peacefully and unharmed.
text.你看见了你的_灵能弓_被置于密林中一块盘状巨石之上。这幅景象与你的记忆相去无几，: You see your _spirit bow_ placed on a large flat circular stone surrounded by dense forest. The scene is almost like a memory, but the details are different. The small clearing around the stone is quiet and empty, completely unlike the celebration when you were given your bow. In fact, you can't sense anything from the surrounding nature at all.
text.你看见了一个高大的身影，身披皇家近卫的甲胄伫立在你面前：那正是你过世的父亲。这幅: You see a tall figure clad in royal guard armor standing before you: your late father. The scene is almost like a memory, but the details are different. The kind look in his eyes is exactly as you remember, but his face is weathered by years that he never got to live. He holds out his _enchanted greatsword_ for you to take.
text.你看见了明烛照映的圣堂中有一个被打开的圣物匣，其中装着的正是_神圣法典_。这幅景: You see an opened reliquary coffer in a brightly lit chapel, containing the _holy tome_. The scene is almost like a memory, but the details are different. You never took the reliquary out of storage, only the tome itself. The divine energies radiating from the tome feel unusual too, as though it is channeling energy from a different source.
text.你注意到黑镜的玻璃镜面已经无影无踪，再也没有任何障碍可以阻止你伸手取走镜中之物。: You notice that the glass surface of the mirror is completely gone, there's nothing stopping you from reaching in and taking the item.
text.你将手探入，取走了其中的物品，但镜中的景象一时却并未变化，仿佛你手中的事物同时也:
As you reach in and take the item the scene is unchanged, as if the item exists in two places at once.

The image in the mirror fades, and the item in your hand seems to gently pulse with the same rhythm as the runes around the mirror.

You're not really sure what just happened but the item's existence seems tied to the mirror, you probably won't be able to take it out of the vault.
text.你再次触碰了黑镜，然而无事发生。镜面光滑坚硬，模糊映出的只有你指尖的倒影。: You approach the mirror again but nothing happens. Its surface is smooth and solid, you can just barely see the reflection of your fingertips as you touch the glass.
text.当矮人的兴趣从工程建设转向奥秘学术时，术士们逐渐于城中掌权。它们从元素魔法起步，:
As the dwarves' interests shifted from engineering to arcane arts, warlocks came to power in the city. They started with elemental magic, but soon switched to demonology and necromancy. The strongest of these warlocks seized the throne of the dwarven city, and his cohorts were allowed to continue practising their dark magic, so long as they surrendered their free will to him.

These warlocks possess powerful disruptive magic, and are able to temporarily hinder the upgrade magic applied to your equipment. The more upgraded an item is, the more strongly it will be affected.
text.怨灵是来自于墓穴中渴望复仇的罪人之魂。作为飘渺的非实体很难被正常武器击中。: A wraith is a vengeful spirit of a sinner, whose grave or tomb was disturbed. Being an ethereal entity, it is very hard to hit with a regular weapon.
text.Yog-Dzewa是一个古老的神；一个将自己的力量延伸向凡间世界并吞噬它们、以为:
Yog-Dzewa is an Old God; a great monstrosity which reaches into mortal worlds and devours them to fuel its endless growth. The dwarves must have attracted the attention of this cosmic horror while toying with dark magics, and have been trying to keep it contained ever since.

Yog-Dzewa originates from a dimension of raw magical chaos, and cannot bring its true form into this world. Instead it has created avatars and summoned demonic minions to do its bidding here.

This giant eye is the focal point of Yog-Dzewa's power in this world. While the eye itself is immobile, it is capable of shooting powerful beams of demonic magic and summoning a variety of minions to aid it.
text.你感觉到恶魔能量正从上层涌向古神之眼。你在上面活着留下的什么东西正在给古神回馈着: You can feel waves of demonic energy radiating to the eye from the floors above. Something you left alive up there must be funneling power back into Yog-Dzewa. _Yog will use this energy to summon more powerful minions!_
text.这些古神的小小造物是一种易于制造的简陋生物。虽然单个幼虫十分脆弱，但它们能够被迅: These tiny spawn of Yog-Dzewa are simple minions that are easy to produce. While individually weak, they are summoned quickly and can become overwhelming in large numbers.
text.拳头邻接古神之眼时无法受到伤害！: The fist is invulnerable while near to the eye!
text.这个拳头是古神力量的部分体现。这些拳头与古神的力量相互联系，并且当它们靠近古神之: This fist is an aspect of Yog-Dzewa's power. Fists are linked to the power of Yog-Dzewa, and will be protected from all damage when they are close to the eye.
text.燃烧之拳是由混沌的炽热魔法形成的。它在移动时会不断地引燃周围的环境。它还可以发射:
This fist is formed out of chaotic fiery magic. As it moves it will constantly set terrain around it ablaze. It is also capable of shooting blasts of fiery power, which spread flames where they impact.

The fist's ability to spread flames is suppressed when near water, but its heat is so great that any water around it will evaporate after a short while!
text.大地之拳是由混沌的大地魔法形成的。当它移动时，它会不断地使周围生出植物。它还可以:
This fist is formed out of chaotic earthen magic. As it moves it will constantly cause vegetation to sprout around it. It can also shoot concentrated earthen blasts that will ensnare its target in rapidly growing vines and roots!

The fist derives power from this plant life, and will resist damage based on the amount of tall or furrowed vegetation near it!
text.腐烂之拳是由一团活的腐肉形成的。它是一团高塔般庞大的腐烂血肉，可以在近战中喷溅腐:
This fist is formed out of living corruption. It is a towering mass of decaying flesh that can spread caustic ooze in melee and toxic gas at range. Even worse, the fist's great mass causes it to bleed instead of taking damage directly.

Water can be used to wash the ooze off, but the fist is also capable of absorbing water to heal itself! Additionally, damaging the fist while it is bleeding will cause the bleed to refresh, but not stack!
text.锈蚀之拳是由一块活性金属形成的。它是一块高塔般庞大的活性金属，具有强大的近战能力:
This fist is formed out of living metal. It is a towering mass of shifting metal that has powerful melee attacks, and can cripple its targets at range. Because of its tremendous mass, the fist will take any damage dealt to it over time, instead of immediately.

The fist is inflexible however, and cannot move into tight passageways. Additionally, while it may take damage slowly, the deferred damage will continue to increase if the fist is hit multiple times.
text.辉耀之拳在一道使你重度盲目的爆闪中传送到了别处！: The fist teleports away in a flash of light that seriously blinds you!
text.辉耀之拳是由纯粹的光能量形成的。它能在每回合射出一道强烈的灼目光束！这些光束除了:
This fist is formed out of pure light energy. It is capable of shooting powerful rays of searing light every turn! These beams will temporarily blind you in addition to dealing heavy damage. The fist is also capable of briefly engulfing the arena in blinding light in order to escape!

The fist has no special abilities which it can use in melee range however.
text.暗影之拳在一片使你光源熄灭的漆黑中传送到了别处！: The fist teleports away in a blast of darkness that extinguishes your light source!
text.暗影之拳是由纯粹的暗能量形成的。它能在每回合射出强大的暗黑法术！这些法术除了造成:
This fist is formed out of pure dark energy. It is capable of shooting powerful blasts of dark magic every turn! These blasts will weaken your light source in addition to dealing heavy damage. The fist is also capable of briefly engulfing the arena in darkness in order to escape!

The fist has no special abilities which it can use in melee range however.
text.腐莓的远亲，来自无味果树丛的梨状产物，尝起来犹如一团泥巴。果实粗糙且松软，但并没: Distant cousin of the rotberry, the pear-shaped produce of the blandfruit bush tastes like caked dust. The fruit is gross and unsubstantial but isn't poisonous. Perhaps it could be cooked.
text.你可在地牢各处找到该植物。: You can find this plant randomly in the dungeon.
text.在被碰到后，致盲草会瞬间枯萎并释放一道强光。这道光足以刺伤受害者双眼，使其暂时失:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Upon being touched a blindweed perishes in a bright flash of light. The flash is strong enough to disorient for several seconds.
text._守望者_能将致盲草的能量化为一层短时间的隐形迷雾，而不会被致盲。: _The Warden_ will channel a blindweed's energy into a temporary shroud of invisibility, instead of being disoriented.
text.魔皇草的带刺花朵含有一种化学物质，因其强大的中和性质而闻名。任何踏入这株植物的东:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

The mageroyal's prickly flowers contain a chemical which is known for its properties as a strong neutralizing agent. Anything that steps in this plant will be cleansed of many negative effects.
text.当踩踏一株魔皇草时，_守望者_在获得中和效果以外，还能短暂地对所有环境影响免疫。: In addition to the neutralizing effect, _the Warden_ will become temporarily immune to all area-bound effects when stepping on mageroyal.
text.碰到地缚根后，它的根系会在踩踏者周边形成某种无法移动的天然护甲。:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

When a creature touches an earthroot, its roots create a kind of immobile natural armor around it.
text._守望者_能将这种护甲转化为可移动的树肤护甲。: The roots of an earthroot plant will move with _the Warden_, providing her mobile barkskin armor.
text.这是一种由层层树皮和藤蔓盘结而成的，不可移动的天然护甲。\n\n每当你受到物理攻:
A kind of natural, immobile armor made of bark and twine.

This herbal armor will block %d damage from any physical hit, until it eventually runs out of durability and collapses.

As the armor is immobile, moving will cause it to break apart and be lost.

Armor remaining: %d.
text.任何触碰到消逝草的生物都会被传送到当前层的一个随机地点。:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Touching a fadeleaf will teleport any creature to a random place on the current level.
text._守望者_能进一步发挥消逝草的空间魔力，直接回到上一层的下楼梯处。: The teleportation effect of fadeleaf is more potent for _the Warden_, teleporting her back to the end of the previous dungeon level.
text.烈焰花被任何物品触碰到时，都会化为一团火焰。:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

When something touches a firebloom, it bursts into flames.
text._守望者_能将有害的火焰转化为短时的烈焰之力。: When she tramples a firebloom, _the Warden_ will be briefly imbued with flame instead of being harmed.
text.冰冠花在被接触到时会喷射出一团能冻结周遭的花粉。冻结效果会在潮湿环境中大幅增强。:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Upon being touched, an icecap lets out a puff of freezing pollen. The freezing effect is much stronger if the environment is wet.
text._守望者_能将有害的冰冻转化为短时的寒霜之力。: When she tramples an icecap, _the Warden_ will be briefly imbued with frost instead of being harmed.
text.守望者踩踏这株植物不会获得额外效果。: This plant has no special effect when used by the Warden.
text.你可在地牢各处直接找到该植物，使用对应的种子进行种植亦可。: You can find this plant randomly in the dungeon, or grow it from its associated seed.
text.把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。\n\n%s:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

%s
text.未成熟的腐莓丛结出的莓果尝起来更像是甜蜜的死亡。经过成年累月的生长，这株腐莓丛终:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

The berries of a young rotberry shrub taste like sweet, sweet death. Over a few years, this rotberry shrub will grow into another rot heart. When trampled, a young rotberry will produce a small puff of toxic gas.
text.遭到践踏时腐莓丛通常只会喷出一小股毒气，但_守望者_却能联结其中的魔力，在短时间: Normally a rotberry bush only produces a little gas when trampled, but _the Warden_ is able to harness energy from it to temporarily boost her strength!
text.你可在某个任务中使用其种子种植该植物。: You can grow this plant from its associated seed during a specific quest.
text.断肠苔（实为花卉而非苔藓）是一种花瓣利如刀片，表面覆有致命毒液的植物。:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

A sorrowmoss is a flower (not a moss) with razor-sharp petals, coated with a deadly venom.
text._守望者_能将有害的毒素转化为短时的毒素之力。: When she tramples a sorrowmoss, _the Warden_ will be briefly imbued with toxin instead of being harmed.
text.星陨花较为罕见，据说其能够为任何接触它的人赋予神圣之力。:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

A rare plant, starflower is said to grant holy power to whomever touches it.
text._守望者_在踩踏星陨花时不仅能受到祝福，还能获得较长时间的法杖充能。: In addition to being blessed, _the Warden_ will gain a significant amount of wand recharging when she tramples a starflower.
text.引力似乎并不能正常地作用在风暴藤上，它蓝色的藤蔓能够\"挂\"在空中。任何被风暴:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Gravity affects the stormvine plant strangely, allowing its whispy blue tendrils to 'hang' on the air. Anything caught in the vine is affected by this, and becomes disoriented.
text.守望者能够操纵风暴藤的魔力，因而在踩踏之后可以获得短暂飘浮的能力。: _The Warden_ is able to control the gravitational effect of stormvine, and will briefly levitate when she tramples one.
text.阳春草因其汁液缓慢但显著的疗伤效果而家喻户晓。:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Sungrass is renowned for its sap's slow but effective healing properties.
text._守望者_能将阳春草的治疗魔力随身携带。: _The Warden_ can receive healing from trampled sungrass even if she moves away from it.
text.阳春草拥有优秀的治疗能力，尽管治疗速率比治疗药剂慢很多。\n\n脱离植株将会打断:
Sungrass possesses excellent healing properties, though it is much slower than a potion of healing.

Moving off the plant will break the healing effect.

Healing remaining: %d.
text.被踩踏后，速行蓟会加速周围的时间流动，让踩踏者可以瞬间行动数次:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

When trampled, swiftthistle will briefly accelerate the flow of time around it, allowing the trampler to perform several actions instantly.
text._守望者_踩踏速行蓟不仅能获得瞬时行动的机会，还能在短时间内极速奔跑。: In addition to gaining instantaneous actions, _the Warden_ will also get a brief haste boost when trampling swiftthistle.
text.这是一个加速时间运行的气泡。\n\n你可以在气泡中瞬间进行多次行动，但是攻击或施:
A small bubble of accelerated time, allowing actions to be performed instantly. Attacking or using magic will break this effect however.

Turns remaining: %s.
text.你可以删除已有的记录以为新的记录腾出空间。你当前所有的自定记录均可在日志窗口查看: You can delete existing notes to make room for more. All of your current custom notes can be viewed from the journal window.
text.你可以在日志中记下任何你想记录的东西。\n\n自定义备注可以只是独立的文本，也可:
Custom Notes let you record anything you'd like in the journal.

They can be just text on its own, or they can be associated with a dungeon floor, one of your items, or a type of potion/scroll/ring.
text.为自定义文本备注拟题：: Write a title for this custom text note:
text.选择要备注的地牢楼层: Select a floor of the dungeon to associate this note with.
text.为_第%d层_的自定义备注拟题：: Write a title for this custom note for _floor %d_:
text.为物品_%s_的备注拟题：:
Write a title for this custom note for the item:
_%s_
text.选择要备注的物品类别: Select a type of item you'd like to associate this note with.
text.你确定要删除这个备注吗？: Are you sure you want to delete this custom note?
text.升到6级以解锁更多天赋: Reach level 6 to unlock more talents.
text.升到12级并使用第二个Boss的掉落物以解锁更多天赋。: Reach level 12 and use the item from the second boss to unlock more talents.
text.升到20级并使用第四个Boss的掉落物以解锁更多天赋。: Reach level 20 and use the item from the fourth boss to unlock more talents.
text.你确定要随机消耗这些天赋点吗？: Are you sure you want to spend these talent points randomly?
text.再按一遍此按钮以搜索周边；\n点选一个地格以获得其信息。:
Press again to search
Press a tile to examine
text.破碎的像素地牢会时常更新以变更既有内容，或是加入新东西！\n\n游戏平衡也会经常:
Shattered Pixel Dungeon is regularly updated with overhauls to existing game content, or entirely new content!

Game balance is also frequently improved in game updates, so that specific items/heroes/enemies aren't too strong or too weak.

Updates also include fixes for bugs and other various stability improvements.
text.好吧，按之前说好的，我得帮你做点事。我干活只收鉴定过还没诅咒的物品。\n\n_当:
Okay, a deal's a deal. Here's what I can do for you. I only work with identified and uncursed items.

_Current Favor: %d_
text._镐子(%d人情)：_你想要的话，这镐子可以给你。毕竟我有的是。: _Pickaxe (%d favor):_ I guess I can give you the pickaxe back if you want. I've got plenty more.
text.你真想要这个破烂吗？这里的石头可不像矿井里的，你没法再拿它挖墙了。: You sure you want dis old thing? The rock around here isn't soft like in the mine, so you won't be able to do any more digging with it.
text.行，你干的不错，这个破烂白送你了。: Eh, you did a pretty good job, I'll give it to you for free.
text._重铸(%d人情)：_我可以重铸两件同种物品制成一件品质更好的。: _Reforge (%d favor):_ I can reforge two of the same type of item into one of a higher quality.
text._硬化(%d人情)：_我可以硬化你的武器护甲，上面的附魔刻印会更容易保留。: _Harden (%d favor):_ I can harden a weapon or armor, so it's easier to keep an enchantment or glyph.
text._升级(%d人情)：_如果你有+2以下的物品，我可以帮你给它升级一下。: _Upgrade (%d favor):_ If you've got an item below +2 I can upgrade it for you.
text._锻造(%d人情)：_我可以帮你锻造一件武器或护甲。锻造出来的装备不仅高阶还可能: _Smith (%d favor):_ I can try forging a weapon or armor for you from scratch. It'll be higher tier and probably upgraded, and you'll get some choice over what you get.
text.行，我先把锻炉预热一下，然后你就能挑选你想要的装备了。: Alright, I'll get the forge warmed up and then you can pick what you want.
text._折现(全部人情)：_我可以给你点我平时捡到的金币，一点人情一枚金币。: _Cash Out (all favor):_ I can just give you some regular gold I've got lyin' around. 1 for each point of favor.
text.行，这是%d金币。之后你就别再来找我干活了！: Okay so that's %d gold. I'm not doin' any more work for you after dis though!
text.行，我可以重铸两件鉴定过的同种物品。较差的那件会报废以升级更好的那件。要是它们等: Okay, I can reforge two identified items of the same type. The weaker one will be destroyed to give the stronger one an upgrade. If they're the same level, I'll keep the one on the left.
text.行，这些就是我能锻造的装备了。锻炉已经烧热了，所以你赶紧给我选。: Okay, here's what I can make. I've already got the forge fired up so choose quickly.
text.手指还未离开，头顶上的皇冠就开始与你的护甲共鸣，发光、发热，好像坐上你的颅骨就是: The crown glows as it rests on your head, and both it and your armor become hot to the touch. You can feel the magic of the crown begin to act on your armor, but it must be directed. Which armor ability do you choose?
text.请陛下选一项护甲技能！: Choose an ability for your armor!
text.陛下确定要选择这项技能吗？: Are you sure you want to choose this ability?
text.你确定要选择随机一个护甲技能吗？: Are you sure you want to choose your armor ability randomly?
text.面具激动地贴附到你的脸上。忽然，眼前的景象极速消逝，你什么都看不见了——不，是什: As the mask fits over your face, your eyesight fades and visions of new power flood into your mind. How will you direct the mask's power?
text.您确定要选择这条专精道路吗？: Are you sure you want to choose this subclass?
text.你确定要选择随机一个专精吗？: Are you sure you want to choose a subclass randomly?
text.选择一个要施放的法术，右键单击获取信息或为法术设置快捷施法。: Select a spell to cast it, right click for info or to set a spell to quick cast.
text.选择一个要施放的法术，长按为法术设置快捷施法，或按信息按钮切换为信息模式。: Select a spell to cast it, long press to set a spell to quick cast, or press the info button to switch to info mode.
text.选择一个要了解的法术，或按圣典按钮切换为施法模式。: Select a spell to learn about it, or press the holy tome button to switch to cast mode.
text.你确定要炼化你的饰物吗？你会获得5点炼金能量返还，但_饰物将会永远消失！_: Are you sure you want to energize your trinket? You'll get 5 energy back but _the trinket will be permanently lost!_
text.你确定要删除这个存档吗？: Are you sure you want to delete this save?
text.你将失去这局游戏的所有进度: All progress on this game will be lost
text.英雄在升级时会获得一点天赋点数。更高阶的天赋在击杀第二个Boss后才会解锁。: The hero gains one talent point each time they level up. Higher tier talents appear after defeating the second boss.
text.击杀第二个Boss后可以选择一种职业专精。: A subclass can be chosen after defeating the second boss.
text.击杀第四个Boss后可以选择一项护甲技能。: An armor ability can be chosen after defeating the fourth boss.
text.哦太棒了！你简直就是我的英雄！\n关于你的奖励，我现在没带钱，但我这有个更好的东:
Oh yes! You are my hero!
Regarding your reward, I don't have cash with me right now, but I have something better for you. This is my family heirloom ring: my granddad took it off a dead paladin's finger.
text.这个陷阱已经失效了，且不会被再次触发。: This trap is inactive, and can no longer be triggered.
text.随着你在地牢中的旅途逐渐推进，这里会自动为你记录下重要信息。: As you journey through the dungeon, you will automatically record noteworthy things here.
text.你还没在任何一局游戏中发现并鉴定过这种物品。: You haven't found and identified that item in any of your runs yet.
text.你还没在任何一局游戏中发现并鉴定过带有这种附魔的武器。: You haven't found and identified a weapon with that enchantment in any of your runs yet.
text.你还没在任何一局游戏中发现并鉴定过带有这种刻印的护甲。: You haven't found and identified an armor with that glyph in any of your runs yet.
text.你还没在任何一局游戏中击败过这种敌人。: You haven't defeated this enemy in any of your runs yet.
text.你还没在任何一局游戏中遇见过这个角色。: You haven't encountered this character in any of your runs yet.
text.你还没在任何一局游戏中检查或触发过这种陷阱。: You haven't examined or triggered this trap in any of your runs yet.
text.你还没在任何一局游戏中检查或践踏过这种植物。: You haven't examined or trampled this plant in any of your runs yet.
text.你已经升级了这种物品共计_%,d_次。: You have upgraded this item a total of _%,d_ times.
text.你已经合成或升级了这种物品共计_%,d_次。: You have crafted or upgraded this item a total of _%,d_ times.
text.你已经使用了这种物品共计_%,d_次。: You have used this item a total of _%,d_ times.
text.你已经花费了共计_%,d_枚金币。: You have spent a total of _%,d_ gold.
text.你已经使用了共计_%,d_个能量晶体。: You have used a total of _%,d_ energy crystals.
text.你已经击败了这种敌人共计_%,d_次。: You have defeated this enemy a total of _%,d_ times.
text.你已经触发了这种陷阱共计_%,d_次。: You have triggered this trap a total of _%,d_ times.
text.你已经践踏了这种植物共计_%,d_次。: You have trampled this plant a total of _%,d_ times.
text.你还没在任何一局游戏中发现过这段背景故事。: You haven't found this lore text in any of your runs yet.
text.使用左摇杆移动你的角色\n使用右摇杆移动光标:
The left stick moves your character
The right stick controls an on-screen pointer
text.按下一个按键以替代_%s_的第一键位。: Press a key to change the first key binding for: _%s_.
text.按下一个按键以替代_%s_的第二键位。: Press a key to change the second key binding for: _%s_.
text.按下一个按键以替代_%s_的第三键位。: Press a key to change the third key binding for: _%s_.
text.这个按键将不再应用于_%s_。: This key will be unbound from _%s_.
text.这个按键已经应用于该行动。: This key is already bound to this action.
text.至少要有一个键位对应此行动。: You must have at least one key bound to this action.
text.你确定要使用这条记录对应的地牢种子开始一场游戏吗？_注意，使用自定义种子的游戏不:
Would you like to use the dungeon seed from this ranking as a custom seed for a new game? _Note that games with a custom seed cannot earn badges or contribute to games played, and appear at the bottom of the rankings page._

If this ranking is for an old run, also note that different versions of Shattered Pixel Dungeon may make different dungeons even if the seed is the same.
text.死亡正在降临，所幸重生十字架正努力引导你的灵魂回到这个世界。这给了你又一个征服地:
As you perish you can feel your ankh guiding your spirit back toward this world. It's giving you another chance to conquer the dungeon!

You can bring two of your items with you, but the rest will be left where you perished. Which items will you choose?
text.你还没有选定两件物品。你确定要放弃保留两件物品并重生吗？: You haven't selected two items. Are you sure you want to resurrect without two items?
text.谢谢你，那个可怕的老鼠被杀，我也终于可以安息了...不知道究竟是什么样畸形的魔法: Thank you, that horrid rat is slain and I can finally rest... I wonder what twisted magic created such a foul creature...
text.谢谢你，那个诡计多端的豺狼人被杀，我也终于可以安息了...不知道究竟是什么样畸形: Thank you, that scheming gnoll is slain and I can finally rest... I wonder what twisted magic made it so smart...
text.谢谢你，那只巨蟹被杀，我也终于可以安息了...不知道究竟是什么样畸形的魔法能让它: Thank you, that giant crab is slain and I can finally rest... I wonder what twisted magic allowed it to live so long...
text.挑一个你喜欢的拿走吧，我再也用不着它们了...希望它们能帮助你继续走下去...\:
Please take one of these items, they are useless to me now... Maybe they will help you in your journey...

Also... There is an item lost in this dungeon that is very dear to me... If you ever... find my... rose......
text.基于最深层数与英雄等级。: Based on maximum depth and hero level.
text.基于收集的金币与随身物品的价值。: Based on gold collected and held item value.
text.基于已探索的楼层。遗漏物品、隐藏门道与未解谜题会降低分数。: Based on floors explored. Reduced by missing items or hidden doors, or unsolved puzzles.
text.基于已击败的boss。在boss战中受到可规避的攻击会降低分数。: Based on bosses defeated. Reduced by standing in avoidable attacks during boss fights.
text.基于已完成的任务。受到可规避的攻击或未完成任务目标会降低分数。: Based on quests completed. Reduced by taking avoidable attacks or missing quest score.
text.在v1.3版本之前开始的游戏得分项目较少，但来自进度项目的得分会增加约50%，并: Games started prior to v1.3 have fewer scoring categories, but progression is ~50% larger and treasure has a higher cap
text.当空间不足以显示所有6个快捷栏的时候，通过“切换快捷栏”按钮可以交替显示另外3个: Shows 3 quickslots with a 'swapper' button if there isn't enough room to display all six quickslots.
text.这个语言已被完全翻译并审核完毕。: This language has been fully translated and reviewed.
text._这个语言尚未被完全审核。_它也许还存在一些问题，不过所有的文本都已被翻译。: _This language has not yet been reviewed._ It may contain errors, but all text has been translated.
text._这个语言尚未被完全翻译。_大量文本可能仍然为英语。: _This language has not been fully translated._ Large amounts of text may still be in English.
text.所有翻译都由_Transifex_网站上的志愿者提供。: All translation provided by volunteers through _Transifex._
text.欢迎~希望您能在破碎的像素地牢中玩得开心！: Hello, I hope you're enjoying Shattered Pixel Dungeon!
text.你的袖章充能无法保证稳妥地窃取这件道具。一旦失败，店主就会关店跑路。你确定要尝试: Your armband does not have enough charge to guarantee stealing this item. If it fails, the shop will close. Are you sure you want to attempt to steal?
text.升级这件物品会永久提升其如下属性：: Upgrading an item permanently improves it:
text.你并不知道这件物品的属性，此处显示的是其未被升级的状态。: You don't know the properties of this item, its un-upgraded state is shown here.
text.你并不知道这枚戒指的效果，因此无从得知升级对其有何作用。: You don't know what this ring's effect is, and so have no idea what upgrading it will do.
text.升级这件物品还有33%的概率净化其诅咒。: Upgrading this item also has a 33% chance to cleanse its curse.
text.升级这件物品不仅会弱化其诅咒，还有33%的概率完全净化其诅咒。: Upgrading this item will also weaken its curse, and has a 33% chance to cleanse it entirely.
text.如果诅咒被净化，这件物品将会不再带有诅咒菱晶的升级效果！: If the curse is cleansed, the item will no longer benefit from curse infusion!
text.升级这件物品还有%d%%的概率消除其附魔！: Upgrading this item also has a %d%% chance to destroy its enchantment!
text.升级这件物品还有%d%%的概率消除其刻印！: Upgrading this item also has a %d%% chance to destroy its glyph!
text.升级这件物品还有%d%%的概率消除其硬化！: Upgrading this item also has a %d%% chance to break its hardening!
text.这根法杖已被奥术树脂强化，一般的升级效果将会覆盖树脂的升级效果！: This wand has been enhanced with arcane resin, normal upgrades will override resin upgrades!
text.这组武器不在你背包的部分将化为尘土。: Weapons from this set that aren't in your inventory will crumble to dust.
text.恭喜您征服了这座地牢！新的游戏选项已经解锁，你可以在选择英雄时查看并设置：: Congratulations on conquering the dungeon! You've unlocked some new features that are available when choosing a hero:
text.您现在可以开启_挑战_功能了！挑战是一类通过各种方式为游戏增添难度的设置选项。: You can now enable _challenges!_ These are optional modifiers to make the game more difficult in a variety of ways.
text.您现在可以使用_自定义种子_进行游戏了！在版本不变的情况下，使用同一个种子将总是: You can now enter _custom seeds!_ The same seed and game version always produce the same dungeon.
text.您现在可以参与_每日挑战_了！每天都有一场新游戏，对每个人都是一样的！: You can now participate in _daily runs!_ Every day there's a new daily run that's the same for every player!
text.万分感谢您能游玩破碎的像素地牢！: Thank you so much for playing Shattered Pixel Dungeon!
text._请考虑赞助这款游戏_，如果您还没有的话。忠实玩家的支持能让开发者不断对游戏进行: If you haven't already, _please consider supporting the game._ Support from dedicated players lets the developer continue improving the game!
text.哦，我注意到你已经获得了尸尘！别担心那些怨灵，我能解决它们。就像我承诺的，你可以: Oh, I see you have the dust! Don't worry about the wraiths, I can deal with them. As I promised, you can choose one of my high quality wands.
text.哦，我注意到你已经获得了余烬！希望那个火焰元素没有造成太多麻烦。就像我承诺的，你: Oh, I see you have the embers! I do hope the fire elemental wasn't too much trouble. As I promised, you can choose one of my high quality wands.
text.哦，我注意到你已经获得了腐莓！希望那株植物没有对你造成太多困扰。就像我承诺的，你: Oh, I see you have the berry! I do hope the rotberry plant didn't trouble you too much. As I promised, you can choose one of my high quality wands.
text.放入材料以制作新的道具！: Combine ingredients to create something new!
text.这个包里没有可炼金的物品。: There are no alchemizeable items in that bag.
text.你终于将它握在手中——Yendor护符！凭借它的力量，没有什么能够阻挡你前进的步:
You finally hold it in your hands, the Amulet of Yendor! With the power of this amulet nothing will be able to stand in your way! You have conquered the dungeon and succeeded in your quest!

Or, perhaps you're not ready yet? You can also decide to just hold onto the amulet, stay a mere mortal a little longer, and perhaps leave the dungeon the old fashioned way...
text.从左侧选取一个图标以阅读此次更新包含的改动。: Select an icon on the left to read about changes from that update.
text.改动详情由开发者亲自撰写，且仅提供英文版本。: Change details are written by the developer and are only available in English.
text.你降入了地牢的第%d层。: You descend to floor %d of the dungeon.
You feel that there's a source of demonic energy above you...
text.你能感觉到恶魔能量从楼上辐射到了这里！: You can feel demonic energy radiating here from the previous floors!
text.你四周的墙壁开始扭曲变换！: The walls warp and shift around you!
text.你回到了地牢的第%d层。: You return to floor %d of the dungeon.
You're certain that there's a secret room somewhere on this floor.
text.这里引人注意的东西不止一件，你想检查哪个？: There are multiple things of interest here, which one do you want to examine?
text.你不清楚那里有什么。: You don't know what is there.
text.点击一个位置以进行移动或互动。: Tap a location to move and interact.
text.使用鼠标或方向键进行移动与互动。: Use the mouse, WASD, or arrow keys to move and interact.
text.选择一个位置或使用左摇杆进行移动与互动。: Select a location or use the left stick to move or interact.
text.点击屏幕右上角闪光的日志按钮以阅读你刚刚拾起的书页。: Tap the flashing journal button on the top-right to read the book you just picked up.
text.选取屏幕右上角闪光的日志按钮(%s)以阅读你刚刚拾起的书页。: Select the flashing journal button (%s) on the top-right to read the book you just picked up.
text.英雄的信息显示于界面的左上角。而物品栏、快捷栏以及一些行动按钮则位于界面下方。开: Hero info is on the top left. Inventory, quickslots, and game actions are below. Good luck!
text.英雄信息(%1$s)显示于界面的下方。而物品栏(%2$s)、快捷栏以及一些交互按: Hero info (%1$s) is below. Inventory (%2$s), quickslots, and game actions are to the right. Good luck!
text.每天都会有一局对所有玩家都一样的新游戏可供游玩！“每日挑战”会为所有玩家生成相同:
Every day a new game is available that is the same for everyone! This 'daily run' generates the same dungeon for every person who plays it (so long as they are also playing the same game version).

You can take as long as you like to complete a daily run, but can only have one active at a time. _Daily runs are not eligible for badges and have their own separate rankings page._

Would you like to start today's daily with your currently selected hero and challenges?
text.你已经游玩过了今天的每日挑战。你当然可以反复游玩它，但仅有练习的意义，只有第一次:
You have already played today's daily. You can replay it if you like, but only as an unranked practice run.

After you complete the replay, you will be able to view it from the daily rankings window for a short time before the record is deleted.

Would you like to replay today's daily with your currently selected hero and challenges?
text.你似乎在未来开始了一场每日挑战！这种情况通常在你改变了时区的情况下发生，亦有可能: It seems you've started a daily that's in the future! This can happen if you recently changed timezones, or if you changed your system clock. _Your next daily will be available in %d days._
text.你已有一场每日挑战在进行中。在开启下一场每日挑战之前，你必须先完成它。: You already have a daily run in progress. You must end that run before starting another daily.
text.每天都有一场新游戏，对每个人都是一样的！“每日挑战”会为每个玩家生成相同的地牢(:
Every day a new game is available that is the same for everyone! This 'daily run' generates the same dungeon for every person who plays it (so long as they are also playing the same game version).

_You must win at least one game before you are able to play daily runs._
text.游戏通过使用种子来生成地牢，在版本不变的情况下，使用同一个种子将总是生成相同的地: The game uses a seed code for dungeon generation, the same seed and game version always generate the same dungeon! _Custom seed games cannot earn badges or contribute to games played, and appear at the bottom of the rankings page._
text.你已有一场使用该种子的游戏在进行中。在使用该种子开始新游戏之前，你必须先结束先前: You already have a regular game in progress with that seed. You must end that game before using that custom seed.
text.游戏通过使用种子来生成地牢，在版本不变的情况下，使用同一个种子将总是生成相同的地:
The game uses a seed code for dungeon generation, the same seed and game version always generate the same dungeon!

_You must win at least one game before you are able to enter custom seeds._
text.挑战是一类为游戏增添难度的设置选项，可自行选择开启与否。其中的一些会使地牢变得更:
Challenges are optional modifiers that make the game more difficult. Some challenges make the dungeon more dangerous, others reduce the power of your abilities or items.

_You must win at least one game before you are able to enable challenges._
text.未能找到存档文件。如果重启后问题依旧存在，那这个存档可能已经损坏。节哀顺变。: Save file not found. If this error persists after restarting, it may mean this save game is corrupted. Sorry about that.
text.未能读取存档文件。如果重启后问题依旧存在，那这个存档可能已经损坏。节哀顺变。: Cannot read save file. If this error persists after restarting, it may mean this save game is corrupted. Sorry about that.
text.新闻仅能由开发者以英文撰写。: News posts are written by the developer and are only available in English.
text.当连接到一个流量计费的网络，比如移动数据时，您无法浏览新闻。: Couldn't check for news posts, as you're connected to a metered network, such as mobile data.
text.无法查看新闻，请确认您已连接到互联网。: Couldn't check for news posts, make sure you're connected to the internet.
text.您已禁用新闻功能，所以这里什么也不会显示。: You have disabled checking for news posts, so none will appear here.
text.目前为止还没有已经结束的游戏。: No games have been played yet.
text.我不希望破碎的像素地牢沾染任何广告或侵入性微交易要素。那些东西毁了不知多少免费游: I want Shattered Pixel Dungeon to be free of ads and invasive microtransactions, which ruin so many free games. Instead, I'd rather ask players to support the game directly!
text.如果您喜欢玩破碎的像素地牢并且想要帮助我持续地开发它，请考虑考虑在_Patreo:
If you enjoy Shattered and want to help me keep making it, please consider supporting me on _Patreon!_ The Patreon has a bunch of exclusive benefits!:
_- Early Access_ to betas of future updates.
_- Weekly Mini-Blogs_ with info about what I'm working on.
_- Monthly Polls_ which directly affect content I'm developing.
_- Physical Reward Pins_ after 1, 2, and 3 years of patronage.
_- A Community Discord_ with a dev log and chat channels.

_And More!_ You can visit the Patreon page for more info. Thanks for your time, and happy dungeoneering!
text.(请注意：Patreon回报仅提供英文内容): (Note that Patreon rewards are only available in English.)
text.《破碎像素地牢》是一款完全免费的游戏，有玩家的大方捐献支持我才能一直坚持开发。\:
Shattered Pixel Dungeon is a completely free game, which means that I depend on support from generous players in order to keep making it.

If you're interested in supporting me, the best way to do so is through Patreon. Patreon gives me a consistent income source, and allows me to give something back to those who support me!

Patrons get exclusive blog posts every week which let them know about what I'm working on before anyone else!

You can take a look at my Patreon page for the most up to date information about benefits, Thank you for your consideration!

(Patreon rewards are only available in English)
text.破碎的像素地牢已经更新！: Shattered Pixel Dungeon has been updated!
text.4.0版本绝对是《破碎的像素地牢》有史以来最大的一次更新！这次更新包含一个大型委: v4.0 is arguably Shattered's biggest update yet! There's a massive new quest, a bunch of new in-game art, 6 new enchantments, and plenty smaller changes and adjustments.
text.破碎的像素地牢补丁已经成功安装！: Shattered Pixel Dungeon has been patched!
text.本次更新包含游戏平衡性改动。: This patch contains tweaks to game balance.
text.本次补丁同样包含少量微调和性能优化。: This patch also contains some small tweaks and performance improvements.
text.看起来你正使用的存档来自于新版本的破碎地牢！\n\n谨慎行事！你的存档可能包含一:
It seems that your current saves are from a future version of Shattered Pixel Dungeon!

Tread with caution! Your saves may contain things which don't exist in this version, this could cause some very weird errors to occur.
text.本次更新内容还未被完全翻译。\n\n部分词汇可能还是英语。\n\n翻译组正全力解:
Some of the new content from this update has not yet been translated.

Some phrases may be written in English.

The translation teams are working to resolve this and a full translation should be patched in soon.

Thank you for your patience.
text.最近，破碎的像素地牢在进行存档时被打断了。\n\n本游戏内置有保护机制，所以你的:
Shattered Pixel Dungeon was interrupted while trying to save your game data recently. Shattered has built-in protections against this, so your game data should be fine.

This usually happens when your device suddenly loses power, or if it terminates Shattered without letting it close properly. Battery saver features can often cause this on mobile devices. Restarting your device may also help if you are seeing this error frequently.
text.正在使用手柄进行游玩吗？使用右摇杆来操纵屏幕上的光标。\n\n按下RT/R2键或:
Playing on a controller? Use the right stick to control an on-screen cursor.

Press RT/R2 or the right stick to select with the cursor.
text.你确定要跳入深渊中？从这么高的地方摔下去一定很疼。: Do you really want to jump into the chasm? A fall that far will be painful.
text.一尊看着像鼠王的雕像。是谁建造的呢？: A statue in the likeness of Rat King. Who made this?
text.这个蓬松的紫色枕头作为你的床有点太小了，但对普天之下最尊贵的老鼠而言这正是完美的: This puffy purple pillow would be too small of a bed for you, but it's the perfect size for the world's most important rat.
text.这里竖立着一面似乎由魔法生成的亮绿色致密火墙。这面火墙足够致密以至于你无法通过，: A wall of dense bright green fire is here, seemingly caused by magic. It's so dense that you can't move through it, and it ignites anything that gets too close. It shows no signs of burning down naturally, you'll need to use something to extinguish it.
text.这红似鲜血的哨卫结晶像是被刻意安置在此，守卫着房间另一端的宝藏。如果你进入警戒区:
This blood-red sentry seems to be positioned here to guard the treasure at the other end of this room. It will fire beams of disintegration magic at you if you step in the area it defends.

It's immune to all harmful effects and can see through invisibility, but seems to take a while to charge up before it starts firing.

Somehow the sentry only wants to fire on you, as if it knows that the denizens of the dungeon are no threat to the treasure.
text.一定是一个莽撞的冒险家在很久以前触发了这个陷阱。尽管处于不活跃状态，它仍在向房间: A careless adventurer must have triggered this trap ages ago. Despite its inactive state, it's still spewing toxic gas into the room and shows no signs of stopping. You'll need some way to prevent damage from the gas if you want to explore this room.
text.你隐约可以看到深处有一口井，也许这下面有些什么？: You can just make out a well in the depths below, perhaps there is something down there?
text.这个不祥的巨坑似乎通向某个远古的矮人宝库。魔法屏障封印了入口，而你可以在其上行走: This ominous pit seems to be the entrance to some ancient dwarven vault. A magical barrier prevents entry, you can walk over top of it as if there was floor here.
text.这架梯子通往铁匠铺下方的一座旧矿井。: This ladder leads to an old mine just below the blacksmith's workshop.
text.一间由巨魔铁匠搭建的小铁匠铺，配有煤盘，熔炉和一个光是看着都脏的水盆。: A little smithy set up by the troll blacksmith, complete with a coal tray, a forge, and a water basin that looks absolutely filthy.
text.为某种黑暗仪式而画下的标记。蜡烛通常摆在四个角上。: A painted marker for some dark ritual. Candles are usually placed on the four corners.
text.这张沉重的桌子像是被粗暴地改造成了某种拷问刑架。: This heavy table looks like it was crudely modified into a sort of torture rack.
text.遍地都是尸骨，这里到底发生过什么？: Bones litter the floor, what happened here?
text.这架梯子通向矿井外，连通到铁匠铺。: This ladder leads out of the mine, back into the blacksmith's workshop.
text.这个平台和你上方的洞口一样大，或许是在之前用于正常出入宝库的某种升降装置。: This large platform is same size as the pit above you. Probably this platform is involved in some kind of elevator mechanism when the vault is accessed normally.
text.当你踏进大房间时，时间的流逝似乎放缓了些，与此同时你听见了小恶魔的声音：\n\n:
As you step into the large room, time seems to slow and you hear the Imp's voice:

"I think you've entered the ultimate chamber of the vault, my statuette should be just beyond! I'm sure there's going to some sort of nasty trap or guardian though, so _you really should explore and prepare before going any further!_ I want you to actually get my prize, not die trying!"

As you step into the large room, time seems to slow and you hear the Imp's voice:

"Alright, I think you're in the ultimate chamber of the vault, my statuette should be just beyond! I'm sure there's going to some sort of nasty trap or guardian though, so _make sure you're all powered up and ready for a big fight!_ I want you to actually get my prize, not die trying."
text.你听到了法阵正在为某物蓄能的声音，只要再往前一步就肯定会触发些什么！: You hear something charging up, one more step forward is going to trigger something!
text.地板上的魔法回路与监狱里的召唤法阵不无相似，但此处的法阵要宏伟得多。\n\n整个:
This pattern in the floor tiles looks like a gigantic version of a summoning marker from the prison.

The whole floor hums with energy, as if there's some great power just waiting to be unleashed.
text.这里堆满了金币，可惜你不能把它们带出宝库。: Gold is piled on the floor here, it's a shame you can't take it back out of the vault with you.
text.陷阱产生的尖锐的警报声在地牢里回荡！: The trap emits a piercing sound that echoes throughout the dungeon!
text.这个陷阱看起来有着能造成很大响动的机制。触发它将使本层所有生物对这里产生警觉。: This trap seems to be tied to a loud alarm mechanism. Triggering it will likely alert everything on the level.
text.踩进这个陷阱会点燃某种极具力量的化学混合物，导致很大一块区域起火。: Stepping on this trap will ignite a powerful chemical mixture, setting a wide area ablaze.
text.踩进这个陷阱会点燃某种化学混合物，导致附近一块区域起火。: Stepping on this trap will ignite a chemical mixture, setting the surrounding area aflame.
text.被触发时，这个陷阱里的化学药剂会迅速冻结附近的空气。: When activated, chemicals in this trap will rapidly freeze the air around its location.
text.触发这个陷阱将在附近释放出一片致眩气体。: Triggering this trap will set a cloud of confusion gas loose within the immediate area.
text.这个陷阱充满了诅咒的力量。触发它会诅咒你身上的部分装备。: This trap contains the same malevolent magic found in cursed equipment. Triggering it will curse some items in the immediate area.
text.这个陷阱包含着非常有针对性的传送魔法，它会将触发陷阱的受害者的武器传送到其他位置: This trap contains very specific teleportation magic, which will warp the weapon of its victim to some other location.
text.陷阱解离了你一部分的%s！: The trap disintegrates some of your %s!
You were killed by the disintegration trap...
text.被触发时，这个陷阱将会用解离射线袭击离它最近的目标，造成显著伤害的同时破坏物品。:
When triggered, this trap will lance the nearest target with beams of disintegration, dealing significant damage and destroying items.

Thankfully the trigger mechanism isn't hidden.
text.这种陷阱由来源不明的奇特魔法制作，触发后会召唤各式各样的怪物到这里。: Built from strange magic of unknown origin, this trap will summon all manner of creatures to this location.
text.这个陷阱包含一些粉状炸药和一个触发机制。激活它会导致一定范围的爆炸。: This trap contains some powdered explosive and a trigger mechanism. Activating it will cause an explosion in the immediate area.
text.被触发时，这个陷阱将点燃储存在里面的强效闪光粉，使受害者暂时失明，残废，并受到伤:
On activation, this trap will ignite a potent flashing powder stored within, temporarily blinding, crippling, and injuring its victim.

The trap must have a large store of powder, as it can activate many times without breaking.
text.也许是个来自一些业余法师的玩笑，触发这个陷阱就会创造一群魔法绵羊。: Perhaps a joke from some amateur mage, triggering this trap will create a flock of magical sheep.
text.被触发时，这个陷阱里的化学药剂会迅速冻结附近大范围的空气。: When activated, chemicals in this trap will rapidly freeze the air in a wide range around its location.
text.这种特殊的传送陷阱可以被反复激活并且总是通向同样的目的地。: This special teleportation trap can activate an infinite numbers of times and always teleports to the same location.
text.被触发时，大量的水会从中喷涌而出，对火属性敌人造成伤害，击退周围所有角色，熄灭火: When triggered, this trap will cause a geyser of water to spew forth, damaging fiery enemies, knocking away all nearby characters, dousing fires, and converting the surrounding terrain to water.
text.这个落石陷阱在制作过程中注入了土石术法。触发时，该陷阱会导致在其周围5x5区域内:
This rockfall trap is made with some form of magical assistance. When triggered, it will cause rocks to loosen and immediately fall from above in a 5x5 area around it. Due to the softer rocks in the area, it won't deal as much damage as a regular rockfall trap, but your armor also won't be effective against it. Rocks also won't fall in locations with an adjacent barricade, as they help hold the ceiling up.

_This trap can't tell friend from foe, and so is just as harmful to the gnolls as it is to you._
You were killed by the blast of a grim trap...
text.非常强大的破坏魔法储存在这个陷阱里，足以瞬间杀死除了状态最佳的英雄外的所有生物。:
Extremely powerful destructive magic is stored within this trap, enough to instantly kill all but the healthiest of heroes. Triggering it will send a ranged blast of lethal magic towards the nearest character.

Thankfully the trigger mechanism isn't hidden.
text.触发这个陷阱将使一对钳子合上，伤害受害者并将他们固定在这里。\n\n由于其简单的:
This trap latches onto the feet of whoever trigger it, damaging them and slowing their movement.

Due to its simple nature, this trap can activate many times without breaking.
text.这个陷阱有着奇怪的魔法机制，它将召唤守卫并向将使本层所有生物对这里产生警觉。: This trap is tied to a strange magical mechanism, which will summon guardians and alert all enemies on the floor.
text.这个蓝色的幻影似乎是地牢中石像守卫的一个召唤映像。: This blue apparition seems to be a summoned echo of one of the dungeon's stone guardians.
text.虽然雕像本身是几乎无形的，但它装备着的_%s_看起来是真家伙。: While the statue itself is almost incorporeal, the _%s_ it's wielding looks real.
text.你可通过某个陷阱遇到该敌人。: You can find this enemy with a specific trap.
text.这个陷阱将会洒出腐蚀性的淤泥，它将烧灼你的皮肤直到被洗掉。: This trap will splash out caustic ooze when activated, which will burn until it is washed away.
text.陷阱附近的地板在迅速崩塌！: The ground starts to give way around the triggered trap!
text.这里的地面太结实了，塌方陷阱在这里无效。: the ground is too solid for a pitfall trap to work here.
text.这种陷阱与一种大型活板门装置相连，在激活后会使周围的地板迅速崩塌！不过这类陷阱在: This trap is connected to a large trapdoor mechanism, and shortly after it is triggered anything near it will slip right through the ground and fall! It won't work in areas with especially solid floors though.
You were killed by the poison dart trap...
text.附近一定藏着一个小型飞镖发射器，激活这个陷阱会导致它向最近的目标射出一个毒镖。\:
A small dart-blower must be hidden nearby, activating this trap will cause it to shoot a poisoned dart at the nearest target.

Thankfully the trigger mechanism isn't hidden.
You were crushed by the rockfall trap...
text.这个陷阱和头顶上一片松散的岩石相连，触发它会导致石块崩塌砸向整个房间！如果这种陷:
This trap is connected to a series of loose rocks above, triggering it will cause them to come crashing down over the entire room! If the trap isn't in a specific room, rocks will fall in an area around the trap instead.

Thankfully the trigger mechanism isn't hidden.
text.一种储存着大量电能的机关。触发这个陷阱会让它把能量释放出来在附近形成小范围的电能: A mechanism with a large amount of energy stored into it. Triggering this trap will discharge that energy into a field around it.
text.一种储存着庞大电能的机关。触发这个陷阱会让它把能量释放出来形成大范围的雷电风暴。: A mechanism with a massive amount of energy stored into it. Triggering this trap will discharge that energy into a large electrical storm.
text.触发这个陷阱将召唤本区域的一些怪物到这里。: Triggering this trap will summon a number of this area's monsters to this location.
text.当这种陷阱被触发时，其周遭的所有东西都会被各自传送到本层的随机地点。: Whenever this trap is triggered, everything around it will be teleported to random locations on this floor.
text.显然，天狗做了充分的战斗准备。这个陷阱会激活一个隐藏的飞镖发射器，向距离最近且不:
Tengu has clearly been preparing for a fight. This trap will activate a hidden dart blower which will shoot a poison dart at the nearest thing that isn't Tengu.

The trap is so well made that the trigger mechanism is impossible to detect without magical aid. However the trap is visible for a moment when it is being set.
text.触发这个陷阱将放出一片有毒气体到这附近。: Triggering this trap will set a cloud of toxic gas loose within the surrounding area.
text.你可在地牢中概率找到该陷阱，每个区域中都会生成不同的陷阱。: You can find this trap randomly in the dungeon. Each region has different traps that may appear.
text.触发这个陷阱将在附近释放出一片致命的强酸性雾气。: Triggering this trap will set a cloud of deadly acidic gas loose within the immediate area.
text.这种陷阱和传送陷阱颇为相似，不过它还会导致英雄忘却本层的地图与各种东西的方位！: This trap is similar to a teleportation trap, but will also cause the hero to lose their knowledge of the floor's layout!
text.陷阱中的黑暗魔法能够吸取任何接触物里的能量，不过强大的敌人能抵抗这种效果。: Dark magic in this trap sucks the energy out of anything that comes into contact with it. Powerful enemies may resist the effect, however.
You were killed by the worn dart trap...
text.附近一定藏着一个小型飞镖发射器，激活这个陷阱会导致它向最近的目标射出一个飞镖。\:
A small dart-blower must be hidden nearby, activating this trap will cause it to shoot at the nearest target.

Due to its age it's not very harmful though, it isn't even hidden...
text.被挖掘的地面上露出粗大的导线，这些导线连接着周围的电力装置。\n\n导线中一定有:
The ground is partially dug up here, showing some large exposed wires. They must be connecting the various electrical machines together.

The wires must have some current running through them. If DM-300 steps here it may be able to draw power from them.
text.这里的地面闪烁着电火花，直接踩上去会触电。_电火花似乎都在朝向某个位置..._也: The ground here is sparking with electricity, and is harmful to step on. _The sparks seem to be gravitating in a certain direction..._ perhaps they lead to the power source?
text.一面高大的金属城门挡住了通往矮人都城的道路。门中间的金属盒嗡嗡作响，想必是与附近: A large metal gate that blocks the path into the dwarven metropolis. The metal box in the center is producing a loud humming noise, it must be connected to the circuitry and machines nearby. Perhaps destroying DM-300 will open the gate?
text.这扇大门一定是以某种形式与DM-300相连，因为在DM-300损坏时它也随之爆炸: The gate must have been connected to DM-300 in some way, as it exploded when DM-300 was defeated. Now only broken pieces remain.
With all the electricity around here water might not always be safe...
text.这座醒目的高大王座曾是矮人国王的席位，但现在它已属于一位沉湎于力量的死灵法师。\:
This impressively large throne is the seat of the dwarven empire, now taken over by a power-mad necromancer.

There seems to be some magical or mechanical parts to the throne, Dwarf King may have additional power when sitting on it.
text.唤灵基座的中央有一个巨大的开口，时不时涌出一些黑暗能量。\n\n矮人国王利用这些:
This pedestal has a large opening in the center, which is practically radiating with dark energy.

Dwarf King uses these pedestals as focal points for his necromantic magic, and can summon minions to them. The pedestal must charge for a few turns before the minion appears, and the type of minion being summoned is telegraphed by the building magical power.
text.通向上一层的梯子。: The ladder leads up to the upper depth.
text.通向下一层的梯子。: The ladder leads down to the lower depth.
text.岩壁上能隐约看见金属矿脉的纹路，难道是黄金？: A vein of some ore is visible on the wall. Gold?
text.到底会有谁需要在洞窟里摆上这么个书架？: Who would need a bookshelf in a cave?
text.一个大型全金属架构，可能是过去的矮人们在采矿时建造的。架构上层似乎有废弃了许久的: A large all-metal structure, probably built by the dwarves when they used to mine this place. You think you can see long-unused minecart tracks running along the top.
text.通向上一层的斜坡。: A ramp leads up to the upper depth.
text.通向下一层的斜坡。: A ramp leads down to the lower depth.
text.这尊雕像刻画出了一位摆出英勇姿态的矮人。: The statue depicts some dwarf standing in a heroic stance.
text.不同学科的书排满了书架。: The rows of books on different disciplines fill the bookshelf.
text.一个在其上燃有明亮的绿色魔法火焰的凸起基座。火焰是如此致密，好似固化了一般。: A raised pedestal with a bright green magical flame atop. The flame is so dense it might as well be solid.
text.看起来如同岩浆一般，不过没有感受到热度，应该可以碰触。: It looks like lava, but it's cold and probably safe to touch.
text.这个柱子由货真价实的人形生物头骨垒成。酷毙了。: The pillar is made of real humanoid skulls. Awesome.
text.用远古语言写就的书籍堆积在书架里。: Books in ancient languages smoulder in the bookshelf.
text.一块巨石，似乎是从天花板或附近的墙壁上掉下来的。: A huge piece of stone that seems to have broken off from the ceiling or a nearby wall.
text.进入水潭中可熄灭身上的火焰。: In case of burning step into the water to extinguish the fire.
text.通向上一层的楼梯。: Stairs lead up to the upper depth.
text.通向下一层的楼梯。: Stairs lead down to the lower depth.
text.这扇门锁着，而你需要匹配的钥匙才能打开它。: This door is locked, you need a matching key to unlock it.
text.这扇锁着的门由魔力水晶铸造而成。你的视线可以穿过它，但你的身体不能，还是找找对应: This locked door is made of magical crystal. You can see through, but you'll need a crystal key to open it.
text.沉重的铁栏杆封锁住了通往下一层的楼梯。: Heavy bars block the stairs leading down.
text.木栅栏依然坚固，但早已风干多年。或许可以点燃烧掉？: The wooden barricade is firmly set but has dried over the years. Might it burn?
text.这个陷阱已经被触发过了，现在一点也不危险。: The trap has been triggered before and it's not dangerous anymore.
Someone wanted to adorn this place, but failed, obviously.
text.这口炼金釜中充满了魔力之水。物品可以在里面共炼以制造新的物品。: This pot is filled with magical water. Items can be mixed into the pot to create something new!
text.你的脚步声在地牢中回荡不绝。: Your steps echo across the dungeon.
text.你听到周围水花四处飞溅的声音。: You hear water splashing around you.
text.浓郁的草木气息弥漫在空气中。: The smell of vegetation is thick in the air.
text.你能听到敌人在暗中潜伏的声音。: You can hear enemies moving in the darkness.
text.这层地牢的规模似乎不同寻常的广阔。: This dungeon floor seems unusually large.
text.这层地牢的地面陷阱密布，暗藏杀机。: The ground seems especially treacherous here.
text.这层地牢的气氛暗示着潜藏其中的秘密。: The atmosphere hints that this floor hides many secrets.
text.不算太硬的平整岩壁。你可以用镐子挖过去，只是这样做很费力，会使你饿得更快。: A smooth rock wall that's a little softer than usual. You can mine through it with your pickaxe, but it'll take some effort and increase your hunger a bit.
text.你也许能用镐子把它挖出来。: You can probably mine it out with your pickaxe.
text.这里冒出了一个硕大的彩色水晶。这种水晶很脆弱，可以使用镐子轻易地破坏掉。挖掘其临: There is a large and colorful crystal outcropping here. These crystals are fragile and can easily be broken with a pickaxe, or will break if something is mined next to it.
text.这里有一块巨大的岩砾阻挡了去路。用镐子应当可以轻易地破坏掉它。: There is a large boulder blocking the way. It should be fairly easy to break with a pickaxe.
text.此处的木栅栏稳当地嵌入了矿层中，充当着矿层顶部的支撑。\n\n这些设施大概是豺狼:
The wooden barricade is firmly set and acts as a support for the ceiling.

This was probably constructed by the gnolls to give some protection against falling rocks. _Any adjacent cells will be protected from rockfall traps and attacks._

It looks like it would burn just as well as any other barricade.
text.其上仍残留着干涸的血迹。: There are old blood stains on the floor.
text.这个书架可能是监狱图书馆的残留物。烧掉怎么样？: This is probably a vestige of a prison library. Might it burn?
text.恰好能装下一个人的金属牢笼。它似乎被某种方式锁在了地上，根本无法移动。: A metal cage just large enough to hold a person. It seems to be locked to the ground in some way, you can't move it.
text.恰好能容纳一个人的金属牢笼，以铁索悬吊于深渊之上。: A metal cage just large enough to hold a person. It's hanging over a deep chasm, suspended by a chain.
text.潮湿且发黄的苔藓覆盖其上。: Wet yellowish moss covers the floor.
text.这个书架塞满了没用的成功学书籍。烧掉怎么样？: The bookshelf is packed with cheap useless books. Might it burn?
text.一个几乎和你差不多大的木桶。里面肯定装满了什么东西，重得搬不动。: A stout barrel that's almost as big as you are. It must be full of something or another, it's too heavy to move.
text.此处的火井似乎会以固定的周期喷射绿色火焰。在烈焰燃起之前你可以看到火势的积聚。通: This vent seems to be sending up bursts of green flame at regular intervals. You can see the flames starting to build just before it fires. The flames can usually be avoided, but _anything that lets you resist fire or area-bound effects_ is also effective.
text.厚重的地毯铺在地面上。但显然经过特殊处理，它点不着。: Thick carpet covers the floor. It must be treated in some way, it isn't flammable.

text.在一局游戏中通过炼金术合成8个物品: Craft 8 items via alchemy in one game

text.在不被任何机关陷阱击中的情况下，击败监狱区域Boss: Defeat the prison boss without getting hit by any traps or hazards
text.在过载期间完全规避所有攻击和伤害来源的情况下，击败洞穴区域Boss: Defeat the caves boss without getting attacked or damaged while it is supercharged
text.在不使用武器、戒指、法杖或攻击性法术进行对其直接攻击的情况下，击败都城区域Bos: Defeat the city boss without ever directly attacking him with weapons, rings, wands, or damaging spells
text.在开启“绝命头目”挑战、且所有恶魔血巢存活的情况下击败最终Boss: Defeat the final boss with all demon spawners alive and the badder bosses challenge enabled

text.在结束游戏时达到25,000分或更高: End a run with a score of 25,000 or higher

text.在结束游戏时达到250,000分或更高: End a run with a score of 250,000 or higher
text.在结束游戏时达到1,000,000分或更高: End a run with a score of 1,000,000 or higher

text.使用一张升级卷轴以解锁法师: Unlock the Mage by using a scroll of upgrade
text.在一场游戏中进行十次伏击以解锁盗贼: Unlock the Rogue by performing 10 surprise attacks in one game
text.在一场游戏中使用投掷武器命中十次敌人以解锁女猎手: Unlock the Huntress by hitting enemies with thrown weapons 10 times in one game
text.不受力量惩罚地装备一个2阶或更高阶的武器以解锁决斗家: Unlock the Duelist by equipping a tier 2 or higher weapon with no strength penalty
text.完全净化任何一件被诅咒装备的诅咒以解锁牧师: Unlock the Cleric by fully cleansing the curse on any piece of cursed equipment
text.在一局游戏中通过特殊地形(陷阱、植物或深渊)击败10个敌人: Defeat 10 enemies in one game with the help of terrain hazards (traps, plants, or chasms)
text.同时获有至少10种增益/减益图标: Have 10 or more buff/debuff icons active at once
text.将其诅咒未曾减弱的Yendor护符带出地牢: Take the Amulet of Yendor to the surface without ever reducing the severity of its curse
text.以一把至少20级的镐子对最终boss打出致命一击: Strike the killing blow on the final boss with a +20 or higher pickaxe
text.在英雄、天赋、专精与护甲技能均为随机的条件下获得Yendor护符: Obtain the Amulet of Yendor with a randomized hero, talent upgrades, subclass, and armor ability
text.食物本就稀缺，但你还需要注意节食！\n\n-使用各类食物与丰饶之角的饱腹效果为原:
Food's already scarce, but you have to watch your portions as well!

- Food and the horn of plenty are one third as effective at satisfying hunger
- Other sources of satiety are unaffected
text.如今护甲已难堪大用，你只能相信你自己的肉身了！\n\n-布甲之外所有护甲的基本防:
You'll need faith in yourself, as your armor won't do much!

- Base blocking power reduced for all armor except cloth
- All armor now gains very little blocking when upgraded
- Earthen guardian's defensive power is also significantly reduced
text.治疗药剂真是种好东西，可惜你对它过敏！\n\n-治疗药剂、以治疗药剂为原料炼制的:
Healing potions sure are handy, unfortunately you're allergic!

- Potions of healing, items that use potions of healing in their recipe, and sunfruit will poison the hero instead of healing them
- Unstable brews cannot randomly poison or heal the hero
- These items still work normally for other characters.
text.这个晦气的地牢里连干净的水都没有了...\n\n-移除露珠\n-移除所有特殊植物:
There seems to be no clean water left in this accursed dungeon...

- Dew drops are removed
- Plants are removed
- Seeds still appear, but will not take root
text.要小心了，地牢里的怪物们也在学习进步！\n\n-每当有敌人发现你或你的盟友时，它:
Watch out, the dungeon monsters are getting smarter!

- While enemies see your or your allies, they will attract other nearby enemies to your position.
- The range for this starts out at just 2 tiles, but grows by 2 for every turn the enemy sees you, up to 12.
- Breaking vision resets the attracting range, even briefly such as with a door.
text.地牢毕竟是在地下嘛！\n\n-正常视野范围显著缩小\n-每层都会出现一根火把\n:
It is a dungeon after all!

- Regular visible distance dramatically reduced
- A torch appears on each floor
- Other light sources are 1/5 as effective
text.一种卷轴会变得更稀有。不幸的是，正好还是最有用的那一种。\n\n-移除地牢中半数:
A certain rune is harder to find. Unfortunately, it's always the most useful one.

- Half of the dungeon's upgrade scrolls are removed
text.道高一尺，魔高一丈！\n\n普通敌人生成时会有概率获得特殊的精英强敌效果，概率会:
You're not the only one who can level up!

Regular enemies have a 1/8 chance to spawn with a special champion buff on floor 1, scaling up to 1/6 on floor 21.

- Champions wake up if they spawn asleep
- The hero knows when a champion spawns
- Champions cannot be turned into allies

There are six types of champion enemy:
_Blazing (orange):_ +25% melee damage, ignites on hit, spreads flames on death, can't ignite water tiles
_Projecting (purple):_ +25% melee damage, +3 melee range
_Antimagic (green):_ -50% damage taken, immune to magical effects
_Giant (blue):_ -80% damage taken, +1 melee range, cannot move into tunnels
_Blessed (yellow):_ 4x accuracy and evasion
_Growing (red):_ +20% accuracy, evasion, damage, and effective HP. Increases by 1% every 4 turns.
text.这项挑战会让所有Boss都更具挑战性！\n\n_粘咕：_生命值+20%\n_-_:
Bosses are much tougher with this challenge!

_Goo:_ +20% health
_-_ Healing in water ramps up, to 3/turn
_-_ Pumps up in 1 turn instead of 2
_Tengu:_ +25% health
_-_ Phase 1: traps are much deadlier
_-_ Phase 2: abilities are more frequent
_DM-300:_ +33% health
_-_ Pylons are tougher and 3 activate
_-_ Abilities are more powerful and frequent
_-_ DM-300 is faster when supercharged
_-_ Exposed wires are twice as common
_Dwarf King:_ +50% health
_-_ Minions are stronger in all phases
_-_ Phase 1: faster abilities and summons
_-_ Phase 2: 2 more minions per round
_-_ Phase 3: 2x health, faster summons
_Yog-Dzewa:_
_-_ Two fists are summoned at a time!
_-_ +60% laser damage
_-_ Stronger minions
text.这张卷轴可以升级一件物品或一组投掷武器。法杖可获得更高的效能与更多的充能，武器、: This scroll can upgrade an item or a set of thrown weapons. Wands gain greater power and more charges; weapons, thrown weapons and armor gain stronger offensive or defensive properties; and rings become more effective.
text.阅读时释放可怖的红光，使视野内的对手将当前装备的武器掉落在其脚下。掉落的武器可被: Reading releases a terrifying red flash, forcing opponents in your field of view to drop their currently equipped weapon at their feet. Dropped weapons can be picked up again; unarmed opponents are unaffected.
text.羊皮纸上的咒语能立刻让阅读者传送到本层的另一处。: The spell on this parchment instantly teleports the reader to another location on the current floor.
text.阅读后，对视野内目标施加致盲和麻痹。两种效果的基础持续时间均为_10回合 × 已: Reading applies blindness and paralysis to targets in your field of view. The base duration of both effects is _10 turns × missing-health fraction_, where the missing-health fraction is (maximum HP − current HP) ÷ maximum HP.
text.卷轴上的咒文会创造使用者的两个镜像。这些像使用者的弱化版克隆体的镜像会对敌人展开: The incantation on this scroll creates two mirror images of the user. These weaker clones pursue enemies, but are extremely fragile and vanish instantly upon taking damage. The images keep their equipped weapon synchronized with the user's.
text.阅读这张卷轴会释放出一段舒缓的旋律，让所有听到它的生物深陷魔法睡眠。进入魔法睡眠: Reading this scroll releases a soothing melody that sends all creatures who hear it into magical sleep. While in magical sleep, players and allied creatures recover an additional 1 HP each turn.

text.从法杖中发出的魔法飞弹会对单个目标造成_%d点伤害_，如果被升级则会暂时强化其他: This wand fires a bolt of magical energy, dealing _%d damage_ to a single target. Upgrading it allows it to temporarily empower other wands.
text.这根法杖能向任何瞄准的地方射出强大的电弧，造成_%d点伤害_。这道闪电能在附近多: This wand shoots a powerful arc of electricity, dealing _%d damage_. Lightning jumps between nearby targets and is stronger in water. Standing too close may shock you, but your allies are protected.
text.这根法杖射出的光束能穿透任何障碍物，并将随着法杖等级的提升而射得更远。光束会造成: This wand fires a beam that pierces any obstacle and reaches farther with upgrades. It deals _%d damage_, with additional damage based on the terrain and enemies pierced.
text.这根法杖能向你的敌人射击冰霜能量，造成_%d点伤害_并冻伤目标，在水中的作用似乎: This wand fires icy energy, dealing _%d damage_ and chilling the target, more strongly in water. Chilled targets take reduced damage; frozen targets take no damage from this frost blast.
text.这根法杖能射出一股能量，在目标位置引发强烈的爆炸。爆炸造成_%d点伤害_，并能击: This wand causes a powerful explosion at the target location, dealing _%d damage_ and knocking back most creatures.
text.这根法杖射出的光线能刺破地牢的黑暗，揭露隐藏的区域和陷阱。光线能致盲敌人并造成_: This wand reveals hidden areas and traps with brilliant light. Its beam can blind enemies and deals _%d damage_. Demonic and undead creatures take additional damage.
text.这根法杖在使用时会产生一股强大的焰浪，延伸出一个锥形区域。下一次使用将消耗_%d: This wand projects a cone of flame. The next cast uses _%d charges_ and deals _%d damage_. Spending more charges increases its range and power.
text.这根法杖对友军或已被魅惑的敌人释放时，会消耗你_%d点生命_并提供_%d点治疗_: Casting on allies or charmed enemies costs you _%d HP_ and provides _%d healing_, with excess healing becoming shielding. Casting on enemies grants you _%d shielding_ and briefly charms living enemies.
text.伏击时造成_50%额外伤害_。: Deals _50% extra damage_ on surprise attacks.
text.这是一件不太精准的武器。不能仅凭隐身触发伏击；若攻击者不在对手视野内，仍保证命中: This is a rather inaccurate weapon. Invisibility alone does not grant a surprise attack; attacks still always hit if the opponent cannot see the attacker.
text.水晶附魔：命中时追加水晶伤害。: Crystal enchantment: hits deal additional crystal damage.
text.魔晶附魔：命中时追加魔法伤害。武器在命中5次后碎裂，剩余_%d_次；未命中不消耗: Crystal enchantment: hits deal additional magic damage. This weapon shatters after 5 hits, with _%d_ uses remaining. Misses do not spend uses, and it does not repair itself.
text.魔晶附魔会造成额外魔法伤害。近战武器命中5次后碎裂，未命中不消耗，也不会自行修复: Crystal enchantment deals additional magic damage. Melee weapons shatter after 5 hits. Misses do not spend uses, and the weapon cannot repair itself. Thrown weapons have no additional crystal durability.
text.提升投掷武器的有效伤害等级。投掷物命中后消耗，不提供耐久加成。: Increases the effective damage level of projectiles. Projectiles are consumed on hit; this ring provides no durability bonus.
text.投掷后在落点立即爆炸，对范围内生物造成_固定15点基础伤害_，不受楼层和伤害随机: Explodes immediately at the landing tile, dealing _a fixed 15 base damage_ to creatures in range, without depth scaling or random base damage. Armor, shields and other defenses still apply. The blast still destroys flammable terrain and item heaps in its area.
text.法杖、投掷武器和近战武器现在使用固定数值，不再随机掷点。: Wands, thrown weapons and melee weapons now use fixed values instead of random rolls.
text.缩圈现在会保留至少2×2的地形。: The shrinking arena now preserves at least a 2×2 area of terrain.
text.加入自身回合盘显示，位于战斗界面左上角、玩家血条下方。: Added your own turn indicator in the upper left of the battle screen, below your health bar.
text.麻痹药剂不再对已经被麻痹的目标施加麻痹。: Paralytic gas potions no longer apply paralysis to targets that are already paralyzed.
text.缩圈警告：红色标记区域将在1回合后塌陷为深渊！: Arena warning: the red-marked area will collapse into the abyss in 1 turn!
text.地图边缘已塌陷，剩余安全区域为 %d×%d。: The arena edge has collapsed. The remaining safe area is %d×%d.
text.阅读后，仅对视野内目标施加致盲和麻痹，不造成伤害，也不再使使用者失明或虚弱。两种:
Reading only applies blindness and paralysis to targets in your field of view, without dealing damage or blinding or weakening the reader. The base duration of each effect is _10 turns × your missing-health fraction_, calculated as (maximum HP − current HP) ÷ maximum HP.

For example, at 50% HP both effects last 5 turns; at 10% HP they last 9 turns. At full HP no effects are applied. Target resistances and immunities still apply.

text.普通门在角色走上门格时自动打开，只消耗正常移动时间。角色离开后，门上有物品则保持: Ordinary doors open when a character steps onto their tile, costing only normal movement time. Items keep a door open after a character leaves. With no character or items remaining, it closes. Opening a door no longer takes a separate turn.
text.新增创建房间与加入房间。服务器生成随机6位房间号，可一键复制后发给朋友，凭号码进: Create or join a private room. The server provides a random 6-digit code you can copy and send to a friend to join your room. Random matchmaking remains available.
text.切到后台不再立即退出对战。连接断开后保留席位60秒，并自动尝试重连原对局；选装与: Moving the app to the background no longer immediately ends your match. After a disconnection, your seat is kept for 60 seconds while the client tries to reconnect. Selection and thinking timers keep running. Reconnecting is unavailable after closing the game process.
text.加入“水庭”“藏书室”与“裂隙”三张固定地图，每局随机选图，并随机采用破碎第1～: Added three fixed maps: Water Court, Library and Rift. Each match randomly selects a map and one of Shattered's five regional terrain themes. Rift features chasms, waterways and tall grass, with spawns at the upper left and lower right. Its equipment market excludes the Wand of Blast Wave.
text.地图总尺寸改为36×36，中心12×12用于实战。外围可点击并参与弹道计算，方便: The map now uses a 36×36 grid with a 12×12 arena in the center. You can target the outer area to adjust ballistic trajectories, but cannot move into it.
text.匹配成功后先展示本局地图5秒，再进入选装备与战斗。双方看到同一张地图和同一区域风: After matching, preview the arena for 5 seconds before equipment selection and battle. Both players see the same map and terrain theme.
text.双方初始生命与基础最大生命由50提高至70，装备带来的最大生命修正仍正常生效。: Both players' starting health and base maximum health increase from 50 to 70. Equipment can still modify maximum health.
text.开战时获得最大生命33%的临时护盾，向上取整，70生命时为24点。先手持续2回合: At battle start, gain a temporary shield equal to 33% of maximum health, rounded up: 24 at 70 health. It lasts 2 turns for the first player and 3 for the second. Damage consumes it first; any remaining protection expires at the end.
text.移除受伤时随机挣脱麻痹的机制。麻痹气体每次施加5回合麻痹。每次受到有效伤害，麻痹: Removed the random chance to break free of paralysis when hurt. Paralytic gas applies 5 turns of paralysis. Each instance of effective damage reduces remaining paralysis by 5 turns. When paralysis ends, gain 3 turns of resistance that grants immunity to paralysis.
text.治疗药剂现在提供20回合治疗Buff，每回合恢复2点生命。再次饮用刷新持续时间，: The potion now grants 20 turns of healing, restoring 2 health per turn. Drinking again refreshes its duration. Being hit or taking effective damage removes healing; dodging does not. Potion and buff descriptions are updated.
text.再生法杖不再召唤结露草与种子荚，从其生成列表中移除这两种植物。: The Wand of Regrowth no longer spawns Dewcatchers or Seedpods. Both plants have been removed from its generation pool.
text.脚下有特殊植物时，可点击自己或脚下格踩踏，消耗当前移动所需的回合时间。若有地面物: Tap yourself or your tile to trample a plant underfoot, spending your current movement time. Items on the ground are picked up first. You cannot trample while flying or rooted.
text.点击视野内的魔法绵羊一次即可令其消失，无需相邻，消耗1回合。羊毛与叫声保留，被驱: Tap a visible magic sheep once to dispel it, even from a distance, spending 1 turn. Its bleat and wool puff still play, and its tile immediately becomes passable.
text.对战中点击一次即可驱散这只魔法绵羊。: During battle, tap this magic sheep once to dispel it.

text.开局获得相当于最大生命33%的临时护盾（向上取整）。先手持续2回合，后手持续3回:
Start the battle with a temporary shield equal to 33% of maximum health, rounded up. It lasts 2 turns for the first player and 3 turns for the second, measured in game time, without natural decay. Damage consumes this shield first; any remaining shield is removed on expiry.

Shield remaining: %1$d
Turns remaining: %2$s
