text.饮用后获得20回合治疗效果，每回合恢复2点生命。受到攻击命中或有效伤害时，治疗效:
Grants healing for 20 turns, restoring 2 HP each turn. A landed attack or positive damage immediately ends the effect. Drinking again refreshes the duration without increasing the healing rate.

Also retains its cleansing effects, including removing poison.
text.每回合恢复2点生命，持续20回合。受到攻击命中或有效伤害时立即结束；再次饮用治疗:
Restores 2 HP each turn for 20 turns. Ends immediately on a landed attack or positive damage. Drinking another healing potion refreshes the duration.

Turns of healing remaining: %s.
text.麻痹使目标无法行动。每次受到有效伤害时，剩余麻痹时长减少5回合；零伤害不减少时长:
Paralysis prevents actions. Each instance of positive damage reduces the remaining paralysis by 5 turns. Zero damage does not reduce it.

When paralysis ends, gain immunity to paralysis for 3 turns.

Turns of paralysis remaining: %s.
text.免疫麻痹，无法被再次施加或延长麻痹效果。\n\n麻痹抗性剩余时长：%s回合:
Immune to paralysis. Paralysis cannot be applied or prolonged during this time.

Turns of paralysis immunity remaining: %s.

text.狂乱会使生物不分敌我地攻击。\n\nPvP 玩家仍由本人控制行动，召唤物沿用狂乱:
Amok makes creatures attack without distinguishing friend from foe.

PvP players retain control of their actions. Summoned creatures follow the original amok targeting rules.

Turns remaining: %s
text.恐惧使生物试图远离施术者。: Terror makes creatures try to flee the caster.
text.\n\n受伤会减少5回合的持续时间。PvP 玩家仍由本人控制行动，不会因离开视野:
Taking damage reduces the duration by 5 turns. PvP players retain control and are not removed from the match when they leave sight.

Turns remaining: %s
text.腐化改变生物的阵营，并持续损耗生命。\n\nPvP 玩家仍由本人控制行动，效果持:
Corruption changes a creature's allegiance and continually drains its health.

PvP players retain control of their actions. The effect lasts until death.
text.魔法免疫状态无法施法: You cannot cast while magic immune
text.诅咒随机施法需要宿主的 cursed_zap 接口；本演示使用正常法杖: Random cursed casting requires a cursed_zap host handler; this demo uses normal wands
text.饮用后获得20回合治疗效果，每回合恢复2点生命。受到攻击命中或有效伤害时，治疗效:
Drinking this potion grants a healing effect for 20 turns, restoring 2 HP each turn. The effect ends immediately when you are hit by an attack or take effective damage.

Drinking a potion of healing also removes some basic negative effects.
text.喝下这甜到掉牙的奇怪液体后，体内会爆发一股巨大的能量，让你10回合内移动速度增加: Drinking this strangely sweet liquid releases a surge of energy through your body, increasing your movement speed by 200% for 10 turns.
text.饮用这种药剂会使你隐形10回合。隐形期间，敌人将无法看见你。使用物理攻击或魔法效: Drinking this potion makes you invisible for 10 turns. Enemies cannot see you while you are invisible. Physical attacks or magical effects, such as using scrolls or wands, immediately end invisibility.
text.喝下这个，你的心智将与大范围内的生物精神同调，让你在10回合内能感受到围墙背后的: Drinking this potion attunes your mind to nearby creatures across a wide area, allowing you to sense their locations through walls for 10 turns. It also allows your vision to pass through nearby walls and doors.
text.这种魔法试剂能迅速中和掉大范围内的各种有害环境。饮用它将使你在20回合内暂时免疫: This magical reagent quickly neutralizes harmful environmental effects over a wide area. Drinking it grants immunity to these effects for 20 turns.
text.暴露于空气时，烧瓶里的液体会气化成一片令人失去知觉的黄色云雾。任何吸入气体的生物: When exposed to air, the liquid in this flask evaporates into a yellow cloud of incapacitating gas. Any creature that inhales it is immediately paralyzed for 5 turns, unable to act until some time after the gas disperses. Throw it at a distant group of enemies to engulf them in the cloud.
text.匹配凭证已失效，请重新匹配。: This matchmaking credential is no longer valid. Please start matching again.
text.每次命中：(L+1)/(L+2)。+0为50%，+1约66.67%，+2为75%: On each hit: (L+1)/(L+2). 50% at +0, about 66.67% at +1, and 75% at +2.
text.持续生效，无随机触发判定。: Always active; no random proc roll.
text.每次命中：1/4，即25%；目标须能流血。: On each hit: 1/4, or 25%. The target must be able to bleed.
text.每次命中均追加伤害，即100%。近战武器第5次命中完整结算后碎裂；未命中不计数。: Extra damage on every hit: 100%. Melee weapons shatter after the fifth hit fully resolves; misses do not count.
text.每次命中后：(50%+5%×L)×目标已损生命比例²。按本次普通伤害结算后的目标: After each hit: (50%+5%*L)*(target missing-HP fraction)^2. Uses the target's HP after the normal damage resolves; 12.5% at +0 against a half-health target.
text.每次命中：5%+25%×自身已损生命比例。自身半血时为17.5%，剩10%生命时: On each hit: 5%+25%*(your missing-HP fraction). 17.5% at half HP and 27.5% at 10% HP. The target must have a different alignment.
text.3格可通行路径内没有敌人时持续生效，无随机触发判定。: Active when no enemy is within a 3-tile passable path; no random proc roll.
text.每次受到物理命中均计算储伤，无随机触发判定。无奥术加成时储存比例为(L+1)/(: Defers part of each physical hit; no random proc roll. Without Arcana, the stored fraction is (L+1)/(L+6), rounded up.
text.每次受到物理命中：(L+1)/(L+6)。+0时约16.67%。: On each physical hit received: (L+1)/(L+6). About 16.67% at +0.
text.持续防护燃烧伤害，无随机触发判定。: Always protects against burning damage; no random proc roll.
text.每次受到物理命中均按原有闪避能力计算减伤，无随机触发判定。: Reduces each physical hit based on your original evasion; no random proc roll.
text.每次受到物理命中：1/4，即25%。: On each physical hit received: 1/4, or 25%.
text.每次受到物理命中：(L+1)/(L+5)。+0时为20%；攻击者须相邻。: On each physical hit received: (L+1)/(L+5). 20% at +0. The attacker must be adjacent.
text.踩入高草时必定生效，即100%；浮空时不触发。: Always activates when stepping into tall grass: 100%. Does not activate while levitating.
text.在水中移动时持续生效，无随机触发判定。: Active while moving in water; no random proc roll.
text.每次受到物理命中：(L+3)/(L+20)。+0时为15%。: On each physical hit received: (L+3)/(L+20). 15% at +0.
text.每次受到可防御的魔法伤害均计算减伤，无随机触发判定；减伤数值随机，可能为0。: Reduces each eligible magic-damage hit; no random proc roll. The reduction is random and may be zero.
text.每次受到物理命中：(L+2)/(L+12)。+0时约16.67%；攻击者须能流血: On each physical hit received: (L+2)/(L+12). About 16.67% at +0. The attacker must be able to bleed and have a different alignment.
text.L为装备有效等级。以上按无奥术之戒加成计算；随机触发概率受奥术之戒提升，最高10: L is the effective equipment level. Chances shown exclude Ring of Arcana bonuses; Arcana increases random proc chances, up to 100%.
text.重新附魔不会抽到当前效果；同档其他效果均分该档概率。: Re-enchanting excludes the current effect; the other effects in its rarity share that rarity's chance equally.
text.一旦暴露在空气里，这种化学混合物会立即冻结并缠绕落点周围3×3范围内非墙格上的目: Once exposed to air, this mixture immediately freezes and roots targets on non-solid cells in a 3x3 area around the impact. Freezes for _5 turns_ on land or _10 turns_ in water, and roots for _5 turns_.
text.饮用后获得_20回合体力充沛_，移动速度提升_50%_，不影响攻击或其他行动的耗: Drinking grants _20 turns of Stamina_, increasing movement speed by _50%_ without changing attack or other action times. Drinking again refreshes the duration without stacking movement speed.
text.饮用后获得_20点奥术护盾_，抵挡受到的伤害，并按原版规则随时间逐渐衰减。再次饮: Drinking grants _20 points of Barrier_ to absorb damage. The shield gradually decays over time as in the original game. Drinking again restores ordinary shielding to at least 20 points without stacking; larger existing shields are preserved.
text.投掷后释放一团持续扩散的浓雾，_遮挡双方视野_，投掷者也无法透过迷雾看见对手。迷: Throwing releases a spreading fog that _blocks both players' sight_, including the thrower's view of their opponent. Fog deals no damage and does not block movement or projectiles. It gradually dissipates over turns. Mind Vision can still sense characters through the fog.
text.投掷后释放持续扩散的雨云。降雨会将可淹没地形变成水潭，熄灭火焰并淹毁陷阱。对_火: Throwing releases spreading rain clouds. Rain floods suitable terrain into water, extinguishes fire and destroys traps. It deals _1 + floor(depth / 5)_ base damage per turn to _fiery targets_. Ordinary targets take no direct rain-cloud damage.
text.饮用后选择方向，喷出最远_6格、60度_的火锥，点燃目标并施加_5回合残废_。不: Drink and choose a direction to breathe a _60-degree cone up to 6 tiles_, igniting targets and crippling them for _5 turns_. It deals no immediate direct damage. Burning lasts _8 base turns_ and uses the normal burning damage rules. Flames open doors and ignite their path, avoiding nonflammable tiles beside the caster. Cancelling targeting consumes nothing; throwing only splashes.
text.选择喷吐火焰的方向: Choose a direction to breathe fire
text.请选择喷吐火焰的方向: Choose a direction to breathe fire
text.饮用后获得树肤，初始额外_固定抵挡8点物理攻击伤害_，与装备护甲共同生效。每过_: Drinking grants Barkskin that initially blocks a _fixed 8 extra physical attack damage_, stacking with equipped armor. Protection decreases by _1 point every 3 turns_ until it reaches zero. It does not block magic or damage over time. Drinking again refreshes protection to 8 without stacking.
text.饮用后立即清除可净化的负面状态，并获得_5回合净化保护_，期间免疫可净化的负面状: Drinking immediately removes cleansable negative buffs and grants _5 turns of Cleansing_, preventing those buffs during that time. Throwing grants the same effect to the character at the impact tile. It does not heal, remove equipment curses or clear environmental fields. Corruption and Lost Inventory retain their original exceptions.
text.树肤为你额外固定抵挡_%1$d点物理攻击伤害_，与装备护甲共同生效，不抵挡魔法或:
Barkskin blocks a _fixed %1$d extra physical attack damage_, stacking with equipped armor. It does not block magic or damage over time. Protection decreases by 1 point every 3 turns.

Turns until next decrease: %2$s.
text.监狱、公园、潜影巨蛇、地心、夹层、黑暗花园、船、间隙。: Prison, Park, Shadow Serpent, Earth Core, Interlayer, Dark Garden, Ship and Gap.
text.极速冰冻、精力回复、奥术护盾、暗夜迷雾、暴风骤雨、火龙吐息、大地护甲、全面净化。: Snap Freeze, Stamina, Shielding, Shrouding Fog, Storm Clouds, Dragon's Breath, Earthen Armor and Cleansing.
text.这组_%1$d阶_的投掷武器能造成_%2$d~%3$d点伤害_。: This set of _tier-%1$d_ thrown weapons deals _%2$d-%3$d damage_.
text.当把这颗符石掷向一个敌人时，被命中的敌人会陷入魔法睡眠。陷入魔法睡眠的敌人会永远:
When this stone is thrown at an enemy, it will put them into a deep magical sleep. Magically slept enemies will sleep forever until disturbed.

As in the original game, this only affects monsters and summoned creatures, not player heroes.
text.这颗符石能够侦测物品上的魔咒。对一件未鉴定物品使用此符石，可探测其是否附有诅咒，:
This runestone is able to detect magic affecting an item. Using this stone on an unidentified item will tell you if it is affected by a malevolent curse and whether it is affected by positive magic such as an enchantment or upgrades.

All items in PvP are already identified. Select equipment to inspect its magic; this does not modify the item.
text.这块符石含有的魔法就像一个弱化版的鉴定卷轴。和鉴定卷轴那种直接识别物品的魔法不一:
This runestone holds a weaker version of the magic found in scrolls of identification. Rather than directly identifying an item, it will work on your intuition, allowing you to attempt to identify the type of a potion, scroll, or ring by guessing.

All items in PvP are already identified. Using this stone retains its animation and effects without identification guesses. Each stone can be used twice.
text.把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。\n\n未成熟的腐莓丛结出的莓果尝起来更像:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

The berries of a young rotberry shrub taste like sweet, sweet death. Over a few years, this rotberry shrub will grow into another rot heart. When trampled, a young rotberry will produce a small puff of toxic gas.
text.把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。\n\n烈焰花被任何物品触碰到时，都会化为:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

When something touches a firebloom, it bursts into flames.
text.把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。\n\n被踩踏后，速行蓟会加速周围的时间流:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

When trampled, swiftthistle will briefly accelerate the flow of time around it, allowing the trampler to perform several actions instantly.
text.把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。\n\n阳春草因其汁液缓慢但显著的疗伤效果:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Sungrass is renowned for its sap's slow but effective healing properties.
text.把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。\n\n冰冠花在被接触到时会喷射出一团能冻:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Upon being touched, an icecap lets out a puff of freezing pollen. The freezing effect is much stronger if the environment is wet.
text.把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。\n\n引力似乎并不能正常地作用在风暴藤上:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Gravity affects the stormvine plant strangely, allowing its whispy blue tendrils to 'hang' on the air. Anything caught in the vine is affected by this, and becomes disoriented.
text.把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。\n\n断肠苔（实为花卉而非苔藓）是一种花:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

A sorrowmoss is a flower (not a moss) with razor-sharp petals, coated with a deadly venom.
text.把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。\n\n魔皇草的带刺花朵含有一种化学物质，:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

The mageroyal's prickly flowers contain a chemical which is known for its properties as a strong neutralizing agent. Anything that steps in this plant will be cleansed of many negative effects.
text.把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。\n\n碰到地缚根后，它的根系会在踩踏者周:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

When a creature touches an earthroot, its roots create a kind of immobile natural armor around it.
text.把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。\n\n星陨花较为罕见，据说其能够为任何接:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

A rare plant, starflower is said to grant holy power to whomever touches it.
text.把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。\n\n任何触碰到消逝草的生物都会被传送到:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Touching a fadeleaf will teleport any creature to a random place on the current level.
text.把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。\n\n在被碰到后，致盲草会瞬间枯萎并释放:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Upon being touched a blindweed perishes in a bright flash of light. The flash is strong enough to disorient for several seconds.
text.强大的黑暗魔法正在吞噬升级卷轴注入你装备的魔力！\n\n降级状态下的装备会被视作:
Powerful dark magic is sapping the strength that scrolls of upgrade have applied to your equipment!

While degraded, upgraded gear will be treated as if it is a lower level than it actually is. _Every upgrade after +3 becomes exponentially weaker than the last one._ The descriptions of your items will change to reflect their reduced power level.

Degradation does not affect wand charges, durability of thrown weapons, or artifacts.

Turns of degradation remaining: %s. Using a scroll of upgrade or remove curse will end degradation immediately.
text.你和周围的地形完全融为一体，使你不可能被看到。\n\n当你在隐形时敌人无法追踪或:
You are completely blended into the surrounding terrain, making you impossible to see.

While you are invisible enemies are unable to attack or follow you. Physical attacks and magical effects (such as scrolls and wands) will immediately cancel invisibility.

Turns of invisibility remaining: %s.

Invisibility does not prevent blind shots at your tile or area damage.
text.打开或摔碎药瓶会释放扩散的腐蚀酸雾，施加_伤害逐回合增长的腐蚀效果_。酸雾也会影: Uncorking or shattering the bottle releases spreading corrosive gas, applying _Corrosion whose damage increases each turn_. The gas also affects the thrower and ignores armor.
text.饮用后获得_10回合魔能透视_，能看穿_6格范围_内的墙壁与地形，洞察墙后的事物: Drinking grants _10 turns of Magical Sight_, revealing terrain and objects through walls within a _6-tile radius_, and removing and preventing blindness.
text.喝下这个，你的心智将与大范围内的生物精神同调，让你在5回合内能感受到围墙背后的生: Drinking this potion attunes your mind to nearby creatures across a wide area, allowing you to sense their locations through walls for 5 turns. It also allows your vision to pass through nearby walls and doors.
text.你能看穿6格范围内的墙壁和地形，洞察墙后的事物，并解除、免疫致盲。\n\n魔能透:
You can see terrain and objects through walls within a 6-tile radius, and are immune to blindness.

Turns of magical sight remaining: %s

text.捐献是用于服务器运行和游戏开发的自愿支付行为。\n\n正式版账号系统推出前，捐献:
Donations are voluntary payments to support server operation and game development.

Donations provide no benefits before the account system for the full release launches.

After the full release, donations may offer cosmetic rewards.
text.腐蚀酸雾合剂、魔能透视合剂。: Potion of Corrosive Gas and Potion of Magical Sight.

messages.items.armor.curses.antientropy.name: %s of anti-entropy
messages.items.armor.curses.antientropy.desc: The Anti-entropy curse works against the forces of the universe, pulling energy into the wearer and away from their surroundings. This briefly sets the wearer on fire, but freezes everything around them!
messages.items.armor.curses.bulk.name: %s of bulk
messages.items.armor.curses.bulk.desc: Armor of bulk looks larger and more imposing, but doesn't actually have enhanced defense. Even worse, the added size makes moving into doorways very difficult.
messages.items.armor.curses.corrosion.name: %s of corrosion
messages.items.armor.curses.corrosion.desc: Armor of corrosion is capable of bursting with corrosive fluid, coating everything in the area with sticky acidic ooze.
messages.items.armor.curses.displacement.name: %s of displacement
messages.items.armor.curses.displacement.desc: The curse of displacement attempts to move the wearer to safety when they are attacked. It is a bit too effective however, randomly teleporting the user around the level.
messages.items.armor.curses.metabolism.name: %s of metabolism
messages.items.armor.curses.metabolism.desc: The metabolism curse directly converts satiety into health when the wearer is injured, providing a boost of healing, but quickly causing starvation.
messages.items.armor.curses.multiplicity.name: %s of multiplicity
messages.items.armor.curses.multiplicity.desc: Armor cursed with multiplicity contains dangerous duplication magic. It will sometimes create a mirror image of the wearer, but is equally likely to duplicate the attacker!
messages.items.armor.curses.overgrowth.name: %s of overgrowth
messages.items.armor.curses.overgrowth.desc: Armor of overgrowth is covered in various blooming plants. While this effect certainly looks interesting, it does nothing for defense, and these plants will randomly activate in combat!
messages.items.armor.curses.stench.name: %s of stench
messages.items.armor.curses.stench.desc: Armor cursed with stench will release clouds of noxious gas, which is hazardous to everything caught in the cloud.
messages.items.armor.glyphs.affection.name: %s of affection
messages.items.armor.glyphs.affection.desc: This powerful glyph manipulates the mind of attackers, charming them temporarily.
messages.items.armor.glyphs.antimagic.name: %s of anti-magic
messages.items.armor.glyphs.antimagic.desc: This powerful glyph allows armor to defend its wearer against magical attacks as well as physical ones. This magical defence is not affected by the armor's tier.
messages.items.armor.glyphs.brimstone.name: %s of brimstone
messages.items.armor.glyphs.brimstone.desc: This glyph shields the wearer and their belongings from fire, completely nullifying its damage and negative effects.
messages.items.armor.glyphs.camouflage.name: %s of camouflage
messages.items.armor.glyphs.camouflage.desc: This glyph allows the wearer to blend into tall grass, granting them temporary invisibility.
messages.items.armor.glyphs.entanglement.name: %s of entanglement
messages.items.armor.glyphs.entanglement.desc: This glyph grows earthen armor around the wearer to absorb damage, but this armor will break if the wearer moves.
messages.items.armor.glyphs.flow.name: %s of flow
messages.items.armor.glyphs.flow.desc: This glyph manipulates the flow of water around the wearer, making them much faster when moving through it.
messages.items.armor.glyphs.obfuscation.name: %s of obfuscation
messages.items.armor.glyphs.obfuscation.desc: This glyph obscures the wearer, making them more difficult to detect.
messages.items.armor.glyphs.potential.name: %s of potential
messages.items.armor.glyphs.potential.desc: This glyph builds energy when struck, granting charge to the wearer's wand when it activates.
messages.items.armor.glyphs.repulsion.name: %s of repulsion
messages.items.armor.glyphs.repulsion.desc: This glyph rebounds force against attackers, sending them flying back.
messages.items.armor.glyphs.stone.name: %s of stone
messages.items.armor.glyphs.stone.desc: This glyph surrounds the armor with heavy magical stone that makes dodging impossible, but blocks damage in proportion with evasion.
messages.items.armor.glyphs.swiftness.name: %s of swiftness
messages.items.armor.glyphs.swiftness.desc: This glyph enhances the speed of the wearer whenever they aren't near to an enemy.
messages.items.armor.glyphs.thorns.name: %s of thorns
messages.items.armor.glyphs.thorns.desc: This powerful glyph harms attackers, causing them to slowly bleed when they attack the wearer.
messages.items.armor.glyphs.viscosity.name: %s of viscosity
messages.items.armor.glyphs.viscosity$defereddama:
Damage is being dealt slowly over time instead of immediately.

Deferred damage remaining: %d.
messages.items.armor.glyphs.viscosity.desc: This glyph is able to store damage dealt to the wearer, dealing it to them slowly rather than all at once.
messages.items.armor.armor.detach_seal: You detach the seal from your armor.
messages.items.armor.armor.equip_cursed: The armor constricts around you painfully.
messages.items.armor.armor.identify: You are now familiar enough with your armor to identify it.
messages.items.armor.armor.hardening_gone: The hardening on this armor has worn off!
messages.items.armor.armor.incompatible: Interaction of different types of magic has erased the glyph on this armor!
messages.items.armor.armor.avg_absorb: Typically this _tier-%1$d_ armor blocks _%2$d-%3$d damage_ and requires _%4$d strength_ to use properly.
messages.items.armor.armor.too_heavy: Because of your inadequate strength wearing this armor will decrease your ability to move, evade, and defend.
messages.items.armor.armor.probably_too_heavy: Probably this armor is too heavy for you.
messages.items.armor.armor.excess_str: Because of your excess strength, you are _more evasive_ while wearing this armor.
messages.items.armor.armor.hardened_no_glyph: This armor has been _hardened,_ but is not currently inscribed with a glyph.
messages.items.armor.armor.cursed_worn: Because this armor is cursed, you are powerless to remove it.
messages.items.armor.armor.cursed: You can feel a malevolent magic lurking within this armor.
messages.items.armor.armor.weak_cursed: Despite the curse, you are able to unequip this armor.
messages.items.armor.armor.not_cursed: This armor is free of malevolent magic.
messages.items.armor.armor.seal_attached: The Warrior's broken seal is attached to this armor. When he is about to be injured below half health, it will grant him _%d shielding_.
messages.items.armor.armor.seal_transfer: The Warrior's broken seal must be affixed to his currently worn armor in order to benefit him. Would you like to automatically detach the seal from the armor you are removing and affix it to the armor you are equipping?
messages.items.armor.armor$glyph.discover_hint: You can find an item with this effect randomly in the dungeon, or try to apply it to an item yourself.
messages.items.armor.classarmor.no_ability: Your armor currently has no ability, you should choose one!
messages.items.armor.classarmor.not_equipped: You need to be wearing this armor to use its special power!
messages.items.armor.classarmor.low_charge: The armor does not have enough charge to use its special power!
messages.items.armor.classarmor.charge_use: Using the ability right now will consume _%s_ charge.
messages.items.armor.classarmor.transfer_desc: The magic of the dwarf king's crown can be transferred to another set of armor. Note that the original armor will be destroyed in the process.
messages.items.armor.classarmor.transfer_complete: Your heroic armor's properties have been transferred!
messages.items.armor.classarmor.discover_hint: You can find this item after defeating the floor 20 boss with a specific hero.
messages.items.armor.clericarmor.name: hero's vestments
messages.items.armor.clericarmor.desc: While wearing this mixture of cloth and plate, the Cleric can perform a special ability.
messages.items.armor.clotharmor.name: cloth armor
messages.items.armor.clotharmor.desc: This lightweight armor offers basic protection.
messages.items.armor.clotharmor.discover_hint: One of the heroes starts with this item.
messages.items.armor.duelistarmor.name: hero's breastplate
messages.items.armor.duelistarmor.desc: While wearing this plate armor and cape, the Duelist can perform a special ability.
messages.items.armor.huntressarmor.name: hero's cloak
messages.items.armor.huntressarmor.desc: While wearing this cloak, the Huntress can perform a special ability.
messages.items.armor.leatherarmor.name: leather armor
messages.items.armor.leatherarmor.desc: Armor made from tanned monster hide. Not as light as cloth armor but provides better protection.
messages.items.armor.magearmor.name: hero's robe
messages.items.armor.magearmor.desc: While wearing this gorgeous robe, the Mage can perform a special ability.
messages.items.armor.mailarmor.name: mail armor
messages.items.armor.mailarmor.desc: Interlocking metal links make for a tough but flexible suit of armor.
messages.items.armor.platearmor.name: plate armor
messages.items.armor.platearmor.desc: Enormous plates of metal are joined together into a suit that provides unmatched protection to any adventurer strong enough to bear its staggering weight.
messages.items.armor.roguearmor.name: hero's garb
messages.items.armor.roguearmor.desc: While wearing this dark garb, the Rogue can perform a special ability.
messages.items.armor.scalearmor.name: scale armor
messages.items.armor.scalearmor.desc: The metal scales sewn onto a leather vest create a flexible, yet protective armor.
messages.items.armor.warriorarmor.name: hero's plate mail
messages.items.armor.warriorarmor.desc: While wearing this heavy plated armor, the Warrior can perform a special ability.
messages.items.artifacts.alchemiststoolkit.name: alchemist's toolkit
messages.items.artifacts.alchemiststoolkit.not_re: Your toolkit has not finished warming up.
messages.items.artifacts.alchemiststoolkit.cursed: Your cursed toolkit prevents you from using alchemy!
messages.items.artifacts.alchemiststoolkit.need_e: You need at least 6 energy for that.
messages.items.artifacts.alchemiststoolkit.energi:
Every 6 energy crystals will give the toolkit enough energy to gain a level, which increases the rate that the toolkit generates energy over time, and how quickly it warms up.

How much energy would you like to use?
messages.items.artifacts.alchemiststoolkit.desc: This toolkit contains a number of reagents and herbs along with a small mixing vial, allowing for alchemy on-the-go. The vial contains what looks like alchemical energy crystals in liquid form.
messages.items.artifacts.alchemiststoolkit.desc_c: The cursed toolkit has bound itself to your side, and refuses to let you use alchemy.
messages.items.artifacts.alchemiststoolkit.desc_w: The toolkit is currently warming up, and will be ready to use after a little while.
messages.items.artifacts.alchemiststoolkit.desc_h: The equipped toolkit is slowly generating alchemical energy as you gain experience. It looks like the mixture in the vial could be enhanced by adding energy crystals to it.
messages.items.artifacts.artifact.cannot_wear_two: You cannot wear two of the same artifact.
messages.items.artifacts.artifact.equip_cursed: The artifact painfully binds itself to you.
messages.items.artifacts.artifact.curse_known: You can feel a malevolent magic lurking within the artifact.
messages.items.artifacts.artifact.not_cursed: This artifact is free of malevolent magic.
messages.items.artifacts.artifact.need_to_equip: You need to equip your artifact to do that.
messages.items.artifacts.capeofthorns.name: cape of thorns
messages.items.artifacts.capeofthorns.desc: These collapsed sheets of metal from the DM-300 have formed together into a rigid cape. It seems to store a deep energy, perhaps it has some of the DM-300's power?
messages.items.artifacts.capeofthorns.desc_inacti: The cape feels reassuringly heavy on your shoulders, it seems to be gaining energy from the damage you take.
messages.items.artifacts.capeofthorns.desc_active: The cape seems to be releasing stored energy, it is radiating a protective power.
messages.items.artifacts.capeofthorns$thorns.radi: Your Cape begins radiating energy, you feel protected!
messages.items.artifacts.capeofthorns$thorns.name: thorns
messages.items.artifacts.capeofthorns$thorns.desc:
Your cape is radiating energy, surrounding you in a field of deflective force!

All damage you receive is reduced while the thorns effect is active. Additionally, if the attacker is next to you, the reduced amount is deflected back at the attacker.

Turns of thorns remaining: %s.
messages.items.artifacts.chaliceofblood.name: chalice of blood
messages.items.artifacts.chaliceofblood.yes: Yes, I know what I'm doing
messages.items.artifacts.chaliceofblood.prick_war:
Each time you use the chalice it will drain more of your life energy, but will further enhance your natural health regeneration in exchange.

Currently pricking yourself will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_, although this damage can be reduced by _both physical and magical blocking or damage reduction._ Without considering damage reduction effects, pricking yourself currently has a _%3$s%% chance_ to drain your life force completely.

Are you sure you want to offer the chalice more life energy?
messages.items.artifacts.chaliceofblood.onprick: You prick yourself, and your life essence drains into the chalice.
messages.items.artifacts.chaliceofblood.ondeath: The Chalice sucks your life essence dry...
messages.items.artifacts.chaliceofblood.desc: This shining silver chalice is oddly adorned with sharp gems at the rim.
messages.items.artifacts.chaliceofblood.desc_curs: The cursed chalice has bound itself to your hand, and is inhibiting your ability to regenerate health.
messages.items.artifacts.chaliceofblood.desc_1: As you hold the chalice, you feel oddly compelled to prick yourself on the sharp gems.
messages.items.artifacts.chaliceofblood.desc_2: Some of your blood is pooled into the chalice, you can subtly feel the chalice feeding life energy into you, increasing your natural health regeneration. You still want to cut yourself on the chalice, even though you know it will hurt.
messages.items.artifacts.chaliceofblood.desc_3: The chalice is filled to the brim with your life essence. You can feel the chalice pouring life energy back into you.
messages.items.artifacts.cloakofshadows.name: cloak of shadows
messages.items.artifacts.cloakofshadows.cooldown: Your cloak needs %d more rounds to re-energize.
messages.items.artifacts.cloakofshadows.cursed: You cannot use a cursed cloak.
messages.items.artifacts.cloakofshadows.no_charge: Your cloak hasn't recharged enough to be usable yet.
messages.items.artifacts.cloakofshadows.desc:
A priceless magical cloak, stolen from the royal armory many years ago by the Rogue. When worn, it can be used to turn completely invisible for a short time.

The more the cloak is used, the stronger it will become, allowing the Rogue to become invisible more frequently and for longer durations.
messages.items.artifacts.cloakofshadows.discover_: One of the heroes starts with this item.
messages.items.artifacts.cloakofshadows$cloakstea: Your cloak has run out of energy.

Your cloak of shadows is granting you invisibility while you are shrouded by it. You will remain cloaked until it is cancelled or your cloak runs out of charge.

While you are invisible enemies are unable to attack or follow you. Physical attacks and magical effects (such as scrolls and wands) will immediately cancel invisibility.

Turns until charge use: %d.
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose.name: dried rose
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose.spawned: You have already summoned the ghost.
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose.no_charge: Your rose isn't fully charged yet.
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose.cursed: You cannot use a cursed rose.
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose.no_space: There is no free space near you.
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose.desc: Is this the rose that the ghost mentioned before disappearing? It seems to hold some spiritual power, perhaps it can be used to channel the energy of that lost warrior.
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose.desc_no_quest:
A dried aged rose that is somehow still holding together despite its age.

It seems to have some spiritual power, but you have no idea how to use it right now.
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose.desc_hint: It seems to be missing some petals. Perhaps reattaching them will strengthen the rose.
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose.desc_cursed: The cursed rose is bound to your hand, it feels eerily cold.
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose$petal.name: dried petal
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose$petal.no_rose: You have no rose to add this petal to.
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose$petal.no_room: There is no room left for this petal, so you discard it.
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose$petal.levelup: You add the petal to the rose.
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose$petal.desc: A frail dried up petal, which has somehow survived this far into the dungeon.
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose$wndghosthero.d:
The ghost is weak on their own, but their form is solid enough to be equipped with a weapon and armor. They will be able to use these items just like you do.

The ghost can currently equip items requiring up to _%d strength._
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose$wndghosthero.c: The ghost can't use unique items.
The ghost can only use equipment that you're sure isn't cursed.
The ghost may not be strong enough to use that.
The ghost is not strong enough to use that.
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose$ghosthero.name: sad ghost
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose$ghosthero.disc: You can find this character with a specific artifact.
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose$ghosthero.intr:
My spirit is bound to this rose, it was very precious to me, a gift from my love whom I left on the surface.

I cannot return to him, but thanks to you I have a second chance to complete my journey. When I am able I will respond to your call and fight with you.

As long as you have the rose I can hear your voice, so you can use it to direct me from afar.

Hopefully you may succeed where I failed...
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose$ghosthero.dial: These sewers used to be safe, people even lived here in the winter.
I wonder what happened to the guard patrols, did they give up?
I had family on the surface, I hope they're safe.
The guards couldn't defeat these monsters, but maybe we can.
If even the sewers are this dangerous, I wonder what's below...
What could have caused these rats and crabs to grow so large?
I've heard stories about this place, nothing good.
This place was always more of a dungeon than a prison.
I can't imagine what went on when this place was abandoned.
It seems both the prisoners and guards have been turned into monsters.
What could be responsible for all these skeletons?
These people didn't have to end up like this...
No human or dwarf has been here for a very long time.
What would cause the dwarves to abandon a gold mine?
It's a shame all the gold here is useless on the surface.
The creatures here are twisted, just like in the sewers.
Even the bats are bloodthirsty here.
No sign of any mining equipment, did the dwarves reclaim it all?
The dwarves were industrious, but greedy.
So the dwarven metropolis really has fallen.
I hope the surface never ends up like this place.
Dwarves aren't supposed to look so pale.
I don't know what's worse, the dwarves, or their creations.
It seems the dwarves are mindless monsters now as well.
What is this place?
This place is terrifying...
What were the dwarves thinking, toying with power like this?
The monsters here are otherworldly, where did they come from?
Can you feel it? It's like something is watching us.
Thank goodness there are torches, it's so dark here!
Why is this happening, I thought we succeeded?
How is that thing still able to influence this world?
I hope you know what you're doing with that amulet.
I suppose we're not done just yet.
We've come so far already, we can finish this!
Just a little further, we can make it out of here!
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose$ghosthero.seen: Many of my friends died to this thing, time for vengeance!
Such an abomination cannot be allowed to live!
The one prisoner left is a deadly assassin. Of course...
I've heard horror stories about that mask...
Only dwarves would build a mining machine that kills intruders.
How has this thing stayed active for so long?
When people say power corrupts, this is what they mean.
He's more of a lich than a king now.
Even in death the dwarves obey their master.
So that's what a god looks like?
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose$ghosthero.bles: I wish I had one of those...
messages.items.artifacts.driedrose$ghosthero.desc:
A frail looking ethereal figure with a humanoid shape. Their power seems tied to the rose you have.

This ghost may not be much, they seem to be your only true friend down here.
messages.items.artifacts.etherealchains.name: ethereal chains
messages.items.artifacts.etherealchains.rooted: Your chains cannot pull you while you are rooted.
messages.items.artifacts.etherealchains.no_charge: Your chains do not have enough charge.
messages.items.artifacts.etherealchains.cant_pull: Your chains cannot pull that target.
messages.items.artifacts.etherealchains.inside_wa: Your chains can only pull you through walls, not into them.
messages.items.artifacts.etherealchains.nothing_t: There is nothing to grab there.
messages.items.artifacts.etherealchains.desc: These large yet lightweight chains glow with spiritual energy. They can be used to pull you towards terrain, or pull enemies toward you. The ethereal nature of the chains even allows them to extend through walls!
messages.items.artifacts.etherealchains.desc_curs: The cursed chains are locked to your side, constantly swinging around, trying to trip or bind you.
messages.items.artifacts.etherealchains.desc_equi: The chains rest around your side, slowly siphoning the spiritual energy of those you defeat. Each charge is a link in the chain, which will extend out exactly one tile.
messages.items.artifacts.holytome.name: holy tome
messages.items.artifacts.holytome.no_spell: You're not able to cast that spell right now.
messages.items.artifacts.holytome.cursed: You cannot use a cursed tome.
messages.items.artifacts.holytome.desc:
A holy tome that acts as a focus for the Cleric's divine magic. Using the tome lets the Cleric cast a variety of magical spells.

The tome will steadily get more powerful as the Cleric uses it, giving the Cleric more maximum charges and slightly increasing the recharging speed.
messages.items.artifacts.holytome.discover_hint: One of the heroes starts with this item.
messages.items.artifacts.hornofplenty.name: horn of plenty
messages.items.artifacts.hornofplenty.no_food: Your horn has no food in it to eat!
messages.items.artifacts.hornofplenty.full: Your horn is full of food!
messages.items.artifacts.hornofplenty.reject: Your horn rejects the uncooked blandfruit.
messages.items.artifacts.hornofplenty.maxlevel: Your horn has consumed all the food it can!
messages.items.artifacts.hornofplenty.levelup: The horn consumes your food offering and grows in strength!
messages.items.artifacts.hornofplenty.feed: The horn consumes your food offering.
messages.items.artifacts.hornofplenty.desc: This horn can't be blown into, but instead seems to fill up with food as you adventure and gain experience. You can consume each charge individually as a snack, or eat until you're full.
messages.items.artifacts.hornofplenty.desc_hint: Perhaps there is a way to increase the horn's power by giving it food energy.
messages.items.artifacts.hornofplenty.desc_cursed: The cursed horn has bound itself to your side, it seems to be eager to take food rather than produce it.
messages.items.artifacts.lloydsbeacon.name: lloyd's beacon
messages.items.artifacts.lloydsbeacon.no_charge: Your beacon does not have enough energy right now.
messages.items.artifacts.lloydsbeacon.preventing: Strong magic aura of this place prevents you from using the lloyd's beacon!
messages.items.artifacts.lloydsbeacon.creatures: Psychic aura of neighbouring creatures doesn't allow you to use the lloyd's beacon at this moment.
messages.items.artifacts.lloydsbeacon.return: The lloyd's beacon is successfully set at your current location, now you can return here anytime.
messages.items.artifacts.lloydsbeacon.desc: Lloyd's beacon is an intricate magical device which grants the user control of teleportation magics. The beacon can be used to return to a set location, but can also expel bursts of random teleportation magic once it has charged from being equipped. This magic can be directed at a target or at the user themselves.
messages.items.artifacts.lloydsbeacon.desc_set: This beacon was set somewhere on the level %d of Pixel Dungeon.
messages.items.artifacts.masterthievesarmband.no_: Your armband does not have enough charge.
messages.items.artifacts.masterthievesarmband.cur: You can't use a cursed armband.
messages.items.artifacts.masterthievesarmband.no_: You must target an enemy that is adjacent to you.
messages.items.artifacts.masterthievesarmband.ste: You can't steal from shopkeepers directly.
messages.items.artifacts.masterthievesarmband.no_: That enemy has nothing to steal.
messages.items.artifacts.masterthievesarmband.fai: You didn't manage to steal anything.
messages.items.artifacts.masterthievesarmband.des: This purple velvet armband bears the mark of a master thief. This doesn't belong to you, but it probably didn't belong to its last user either.
The cursed armband is bound to your wrist, and somehow your pouch of gold seems to be slowly getting lighter...

You feel power building in the armband on your wrist as you gain experience. You can use this power to steal from shops, or to rob enemies!

Robbing enemies happens instantly, briefly disorients them, and gives you a chance to get whatever loot they have! This power is more effective against unaware enemies. Robbing the same enemy multiple times does not give more chances at loot.
messages.items.artifacts.sandalsofnature.name: sandals of nature
messages.items.artifacts.sandalsofnature.absorb_s: The footwear absorbs the seed, they seem healthier.
messages.items.artifacts.sandalsofnature.no_effec: You must feed a seed to your footwear first.
messages.items.artifacts.sandalsofnature.low_char: Your footwear don't have enough energy for that.
messages.items.artifacts.sandalsofnature.out_of_r: That location is out of range.
messages.items.artifacts.sandalsofnature.desc_1: What initially seem like sandals made of twine are actually two plants! They seem very weak and pale, perhaps they need to be given nutrients?
messages.items.artifacts.sandalsofnature.desc_2: The footwear has grown and now more closely resemble two tailored shoes. Some colour has returned to them, perhaps they can still grow further?
messages.items.artifacts.sandalsofnature.desc_3: The plants have grown again and now resembles a pair of solid boots made from bark. The plants seem to have regained their strength, but perhaps they can still grow further?
messages.items.artifacts.sandalsofnature.desc_4: The plants seem to have reached their maximum size, they resemble a pair of armored greaves. The greaves are a deep brown and resemble a very sturdy tree.
messages.items.artifacts.sandalsofnature.desc_hin: You feel more attuned with nature while wearing this artifact.
messages.items.artifacts.sandalsofnature.desc_cur: The cursed sandals are blocking any attunement with nature.
messages.items.artifacts.sandalsofnature.desc_abi:
The footwear ripples with the color of the last seed you fed them. They can briefly root into the ground and produce that plant's effect anywhere in a 3 tile radius.
Seed: _%s_
Charge needed: _%d%%_
messages.items.artifacts.sandalsofnature.desc_see: You have fed the footwear %d seeds.
messages.items.artifacts.skeletonkey.name: skeleton key
messages.items.artifacts.skeletonkey.cursed: You can't use a cursed skeleton key.
messages.items.artifacts.skeletonkey.invalid_targ: There's nothing to lock or unlock there.
messages.items.artifacts.skeletonkey.lock_no_spac: You can't lock a character inside of a door!
messages.items.artifacts.skeletonkey.iron_charges: Opening a regular lock requires 1 charge.
messages.items.artifacts.skeletonkey.gold_charges: Opening a gold lock requires 2 charges.
messages.items.artifacts.skeletonkey.wall_charges: Creating a temporary wall requires 2 charges.
messages.items.artifacts.skeletonkey.crystal_char: Opening a crystal lock requires 5 charges.
messages.items.artifacts.skeletonkey.wont_open: The key refuses to fit into this lock for some reason.
messages.items.artifacts.skeletonkey.locked_with_: That door was locked by your skeleton key.
messages.items.artifacts.skeletonkey.force_lock: The lock has weakened without your skeleton key. You manage to force it open.
messages.items.artifacts.skeletonkey.desc: An important-looking key with a head shaped like a skull. Its teeth seem to be different every time you look at them.
messages.items.artifacts.skeletonkey.desc_worn:
This magical key seems to gain power as you use it instead of the dungeon's regular keys. It can be inserted into almost any of the dungeon's locks to either open or close them, including doors that were never locked previously.

The key can even be used on empty space in a cardinal or diagonal direction to 'lock' the air in front of you, creating a 3 tile wide solid wall that lasts for 10 turns. Locking will push away enemies if there is space to do so.
messages.items.artifacts.skeletonkey.desc_cursed: The cursed key seems to be actively avoiding fitting into any lock, and is even making it difficult (but not impossible) for you to use your other keys.
messages.items.artifacts.skeletonkey$keywall.desc: A temporary magical wall has been placed here by the skeleton key.
messages.items.artifacts.talismanofforesight.name: talisman of foresight
messages.items.artifacts.talismanofforesight.low_: The talisman requires at least 5% charge to scry.
messages.items.artifacts.talismanofforesight.desc: A smooth stone with strange engravings on it. You feel like it's watching everything around you, keeping an eye out for anything hidden.

When you hold the talisman you feel like your senses are heightened. The talisman is slowly building charge as time passes and when you discover hidden doors or traps.

The talisman can expend its charge to 'scry' in a cone shape, which reveals all tiles and secrets in the scanned area, and will grant you vision of enemies and items for a short time.
The cursed talisman is intently staring into you, dulling your senses.
messages.items.artifacts.talismanofforesight$fore: You feel very nervous, as if there is nearby unseen danger.
messages.items.artifacts.timekeepershourglass.no_: Your hourglass hasn't recharged enough to be usable yet.
messages.items.artifacts.timekeepershourglass.cur: You cannot use a cursed hourglass.
messages.items.artifacts.timekeepershourglass.ons: The world seems to shift around you in an instant.
messages.items.artifacts.timekeepershourglass.pro:
How would you like to use the hourglass's magic?

While in stasis, time will move normally while you are frozen and completely invulnerable, consumes up to 2 charges at a time.

When time is frozen, you can move as if your actions take no time. This can be deactivated at any time by using the hourglass or attacking.
messages.items.artifacts.timekeepershourglass.des: This large ornate hourglass looks fairly unassuming, but you feel a great power in its finely carved frame. As you rotate the hourglass and watch the sand pour you can feel its magic tugging at you, surely using this magic would give you some control over time.
The hourglass seems to have lost some sand, if only you could find some...
The cursed hourglass is locked to your side, you can feel it trying to manipulate your flow of time.
messages.items.artifacts.timekeepershourglass$tim:
Time is frozen around you, allowing you to perform actions instantly. The effect will last until it is cancelled or your hourglass runs out of charge. Attacking or using magic will break this effect as well.

Turns until charge use: %s.
messages.items.artifacts.timekeepershourglass$san: You add the sand to your hourglass.
Your hourglass is filled with magical sand!
You have no hourglass to place this sand into.

This small bag of fine sand should work perfectly with your hourglass.

It seems odd that the shopkeeper would have this specific item right when you need it...
messages.items.artifacts.unstablespellbook.name: unstable spellbook
messages.items.artifacts.unstablespellbook.blinde: You cannot read from the book while blinded.
messages.items.artifacts.unstablespellbook.no_cha: Your spellbook is out of energy for now.
messages.items.artifacts.unstablespellbook.cursed: You cannot read from a cursed spellbook.
messages.items.artifacts.unstablespellbook.infuse: You infuse the scroll's energy into the book.
messages.items.artifacts.unstablespellbook.unable: You are unable to add this scroll to the book.
messages.items.artifacts.unstablespellbook.unknow: You're not sure what type of scroll this is yet.
messages.items.artifacts.unstablespellbook.desc: This Tome is in surprising good condition given its age. It fizzes and crackles as you move the pages, surging with unstable energy. If you read from this book, there's no telling what spell you might cast.
messages.items.artifacts.unstablespellbook.desc_c: The cursed book has bound itself to you, it is inhibiting your ability to use most scrolls.
messages.items.artifacts.unstablespellbook.desc_i: The book is incomplete. Its index is currently pointing to the following blank pages:
messages.items.artifacts.unstablespellbook.desc_e: The scrolls that you've added to the book are glowing with power. You will be able to choose the exotic version of these scroll's effects, but at the cost of an additional charge.
messages.items.artifacts.unstablespellbook.read_e:
The scroll you added to the spellbook surges with energy. You are able to channel either the regular, or exotic version of this scroll's effect.

Choosing the exotic variant will cost 2 charges instead of 1.
messages.items.bags.bag.name: backpack
messages.items.bags.bag.discover_hint: You can buy this item in a shop.
messages.items.bags.potionbandolier.name: potion bandolier
messages.items.bags.potionbandolier.desc:
This thick bandolier fits around your chest like a sash, it has many insulated straps on it to hold potion vials, your waterskin, or liquid metal vials.

While inside the bandolier, your potions should be protected from the cold.
messages.items.bags.scrollholder.name: scroll holder
messages.items.bags.scrollholder.desc:
This tubular container looks like it would hold an astronomer's tools and charts, but your scrolls will fit just as well. There's even a few side compartments which would nicely fit spell crystals, arcane styli, and arcane resin.

The holder doesn't look very flammable, so your scrolls should be safe from fire inside it.
messages.items.bags.velvetpouch.name: velvet pouch
messages.items.bags.velvetpouch.desc: This small velvet pouch can store many small items in it, such as seeds, runestones, and some alchemy ingredients.
messages.items.bags.velvetpouch.discover_hint: One of the heroes starts with this item.
messages.items.bags.magicalholster.name: magical holster
messages.items.bags.magicalholster.desc:
This slim holster is made from some exotic animal hide, and possesses powerful magic which lets it store a massive amount of ranged weapons.

You can simply reach into the bag and will always grab the item you were looking for.

Due to the holster's magic, wands will charge slightly faster and thrown weapons will last slightly longer inside of it.
messages.items.bombs.arcanebomb.name: arcane bomb
messages.items.bombs.arcanebomb.desc: This bomb has been imbued with arcane properties. It will explode into a powerful blast similar to Goo's pumped up attack, dealing _%1$d-%2$d magical damage_ to anything within 2 tiles.
messages.items.bombs.arcanebomb.discover_hint: You can craft this item via alchemy.
messages.items.bombs.bomb.name: bomb
messages.items.bombs.bomb.snuff_fuse: You quickly snuff the bomb's fuse.
messages.items.bombs.bomb.desc: A fairly hefty black powder bomb. An explosion from this bomb deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ to anything adjacent to it, and will destroy some adjacent terrain or items.
messages.items.bombs.bomb.desc_fuse: It looks like the fuse will take a couple rounds to burn down once it is lit.
messages.items.bombs.bomb.desc_burning: The bomb's fuse is burning away, keep your distance or put it out!
messages.items.bombs.bomb$doublebomb.name: two bombs
messages.items.bombs.bomb$doublebomb.desc: A stack of two hefty black powder bombs, looks like you get one free!
messages.items.bombs.firebomb.name: firebomb
messages.items.bombs.firebomb.desc: This bomb has been modified to explode in a larger area, dealing _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and spreading sustained flame within 2 tiles.
messages.items.bombs.firebomb.discover_hint: You can craft this item via alchemy.
messages.items.bombs.flashbangbomb.name: flashbang
messages.items.bombs.flashbangbomb.desc: This customized bomb will erupt into a blast of light, sound, and electricity when it explodes. Anything within 2 tiles will take _%1$d-%2$d damage_ from the explosion, an additional 25%% damage from the electricity, and be stunned for 10 turns.
messages.items.bombs.flashbangbomb.discover_hint: You can craft this item via alchemy.
messages.items.bombs.frostbomb.name: frost bomb
messages.items.bombs.frostbomb.desc: This bomb has been modified to explode in a larger area, dealing _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and spreading a sustained gust of freezing air within 2 tiles.
messages.items.bombs.frostbomb.discover_hint: You can craft this item via alchemy.
messages.items.bombs.holybomb.name: holy bomb
messages.items.bombs.holybomb.desc: This bomb has been modified to flash holy light in a larger area when it explodes. Anything within 2 tiles will take _%1$d-%2$d damage_ from the explosion, and undead or demonic enemies will take an additional 50%% damage from the holy light.
messages.items.bombs.holybomb.discover_hint: You can craft this item via alchemy.
messages.items.bombs.noisemaker.name: noisemaker
messages.items.bombs.noisemaker.desc: This customized bomb will repeatedly make noise when its fuse runs out. When something touches the bomb, it will explode and deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_ to anything within 2 tiles!
messages.items.bombs.noisemaker.desc_burning: The noisemaker is ticking away, it'll explode when something gets near!
messages.items.bombs.noisemaker.discover_hint: You can craft this item via alchemy.
messages.items.bombs.smokebomb.name: smoke bomb
messages.items.bombs.smokebomb.desc: This bomb has been modified to spew a thick cloud of gas at the same time as exploding. It will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and spread shrouding fog within 2 tiles.
messages.items.bombs.smokebomb.discover_hint: You can craft this item via alchemy.
messages.items.bombs.regrowthbomb.name: regrowth bomb
messages.items.bombs.regrowthbomb.desc: This customized bomb will splash life-giving liquid everywhere within 3 tiles instead of exploding. The area caught in the blast will rapidly sprout grass and plants. Yourself and any allies caught in the blast will be healed as if they had drank a potion of healing.
messages.items.bombs.regrowthbomb.discover_hint: You can craft this item via alchemy.
messages.items.bombs.shrapnelbomb.name: shrapnel bomb
messages.items.bombs.shrapnelbomb.desc: This bomb has been modified with scraps of DM-300's metal, which will fragment and fly everywhere when it explodes, dealing _%1$d-%2$d damage_ in a huge range around the bomb. You had better hide behind something when using it...
messages.items.bombs.shrapnelbomb.discover_hint: You can craft this item via alchemy.
messages.items.bombs.woollybomb.name: woolly bomb
messages.items.bombs.woollybomb.desc: This customized bomb will create a wide field of magical sheep after exploding. The explosion will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_ to anything within 2 tiles. The sheep will block movement and persist for a very long time! The sheep will not last as long in the presence of powerful enemies though, and can be manually dispelled sooner by interacting with them.
messages.items.bombs.woollybomb.discover_hint: You can craft this item via alchemy.
messages.items.food.berry.name: dungeon berry
messages.items.food.berry.desc: This small berry was found by the Huntress among the dungeon's vegetation. It can be eaten quickly, restores a small amount of satiety, and might contain a usable seed!
messages.items.food.berry.discover_hint: You can find this item using a specific hero talent.
messages.items.food.blandfruit.name: blandfruit
messages.items.food.blandfruit.raw: You can't bear to eat it raw.
messages.items.food.blandfruit.desc: So dry and insubstantial, perhaps stewing it with another ingredient would improve it.
messages.items.food.blandfruit.desc_cooked: The fruit has plumped up from its time soaking in the pot and has even absorbed the properties of the seed it was cooked with. It will have the effect of whatever potion the seed corresponded to.
messages.items.food.blandfruit.desc_eat: It looks ready to be eaten!
messages.items.food.blandfruit.desc_throw: It seems pretty volatile, it might be best to throw it.
messages.items.food.blandfruit$chunks.name: blandfruit chunks
messages.items.food.blandfruit$chunks.desc:
The blandfruit has exploded on impact, leaving inert chunks behind.

Despite a bit of dirt, these large chunks of cooked blandfruit seem perfectly edible.
messages.items.food.chargrilledmeat.name: chargrilled meat
messages.items.food.chargrilledmeat.desc: It looks like a decent steak.
messages.items.food.chargrilledmeat.discover_hint: You can create this using another food item.
messages.items.food.food.name: ration of food
messages.items.food.food.desc: Nothing fancy here: dried meat, some biscuits - things like that.
messages.items.food.frozencarpaccio.name: frozen carpaccio
messages.items.food.frozencarpaccio.invis: You see your hands turn invisible!
messages.items.food.frozencarpaccio.desc: It's a piece of frozen raw meat. The only way to eat it is by cutting thin slices of it. And this way it's surprisingly good.
messages.items.food.frozencarpaccio.discover_hint: You can create this using another food item.
messages.items.food.meatpie.name: meat pie
messages.items.food.meatpie.desc: A delicious pie filled with savoury meat. This will satiate you far more than any other meal.
messages.items.food.meatpie.discover_hint: You can craft this item via alchemy.
messages.items.food.mysterymeat.name: mystery meat
messages.items.food.mysterymeat.discover_hint: You can get this item as a drop from certain enemies.
messages.items.food.mysterymeat$placeholder.name: meat
messages.items.food.phantommeat.name: phantom meat
messages.items.food.phantommeat.desc: A large glistening translucent steak, cut from a phantom piranha. This magical meat doesn't need to be cooked and grants a number of defensive benefits in addition to fully satiating you. When eaten it will grant invisibility, barkskin, some healing, and cures many harmful effects.
messages.items.food.phantommeat.discover_hint: You can get this item as a drop from certain enemies.
messages.items.food.pasty.name: pasty
messages.items.food.pasty.desc: An authentic Cornish pasty with a traditional filling of beef and potato. Delicious!
messages.items.food.pasty.fish_desc:
A whole steamed fish, magically preserved on a bed of greens. It's tradition to save some fish for later around this time of year, so you'll keep some leftovers instead of eating it all at once.

Happy Lunar New Year!
messages.items.food.pasty.amulet_desc:
You've finally found it, the magical amulet of - wait a minute, this is just a foil-wrapped chocolate made to look like the amulet! It won't grant you limitless power, but at least it'll fill you up and give you a little artifact charge.

April Fools!
messages.items.food.pasty.egg_desc:
A great big chocolate egg, wrapped in colorful yellow foil. There's easily enough chocolate here to fill you up, and the sugar might give your artifacts a tiny bit of extra charge.

Happy Easter!
messages.items.food.pasty.rainbow_desc:
This colorful potion is a kind of liquid food. In addition to satisfying your hunger, it has a little magic in it which will calm an adjacent non-boss enemy, making them temporarily hesitant to fight you.

Happy Pride!
messages.items.food.pasty.shattered_desc:
This large slice of vanilla cake has colorful sprinkles and green frosting. The cake was made to celebrate years of experience, and will grant a small amount of that experience to you when eaten.

Shattered Pixel Dungeon was first released on August 5th 2014. Happy birthday Shattered Pixel Dungeon!
messages.items.food.pasty.pie_desc:
A great big slice of pumpkin pie. Its sweet and spicy flavor will fill you up and give you a tiny bit of healing.

Happy Halloween!
messages.items.food.pasty.vanilla_desc:
This large slice of vanilla cake has colorful sprinkles and blue frosting. The cake was made to celebrate years of experience, and will grant a small amount of that experience to you when eaten.

The original Pixel Dungeon was first released on December 4th 2012. Happy birthday Pixel Dungeon!
messages.items.food.pasty.cane_desc:
A huge sugary sweet candy cane. It's big enough to fill you up, and the sugar might give your wands a tiny bit of extra charge too.

Happy Holidays!
messages.items.food.pasty.sparkling_desc:
This sparkling potion is a kind of liquid food. It satisfies hunger and simulates sparkling wine, but isn't actually alcoholic. The warm feeling in your belly will grant a little bit of shielding.

Happy New Year!
messages.items.food.pasty$fishleftover.name: fish leftovers
messages.items.food.pasty$fishleftover.desc: Some surplus fish from your previous meal. You can eat it any time you like to restore a little hunger.
messages.items.food.smallration.name: small food ration
messages.items.food.smallration.desc: It looks exactly like a standard ration of food but smaller.
messages.items.food.smallration.discover_hint: You can buy this item in a shop.
messages.items.food.stewedmeat.name: stewed meat
messages.items.food.stewedmeat.desc: Stewing the meat has cleansed it of any disease or parasites. It should be safe to eat.
messages.items.food.stewedmeat.discover_hint: You can craft this item via alchemy.
messages.items.food.supplyration.name: supply ration
messages.items.food.supplyration.desc:
This ration was left in the dungeon by and for members of the thieves guild. It's specifically designed to be eaten on the go, and aid with general skullduggery.

While it doesn't fill you up as much as a regular ration, it can be eaten quickly, provides a little direct healing, and will restore a charge to the Rogue's cloak of shadows.
messages.items.food.supplyration.discover_hint: You can find this item using a specific hero talent.
messages.items.journal.documentpage.name: torn page
messages.items.journal.documentpage.desc: A lone page, probably torn from a book of some sort. You'll need to pick it up to read it.
messages.items.journal.alchemypage.name: torn alchemy book page
messages.items.journal.alchemypage.desc:
A torn page from a guidebook on alchemy.

Most of the text is too small to read at a distance, but you can make out the title of the page:

_"%s"_
messages.items.journal.guidebook.name: tome of dungeon mastery
messages.items.journal.guidebook.hint_mobile: Your guidebook has advice for you! Tap the flashing journal button on the top-right to read it.
messages.items.journal.guidebook.hint_desktop: Your guidebook has advice for you! Select the flashing journal button (%s) on the top-right to read it.
messages.items.journal.guidebook.desc:
An adventurer's guidebook, left here by someone who decided adventuring wasn't for them! This particular book is magical, and can prompt adventurers to read a page at the right moment.

Despite that functionality, the book is most popular because of the big words "Don't Panic!" written in large friendly letters on the cover.
messages.items.journal.guidepage.name: torn guidebook page
messages.items.journal.guidepage.desc:
A torn page from an adventuring guidebook.

Most of the text is too small to read at a distance, but you can make out the title of the page:

_"%s"_
messages.items.journal.regionlorepage$sewers.name: worn letter
messages.items.journal.regionlorepage$sewers.desc: What looks to be a letter, written on a dirt-stained piece of paper. You'll need to pick it up to be able to make out what's written on it.
messages.items.journal.regionlorepage$prison.name: worn journal entry
messages.items.journal.regionlorepage$prison.desc: A journal entry, or some other kind of record, written on an old piece of paper. It seems to have fared better than the letters you found in the sewers, but you'll still need to pick it up to read it.
messages.items.journal.regionlorepage$caves.name: old log entry
messages.items.journal.regionlorepage$caves.desc: What looks to be an entry in an explorer's logbook, preserved surprisingly well despite how old it must be. Pick it up to read it.
messages.items.journal.regionlorepage$city.name: rusted tablet
messages.items.journal.regionlorepage$city.desc: A small rusted metal tablet with a message magically etched into it. The letters are still clear despite the tablet's age, but you'll have to pick it up to read it.
messages.items.journal.regionlorepage$halls.name: glowing tablet
messages.items.journal.regionlorepage$halls.desc: A small black tablet with glowing green letters etched into it. The glowing letters blur together into a haze at a distance, you'll have to pick it up to read it.
messages.items.keys.goldenkey.name: golden key
messages.items.keys.goldenkey.desc: The notches on this golden key are tiny and intricate. Perhaps it will open a locked chest?
messages.items.keys.crystalkey.name: Crystal key
messages.items.keys.crystalkey.desc: The cut surfaces of this crystalline key shimmer in the darkness. Perhaps it will open something made of crystal?
messages.items.keys.ironkey.name: iron key
messages.items.keys.ironkey.desc: The notches on this ancient iron key are well worn; its leather lanyard is battered by age. What door might it open?
messages.items.keys.wornkey.name: worn key
messages.items.keys.wornkey.desc: This key is worn and discolored, but looks serious. Probably it can open some serious door nearby.
messages.items.potions.potion.unknown_desc: This flask contains a swirling colorful liquid. Who knows what it will do when drunk or thrown?
messages.items.potions.potion.yes: Yes, I know what I'm doing
messages.items.potions.potion.sure_drink: Are you sure you want to drink it? In most cases you should throw such potions at your enemies.
messages.items.potions.potion.sure_throw: Are you sure you want to throw it? In most cases it makes sense to drink it.
messages.items.potions.potion.shatter: The flask shatters and the liquid splashes harmlessly.
messages.items.potions.potion.discover_hint: You can find this item randomly in the dungeon, or craft it via alchemy.
messages.items.potions.potion$placeholder.name: potion
messages.items.potions.potion$seedtopotion.name: Random Potion
messages.items.potions.potionofexperience.name: potion of experience
messages.items.potions.potionofexperience.desc: The storied experiences of multitudes of battles reduced to liquid form, this draught will instantly raise your experience level.
messages.items.potions.potionoffrost.name: potion of frost
messages.items.potions.potionoffrost.desc: The chemical contained in this potion will evaporate into a freezing cloud upon exposure to open air.
messages.items.potions.potionofhaste.name: potion of haste
messages.items.potions.potionofhaste.desc: Drinking this oddly sweet liquid will imbue you with tremendous energy for a short time, allowing you to run at high speeds.
messages.items.potions.potionofhealing.name: potion of healing
messages.items.potions.potionofhealing.desc: This elixir will rapidly restore your health and instantly cure many ailments.
messages.items.potions.potionofinvisibility.name: potion of invisibility
messages.items.potions.potionofinvisibility.invis: You see your hands turn invisible!
messages.items.potions.potionofinvisibility.desc: Drinking this potion will render you temporarily invisible. While invisible, enemies will be unable to see you. Physical attacks and magical effects (such as scrolls and wands) will immediately cancel invisibility.
messages.items.potions.potionoflevitation.name: potion of levitation
messages.items.potions.potionoflevitation.desc: Drinking this curious liquid will cause you to hover in the air, able to drift effortlessly over traps and pits. Throwing this potion will create a cloud of unrefined gas, disorienting anything caught in it.
messages.items.potions.potionofliquidflame.name: potion of liquid flame
messages.items.potions.potionofliquidflame.desc: This flask contains an unstable compound which will burst violently into flame upon exposure to open air.
messages.items.potions.potionofmindvision.name: potion of mind vision
messages.items.potions.potionofmindvision.see_mob: You can somehow feel the presence of other creatures' minds!
messages.items.potions.potionofmindvision.see_non: You can somehow tell that you are alone on this level at the moment.
messages.items.potions.potionofmindvision.desc: After drinking this, your mind will become attuned to the psychic signature of distant creatures, enabling you to sense biological presences through walls. Also this potion will permit you to see through nearby walls and doors.
messages.items.potions.potionofparalyticgas.name: potion of paralytic gas
messages.items.potions.potionofparalyticgas.desc: Upon exposure to open air, the liquid in this flask will vaporize into a numbing yellow haze. Anyone who inhales the cloud will be paralyzed instantly, unable to move for some time after the cloud dissipates. This item can be thrown at distant enemies to catch them within the effect of the gas.
messages.items.potions.potionofpurity.name: potion of purity
messages.items.potions.potionofpurity.freshness: You feel uncommon freshness in the air.
messages.items.potions.potionofpurity.desc: This magical reagent will quickly neutralize all harmful area-bound effects in a large area. Drinking it will give you temporary immunity to such effects.
messages.items.potions.potionofstrength.name: potion of strength
messages.items.potions.potionofstrength.msg: Newfound strength surges through your body, you now have %d strength!
messages.items.potions.potionofstrength.desc: This powerful liquid will course through your muscles, permanently increasing your strength by one point.
messages.items.potions.potionoftoxicgas.name: potion of toxic gas
messages.items.potions.potionoftoxicgas.desc: Uncorking or shattering this pressurized glass will cause its contents to explode into a deadly cloud of toxic green gas. You might choose to fling this potion at distant enemies instead of uncorking it by hand.
messages.items.potions.brews.brew.discover_hint: You can craft this item via alchemy.
messages.items.potions.brews.aquabrew.name: aqua brew
messages.items.potions.brews.aquabrew.desc: When shattered, this brew will release a burst of pressurized water at its location. It's only forceful enough to damage fiery enemies, but it also spreads water to nearby terrain, disables traps, douses fires, and knocks back characters near the burst.
messages.items.potions.brews.blizzardbrew.name: blizzard brew
messages.items.potions.brews.blizzardbrew.desc: When shattered, this brew will unleash a swirling blizzard which quickly spreads like a gas.
messages.items.potions.brews.causticbrew.name: caustic brew
messages.items.potions.brews.causticbrew.desc: This brew will spread corrosive ooze in a wide area around the location it shatters in. Anything caught by the ooze will slowly melt if it can't wash it off in water.
messages.items.potions.brews.infernalbrew.name: infernal brew
messages.items.potions.brews.infernalbrew.desc: When shattered, this brew will unleash a raging inferno which quickly spreads like a gas.
messages.items.potions.brews.shockingbrew.name: shocking brew
messages.items.potions.brews.shockingbrew.desc: When shattered, this brew will unleash an electrical storm in a wide area around the location it breaks at.
messages.items.potions.brews.unstablebrew.name: unstable brew
messages.items.potions.brews.unstablebrew.desc:
This magical brew glows with shifting colors of the rainbow.

When drank or thrown it will trigger the effect of a random potion. The potion effect will always be beneficial if it is drank, and will always be harmful if it is thrown.
messages.items.potions.elixirs.elixir.discover_hi: You can craft this item via alchemy.
messages.items.potions.elixirs.elixirofarcanearmo: This elixir will grant the drinker a long lasting resistance to magical damage.
messages.items.potions.elixirs.elixirofaquaticrej: This elixir contains the remains of Goo enhanced with a healing potion. While it will not provide immediate healing, it will steadily restore a greater amount of health while you are standing in water.

You have temporarily gained restorative properties similar to that of Goo.

While standing in water, you will recover a small amount of health per turn. The effect is paused when you are at full health or are out of water.

Healing left: %d.
messages.items.potions.elixirs.elixirofdragonsblo: When consumed, this elixir will send fiery power coursing through the drinker's veins. This effect will make the drinker immune to fire, and allow them to set enemies aflame with physical attacks.
messages.items.potions.elixirs.elixiroffeatherfal: You feel light as a feather!
This elixir offers a weaker but more controlled levitation effect, allowing the drinker to fall great distances without harm for a little while.

You are under the effects of a feather fall elixir, allowing you to fall into chasms without taking damage!

Turns remaining: %s.
messages.items.potions.elixirs.elixirofhoneyedhea:
This elixir combines healing with the sweetness of honey. When drank, it will apply the same effect as a potion of healing and satisfy a small amount of hunger, but it can also be thrown to heal an ally.

Creatures with an affinity for honey might be pacified if this item is used on them.
messages.items.potions.elixirs.elixiroficytouch.d: When consumed, this elixir will allow the drinker to sap the heat from enemies they attack. This effect will make the drinker immune to the cold, and allow them to chill enemies with physical attacks.
messages.items.potions.elixirs.elixirofmight.name: elixir of might
messages.items.potions.elixirs.elixirofmight.msg: Newfound strength surges through your body, you now have %d strength!
messages.items.potions.elixirs.elixirofmight.desc: This powerful liquid will course through your muscles, permanently increasing your strength by one point and temporarily increasing maximum health by %d points. The health boost scales with your maximum health, but will slowly wear off as you gain levels.
messages.items.potions.elixirs.elixirofmight$htbo:
Your body feels unnaturally strong and healthy.

Your maximum health is boosted for an extended period of time. As you gain levels, the boost will steadily fade.

Current boost amount: %d.
Levels remaining: %d.
messages.items.potions.elixirs.elixiroftoxicessen: When consumed, this elixir will imbue the drinker with toxic energy. The drinker will continuously spread toxic gas as they move, and will be immune to toxic gas and poison for slightly longer than the duration of the effect.
messages.items.potions.exotic.exoticpotion.unknow: This round flask contains a grainy colorful liquid. It seems to be foreign to this land, who knows what it might do when drunk or thrown?
messages.items.potions.exotic.exoticpotion.warnin: Do you really want to cancel this potion usage? It will be consumed anyway.
messages.items.potions.exotic.exoticpotion.discov: You can craft this item via alchemy.
messages.items.potions.exotic.potionofcleansing.d: This powerful reagent will render the drinker immune to all harmful status effects for a few turns when quaffed. It can be thrown at a target to cleanse them as well.
messages.items.potions.exotic.potionofcleansing$c:
This character is temporarily immune to all harmful status effects!

Turns remaining: %s.
messages.items.potions.exotic.potionofcorrosivega: Uncorking or shattering this pressurized glass will cause its contents to explode into a deadly cloud of corrosive rust-colored gas. The gas spreads more quickly than toxic gas and is more deadly, but also won't last as long.
messages.items.potions.exotic.potionofdragonsbrea: This flask contains an unusual compound which bursts into flame shortly after mixing with saliva. Quickly spitting the liquid will allow the user to spew flame from their mouth!
messages.items.potions.exotic.potionofearthenarmo: Rather than paralyze, this liquid has a hardening effect on the skin which will turn it into temporary natural armor.
messages.items.potions.exotic.potionofdivineinspi: You can't gain any more bonus talent points.
Select a talent tier to gain two bonus points in. You must have unlocked the tier to be able to spend the points.

The power of holy energy reduced to liquid form, this draught will imbue the drinker with divine power, granting them two bonus talent points in a tier of their choosing.

This potion can only be used once for each talent tier.
messages.items.potions.exotic.potionofmagicalsigh: After drinking this, your senses will be briefly heightened to incredible levels, allowing you to see through walls in a 12 tile radius!
messages.items.potions.exotic.potionofmastery.wea: Your weapon becomes easier to wield!
messages.items.potions.exotic.potionofmastery.arm: Your armor becomes easier to wear!
messages.items.potions.exotic.potionofmastery.des:
Rather than granting raw strength, this potion will instead attune the muscles of the user to a particular item. This will make that item easier to use, as if the drinker had practised with it and built muscle memory.

The chosen weapon or armor will require 2 less strength to use. This potion can only be used once on each item.
messages.items.potions.exotic.potionofshielding.d: Rather than heal, this potion will instead project a durable shield around the user's body, blocking a considerable amount of damage.
messages.items.potions.exotic.potionofshroudingfo: When exposed to air, the liquid in this flask will produce a thick smoky fog which quickly spreads and blocks the vision of your enemies.
The chemical contained in this potion will rapidly react with the air, instantly freezing and rooting all within its effect.
messages.items.potions.exotic.potionofstamina.des: Drinking this oddly sweet liquid will imbue you with a long-lasting boost of energy, allowing you to run at a quickened pace for an extended period of time.
messages.items.potions.exotic.potionofstormclouds: Throwing this potion will create a quickly-spreading cloud of concentrated vapor, which will condense and pour down onto the environment. Most terrain will be converted to water, fiery enemies will take damage, fire will be doused, and traps will be overwhelmed and break.
messages.items.quest.ceremonialcandle.name: ceremonial candle
messages.items.quest.ceremonialcandle.desc:
A set of candles, melted down and fused together through use.

Alone they are worthless, but used with other candles in a pattern, they can focus the energy for a summoning ritual.
messages.items.quest.ceremonialcandle.discover_hi: You can find this item during a specific quest.
messages.items.quest.corpsedust.name: corpse dust
messages.items.quest.corpsedust.chill: A chill runs down your spine.
messages.items.quest.corpsedust.desc:
The ball of corpse dust doesn't differ outwardly from a regular dust ball. But you can feel a malevolent energy lurking within it.

Getting rid of it as soon as possible would be a good idea.
