messages.items.quest.corpsedust.discover_hint: You can find this item during a specific quest.
messages.items.quest.darkgold.name: dark gold ore
messages.items.quest.darkgold.you_now_have: You now have %d dark gold ore.
messages.items.quest.darkgold.desc: This metal is called dark not because of its color (it doesn't differ from the normal gold), but because it melts under the daylight, making it useless on the surface.
messages.items.quest.darkgold.discover_hint: You can find this item during a specific quest.
messages.items.quest.dwarftoken.name: dwarf token
messages.items.quest.dwarftoken.desc: A strange shaped piece of metal that was being held by a denizen of the dwarven vault. Perhaps it is part of the magic that was binding it to the vault? Best to hold onto it, it might have some use.
messages.items.quest.dwarftoken.desc_old: Many dwarves and some of their larger creations carry these small pieces of metal of unknown purpose. Maybe they are jewelry or maybe some kind of ID. Dwarves are strange folk.
messages.items.quest.dwarftoken.discover_hint: You can find this item during a specific quest.
messages.items.quest.embers.name: elemental embers
messages.items.quest.embers.desc: Special embers which can only be harvested from young fire elementals. They radiate thermal energy.
messages.items.quest.embers.discover_hint: You can find this item during a specific quest.
messages.items.quest.escapecrystal.name: escape crystal
messages.items.quest.escapecrystal.desc: A thin magical spell crystal that seems to contain teleportation magic. You can use the crystal at any time to leave the dwarven vault, but if you leave early you won't get the full reward!
messages.items.quest.escapecrystal.discover_hint: You can find this item during a specific quest.
messages.items.quest.escapecrystal.injure_warning:
Time seems to slow down as you hear the Imp's voice:

"Hey, you seem to be pretty injured, is everything going alright down there? I want my statue but not badly enough for you to die trying to get it!"
"If you're stuck in a nasty situation you can use one of those _teleport items from the starting room_ to escape back there and try again."
"If things are looking really dire, you can _escape using that crystal I gave you._ I'm not going to give you the full reward but it's certainly better than dying!"
messages.items.quest.escapecrystal.injure_confirm: Okay (this message won't appear again in future runs)
messages.items.quest.escapecrystal.leaving_start:
Time seems to slow down as you hear the Imp's voice:

"Listen, I understand if you're nervous but please at least leave the first room!"

"You don't need to worry about your gear, I'm an Imp of my word, I promise it will all be waiting for you when you get back. I also promise that I'll let you use the crystal to escape if you're actually in danger."
messages.items.quest.escapecrystal.leaving_early:
Time seems to slow down as you hear the Imp's voice:

"Really, fleeing already!? You know you can run away from most of the enemies in that place right?"

"Look, if your life is in danger I can pull you out, but I'm not letting you take anything back with you. I expected a lot more from you =("
messages.items.quest.escapecrystal.leaving_partly:
Time seems to slow down and you hear the Imp's voice:

"Oh, are you leaving already? Well I suppose you've helped chart the place out, and that's better than nothing."

"Still, I had expected more from you =(. Of course I'll pull you out if you need me to. I'll let you take something like a potion or scroll with you I suppose."
messages.items.quest.escapecrystal.leaving_fully_:
Time seems to slow down and you hear the Imp's voice:

"Need to leave? Well, you've explored the vault a decent amount at least. I was hoping you'd fare better with actually pilfering it, but I've got a much better idea of how the place works now."

"I'll let you bring something out with you, but nothing magically upgraded!"
messages.items.quest.escapecrystal.leaving_partia:
Time seems to slow down and you hear the Imp's voice:

"I had hoped you might get my statuette, but you have done a great job of exploring and clearing most of the vault!"

"Tell you what, I'll let you keep an item as long as it's not enhanced past +1, and I'll still set up shop further in the dungeon. I'll need some time to plan my next steps anyway."
messages.items.quest.escapecrystal.leaving_victor:
Time seems to slow down and you hear the Imp's voice:

"Excellent work!! Are you ready to leave? I'll take the statue from you when you return."

"As promised I'll set up shop further down and I'll let you take anything you like back out with you! Take your time choosing if you want, everything else will stay inside the vault."
messages.items.quest.escapecrystal.leaving_item: Are you sure this is the item that you want to take with you?
messages.items.quest.escapecrystal.leaving_seal: _The Broken Seal attached to this armor is tied to the mirror and cannot be taken with you._ The seal will be automatically removed from the armor. This will reduce the armor's level by 1 but will not remove any glyph it has.
messages.items.quest.escapecrystal.leaving_staff: _This Mage's Staff is tied to the mirror and cannot be taken with you, but the wand imbued in it can._ The wand will be automatically removed from the staff, and given to you at the staff's level -1.
messages.items.quest.escapecrystal.error_start: It looks like you aren't in the Vault level! This might have happened due to a bug or crash.
messages.items.quest.escapecrystal.error_no_items: None of your items are being stored, so the crystal has been removed from your inventory.
messages.items.quest.escapecrystal.error_with_ite: Your items are currently being stored, so you should attempt to descend into the vault again to begin the quest. Your stored items will be returned to you when the quest ends.
messages.items.quest.gooblob.name: blob of goo
messages.items.quest.gooblob.desc:
A jiggly blob of goop, split off from Goo as it died. It's almost like a big ball of jelly, though you wouldn't dare eat it.

It does nothing on its own, but it might be useful when combined with certain potions, or a bomb. At the very least it should convert into a decent amount of energy.
messages.items.quest.gooblob.discover_hint: You can get this item as a drop from certain enemies.
messages.items.quest.impstatue.name: obsidian statuette
messages.items.quest.impstatue.desc: A small jet-black statue carved out of obsidian. It resembles the Imp who sent you down here, it even has their glowing green eyes. There is an inscription on the base of the statue in a language you've never seen before.
messages.items.quest.impstatue.discover_hint: You can find this item during a specific quest.
messages.items.quest.vaultbeacon.name: vault beacon
messages.items.quest.vaultbeacon.desc:
This beacon of returning spell seems to already have a location set, probably to the entry room you found it in.

You could use it to save time while exploring, or as a way to escape if you're in danger.
messages.items.quest.vaultbeacon.discover_hint: You can find this item during a specific quest.
messages.items.quest.metalshard.name: cursed metal shard
messages.items.quest.metalshard.desc:
A shard of rusted cursed metal, which broke off DM-300 as it was destroyed. You can feel an inactive malevolent magic within it.

It does nothing on its own, but it might be useful when combined with certain scrolls, or a bomb. At the very least it should convert into a decent amount of energy.
messages.items.quest.metalshard.discover_hint: You can get this item as a drop from certain enemies.
messages.items.quest.pickaxe.name: pickaxe
messages.items.quest.pickaxe.ability_desc: The Duelist can _pierce_ an enemy with a pickaxe. This is guaranteed to hit, applies vulnerable for 3 turns, and deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ to enemies with rigid skin.
messages.items.quest.pickaxe.desc: This is a sturdy and heavy tool for breaking rocks. You don't need to equip the pickaxe to mine with it, but it can probably be equipped as a weapon in a pinch.
messages.items.quest.pickaxe.discover_hint: You can find this item during a specific quest.
messages.items.remains.remainsitem.discover_hint: You can find this item in the remains of a specific hero from a previous lost run.
messages.items.remains.bowfragment.name: bow fragment
messages.items.remains.bowfragment.desc: This broken fragment of wood was once part of a lost Huntress' spirit bow. You can still feel a little nature energy left in the fragment, you can use the fragment to grow some high grass around you. Doing this will destroy the fragment however.
messages.items.remains.brokenhilt.name: broken hilt
messages.items.remains.brokenhilt.desc: This broken hilt looks like it came from a defeated Duelist's weapon. You can still feel a little martial power left in the hilt, you can use it to get a little bonus damage on your next two melee hits. Doing this will destroy the hilt however.
messages.items.remains.brokenstaff.name: broken staff
messages.items.remains.brokenstaff.desc: This Mage's staff has been broken in half after its owner met their demise. You can still feel some magical energy left in the staff, you can use it to give your wands a little charge boost. Doing this will destroy the staff however.
messages.items.remains.cloakscrap.name: scrap of fabric
messages.items.remains.cloakscrap.desc: This scrap of translucent fabric looks like it came from a late Rogue's cloak of shadows. You can still feel a little mystical energy left in it, you can use it to give your artifacts a little charge boost. Doing this will destroy the fabric however.
messages.items.remains.sealshard.name: seal shards
messages.items.remains.sealshard.desc: These tiny shards of red wax look like they came from the seal of a fallen Warrior. You can still feel a bit of willpower clinging to the seal, you can use it to give yourself a bit of shielding. Doing this will destroy the seal shards however.
messages.items.remains.tornpage.name: torn page
messages.items.remains.tornpage.desc: This page looks like it was ripped out of an expired Cleric's holy tome. There's still a little divine energy clinging to it, you can use it to regain a little bit of health. Doing this will destroy the torn page however.
messages.items.rings.ring.equip_cursed: The ring tightens around your finger painfully!
messages.items.rings.ring.unknown_desc: This metal band is adorned with a large gem that glitters in the darkness. Who knows what effect it has when worn?
messages.items.rings.ring.identify: You are now familiar enough with your ring to identify it.
messages.items.rings.ring.cursed_worn: Because this ring is cursed, you are powerless to remove it.
messages.items.rings.ring.curse_known: You can feel a malevolent magic lurking within this ring.
messages.items.rings.ring.not_cursed: This ring is free of malevolent magic.
messages.items.rings.ringofaccuracy.name: ring of accuracy
messages.items.rings.ringofaccuracy.stats: When worn, this ring will increase your accuracy by _%s%%._
messages.items.rings.ringofaccuracy.typical_stats: When worn, this ring will typically increase your accuracy by _%s%%._
messages.items.rings.ringofaccuracy.combined_stat: Your equipped rings are combining their power, increasing your accuracy by _%s%%_ in total.
messages.items.rings.ringofaccuracy.desc: This ring increases your focus, making it easier for your attacks to find their mark. A cursed ring will instead make it harder for your attacks to connect.
messages.items.rings.ringofarcana.name: ring of arcana
messages.items.rings.ringofarcana.stats: When worn, this ring will increase the power of enchantments and glyphs by _%s%%._
messages.items.rings.ringofarcana.typical_stats: When worn, this ring will typically increase the power of enchantments and glyphs by _%s%%._
messages.items.rings.ringofarcana.combined_stats: Your equipped rings are combining their power, increasing the power of enchantments and glyphs by _%s%%_ in total.
messages.items.rings.ringofarcana.desc: This ring enhances magical enchantments on weapons and glyphs on armor, including curses! It first increases activation chance, and then increases the strength of the effect once activation chance is 100%. A cursed ring will instead weaken enchantments, glyphs, and curses.
messages.items.rings.ringofelements.name: ring of elements
messages.items.rings.ringofelements.stats: When worn, this ring will provide _%s%%_ elemental resistance.
messages.items.rings.ringofelements.typical_stats: When worn, this ring will typically provide _%s%%_ elemental resistance.
messages.items.rings.ringofelements.combined_stat: Your equipped rings are combining their power, providing _%s%%_ elemental resistance in total.
messages.items.rings.ringofelements.desc: This ring provides resistance to most elemental and magical effects, decreasing damage and debuff duration. Naturally a cursed ring will instead worsen these effects.
messages.items.rings.ringofenergy.name: ring of energy
messages.items.rings.ringofenergy.stats: When worn, this ring will increase wand, artifact, and heroic armor charge speed by _%s%%._
messages.items.rings.ringofenergy.typical_stats: When worn, this ring will typically increase wand, artifact, and heroic armor charge speed by _%s%%._
messages.items.rings.ringofenergy.combined_stats: Your equipped rings are combining their power, increasing charge speed by _%s%%_ in total.
messages.items.rings.ringofenergy.desc: Your magical equipment will recharge more quickly in the arcane field that radiates from this ring. A cursed ring will instead slow recharge.
messages.items.rings.ringofevasion.name: ring of evasion
messages.items.rings.ringofevasion.stats: When worn, this ring will increase your evasion by _%s%%._
messages.items.rings.ringofevasion.typical_stats: When worn, this ring will typically increase your evasion by _%s%%._
messages.items.rings.ringofevasion.combined_stats: Your equipped rings are combining their power, increasing your evasion by _%s%%_ in total.
messages.items.rings.ringofevasion.desc: This ring quickens the wearer's reactions, making it harder to land blows on them. A cursed ring will instead make the user easier to strike.
messages.items.rings.ringofforce.name: ring of force
messages.items.rings.ringofforce.stats: When unarmed, at your current strength, this ring will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage._ With a weapon equipped, this ring will increase damage by _%3$d._
messages.items.rings.ringofforce.typical_stats: When unarmed, at your current strength, typically this ring will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage._ With a weapon equipped, typically this ring will increase damage by _%3$d._
messages.items.rings.ringofforce.combined_stats: Your equipped rings are combining their power, dealing a total of _%1$d-%2$d damage_ without a weapon, or increasing damage by _%3$d_ with one.
messages.items.rings.ringofforce.typical_ability_: The Duelist can adopt a _brawler's stance_ with this ring, causing her regular attacks to always use this ring even with a weapon equipped. These attacks will typically deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and will also inherit the weapon's enchantment and augmentation. This stance slows weapon recharging speed by 50%%.
messages.items.rings.ringofforce.ability_desc: The Duelist can adopt a _brawler's stance_ with this ring, causing her regular attacks to always use this ring even with a weapon equipped. These attacks will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and will also inherit the weapon's enchantment and augmentation. This stance slows weapon recharging speed by 50%%.
messages.items.rings.ringofforce.desc: This ring enhances the force of the wearer's melee blows. This extra power is fairly weak when wielding weapons, but an unarmed attack will be made much stronger. A cursed ring will instead weaken the wearer's blows.
messages.items.rings.ringofforce$brawlersstance.d:
While in this stance the Duelist's regular attacks will use an equipped ring of force even when she has a weapon equipped. These attacks gain bonus damage and will still use the weapon's augmentation and enchantment.

Maintaining this stance takes focus however, reducing weapon ability recharge speed by 50%.

This stance can be toggled on or off by using a ring of force, but the reduction in charge speed will persist for a little while if the stance is quickly activated and deactivated.
messages.items.rings.ringoffuror.name: ring of furor
messages.items.rings.ringoffuror.stats: When worn, this ring will increase the speed of your attacks by _%s%%._
messages.items.rings.ringoffuror.typical_stats: When worn, this ring will typically increase the speed of your attacks by _%s%%._
messages.items.rings.ringoffuror.combined_stats: Your equipped rings are combining their power, increasing the speed of your attacks by _%s%%_ in total.
messages.items.rings.ringoffuror.desc: This ring grants the wearer an inner fury, allowing them to attack more rapidly. A cursed ring will instead slow the wearer's speed of attack.
messages.items.rings.ringofhaste.name: ring of haste
messages.items.rings.ringofhaste.stats: When worn, this ring will increase your movement speed by _%s%%._
messages.items.rings.ringofhaste.typical_stats: When worn, this ring will typically increase your movement speed by _%s%%._
messages.items.rings.ringofhaste.combined_stats: Your equipped rings are combining their power, increasing your movement speed by _%s%%_ in total.
messages.items.rings.ringofhaste.desc: This ring reduces the stress of movement on the wearer, allowing them to run at superhuman speeds. A cursed ring will instead weigh the wearer down.
messages.items.rings.ringofmight.name: ring of might
messages.items.rings.ringofmight.stats: When worn, this ring will increase your strength by _%1$d_ and your max HP by _%2$s%%._
messages.items.rings.ringofmight.typical_stats: When worn, this ring will typically increase your strength by _%1$d_ and your max HP by _%2$s%%._
messages.items.rings.ringofmight.combined_stats: Your equipped rings are combining their power, boosting your strength by _%1$d_ and max HP by _%2$s%%_ in total.
messages.items.rings.ringofmight.desc: This ring enhances the physical traits of the wearer, granting them greater physical strength and constitution. A cursed ring will weaken the wearer.
messages.items.rings.ringofsharpshooting.name: ring of sharpshooting
messages.items.rings.ringofsharpshooting.stats: When worn, this ring will boost the damage of your thrown weapons as if their level was increased by _%1$d_, and will increase their durability by _%2$s%%._
messages.items.rings.ringofsharpshooting.typical_: When worn, this ring will typically boost the damage of your thrown weapons as if their level was increased by _%1$d_ and will increase their durability by _%2$s%%._
messages.items.rings.ringofsharpshooting.combined: Your equipped rings are combining their power, boosting effective thrown weapon level by _%1$d_ and increasing their durability by _%2$s%%_ in total.
messages.items.rings.ringofsharpshooting.desc: This ring enhances the wearer's precision and aim, which will make all projectile weapons more damaging and durable. A cursed ring will have the opposite effect.
messages.items.rings.ringoftenacity.name: ring of tenacity
messages.items.rings.ringoftenacity.stats: When worn, this ring will reduce the damage you take by up to _%s%%._
messages.items.rings.ringoftenacity.typical_stats: When worn, this ring will typically reduce the damage you take by up to _%s%%._
messages.items.rings.ringoftenacity.combined_stat: Your equipped rings are combining their power, reducing the damage you take by up to _%s%%_ in total.
messages.items.rings.ringoftenacity.desc: When worn, this ring will allow the wearer to resist normally mortal strikes. The more injured the user is, the more resistant they will be to damage. A cursed ring will instead make it easier for enemies to execute the wearer.
messages.items.rings.ringofwealth.name: ring of wealth
messages.items.rings.ringofwealth.stats: When worn, this ring will increase your luck by _%s%%._
messages.items.rings.ringofwealth.typical_stats: When worn, this ring will typically increase your luck by _%s%%._
messages.items.rings.ringofwealth.combined_stats: Your equipped rings are combining their power, increasing your luck by _%s%%_ in total.
messages.items.rings.ringofwealth.desc: This ring acts like a magnet for treasure, increasing the likelihood that enemies and containers will be carrying valuable items. A cursed ring will instead reduce your chance of receiving loot.
messages.items.scrolls.scroll.unknown_desc: An indecipherable magical rune is written on this parchment. Who knows what it will do when read aloud?
messages.items.scrolls.scroll.blinded: You can't read a scroll while blinded.
messages.items.scrolls.scroll.no_magic: You can't read a scroll while magic immune.
messages.items.scrolls.scroll.cursed: Your cursed spellbook prevents you from invoking this scroll's magic! A scroll of remove curse might be strong enough to still work though...
messages.items.scrolls.scroll$placeholder.name: scroll
messages.items.scrolls.inventoryscroll.warning: Do you really want to cancel this scroll usage? The scroll wasn't previously identified, so it will be consumed anyway.
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofidentify.name: scroll of identify
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofidentify.desc: This scroll permanently reveals all of the secrets of a single item.
messages.items.scrolls.scrolloflullaby.name: scroll of lullaby
messages.items.scrolls.scrolloflullaby.sooth: The scroll utters a soothing melody. You feel very sleepy.
messages.items.scrolls.scrolloflullaby.desc: Reading this scroll emits a soothing melody which will lull all who hear it into a deep magical sleep. For the reader and their allies the sleep is restorative.
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofmagicmapping.name: scroll of magic mapping
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofmagicmapping.layou: You are now aware of the level layout.
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofmagicmapping.desc: When this scroll is read, an image of crystal clarity will be etched into your memory, alerting you to the precise layout of the level and revealing all hidden secrets. The locations of items and creatures will remain unknown.
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofmirrorimage.name: scroll of mirror image
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofmirrorimage.copies: The scroll forms mirror images of you.
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofmirrorimage.no_cop: The scroll attempts to create mirror images of you, but they have nowhere to go.
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofmirrorimage.desc: The incantation on this scroll will create two illusory twins of the reader. These mirror images act as weaker clones of the reader, and will chase down their enemies. They have no durability however, and will fade upon taking damage.
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofretribution.name: scroll of retribution
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofretribution.blast: Powerful magical energy erupts from the scroll!
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofretribution.desc:
This scroll contains destructive energy which channels the reader's suffering outward into a blast of power. The weaker the reader is, the more damage they will deal. At very low health this scroll can kill most enemies instantly.

Using the scroll takes a toll on the user however, blinding and weakening them.
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofrage.name: scroll of rage
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofrage.roar: The scroll emits an enraging roar that echoes throughout the dungeon!
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofrage.desc: When read aloud, this scroll will unleash a great roar that draws all enemies to the reader, and enrages nearby ones.
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofrecharging.name: scroll of recharging
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofrecharging.surge: A surge of energy courses through your body, invigorating your wands!
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofrecharging.desc: The raw magical power bound up in this parchment will charge up all the user's wands over time when released.
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofremovecurse.name: scroll of remove curse
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofremovecurse.cleans: Your item glows with a cleansing light, and a malevolent energy disperses!
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofremovecurse.not_cl: Your item glows with a cleansing light, but nothing happens.
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofremovecurse.spirit: Your scroll frees the tormented spirit!
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofremovecurse.desc: The incantation on this scroll will instantly strip any curses from a single weapon, ring, wand, armor, or artifact.
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofteleportation.name: scroll of teleportation
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofteleportation.tele: In a blink of an eye you were teleported to another location of the level.
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofteleportation.desc: The spell on this parchment instantly transports the reader to a different location on the dungeon level. The scroll prioritizes areas the reader hasn't been to before, though it is not able to teleport past locked doors or barricades. It can, however, reveal hidden doors that lead to new areas.
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofterror.name: scroll of terror
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofterror.none: The scroll emits a brilliant flash of red light.
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofterror.one: The scroll emits a brilliant flash of red light and the %s flees!
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofterror.many: The scroll emits a brilliant flash of red light and the monsters flee!
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofterror.desc: When read, this scroll will emit a flash of red light that will overwhelm all enemies in your field of view with terror, and they will turn and flee. Attacking a fleeing enemy will shorten the effect.
messages.items.scrolls.scrolloftransmutation.name: scroll of transmutation
messages.items.scrolls.scrolloftransmutation.morp: Your item morphs into something different!
messages.items.scrolls.scrolloftransmutation.desc: This scroll contains powerful transmutation magic. When used on an eligible item it will transform it into a different item of the same type. The magic will even preserve upgrades, enchantments, and glyphs. Scrolls and potions will be transmuted into their exotic equivalent, and vice-versa.
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofupgrade.name: scroll of upgrade
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofupgrade.weaken_cur: The scroll of upgrade weakens the curse on your item.
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofupgrade.remove_cur: The scroll of upgrade cleanses the curse on your item!
messages.items.scrolls.scrollofupgrade.desc:
This scroll will upgrade a single item or set of thrown weapons. Wands will increase in power and number of charges, weapons and armor will deal and block more damage, thrown weapon sets will be fully repaired and more durable, and the effects of rings will intensify.

It can even weaken or sometimes totally dispel curses, though it is not as potent as a scroll of remove curse. Unfortunately, the upgrading magic can also erase enchantments or glyphs on higher level gear.
messages.items.scrolls.exotic.exoticscroll.unknow: A glowing indecipherable magical rune is written on this black parchment. It seems to be foreign to this land, who knows what it will do when read aloud?
messages.items.scrolls.exotic.exoticscroll.discov: You can craft this item via alchemy.
The scroll activates without a target.

Reading this scroll emits an alluring melody which will enthrall a targeted enemy, permanently turning them into an ally! Other enemies who hear it will be temporarily charmed.

Particularly strong enemies can resist the enthrall effect, and will be charmed instead.
messages.items.scrolls.exotic.scrollofsirenssong$:
This creature has been bewitched by the magic of a scroll of siren's song.

An enthralled character is permanently your ally, and will fight any enemies they encounter.
messages.items.scrolls.exotic.scrollofantimagic.d: The incantation on this scroll will surround you with a magical aura that temporarily blocks all magical effects, harmful or helpful. This includes most magical item effects such as wands, scrolls, rings, artifacts, enchantments, and curses. Heroic armor abilities are strong enough to work regardless however.
messages.items.scrolls.exotic.scrollofchallenge.d:
When read aloud, this scroll will unleash a great roar that draws enemies to the user while simultaneously creating a small arena around them.

As long as the reader stays in this arena they will take 33% less damage from all sources (this is applied before other forms of damage reduction), and they will not lose satiety.

The size of the arena will scale with the size of the area the reader is in. It will be particularly small in some boss areas.
messages.items.scrolls.exotic.scrollofchallenge$c:
A magical arena has appeared around you, denoted by a billowing red fog.

While standing in the fog, your hunger will not increase and you will take 33%% less damage from all sources. If you have any other sources of damage reduction (such as armor), they will apply after the 33%% reduction.

Turns remaining: %d.
There is nothing left to identify!

This scroll will randomly identify four types of item that you don't currently know. The types identified can be a potion's color, a scroll's rune, or a ring's gem. The items identified won't necessarily be ones you're carrying.
messages.items.scrolls.exotic.scrollofdivination$: Your scroll of divination has identified the following items:
messages.items.scrolls.exotic.scrollofdread.name: scroll of dread
messages.items.scrolls.exotic.scrollofdread.desc:
When read, this scroll will emit a flash of red light that will instill incredible terror in all enemies in your field of view. So great is this effect that they will rapidly try to flee from the entire dungeon, never to be seen again!

Just like with terror, this effect can expire with time, or if the enemy is attacked.

Strong-willed enemies, such as bosses, will be inflicted with regular terror instead.
messages.items.scrolls.exotic.scrollofenchantment: Select an enchantment to apply to your weapon.
Select a glyph to apply to your armor.
Cancelling will still consume your scroll of enchantment, are you sure?
This scroll will infuse a weapon or armor with powerful magical energy. The reader even has some degree of control over which magic is imbued.
messages.items.scrolls.exotic.scrollofforesight.d: After reading this scroll, the detail of nearby terrain will be constantly fed to the reader's mind in crystal clarity. This effect lasts for a considerable amount of time, and will reveal all hidden doors or traps, making searching unnecessary.
messages.items.scrolls.exotic.scrollofmetamorphos: Choose a new talent to replace your metamorphosed talent with.
Cancelling will still consume your scroll of metamorphosis, are you sure?

This scroll contains powerful transmutation magic, which will apply to the caster instead of to an item. The magic of this scroll will let you select one talent, and replace it with one of five talents of the same tier from different hero classes!

This effect can only apply to class talents, not talents gained from subclasses or armor abilities. Talents that you cannot use will not be given as options.
messages.items.scrolls.exotic.scrollofmysticalene: The raw magical power bound up in this parchment will, when released, charge a user's equipped artifacts over time.
messages.items.scrolls.exotic.scrollofpassage.des: The spell on this parchment instantly transports the reader to the nearest region first floor above them. Very handy for quickly getting to a shop.
messages.items.scrolls.exotic.scrollofprismaticim:
The incantation on this scroll will create a colorful illusory twin of the reader. This prismatic image acts as a weaker clone of the reader, with similar defence but lower hp and damage.

The prismatic image will show itself when enemies are present, and will attempt to defend the reader.

If a prismatic image already exists, using this scroll will fully heal it.
messages.items.scrolls.exotic.scrollofpsionicblas: The Psionic Blast tears your mind apart...

This scroll contains incredible destructive energy that can be channeled to destroy the minds of all visible creatures.

There is significant feedback however, and the reader will also be damaged, blinded, and weakened. The more targets the scroll hits, the less self-damage will be taken.
messages.items.spells.alchemize.name: alchemize
messages.items.spells.alchemize.desc:
This spell contains transmutative powers similar to those found in an alchemy pot. Each cast allows the user to turn an item (or stack of items) into gold or alchemical energy. Turning potions or scrolls into energy will even identify them!

A few Alchemize uses are sold from shops, but many more can be made using alchemy by combining a seed, runestone, and a little alchemical energy.
messages.items.spells.beaconofreturning.name: beacon of returning
messages.items.spells.beaconofreturning.preventin: The strong magic aura of this place prevents you from using the spell!
messages.items.spells.beaconofreturning.creatures: The Psychic aura of neighbouring creatures doesn't allow you to teleport at this moment.
messages.items.spells.beaconofreturning.set: The beacon was set at your current location.
messages.items.spells.beaconofreturning.wnd_body:
Setting will override the location the beacon was previously set to.

Returning will return to your last set location and consume one use of the spell.
messages.items.spells.beaconofreturning.desc_set: This beacon was set somewhere on floor %d.
messages.items.spells.beaconofreturning.desc: This intricate spell grants the user the ability to return to a set location, regardless of distance. The spell will only be consumed by returning, it can be set as many times as you like, but it will only remember the most recent location it was set to.
messages.items.spells.curseinfusion.name: curse infusion
messages.items.spells.curseinfusion.desc:
This spell infuses a piece of equipment with the same powerful malignant magic present within DM-300. The item it is used on will immediately be cursed, and any enchantment or glyph it may have had will be overridden.

In the case of weapons, armor, and wands, the item will gain upgrades in addition to being cursed. Curse infusion upgrades do not stack, and the upgrades are lost if the item becomes uncursed.

Multiple curse infusions can also be used to change the curse on a weapon or armor.
messages.items.spells.spell.no_magic: You can't cast spells while magic immune.
messages.items.spells.spell.discover_hint: You can craft this item via alchemy.
messages.items.spells.magicalinfusion.name: magical infusion
messages.items.spells.magicalinfusion.infuse: Your item is infused with arcane energy!
messages.items.spells.magicalinfusion.desc:
This spell possesses the same magical power as a scroll of upgrade, but in a more stable form.

In addition to upgrading an item as normal it will never erase an enchantment, glyph, or curse.
messages.items.spells.magicalporter.name: magical porter
messages.items.spells.magicalporter.nowhere: There is nowhere for you to port an item to.
messages.items.spells.magicalporter.desc: This spell will magically transport any item it is cast on. Unlike a merchant's beacon however, the items will be transported to the entrance of the next boss floor.
messages.items.spells.phaseshift.name: phase shift
messages.items.spells.phaseshift.no_target: There is nothing to teleport there.
messages.items.spells.phaseshift.desc: This chaotic spell will teleport any character it is aimed at to a random location on the current floor, and stun them for a significant amount of time. Powerful foes will be able to resist the stunning effect. This spell can be directed at a target or at the user themselves.
messages.items.spells.reclaimtrap.name: reclaim trap
messages.items.spells.reclaimtrap.desc_trap: The spell is currently ready to trigger a _%s._
messages.items.spells.reclaimtrap.desc:
This spell contains remnants of the mechanical energy of DM-300. When cast on an active trap, the power of the trap will become attached to you, allowing you to use the spell again to expel this power and trigger the trap's effect at any location you like.

However, some traps may not function in all places, and only one trap can be stored at a time.
messages.items.spells.recycle.name: recycle
messages.items.spells.recycle.desc: This spell contains a lesser form of transmutation magic. While it won't work on equipment, this spell will transform a scroll, potion, seed, runestone, or tipped dart into a random item of the same type.
messages.items.spells.summonelemental.name: summon elemental
messages.items.spells.summonelemental.desc: This spell channels the energy of the elemental embers used to make it, and will allow you to summon a friendly elemental to fight with you! Only one elemental can be summoned at a time, but the spell can be re-cast to return the elemental to you at no cost.
messages.items.spells.summonelemental.desc_newbor: The spell is currently unimbued, and will summon a _newborn elemental_ without a ranged attack. You can imbue an identified potion of liquid flame, potion of frost, scroll of recharging, or scroll of transmutation to power the spell up, causing future summons to be a full power elemental!
messages.items.spells.summonelemental.desc_fire: The spell is currently hot to the touch, it will summon a _fire elemental_. You can imbue a different item, but the spell will lose its current imbue.
messages.items.spells.summonelemental.desc_frost: The spell is currently cold to the touch, it will summon a _frost elemental_. You can imbue a different item, but the spell will lose its current imbue.
messages.items.spells.summonelemental.desc_shock: The spell is currently radiating static energy, it will summon a _shock elemental_. You can imbue a different item, but the spell will lose its current imbue.
messages.items.spells.summonelemental.desc_chaos: The spell is currently radiating chaotic energy, it will summon a _chaos elemental_. You can imbue a different item, but the spell will lose its current imbue.
messages.items.spells.telekineticgrab.name: telekinetic grab
messages.items.spells.telekineticgrab.desc:
This spell allows the caster to remotely grab all items at a location, or all thrown weapons stuck to an enemy!

It can't be used to grab items that someone else owns, or to grab containers like chests.
messages.items.spells.unstablespell.name: unstable spell
messages.items.spells.unstablespell.desc:
This small black square crystal has shifting runic symbols on each of its surfaces.

When activated, it will trigger the effect of a random scroll. The scroll effect will always be combat focused if there are enemies in your field of view, and will always be non-combat focused otherwise.
messages.items.spells.wildenergy.name: wild energy
messages.items.spells.wildenergy.desc: This spell contains some of the cursed energy which powered DM-300. When cast, it will recharge your wands and worn artifacts, while also triggering a random cursed wand effect. You are able to choose a direction for this cursed magic to shoot in, however.
messages.items.stones.runestone$placeholder.name: runestone
messages.items.stones.runestone.discover_hint: You can find this item randomly in the dungeon, or craft it via alchemy.
messages.items.stones.stoneofaggression.name: stone of aggression
messages.items.stones.stoneofaggression.desc:
When this stone is thrown at an ally or enemy, all nearby enemies will prefer to attack that character for a short time.

Boss enemies cannot be targeted by this effect directly, but it does work on their minions.
messages.items.stones.stoneofaggression$aggressio:
Manipulative magic is making all nearby enemies prefer to attack this character.

Turns remaining: %s.
messages.items.stones.stoneofaugmentation.name: stone of augmentation
messages.items.stones.stoneofaugmentation.desc:
This runestone possesses potent magic which can augment equipment to enhance one property at the cost of another.

Using on a weapon will allow you to enhance either speed or damage. Thrown weapons will also gain or lose durability in proportion with their speed.

Using on armor will allow you to enhance either defense or evasion.
messages.items.stones.stoneofaugmentation.discove: You can buy this item in a shop, or craft it via alchemy.
messages.items.stones.stoneofaugmentation$wndaugm: Augmenting for one property will reduce the other. What property would you like to enhance?
This item is already augmented, you can swap the augment or remove it.
messages.items.stones.stoneofblast.name: stone of blast
messages.items.stones.stoneofblast.desc: This runestone will instantly explode at the location it is thrown to. Just like a bomb, the explosion will deal damage to anything nearby.
messages.items.stones.stoneofblink.name: stone of blink
messages.items.stones.stoneofblink.desc: This runestone will teleport the user to the location it is thrown to.
messages.items.stones.stoneofclairvoyance.name: stone of clairvoyance
messages.items.stones.stoneofclairvoyance.desc: This stone will instantly reveal all tiles in a very wide area around where it is thrown. Its effect will even reach through walls.
messages.items.stones.stoneofdeepsleep.name: stone of deep sleep
messages.items.stones.stoneofdeepsleep.desc: When this stone is thrown at an enemy, it will put them into a deep magical sleep. Magically slept enemies will sleep forever until disturbed.
messages.items.stones.stoneofdetectmagic.name: stone of detect magic
messages.items.stones.stoneofdetectmagic.detected: You don't detect any magic affecting this item.
You detect both positive and malevolent magic affecting this item!
You detect positive magic affecting this item!
You detect malevolent magic affecting this item!
messages.items.stones.stoneofdetectmagic.desc: This runestone is able to detect magic affecting an item. Using this stone on an unidentified item will tell you if it is affected by a malevolent curse and whether it is affected by positive magic such as an enchantment or upgrades.
messages.items.stones.stoneofdisarming.name: stone of disarming
messages.items.stones.stoneofdisarming.desc: This runestone holds magic that can disable malicious traps hidden throughout the dungeon. It will disarm up to 9 traps around the area it is thrown at.
messages.items.stones.stoneofenchantment.name: stone of enchantment
messages.items.stones.stoneofenchantment.weapon: Your weapon glows in the darkness!
messages.items.stones.stoneofenchantment.armor: Your armor glows in the darkness!
messages.items.stones.stoneofenchantment.desc: This runestone possesses enchanting magic. Unlike a scroll of upgrade, it will not increase the direct power of an item, but will instead imbue a weapon or armor with an enchantment, granting it a new power.
messages.items.stones.stoneoffear.name: stone of fear
messages.items.stones.stoneoffear.desc: When this stone is thrown onto a character they will be overwhelmed with terror, and will turn and flee. Attacking a fleeing character will shorten the effect.
messages.items.stones.stoneofflock.name: stone of flock
messages.items.stones.stoneofflock.desc: This runestone summons magical sheep for a short time around the location it is thrown to.
messages.items.stones.stoneofintuition.name: stone of intuition
messages.items.stones.stoneofintuition.desc: This runestone holds a weaker version of the magic found in scrolls of identification. Rather than directly identifying an item, it will work on your intuition, allowing you to attempt to identify the type of a potion, scroll, or ring by guessing.
messages.items.stones.stoneofintuition.break_info: You can use stones of intuition twice before one breaks, _your next use won't consume a stone_.
messages.items.stones.stoneofintuition.break_warn: You've used a stone of intuition previously, so _your next use will consume a stone_.
messages.items.stones.stoneofintuition$wndguess.t: Guess what the type of the unidentified item is. If you guess correctly, the type will be identified!
messages.items.stones.stoneofintuition$wndguess.c: Correct. The item's type has been identified!
messages.items.stones.stoneofintuition$wndguess.b: Your stone of intuition crumbles to dust...
messages.items.stones.stoneofshock.name: stone of shock
messages.items.stones.stoneofshock.desc: This runestone unleashes a blast of electrical energy which briefly stuns all nearby targets, and grants the thrower wand charge for each target hit.
messages.items.trinkets.chaoticcenser.name: chaotic censer
messages.items.trinkets.chaoticcenser.spew: Your censer is about to spew: %s.
messages.items.trinkets.chaoticcenser.desc: After some time in the alchemy pot this incense-burning censer appears to be producing smoke all on its own! These gasses build up and will spew forth from the censer toward enemies at semi-random intervals. It seems capable of producing all sorts of gasses, but you'll get a moment of warning just before the censer activates.
messages.items.trinkets.chaoticcenser.typical_sta: Typically this trinket will spawn a harmful gas near an enemy roughly every _%d_ turns. Gasses will only appear when enemies are present. At higher levels these gases are more likely to be exotic and powerful.
messages.items.trinkets.chaoticcenser.stats_desc: At its current level, this trinket will spawn a harmful gas near an enemy roughly every _%d_ turns. Gasses will only appear when enemies are present. At higher levels these gases are more likely to be exotic and powerful.
messages.items.trinkets.crackedspyglass.name: cracked spyglass
messages.items.trinkets.crackedspyglass.desc: This handheld telescope would be a demonstration of great and precise workmanship, if it weren't for the crack along its front lens. The spyglass seems to be helping you by revealing new items in the dungeon, but due to its flaw the revealed items are quite hard to see!
messages.items.trinkets.crackedspyglass.typical_s: Typically this trinket has a _%1$s%% chance_ to create an extra hidden item on each non-boss floor.
messages.items.trinkets.crackedspyglass.stats_des: At its current level, this trinket has a _%1$s%% chance_ to create an extra hidden item on each non-boss floor.
At its current level, this trinket has a _100%% chance_ to create an extra hidden item on each non-boss floor, and a _%1$s%% chance_ to create a second extra hidden item.
messages.items.trinkets.dimensionalsundial.name: dimensional sundial
messages.items.trinkets.dimensionalsundial.warnin: Your sundial isn't casting a shadow, you feel uneasy.
messages.items.trinkets.dimensionalsundial.desc: This small handheld sundial is somehow able to cast a shadow in the depths of the dungeon, even if you aren't holding it upright. Even more strangely, the shadow's position seems to have no relation to the sun in this world. When no shadow is cast, the sundial seems to attract danger.
messages.items.trinkets.dimensionalsundial.typica: Typically this trinket will reduce the spawning rate of enemies by _%1$d%%_ during the daytime in real life (8am-8pm), and increase the spawning rate of enemies by _%2$d%%_ at nighttime (8pm-8am).
messages.items.trinkets.dimensionalsundial.stats_: At its current level, this trinket will reduce the spawning rate of enemies by _%1$d%%_ during the daytime in real life (8am-8pm), and increase the spawning rate of enemies by _%2$d%%_ at nighttime (8pm-8am).
messages.items.trinkets.exoticcrystals.name: exotic crystals
messages.items.trinkets.exoticcrystals.desc: These small pink crystals have the same shape as crystals of alchemical energy. While they can't be used for energy directly, they seem to be somehow influencing the potions and scrolls you find.
messages.items.trinkets.exoticcrystals.typical_st: Typically this trinket will replace _%s%%_ of potion or scroll drops with their exotic equivalents. This does not affect potions of strength, scrolls of upgrade, or items that are generated to help solve hazard rooms.
messages.items.trinkets.exoticcrystals.stats_desc: At its current level this trinket will replace _%s%%_ of potion or scroll drops with their exotic equivalents. This does not affect potions of strength, scrolls of upgrade, or items that are generated to help solve hazard rooms.
messages.items.trinkets.eyeofnewt.name: eye of newt
messages.items.trinkets.eyeofnewt.desc: This golden and black newt's eye is a common ingredient, now enhanced into a trinket. The eye seems to be reducing your vision in exchange for letting you see things in other ways.
messages.items.trinkets.eyeofnewt.typical_stats_d: Typically this trinket will reduce your vision range by _%1$s%%_, but will also grant you mind vision on enemies within _%2$d_ tiles.
messages.items.trinkets.eyeofnewt.stats_desc: At its current level this trinket will reduce your vision range by _%1$s%%_, but will also grant you mind vision on enemies within _%2$d_ tiles.
messages.items.trinkets.ferrettuft.name: ferret tuft
messages.items.trinkets.ferrettuft.desc: A tuft of silky white ferret fur, held together by a Lime green ribbon tied into a bow. Ferrets are known for their agility, mischievousness, and lack of integrity. Some of that power seems to radiate from the trinket, enhancing the evasion of anything nearby.
messages.items.trinkets.ferrettuft.typical_stats_: Typically this trinket will increase the evasion of all characters by _%1$s%%_.
messages.items.trinkets.ferrettuft.stats_desc: At its current level this trinket will increase the evasion of all characters by _%1$s%%_.
messages.items.trinkets.mimictooth.name: mimic tooth
messages.items.trinkets.mimictooth.desc: This large sharp tooth must have been pulled from a very unhappy mimic. It seems to be influencing the mimics of the dungeon, making them more frequent and dangerous.
messages.items.trinkets.mimictooth.typical_stats_: Typically this trinket will make all kinds of mimic _%1$sx_ more common and much more difficult to detect, but will also increase the amount of loot they drop. Each dungeon floor will also have a _%2$s%%_ chance to contain an extra stealthy ebony mimic.
messages.items.trinkets.mimictooth.stats_desc: At its current level this trinket will make all kinds of mimic _%1$sx_ more common and much more difficult to detect, but will also increase the amount of loot they drop. Each dungeon floor will also have a _%2$s%%_ chance to contain an extra stealthy ebony mimic.
messages.items.trinkets.mossyclump.name: mossy clump
messages.items.trinkets.mossyclump.desc: This clump of wet moss seems to hold onto its moisture no matter how hard you squeeze it. It seems to be magically tied to the dungeon itself, making grass and water more likely to appear.
messages.items.trinkets.mossyclump.typical_stats_:
Typically this trinket will make _%d%%_ of unthemed floors become filled with either water or grass instead.

This trinket costs a larger amount of energy to upgrade.
messages.items.trinkets.mossyclump.stats_desc:
At its current level this trinket will make _%d%%_ of unthemed floors become filled with either water or grass instead.

This trinket costs a larger amount of energy to upgrade.
messages.items.trinkets.parchmentscrap.name: parchment scrap
messages.items.trinkets.parchmentscrap.desc: This little scrap of parchment looks like it came from a scroll. It has retained some of its magic, and it seems to be influencing weapons and armor found in the dungeon.
messages.items.trinkets.parchmentscrap.typical_st:
Typically this trinket will make enchantments and glyphs _%dx_ as common, and curses on weapons and armor _%sx_ as common. Curses on wands, rings, or artifacts are not affected.

This trinket costs a larger amount of energy to upgrade.
messages.items.trinkets.parchmentscrap.stats_desc:
At its current level this trinket will make enchantments and glyphs _%dx_ as common, and curses on weapons and armor _%sx_ as common. Curses on wands, rings, or artifacts are not affected.

This trinket costs a larger amount of energy to upgrade.
messages.items.trinkets.petrifiedseed.name: petrified seed
messages.items.trinkets.petrifiedseed.desc: This seed has been fossilised, either by slow geological processes or by magic. The seed seems to be magically influencing the flora of the dungeon, occasionally replacing plant seeds with runestones.
messages.items.trinkets.petrifiedseed.typical_sta: Typically this trinket will cause trampled grass to drop runestones instead of seeds _%1$s%%_ of the time, and will also cause high grass to drop items _%2$s%%_ more often.
messages.items.trinkets.petrifiedseed.stats_desc: At its current level this trinket will cause trampled grass to drop runestones instead of seeds _%1$s%%_ of the time, and will also cause high grass to drop items _%2$s%%_ more often.
messages.items.trinkets.ratskull.name: rat skull
messages.items.trinkets.ratskull.desc: This macabre trinket isn't much larger than the skull of a normal rat, which is somehow a rarity down in this dungeon. The skull's magical influence seems to attract the more rare denizens of the dungeon, making them appear far more often.
messages.items.trinkets.ratskull.typical_stats_de: Typically this trinket will make rare exotic enemies _%dx_ as likely to appear. The skull is only half as effective at attracting crystal mimics and armored statues, however.
messages.items.trinkets.ratskull.stats_desc: At its current level this trinket will make rare exotic enemies _%dx_ as likely to appear. The skull is only half as effective at attracting crystal mimics and armored statues, however.
messages.items.trinkets.saltcube.name: salt cube
messages.items.trinkets.saltcube.desc: This large salt crystal was cut into an almost perfect cube shape, and it somehow managed to drain half the water from the alchemy pot instead of dissolving. It seems to be magically dehydrating and preserving the food you eat, extending the satiety you get, but also lessening your health restoration when not starving.
messages.items.trinkets.saltcube.typical_stats_de: Typically this trinket will increase the amount of time before you grow hungry by _%1$s%%_, but will also reduce your rate of health regeneration by _%2$s%%_ unless the floor is locked.
messages.items.trinkets.saltcube.stats_desc: At its current level this trinket will increase the amount of time before you grow hungry by _%1$s%%_, but will also reduce your rate of health regeneration by _%2$s%%_ unless the floor is locked.
messages.items.trinkets.shardofoblivion.name: shard of oblivion
messages.items.trinkets.shardofoblivion.desc: After stewing in the alchemy pot, this small shard of cursed metal has changed to be made of... nothing? Light seems to bend around it, and it hovers in place when you aren't holding it. The shard seems to be magically drawing power from your ignorance, so it's probably best to not think about it too much.
messages.items.trinkets.shardofoblivion.typical_s: Typically this trinket will increase the rate that enemies drop loot by 20%% for each piece of unidentified equipment you have equipped or recently used, to a max of _%d item(s)_. The shard will also prevent you from identifying equipment, but can be used to manually identify items that are ready for it.
messages.items.trinkets.shardofoblivion.stats_des: At its current level this trinket will increase the rate that enemies drop loot by 20%% for each piece of unidentified equipment you have equipped or recently used, to a max of _%d item(s)_. The shard will also prevent you from identifying equipment, but can be used to manually identify items that are ready for it.
messages.items.trinkets.shardofoblivion.identify_: An item is ready to identify: %s. Use your Shard of Oblivion on it to identify it.
Your worn items are now all ready to identify. Use your Shard of Oblivion on items to identify them.
That item isn't ready to be identified yet.
messages.items.trinkets.shardofoblivion$wandusetr:
You have recently used an unidentified wand, which counts as one piece of used unidentified equipment for the shard of oblivion for a little while.

Turns remaining: %s.
messages.items.trinkets.shardofoblivion$thrownuse:
You have recently used an unidentified thrown weapon, which counts as one piece of used unidentified equipment for the shard of oblivion for a little while.

Turns remaining: %s.
messages.items.trinkets.thirteenleafclover.name: thirteen leaf clover
messages.items.trinkets.thirteenleafclover.desc: Somehow stewing in the alchemy pot has caused this clover to grow a bunch of extra leaves! It's not really clear if this trinket is lucky or unlucky, perhaps this trinket will make your luck more chaotic?
messages.items.trinkets.thirteenleafclover.typica: Typically this trinket will cause you to deal maximum damage _%1$d%%_ of the time, and minimum damage _%2$d%%_ of the time.
messages.items.trinkets.thirteenleafclover.stats_: At its current level this trinket will cause you to deal maximum damage _%1$d%%_ of the time, and minimum damage _%2$d%%_ of the time.
messages.items.trinkets.trapmechanism.name: trap mechanism
messages.items.trinkets.trapmechanism.desc: The core mechanism of one of the dungeon's pitfall traps, carefully carved out of the floor so it can be carried. It seems to be magically tied to the dungeon itself, making hazardous terrain more common but also increasing your affinity towards it.
messages.items.trinkets.trapmechanism.typical_sta: Typically this trinket will make _%1$d%%_ of unthemed floors become filled with either traps or chasms instead. Additionally, _%2$d%%_ of the dungeon's hidden traps will instead be visible.
messages.items.trinkets.trapmechanism.stats_desc: At its current level this trinket will make _%1$d%%_ of unthemed floors become filled with either traps or chasms instead. Additionally, _%2$d%%_ of the dungeon's hidden traps will instead be visible.
messages.items.trinkets.vialofblood.name: vial of blood
messages.items.trinkets.vialofblood.desc: This thin vial contains the blood of some denizen of the dungeon, it moves slowly as you rotate the vial. It seems to be magically enhancing stronger healing effects, but also delaying them.
messages.items.trinkets.vialofblood.typical_stats: Typically this trinket will increase the overall health you gain from drinking potions of healing, waterskins, or wells of health by _%1$s%%_. However, these healing effects will also occur more slowly, regenerating a maximum of _%2$s_ HP per turn (this scales with hero level).
messages.items.trinkets.vialofblood.stats_desc: At its current level this trinket will increase the overall health you gain from drinking potions of healing, waterskins, or wells of health by _%1$s%%_. However, these healing effects will also occur more slowly, regenerating a maximum of _%2$s_ HP per turn (this scales with hero level).
messages.items.trinkets.wondrousresin.name: wondrous resin
messages.items.trinkets.wondrousresin.desc: This shimmering blue resin appears to have the distilled essence of a cursed wand's magic. The magic from the alchemy pot has seemed to stabilize it somewhat, and it's now affecting your wands.
messages.items.trinkets.wondrousresin.typical_sta:
Typically this trinket will force cursed wand effects to become neutral or positive _%1$s%%_ of the time, and will cause uncursed wands to fire an additional neutral or positive cursed zap _%2$s%%_ of the time.

This trinket costs a larger amount of energy to upgrade.
messages.items.trinkets.wondrousresin.stats_desc:
At its current level this trinket will force cursed wand effects to become neutral or positive _%1$s%%_ of the time, and will cause uncursed wands to fire an additional neutral or positive cursed zap _%2$s%%_ of the time.

This trinket costs a larger amount of energy to upgrade.
messages.items.trinkets.trinketcatalyst.name: magical catalyst
messages.items.trinkets.trinketcatalyst.window_te: The water begins to glow as you add the catalyst. There are a few nearby items you could imbue with energy to turn into a magical trinket.
messages.items.trinkets.trinketcatalyst.desc:
This ball of magical golden dust glimmers in the darkness of the dungeon. This catalyst can be used at an alchemy pot with a little alchemical energy to produce a unique trinket item.

Trinkets provide various different effects that slightly alter the dungeon or its inhabitants. Trinkets can be upgraded with more energy to make their effect more powerful, or dropped to forego the effect entirely.
messages.items.trinkets.trinketcatalyst$randomtri:
One nearby item is stuck inside a pouch that you can't get open.

The alchemy process will dissolve the pouch away, but you won't know what trinket you'll get until you do it!
messages.items.trinkets.trinket.discover_hint: This item has a chance to be an option whenever you craft a trinket via alchemy.
messages.items.trinkets.trinket$placeholder.name: trinket
messages.items.wands.cursedwand.ondeath: You were killed by your own %s.
messages.items.wands.cursedwand.mass_invuln: Brilliant light erupts from your wand!
messages.items.wands.cursedwand.transmogrify_wand: Your wand transmogrifies into a different item!
messages.items.wands.cursedwand.transmogrify_othe: Your item transmogrifies into something different!
messages.items.wands.cursedwand.disguise: Your appearance changes before your eyes!
messages.items.wands.cursedwand.supernova: A blazing ball of energy starts to grow. You might want to run!
messages.items.wands.cursedwand.supernova_positiv: A blazing ball of energy starts to grow, but it feels safe somehow.
messages.items.wands.cursedwand.sinkhole: The ground starts to give way around you!
messages.items.wands.cursedwand.sinkhole_positive: The ground starts to give way, but feels solid enough beneath you.
messages.items.wands.cursedwand.gravity: Gravity suddenly starts to pull in random directions!
messages.items.wands.cursedwand.gravity_positive: Gravity suddenly starts to pull in random directions, but this doesn't seem to affect you.
messages.items.wands.wand.fizzles: Your wand fizzles; it must not have enough charge.
messages.items.wands.wand.no_magic: Your wand fizzles; you cannot use wands while magic immune.
messages.items.wands.wand.identify: You are now familiar enough with your wand to identify it.
messages.items.wands.wand.resin_one: This wand has gained _1 level_ from arcane resin.
messages.items.wands.wand.resin_many: This wand has gained _%d levels_ from arcane resin.
messages.items.wands.wand.cursed: This wand is cursed, making its magic chaotic and random.
messages.items.wands.wand.not_cursed: This wand is free of malevolent magic.
messages.items.wands.wand$placeholder.name: wand
messages.items.wands.wandofblastwave.name: wand of blast wave
messages.items.wands.wandofblastwave.ondeath: You killed yourself with your own Wand of Blast Wave...
messages.items.wands.wandofblastwave.desc: This wand is made of a sort of marbled stone, with gold trim and a round black gem at the tip. It feels very weighty in your hand.
messages.items.wands.wandofblastwave.typical_stat: This wand shoots a bolt which violently detonates at a target location. The force of this blast typically deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and is strong enough to send most enemies flying.
messages.items.wands.wandofblastwave.stats_desc: This wand shoots a bolt which violently detonates at a target location. The force of this blast deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and is strong enough to send most enemies flying.
messages.items.wands.wandofblastwave.bmage_desc: When _the Battlemage_ strikes a paralyzed enemy with a staff of blast wave, it will consume the paralysis to deal a burst of bonus magic damage. This has a short cooldown per-enemy.
messages.items.wands.wandofblastwave.eleblast_des: An elemental blast with a staff of blast wave deals 67% damage and knocks all enemies outside of the blast area.
messages.items.wands.wandofcorrosion.name: wand of corrosion
messages.items.wands.wandofcorrosion.desc: This wand has an ashen body which opens to a brilliant orange gem.
messages.items.wands.wandofcorrosion.stats_desc: This wand shoots a bolt which explodes into a cloud of highly corrosive gas at a targeted location. Anything caught inside this cloud will take increasing damage over time, starting at _%d damage._
messages.items.wands.wandofcorrosion.bmage_desc: When _the Battlemage_ strikes an enemy with a staff of corrosion, the enemy has a chance to become oozed.
messages.items.wands.wandofcorrosion.eleblast_des: An elemental blast with a staff of corrosion inflicts enemies with 4 turns of corrosion, starting at 6 damage.
messages.items.wands.wandofcorruption.name: wand of corruption
messages.items.wands.wandofcorruption.already_cor: That character cannot be influenced further.
messages.items.wands.wandofcorruption.desc: This wand radiates chaotic dark energy, if that weren't already obvious from the small decorative skull shaped onto its tip.
messages.items.wands.wandofcorruption.stats_desc: This wand will release a blast of corrupting energy which will debuff enemies and eventually bend them to your will. Enemies are able to resist the corruption, but weakened enemies are much easier to corrupt than healthy ones.
messages.items.wands.wandofcorruption.bmage_desc: When _the Battlemage_ strikes an enemy with a staff of corruption, the enemy has a chance to become amoked.
messages.items.wands.wandofcorruption.eleblast_de: An elemental blast with a staff of corruption inflicts enemies with 5 turns of amok.
messages.items.wands.wandofdisintegration.name: wand of disintegration
messages.items.wands.wandofdisintegration.desc: This wand is made from a solid smooth chunk of obsidian, with a deep purple light running up its side, ending at the tip. It glows with destructive energy, waiting to shoot forward.
messages.items.wands.wandofdisintegration.stats_d: This wand shoots a beam that pierces any obstacle, and will go farther the more it is upgraded. The beam deals _%1$d-%2$d damage,_ and will also deal bonus damage for each enemy and wall it penetrates.
messages.items.wands.wandofdisintegration.bmage_d: When wielded by _the Battlemage_, a staff of disintegration has increased attack range, as if it had a projecting enchantment.
messages.items.wands.wandofdisintegration.eleblas: An elemental blast with a staff of disintegration deals 100% damage and pierces through walls.
messages.items.wands.wandoffireblast.name: wand of fireblast
messages.items.wands.wandoffireblast.desc: This wand is made from red-lacquered wood with golden leaf used liberally to make it look quite regal. It crackles and hisses at the tip, eager to unleash its powerful magic.
messages.items.wands.wandoffireblast.stats_desc: This wand blasts out a cone of fire when used. Its next attack will consume _%1$d charges_ and deal _%2$d-%3$d damage._ The more charges the wand uses, the larger and stronger the effect.
messages.items.wands.wandoffireblast.bmage_desc: When _the Battlemage_ strikes an enemy with a staff of fireblast, there is a chance for it to produce an explosion that damages enemies and consumes all nearby fire! This chance increases the more fire is adjacent to the enemy.
messages.items.wands.wandoffireblast.eleblast_des: An elemental blast with a staff of fireblast deals 100% damage, bursts open doors, and sets enemies and terrain on fire.
messages.items.wands.wandoffrost.name: wand of frost
messages.items.wands.wandoffrost.desc: This wand seems to be made out of some kind of magical ice. It grows brighter towards its rounded tip. It feels very cold when held, but somehow your hand stays warm.
messages.items.wands.wandoffrost.stats_desc: This wand shoots blasts of icy energy toward your foes, dealing _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and chilling. The effect seems stronger in water. Enemies that are already chilled or frozen take less damage from this wand.
messages.items.wands.wandoffrost.bmage_desc: When _the Battlemage_ strikes a chilled enemy with a staff of frost, they have a chance to instantly freeze. This chance becomes greater the more chilled they are.
messages.items.wands.wandoffrost.eleblast_desc: An elemental blast with a staff of frost deals 100% damage, freezes enemies, and puts out fires.
messages.items.wands.wandoflightning.name: wand of lightning
messages.items.wands.wandoflightning.ondeath: You killed yourself with your own Wand of Lightning...
messages.items.wands.wandoflightning.desc: This wand is made out of solid metal, making it surprisingly heavy. Two prongs curve together at the tip, and electricity arcs between them.
messages.items.wands.wandoflightning.stats_desc: This wand sends powerful lightning arcing through whatever it is shot at, dealing _%1$d-%2$d damage._ This electricity will arc to nearby characters, and spreads more easily in water. The arcs from this wand can damage you, but won't hurt your allies.
messages.items.wands.wandoflightning.bmage_desc: When _the Battlemage_ strikes an enemy with a staff of lightning, he has a chance to electrically charge himself for 10 turns. While charged the Battlemage is immune to lightning damage and will arc lightning further.
messages.items.wands.wandoflightning.eleblast_des: An elemental blast with a staff of lightning deals 100% damage, stuns enemies for 5 turns, and electrifies water.
messages.items.wands.wandoflightning$lightningcha:
The Battlemage is currently charged with energy, granting him immunity to his staff of lightning and increasing the range that lightning can arc from it.

Turns Remaining: %s.
messages.items.wands.wandoflivingearth.name: wand of living earth
messages.items.wands.wandoflivingearth.desc: This wand is made from a curious rock, with bands of glowing yellow energy. The rocks seem to shift slightly as you grip the wand, as if they can feel your hand.
messages.items.wands.wandoflivingearth.stats_desc: This wand sends bolts of magical rock at enemies, dealing _%1$d-%2$d damage._ The rocks will then re-form around the user, granting them armor in proportion to the damage dealt. If enough armor is built, it will form into a rock guardian when the wand is next zapped.
messages.items.wands.wandoflivingearth.bmage_desc: When _the Battlemage_ strikes an enemy with a staff of living earth, some of the damage dealt is returned as rock armor.
messages.items.wands.wandoflivingearth.eleblast_d: An elemental blast with a staff of living earth deals 50% damage, and heals an active earthen guardian for each enemy hit.
Magical rocks are surrounding your body, when you are attacked they will attempt to block for you, and will reduce the damage you take by 50%%. Each damage blocked scrapes away some of the rock however.

Remaining Armor: %1$d.

If enough rock is built around you, the next zap from your wand of living earth will cause the rocks to form up into a guardian which will fight with you.

Armor needed for Guardian: %2$d.
This earthen guardian is also benefitting from Power of Many. Turns Remaining: %d.
messages.items.wands.wandoflivingearth$earthguard: The rocks from your wand of living earth have formed into a protective earthen guardian! This rocky protector will attack nearby enemies, which will force them to attack the guardian instead of you. When all nearby threats are gone, the guardian will re-form around you, and will return when you next use your wand.
The guardian's defensive power is tied to the level of your wand. It currently blocks _%1$d-%2$d damage._
You can find this character with a specific wand.
messages.items.wands.wandofmagicmissile.name: wand of magic missile
messages.items.wands.wandofmagicmissile.desc: This fairly plain wand launches missiles of pure magical energy. While the wand itself lacks any special effects, it has more available charges and can briefly empower other wands when upgraded.
messages.items.wands.wandofmagicmissile.stats_des: Each bolt from this wand deals _%1$d-%2$d damage,_ and will briefly empower other wands if it is upgraded.
messages.items.wands.wandofmagicmissile.bmage_des: When _the Battlemage_ strikes an enemy with a staff of magic missile, all of his wands will gain charge in addition to his staff.
messages.items.wands.wandofmagicmissile.eleblast_: An elemental blast with a staff of magic missile deals 50% damage, and grants the mage 15 turns of recharging.
messages.items.wands.wandofmagicmissile.discover_: One of the heroes starts with this item.
messages.items.wands.wandofmagicmissile$magicchar:
Your wand of magic missile has fed power back into your wands, boosting the effective level of the next zap they make.

Your wands are boosted to: +%d.

Turns of magic charge remaining: %s.
messages.items.wands.wandofprismaticlight.name: wand of prismatic light
messages.items.wands.wandofprismaticlight.desc: This wand is made of a solid piece of translucent crystal, like a long chunk of smooth glass. Small bits of colorful light dance around the tip of the wand, eager to burst forth.
messages.items.wands.wandofprismaticlight.stats_d: This wand shoots rays of light which cut through the darkness of the dungeon, revealing hidden areas and traps. The beam can blind enemies, and deals _%1$d-%2$d damage._ Demonic and undead foes will burn in the bright light of the wand, taking bonus damage.
messages.items.wands.wandofprismaticlight.bmage_d: When _the Battlemage_ strikes an enemy with a staff of prismatic light, they will be crippled for a duration that scales with staff level.
messages.items.wands.wandofprismaticlight.eleblas: An elemental blast with a staff of prismatic light deals 67% damage, reveals all terrain in the blast, and blinds enemies for 5 turns.
messages.items.wands.wandofregrowth.name: wand of regrowth
messages.items.wands.wandofregrowth.desc: This wand is made from a thin shaft of expertly carved wood. Somehow it is still alive and vibrant, bright green like a young tree's core. "When life ceases new life always begins to grow... The eternal cycle always remains!"
messages.items.wands.wandofregrowth.stats_desc: When used, this wand will blast magical regrowth energy outward in a cone, causing grass, roots, and rare plants to spring to life. Its next zap will consume _%1$d charges_. The more charges the wand uses, the larger and stronger the effect.
messages.items.wands.wandofregrowth.degradation: After another _%d charges_ this wand will start failing to produce plants and fresh grass. This limit is increased by leveling up or upgrading the wand.
messages.items.wands.wandofregrowth.bmage_desc: When _the Battlemage_ strikes an enemy with a staff of regrowth, and either are standing on grass, he will gain herbal healing in proportion with the damage dealt.
messages.items.wands.wandofregrowth.eleblast_desc: An elemental blast with a staff of regrowth roots enemies and grows grass randomly over the blasts area.
messages.items.wands.wandofregrowth$dewcatcher.de: Dewcatchers are wondrous plants that fill themselves with magical dew. They attempt to camouflage as grass to avoid attention, but their bulges of collected dew give them away.
messages.items.wands.wandofregrowth$dewcatcher.di: You can find this plant with a specific wand.
messages.items.wands.wandofregrowth$seedpod.name: Seed Pod
messages.items.wands.wandofregrowth$seedpod.desc: Seed Pods are magical plants that produce seeds from other plant types, rather than any seeds of their own. They somehow manage to spread despite having no seed of their own.
messages.items.wands.wandofregrowth$seedpod.disco: You can find this plant with a specific wand.
messages.items.wands.wandofregrowth$lotus.name: Golden Lotus
messages.items.wands.wandofregrowth$lotus.desc: The golden lotus is a mystical plant that can only be conjured by a powerful wand of regrowth. Its aura enhances all plants and plant effects, but it burns through its energy and dies after a short time.
messages.items.wands.wandofregrowth$lotus.wand_in: This lotus was produced by a _+%1$d_ wand of regrowth. All plants in its effect will _instantly trigger_ if they are planted on a character. Plants will also have a _%2$d%% chance_ to drop their seed, and tipped darts will use _%3$d%% less durability_.
messages.items.wands.wandofregrowth$lotus.discove: You can find this plant with a specific wand, after upgrading it several times.
messages.items.wands.wandoftransfusion.name: wand of transfusion
messages.items.wands.wandoftransfusion.ondeath: You killed yourself with your own Wand of Transfusion...
messages.items.wands.wandoftransfusion.charged: Your staff is charged with the life energy of your enemy!
messages.items.wands.wandoftransfusion.desc: A fairly plainly shaped wand, it stands out due to its magenta hue and pitch black gem at the tip.
messages.items.wands.wandoftransfusion.stats_desc: When used on allies or charmed enemies, this wand will sap _%1$d of the user's health_ to heal or shield the ally for _%2$d health._ When used on enemies, the wand briefly charms them while applying _%3$d shielding_ to the user. Hostile undead will take _%4$d-%5$d damage_ instead of being charmed.
messages.items.wands.wandoftransfusion.bmage_desc: When _the Battlemage_ strikes a charmed enemy with a staff of transfusion, he will gain shielding and his next zap with the staff will not cost any health.
messages.items.wands.wandoftransfusion.eleblast_d: An elemental blast with a staff of transfusion charms enemies, heals allies, and deals 100% damage to undead enemies.
messages.items.wands.wandofwarding.name: wand of warding
messages.items.wands.wandofwarding.no_more_wards: Your wand can't sustain any more wards.
messages.items.wands.wandofwarding.bad_location: You can't place a ward there.
messages.items.wands.wandofwarding.desc: This short metal wand has a bright purple gem floating above its tip.
messages.items.wands.wandofwarding.stats_desc: Rather than directly damaging an enemy, this wand will summon stationary wards and sentries. Wards can be summoned anywhere, even through walls if you have vision. This wand can sustain _%d energy_ worth of wards at a time.
messages.items.wands.wandofwarding.bmage_desc: When _the Battlemage_ strikes an enemy with a staff of warding, all active wards and sentries have a chance to be healed.
messages.items.wands.wandofwarding.eleblast_desc: An elemental blast with a staff of warding heals all wards and sentries in the blast area.
messages.items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_gene:
This ward will automatically zap any enemy which comes into its range of vision.

Zapping this ward with your wand of warding will upgrade it.

Wards have a limited number of zaps before dissipating.

This sentry has the same firepower as a ward, but has health instead of a set number of charges. It resembles the gem at the tip of your wand of warding.

Zapping this sentry with your wand of warding will upgrade and heal it.

This sentry will spend some health each time it zaps an enemy, but can be healed by using your wand of warding on it.
messages.items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_1:
This basic ward will automatically zap any enemy which comes into its range of vision, dealing _%1$d-%2$d damage._

Zapping this ward with your wand of warding will upgrade it.

This ward will only zap a single time before dissipating.

Your wand of warding is using _%3$d energy_ to sustain this ward.
messages.items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_2:
This upgraded ward has a more intricate pattern, and can attack multiple times. Each zap from this ward will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage._

Zapping this ward with your wand of warding will upgrade it.

This ward will zap three times before dissipating.

Your wand of warding is using _%3$d energy_ to sustain this ward.
messages.items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_3:
This fully upgraded ward is able to attack more times than its predecessors. Each zap from this ward will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage._
