Zapping this ward with your wand of warding will upgrade it.

This ward will zap five times before dissipating.

Your wand of warding is using _%3$d energy_ to sustain this ward.
messages.items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_4:
This smaller sentry has the same firepower as a greater ward, but has health instead of a set number of charges. It resembles the gem at the tip of your wand of warding. Each zap from this sentry will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage._

Zapping this sentry with your wand of warding will upgrade and heal it.

This sentry will spend some health each time it zaps an enemy, but can be healed by using your wand of warding on it.

Your wand of warding is using _%3$d energy_ to sustain this sentry.
messages.items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_5:
This upgraded sentry is larger and more durable than a lesser sentry. Each zap from this sentry will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage._

Zapping this sentry with your wand of warding will upgrade and heal it.

This sentry will spend some health each time it zaps an enemy, but can be healed by using your wand of warding on it.

Your wand of warding is using _%3$d energy_ to sustain this sentry.
messages.items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_6:
This fully upgraded sentry is significantly more durable than its predecessors. Each zap from this sentry will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage._

Zapping this sentry with your wand of warding will heal it.

This sentry will spend some health each time it zaps an enemy, but can be healed by using your wand of warding on it.

Your wand of warding is using _%3$d energy_ to sustain this sentry.
messages.items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.discover_: You can find this character with a specific wand.
messages.items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.dismiss_b:
You can dispel this ward if you no longer want your wand to maintain it. Doing so immediately destroys the ward.

Dismiss this ward?
messages.items.weapon.curses.annoying.name: annoying %s
messages.items.weapon.curses.annoying.msg_4: ARE WE AT THE BOSS YET!?
messages.items.weapon.curses.annoying.msg_5: OUCH, DON'T SWING ME SO HARD!
messages.items.weapon.curses.annoying.msg_11: I didn't want to be a weapon, I wanted to be a lumberjack's axe.
messages.items.weapon.curses.annoying.msg_12: Remember, overconfidence is a slow and insidious killer.
messages.items.weapon.curses.annoying.msg_13: ALL YOUR BASE ARE BELONG TO US!
messages.items.weapon.curses.annoying.desc: Annoying weapons are capable of speech, but they're a bit too energetic. They will often draw attention to you without meaning to.
messages.items.weapon.curses.annoying.elestrike_d: An elemental strike with an annoying curse has a 20% chance to amok each enemy in range for 6 turns.
messages.items.weapon.curses.dazzling.name: dazzling %s
messages.items.weapon.curses.dazzling.desc: Dazzling weapons will sometimes flash with dazzling light, blinding everything that can see them.
messages.items.weapon.curses.dazzling.elestrike_d: An elemental strike with a dazzling curse has a 50% chance to blind each enemy in range for 6 turns.
messages.items.weapon.curses.displacing.name: displacing %s
messages.items.weapon.curses.displacing.desc: Displacing weapons are infused with chaotic teleportation magic, possessing the ability to warp enemies around the floor randomly.
messages.items.weapon.curses.displacing.elestrike: An elemental strike with a displacing curse has a 50% chance to teleport each enemy in range.
messages.items.weapon.curses.explosive.name: explosive %s
messages.items.weapon.curses.explosive.desc: Explosive weapons steadily build up power and explode, damaging anything nearby.
messages.items.weapon.curses.explosive.desc_cool: Your weapon is currently cool to the touch.
messages.items.weapon.curses.explosive.desc_warm: Your weapon is building energy and getting warm...
messages.items.weapon.curses.explosive.desc_hot: Your weapon is hot! It's about to explode!
messages.items.weapon.curses.explosive.elestrike_: An elemental strike with an explosive curse has a 50% chance to cause an explosion to appear on a random enemy in range.
messages.items.weapon.curses.friendly.name: friendly %s
messages.items.weapon.curses.friendly.desc: Friendly weapons are best suited for pacifists, occasionally triggering magic that makes it impossible to fight.
messages.items.weapon.curses.friendly.elestrike_d: An elemental strike with a friendly curse has a 50% chance to charm each enemy in range for 6 turns.
messages.items.weapon.curses.polarized.name: polarized %s
messages.items.weapon.curses.polarized.desc: A polarized weapon is affected by magic that causes its attack to either deal 50% more damage, or no damage at all.
messages.items.weapon.curses.polarized.elestrike_: An elemental strike with a polarized curse has a 50% chance to deal 24-36 damage to each enemy in range.
messages.items.weapon.curses.pressurized.name: pressurized %s
messages.items.weapon.curses.pressurized.desc: Pressurized weapons are capable of erupting with a forceful geyser of water which knocks everything away, including you.
messages.items.weapon.curses.pressurized.elestrik: An elemental strike with a pressurized curse will create a wave of water that destroys terrain and knocks back every enemy in range.
messages.items.weapon.curses.sacrificial.name: sacrificial %s
messages.items.weapon.curses.sacrificial.desc: Sacrificial weapons will demand blood from the wearer in return for attacking foes. The more healthy the wearer is, the more blood the curse will take.
messages.items.weapon.curses.sacrificial.elestrik: An elemental strike with a sacrificial curse causes the hero and each enemy in range to bleed for 12 HP.
messages.items.weapon.curses.wayward.name: wayward %s
messages.items.weapon.curses.wayward.desc: Wayward weapons will sometimes become extremely inaccurate. This magic lasts for a little while when it activates, but can be dispelled by landing a blow with the wayward weapon.
messages.items.weapon.curses.wayward.elestrike_de: An elemental strike with a wayward curse has a 50% chance to hex each enemy in range for 6 turns.
Your wayward weapon's magic has activated, making it extremely inaccurate for a short time. Note that this does not affect attacks which are guaranteed to hit, such as surprise attacks. Successfully attacking with the wayward weapon will clear this effect immediately.

Turns remaining: %s.
messages.items.weapon.curses.wondrous.name: wondrous %s

The Duelist is using her quarterstaff to deflect incoming blows and projectiles. As long as she is in this stance, her evasion against all attacks is tripled.

Turns remaining: %s.
messages.items.weapon.melee.rapier.name: rapier
messages.items.weapon.melee.rapier.typical_abilit: The Duelist can _lunge_ with a rapier at an enemy 1 tile away. This moves toward the enemy, typically deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_, and is guaranteed to hit.
messages.items.weapon.melee.rapier.ability_desc: The Duelist can _lunge_ with a rapier at an enemy 1 tile away. This moves toward the enemy, deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_, and is guaranteed to hit.
messages.items.weapon.melee.rapier.desc: A slim straight sword that offers some protection in exchange for less slashing power.
messages.items.weapon.melee.rapier.discover_hint: One of the heroes starts with this item.
messages.items.weapon.melee.roundshield.name: round shield
messages.items.weapon.melee.roundshield.typical_s: Typically this weapon blocks 0-%d damage. This blocking scales with upgrades.
messages.items.weapon.melee.roundshield.stats_des: This weapon blocks 0-%d damage. This blocking scales with upgrades.
messages.items.weapon.melee.roundshield.typical_a: The Duelist can _guard_ herself with a round shield, completely negating all physical or magical attacks made against her typically for _%d turns_. Once the Duelist has blocked an attack, attacking back or using magic will end guarding.
messages.items.weapon.melee.roundshield.ability_d: The Duelist can _guard_ herself with a round shield, completely negating all physical or magical attacks made against her for _%d turns_. Once the Duelist has blocked an attack, attacking back or using magic will end guarding.
messages.items.weapon.melee.roundshield.desc: This large shield effectively blocks attacks and makes a decent weapon in a pinch.
messages.items.weapon.melee.roundshield$guardtrac:
The Duelist has readied her shield in anticipation of incoming attacks. Physical or magical attacks made against her will be completely negated.

Turns remaining: %s.
messages.items.weapon.melee.runicblade.name: runic blade
messages.items.weapon.melee.runicblade.stats_desc: This weapon benefits more from upgrades.
messages.items.weapon.melee.runicblade.typical_ab: The Duelist can perform a _runic slash_ with a runic blade. This attack is guaranteed to hit and typically has _+%d%% enchantment power._
messages.items.weapon.melee.runicblade.ability_de: The Duelist can perform a _runic slash_ with a runic blade. This attack is guaranteed to hit and has _+%d%% enchantment power._
messages.items.weapon.melee.runicblade.desc: A mysterious weapon from a distant land, with a bright blue blade.
messages.items.weapon.melee.sai.name: sai
messages.items.weapon.melee.sai.stats_desc: This is a very fast weapon.
messages.items.weapon.melee.sai.typical_ability_d: The Duelist can perform a _combo strike_ with sai. This attack is guaranteed to hit and typically deals _+%d damage_ for each time the Duelist has hit with a regular melee or thrown weapon attack. Not hitting for 5 turns (15 after a kill) resets this combo.
messages.items.weapon.melee.sai.ability_desc: The Duelist can perform a _combo strike_ with sai. This attack is guaranteed to hit and deals _+%d damage_ for each time the Duelist has hit with a regular melee or thrown weapon attack. Not hitting for 5 turns (15 after a kill) resets this combo.
messages.items.weapon.melee.sai.desc: Two thin blades meant to be wielded in one hand each. Excellent for tearing down enemies with a flurry of cuts.
messages.items.weapon.melee.sai$combostriketracke:
The Duelist is building combo that can be used to increase the damage of the combo strike ability. Each successful regular melee or thrown weapon attack will count, but not successfully attacking for 5 turns (15 after a kill) resets this combo.

Recent hits: %1$d.

Turns until hits are lost: %2$s.
messages.items.weapon.melee.scimitar.name: scimitar
messages.items.weapon.melee.scimitar.stats_desc: This is a rather fast weapon.
messages.items.weapon.melee.scimitar.typical_abil: The Duelist can perform a _sword dance_ with a scimitar. This stance takes no time to activate and grants the Duelist +60%% attack speed and +50%% accuracy typically for _%d turns._
messages.items.weapon.melee.scimitar.ability_desc: The Duelist can perform a _sword dance_ with a scimitar. This stance takes no time to activate and grants the Duelist +60%% attack speed and +50%% accuracy for _%d turns._
messages.items.weapon.melee.scimitar.desc: A thick curved blade. Its shape allows for faster, yet less powerful attacks.
messages.items.weapon.melee.scimitar$sworddance.d:
The Duelist is making quick momentum based strikes in a sort of dance. While this stance is active, she attacks 60%% faster (enough to attack exactly twice a turn with a scimitar) and has +50%% accuracy.

Turns remaining: %s.
messages.items.weapon.melee.sickle.name: sickle
messages.items.weapon.melee.sickle.stats_desc: This is a rather inaccurate weapon.
messages.items.weapon.melee.sickle.typical_abilit: The Duelist can _harvest_ an enemy with a sickle. This devastating attack is guaranteed to hit and typically deals _%d damage_. This damage is applied as bleeding if the target isn't immune.
messages.items.weapon.melee.sickle.ability_desc: The Duelist can _harvest_ an enemy with a sickle. This devastating attack is guaranteed to hit and deals _%d damage_. This damage is applied as bleeding if the target isn't immune.
messages.items.weapon.melee.sickle.desc: A handheld farming tool that can double as a strong but unwieldy weapon.
messages.items.weapon.melee.spear.name: spear
messages.items.weapon.melee.spear.stats_desc:
This is a rather slow weapon.
This weapon has extra reach.
messages.items.weapon.melee.spear.typical_ability: The Duelist can use the tip of a spear to _spike_ an enemy that is in range but not adjacent. This typically deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_, knocks the enemy back, and is guaranteed to hit.
messages.items.weapon.melee.spear.ability_desc: The Duelist can use the tip of a spear to _spike_ an enemy that is in range but not adjacent. This deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_, knocks the enemy back, and is guaranteed to hit.
messages.items.weapon.melee.spear.desc: A slender wooden rod tipped with sharpened iron.
messages.items.weapon.melee.sword.name: sword
messages.items.weapon.melee.sword.typical_ability: The Duelist can _cleave_ an enemy with a sword. This typically deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and is guaranteed to hit. If cleave kills an enemy it is instantaneous and the Duelist can use cleave again within 5 turns for free.
messages.items.weapon.melee.sword.ability_desc: The Duelist can _cleave_ an enemy with a sword. This deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and is guaranteed to hit. If cleave kills an enemy it is instantaneous and the Duelist can use cleave again within 5 turns for free.
messages.items.weapon.melee.sword.desc: A nicely balanced sword. Not too large, but still notably longer than a shortsword.
messages.items.weapon.melee.sword$cleavetracker.d:
The Duelist is ready to follow up on her previous cleave. The next use of cleave will not cost any weapon ability charge.

Turns remaining: %s.
messages.items.weapon.melee.warhammer.name: war hammer
messages.items.weapon.melee.warhammer.stats_desc: This is a rather accurate weapon.
messages.items.weapon.melee.warhammer.typical_abi: The Duelist can perform a _heavy blow_ with a war hammer. This concentrated attack typically deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ if it surprised the enemy, and dazes them for 5 turns which reduces accuracy and evasion by 50%%. Heavy blow always hits but deals regular damage if it does not surprise the enemy.
messages.items.weapon.melee.warhammer.ability_des: The Duelist can perform a _heavy blow_ with a war hammer. This concentrated attack deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ if it surprised the enemy, and dazes them for 5 turns which reduces accuracy and evasion by 50%%. Heavy blow always hits but deals regular damage if it does not surprise the enemy.
messages.items.weapon.melee.warhammer.desc: Few creatures can withstand the crushing blow of this towering mass of lead and steel, but it takes great strength to use effectively.
messages.items.weapon.melee.warscythe.name: war scythe
messages.items.weapon.melee.warscythe.stats_desc: This is a rather inaccurate weapon.
messages.items.weapon.melee.warscythe.typical_abi: The Duelist can _harvest_ an enemy with a war scythe. This devastating attack is guaranteed to hit and typically deals _%d damage_. This damage is applied as bleeding if the target isn't immune.
messages.items.weapon.melee.warscythe.ability_des: The Duelist can _harvest_ an enemy with a war scythe. This devastating attack is guaranteed to hit and deals _%d damage_. This damage is applied as bleeding if the target isn't immune.
messages.items.weapon.melee.warscythe.desc: This large and unwieldy tool has been reinforced to make it better at cutting foes than crops.
messages.items.weapon.melee.whip.name: whip
messages.items.weapon.melee.whip.typical_ability_: The Duelist can _lash_ all enemies around her with a whip. This ability typically deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_, attacks all enemies within attack range, and is guaranteed to hit.
messages.items.weapon.melee.whip.ability_desc: The Duelist can _lash_ all enemies around her with a whip. This ability deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_, attacks all enemies within attack range, and is guaranteed to hit.
messages.items.weapon.melee.whip.desc: While the barbed length of rope at the end of this weapon deals poor damage, its reach cannot be matched.
messages.items.weapon.melee.wornshortsword.name: worn shortsword
messages.items.weapon.melee.wornshortsword.typica: The Duelist can _cleave_ an enemy with a worn shortsword. This typically deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and is guaranteed to hit. If cleave kills an enemy it is instantaneous and the Duelist can use cleave again within 5 turns for free.
messages.items.weapon.melee.wornshortsword.abilit: The Duelist can _cleave_ an enemy with a worn shortsword. This deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and is guaranteed to hit. If cleave kills an enemy it is instantaneous and the Duelist can use cleave again within 5 turns for free.
messages.items.weapon.melee.wornshortsword.desc: A quite short sword, worn down through heavy use. It is both weaker and a bit lighter than a shortsword in better condition.
messages.items.weapon.melee.wornshortsword.discov: One of the heroes starts with this item.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.darts.adrenalineda: These darts are tipped with a swiftthistle-based compound which will boost the movement and attack speed of allies, or briefly lower the movement speed of enemies. The dart itself is still harmful to enemies, but will not harm allies.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.darts.blindingdart: These darts are tipped with a blindweed-based compound which will blind their target for a short time. They do not disorient however, so an enemy will still know where they last saw you.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.darts.chillingdart: These darts are tipped with an icecap-based compound which will significantly chill their target.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.darts.cleansingdar: These darts are tipped with a mageroyal-based compound which will temporarily make allies immune to all negative effects, or will cleanse positive effects from enemies. Enemies may even briefly forget that they are attacking or fleeing from you. The dart itself is still harmful to enemies, but will not harm allies.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.darts.dart.name: dart
messages.items.weapon.missiles.darts.dart.tip_des:
A seed can be combined with one or two darts to tip them. Each type of seed produces its own type of tipped dart, with a unique single-use effect.

Tipping a dart with these seeds will produce a _%s._
messages.items.weapon.missiles.darts.dart.desc: These simple shafts of spike-tipped wood are weighted to fly true and sting their prey with a flick of the wrist. They can be tipped with seeds to gain bonus effects when thrown.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.darts.dart.unlimit: Due to their simple construction darts will effectively last forever.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.darts.displacingda: These darts are tipped with a fadeleaf-based compound which will teleport their target a short distance away.
These darts are tipped with a sungrass-based compound which grants a burst of healing to their target. The dart itself is still harmful to enemies, but will not harm allies.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.darts.holydart.des: These darts are tipped with a starflower-based compound which infuses holy energy into their target. Allies and regular enemies will become blessed, but undead or demonic enemies will take heavy damage. The dart itself is still harmful to enemies, but will not harm allies.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.darts.incendiaryda: These darts are tipped with a firebloom-based compound which will burst into brilliant flames on impact.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.darts.paralyticdar: These darts are tipped with an earthroot-based compound which will paralyze their target for a short time.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.darts.poisondart.d: These darts are tipped with a sorrowmoss-based compound which will poison their target.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.darts.rotdart.name: rot dart
messages.items.weapon.missiles.darts.rotdart.desc: These wicked darts are tipped with an acidic rotberry-based compound, which will aggressively eat through anything the dart comes into contact with. Powerful foes will resist most of the effect, but the corrosion is strong enough to easily kill most standard enemies. These last longer than other tipped darts, but their durability cannot be boosted.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.darts.rotdart.disc: You can create this item using a seed from a specific quest.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.darts.shockingdart: These darts are tipped with a stormvine-based compound which will deliver a nasty shock to their target.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.darts.tippeddart.c: This action will remove the seed tipping on your darts, reverting them back to regular darts.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.darts.tippeddart.u: This stack of darts has _%d/%d_ uses left before one tip wears off.
_But these are of such high quality that they will effectively last forever._
messages.items.weapon.missiles.darts.tippeddart.a: Your dart's tip is about to expire.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.darts.tippeddart.d: You can buy this item in a shop, or create it using a seed.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.bolas.name: bolas
messages.items.weapon.missiles.bolas.stats_desc: This weapon inflicts cripple on its target.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.bolas.desc: These unusual ranged weapons aren't very damaging, but do an excellent job of slowing their target.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.boomerang.name: boomerang
messages.items.weapon.missiles.boomerang.desc: Thrown to the enemy this flat curved wooden missile will return to the hands of its thrower.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.boomerang.durabili: Due to its solid construction, this boomerang will not break from use.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.fishingspear.name: fishing spear
messages.items.weapon.missiles.fishingspear.desc: Tiny throwing spears that work well as an improvised weapon despite being designed for fishing.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.forcecube.name: force cube
messages.items.weapon.missiles.forcecube.ondeath: You killed yourself with your own Force Cube...
messages.items.weapon.missiles.forcecube.stats_de: This weapon spreads the force of its impact over a small area, hitting everything nearby.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.forcecube.desc: These oddly-shaped magical cubes are small enough to hold in your hand, but are incredibly heavy.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.heavyboomerang.sta: This weapon circles back to the location it was thrown from after five turns.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.heavyboomerang.des: This large boomerang is difficult to wield effectively, but will deal considerable damage.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.javelin.name: javelin
messages.items.weapon.missiles.javelin.desc: These larger throwing spears are weighted to keep the spike at their tip foremost as they sail through the air.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.kunai.name: kunai
messages.items.weapon.missiles.kunai.stats_desc: This weapon is stronger against unaware enemies.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.kunai.desc: These small knives are very powerful in the hands of a skilled user.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.missileweapon.stat: This set of _tier-%1$d_ thrown weapons deals _%2$d-%3$d damage_.
Typically this set of _tier-%1$d_ thrown weapons deals _%2$d-%3$d damage_ and requires _%4$d strength_ to use.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.missileweapon.prob: Probably this weapon is too heavy for you.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.missileweapon.dist: Thrown weapons are more accurate at range, but less accurate up close.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.missileweapon.dura: Thrown weapons will wear out and break as they are used.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.missileweapon.uses: This set of thrown weapons has _%d/%d_ uses left before one breaks.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.missileweapon.unli: This set is of such high quality that it will effectively last forever.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.missileweapon.unkn: Typically this set of thrown weapons will have _%d_ uses before one breaks.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.missileweapon.abou: Your thrown weapon is about to break.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.missileweapon.has_: One of your thrown weapons has broken.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.missileweapon.dust: The thrown weapon crumbles to dust as you touch it.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.missileweapon.brea: If the last thrown weapon in your enhanced thrown weapon set breaks, the set will be permanently lost. Are you sure you want to throw it?
messages.items.weapon.missiles.shuriken.name: shuriken
messages.items.weapon.missiles.shuriken.stats_des: Shurikens can be thrown instantly with a 20 turn cooldown.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.shuriken.desc: These star-shaped pieces of metal with razor-sharp blades can be quickly thrown while on the move.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.shuriken$shurikeni:
You have recently thrown a shuriken instantly, and must wait before doing it again. Shurikens can still be thrown, but at normal weapon speed.

Turns Remaining: %s.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.throwingclub.name: throwing club
messages.items.weapon.missiles.throwingclub.stats: This weapon doesn't stick to enemies and can be collected instantly.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.throwingclub.desc: A fairly simple but durable thrown weapon, essentially a large rock fastened to a stick.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.throwinghammer.sta: This weapon doesn't stick to enemies and can be collected instantly.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.throwinghammer.des: These hefty hammers are designed to be thrown at an enemy. Their smooth all-metal construction means they are quite durable.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.throwingknife.name: throwing knife
messages.items.weapon.missiles.throwingknife.stat: This weapon is stronger against unaware enemies.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.throwingknife.desc: These lightweight knives are balanced to arc through the air right into their target.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.throwingknife.disc: One of the heroes starts with this item.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.throwingspear.name: throwing spear
messages.items.weapon.missiles.throwingspear.desc: These lightweight spears have thin frames which are designed to be thrown, and not thrusted.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.throwingspike.name: throwing spike
messages.items.weapon.missiles.throwingspike.desc: These durable pointed shafts of metal are meant to be thrown into distant enemies.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.throwingspike.disc: One of the heroes starts with this item.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.throwingstone.name: throwing stone
messages.items.weapon.missiles.throwingstone.desc: These stones are sanded down to make them able to be thrown with more power than a regular stone.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.throwingstone.disc: One of the heroes starts with this item.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.tomahawk.name: tomahawk
messages.items.weapon.missiles.tomahawk.stats_des: This weapon inflicts _%1$d-%2$d bleed_ to its target.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.tomahawk.typical_s: This weapon typically inflicts _%1$d-%2$d bleed_ to its target.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.tomahawk.desc: These throwing axes have a serrated edge that tears as they stick to an enemy.
messages.items.weapon.missiles.trident.name: trident
messages.items.weapon.missiles.trident.desc: Massive throwing spears with three deadly prongs on the end. They are powerful, but quite heavy.
messages.items.weapon.spiritbow.name: spirit bow
messages.items.weapon.spiritbow.stats: The bow cannot be directly upgraded, but will instead steadily grow stronger as you level up. At your current level, arrows shot from the bow will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and require _%3$d strength_ to use properly.
messages.items.weapon.spiritbow.desc: A bow made out of ancient magical wood. The bow's string and etchings glow with a pale blue light. When the string is pulled this bow will conjure a magical arrow which can be fired at an enemy.
messages.items.weapon.spiritbow.discover_hint: One of the heroes starts with this item.
messages.items.weapon.weapon.identify: You are now familiar enough with your weapon to identify it.
messages.items.weapon.weapon.too_heavy: Because of your inadequate strength this weapon will hinder your attack speed, accuracy, and ability to surprise attack.
messages.items.weapon.weapon.excess_str: Because of your excess strength, you will deal _0-%d bonus damage_ with this weapon.
messages.items.weapon.weapon.hardening_gone: The hardening on this weapon has worn off!
messages.items.weapon.weapon.incompatible: Interaction of different types of magic has negated the enchantment on this weapon!
messages.items.weapon.weapon.cursed_worn: Because this weapon is cursed, you are powerless to remove it.
messages.items.weapon.weapon.cursed: You can feel a malevolent magic lurking within this weapon.
messages.items.weapon.weapon.weak_cursed: Despite the curse, you are able to unequip this weapon.
messages.items.weapon.weapon.not_cursed: This weapon is free of malevolent magic.
messages.items.weapon.weapon.hardened_no_enchant: This weapon has been _hardened,_ but is not currently enchanted.
messages.items.weapon.weapon$enchantment.discover: You can find an item with this effect randomly in the dungeon, or try to apply it to an item yourself.
messages.items.amulet.name: amulet of yendor
messages.items.amulet.desc: The Amulet of Yendor is the most powerful artifact known to human or dwarf kind. Its shimmering crystals contain incredible and wondrous power.
messages.items.amulet.desc_origins: The origins of the amulet are unknown. History says that the King of Dwarves boasted that he had discovered the artifact shortly before the Dwarven civilization cut off all contact. How did he find it? How did Yog-Dzewa take it from him? Questions for another time perhaps, all that matters now is the amulet is yours!
messages.items.amulet.desc_ascent: The origins of the amulet are unknown, but clearly it has been heavily influenced by Yog-Dzewa's power. The dungeon seems to be bending to Yog's will as you move through it, making enemies much more plentiful and powerful! You're also no longer able to activate or discard the amulet, almost as if it is cursed.
messages.items.amulet.ascent_desc:
You begin to feel Yog-Dzewa's great and terrible power radiating from the amulet. Ascending back through the dungeon as a mortal might be more difficult than you thought!

If you continue ascending with the amulet the dungeon will become more dangerous, teleports between floors will be disabled, and you will only be able to win the game by defeating enemies as you ascend through the dungeon!

You can leave the amulet here for now if you want to ascend without starting this challenge, or activate the amulet before ascending to end the game normally.
messages.items.amulet.discover_hint: You can find this item at the bottom of the dungeon...
messages.items.ankh.name: ankh
messages.items.ankh.bless: You bless the ankh with magical water.
messages.items.ankh.desc: This ancient symbol of immortality grants the ability to return to life after death. Most items will be dropped where you died, but can be reclaimed if you return to it. Using a full waterskin, the ankh can be blessed with extra strength.
messages.items.ankh.desc_blessed: This ancient symbol of immortality grants the ability to return to life after death. The ankh has been blessed and is now much stronger. The Ankh will sacrifice itself to save you in a moment of deadly peril.
messages.items.ankh.discover_hint: You can buy this item in a shop.
messages.items.arcaneresin.name: arcane resin
messages.items.arcaneresin.level_too_high: That wand is too powerful for resin to improve.
messages.items.arcaneresin.not_enough: You don't have enough resin for that!
messages.items.arcaneresin.apply: You coat your wand with resin, increasing its power!
messages.items.arcaneresin.desc:
This fine powder shimmers between shades of purple and white. It can act as an amplifier to magical energies, increasing the level of wands when it is applied to them!

Upgrading a wand costs 1, 2, or 3 resin depending on the wand's initial level. Resin can upgrade wands to a maximum of +3.

Resin upgrades are _overridden by other upgrade sources_ however (such as scrolls of upgrade), and do not apply when imbuing a wand into the Mage's staff.
messages.items.arcaneresin.discover_hint: You can craft this item via alchemy.
messages.items.brokenseal.name: broken seal
messages.items.brokenseal.unknown_armor: You must identify whether that armor is cursed or not first.
messages.items.brokenseal.cursed_armor: The seal won't apply to cursed armor.
messages.items.brokenseal.affix: You affix the seal to your armor!
messages.items.brokenseal.desc:
A wax seal, affixed to armor as a symbol of valor. It has a faded rune of protection engraved in the center, and is cracked in half across the middle.

A memento from his home, the seal helps the warrior persevere. While wearing the seal the warrior will instantly gain shielding when he is about to be damaged to half health or lower.

The seal can be _affixed to armor,_ and moved between armors. It can carry a single upgrade with it, so long as that upgrade was applied to the armor while the seal was attached to it.
messages.items.brokenseal.inscribed: The seal is inscribed with a _%s._
messages.items.brokenseal.choose_desc:
Both this armor and the broken seal are carrying a glyph. Pick which glyph should be kept.

Armor Glyph: %1$s
Broken Seal Glyph: %2$s

Note that if you pick the glyph that is currently on the armor, the seal will not be able to transfer it later.
messages.items.brokenseal.discover_hint: One of the heroes starts with this item.
messages.items.brokenseal$warriorshield.name: Warrior Shield
messages.items.brokenseal$warriorshield.desc_acti:
The Warrior's broken seal is currently helping him persevere, granting him shielding on top of his health. There is a cooldown after the shielding initially triggers before it can be used again.

This shield does not decay over time, but will end if no enemies are nearby for a few turns. When it ends, any unused shielding will reduce the cooldown, up to a max of 50%%.

Shield remaining: %1$d.

Current Cooldown: %2$d.
messages.items.brokenseal$warriorshield.desc_cool:
The Warrior has recently gained shielding from his broken seal, and must wait until he can benefit from its shielding effect again.

Turns Remaining: %d.
messages.items.brokenseal$warriorshield.desc_nega:
The Warrior's shield cooldown is currently negative, meaning that when his shield activates the cooldown will be lower than the usual 150 turns. The shield cooldown can be reduced to as low as -150 turns, which means it will immediately be available again once it is activated.

Current cooldown: %d.
messages.items.dewdrop.name: dewdrop
messages.items.dewdrop.desc:
A crystal clear dewdrop.

Due to the magic of this place, pure water has minor restorative properties.
messages.items.equipableitem.curse_detected: You sense that the item is cursed just before you equip it!
messages.items.equipableitem.unequip_cursed: You can't remove a cursed item!
messages.items.energycrystal.name: energy crystal
messages.items.energycrystal.desc:
A collection of small magical crystals, filled with alchemical energy.

These crystals are the most common ingredient in alchemy recipes and can be produced at an alchemy pot by scrapping consumable items.
messages.items.gold.name: gold
messages.items.gold.desc: A pile of gold coins. Collect gold coins to spend them later in a shop.
messages.items.heap.chest_desc: You won't know what's inside until you open it!
messages.items.heap.locked_chest_desc: You won't know what's inside until you open it! But to open it you need a golden key.
messages.items.heap.crystal_chest_desc: You can see _%s_ inside, but to open the chest you need a crystal key.
messages.items.heap.tomb_desc: This ancient tomb may contain something useful, but its owner will most certainly object to checking.
messages.items.heap.skeleton_desc: This is all that's left of some unfortunate adventurer. Maybe it's worth checking for any valuables.
messages.items.heap.remains_desc: This is all that's left from one of your predecessors. Maybe it's worth checking for any valuables.
messages.items.honeypot.name: honeypot
messages.items.honeypot.desc: This large honeypot is only really lined with honey, instead it houses a giant bee! These sorts of massive bees usually stay in their hives, perhaps the pot is some sort of specialized trapper's cage? The bee seems pretty content inside the pot with its honey, and buzzes at you warily when you look at it.
messages.items.honeypot$shatteredpot.name: shattered honeypot
messages.items.honeypot$shatteredpot.desc:
The pot has been shattered, only the sticky honey that lines its walls is holding it together, and it is slowly coming apart.

Despite its broken state, the bee still seems to want to protect the pot.
messages.items.item.custom_note_type: This type of item has a custom note: "_%s_"
messages.items.item.custom_note: This item has a custom note: "_%s_"
messages.items.item.discover_hint: You can find this item randomly in the dungeon.
messages.items.kindofmisc.unequip_message: You must unequip one of these items first. Select an item to swap with.
messages.items.kindofweapon.equip_cursed: Your grip involuntarily tightens around the weapon.
messages.items.kindofweapon.which_equip_msg:
Which weapon slot would you like to equip this item to?

The Champion directly attacks with her primary weapon, but can use the ability of either weapon. Both weapons share the same charge count.

The Champion can also swap her primary and secondary weapon instantly.
messages.items.kingscrown.name: Dwarf King's crown
messages.items.kingscrown.naked: Unfortunately, the crown cannot transform your underwear.
messages.items.kingscrown.upgraded: The crown glows brightly and then disintegrates as your armor transforms!
messages.items.kingscrown.ratgraded: Rat King's paws glow brightly as your armor transforms!
messages.items.kingscrown.desc:
The crown of the last dwarven king, it glows with tremendous magical energy.

When worn, the crown's magic will flow into the armor you're currently wearing, transforming it into a _unique epic armor with special abilities._ The new armor will keep all the properties of the original armor.
messages.items.kingscrown.discover_hint: You can get this item as a drop from certain enemies.
messages.items.liquidmetal.name: liquid metal
messages.items.liquidmetal.already_fixed: That thrown weapon is already in perfect condition!
messages.items.liquidmetal.apply: You use %d liquid metal to repair your thrown weapon.
messages.items.liquidmetal.desc:
This magical liquid can fill into the cracks and tears on a thrown weapon, restoring it to perfect condition! If a set of weapons is missing a weapon but otherwise fully repaired, then liquid metal can even be used to replace a missing weapon from the set!

A tier 1 weapon requires 10 liquid metal to be fully repaired, a tier 5 weapon requires 30. Each upgrade also increases the amount of metal needed by 35%.

Liquid metal cannot be used to repair the tips on tipped darts.
messages.items.liquidmetal.discover_hint: You can craft this item via alchemy.
messages.items.lostbackpack.name: lost backpack
messages.items.lostbackpack.desc: This is your lost inventory. Collect it to reclaim all the items you lost!
messages.items.merchantsbeacon.name: merchant's beacon
messages.items.merchantsbeacon.desc:
This odd piece of dwarven technology allows you to communicate from great distances.

After being activated, this beacon will let you sell items to Pixel Mart from anywhere in the dungeon.

However, the magic within the beacon will only last for one session, so use it wisely.
messages.items.stylus.name: arcane stylus
messages.items.stylus.identify: You must identify whether that armor is cursed first.
messages.items.stylus.cursed: The stylus's magic will not work on cursed armor.
messages.items.stylus.inscribed: You inscribed your armor with the stylus.
messages.items.stylus.desc: This arcane stylus is made of some dark, very hard stone. Using it you can inscribe a magical glyph on your armor, but you have no power over choosing what glyph it will be, the stylus will decide it for you.
messages.items.tengusmask.name: Tengu's mask
messages.items.tengusmask.used: The mask disintegrates as its power flows into you!
messages.items.tengusmask.desc:
This mask fell off Tengu's face as he died, you can feel great magical power emanating from it. Was the mask Tengu's source of strength?

When worn, the tremendous power of the mask will be transferred into you, enabling you to _choose a subclass for your hero._

Which subclass will you choose?
messages.items.tengusmask.discover_hint: You can get this item as a drop from certain enemies.
messages.items.torch.name: torch
messages.items.torch.desc: An adventuring staple, when a dungeon goes dark, a torch can help lead the way.
messages.items.waterskin.name: waterskin
messages.items.waterskin.collected: You collect the dewdrop into your waterskin.
messages.items.waterskin.desc: A container for liquid, made from leather and string, sealed with a cork stopper.
messages.items.waterskin.desc_water: Right now the waterskin just contains some plain drinking water. Surely there is something in the dungeon that the waterskin could store instead.
messages.items.waterskin.desc_heal: The waterskin is currently being used to store healing water. The more full the waterskin is, the more you will be instantly healed when drinking from it. You will only drink as much as you need.
messages.items.waterskin.desc_full: The full waterskin seems to radiate energy, perhaps it can be used to bless another survival item?
messages.items.waterskin.discover_hint: One of the heroes starts with this item.
messages.actors.blobs.blizzard.name: blizzard
messages.actors.blobs.confusiongas.name: confusion gas
messages.actors.blobs.confusiongas.desc: A cloud of confusion gas is swirling here.
messages.actors.blobs.electricity.name: electricity
messages.actors.blobs.electricity.desc: A field of electricity is sparking brightly here.
messages.actors.blobs.fire.name: fire
messages.actors.blobs.foliage.name: foliage
messages.actors.blobs.foliage.desc: Shafts of light pierce the gloom of the underground garden.
messages.actors.blobs.freezing.name: freezing air
messages.actors.blobs.freezing.desc: The air is unnaturally frigid here.
messages.actors.blobs.goowarn.name: dark energy
messages.actors.blobs.goowarn.desc: Specks of dark energy are swarming here!
messages.actors.blobs.inferno.name: inferno
messages.actors.blobs.paralyticgas.name: paralytic gas
messages.actors.blobs.paralyticgas.desc: A cloud of paralytic gas is swirling here.
messages.actors.blobs.regrowth.name: regrowth
messages.actors.blobs.sacrificialfire.name: sacrificial fire
messages.actors.blobs.sacrificialfire.desc:
There is an altar here with a sacrificial fire burning atop it. Any creature that's killed here will be consumed as an offering to the spirits of the dungeon.

Perhaps a reward will be given if enough sacrifices are made?
messages.actors.blobs.sacrificialfire.worthy: The fire consumes your offering and grows stronger.
messages.actors.blobs.sacrificialfire.unworthy: The fire consumes your offering, but doesn't change.
messages.actors.blobs.sacrificialfire.reward: The fire flares and then dissipates, leaving a reward behind!
messages.actors.blobs.smokescreen.name: smokescreen
messages.actors.blobs.smokescreen.desc: A cloud of thick black smoke is swirling here.
messages.actors.blobs.stenchgas.name: stench gas
messages.actors.blobs.stenchgas.desc: A cloud of fetid stench is swirling here.
messages.actors.blobs.stormcloud.name: storm clouds
messages.actors.blobs.stormcloud.desc: A cloud of billowing water vapor is swirling here.
messages.actors.blobs.toxicgas.name: toxic gas
messages.actors.blobs.toxicgas.desc: A greenish cloud of toxic gas is swirling here.
messages.actors.blobs.toxicgas.ondeath: You died from the toxic gas...
messages.actors.blobs.corrosivegas.name: corrosive gas
messages.actors.blobs.corrosivegas.desc: A cloud of deadly caustic gas is swirling here.
messages.actors.blobs.waterofawareness.name: water of awareness
messages.actors.blobs.waterofawareness.procced: As you take a sip, you feel knowledge pour into your mind.
messages.actors.blobs.waterofawareness.desc: Power of knowledge radiates from the water of this well. Drinking from the well will fully identify all equipped items, identify curses on all items in your inventory, and reveal all items on the current floor.
messages.actors.blobs.waterofhealth.name: water of health
messages.actors.blobs.waterofhealth.procced: As you take a sip, you feel your wounds heal completely.
messages.actors.blobs.waterofhealth.desc: Power of health radiates from the water of this well. Drinking from this well will heal your wounds, satisfy hunger, and cleanse curses on any worn items.
messages.actors.blobs.web.name: spider web
messages.actors.blobs.web.desc: A thick web is covering everything here. Anything that touches or is thrown through the web will break it, but will also be stuck in place.
messages.actors.buffs.adrenaline.name: adrenaline
messages.actors.buffs.adrenaline.desc:
A surge of physical power, adrenaline enhanced both attack and movement speed.

Adrenaline allows its target to run at 2x speed, and attack at 1.5x speed.

Turns remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.adrenalinesurge.name: strength boost
messages.actors.buffs.adrenalinesurge.desc:
A surge of great might, but sadly not permanent.

Strength boost: +%d.
Turns until boost weakens: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.amok.name: amok
messages.actors.buffs.amok.desc:
Amok causes a state of great rage and confusion in its target.

When a creature is amoked, they will attack whatever is near them, whether they be friend or foe.

Turns of amok remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.arcanearmor.name: arcane armor
messages.actors.buffs.arcanearmor.desc:
A thin shield is surrounding you, blocking some of the damage from magical attacks.

Your magical armor is currently boosted by: 0-%d.

Turns until arcane armor weakens: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.artifactrecharge.name: artifact recharging
messages.actors.buffs.artifactrecharge.desc:
Energy is coursing through you, increasing the rate your equipped artifacts charge.

Each artifact is affected a little differently, but they will all gain charge much faster than normal.

Turns remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.ascensionchallenge.name: amulet's curse
messages.actors.buffs.ascensionchallenge.desc:
Somehow Yog-Dzewa is maintaining influence on this world through the amulet, and is trying to stop your ascent!

Yog's power is making the dungeon much more dangerous, increasing the number of enemies and making them stronger! This power will keep building if left unchecked, it can be weakened by defeating enemies that have been enhanced by Yog's power.
messages.actors.buffs.ascensionchallenge.desc_cle: The dark energy radiating from the amulet has been weakened as much as possible for now.
messages.actors.buffs.ascensionchallenge.desc_bec: The amulet is currently _calling out to distant enemies,_ alerting them to your position.
messages.actors.buffs.ascensionchallenge.desc_has: The amulet is currently _hastening distant enemies,_ letting them reach you faster!
messages.actors.buffs.ascensionchallenge.desc_slo: The amulet is currently _slowing you down,_ and negating speed boosting effects!
messages.actors.buffs.ascensionchallenge.desc_dam: The energy from the amulet has gotten so strong that it's _directly harming you!_
messages.actors.buffs.ascensionchallenge.beckon: The amulet begins calling out to distant enemies.
messages.actors.buffs.ascensionchallenge.haste: The amulet begins hastening distant enemies!
messages.actors.buffs.ascensionchallenge.slow: The amulet starts to feel like a lead weight in your inventory!
messages.actors.buffs.ascensionchallenge.damage: The amulet begins radiating dark energy. It burns!
messages.actors.buffs.ascensionchallenge.weaken_i: The amulet's curse can be weakened by defeating more enemies.
If you defeat enemies the amulet's curse will weaken!
messages.actors.buffs.ascensionchallenge.weaken: You can feel the amulet's curse weaken slightly.
messages.actors.buffs.ascensionchallenge.break: You take a moment to catch your breath and feel your wounds begin to close!
messages.actors.buffs.ascensionchallenge.almost: You feel Yog's grip on the amulet begin to weaken, you're almost there!
messages.actors.buffs.barkskin.name: barkskin
messages.actors.buffs.barkskin.desc:
Your skin is hardened, it feels rough and solid like bark.

The hardened skin increases your effective armor, allowing you to better defend against physical attack.

Your armor is currently increased by: 0-%d.
Turns until barkskin weakens: %s.

If you receive barkskin from multiple sources, only the strongest one will apply.
messages.actors.buffs.barrier.name: barrier
messages.actors.buffs.barrier.desc:
A durable bubble of force which blocks all damage.

The barrier will take damage for whatever it is protecting so long as there is shielding left. The shielding will also slowly decay over time.

Shielding remaining: %d.
messages.actors.buffs.berserk.angered_desc:
The severity of the Berserker's injuries strengthen his blows. As the berserker takes physical damage, his rage will build, granting him bonus damage. Damage which is blocked by armor still counts towards building rage.

Rage will fade over time. The lower the berserker's health, the longer it will last.

At 100%% rage, the Berserker can go berserk, granting him shielding based on the level of his armor and his missing health. While berserking, his shielding decays over time and once it runs out he will have to rest before building rage again.

Current Rage: _%1$.0f%%_
_+%2$.0f%%_ damage

Berserk shield at current armor and HP: _%3$d_
messages.actors.buffs.berserk.berserk_desc:
Fear and uncertainty bleed away, leaving only anger. In this state the Berserker is extremely powerful, _dealing +50%% damage and gaining bonus shielding,_ but also losing shielding every turn.

When all of his shielding is reduced to 0, berserking will end.

After raging, the Berserker will need to recover before being able to build rage again.

Shield Remaining: %d
messages.actors.buffs.berserk.recovering_desc:
Inner strength has its limits. The Berserker must rest before using his rage again.

While recovering the Berserker does not build any rage from taking damage.
messages.actors.buffs.berserk.no_seal: You need your broken seal to berserk!
messages.actors.buffs.bleeding.name: bleeding
messages.actors.buffs.bleeding.desc:
That wound is leaking a worrisome amount of blood.

Bleeding causes damage every turn. Each turn the damage decreases by a random amount, until the bleeding eventually stops.

Current bleed damage: %d.
messages.actors.buffs.bless.name: blessed
messages.actors.buffs.bless.desc:
A great burst of focus, some say it is inspired by the gods.

Blessing increases accuracy and evasion by 25%%, making the blessed much more effective in combat.

Turns of bless remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.blindness.name: blinded
messages.actors.buffs.blindness.desc:
Blinding turns the surrounding world into a dark haze.

While blinded, a character's vision range is reduced to one tile, rendering ranged attacks useless and making it very easy to lose track of distant enemies. Additionally, a blinded hero is unable to read scrolls or books.

Turns of blindness remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.burning.name: burning
messages.actors.buffs.burning.desc:
Few things are more distressing than being engulfed in flames.

Fire will deal damage every turn until it is put out by water or it expires. Fire can be extinguished by stepping into water, or from the splash of a shattering potion.

Additionally, the fire may ignite flammable terrain or items that it comes into contact with.

Turns of burning remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.championenemy$blazing.name: blazing champion
messages.actors.buffs.championenemy$blazing.desc: Blazing champions deal 25% more melee damage, ignite enemies they attack, are immune to fire, and spread fire around them as they die. They can't spread fire onto water however.
messages.actors.buffs.championenemy$projecting.de: Projecting champions deal 25% more melee damage and have +3 attack range.
messages.actors.buffs.championenemy$antimagic.des: Antimagic champions take 50% less damage and are completely immune to magical effects.
messages.actors.buffs.championenemy$giant.name: giant champion
messages.actors.buffs.championenemy$giant.desc: Giant champions take 80% less damage and have +1 attack range, but cannot move through enclosed spaces.
messages.actors.buffs.championenemy$blessed.name: blessed champion
messages.actors.buffs.championenemy$blessed.desc: Blessed champions have 4x accuracy and evasion.
messages.actors.buffs.championenemy$growing.name: growing champion
messages.actors.buffs.championenemy$growing.desc:
Growing champions gain a steadily increasing bonus to accuracy, evasion, physical damage, and a reduction to damage taken.

Current acc/eva/dmg boost: %1$d%%
Current damage reduction: %2$d%%
messages.actors.buffs.charm.name: charmed
messages.actors.buffs.charm.cant_attack: You are charmed by that enemy and can't attack them.
messages.actors.buffs.charm.desc:
A charm is manipulative magic that can make enemies temporarily adore each other.

Characters affected by charm are unable to directly attack the enemy they are charmed by. Attacking other targets is still possible however. The shock of pain will lessen the duration of charm.

Turns of charm remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.chill.name: chilled
messages.actors.buffs.chill.desc:
Not quite frozen, but still much too cold.

Chilled targets perform all actions more slowly, depending on how many turns are left in the effect. At its worst, this is equivalent to being slowed.

Turns of chill remaining: %1$s.
Speed is reduced by: %2$s%%
messages.actors.buffs.combo.name: combo
messages.actors.buffs.combo.bad_target: You must target an enemy in attack range.
messages.actors.buffs.combo.desc:
The gladiator builds momentum as he lands successful blows. Each attack increases the combo counter by one, but taking too long between hits will reset the combo counter to 0. While the gladiator has combo any shielding he has from his broken seal will not start to fade.

Building combo unlocks special combo attacks that cannot miss! A different attack is unlocked at 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 combo count. Some moves reset combo and some do not, but each move can only be used once per combo session.

Current combo: %1$d.

Turns until Combo is lost: %2$s.
messages.actors.buffs.combo$combomove.clobber.des: Knocks an enemy back 2 tiles, but deals no damage and cannot knock into pits. Increments combo by 1.
messages.actors.buffs.combo$combomove.clobber.emp: Knocks an enemy back _3 tiles, inflicts vertigo, and can knock into pits,_ but deals no damage. Increments combo by 1.
messages.actors.buffs.combo$combomove.slam.name: slam
messages.actors.buffs.combo$combomove.slam.desc: Deals %d%% (combo*20%%) of your damage blocking power as bonus damage. Resets combo when used.
messages.actors.buffs.combo$combomove.slam.empowe: _Leaps up to %1$d tile(s)_ and deals %2$d%% (combo*20%%) of your damage blocking power as bonus damage. Resets combo when used.
messages.actors.buffs.combo$combomove.parry.name: parry
messages.actors.buffs.combo$combomove.parry.desc: Blocks the next attack within 1 turn when activated, and instantly retaliates to it. Resets combo if nothing is parried.
messages.actors.buffs.combo$combomove.parry.empow: Blocks _all attacks_ within 1 turn when activated, and instantly retaliates to them. Resets combo if nothing is parried.
messages.actors.buffs.combo$combomove.crush.name: crush
messages.actors.buffs.combo$combomove.crush.desc: Deals %d%% (combo*25%%) damage to the primary target, and half that damage to all other enemies in a 7x7 AOE. Resets combo when used.
messages.actors.buffs.combo$combomove.crush.empow: _Leaps up to %1$d tile(s)_ and deals %2$d%% (combo*25%%) damage to the primary target, and half that damage to all other enemies in a 7x7 AOE. Resets combo when used.
messages.actors.buffs.combo$combomove.fury.name: fury
messages.actors.buffs.combo$combomove.fury.desc: Hits an enemy once for each combo you have, each hit deals 60% damage and can trigger enchantments. Resets combo when used.
messages.actors.buffs.combo$combomove.fury.empowe: _Leaps up to %d tile(s)_ and hits an enemy once for each combo you have, each hit deals 60%% damage and can trigger enchantments. Resets combo when used.
messages.actors.buffs.corruption.name: corrupted
messages.actors.buffs.corruption.desc:
Corruption seeps into the essence of a being, twisting them against their former nature.

Corrupted creatures will attack their allies, and ignore their former enemies. Corruption is damaging as well, and will slowly cause its target to succumb.

Corruption is permanent, its effects only end in death.
messages.actors.buffs.cripple.name: crippled
messages.actors.buffs.cripple.desc:
You're pretty sure legs aren't meant to bend that way.

Crippled halves movement speed, making moving a tile usually take two turns instead of one.

Turns of cripple remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.daze.name: dazed
messages.actors.buffs.daze.desc:
Ringing ears and blurred vision make it difficult to fight.

While dazed, accuracy and evasion are reduced by 50%%, making both landing and evading blows much harder.

Turns of daze remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.degrade.name: degraded
messages.actors.buffs.degrade.desc:
Powerful dark magic is sapping the strength that scrolls of upgrade have applied to your equipment!

While degraded, upgraded gear will be treated as if it is a lower level than it actually is. _Every upgrade after +3 becomes exponentially weaker than the last one._ The descriptions of your items will change to reflect their reduced power level.

Degradation does not affect strength requirements, wand charges, durability of thrown weapons, or artifacts.

Turns of degradation remaining: %s. Using a scroll of upgrade or remove curse will end degradation immediately.
messages.actors.buffs.doom.name: doomed
messages.actors.buffs.doom.desc:
It's hard to keep going when it seems like the universe wants you dead.

Doomed characters will receive +67% damage from all sources.

Doom is permanent, its effects only end in death.
messages.actors.buffs.dread.name: dread
messages.actors.buffs.dread.desc:
A terror so great that it will cause its target to flee the dungeon entirely!

Creatures affected by dread will run from their opponent at high speed, and will disappear from the dungeon entirely once they are out of sight. Enemies that are defeated this way award half experience and drop no items. The shock of pain will lessen the duration of dread.

Turns of dread remaining: %d.
messages.actors.buffs.drowsy.name: drowsy
messages.actors.buffs.drowsy.desc:
A magical force is making it difficult to stay awake, after a few turns, the target will fall into a deep magical sleep.

The hero can resist drowsiness by taking damage or by being at full health.

Turns until sleep: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.earthimbue.name: imbued with earth
messages.actors.buffs.earthimbue.desc:
You are imbued with the power of earth!

All physical attacks will shift the earth under the enemy, crippling them for a short time.

Turns of earth imbue remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.enhancedrings.name: enhanced rings
messages.actors.buffs.enhancedrings.desc:
The Rogue's recently used artifact is empowering his rings, granting them +1 level.

Turns remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.fireimbue.name: imbued with fire
messages.actors.buffs.fireimbue.desc:
You are imbued with the power of fire!

All physical attacks will have a chance to light enemies ablaze. Additionally, you are completely immune to the effects of fire.

Turns of fire imbue remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.foresight.name: foresight
messages.actors.buffs.foresight.desc:
You are somehow able to see the layout of surrounding terrain with your mind.

While under the effect of foresight all tiles in a wide radius are revealed to you, including any secret traps or doors.

Turns of foresight remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.frost.name: frozen
messages.actors.buffs.frost.desc:
Not to be confused with freezing solid, this more benign freezing simply encases the target in ice.

Freezing acts similarly to paralysis, making it impossible for the target to act. Unlike paralysis, freezing is immediately cancelled if the target takes damage, as the ice will shatter.

Turns of freeze remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.frostimbue.name: imbued with frost
messages.actors.buffs.frostimbue.desc:
You are imbued with icy power!

All physical attacks will steadily stack chill on enemies. Additionally, you are completely immune to the cold.

Turns of frost imbue remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.fury.name: furious
messages.actors.buffs.fury.desc:
You are angry, enemies won't like you when you're angry.

A great rage burns within you, increasing the damage you deal with physical attacks by 50%%.

This rage will last as long as you are injured below 50%% health.
messages.actors.buffs.blobimmunity.name: purification barrier
messages.actors.buffs.blobimmunity.desc:
Some strange force is encasing you in a thin protective barrier, blocking out all harmful airborne effects.

You are immune to all area-bound effects while this barrier lasts.

Turns of immunity remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.gravitychaostracker.name: gravity chaos
messages.actors.buffs.gravitychaostracker.desc_in: Every few turns all characters on the current dungeon floor will be thrown in a random direction.
messages.actors.buffs.gravitychaostracker.desc_po: You and your allies seem to be immune though.
messages.actors.buffs.gravitychaostracker.desc_du: It's not clear how long the effect will last for, but it can't last forever.
messages.actors.buffs.greaterhaste.name: greater haste
messages.actors.buffs.greaterhaste.desc:
An incredible boost of speed, for a moment it feels as if everything else is standing still.

While under the effects of greater haste moving actions take no time at all, but other actions are still performed at normal speed. Each step of movement consumes a turn of greater haste.

Turns of greater haste remaining: %d.
messages.actors.buffs.haste.name: haste
messages.actors.buffs.haste.desc:
Energy courses through your muscles, allowing you to run at incredible speeds!

While under the effects of haste you will run at 3x speed, but will perform all other actions at normal speed.

Turns of haste remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.healing.name: healing
messages.actors.buffs.healing.desc:
A magical remedy is causing wounds to close and flesh to knit.

Every turn health will steadily regenerate until the healing effect expires. The amount of healing may fade over time.

Next heal: %d.

Healing remaining: %d.
messages.actors.buffs.herodisguise.name: disguise
messages.actors.buffs.herodisguise.desc:
Illusory magic has altered your physical appearance! The effect is purely cosmetic, but feels very strange regardless.

Turns of disguise remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.hex.name: hexed
messages.actors.buffs.hex.desc:
Dark magic which saps focus, making the target slightly disoriented.

Hexing reduces accuracy and evasion by 20%%, making the target less effective in combat.

Turns of hex remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.holdfast.name: hold fast
messages.actors.buffs.holdfast.desc: The Warrior is holding his position, increasing his armor by %1$d-%2$d and slowing the decay rate of some buffs by %3$d%%. This will last until he moves.
messages.actors.buffs.hunger.cursedhorn: The cursed horn steals some of the food energy as you eat.
messages.actors.buffs.hunger.desc_intro_hungry: You can feel your stomach calling out for food, but it's not too urgent yet.
messages.actors.buffs.hunger.desc:
Hunger slowly increases as you spend time in the dungeon, eventually you will begin to starve. While starving you will slowly lose health instead of regenerating it.

Rationing is important! If you have health to spare starving isn't a bad idea if it means there will be more food later. Effective rationing can make food last a lot longer!
messages.actors.buffs.invisibility.name: invisible
messages.actors.buffs.invisibility.desc:
You are completely blended into the surrounding terrain, making you impossible to see.

While you are invisible enemies are unable to attack or follow you. Physical attacks and magical effects (such as scrolls and wands) will immediately cancel invisibility.

Turns of invisibility remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.invulnerability.name: invulnerable
messages.actors.buffs.invulnerability.desc:
This character is suffused with great protective power, granting them a brief period of invulnerability!

Turns remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.levitation.name: levitating
messages.actors.buffs.levitation.desc:
A magical force is levitating you over the ground, making you feel weightless.

Levitating characters move silently and ignore all ground-based effects. Traps won't trigger, water won't put out fire, plants won't be trampled, roots will miss, and pits will be hovered over. Be careful, as all these things can come into effect the second the levitation ends!

Turns of levitation remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.lifelink.name: life link
messages.actors.buffs.lifelink.ondeath: The life linked damage killed you...
messages.actors.buffs.lifelink.desc:
This character's life force is linked to another character nearby. Any damage taken is shared between them.

Whenever this character takes damage, half of it will be dealt to the life link target instead.

Turns of life link remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.light.name: illuminated
messages.actors.buffs.light.desc:
Even in the Darkest Dungeon, a steady light at your side is always comforting.

Light helps keep darkness at bay, allowing you to see a reasonable distance despite the environment.

Turns of illumination remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.lockedfloor.name: floor is locked
messages.actors.buffs.lockedfloor.desc:
The current floor is locked, and you are unable to leave it!

While a floor is locked, you will not gain hunger or take damage from starving. In addition, if you do not work towards defeating this floor's boss, passive regeneration effects will also stop.

Additionally, if you are revived by an unblessed ankh while the floor is locked, then it will reset.

Kill this floor's boss to break the lock.
messages.actors.buffs.lostinventory.name: lost inventory
messages.actors.buffs.lostinventory.desc: Your inventory has been lost somewhere in the dungeon! You won't be able to pick up or use most items until you retrieve it.
messages.actors.buffs.magicalsight.name: magical sight
messages.actors.buffs.magicalsight.desc:
Somehow you are able to see with your mind, rather than your eyes.

While magical sight is active you will be able to see through all terrain in a 12 tile radius.

Turns of magical sight remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.magicalsleep.name: magical sleep
messages.actors.buffs.magicalsleep.toohealthy: You are too healthy, and resist the urge to sleep.
messages.actors.buffs.magicalsleep.fallasleep: You fall into a deep magical sleep.
messages.actors.buffs.magicalsleep.wakeup: You wake up feeling refreshed and healthy.
messages.actors.buffs.magicalsleep.desc:
This character has fallen into a deep magical sleep which they will not wake from naturally.

Magical sleep is similar to regular sleep, except that only damage will cause the target to wake up.

For the hero and their allies, magical sleep has some restorative properties, allowing them to rapidly heal while resting.
messages.actors.buffs.magicimmune.name: immune to magic
messages.actors.buffs.magicimmune.desc:
All magical effects have lost their hold on you, you are completely impervious to them.

While magic immune all harmful and helpful magical effects will not apply to you, including curses, enchants, wands, scrolls, rings, artifacts, etc. Heroic armor abilities are strong enough to work regardless of this effect.

Turns of magic immunity remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.mindvision.name: mind vision
messages.actors.buffs.mindvision.desc:
Somehow you are able to see all creatures on this floor through your mind. It's a weird feeling.

All characters on this floor are visible to you as long as you have mind vision. Seeing a creature through mind vision counts as it being seen or nearby for the purposes of many magical effects.

Turns of mind vision remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.momentum.momentum_desc:
As he moves, the Freerunner builds momentum, which he can spend to start freerunning.

Each charge of momentum grants two turns of freerunning, and the Freerunner can build up to 10 charges. Momentum is rapidly lost when the Freerunner stops moving.

Current momentum charge: %d.
messages.actors.buffs.momentum.running_desc:
As he moves, the Freerunner builds momentum, which he can spend to start freerunning.

While freerunning, the Freerunner moves at double speed and gains bonus evasion based on his level.

Turns remaining: %d.
messages.actors.buffs.momentum.resting_desc:
As he moves, the Freerunner builds momentum, which he can spend to start freerunning.

The Freerunner needs time to regain his stamina before building momentum again.

Turns remaining: %d.
messages.actors.buffs.monkenergy.name: energy
messages.actors.buffs.monkenergy.desc:
As she defeats enemies, the Monk gains energy that she can use on a variety of abilities. Most enemies grant 1 energy when defeated, and the Monk does not lose energy over time.

Current energy: %1$d/%2$d.
messages.actors.buffs.monkenergy.desc_cooldown:
The Monk has recently used an ability, and must wait before using another.

Current cooldown: %d turns.
messages.actors.buffs.monkenergy$monkability$flur: Two instant strikes that deal %1$d-%2$d damage and ignore armor. This ability cannot be used repeatedly.
Two instant strikes that deal %1$d-%2$d damage, ignore armor, _and use your weapon's enchantment._ This ability cannot be used repeatedly.
messages.actors.buffs.monkenergy$monkability$focu: The Monk takes a turn to focus, letting her parry the next attack made against her.
The Monk _instantly focuses,_ letting her parry the next attack made against her.
The Monk is focused on her surroundings, anticipating the next attack made against her. While focused, she is guaranteed to parry the next incoming attack.
messages.actors.buffs.monkenergy$monkability$dash: An instant dash up to 4 tiles away. This ability can go over hazards, but not through enemies or solid terrain.
An instant dash up to _8 tiles_ away. This ability can go over hazards, but not through enemies or solid terrain.
messages.actors.buffs.monkenergy$monkability$drag: A devastating kick that deals %1$d-%2$d damage and ignores armor. The kick knocks the target away and paralyzes them for each tile they travel.
A devastating kick that deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and ignores armor. The kick knocks _all adjacent targets_ away and paralyzes them for each tile they travel.
messages.actors.buffs.monkenergy$monkability$medi: The Monk focuses energy into her body for 5 turns. This clears most negative effects and grants her 8 turns of wand and artifact recharging.

The Monk focuses energy into her body for 5 turns. This clears most negative effects and grants her 8 turns of wand and artifact recharging. _She also gains 80% damage resistance while meditating, and slowly heals for 20% of her missing HP._
messages.actors.buffs.ooze.name: caustic ooze
messages.actors.buffs.ooze.heromsg: Caustic ooze eats your flesh. Wash it away!
messages.actors.buffs.ooze.desc:
This sticky acid clings to flesh, slowly melting it away.

Ooze will deal consistent damage over time, but can be immediately washed off in water.

Turns of ooze remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.paralysis.name: paralysed
messages.actors.buffs.paralysis.desc:
Oftentimes the worst thing to do is nothing at all.

Paralysis completely halts all actions, forcing the target to wait until the effect wears off. The pain from taking damage can cause characters to resist paralysis, breaking them out of the effect.

Turns of paralysis remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.physicalempower.name: physically empowered
messages.actors.buffs.physicalempower.desc:
Your blows have been empowered, increasing the amount of damage you can deal when you hit enemies with physical attacks.

Bonus damage: %1$d.
Hits remaining: %2$d.
messages.actors.buffs.pincushion.name: pincushion
messages.actors.buffs.pincushion.desc:
The thrown weapons you have used against this character are currently stuck to them and will fall to the floor after they are defeated.

The following items are currently attached:
messages.actors.buffs.poison.name: poisoned
messages.actors.buffs.poison.desc:
Poison works its way through the body, slowly impairing its internal functioning.

Poison deals damage each turn proportional to how long until it expires.

Turns of poison remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.preparation.name: preparation
messages.actors.buffs.preparation.desc: The Assassin is waiting patiently, preparing to strike from the shadows.
messages.actors.buffs.preparation.desc_dmg: His next attack will deal _%1$d%% bonus damage_, and will execute regular enemies below _%2$d%% health_, or bosses below _%3$d%% health_.
messages.actors.buffs.preparation.desc_dmg_likely: The attack will also be more likely to deal a larger amount of damage.
messages.actors.buffs.preparation.desc_blink: He is able to blink towards an enemy before striking them, with a max distance of _%d._
messages.actors.buffs.preparation.prompt:
Select a target to attack!
Max blink distance: %d
messages.actors.buffs.preparation.out_of_reach: That target is out of reach.
messages.actors.buffs.prismaticguard.name: prismatic Guard
messages.actors.buffs.prismaticguard.desc:
You are being guarded by a prismatic image which is currently inactive. When enemies are present the prismatic image will spring to action and protect you!

While inactive, the prismatic image will steadily recover from any damage it has taken.

Current HP: %d/%d.
messages.actors.buffs.prismaticguard.desc_many: This prismatic image is also benefitting from Power of Many. Turns Remaining: %d.
messages.actors.buffs.recharging.name: recharging
messages.actors.buffs.recharging.desc:
Energy is coursing through you, improving the rate that your wands and staffs charge.

Each turn this buff will increase current charge by one quarter, in addition to regular recharge.

Turns of recharging remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.revealedarea.name: revealed area
messages.actors.buffs.revealedarea.desc:
An area of the dungeon has been temporarily revealed to the hero, They will see it no matter where they are.

Turns remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.revealedchar.name: revealed
messages.actors.buffs.revealedchar.desc:
This character is revealed to the hero, They will be visible no matter where they are.

Turns remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.roots.name: rooted
messages.actors.buffs.roots.desc:
Roots (magical or natural) grab at the feet, forcing them down to the ground.

Roots lock a target in place, making movement and most movement abilities impossible. Other actions are not affected, including teleportation effects.

Turns of root remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.scrollempower.name: scroll empower
messages.actors.buffs.scrollempower.desc:
The energy from the Mage's recently read scroll is empowering his wands!

Level Boost: +%1$d.
Zaps remaining: %2$d.
messages.actors.buffs.shadows.name: shadowmelded
messages.actors.buffs.shadows.desc:
You are blended into the shadows around you, granting you invisibility and slowing your metabolism.

While you are invisible enemies are unable to attack or follow you. Most physical attacks and magical effects (such as scrolls and wands) will immediately cancel invisibility. Additionally, while shadowmelded, your rate of hunger is slowed.

You will remain shadowmelded until you leave the shadows or an enemy comes into contact with you.
messages.actors.buffs.slow.name: slowed
messages.actors.buffs.slow.desc:
Slowing magic affects the target's rate of time, to them everything is moving super-fast.

A slowed character performs all actions in twice the amount of time they would normally take.

Turns of slow remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.snipersmark.name: sniper's mark
messages.actors.buffs.snipersmark.desc:
The Sniper is honed in on the target she most recently attacked. She is able to perform a special attack with her bow which will vary based on how the bow is augmented.

An unaugmented bow will fire a _snapshot,_ which deals reduced damage but does not take any time to fire.

A bow augmented for speed will fire a _volley_ of three arrows. Each arrow will deal reduced damage, but can still activate enchantment. This volley takes 1 turn to shoot.

A bow augmented for damage will fire a _sniper shot._ This shot is guaranteed to hit, deals bonus damage based on distance from the target, and takes 2 turns to fire.

Turns remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.soulmark.name: soul marked
messages.actors.buffs.soulmark.desc:
The warlock has tapped into the soul of this creature, allowing him to heal as it takes physical damage.

Turns of soul mark remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.stamina.name: stamina
messages.actors.buffs.stamina.desc:
You have unending stamina, allowing for faster movement!

While under the effects of stamina you will run at +50%% speed, but will perform all other actions at normal speed.

Turns of stamina remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.swarminteltracker.name: swarm intelligence
messages.actors.buffs.swarminteltracker.desc:
Swarm Intelligence causes enemies to attract other enemies to your position when they see you or your allies.

This attracting has a limited range, but the longer you are seen the higher this range grows, to a max of 12. Breaking sight even for a moment resets the range.

Current largest attraction range: %d.
messages.actors.buffs.vulnerable.name: vulnerable
messages.actors.buffs.vulnerable.desc:
Vulnerability magic increases all physical damage that a character takes by 33%%, after that damage has been reduced by armor.

Turns of vulnerable remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.terror.name: terrified
messages.actors.buffs.terror.desc:
Terror is manipulative magic which forces its target into an uncontrollable panic.

Terrified characters are forced to run away from their opponent, trying to put as many doors and walls between them as possible. The shock of pain will lessen the duration of terror, however.

Turns of terror remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.toxicimbue.name: imbued with toxicity
messages.actors.buffs.toxicimbue.desc:
You are imbued with poisonous energy!

As you move around toxic gas will constantly billow forth from you, damaging your enemies. You are immune to toxic gas and poison for the duration of the effect, as well as for a few turns afterward.

Turns of toxic imbue remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.corrosion.name: corrosion
messages.actors.buffs.corrosion.desc:
Powerful acid melts away flesh, metal, and bone at an alarming rate.

Corrosion damage increases over time, as the target continues to melt away.

Turns of corrosion remaining: %1$s.
Current corrosion damage: %2$d.
messages.actors.buffs.vertigo.name: vertigo
messages.actors.buffs.vertigo.desc:
Walking in a straight line can be difficult when the whole world is spinning.
