While under the effects of vertigo, characters who attempt to move will go in a random direction, instead of the one they intended to go in.

Turns of vertigo remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.wandempower.name: wands empowered
messages.actors.buffs.wandempower.desc:
Your damage-dealing wands have been empowered, increasing the amount of damage they deal for a few hits.

Bonus damage: %1$d.
Hits remaining: %2$d.
messages.actors.buffs.weakness.name: weakened
messages.actors.buffs.weakness.desc:
Everything suddenly seems much heavier.

Weakening magic reduces a character's physical strength, causing them to deal 33%% reduced damage.

Turns of weakness remaining: %s.
messages.actors.buffs.wellfed.name: well fed
messages.actors.buffs.wellfed.desc:
You feel quite satisfied and full.

While well fed, your hunger will not increase, and you will heal an additional amount of health over time.

Turns remaining: %d.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.warrior.heroicleap: The Warrior performs a _Heroic Leap_ towards a targeted location, sailing above enemies and hazards.
The Warrior leaps toward a targeted location, going over any enemies or hazards in the way. He cannot leap over walls or other solid terrain however.
The Warrior releases a _Shockwave_ in a conical AOE by slamming the ground. Enemies caught in the shockwave are damaged and crippled.

The Warrior slams the ground, producing a shockwave that travels up to 5 tiles in a 60 degree cone.

Enemies caught in this shockwave are crippled for 5 turns. They also take 5-10 damage, plus an additional 1-2 damage for every point of strength the Warrior has above 10.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.warrior.endure$end:
The Warrior is now dealing bonus damage based on the damage he endured.

Bonus Damage: %1$d
Hits Left: %2$d
messages.actors.hero.abilities.warrior.endure.sho: The Warrior _Endures_, skipping several turns but gaining high damage resistance. He then deals bonus damage based on what he endured.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.warrior.endure.des:
The Warrior endures for 3 turns, taking half damage from all sources. This reduction is applied before damage resisting effects like armor.

After enduring, the warrior's next hit within 10 turns gains bonus damage. This bonus damage is equal to half of all the damage inflicted on him while enduring, before any damage reduction effects!

If the Warrior has any combo, using this ability increases its remaining time by 3 turns.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.mage.elementalblas: You can't use this ability without your staff.
The Mage emits an _Elemental Blast_ from his staff, covering a large area around him in an effect that varies based on the wand in his staff.

The Mage emits a blast of magic, which covers a circular region up to 4 tiles away and deals up to 15-25 damage. The specific effect of elemental blast will vary by the wand imbued in the Mage's staff.
The effect of elemental blast will be similar to the effect of the wand when zapped at an enemy or ally.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.mage.wildmagic.no_: You have no wands to zap with!
messages.actors.hero.abilities.mage.wildmagic.sho: The Mage unleashes the _Wild Magic_ contained in his wands, randomly firing them multiple times at a chosen target over a single turn.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.mage.wildmagic.des:
The Mage unleashes the power in his wands, randomly firing them up to 4 times in a single turn. The Mage's staff is not included in this effect.

Each wand also has its level boosted by 2, up to +3. This ability uses half a wand charge for each zap, and no one wand can be fired more than 2 times.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.mage.warpbeacon.lo: You cannot leave a locked floor!
messages.actors.hero.abilities.mage.warpbeacon.in: You can't place a beacon there!
messages.actors.hero.abilities.mage.warpbeacon.wi: Your beacon is currently placed on floor %d.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.mage.warpbeacon.sh: The Mage places a _Warping Beacon_ at his current location, which he can instantly teleport back to.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.mage.warpbeacon.de:
The Mage places a beacon, which can then be warped to at will. Placing the beacon takes 1 turn, but warping to it is instantaneous.

The Mage cannot warp between floors by default, or use the beacon to reach inaccessible places such as locked rooms. The Mage can teleport into enemies, which will push them aside.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.rogue.smokebomb.fo: You can only jump to an empty location in your field of view.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.rogue.smokebomb.pr: Choose a location to jump to
messages.actors.hero.abilities.rogue.smokebomb$ni: Somehow, enemies are easily convinced that this wooden decoy is the real Rogue!
You can find this character with a specific hero armor ability.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.rogue.smokebomb.sh: The Rogue throws down a _Smoke Bomb_ while blinking away. He blinds enemies near his old location.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.rogue.smokebomb.de:
The Rogue throws down a smoke bomb and blinks up to 6 tiles away. He can blink through hazards and enemies, but not through solid terrain like walls.

Enemies that are adjacent to the Rogue's old position will be blinded for 5 turns.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.rogue.deathmark.sh: The Rogue places a _Death Mark_ on a chosen enemy. Marked enemies take bonus damage, but cannot die until the mark ends.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.rogue.deathmark.de:
The Rogue places a mark on a chosen enemy, causing them to take 25% extra damage. The mark is applied instantly and lasts for 5 turns.

Marked enemies take bonus damage but are unable to die until the mark expires. If an enemy has 0 HP when the mark ends, they will immediately die.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.rogue.deathmark$de:
This enemy has been marked, causing them to take 25%% bonus damage, but also rendering them unable to die until the mark ends.

Turns remaining: %s.
The Rogue summons a _Shadow Clone_, which can be directed to aid him in combat.

The Rogue summons a shadowy mimic of himself, which can be directed to aid him in combat. Directing the shadow clone does not cost any charge.

The clone has 80 HP, no armor, and deals 10-20 damage. All of these traits can be improved with talents, such that the clone benefits from weapons and armor the hero has.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.rogue.shadowclone$: Your clone moves to that position.
Your clone moves to follow you.

A copy of the Rogue, made from shadowy darkness. It stands stock still, with empty eyes and tiny wisps of darkness rising from it like steam.

The clone is not a perfect copy of the Rogue, but is still a decent fighter, and can benefit from the Rogue's equipment with the right talents.
You can find this character with a specific hero armor ability.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.huntress.spectralb: The Huntress throws _Spectral Blades_ at a target, inflicting damage depending on her currently equipped melee weapon.
The Huntress throws out a spectral blade at an enemy, which acts like a ranged strike from her melee weapon. All of the normal effects of a melee weapon will activate, including enchantments.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.huntress.naturespo: The Huntress calls upon _Nature's Power_, increasing her movement speed and her bow's rate of fire for a short time.

The Huntress temporarily empowers herself and her bow with the power of nature! This lasts for 8 turns.

During this time, the Huntress moves at 2x speed, and attacks 33% faster with her bow. The bonus bow effects do not trigger if the Sniper is using her special attacks.

The Huntress is briefly empowered, increasing her movement speed and attack speed with her bow.

Turns remaining: %s.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.huntress.spirithaw: There is no free space near you.
The Huntress summons a _Spirit Hawk_ familiar, which can help her scout locations and distract enemies.

The Huntress summons a spirit hawk familiar, which can be directed by using the ability again while it is summoned. The hawk lasts for 100 turns, directing the hawk does not cost any charge.

The hawk has minimal health and attacking power, but is fast, evasive, and accurate. It shares its entire field of vision with the Huntress at all times. It is immune to all area-bound effects, such as fire and poison gas. It will not attack unless specifically directed to.
Your hawk moves to that position.
Your hawk moves to follow you.

A magical hawk, summoned by the Huntress. It glows a bright ethereal blue, its head constantly shifts around as it surveys the area.

While it isn't much of a fighter its speed and vision make it excellent for scouting and distracting enemies.
You can find this character with a specific hero armor ability.
You can only be in one duel at a time.
You must be able to reach your target.
That enemy is too far away to challenge.
The Duelist _Challenges_ a nearby enemy to a duel, temporarily freezing all other enemies.

The Duelist challenges a nearby enemy to a duel. That enemy is compelled to fight her while all other enemies are temporarily frozen in time.

The target must be reachable and within 5 tiles of the Duelist. The duel lasts until 10 turns pass, the enemy dies, or the Duelist is more than 5 tiles away from the enemy.

Frozen enemies are invulnerable. The Duelist's allies are not frozen by this ability, but if a boss is targeted its minions will not be frozen either.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.duelist.challenge$:
This character is participating in a duel. They, and any of their allies or minions, are allowed to act normally while others are frozen.

The duel will last for a set amount of time, until one participant dies, or until the participants move more than 5 tiles away from eachother.

Turns remaining: %d.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.duelist.elementals: The Duelist performs an _Elemental Strike_, spreading an effect in a conical AOE based on her weapon enchantment.

The Duelist strikes an enemy or location, performing a regular attack that's guaranteed to hit and spreading a magical effect that travels up to 4 tiles in a 65 degree cone. This magical effect varies based on the enchantment on the Duelist's primary weapon.
An elemental strike with no enchantment will release a small burst of magic, dealing 6-12 damage to all enemies in range.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.duelist.feint.name: feint
messages.actors.hero.abilities.duelist.feint.prom: Choose a location to dash to
messages.actors.hero.abilities.duelist.feint.too_: That location is not adjacent to you.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.duelist.feint.bad_: You can't move to that location.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.duelist.feint.shor: The Duelist _Feints_, faking an attack while dashing to an adjacent tile. Enemies will attack her afterimage, leaving them open to a counterattack.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.duelist.feint.desc:
The Duelist fakes an attack while dashing to an adjacent tile, leaving behind a momentary afterimage of herself. Enemies that were attacking the Duelist will attack her afterimage instead.

Enemies that attack the afterimage become confused, which cancels their next action and leaves them open to a surprise attack.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.ascendedfor: The Cleric assumes an _Ascended Form_, gaining new spells, attack range, and shielding.

The Cleric projects holy energy from themselves, assuming an extended radiant form for 10 turns. While in this form the Cleric can cast new spells, gains 2 attack range, 30 shielding, and any additional spells they cast will grant 10 shielding per holy tome charge used.

The shielding from ascended form and its spells does not decay normally, but will immediately fade once ascended form ends. The ability can be re-used to refresh ascended form's duration.

Radiant energy is emanating from the Cleric's body. While in this form the Cleric gains 2 attack range (from the holy energy projecting from them), and 10 shielding whenever they spend a holy tome charge. They are also able to cast the spells which are unlocked via ascended form's talents.

The shield granted by ascended form and its spells will not decay normally, but will instantly fade when ascended form ends.

Current shielding: %1$d.
Turns remaining: %2$d.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.trinity.no_: Trinity has no effect set for any of its forms currently, use one of its spells!
Trinity cannot duplicate an effect that you already have equipped!
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.trinity.enc: Trinity will apply this effect for _%1$d turns_ at the cost of _%2$s charge._
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.trinity.rar: Trinity will apply this _powerful_ effect for _%1$d turns_ at the cost of _%2$s charge._
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.trinity.wan: Trinity will zap this wand at _+%1$d_ at the cost of _%2$s charge._
Trinity will zap this _multi-charge_ wand at _+%1$d_ at the cost of _%2$s charge._
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.trinity.thr: Trinity will throw this weapon at _+%1$d_ at the cost of _%2$s charge._
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.trinity.rin: Trinity will apply this ring's effect at _+%1$d_ for 20 turns, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.trinity.alc: Trinity will apply this artifact's remote alchemy effect, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.trinity.cha: Trinity will apply this artifact's passive health regen effect at _+%1$d_ for 20 turns, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.trinity.dri: Trinity will use this artifact's effect to summon a corrupted friendly wraith with the HP of a _+%1$d_ ghost, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.trinity.eth: Trinity will apply this artifact's chain-casting effect with reach at _+%1$d_, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.trinity.hor: Trinity will apply this artifact's snacking effect, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.trinity.mas: Trinity will apply this artifact's enemy robbing effect at _+%1$d_, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.trinity.san: Trinity will apply this artifact's root effect with a random harmful seed, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.trinity.ske: Trinity will apply this artifact's insert effect, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.trinity.tal: Trinity will apply this artifact's scry effect at _+%1$d_, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.trinity.tim: Trinity will apply this artifact's time freeze effect with a _%1$d_ turn duration, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.trinity.uns: Trinity will apply this artifact's random scroll effect with a _%1$d/10_ chance to offer the exotic version at no additional cost, at the cost of _%2$s charge._
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.trinity.cos: The charge cost of this ability varies, but is most often _%d._
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.trinity.sho: The Cleric gains a _Trinity_ of abilities, which emulate equipment they have seen and can be assigned by using new spells.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.trinity.des:
The Cleric gains a _Trinity_ of armor abilities, which can be assigned to various item effects by using three new spells. Each of these spells focuses on emulating the effects of different kinds of equipment that the Cleric has identified during this run: body form (weapons and armor), mind form (wands and thrown weapons), and spirit form (rings and artifacts).

Each Trinity form can be imbued with one effect at a time, and the Cleric chooses which one to activate when using Trinity. Trinity will not duplicate the effect of something you already have equipped.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.trinity$wnd: Select which form of Trinity to use. The effects of different forms can be active simultaneously.
Select an effect to be imbued into Trinity. Additional info will be shown before confirmation.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.cleric.powerofmany: You already have an empowered ally.
You can't target a location you can't see.
The Cleric channels the _Power of Many_, empowering an existing ally or creating a new one.

The Cleric channels the _Power of Many_, which either empowers an existing ally or creates a new empowered one for 100 turns. Targeting an empty space creates a new ally.

While empowered by Power of Many, any ally deals +25% damage, takes -25% damage, and shares their vision with the Cleric. They also gain 25 shielding when the ability is used.

The Cleric also gains three new spells that can only be cast with an empowered ally. Power of Many won't end while one of these spells is active.

This ally has been empowered by Power of Many, granting them +25%% damage dealt and -25%% damage taken. They will also share their vision range with the Cleric, and can benefit from power of many spells.

Power of Many will persist when allies such as prismatic images hide away, but its duration will still count down.

Turns Remaining: %s.
Your ally moves to that position.
Your ally moves to follow you.

A copy of one of the Cleric's adventuring companions, made out of solid light. While it has the shape of another hero, it does not have any of their unique abilities. This ally will persist for as long as Power of Many is applied to them.

This ally can be directed at no cost by re-using the Power of Many armor ability.
You can find this character with a specific hero armor ability.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.ratmogrify.name: ratmogrify
messages.actors.hero.abilities.ratmogrify.too_str: That enemy is too strong to ratmogrify!
messages.actors.hero.abilities.ratmogrify.short_d: The hero _Ratmogrifies_ an enemy! This temporarily turns them into a rat with no abilities.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.ratmogrify.desc:
The hero transforms an enemy into a rat for 6 turns! Bosses, allies, and rats cannot be ratmogrified.

Ratmogrified enemies retain their original stats, but do not have any abilities.
messages.actors.hero.abilities.ratmogrify$transmo: This enemy has been transformed into a rat. A big improvement, if you ask me! - Rat King
messages.actors.hero.spells.auraofprotection.name: aura of protection
messages.actors.hero.spells.auraofprotection.shor: Boosts defence for Paladin and nearby allies.
messages.actors.hero.spells.auraofprotection.desc:
The Paladin begins radiating protective energy in a sparkling aura around themselves for 20 turns. Any ally within 2 tiles of the Paladin (including themselves) takes %1$d%% less damage, and gains the effect of the Paladin's armor glyph at +%2$d%% power.

This damage reduction takes place before other damage-reducing effects (e.g. armor). The glyph power boost will always apply, but this spell cannot cause the Paladin's glyph to apply more than once if a character is already benefitting from it (e.g. the Paladin themselves, or a prismatic image).
messages.actors.hero.spells.auraofprotection$aura:
The Paladin is radiating protective energy around themselves.

Any nearby ally (including the Paladin themselves) takes reduced damage and gains the effect of the Paladin's armor glyph with boosted power.

Turns Remaining: %s.
messages.actors.hero.spells.beamingray.name: beaming ray
messages.actors.hero.spells.beamingray.no_space: There's no space for your ally to appear there.
messages.actors.hero.spells.beamingray.out_of_ran: That location is out of range.
messages.actors.hero.spells.beamingray.short_desc: Teleports your ally and grants bonus damage.
messages.actors.hero.spells.beamingray.desc:
The Cleric channels the power on their ally into a ray of light that beams them to a location. If the ray collides with an enemy it will place the ally nearby and direct them towards the enemy.

The ray has a maximum range of %1$d tiles, and will increase Power of Many's bonus damage to +%2$d%% for 10 turns against the closest enemy within 4 tiles. Beaming ray can even teleport normally immobile allies, but its range is halved in these cases.
messages.actors.hero.spells.beamingray$beamingray:
This ally was recently teleported by Beaming Ray, giving them bonus damage against the nearest enemy after the teleport. Power of Many also won't expire when this buff is active.

Turns Remaining: %s.
messages.actors.hero.spells.blessspell.name: bless
messages.actors.hero.spells.blessspell.short_desc: Blesses & shields Cleric, blesses & heals others.
messages.actors.hero.spells.blessspell.desc:
The Cleric places a holy blessing on themselves or another character they can see.

When cast on themselves the effect is weaker, granting %1$d turns of bless and %2$d barrier.

When cast on other characters the spell is more powerful, granting %3$d turns of bless and %4$d healing. Excess healing is converted into barrier.
messages.actors.hero.spells.bodyform.name: body form
messages.actors.hero.spells.bodyform.short_desc: Assigns Trinity to an enchant or glyph.
messages.actors.hero.spells.bodyform.desc:
The Cleric chooses an enchantment or glyph that they have identified this run and imbues Trinity with its effect.

When Trinity is used, The Cleric gains the effect of the chosen enchantment or glyph for %d turns. This temporary enchant or glyph will work with any effect that a regular enchantment or glyph would.

This spell replaces any other body effect that Trinity is currently imbued with.
messages.actors.hero.spells.bodyform$bodyformbuff:
Trinity's body form is currently granting you the power of an enchantment or glyph, as if you had it equipped on your current weapon or armor.

Note that body form cannot provide another copy of an effect that you're already benefitting from.

Current Effect: %1$s.

Turns Remaining: %2$s.
messages.actors.hero.spells.cleanse.name: cleanse
messages.actors.hero.spells.cleanse.desc: The Cleric clears all harmful status effects on themselves and visible allies. After the spell ends all characters affected also gain %1$d turns of debuff immunity, and %2$d barrier.
messages.actors.hero.spells.divinesense.name: divine sense
messages.actors.hero.spells.divinesense.short_des: Gain temporary mind vision in a wide range.
messages.actors.hero.spells.divinesense.desc: The Cleric focuses their senses on their surroundings, gaining mind vision with a %d tile range for 50 turns. This spell takes no time to cast.
messages.actors.hero.spells.divinesense$divinesen:
This character is temporarily able to see other nearby creatures with their mind!

Turns remaining: %s.
messages.actors.hero.spells.divineintervention.sh: Massive shield boost to Cleric and allies.
messages.actors.hero.spells.divineintervention.de:
The Cleric pours a tremendous amount of power from their tome into themselves and allies, boosting everyone to %1$d shielding and extending Ascended Form by %2$d turns. This spell's incredible defensive power is weighed against its very high charge cost.

Just like other shielding granted by ascended form, this shielding does not decay normally, but will immediately expire when ascended form ends.
messages.actors.hero.spells.flash.name: flash
messages.actors.hero.spells.flash.desc: The Cleric channels their ascended form at a nearby location and teleports there. Flash can teleport the Cleric to any discovered location that is in range and unoccupied. This spell costs more tome charges every time it is used in the same ascended form.
messages.actors.hero.spells.guidinglight.name: guiding light
messages.actors.hero.spells.guidinglight.short_de: Deals ranged magic damage and guarantees a hit.
messages.actors.hero.spells.guidinglight.desc: The Cleric fires a bolt of magical energy which strikes a target, dealing 2-8 damage and illuminating them. The next non-encumbered physical attack made against an illuminated enemy is guaranteed to hit them.
messages.actors.hero.spells.guidinglight.desc_pri: _This spell is more powerful when cast by the Priest._ The first cast of the spell every 50 turns costs no tome charges, and illumination will be consumed by radiance, wands, other characters, and artifacts that directly affect enemies. When illuminated is used in this way, it deals bonus magic damage equal to the Priest's level + 5.
messages.actors.hero.spells.guidinglight$guidingl:
The Priest will be able to cast Guiding Light for free again after 50 turns elapse.

Turns remaining: %s.
messages.actors.hero.spells.guidinglight$illumina: This character is glowing as a result of being struck by guiding light. While the glow isn't strong enough to brighten the surrounding area, the magical effect will make landing blows on them much easier for the Cleric.

The Priest can additionally consume illuminated with radiance, a wand zap, strike from an ally, or effects from some artifacts. Using illuminated in this way will deal bonus magic damage equal to the Priest's level + 5.
Other heroes can still use illuminated to benefit from the searing light talent, but will not gain any accuracy.
messages.actors.hero.spells.hallowedground.name: hallowed ground
messages.actors.hero.spells.hallowedground.short_: Heals allies, slows enemies, and spreads grass in an AOE.
messages.actors.hero.spells.hallowedground.desc:
The Priest focuses their divine magic into the ground nearby, creating a %1$dx%1$d area of hallowed terrain for 20 turns.

When it is cast, this spell heals all allies for 15 HP (healthy allies and the Priest get shielding), briefly roots enemies, and spreads short grass.

The hallowed terrain heals allies for 1 HP per turn (healthy allies and the Priest get shielding), cripples enemies, and randomly causes tall grass to grow.

Hallowed terrain is destroyed by fire, and will produce furrowed grass if passive regen effects are disabled or the Priest has not gained exp in a while.
messages.actors.hero.spells.hallowedground$hallow: The ground has been hallowed here. Hallowed ground slows enemies, heals allies, and causes grass to spread.
messages.actors.hero.spells.holyintuition.name: holy intuition
messages.actors.hero.spells.holyintuition.cursed: You sense malevolent magic lurking within this item.
messages.actors.hero.spells.holyintuition.uncurse: This item is free of malevolent magic.
messages.actors.hero.spells.holyintuition.short_d: identifies whether an item is cursed or not.
messages.actors.hero.spells.holyintuition.desc: The Cleric focuses their senses on an item and determines whether it is cursed or not without having to equip it.
messages.actors.hero.spells.holylance.name: holy lance
messages.actors.hero.spells.holylance.desc:
The Priest concentrates a large amount of energy into a devastating thrown lance made of light. This lance deals %1$d-%2$d damage and always deals maximum damage to undead and demonic targets.

This spell is very expensive, and has a cooldown of 30 turns.
messages.actors.hero.spells.holylance$lancecooldo:
The Priest has recently cast Holy Lance, and must wait before casting it again.

Turns remaining: %s.
messages.actors.hero.spells.holyward.name: holy ward
messages.actors.hero.spells.holyward.glyph_desc: This glyph slightly increases the amount of damage armor can block.
messages.actors.hero.spells.holyward.short_desc: Temporarily overrides glyphs to boost armor blocking.
messages.actors.hero.spells.holyward.desc:
The Cleric imbues their worn armor with glyphs of holy light, increasing the armor's damage blocking by 1. This spell takes no time to cast.

This glyph lasts for 50 turns, and will override any beneficial glyph the armor has for the duration. The Cleric will benefit from this effect even if they have no armor.
messages.actors.hero.spells.holyward.desc_paladin: _This spell is more powerful when cast by the Paladin._ The additional damage blocking is increased to 3, the spell no longer overrides existing glyphs, and casting other spells while holy ward is active will extend its duration by 10 turns per charge used.
The Cleric has imbued their worn armor with holy energy, temporarily overriding any existing glyph and causing the armor to block an extra 1 point of damage.

Turns Remaining: %s.

The Paladin has imbued their worn armor with holy energy, causing the armor to block an extra 3 points of damage.

Casting other spells while holy ward is active will extend its duration by 10 turns per charge spent.

Turns Remaining: %s.
messages.actors.hero.spells.holyweapon.name: holy weapon
messages.actors.hero.spells.holyweapon.ench_desc: Enemies struck by a holy weapon will take extra magical damage.
messages.actors.hero.spells.holyweapon.short_desc: Temporarily overrides enchantments to boost damage.
messages.actors.hero.spells.holyweapon.desc:
The Cleric enchants their worn weapon with holy energy, causing the weapon to deal an additional 2 magical damage any time they strike an enemy with it. This spell takes no time to cast.

This enchantment lasts for 50 turns, and will override any beneficial enchantment the weapon has for the duration. Unarmed strikes can also benefit from this effect.
messages.actors.hero.spells.holyweapon.desc_palad: _This spell is more powerful when cast by the Paladin._ The additional magical damage is increased to 6, the spell no longer overrides existing enchantments, and casting other spells while holy weapon is active will extend its duration by 10 turns per charge used.
messages.actors.hero.spells.holyweapon$holywepbuf:
The Cleric has imbued their worn weapon with holy energy, temporarily overriding any existing enchantment and causing the weapon to deal an extra 2 magical damage on each attack.

Turns Remaining: %s.

The Paladin has imbued their worn weapon with holy energy, causing their attacks to deal an extra 6 magical damage.

Casting other spells while holy weapon is active will extend its duration by 10 turns per charge spent.

Turns Remaining: %s.
messages.actors.hero.spells.judgement.name: judgement
messages.actors.hero.spells.judgement.desc:
The Cleric slams their fist onto the ground, causing an eruption of light that deals damage to all enemies they can see. This deals %1$d-%2$d damage at base, but also deals an additional 33%% damage for each spell the Cleric has cast since entering ascended form (or since they last cast Judgement).

Currently Judgement will deal %3$d-%4$d damage.
messages.actors.hero.spells.layonhands.name: lay on hands
messages.actors.hero.spells.layonhands.short_desc: Instantly heals an adjacent character or shields the Paladin.
messages.actors.hero.spells.layonhands.desc:
The Paladin channels holy energy through their hands, healing or protecting whatever they touch.

The Paladin can cast this spell on any adjacent character to give them %1$d healing, or on themselves to gain %1$d shielding. Excess healing from this spell is converted into shielding.

This spell is cast instantaneously and can be cast repeatedly, but cannot grant more than three casts worth of shielding at a time.
messages.actors.hero.spells.lifelinkspell.name: life link
messages.actors.hero.spells.lifelinkspell.short_d: Shares damage with an ally, and reduces their damage taken.
messages.actors.hero.spells.lifelinkspell.desc:
The Cleric strengthens the link between themselves and their empowered ally. With this empowered link, any damage taken will be shared between both the hero and their ally for %1$d turns, and Power of Many's defensive boost will be increased to -%2$d%% damage taken. Note that the damage is shared after armor, but before Power of Many's damage reduction.

While this effect is active, beneficial Cleric spells of T3 or below will apply to both the Cleric and their ally if they would have just applied to one of them.
messages.actors.hero.spells.lifelinkspell$lifelin:
The Cleric recently cast Life Link on this ally.

In addition to Life Link's regular benefits, this character also takes reduced damage, any positive Cleric spells are applied to both the Cleric and this ally instead of just one, and Power of Many won't expire while this buff is active.

Turns Remaining: %s.
messages.actors.hero.spells.mindform.name: mind form
messages.actors.hero.spells.mindform.short_desc: Assigns Trinity to a wand or thrown weapon.
messages.actors.hero.spells.mindform.desc:
The Cleric chooses a wand or thrown weapons that they have identified this run and imbues Trinity with its effect.

When Trinity is used, The Cleric can make a single attack as if they were using the chosen item at +%d. This will trigger all effects that using that type of item would normally trigger.

This spell replaces any other mind effect that Trinity is currently imbued with.
messages.actors.hero.spells.mnemonicprayer.name: mnemonic prayer
messages.actors.hero.spells.mnemonicprayer.short_: Extends buffs/debuffs on an ally/enemy, & re-applies illuminated.
messages.actors.hero.spells.mnemonicprayer.desc:
The Priest utters a prayer that extends the duration of all buffs or debuffs on a specific target by %1$d turns. This spell takes no time to cast. Positive effects will last longer on allies (including the Priest themselves), and harmful effects will last longer on enemies.

Mnemonic Prayer can only extend a specific instance of a buff or debuff once, and cannot extend buffs granted from armor abilities.
messages.actors.hero.spells.radiance.name: radiance
messages.actors.hero.spells.radiance.short_desc: Illuminates and briefly stuns visible enemies.
messages.actors.hero.spells.radiance.desc: The Priest erupts in holy light, stunning all visible enemies for 3 turns. If an enemy is already illuminated, Radiance will trigger illuminate's bonus damage and then apply the illuminated debuff. Radiance will also cause the Priest to glow for 100 turns if the current floor is dark.
messages.actors.hero.spells.recallinscription.sho: Repeats a recently used runestone or scroll.
messages.actors.hero.spells.recallinscription.des:
The Cleric uses holy magic to re-cast the effect of a magical rune found on a runestone or scroll they used in the last %s turns.

Recall Inscription cannot be used to replicate scrolls of upgrade. This spell's charge cost varies based on which item was used recently: 2 for a runestone, 3 for a scroll, 4 for an exotic scroll. This charge cost is also doubled when replicating a scroll of transmutation, or alchemy items that must be crafted using transmutation or upgrade.
messages.actors.hero.spells.recallinscription$use:
The Cleric has recently used an item that works with the inscribed recall spell. The Cleric can cast the spell to repeat the item's effect.

Item Used: %1$s.

Turns Remaining: %2$s.
messages.actors.hero.spells.shieldoflight.name: shield of light
messages.actors.hero.spells.shieldoflight.short_d: Grants temporary armor against a target.
messages.actors.hero.spells.shieldoflight.desc:
The Cleric creates a thin barrier of light between themselves and an enemy, increasing their armor's block power against that enemy by %1$d-%2$d for 5 turns.

This spell takes no time to cast, but cannot be used against multiple targets simultaneously.
messages.actors.hero.spells.shieldoflight$shieldo:
A thin shield of light is standing between this character and an enemy. It's not strong enough to outright block attacks, but will soften them.

Turns Remaining: %s
messages.actors.hero.spells.spiritform.name: spirit form
messages.actors.hero.spells.spiritform.short_desc: Assigns Trinity to a ring or artifact.
messages.actors.hero.spells.spiritform.desc:
The Cleric chooses a ring or artifact that they have identified this run (except the holy tome) and imbues Trinity with its effect.

If a ring is chosen, then Trinity grants that ring's effect at +%1$d for 20 turns.

If an artifact is chosen, then Trinity replicates that Artifact's effect at +%2$d. Each artifact has different specific behaviors and armor charge costs when used with Trinity.

This spell replaces any other spirit effect that Trinity is currently imbued with.
messages.actors.hero.spells.spiritform$spiritform:
Trinity's spirit form is currently granting you the power of an item, as if you had it equipped.

Note that spirit form cannot provide another copy of an effect that you're already benefitting from.

Current Effect: %1$s.

Turns Remaining: %2$s.
messages.actors.hero.spells.smite.name: smite
messages.actors.hero.spells.smite.short_desc: Guarantees a hit with bonus damage and enchant power.
messages.actors.hero.spells.smite.desc:
The Paladin infuses a melee strike with righteous destructive power.

In addition to dealing normal melee damage, Smite makes non-encumbered attacks guaranteed to hit, has +300%% enchantment power, and deals %1$d - %2$d bonus magic damage.

Smite's bonus magic damage scales with the Paladin's level, and it will always deal maximum bonus magic damage against undead or demonic foes.
messages.actors.hero.spells.stasis.name: stasis
messages.actors.hero.spells.stasis.short_desc: Removes ally from dungeon and preserves them.
messages.actors.hero.spells.stasis.desc:
The Cleric focuses their connection with their ally toward themselves, causing the ally to be temporarily held in a sort of energy stasis within the Cleric. The ally will be preserved for up to %d turns, with all positive effects on them being unaffected by their time in stasis.

The ally will appear next to the Cleric when stasis ends naturally or they can instantly re-cast the spell at no cost to end the effect early. Stasis can even move immobile allies, but cannot transfer them between floors.
messages.actors.hero.spells.stasis$stasisbuff.lef: Your immobile ally is left behind.
messages.actors.hero.spells.stasis$stasisbuff.des:
The Cleric currently has an ally stored in stasis. All positive effects on this ally are preserved, including Power of Many, and they will reappear next to the Cleric when the effect ends. The effect can also be ended early by re-casting Stasis.

Ally in stasis: %1$s.
Turns Remaining: %2$s.
messages.actors.hero.spells.sunray.name: sunray
messages.actors.hero.spells.sunray.short_desc: Deals ranged magic damage and blinds a target once.
messages.actors.hero.spells.sunray.desc:
The Cleric fires a ray of blinding light at a target, dealing %1$d-%2$d damage and blinding them for %3$d turns. Sunray always deals maximum damage to undead and demonic targets.

After being struck with this spell an enemy's vision will adjust, preventing them from being blinded by it again. However, if they are struck again while blinded by this spell, then the light is overwhelming and paralyses them instead.
messages.actors.hero.spells.walloflight.name: wall of light
messages.actors.hero.spells.walloflight.short_des: Creates a wall that blocks enemies.
messages.actors.hero.spells.walloflight.desc:
The Paladin creates a wall made out of panels of solid light directly in front of themselves which is 1 tile thick, %1$d tiles wide, and lasts for 20 turns.

This wall acts just like a regular one, except it can be seen through. Enemies that are caught in the wall when its created will be momentarily stunned and pushed back if possible. Anything stuck in the wall will be able to move out of it.

The wall can be cast in any of the four cardinal or four diagonal directions. If a wall is already active, the spell can be re-used for free to instantly clear the wall.
messages.actors.hero.spells.walloflight.early_end: You dispel the wall of light.
messages.actors.hero.spells.walloflight$lightwall: Shimmering panels of light are blocking passage here.
messages.actors.hero.hero.name: you
messages.actors.hero.hero.leave: You can't leave yet, the rest of the dungeon awaits below!
messages.actors.hero.hero.level_cap: You cannot grow stronger, but your experiences do give you a surge of power!
messages.actors.hero.hero.locked_chest: This chest is locked and you don't have a matching key.
messages.actors.hero.hero.locked_door: You don't have a matching key.
messages.actors.hero.hero.search_distracted: It's hard to concentrate, searching is exhausting.
messages.actors.hero.hero.key_distracted: You can't quite get the lock open, you'll have to keep trying.
messages.actors.hero.hero.pain_resist: The pain helps you resist the urge to sleep.
messages.actors.hero.hero.revive: The ankh explodes with life-giving energy!
messages.actors.hero.heroclass.warrior_desc_short: The Warrior endures extra damage with shielding granted by his _broken seal._ The seal can be moved between armors and _transfers a single upgrade._
messages.actors.hero.heroclass.warrior_desc:
The Warrior starts with a _unique broken seal_ that grants him a burst of shielding when he is below half health. The seal can be moved between armors, and can _transfer a single upgrade_ with it.

The Warrior also starts with a _worn shortsword_, _three throwing stones_, cloth armor, a waterskin, and a velvet pouch.

The Warrior automatically identifies:
_-_ Scrolls of Identify
_-_ Potions of Healing
_-_ Scrolls of Rage
messages.actors.hero.heroclass.mage_desc_short: The Mage is an arcane expert and carries a _magical staff_ that's stronger than a wand. The staff can be _imbued with any wand_ the Mage finds.
messages.actors.hero.heroclass.mage_desc:
The Mage starts with a _unique staff_, which recharges significantly faster than a wand and has 1 more charge. The staff _can be imbued with any wand_ the Mage finds in the dungeon.

The Mage also starts with a _wand of magic missile_ imbued in his staff, cloth armor, a waterskin, and a velvet pouch.

The Mage automatically identifies:
_-_ Scrolls of Identify
_-_ Potions of Liquid Flame
_-_ Scrolls of Upgrade
messages.actors.hero.heroclass.mage_unlock: To unlock the Mage _use a scroll of upgrade to make an item stronger._
messages.actors.hero.heroclass.rogue_desc_short: The Rogue can evade enemies and strike from invisibility using his _cloak of shadows._ He also _detects secrets and traps_ from a greater distance.
messages.actors.hero.heroclass.rogue_desc:
The Rogue starts with a _unique Cloak of Shadows_, which he can use to become invisible at will.

The Rogue can _detect secrets and traps_ from a greater distance.

The Rogue also starts with _a dagger_, _three throwing knives_, cloth armor, a waterskin, and a velvet pouch.

The Rogue automatically identifies:
_-_ Scrolls of Identify
_-_ Potions of Invisibility
_-_ Scrolls of Magic Mapping
messages.actors.hero.heroclass.rogue_unlock: To unlock the Rogue _perform 10 surprise attacks in one game._
messages.actors.hero.heroclass.huntress_desc_shor: The Huntress is a master of thrown weapons and has a _magical bow_ with infinite arrows. She also travels through tall grass _without trampling it._
messages.actors.hero.heroclass.huntress_desc:
The Huntress starts with a _unique spirit bow_, which can fire an infinite number of conjured arrows.

The Huntress can travel through tall grass _without trampling it_.

The Huntress also starts with _studded gloves_, cloth armor, a waterskin, and a velvet pouch.

The Huntress automatically identifies:
_-_ Scrolls of Identify
_-_ Potions of Mind Vision
_-_ Scrolls of Lullaby
messages.actors.hero.heroclass.huntress_unlock: To unlock the Huntress _hit enemies with thrown weapons 10 times in one game._
messages.actors.hero.heroclass.duelist_desc_short: The Duelist is a weapons master who can use her weapon to trigger a _special weapon ability._ This special ability is _different for every weapon._
messages.actors.hero.heroclass.duelist_desc:
The Duelist starts with a _unique rapier_ with a special ability that recharges over time.

Every weapon in the game has a _different special ability_ that the Duelist can use.

The Duelist also starts with _two throwing spikes_, cloth armor, a waterskin, and a velvet pouch.

The Duelist automatically identifies:
_-_ Scrolls of Identify
_-_ Potions of Strength
_-_ Scrolls of Mirror Image
messages.actors.hero.heroclass.duelist_unlock: To unlock the Duelist _equip a tier 2 or higher weapon with no strength penalty._
messages.actors.hero.heroclass.cleric_desc_short: The Cleric is a divine spellcaster who uses their unique _holy tome_ to channel divine magic. They can _learn and upgrade spells_ via talents.
messages.actors.hero.heroclass.cleric_desc:
The Cleric starts with a _unique holy tome_, which they can use to cast various spells.

Most of the Cleric's talents are focused around learning or upgrading spells.

The Cleric also starts with _a cudgel_, cloth armor, a waterskin, and a velvet pouch.

The Cleric automatically identifies:
_-_ Scrolls of Identify
_-_ Potions of Purity
_-_ Scrolls of Remove Curse
messages.actors.hero.heroclass.cleric_unlock: To unlock the Cleric _fully cleanse the curse on any piece of cursed equipment._
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.berserker_short: The _Berserker_ builds rage as he takes damage. Rage increases his damage and can be activated at 100% for bonus shielding.
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.berserker_desc:
The Berserker gains rage as he takes physical damage, including damage that gets blocked by his armor! Rage steadily fades away over time, but fades more slowly if he is at low HP.

Rage can cause the Berserker to deal up to +50% damage. At max rage he can go berserk, gaining a burst of shielding and keeping his rage as long as he has shielding left. The shielding scales with the level of the berserker's armor, and can be massively boosted if he is at low health. The Berserker needs time to recover after he goes berserk.
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.gladiator_short: The _Gladiator_ builds combo when he makes successful attacks. He can spend combo to use unique abilities.
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.gladiator_desc:
The Gladiator builds one point of combo every time he makes a successful attack with a melee or thrown weapon. If the Gladiator does not make a successful attack within 5 turns (15 turns after a kill), his combo is reset.

As he builds combo the Gladiator can use a variety of abilities that are guaranteed to hit:
2 Combo: knock enemy back, preserves combo
4 Combo: deal damage based on armor
6 Combo: parry, preserves combo
8 Combo: damage target and nearby enemies
10 Combo: attack once for each combo
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.battlemage_shor: The _Battlemage_ conjures bonus effects when fighting in melee with his staff. These effects depend on the wand his staff is imbued with.
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.battlemage_desc: The Battlemage gains a bonus effect whenever he strikes in melee with his staff, as if his staff had an additional enchantment. These effects depend on the wand his staff is imbued with, every wand has its own effect. In addition to the wand effects, the Battlemage's staff will also gain 0.5 charges when he strikes with it.
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.warlock_short_d: The _Warlock_ has a chance to soul mark enemies with his wands. He will heal whenever he deals physical damage to marked enemies.
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.warlock_desc:
The Warlock has a chance to inflict a soul mark on characters when he uses wands on them. The chance to apply a soul mark and its duration increase with wand level.

When an enemy is soul marked, the Warlock will heal 2 hp for every 5 damage he deals to them, but only with attacks from melee or thrown weapons, not from wands!
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.assassin_short_: The _Assassin_ can prepare a deadly strike while he is invisible. The longer he waits, the more powerful the attack will be.
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.assassin_desc:
The Assassin prepares his next strike when he becomes invisible. The longer he prepares for, the more powerful his next attack will be. Preparation builds for up to 9 turns.

After preparing, the Assassin deals bonus damage on his next attack, can blink to his target, and can even instantly kill enemies who are weak enough.
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.freerunner_shor: The _Freerunner_ builds momentum as he runs, which can be used to start freerunning. This grants him bonus speed and evasion for a short while.
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.freerunner_desc:
As the Freerunner moves he builds stacks of momentum. He can gain up to 10 momentum after running for 10 turns, but rapidly loses it if he stops moving. The freerunner can use up his momentum to start freerunning, for 2 turns per point of momentum.

When freerunning the Freerunner moves at 2x speed, and gains bonus evasion in proportion to his level. Once freerunning ends there is a cooldown before momentum can be built again.
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.sniper_short_de: The _Sniper_ can pierce armor with her ranged attacks. After striking with a thrown weapon she can follow up with a special attack from her bow.
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.sniper_desc:
The Sniper is a master of ranged combat, whose ranged attacks pierce enemy armor. When she attacks an enemy with a thrown weapon, she places a sniper's mark on them, which lets her follow up with a special attack from her bow. This special attack varies based on how her bow is augmented.

An unaugmented bow will fire a snapshot which deals reduced damage but fires instantly. A speed bow will fire a volley of three arrows which deal reduced damage, can still activate enchantments, and take 1 turn to fire. A damage bow will fire a sniper shot which is guaranteed to hit, deals bonus damage based on distance, and takes 2 turns to fire.
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.warden_short_de: The _Warden_ can see through tall grass and gains bonus effects when she plants seeds and tramples plants.
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.warden_desc:
The Warden has a strong connection to nature which grants her a variety of bonus effects relating to grass and plants. She is able to see through tall and furrowed grass as if it were empty space.

The Warden causes grass to sprout up around any seed she throws or plants, and gains special effects when trampling plants. These special effects replace the regular plant effects, meaning that no plant is harmful for her to step on.
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.champion_short_: The _Champion_ can wield two weapons and gets more weapon charges. Her regular attacks use her primary weapon, but she can swap weapons and use either weapon's ability.
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.champion_desc:
The Champion is a master of melee weapons who can equip a secondary weapon in addition to her primary one. Her regular attacks use her primary weapon, but she can swap her primary weapon instantly and use either weapon's ability.

She also gains 2 more max weapon ability charges and +50% weapon ability recharge speed.
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.monk_short_desc: The _Monk_ builds energy while fighting. This energy can be spent on a variety of unique abilities.
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.monk_desc:
The Monk is a master of physical technique. As she defeats enemies, she gains energy which can be used on a variety of defensive and utility-focused abilities. This energy does not fade over time, but has a cap based on the Monk's level.

1 Energy: quickly strike with fists
2 Energy: focus to dodge next attack
3 Energy: instantly dash nearby
4 Energy: kick an enemy away
5 Energy: meditate to clear statuses and restore wand & artifact charge
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.priest_short_de: The _Priest_ gains new long-range spells and an empowered version of guiding light.
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.priest_desc:
The Priest gains a variety of new and upgraded spells that emphasize ranged combat and synergy with magical items.

The Priest can cast _Guiding Light_ for free once every 50 turns, illuminates enemies directly targeted by any of their spells, and can consume the illumination debuff with allies, wands, and some artifacts for bonus damage equal to their level + 5.

The Priest also gains the _Radiance_ spell, which dispels darkness and affects all visible enemies, triggering and applying illuminate and briefly stunning them at the cost of 2 charges.
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.paladin_short_d: The _Paladin_ gains new short-range spells and empowered versions of holy weapon and ward.
messages.actors.hero.herosubclass.paladin_desc:
The Paladin gains a variety of new and upgraded spells that emphasize melee combat and synergy with weapons and armor.

The Paladin's _Holy Weapon_ and _Holy Ward_ spells grant larger bonuses, no longer override existing enchantments and glyphs, and can be extended by casting other spells.

The Paladin also gains the _Smite_ spell, which lets them perform a guaranteed melee hit with bonus damage and enchantment power.

messages.actors.hero.talent.hearty_meal.title: hearty meal
messages.actors.hero.talent.hearty_meal.desc:
_+1:_ Eating food heals the Warrior for _4 HP_ when he is at or below 33% health.

_+2:_ Eating food heals the Warrior for _6 HP_ when he is at or below 33% health.
messages.actors.hero.talent.veterans_intuition.de:
_+1:_ The Warrior identifies weapons _1.75x faster_ and armor _2.5x faster_.

_+2:_ The Warrior identifies weapons _2.5x faster_ and armor _when he equips it_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.provoked_anger.title: provoked anger
messages.actors.hero.talent.provoked_anger.desc:
_+1:_ When any shielding buff applied to the Warrior is broken by damage, his next physical attack will deal _3 bonus damage_.

_+2:_ When any shielding buff applied to the Warrior is broken by damage, his next physical attack will deal _5 bonus damage_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.iron_will.title: iron will
messages.actors.hero.talent.iron_will.desc:
_+1:_ The shield provided by the Warrior's seal is _increased by 1_.

_+2:_ The shield provided by the Warrior's seal is _increased by 2_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.iron_will.meta_desc: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will passively grant a 1 or 2 max shield version of the Warrior's broken seal effect.
messages.actors.hero.talent.iron_stomach.title: iron stomach
messages.actors.hero.talent.iron_stomach.desc:
_+1:_ Eating food takes the Warrior 1 turn and grants him _75% damage resistance_ while eating.

_+2:_ Eating food takes the Warrior 1 turn and grants him _100% damage resistance_ while eating.
messages.actors.hero.talent.liquid_willpower.desc:
_+1:_ The Warrior gains _6.5% of his max HP in shielding_ when drinking or throwing a potion, brew, or elixir.

_+2:_ The Warrior gains _10% of his max HP in shielding_ when drinking or throwing a potion, brew, or elixir.

The shield amount is doubled when using potions of strength, experience, or alchemy items that must be crafted using those potions.

For alchemy items with higher output quantities (e.g. aqua brew), this talent has a chance to trigger based on how many of that item is produced.
messages.actors.hero.talent.runic_transference.de:
_+1:_ The Warrior's broken seal can transfer _regular glyphs_ in the same way it transfers an upgrade.

_+2:_ The Warrior's broken seal can transfer _regular, powerful, and curse glyphs_ in the same way it transfers an upgrade.

The seal can only transfer glyphs if they were applied to the armor when the seal was attached.
messages.actors.hero.talent.runic_transference.me: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead help glyphs on your armor resist being removed by scrolls of upgrade. Glyphs will begin to be lost when upgrading from level 6(up from 4) at +1, or level 7(up from 4) at +2. The level where glyphs are guaranteed to be lost is unchanged at +8.
messages.actors.hero.talent.lethal_momentum.title: lethal momentum
messages.actors.hero.talent.lethal_momentum.desc:
_+1:_ When the Warrior lands a killing blow on an enemy with a physical weapon, it has a _67% chance_ to take 0 turns.

_+2:_ When the Warrior lands a killing blow on an enemy with a physical weapon, it has a _100% chance_ to take 0 turns.
messages.actors.hero.talent.improvised_projectile:
_+1:_ The Warrior can blind an enemy for _2 turns_ by throwing any item that isn’t a thrown weapon at them. This has a 50 turn cooldown.

_+2:_ The Warrior can blind an enemy for _3 turns_ by throwing any item that isn’t a thrown weapon at them. This has a 50 turn cooldown.
messages.actors.hero.talent.hold_fast.title: hold fast
messages.actors.hero.talent.hold_fast.desc:
_+1:_ When the Warrior waits with his seal equipped he gains _1-2 armor_ and slows the decay of combo and shielding buffs by _50%_ until he moves.

_+2:_ When the Warrior waits with his seal equipped he gains _2-4 armor_ and slows the decay of combo and shielding buffs by _75%_ until he moves.

_+3:_ When the Warrior waits with his seal equipped he gains _3-6 armor_ and slows the decay of combo and shielding buffs by _100%_ until he moves.
messages.actors.hero.talent.hold_fast.meta_desc: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it does not require the warrior's seal, but cannot grant more armor than the tier of your equipped armor plus its level.
messages.actors.hero.talent.strongman.title: strongman
messages.actors.hero.talent.strongman.desc:
_+1:_ The Warrior's strength is _increased by 8%_, rounded down.

_+2:_ The Warrior's strength is _increased by 13%_, rounded down.

_+3:_ The Warrior's strength is _increased by 18%_, rounded down.
messages.actors.hero.talent.endless_rage.title: endless rage
messages.actors.hero.talent.endless_rage.desc:
_+1:_ The Berserker can reach a max of _116% rage_.

_+2:_ The Berserker can reach a max of _133% rage_.

_+3:_ The Berserker can reach a max of _150% rage_.

Each point of rage above 100% increases berserk shielding by 1% and reduces cooldown by 1%, but does not increase the damage bonus beyond +50%.
messages.actors.hero.talent.deathless_fury.title: deathless fury
messages.actors.hero.talent.deathless_fury.desc:
_+1:_ Berserk automatically triggers if the Berserker is about to die and rage is at or above 100%, but it has a cooldown of _3 hero levels_ when this happens.

_+2:_ Berserk automatically triggers if the Berserker is about to die and rage is at or above 100%, but it has a cooldown of _2 hero levels_ when this happens.

_+3:_ Berserk automatically triggers if the Berserker is about to die and rage is at or above 100%, but it has a cooldown of _1 hero level_ when this happens.

Note that the Berserker will still die if he has 0 HP when berserking ends.
messages.actors.hero.talent.enraged_catalyst.desc:
_+1:_ Enchantments and curses on the Berserker's weapon trigger more often the more rage he has, to a maximum of _15% more often_ at 100% rage.

_+2:_ Enchantments and curses on the Berserker's weapon trigger more often the more rage he has, to a maximum of _30% more often_ at 100% rage.

_+3:_ Enchantments and curses on the Berserker's weapon trigger more often the more rage he has, to a maximum of _45% more often_ at 100% rage.
messages.actors.hero.talent.cleave.title: cleave
messages.actors.hero.talent.cleave.desc:
_+1:_ The extra time the Gladiator gets on a kill is increased to _30 turns_, from 15.

_+2:_ The extra time the Gladiator gets on a kill is increased to _45 turns_, from 15.

_+3:_ The extra time the Gladiator gets on a kill is increased to _60 turns_, from 15.
messages.actors.hero.talent.lethal_defense.title: lethal defense
messages.actors.hero.talent.lethal_defense.desc:
_+1:_ When the Gladiator kills an enemy with a combo move, the cooldown on his broken seal shielding is _reduced by 50 turns_.

_+2:_ When the Gladiator kills an enemy with a combo move, the cooldown on his broken seal shielding is _reduced by 100 turns_.

_+3:_ When the Gladiator kills an enemy with a combo move, the cooldown on his broken seal shielding is _reduced by 150 turns_.

The shield cooldown can be reduced to as low as -150 turns by this talent, which means it will immediately be available again once it is activated.
messages.actors.hero.talent.enhanced_combo.title: enhanced combo
messages.actors.hero.talent.enhanced_combo.desc:
_+1:_ When the Gladiator's combo is 7 or higher, Clobber's knockback range increases to 3, it inflicts vertigo, and it can knock enemies into pits.

_+2:_ In addition to the benefits of +1, when the Gladiator's combo is 9 or higher Parry works on multiple attacks.

_+3:_ In addition to the benefits of +1 and +2, the Gladiator can leap up to combo/3 tiles when using Slam, Crush, or Fury.
messages.actors.hero.talent.body_slam.title: body slam
messages.actors.hero.talent.body_slam.desc:
_+1:_ When the Warrior lands after jumping, all adjacent enemies take damage equal to _1-4 plus 25%_ of his damage blocking power.

_+2:_ When the Warrior lands after jumping, all adjacent enemies take damage equal to _2-8 plus 50%_ of his damage blocking power.

_+3:_ When the Warrior lands after jumping, all adjacent enemies take damage equal to _3-12 plus 75%_ of his damage blocking power.

_+4:_ When the Warrior lands after jumping, all adjacent enemies take damage equal to _4-16 plus 100%_ of his damage blocking power.
messages.actors.hero.talent.impact_wave.title: impact wave
messages.actors.hero.talent.impact_wave.desc:
_+1:_ When the Warrior lands after jumping, all adjacent enemies are knocked _2 tiles_ back and have a _25% chance_ of becoming vulnerable for 5 turns.

_+2:_ When the Warrior lands after jumping, all adjacent enemies are knocked _3 tiles_ back and have a _50% chance_ of becoming vulnerable for 5 turns.

_+3:_ When the Warrior lands after jumping, all adjacent enemies are knocked _4 tiles_ back and have a _75% chance_ of becoming vulnerable for 5 turns.

_+4:_ When the Warrior lands after jumping, all adjacent enemies are knocked _5 tiles_ back and have a _100% chance_ of becoming vulnerable for 5 turns.
messages.actors.hero.talent.double_jump.title: double jump
messages.actors.hero.talent.double_jump.desc:
_+1:_ If the Warrior performs a second leap within 3 turns, that leap has a _16% reduced_ charge cost.

_+2:_ If the Warrior performs a second leap within 3 turns, that leap has a _30% reduced_ charge cost.

_+3:_ If the Warrior performs a second leap within 3 turns, that leap has a _40% reduced_ charge cost.

_+4:_ If the Warrior performs a second leap within 3 turns, that leap has a _50% reduced_ charge cost.
messages.actors.hero.talent.expanding_wave.title: expanding wave
messages.actors.hero.talent.expanding_wave.desc:
_+1:_ Shockwave's range is increased to _6 tiles_ from 5, and its width is increased to _75 degrees_ from 60.

_+2:_ Shockwave's range is increased to _7 tiles_ from 5, and its width is increased to _90 degrees_ from 60.

_+3:_ Shockwave's range is increased to _8 tiles_ from 5, and its width is increased to _105 degrees_ from 60.

_+4:_ Shockwave's range is increased to _9 tiles_ from 5, and its width is increased to _120 degrees_ from 60.
messages.actors.hero.talent.striking_wave.title: striking wave
messages.actors.hero.talent.striking_wave.desc:
_+1:_ Shockwave has a _30% chance_ to also use on-hit effects like enchantments and combo.

_+2:_ Shockwave has a _60% chance_ to also use on-hit effects like enchantments and combo.

_+3:_ Shockwave has a _90% chance_ to also use on-hit effects like enchantments and combo.

_+4:_ Shockwave has a _100% chance_ to also use on-hit effects like enchantments and combo, and it gives enchantments _+20% power_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.shock_force.title: shock force
messages.actors.hero.talent.shock_force.desc:
_+1:_ Shockwave deals _20% more damage_ and has a _25% chance_ to stun instead of cripple.

_+2:_ Shockwave deals _40% more damage_ and has a _50% chance_ to stun instead of cripple.

_+3:_ Shockwave deals _60% more damage_ and has a _75% chance_ to stun instead of cripple.

_+4:_ Shockwave deals _80% more damage_ and has a _100% chance_ to stun instead of cripple.
messages.actors.hero.talent.sustained_retribution:
_+1:_ The Warrior deals _115% bonus damage_ spread over _2 hits_, instead of 100% bonus damage in 1 hit.

_+2:_ The Warrior deals _130% bonus damage_ spread over _3 hits_, instead of 100% bonus damage in 1 hit.

_+3:_ The Warrior deals _145% bonus damage_ spread over _4 hits_, instead of 100% bonus damage in 1 hit.

_+4:_ The Warrior deals _160% bonus damage_ spread over _5 hits_, instead of 100% bonus damage in 1 hit.
messages.actors.hero.talent.shrug_it_off.title: shrug it off
messages.actors.hero.talent.shrug_it_off.desc:
_+1:_ The Warrior's damage reduction while enduring is _increased to 60%_, from 50%.

_+2:_ The Warrior's damage reduction while enduring is _increased to 68%_, from 50%.

_+3:_ The Warrior's damage reduction while enduring is _increased to 74%_, from 50%.

_+4:_ The Warrior's damage reduction while enduring is _increased to 80%_, from 50%.
messages.actors.hero.talent.even_the_odds.title: even the odds
messages.actors.hero.talent.even_the_odds.desc:
_+1:_ The Warrior deals an additional _5% bonus damage_ for every enemy within 2 tiles when enduring ends.

_+2:_ The Warrior deals an additional _10% bonus damage_ for every enemy within 2 tiles when enduring ends.

_+3:_ The Warrior deals an additional _15% bonus damage_ for every enemy within 2 tiles when enduring ends.

_+4:_ The Warrior deals an additional _20% bonus damage_ for every enemy within 2 tiles when enduring ends.
messages.actors.hero.talent.empowering_meal.title: empowering meal
messages.actors.hero.talent.empowering_meal.desc:
_+1:_ Eating food grants the Mage _2 bonus damage_ on the next 3 times he deals damage with a wand.

_+2:_ Eating food grants the Mage _3 bonus damage_ on the next 3 times he deals damage with a wand.
messages.actors.hero.talent.scholars_intuition.de:
_+1:_ The Mage identifies wands _3x faster_.

_+2:_ The Mage identifies wands _when he uses them_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.lingering_magic.title: lingering magic
messages.actors.hero.talent.lingering_magic.desc:
_+1:_ When the Mage zaps with a wand or staff, his next physical attack deals _1-2 bonus damage_.

_+2:_ When the Mage zaps with a wand or staff, his next physical attack deals _2 bonus damage_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.backup_barrier.title: backup barrier
messages.actors.hero.talent.backup_barrier.desc:
_+1:_ The Mage gains _3 shielding_ whenever he spends the last charge in his staff.

_+2:_ The Mage gains _5 shielding_ whenever he spends the last charge in his staff.
messages.actors.hero.talent.backup_barrier.meta_d: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead trigger from the hero's highest level wand.
messages.actors.hero.talent.energizing_meal.title: energizing meal
messages.actors.hero.talent.energizing_meal.desc:
_+1:_ Eating food takes the Mage 1 turn and grants him _5 turns of wand recharging_.

_+2:_ Eating food takes the Mage 1 turn and grants him _8 turns of wand recharging_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.inscribed_power.title: inscribed power
messages.actors.hero.talent.inscribed_power.desc:
_+1:_ When the Mage reads a scroll or uses a spell item, his _next 2 wand zaps_ get +2 levels.

_+2:_ When the Mage reads a scroll or uses a spell item, his _next 3 wand zaps_ get +2 levels.

The number of enhanced wand zaps is doubled when using a scroll of upgrade, transmutation, or alchemy items that must be crafted using those scrolls.

For alchemy items with higher output quantities (e.g. most spells), this talent has a chance to trigger based on how many of that item is produced.
messages.actors.hero.talent.wand_preservation.des:
_+1:_ When the Mage imbues a new wand into his staff, the old wand is returned at +0, _but this can only be done once._

_+2:_ When the Mage imbues a new wand into his staff, the old wand is returned at +0, _this can be repeated with a one hero level cooldown._
messages.actors.hero.talent.wand_preservation.met: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead increase the amount of arcane resin gained when putting a wand into an alchemy pot by 1 at +1, or by 2 at +2.
messages.actors.hero.talent.arcane_vision.title: arcane vision
messages.actors.hero.talent.arcane_vision.desc:
_+1:_ When the Mage zaps an enemy, he gains mind vision on them for _10 turns_.

_+2:_ When the Mage zaps an enemy, he gains mind vision on them for _15 turns_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.shield_battery.title: shield battery
messages.actors.hero.talent.shield_battery.desc:
_+1:_ The Mage can self-target with a wand to convert all of its charges into shielding at a rate of _4% max HP per charge_.

_+2:_ The Mage can self-target with a wand to convert all of its charges into shielding at a rate of _6% max HP per charge_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.desperate_power.title: desperate power
messages.actors.hero.talent.desperate_power.desc:
_+1:_ The Mage's wands and staff gain _+1 level_ on their final zap when they are down to their last charge.

_+2:_ The Mage's wands and staff gain _+2 levels_ on their final zap when they are down to their last charge.

_+3:_ The Mage's wands and staff gain _+3 levels_ on their final zap when they are down to their last charge.
messages.actors.hero.talent.ally_warp.title: ally warp
messages.actors.hero.talent.ally_warp.desc:
_+1:_ The Mage can select an ally to instantly swap places with them, with a _2 tile range_.

_+2:_ The Mage can select an ally to instantly swap places with them, with a _4 tile range_.

_+3:_ The Mage can select an ally to instantly swap places with them, with a _6 tile range_.

The Mage cannot swap places with immobile allies.
messages.actors.hero.talent.empowered_strike.desc:
_+1:_ The Battlemage's first melee strike with his staff after zapping with it deals _+16% damage_ and the staff's bonus effect gets _+50% power_.

_+2:_ The Battlemage's first melee strike with his staff after zapping with it deals _+33% damage_ and the staff's bonus effect gets _+100% power_.

_+3:_ The Battlemage's first melee strike with his staff after zapping with it deals _+50% damage_ and the staff's bonus effect gets _+150% power_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.mystical_charge.title: mystical charge
messages.actors.hero.talent.mystical_charge.desc:
_+1:_ Striking with his staff grants the Battlemage _0.5 turns_ worth of artifact recharging.

_+2:_ Striking with his staff grants the Battlemage _1 turn_ worth of artifact recharging.

_+3:_ Striking with his staff grants the Battlemage _1.5 turns_ worth of artifact recharging.
messages.actors.hero.talent.excess_charge.title: excess charge
messages.actors.hero.talent.excess_charge.desc:
_+1:_ When the Battlemage's staff is fully charged, its next zap will grant him _0.67 shielding_ per level of the staff.

_+2:_ When the Battlemage's staff is fully charged, its next zap will grant him _1.33 shielding_ per level of the staff.

_+3:_ When the Battlemage's staff is fully charged, its next zap will grant him _2 shielding_ per level of the staff.
messages.actors.hero.talent.soul_siphon.title: soul siphon
messages.actors.hero.talent.soul_siphon.desc:
_+1:_ Physical damage dealt by other characters triggers the Warlock's soul mark at _13% effectiveness_.

_+2:_ Physical damage dealt by other characters triggers the Warlock's soul mark at _27% effectiveness_.

_+3:_ Physical damage dealt by other characters triggers the Warlock's soul mark at _40% effectiveness_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.soul_eater.title: soul eater
messages.actors.hero.talent.soul_eater.desc:
_+1:_ Soul mark grants _0.33 turns_ of satiety for each physical damage dealt. Soul marked enemies have a _10% chance_ to trigger on-eat effects when they die.

_+2:_ Soul mark grants _0.67 turns_ of satiety for each physical damage dealt. Soul marked enemies have a _20% chance_ to trigger on-eat effects when they die.

_+3:_ Soul mark grants _1 turn_ of satiety for each physical damage dealt. Soul marked enemies have a _30% chance_ to trigger on-eat effects when they die.
_+1:_ When a soul marked enemy dies, the Warlock has a _13% chance_ to raise them as a corrupted wraith.

_+2:_ When a soul marked enemy dies, the Warlock has a _27% chance_ to raise them as a corrupted wraith.

_+3:_ When a soul marked enemy dies, the Warlock has a _40% chance_ to raise them as a corrupted wraith.
messages.actors.hero.talent.blast_radius.title: blast radius
messages.actors.hero.talent.blast_radius.desc:
_+1:_ Elemental blast's radius is increased to _5 tiles_, from 4.

_+2:_ Elemental blast's radius is increased to _6 tiles_, from 4.

_+3:_ Elemental blast's radius is increased to _7 tiles_, from 4.

_+4:_ Elemental blast's radius is increased to _8 tiles_, from 4.
messages.actors.hero.talent.elemental_power.title: elemental power
messages.actors.hero.talent.elemental_power.desc:
_+1:_ The power of elemental blast is increased by _25%_.

_+2:_ The power of elemental blast is increased by _50%_.

_+3:_ The power of elemental blast is increased by _75%_.

_+4:_ The power of elemental blast is increased by _100%_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.reactive_barrier.desc:
_+1:_ The Mage gains _2.5 shielding_ for every character affected by elemental blast, to a max of 5 characters.

_+2:_ The Mage gains _5 shielding_ for every character affected by elemental blast, to a max of 6 characters.

_+3:_ The Mage gains _7.5 shielding_ for every character affected by elemental blast, to a max of 7 characters.

_+4:_ The Mage gains _10 shielding_ for every character affected by elemental blast, to a max of 8 characters.
messages.actors.hero.talent.wild_power.title: wild power
messages.actors.hero.talent.wild_power.desc:
_+1:_ When using wild magic, wands will be boosted by either _2 or 3, up to +4_.

_+2:_ When using wild magic, wands will be boosted by _3, up to +5_.

_+3:_ When using wild magic, wands will be boosted by either _3 or 4, up to +6_.

_+4:_ When using wild magic, wands will be boosted by _4, up to +7_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.fire_everything.title: fire everything
messages.actors.hero.talent.fire_everything.desc:
_+1:_ Wild magic now fires _5 times_ up from 4, and each wand has a _25% chance_ to be usable 3 times.

_+2:_ Wild magic now fires _6 times_ up from 4, and each wand has a _50% chance_ to be usable 3 times.

_+3:_ Wild magic now fires _7 times_ up from 4, and each wand has a _75% chance_ to be usable 3 times.

_+4:_ Wild magic now fires _8 times_ up from 4, and each wand has a _100% chance_ to be usable 3 times.
messages.actors.hero.talent.conserved_magic.title: conserved magic
messages.actors.hero.talent.conserved_magic.desc:
_+1:_ Each zap from wild magic now uses _0.33 charges_ instead of 0.5, and wild magic has a _25% chance_ to not spend a turn.

_+2:_ Each zap from wild magic now uses _0.225 charges_ instead of 0.5, and wild magic has a _50% chance_ to not spend a turn.

_+3:_ Each zap from wild magic now uses _0.15 charges_ instead of 0.5, and wild magic has a _75% chance_ to not spend a turn.

_+4:_ Each zap from wild magic now uses _0.1 charges_ instead of 0.5, and wild magic has a _100% chance_ to not spend a turn.
messages.actors.hero.talent.telefrag.title: Telefrag
messages.actors.hero.talent.telefrag.desc:
_+1:_ If the Mage warps into another character he deals _10-15 damage_ to it, but also takes _5 damage_.

_+2:_ If the Mage warps into another character he deals _20-30 damage_ to it, but also takes _10 damage_.

_+3:_ If the Mage warps into another character he deals _30-45 damage_ to it, but also takes _15 damage_.

_+4:_ If the Mage warps into another character he deals _40-60 damage_ to it, but also takes _20 damage_.

The hero cannot be killed by this talent, the self damage can be reduced by magic resisting effects.
messages.actors.hero.talent.remote_beacon.title: Remote Beacon
messages.actors.hero.talent.remote_beacon.desc:
_+1:_ The Mage can place a beacon at any location within _4 tiles_.

_+2:_ The Mage can place a beacon at any location within _8 tiles_.

_+3:_ The Mage can place a beacon at any location within _12 tiles_.

_+4:_ The Mage can place a beacon at any location within _16 tiles_.

The Mage cannot place beacons in locations that are inaccessible.
messages.actors.hero.talent.longrange_warp.title: Longrange Warp
messages.actors.hero.talent.longrange_warp.desc:
_+1:_ The Mage can now warp between floors, at _150% charge cost_.

_+2:_ The Mage can now warp between floors, at _117% charge cost_.

_+3:_ The Mage can now warp between floors, at _83% charge cost_.

_+4:_ The Mage can now warp between floors, at _50% charge cost_.

The Mage cannot use longrange warp to leave a locked floor.
messages.actors.hero.talent.cached_rations.title: cached rations
messages.actors.hero.talent.cached_rations.desc:
_+1:_ The Rogue can find _2 supply rations_ placed in chests while he explores the next few floors of the dungeon.

_+2:_ The Rogue can find _3 supply rations_ placed in chests while he explores the next few floors of the dungeon.

Supply rations are eaten quickly, restore a moderate amount of satiety, heal 5 hp, and restore 1 charge to the cloak of shadows.
messages.actors.hero.talent.thiefs_intuition.desc:
_+1:_ The Rogue identifies rings _2x faster_, and identifies the type of a ring _when he equips it_.

_+2:_ The Rogue identifies rings _when he equips them_, and identifies the type of a ring _when he picks it up_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.sucker_punch.title: sucker punch
messages.actors.hero.talent.sucker_punch.desc:
_+1:_ The Rogue deals _1-2 bonus damage_ the first time he surprise attacks an enemy.

_+2:_ The Rogue deals _2 bonus damage_ the first time he surprise attacks an enemy.
messages.actors.hero.talent.protective_shadows.de:
_+1:_ The Rogue gains one shielding _every other turn_ he is invisible, _to a max of 3_.

_+2:_ The Rogue gains one shielding _every turn_ he is invisible, _to a max of 5_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.mystical_meal.title: mystical meal
messages.actors.hero.talent.mystical_meal.desc:
_+1:_ Eating food takes the Rogue 1 turn (supply rations are eaten instantly) and grants him _3 turns of artifact recharging_.

_+2:_ Eating food takes the Rogue 1 turn (supply rations are eaten instantly) and grants him _5 turns of artifact recharging_.

This talent cannot be used to let the horn of plenty recharge itself.
messages.actors.hero.talent.inscribed_stealth.des:
_+1:_ The Rogue gains _3 turns_ of invisibility after reading a scroll or using a spell item.

_+2:_ The Rogue gains _5 turns_ of invisibility after reading a scroll or using a spell item.

The invisibility duration is doubled when using a scroll of upgrade, scroll of transmutation, or alchemy items that must be crafted using those scrolls.

For alchemy items with higher output quantities (e.g. most spells), this talent has a chance to trigger based on how many of that item is produced.
messages.actors.hero.talent.wide_search.title: wide search
messages.actors.hero.talent.wide_search.desc:
_+1:_ The Rogue’s search radius is increased from a 5x5 square to a _7x7 circle_.

_+2:_ The Rogue’s search radius is increased from a 5x5 square to a _7x7 square_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.wide_search.meta_desc: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead increase their search radius from a 3x3 square to a 5x5 circle at +1, or a 5x5 square at +2.
messages.actors.hero.talent.silent_steps.title: silent steps
messages.actors.hero.talent.silent_steps.desc:
_+1:_ The Rogue will not wake sleeping enemies while he is _3 or more tiles away from them_.

_+2:_ The Rogue will not wake sleeping enemies while he is _not adjacent to them_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.rogues_foresight.desc:
_+1:_ When the Rogue is on a level with a secret room, he has a _75% chance to notice_ that the level contains a secret.

_+2:_ When the Rogue is on a level with a secret room, he has a _100% chance to notice_ that the level contains a secret.
messages.actors.hero.talent.light_cloak.title: light cloak
messages.actors.hero.talent.light_cloak.desc:
_+1:_ The Rogue can use his cloak of shadows when it is not equipped, but it recharges at _25% speed_ when unequipped.

_+2:_ The Rogue can use his cloak of shadows when it is not equipped, but it recharges at _50% speed_ when unequipped.
