_+3:_ The Rogue can use his cloak of shadows when it is not equipped, but it recharges at _75% speed_ when unequipped.
messages.actors.hero.talent.light_cloak.meta_desc: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead increase the charging speed of all artifacts by 7/13/20% at +1/+2/+3.
messages.actors.hero.talent.enhanced_rings.title: enhanced rings
messages.actors.hero.talent.enhanced_rings.desc:
_+1:_ When the Rogue uses an artifact, his rings gain +1 upgrade for _3 turns_.

_+2:_ When the Rogue uses an artifact, his rings gain +1 upgrade for _6 turns_.

_+3:_ When the Rogue uses an artifact, his rings gain +1 upgrade for _9 turns_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.enhanced_lethality.de:
_+1:_ The Assassin can assassinate enemies left at below _4/13/27/67% health_ per level of preparation, up from 3/10/20/50%.

_+2:_ The Assassin can assassinate enemies left at below _5/17/33/83% health_ per level of preparation, up from 3/10/20/50%.

_+3:_ The Assassin can assassinate enemies left at below _6/20/40/100% health_ per level of preparation, up from 3/10/20/50%.
messages.actors.hero.talent.assassins_reach.title: assassin's reach
messages.actors.hero.talent.assassins_reach.desc:
_+1:_ The Assassin's blink range per level of preparation is increased to _1/3/4/6 tiles_, from 1/2/3/4.

_+2:_ The Assassin's blink range per level of preparation is increased to _2/4/6/8 tiles_, from 1/2/3/4.

_+3:_ The Assassin's blink range per level of preparation is increased to _2/5/7/10 tiles_, from 1/2/3/4.

This blink can go through hazards and enemies, but not through solid terrain like walls.
messages.actors.hero.talent.bounty_hunter.title: bounty hunter
messages.actors.hero.talent.bounty_hunter.desc:
_+1:_ When the Assassin kills an enemy with a prepared strike their item drop chance is increased by _2/4/8/16%_, per level of preparation.

_+2:_ When the Assassin kills an enemy with a prepared strike their item drop chance is increased by _4/8/16/32%_, per level of preparation.

_+3:_ When the Assassin kills an enemy with a prepared strike their item drop chance is increased by _6/12/24/48%_, per level of preparation.
messages.actors.hero.talent.evasive_armor.title: evasive armor
messages.actors.hero.talent.evasive_armor.desc:
_+1:_ While freerunning, the Freerunner gains an additional _+1 evasion_ per excess point of strength on his armor.

_+2:_ While freerunning, the Freerunner gains an additional _+2 evasion_ per excess point of strength on his armor.

_+3:_ While freerunning, the Freerunner gains an additional _+3 evasion_ per excess point of strength on his armor.
messages.actors.hero.talent.projectile_momentum.d:
_+1:_ While freerunning, the Freerunner gains _+50% accuracy and +15% damage_ with thrown weapons.

_+2:_ While freerunning, the Freerunner gains _+100% accuracy and +30% damage_ with thrown weapons.

_+3:_ While freerunning, the Freerunner gains _+150% accuracy and +45% damage_ with thrown weapons.
messages.actors.hero.talent.speedy_stealth.title: speedy stealth
messages.actors.hero.talent.speedy_stealth.desc:
_+1:_ The Freerunner gains 2 stacks of momentum per turn while he is invisible.

_+2:_ In addition to the benefits of +1, freerunning no longer counts down while the Freerunner is invisible.

_+3:_ In addition to the benefits of +1 and +2, the Freerunner moves at 2x speed while invisible, regardless of whether he is freerunning or not.
messages.actors.hero.talent.hasty_retreat.title: hasty retreat
messages.actors.hero.talent.hasty_retreat.desc:
_+1:_ After blinking the Rogue gains _1 turn_ of haste and invisibility.

_+2:_ After blinking the Rogue gains _2 turns_ of haste and invisibility.

_+3:_ After blinking the Rogue gains _3 turns_ of haste and invisibility.

_+4:_ After blinking the Rogue gains _4 turns_ of haste and invisibility.
messages.actors.hero.talent.body_replacement.desc:
_+1:_ After blinking, the Rogue leaves a wooden decoy behind that has _20 health and 1-3 armor_.

_+2:_ After blinking, the Rogue leaves a wooden decoy behind that has _40 health and 2-6 armor_.

_+3:_ After blinking, the Rogue leaves a wooden decoy behind that has _60 health and 3-9 armor_.

_+4:_ After blinking, the Rogue leaves a wooden decoy behind that has _80 health and 4-12 armor_.

Only one decoy can be active at a time.
messages.actors.hero.talent.shadow_step.title: shadow step
messages.actors.hero.talent.shadow_step.desc:
_+1:_ If the rogue uses smoke bomb while invisible, it occurs instantly and has a _16% reduced_ charge cost, but it also doesn't blind enemies or trigger other talents.

_+2:_ If the rogue uses smoke bomb while invisible, it occurs instantly and has a _30% reduced_ charge cost, but it also doesn't blind enemies or trigger other talents.

_+3:_ If the rogue uses smoke bomb while invisible, it occurs instantly and has a _41% reduced_ charge cost, but it also doesn't blind enemies or trigger other talents.

_+4:_ If the rogue uses smoke bomb while invisible, it occurs instantly and has a _50% reduced_ charge cost, but it also doesn't blind enemies or trigger other talents.
messages.actors.hero.talent.fear_the_reaper.title: fear the reaper
messages.actors.hero.talent.fear_the_reaper.desc:
_+1:_ When a death marked enemy reaches 0 hp, they become _crippled_.

_+2:_ When a death marked enemy reaches 0 hp, they become _feared and crippled_.

_+3:_ When a death marked enemy reaches 0 hp, they become _feared and crippled_ and enemies within 3 tiles become _crippled_.

_+4:_ When a death marked enemy reaches 0 hp, they become _feared and crippled_ and enemies within 3 tiles become _feared and crippled_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.deathly_durability.de:
_+1:_ Enemies killed by death mark give the Rogue shielding equal to _13%_ of their hp when they were marked.

_+2:_ Enemies killed by death mark give the Rogue shielding equal to _25%_ of their hp when they were marked.

_+3:_ Enemies killed by death mark give the Rogue shielding equal to _38%_ of their hp when they were marked.

_+4:_ Enemies killed by death mark give the Rogue shielding equal to _50%_ of their hp when they were marked.
messages.actors.hero.talent.double_mark.title: double mark
messages.actors.hero.talent.double_mark.desc:
_+1:_ Marking a second target at the same time as the first one has a _30% reduced_ charge cost.

_+2:_ Marking a second target at the same time as the first one has a _50% reduced_ charge cost.

_+3:_ Marking a second target at the same time as the first one has a _65% reduced_ charge cost.

_+4:_ Marking a second target at the same time as the first one has a _75% reduced_ charge cost.
messages.actors.hero.talent.shadow_blade.title: shadow blade
messages.actors.hero.talent.shadow_blade.desc:
_+1:_ The shadow clone gains _8%_ of the hero's damage per turn, and has a _25% chance_ to use the enchantment on the hero's weapon.

_+2:_ The shadow clone gains _16%_ of the hero's damage per turn, and has a _50% chance_ to use the enchantment on the hero's weapon.

_+3:_ The shadow clone gains _24%_ of the hero's damage per turn, and has a _75% chance_ to use the enchantment on the hero's weapon.

_+4:_ The shadow clone gains _32%_ of the hero's damage per turn, and has a _100% chance_ to use the enchantment on the hero's weapon.
messages.actors.hero.talent.cloned_armor.title: cloned armor
messages.actors.hero.talent.cloned_armor.desc:
_+1:_ The shadow clone gains _12%_ of the hero's armor value, and has a _25% chance_ to use the glyph on the hero's armor.

_+2:_ The shadow clone gains _24%_ of the hero's armor value, and has a _50% chance_ to use the glyph on the hero's armor.

_+3:_ The shadow clone gains _36%_ of the hero's armor value, and has a _75% chance_ to use the glyph on the hero's armor.

_+4:_ The shadow clone gains _48%_ of the hero's armor value, and has a _100% chance_ to use the glyph on the hero's armor.
messages.actors.hero.talent.perfect_copy.title: perfect copy
messages.actors.hero.talent.perfect_copy.desc:
_+1:_ The shadow clone gains _10%_ of the hero's max HP, and can instantly swap places with the hero up to _1 tile_ away.

_+2:_ The shadow clone gains _20%_ of the hero's max HP, and can instantly swap places with the hero up to _2 tiles_ away.

_+3:_ The shadow clone gains _30%_ of the hero's max HP, and can instantly swap places with the hero up to _3 tiles_ away.

_+4:_ The shadow clone gains _40%_ of the hero's max HP, and can instantly swap places with the hero up to _4 tiles_ away.
messages.actors.hero.talent.natures_bounty.title: nature's bounty
messages.actors.hero.talent.natures_bounty.desc:
_+1:_ The Huntress can find _4 berries_ hidden in tall grass as she explores the next few floors of the dungeon.

_+2:_ The Huntress can find _6 berries_ hidden in tall grass as she explores the next few floors of the dungeon.

Berries are eaten quickly, restore a small amount of satiety, and might contain a usable seed.
messages.actors.hero.talent.survivalists_intuitio:
_+1:_ The Huntress identifies thrown weapons _3x faster_.

_+2:_ The Huntress identifies thrown weapons _when she hits with them_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.followup_strike.title: followup strike
messages.actors.hero.talent.followup_strike.desc:
_+1:_ When the Huntress hits an enemy with her bow or a thrown weapon, her next melee attack against that enemy deals _2 bonus damage_.

_+2:_ When the Huntress hits an enemy with her bow or a thrown weapon, her next melee attack against that enemy deals _3 bonus damage_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.natures_aid.title: nature's aid
messages.actors.hero.talent.natures_aid.desc:
_+1:_ The Huntress gains 0-2 armor of barkskin, which fades every _3 turns_ when a plant's effect is activated in her vision.

_+2:_ The Huntress gains 0-2 armor of barkskin, which fades every _5 turns_ when a plant's effect is activated in her vision.
messages.actors.hero.talent.invigorating_meal.des:
_+1:_ Eating food takes the Huntress 1 turn (berries are eaten instantly) and grants her _1 turn of haste_.

_+2:_ Eating food takes the Huntress 1 turn (berries are eaten instantly) and grants her _2 turns of haste_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.liquid_nature.title: liquid nature
messages.actors.hero.talent.liquid_nature.desc:
_+1:_ When the Huntress drinks or throws a potion, brew, or elixir, _up to 4 grass tiles_ sprout in the surrounding area, and adjacent enemies are rooted for _1 turn_.

_+2:_ When the Huntress drinks or throws a potion, brew, or elixir, _up to 6 grass tiles_ sprout in the surrounding area, and adjacent enemies are rooted for _2 turns_.

The amount of grass and root duration are doubled when using potions of strength, experience, or alchemy items that must be crafted using those potions.

For alchemy items with higher output quantities (e.g. aqua brew), this talent has a chance to trigger based on how many of that item is produced.
messages.actors.hero.talent.rejuvenating_steps.de:
_+1:_ When the Huntress steps on short grass or embers, they spring up into tall grass which the Huntress immediately furrows. This has a _10 turn cooldown_.

_+2:_ When the Huntress steps on short grass or embers, they spring up into tall grass which the Huntress immediately furrows. This has a _5 turn cooldown_.

This talent will produce furrowed grass if passive regeneration effects are disabled or the hero has not gained exp in a long time.
messages.actors.hero.talent.heightened_senses.des:
_+1:_ The Huntress gains mind vision on characters within _2 tiles of her position_.

_+2:_ The Huntress gains mind vision on characters within _3 tiles of her position_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.durable_projectiles.d:
_+1:_ Thrown weapons have _+50% durability_ when used by the Huntress.

_+2:_ Thrown weapons have _+75% durability_ when used by the Huntress.
messages.actors.hero.talent.point_blank.title: point blank
messages.actors.hero.talent.point_blank.desc:
_+1:_ When the Huntress uses her bow or a thrown weapon at melee range it has _-25% accuracy,_ instead of -50%.

_+2:_ When the Huntress uses her bow or a thrown weapon at melee range it has _normal accuracy,_ instead of -50%.

_+3:_ When the Huntress uses her bow or a thrown weapon at melee range it has _+25% accuracy,_ instead of -50%.

Note that thrown weapons or the spirit bow always have +50% accuracy when used at a distance.
messages.actors.hero.talent.seer_shot.title: seer shot
messages.actors.hero.talent.seer_shot.desc:
_+1:_ When the Huntress fires an arrow at the ground, it grants vision in a 3x3 area around it for _5 turns_. This has a 20 turn cooldown.

_+2:_ When the Huntress fires an arrow at the ground, it grants vision in a 3x3 area around it for _10 turns_. This has a 20 turn cooldown.

_+3:_ When the Huntress fires an arrow at the ground, it grants vision in a 3x3 area around it for _15 turns_. This has a 20 turn cooldown.
messages.actors.hero.talent.seer_shot.meta_desc: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will trigger from any thrown weapon.
messages.actors.hero.talent.farsight.title: farsight
messages.actors.hero.talent.farsight.desc:
_+1:_ The Sniper's vision range is _increased by 25%_.

_+2:_ The Sniper's vision range is _increased by 50%_.

_+3:_ The Sniper's vision range is _increased by 75%_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.shared_enchantment.de:
_+1:_ Thrown weapons have a _33% chance_ to use the enchantment on the Sniper's bow.

_+2:_ Thrown weapons have a _67% chance_ to use the enchantment on the Sniper's bow.

_+3:_ Thrown weapons have a _100% chance_ to use the enchantment on the Sniper's bow.

The bow's enchantment can trigger in addition to whatever enchantment the thrown weapon already has.
messages.actors.hero.talent.shared_upgrades.title: shared upgrades
messages.actors.hero.talent.shared_upgrades.desc:
_+1:_ When the Sniper attacks with an upgraded thrown weapon, each level increases the duration of sniper's mark by 1 turn and the damage of her special attack by 16%, to a max of _2 turns and +33% damage at +2_.

_+2:_ When the Sniper attacks with an upgraded thrown weapon, each level increases the duration of sniper's mark by 1 turn and the damage of her special attack by 16%, to a max of _4 turns and +67% damage at +4_.

_+3:_ When the Sniper attacks with an upgraded thrown weapon, each level increases the duration of sniper's mark by 1 turn and the damage of her special attack by 16%, to a max of _6 turns and +100% damage at +6_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.durable_tips.title: durable tips
messages.actors.hero.talent.durable_tips.desc:
_+1:_ Tipped darts have _2x durability_ when the Warden uses them.

_+2:_ Tipped darts have _3x durability_ when the Warden uses them.

_+3:_ Tipped darts have _4x durability_ when the Warden uses them.
messages.actors.hero.talent.barkskin.title: barkskin
messages.actors.hero.talent.barkskin.desc:
_+1:_ When stepping on unfurrowed high grass or plants, the Warden gains _0-33% of her level_ in barkskin armor which fades every turn.

_+2:_ When stepping on unfurrowed high grass or plants, the Warden gains _0-67% of her level_ in barkskin armor which fades every turn.

_+3:_ When stepping on unfurrowed high grass or plants, the Warden gains _0-100% of her level_ in barkskin armor which fades every turn.
messages.actors.hero.talent.shielding_dew.title: shielding dew
messages.actors.hero.talent.shielding_dew.desc:
_+1:_ Dewdrops can shield the Warden when her health is full, up to _20% of her max HP_.

_+2:_ Dewdrops can shield the Warden when her health is full, up to _40% of her max HP_.

_+3:_ Dewdrops can shield the Warden when her health is full, up to _60% of her max HP_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.fan_of_blades.title: fan of blades
messages.actors.hero.talent.fan_of_blades.desc:
_+1:_ Spectral blades can hit up to _1 additional target_ for 50% damage. The target must be visible and within a _30 degree_ cone AOE.

_+2:_ Spectral blades can hit up to _2 additional targets_ for 50% damage. The targets must be visible and within a _60 degree_ cone AOE.

_+3:_ Spectral blades can hit up to _3 additional targets_ for 50% damage. The targets must be visible and within a _90 degree_ cone AOE.

_+4:_ Spectral blades can hit up to _4 additional targets_ for 50% damage. The targets must be visible and within a _120 degree_ cone AOE.
messages.actors.hero.talent.projecting_blades.des:
_+1:_ Spectral blades has _+25% accuracy_, and can penetrate up to _2 solid tiles_.

_+2:_ Spectral blades has _+50% accuracy_, and can penetrate up to _4 solid tiles_.

_+3:_ Spectral blades has _+75% accuracy_, and can penetrate up to _6 solid tiles_.

_+4:_ Spectral blades has _+100% accuracy_, and can penetrate up to _8 solid tiles_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.spirit_blades.title: spirit blades
messages.actors.hero.talent.spirit_blades.desc:
_+1:_ Spectral blades has a _30% chance_ to also use the enchantment on the spirit bow.

_+2:_ Spectral blades has a _60% chance_ to also use the enchantment on the spirit bow.

_+3:_ Spectral blades has a _90% chance_ to also use the enchantment on the spirit bow.

_+4:_ Spectral blades has a _100% chance_ to also use the enchantment on the spirit bow, and it gives each enchantment _+10% power_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.growing_power.title: growing power
messages.actors.hero.talent.growing_power.desc:
_+1:_ The attack and movespeed boosts from nature's power are increased to _38% and 125%_, from 33% and 100%.

_+2:_ The attack and movespeed boosts from nature's power are increased to _42% and 150%_, from 33% and 100%.

_+3:_ The attack and movespeed boosts from nature's power are increased to _46% and 175%_, from 33% and 100%.

_+4:_ The attack and movespeed boosts from nature's power are increased to _50% and 200%_, from 33% and 100%.
messages.actors.hero.talent.natures_wrath.title: nature's wrath
messages.actors.hero.talent.natures_wrath.desc:
_+1:_ While nature's power is active, shots from the spirit bow have an _8% chance_ to trigger a random harmful plant effect.

_+2:_ While nature's power is active, shots from the spirit bow have a _17% chance_ to trigger a random harmful plant effect.

_+3:_ While nature's power is active, shots from the spirit bow have an _25% chance_ to trigger a random harmful plant effect.

_+4:_ While nature's power is active, shots from the spirit bow have a _33% chance_ to trigger a random harmful plant effect.

The plants that can be triggered are: blindweed, firebloom, icecap, sorrowmoss, and stormvine.
messages.actors.hero.talent.wild_momentum.title: wild momentum
messages.actors.hero.talent.wild_momentum.desc:
_+1:_ Killing an enemy with the spirit bow prolongs the duration of nature's power by _1 turn_. The duration can be extended by a max of _2 turns_.

_+2:_ Killing an enemy with the spirit bow prolongs the duration of nature's power by _2 turns_. The duration can be extended by a max of _4 turns_.

_+3:_ Killing an enemy with the spirit bow prolongs the duration of nature's power by _3 turns_. The duration can be extended by a max of _6 turns_.

_+4:_ Killing an enemy with the spirit bow prolongs the duration of nature's power by _4 turns_. The duration can be extended by a max of _8 turns_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.eagle_eye.title: eagle eye
messages.actors.hero.talent.eagle_eye.desc:
_+1:_ The spirit hawk's vision range is increased to _7 tiles_ from 6.

_+2:_ The spirit hawk's vision range is increased to _8 tiles_ from 6.

_+3:_ The spirit hawk's vision range is increased to _9 tiles_ from 6, and it gets _2 tiles_ of mind vision.

_+4:_ The spirit hawk's vision range is increased to _10 tiles_ from 6, and it gets _3 tiles_ of mind vision.
messages.actors.hero.talent.go_for_the_eyes.title: go for the eyes
messages.actors.hero.talent.go_for_the_eyes.desc:
_+1:_ Attacks from the spirit hawk blind enemies for _2 turns_.

_+2:_ Attacks from the spirit hawk blind enemies for _5 turns_.

_+3:_ Attacks from the spirit hawk blind enemies for _5 turns_ and cripple them for _2 turns_.

_+4:_ Attacks from the spirit hawk blind enemies for _5 turns_ and cripple them for _5 turns_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.swift_spirit.title: swift spirit
messages.actors.hero.talent.swift_spirit.desc:
_+1:_ The spirit hawk's movement speed is increased to _2.5 tiles_ from 2, and it is guaranteed to dodge the first _2 attacks_ made against it.

_+2:_ The spirit hawk's movement speed is increased to _3 tiles_ from 2, and it is guaranteed to dodge the first _4 attacks_ made against it.

_+3:_ The spirit hawk's movement speed is increased to _3.5 tiles_ from 2, and it is guaranteed to dodge the first _6 attacks_ made against it.

_+4:_The spirit hawk's movement speed is increased to _4 tiles_ from 2, and it is guaranteed to dodge the first _8 attacks_ made against it.
messages.actors.hero.talent.strengthening_meal.de:
_+1:_ Eating food grants the Duelist 3 bonus damage the next _2 times_ she hits an enemy with a physical attack.

_+2:_ Eating food grants the Duelist 3 bonus damage the next _3 times_ she hits an enemy with a physical attack.
messages.actors.hero.talent.adventurers_intuition:
_+1:_ The Duelist identifies weapons _2.5x faster_ and armor _1.75x faster_.

_+2:_ The Duelist identifies weapons _when she equips them_ and armor _2.5x faster_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.patient_strike.title: patient strike
messages.actors.hero.talent.patient_strike.desc:
_+1:_ If the Duelist waits before performing a melee attack, she will deal _1-2 bonus damage_.

_+2:_ If the Duelist waits before performing a melee attack, she will deal _2 bonus damage_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.aggressive_barrier.de:
_+1:_ The Duelist gains _3 shielding_ when she uses a weapon ability and is at or below 50% health.

_+2:_ The Duelist gains _5 shielding_ when she uses a weapon ability and is at or below 50% health.
messages.actors.hero.talent.aggressive_barrier.me: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead grant shielding when making a melee attack at low health, with a 50 turn cooldown.
messages.actors.hero.talent.focused_meal.title: focused meal
messages.actors.hero.talent.focused_meal.desc:
_+1:_ Eating food takes the Duelist 1 turn and grants her _0.67 charges_ on her weapons.

_+2:_ Eating food takes the Duelist 1 turn and grants her _1 charge_ on her weapons.
messages.actors.hero.talent.focused_meal.meta_des: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead grant bonus damage to their next hit equal to their level/3 at +1, or level/2 at +2.
messages.actors.hero.talent.liquid_agility.title: liquid agility
messages.actors.hero.talent.liquid_agility.desc:
_+1:_ When drinking or throwing a potion, brew, or elixir, the Duelist has _3x evasion_, and has _3x accuracy_ on her next melee attack within 5 turns.

_+2:_ When drinking or throwing a potion, brew, or elixir, the Duelist has _infinite evasion_, and has _infinite accuracy_ on her next melee attack within 5 turns.

This bonus lasts for one additional turn and attack when using potions of strength, experience, or alchemy items that must be crafted using those potions.

For alchemy items with higher output quantities (e.g. aqua brew), this talent has a chance to trigger based on how many of that item is produced.
messages.actors.hero.talent.weapon_recharging.des:
_+1:_ The Duelist gains one weapon charge every _15 turns_ when under the effect of wand or artifact recharging buffs.

_+2:_ The Duelist gains one weapon charge every _10 turns_ when under the effect of wand or artifact recharging buffs.
messages.actors.hero.talent.weapon_recharging.met: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead cause them to deal +5% melee damage while recharging at +1, or +7.5% melee damage while recharging at +2.
messages.actors.hero.talent.lethal_haste.title: lethal haste
messages.actors.hero.talent.lethal_haste.desc:
_+1:_ When the Duelist lands a killing blow on an enemy with a weapon ability, she gains _3 turns_ worth of instant movement.

_+2:_ When the Duelist lands a killing blow on an enemy with a weapon ability, she gains _5 turns_ worth of instant movement.
messages.actors.hero.talent.lethal_haste.meta_des: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead trigger with regular weapon attacks, with a 100 turn cooldown.
messages.actors.hero.talent.swift_equip.title: swift equip
messages.actors.hero.talent.swift_equip.desc:
_+1:_ The Duelist can switch her equipped weapon instantly _one time_ every 20 turns.

_+2:_ The Duelist can switch her equipped weapon instantly _two times_ every 20 turns.

If the Duelist has this talent and it is not on cooldown, quick-using an unequipped weapon will equip it.
messages.actors.hero.talent.precise_assault.title: precise assault
messages.actors.hero.talent.precise_assault.desc:
_+1:_ When the Duelist uses a weapon ability, she gains _2x accuracy_ on her next melee attack within 5 turns.

_+2:_ When the Duelist uses a weapon ability, she gains _5x accuracy_ on her next melee attack within 5 turns.

_+3:_ When the Duelist uses a weapon ability, she gains _infinite accuracy_ on her next melee attack within 5 turns.
messages.actors.hero.talent.precise_assault.meta_: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead increase melee accuracy by 10% at +1, 20% at +2, or 30% at +3.
messages.actors.hero.talent.deadly_followup.title: deadly followup
messages.actors.hero.talent.deadly_followup.desc:
_+1:_ When the Duelist hits an enemy with a thrown weapon, she will deal _10% more melee damage_ to them for 5 turns.

_+2:_ When the Duelist hits an enemy with a thrown weapon, she will deal _20% more melee damage_ to them for 5 turns.

_+3:_ When the Duelist hits an enemy with a thrown weapon, she will deal _30% more melee damage_ to them for 5 turns.
messages.actors.hero.talent.varied_charge.title: varied charge
messages.actors.hero.talent.varied_charge.desc:
_+1:_ The Champion instantly regains _0.17 weapon charges_ when she uses two different weapon abilities, with no time limit.

_+2:_ The Champion instantly regains _0.33 weapon charges_ when she uses two different weapon abilities, with no time limit.

_+3:_ The Champion instantly regains _0.5 weapon charges_ when she uses two different weapon abilities, with no time limit.
messages.actors.hero.talent.twin_upgrades.title: twin upgrades
messages.actors.hero.talent.twin_upgrades.desc:
_+1:_ If one of the Champion's two equipped weapons has a lower level and is _2 or more tiers lower_ than the other weapon, it will be boosted to the other weapon's level.

_+2:_ If one of the Champion's two equipped weapons has a lower level and is _1 or more tiers lower_ than the other weapon, it will be boosted to the other weapon's level.

_+3:_ If one of the Champion's two equipped weapons has a lower level and is _the same tier or lower_ than the other weapon, it will be boosted to the other weapon's level.
messages.actors.hero.talent.combined_lethality.de:
_+1:_ If the Champion attacks with a melee weapon immediately after using a different weapon's ability, that attack will execute any non-boss enemy left at _below 13% HP_.

_+2:_ If the Champion attacks with a melee weapon immediately after using a different weapon's ability, that attack will execute any non-boss enemy left at _below 27% HP_.

_+3:_ If the Champion attacks with a melee weapon immediately after using a different weapon's ability, that attack will execute any non-boss enemy left at _below 40% HP_.

This attack can be a regular melee weapon attack, or part of a weapon ability.
messages.actors.hero.talent.unencumbered_spirit.d:
_+1:_ The Monk gains _50% more energy_ for each piece of _tier 3 or lower_ equipment she is using.

_+2:_ The Monk gains _75% more energy_ for each piece of _tier 2 or lower_ equipment she is using. The tier 3 benefit is unchanged.

_+3:_ The Monk gains _100% more energy_ for each piece of _tier 1 or lower_ equipment she is using. The tier 2 and 3 benefits are unchanged. She also gains a free cloth armor and studded gloves.

Note that this talent gives no benefit from being unarmed or attacking with a Ring of Force.
messages.actors.hero.talent.monastic_vigor.title: monastic vigor
messages.actors.hero.talent.monastic_vigor.desc:
_+1:_ If the Monk has _100% energy_, her abilities are empowered.

_+2:_ If the Monk has _80% or more energy_, her abilities are empowered.

_+3:_ If the Monk has _60% or more energy_, her abilities are empowered.

When empowered:
- Flurry applies your weapon's enchantment
- Focus is instantaneous
- Dash gains +4 range
- Dragon Kick deals +50% damage and applies its knock back and stun effect to all adjacent enemies
- Meditate slowly heals 20% of missing HP and grants 80% damage resistance.
messages.actors.hero.talent.combined_energy.title: combined energy
messages.actors.hero.talent.combined_energy.desc:
_+1:_ If the Monk uses a weapon ability and a _4+ energy_ ability within 5 turns of each other, she regains 1 spent energy.

_+2:_ If the Monk uses a weapon ability and a _3+ energy_ ability within 5 turns of each other, she regains 1 spent energy.

_+3:_ If the Monk uses a weapon ability and a _2+ energy_ ability within 5 turns of each other, she regains 1 spent energy.
messages.actors.hero.talent.close_the_gap.title: close the gap
messages.actors.hero.talent.close_the_gap.desc:
_+1:_ The Duelist blinks _up to two tiles_ toward her target when starting a duel.

_+2:_ The Duelist blinks _up to three tiles_ toward her target when starting a duel.

_+3:_ The Duelist blinks _up to four tiles_ toward her target when starting a duel.

_+4:_ The Duelist blinks _up to five tiles_ toward her target when starting a duel.

This blink can go through hazards and enemies, but not solid terrain like walls. The blink is taken into account when determining if an enemy is in range to be challenged.
_+1:_ If the Duelist defeats her target before the duel ends, she heals for _5 HP plus 30% of the damage_ she took during the duel.

_+2:_ If the Duelist defeats her target before the duel ends, she heals for _10 HP plus 50% of the damage_ she took during the duel.

_+3:_ If the Duelist defeats her target before the duel ends, she heals for _15 HP plus 65% of the damage_ she took during the duel.

_+4:_ If the Duelist defeats her target before the duel ends, she heals for _20 HP plus 75% of the damage_ she took during the duel.
messages.actors.hero.talent.elimination_match.des:
_+1:_ If the Duelist challenges again within 3 turns of a duel ending, that challenge has a _16% reduced_ charge cost.

_+2:_ If the Duelist challenges again within 3 turns of a duel ending, that challenge has a _30% reduced_ charge cost.

_+3:_ If the Duelist challenges again within 3 turns of a duel ending, that challenge has a _40% reduced_ charge cost.

_+4:_ If the Duelist challenges again within 3 turns of a duel ending, that challenge has a _50% reduced_ charge cost.
messages.actors.hero.talent.elemental_reach.title: elemental reach
messages.actors.hero.talent.elemental_reach.desc:
_+1:_ Elemental strike's range is increased to _5 tiles_ from 4, and its width is increased to _75 degrees_ from 65.

_+2:_ Elemental strike's range is increased to _6 tiles_ from 4, and its width is increased to _85 degrees_ from 65.

_+3:_ Elemental strike's range is increased to _7 tiles_ from 4, and its width is increased to _95 degrees_ from 65.

_+4:_ Elemental strike's range is increased to _8 tiles_ from 4, and its width is increased to _105 degrees_ from 65.
messages.actors.hero.talent.striking_force.title: striking force
messages.actors.hero.talent.striking_force.desc:
_+1:_ The power of elemental strike's effect is increased by _30%_.

_+2:_ The power of elemental strike's effect is increased by _60%_.

_+3:_ The power of elemental strike's effect is increased by _90%_.

_+4:_ The power of elemental strike's effect is increased by _120%_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.directed_power.title: directed power
messages.actors.hero.talent.directed_power.desc:
_+1:_ The direct attack from elemental strike gains _+30% enchantment power_ for each enemy in range of elemental strike's effect, including the attack target.

_+2:_ The direct attack from elemental strike gains _+60% enchantment power_ for each enemy in range of elemental strike's effect, including the attack target.

_+3:_ The direct attack from elemental strike gains _+90% enchantment power_ for each enemy in range of elemental strike's effect, including the attack target.

_+4:_ The direct attack from elemental strike gains _+120% enchantment power_ for each enemy in range of elemental strike's effect, including the attack target.
messages.actors.hero.talent.feigned_retreat.title: feigned retreat
messages.actors.hero.talent.feigned_retreat.desc:
_+1:_ If an enemy attacks the Duelist's afterimage, she gains _2 turns_ of haste.

_+2:_ If an enemy attacks the Duelist's afterimage, she gains _4 turns_ of haste.

_+3:_ If an enemy attacks the Duelist's afterimage, she gains _6 turns_ of haste.

_+4:_ If an enemy attacks the Duelist's afterimage, she gains _8 turns_ of haste.
messages.actors.hero.talent.expose_weakness.title: expose weakness
messages.actors.hero.talent.expose_weakness.desc:
_+1:_ Enemies that attack the Duelist's afterimage become weak and vulnerable for _2 turns_.

_+2:_ Enemies that attack the Duelist's afterimage become weak and vulnerable for _4 turns_.

_+3:_ Enemies that attack the Duelist's afterimage become weak and vulnerable for _6 turns_.

_+4:_ Enemies that attack the Duelist's afterimage become weak and vulnerable for _8 turns_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.counter_ability.title: counter ability
messages.actors.hero.talent.counter_ability.desc:
_+1:_ If the Duelist uses a weapon ability within 3 turns of her afterimage being attacked, she will instantly regain _0.38 charges_.

_+2:_ If the Duelist uses a weapon ability within 3 turns of her afterimage being attacked, she will instantly regain _0.77 charges_.

_+3:_ If the Duelist uses a weapon ability within 3 turns of her afterimage being attacked, she will instantly regain _1.13 charges_.

_+4:_ If the Duelist uses a weapon ability within 3 turns of her afterimage being attacked, she will instantly regain _1.5 charges_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.satiated_spells.title: Satiated Spells
messages.actors.hero.talent.satiated_spells.desc:
_+1:_ Eating food causes the Cleric to gain _3 shielding_ the next time they cast a spell.

_+2:_ Eating food causes the Cleric to gain _5 shielding_ the next time they cast a spell.
messages.actors.hero.talent.satiated_spells.meta_: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead grant shielding immediately, which will start to decay normally after 10 turns.
messages.actors.hero.talent.holy_intuition.title: holy intuition
messages.actors.hero.talent.holy_intuition.desc:
_+1:_ The Cleric can cast _Holy Intuition,_ a spell that reveals whether an item is cursed at the cost of _3 charges._

_+2:_ The Cleric can cast _Holy Intuition,_ a spell that reveals whether an item is cursed at the cost of _2 charges._
messages.actors.hero.talent.holy_intuition.meta_d: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead let the hero identify the curse status on a cursed item just before equipping it, 15% of the time at +1 or 25% of the time at +2.
messages.actors.hero.talent.searing_light.title: searing light
messages.actors.hero.talent.searing_light.desc:
_+1:_ The Cleric's physical attacks on enemies illuminated by _Guiding Light_ deal _+3 damage._

_+2:_ The Cleric's physical attacks on enemies illuminated by _Guiding Light_ deal _+5 damage._
messages.actors.hero.talent.searing_light.meta_de: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead grant its bonus damage after a wand or artifact is used on an enemy, with a 20 turn cooldown.
messages.actors.hero.talent.shield_of_light.title: shield of light
messages.actors.hero.talent.shield_of_light.desc:
_+1:_ The Cleric can cast _Shield of Light,_ a spell that is cast instantly and grants them _2-4 armor_ against a target for 5 turns at the cost of 1 charge.

_+2:_ The Cleric can cast _Shield of Light,_ a spell that is cast instantly and grants them _3-6 armor_ against a target for 5 turns at the cost of 1 charge.
messages.actors.hero.talent.shield_of_light.meta_: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead reduce physical damage taken from your targeted enemy by 1, 33% of the time at +1 or 50% of the time at +2.
messages.actors.hero.talent.enlightening_meal.des:
_+1:_ Eating food takes the Cleric 1 turn and grants them _0.67 charges_ on their holy tome.

_+2:_ Eating food takes the Cleric 1 turn and grants them _1 charge_ on their holy tome.
messages.actors.hero.talent.enlightening_meal.met: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead grant 2 turns of wand and artifact recharging at +1, or 3 turns at +2. This cannot be used to let the horn of plenty recharge itself.
messages.actors.hero.talent.recall_inscription.de:
_+1:_ The Cleric can cast _Recall Inscription,_ a spell that lets them repeat the effect of the last runestone or scroll they used within _10 turns._

_+2:_ The Cleric can cast _Recall Inscription,_ a spell that lets them repeat the effect of the last runestone or scroll they used within _300 turns._

Recall Inscription cannot be used with scrolls of upgrade. This spell's charge cost varies based on which item was used recently: 2 for a runestone, 3 for a scroll, 4 for an exotic scroll. This charge cost is also doubled when used with a scroll of transmutation, or alchemy items that must be crafted using transmutation or upgrade.
messages.actors.hero.talent.recall_inscription.me: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead refund any scroll or runestone 10% of the time at +1 or 15% of the time at +2. Scrolls of Upgrade are exempt from this effect.
messages.actors.hero.talent.sunray.title: Sunray
messages.actors.hero.talent.sunray.desc:
_+1:_ The Cleric can cast _Sunray,_ a spell that deals _4-8 damage_ and blinds the target for _4 turns,_ at the cost of 1 charge.

_+2:_ The Cleric can cast _Sunray,_ a spell that deals _6-12 damage_ and blinds the target for _6 turns,_ at the cost of 1 charge.

Sunray can only blind each target once, but if the target is already blinded by Sunray then it paralyses instead. Sunray always deals maximum damage to demonic and undead foes.
messages.actors.hero.talent.sunray.meta_desc: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead cause wands and artifacts to blind enemies for 4 turns, 15% of the time at +1 or 25% of the time at +2.
messages.actors.hero.talent.divine_sense.title: Divine Sense
messages.actors.hero.talent.divine_sense.desc:
_+1:_ The Cleric can cast _Divine Sense,_ a spell that grants them _8 tiles_ of Mind Vision for 50 turns and takes no time to cast, at the cost of 2 charges.

_+2:_ The Cleric can cast _Divine Sense,_ a spell that grants them _12 tiles_ of Mind Vision for 50 turns and takes no time to cast, at the cost of 2 charges.
messages.actors.hero.talent.divine_sense.meta_des: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead grant them mind vision for a brief moment after using a wand or artifact with a range of 3 tiles at +1 or 5 tiles at +2.
messages.actors.hero.talent.bless.title: Bless
messages.actors.hero.talent.bless.desc:
_+1:_ The Cleric can cast _Bless,_ a spell that grants _6 turns of bless and 10 shielding_ when cast on themselves or _10 turns of bless and 10 healing_ when cast on another character, at the cost of 1 charge.

_+2:_ The Cleric can cast _Bless,_ a spell that grants _10 turns of bless and 15 shielding_ when cast on themselves or _15 turns of bless and 15 healing_ when cast on another character, at the cost of 1 charge.

Excess healing from this spell is converted into shielding.
messages.actors.hero.talent.bless.meta_desc: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead boost accuracy and evasion for the hero and all allies by 3% at +1 or 5% at +2.
messages.actors.hero.talent.cleanse.title: Cleanse
messages.actors.hero.talent.cleanse.desc:
_+1:_ The Cleric can cast _Cleanse,_ a spell which _removes negative status effects_ from the Cleric and any nearby allies, and grants them _10 shielding,_ at the cost of 2 charges.

_+2:_ The Cleric can cast _Cleanse,_ a spell which _grants 3 turns of negative status immunity_ to the Cleric and any nearby allies, and grants them _20 shielding,_ at the cost of 2 charges.

_+3:_ The Cleric can cast _Cleanse,_ a spell which _grants 5 turns of negative status immunity_ to the Cleric and any nearby allies, and grants them _30 shielding,_ at the cost of 2 charges.
messages.actors.hero.talent.cleanse.meta_desc: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead cleanse negative status effects on the hero after using a wand or artifact, 10/20/30% of the time at +1/+2/+3.
messages.actors.hero.talent.light_reading.title: Light Reading
messages.actors.hero.talent.light_reading.desc:
_+1:_ The Cleric can use their holy tome when it is not equipped, but it recharges at _25% speed_ when unequipped.

_+2:_ The Cleric can use their holy tome when it is not equipped, but it recharges at _50% speed_ when unequipped.

_+3:_ The Cleric can use their holy tome when it is not equipped, but it recharges at _75% speed_ when unequipped.
messages.actors.hero.talent.light_reading.meta_de: _If this talent is gained by a different hero_ it will instead increase the recharging speed of all wands by 7/13/20% at +1/+2/+3.
messages.actors.hero.talent.holy_lance.title: Holy Lance
messages.actors.hero.talent.holy_lance.desc:
_+1:_ The Priest can cast _Holy Lance,_ a devastating spell that deals _30-55 damage_ at the cost of 4 charges.

_+2:_ The Priest can cast _Holy Lance,_ a devastating spell that deals _45-83 damage_ at the cost of 4 charges.

_+3:_ The Priest can cast _Holy Lance,_ a devastating spell that deals _60-110 damage_ at the cost of 4 charges.

Holy Lance always deals maximum damage to demonic and undead foes. Holy Lance has a 30 turn cooldown before it can be cast again.
messages.actors.hero.talent.hallowed_ground.title: Hallowed Ground
messages.actors.hero.talent.hallowed_ground.desc:
_+1:_ The Priest can cast _Hallowed Ground,_ a spell that hallows terrain in a _3x3 area_ for 20 turns, at the cost of 2 charges.

_+2:_ The Priest can cast _Hallowed Ground,_ a spell that hallows terrain in a _5x5 area_ for 20 turns, at the cost of 2 charges.

_+3:_ The Priest can cast _Hallowed Ground,_ a spell that hallows terrain in a _7x7 area_ for 20 turns, at the cost of 2 charges.

When it is cast, Hallowed Ground heals allies for 15 HP, briefly roots enemies, and spreads short grass. Afterward, it slowly heals allies, cripples enemies, and causes tall grass to randomly grow. Hallowed ground grants shielding to the Priest instead of healing and is destroyed by fire.
messages.actors.hero.talent.mnemonic_prayer.title: Mnemonic Prayer
messages.actors.hero.talent.mnemonic_prayer.desc:
_+1:_ The Priest can cast _Mnemonic Prayer,_ a spell that extends buffs/debuffs on an ally/enemy for _3 turns_ at 1 charge cost.

_+2:_ The Priest can cast _Mnemonic Prayer,_ a spell that extends buffs/debuffs on an ally/enemy for _4 turns_ at 1 charge cost.

_+3:_ The Priest can cast _Mnemonic Prayer,_ a spell that extends buffs/debuffs on an ally/enemy for _5 turns_ at 1 charge cost.

Mnemonic prayer takes no time to cast. Mnemonic Prayer can only extend a particular instance of a buff/debuff once, and cannot extend buffs from armor abilities.
messages.actors.hero.talent.lay_on_hands.title: lay on hands
messages.actors.hero.talent.lay_on_hands.desc:
_+1:_ The Paladin can cast _Lay on Hands,_ a spell that instantly heals a nearby character for _15 HP,_ or grants the Paladin _15 shielding,_ at the cost of 1 charge.

_+2:_ The Paladin can cast _Lay on Hands,_ a spell that instantly heals a nearby character for _20 HP,_ or grants the Paladin _20 shielding,_ at the cost of 1 charge.

_+3:_ The Paladin can cast _Lay on Hands,_ a spell that instantly heals a nearby character for _25 HP,_ or grants the Paladin _25 shielding,_ at the cost of 1 charge.

Excess healing from this spell is converted into shielding. Lay on Hands can be cast repeatedly, but cannot apply more than three casts worth of shielding at once.
messages.actors.hero.talent.aura_of_protection.de:
_+1:_ The Paladin can cast _Aura of Protection,_ a spell that grants the Paladin and all allies within 2 tiles _20% damage resistance_ and the effect of the Paladin's armor glyph at _+50% power_ for 20 turns, at the cost of 2 charges.

_+2:_ The Paladin can cast _Aura of Protection,_ a spell that grants the Paladin and all allies within 2 tiles _30% damage resistance_ and the effect of the Paladin's armor glyph at _+75% power_ for 20 turns, at the cost of 2 charges.

_+3:_ The Paladin can cast _Aura of Protection,_ a spell that grants the Paladin and all allies within 2 tiles _40% damage resistance_ and the effect of the Paladin's armor glyph at _+100% power_ for 20 turns, at the cost of 2 charges.
messages.actors.hero.talent.wall_of_light.title: wall of light
messages.actors.hero.talent.wall_of_light.desc:
_+1:_ The Paladin can cast _Wall of Light,_ a spell that creates a _3 tile wide_ solid wall in front of the Paladin that pushes away enemies and lasts for 20 turns, at the cost of 3 charges.

_+2:_ The Paladin can cast _Wall of Light,_ a spell that creates a _5 tile wide_ solid wall in front of the Paladin that pushes away enemies and lasts for 20 turns, at the cost of 3 charges.

_+3:_ The Paladin can cast _Wall of Light,_ a spell that creates a _7 tile wide_ solid wall in front of the Paladin that pushes away enemies and lasts for 20 turns, at the cost of 3 charges.

The wall can be placed cardinally or diagonally, only one wall can exist at a time.
messages.actors.hero.talent.divine_intervention.d:
_+1:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Divine Intervention,_ which boosts the Cleric and all allies up to _150 shielding_ and extends Ascended Form by _3 turns._

_+2:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Divine Intervention,_ which boosts the Cleric and all allies up to _200 shielding_ and extends Ascended Form by _4 turns._

_+3:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Divine Intervention,_ which boosts the Cleric and all allies up to _250 shielding_ and extends Ascended Form by _5 turns._

_+4:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Divine Intervention,_ which boosts the Cleric and all allies up to _300 shielding_ and extends Ascended Form by _6 turns._

Divine Intervention costs a whopping 5 tome charges, and can only be cast once in the same ascended form.
messages.actors.hero.talent.judgement.title: judgement
messages.actors.hero.talent.judgement.desc:
_+1:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Judgement,_ which deals _10-20 damage_ to all visible enemies.

_+2:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Judgement,_ which deals _15-30 damage_ to all visible enemies.

_+3:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Judgement,_ which deals _20-40 damage_ to all visible enemies.

_+4:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Judgement,_ which deals _25-50 damage_ to all visible enemies.

Judgement costs 3 tome charges. Judgement deals +33% damage for every spell the Cleric has cast since entering ascended form or since the last cast of Judgement.
messages.actors.hero.talent.flash.title: flash
messages.actors.hero.talent.flash.desc:
_+1:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Flash_ to teleport up to _3 tiles_ away.

_+2:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Flash_ to teleport up to _4 tiles_ away.

_+3:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Flash_ to teleport up to _5 tiles_ away.

_+4:_ While in Ascended Form, the Cleric can cast _Flash_ to teleport up to _6 tiles_ away.

Flash costs 2 tome charges initially, and 1 more charge for each use in the same ascended form.
messages.actors.hero.talent.body_form.title: body form
messages.actors.hero.talent.body_form.desc:
The Cleric can cast _Body Form_, which imbues Trinity with the power of an enchantment or glyph that the Cleric has identified this run, at the cost of 2 charges.

_+1:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric gains the chosen effect for _20 turns._

_+2:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric gains the chosen effect for _27 turns._

_+3:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric gains the chosen effect for _33 turns._

_+4:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric gains the chosen effect for _40 turns._

Trinity can only be imbued with one body effect at a time. Trinity's armor charge cost is higher if the chosen glyph is rare and powerful.
messages.actors.hero.talent.mind_form.title: mind form
messages.actors.hero.talent.mind_form.desc:
The Cleric can cast _Mind Form_, which imbues Trinity with the power of a wand or thrown weapon that the Cleric has used this run, at the cost of 3 charges.

_+1:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric uses the zap or throw effect of the chosen item, as if it were _+3._

_+2:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric uses the zap or throw effect of the chosen item, as if it were _+4._

_+3:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric uses the zap or throw effect of the chosen item, as if it were _+5._

_+4:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric uses the zap or throw effect of the chosen item, as if it were _+6._

Trinity can only be imbued with one mind effect at a time.
messages.actors.hero.talent.spirit_form.title: spirit form
messages.actors.hero.talent.spirit_form.desc:
The Cleric can cast _Spirit Form_, which imbues Trinity with the power of a ring or artifact that the Cleric has identified this run (except the holy tome), at the cost of 4 charges.

_+1:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric will gain a ring's effect at _+1_ for 20 turns, or will trigger an artifact's effect at _+4._

_+2:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric will gain a ring's effect at _+2_ for 20 turns, or will trigger an artifact's effect at _+6._

_+3:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric will gain a ring's effect at _+3_ for 20 turns, or will trigger an artifact's effect at _+8._

_+4:_ When Trinity is used, the Cleric will gain a ring's effect at _+4_ for 20 turns, or will trigger an artifact's effect at _+10._

Trinity can only be imbued with one spirit effect at a time. Artifacts have varied effects and armor charge costs when triggered by Trinity.
messages.actors.hero.talent.beaming_ray.title: beaming ray
messages.actors.hero.talent.beaming_ray.desc:
The Cleric can cast _Beaming Ray_ from an empowered ally at the cost of 1 charge. This ray can go through walls and teleports the ally to a targeted location. If an enemy is at that location, the ally appears next to the enemy and will target them. Beaming Ray can even teleport normally immobile allies, but has half range when doing so.

_+1:_ Beaming Ray has a max range of _4 tiles,_ and increases Power of Many's bonus to _+35% damage_ against the closest enemy for 10 turns.

_+2:_ Beaming Ray has a max range of _8 tiles,_ and increases Power of Many's bonus to _+40% damage_ against the closest enemy for 10 turns.

_+3:_ Beaming Ray has a max range of _12 tiles,_ and increases Power of Many's bonus to _+45% damage_ against the closest enemy for 10 turns.

_+4:_ Beaming Ray has a max range of _16 tiles,_ and increases Power of Many's bonus to _+50% damage_ against the closest enemy for 10 turns.
messages.actors.hero.talent.life_link.title: life link
messages.actors.hero.talent.life_link.desc:
The Cleric can cast _Life Link_ between themselves and an empowered ally at the cost of 2 charges. This spell causes damage to be shared between the Cleric and their ally, and causes beneficial cleric spells of tier 3 or lower to apply to both if either is being affected.

_+1:_ Life Link lasts for _10 turns_ and increases Power of Many's bonus to _-35% damage taken._

_+2:_ Life Link lasts for _13 turns_ and increases Power of Many's bonus to _-40% damage taken._

_+3:_ Life Link lasts for _17 turns_ and increases Power of Many's bonus to _-45% damage taken._

_+4:_ Life Link lasts for _20 turns_ and increases Power of Many's bonus to _-50% damage taken._
messages.actors.hero.talent.stasis.title: Stasis
messages.actors.hero.talent.stasis.desc:
The Cleric can cast _Stasis_ on an empowered ally at the cost of 2 charges. Stasis temporarily removes the ally from the dungeon and preserves the remaining time on all buffs, including Power of Many. The ally will reappear next to you when the effect ends. Stasis can be re-cast instantly and at no cost to end the effect early. Stasis works on immobile allies, but cannot move them between dungeon floors.

_+1:_ Stasis lasts for a max of _60 turns._

_+2:_ Stasis lasts for a max of _90 turns._

_+3:_ Stasis lasts for a max of _120 turns._

_+4:_ Stasis lasts for a max of _150 turns._

The Cleric can also cast Beaming Ray when an ally is in stasis to resummon them, or cast Life Link to pre-emptively apply its effect. Allies do not benefit from Life Link while in stasis however.
messages.actors.hero.talent.heroic_energy.title: heroic energy
messages.actors.hero.talent.heroic_energy.desc:
_+1:_ The hero's armor ability has a _12% reduced_ charge cost.

_+2:_ The hero's armor ability has a _23% reduced_ charge cost.

_+3:_ The hero's armor ability has a _32% reduced_ charge cost.

_+4:_ The hero's armor ability has a _40% reduced_ charge cost.
messages.actors.hero.talent.ratsistance.title: ratsistance
messages.actors.hero.talent.ratsistance.desc:
_+1:_ Hostile ratmogrified enemies deal _-10% damage_.

_+2:_ Hostile ratmogrified enemies deal _-19% damage_.

_+3:_ Hostile ratmogrified enemies deal _-27% damage_.

_+4:_ Hostile ratmogrified enemies deal _-35% damage_.
messages.actors.hero.talent.ratlomacy.title: ratlomacy
messages.actors.hero.talent.ratlomacy.desc:
_+1:_ Using ratmogrify on a ratmogrified enemy makes them friendly and makes the transformation permanent.

_+2:_ Using ratmogrify on a ratmogrified enemy makes them friendly, makes the transformation permanent, and gives them _2 turns_ of adrenaline.

_+3:_ Using ratmogrify on a ratmogrified enemy makes them friendly, makes the transformation permanent, and gives them _4 turns_ of adrenaline.

_+4:_ Using ratmogrify on a ratmogrified enemy makes them friendly, makes the transformation permanent, and gives them _6 turns_ of adrenaline.
messages.actors.hero.talent.ratforcements.title: ratforcements
messages.actors.hero.talent.ratforcements.desc:
_+1:_ Using ratmogrify on yourself _spawns 1_ ally marsupial rat next to you.

_+2:_ Using ratmogrify on yourself _spawns 2_ ally marsupial rats next to you.

_+3:_ Using ratmogrify on yourself _spawns 3_ ally marsupial rats next to you.

_+4:_ Using ratmogrify on yourself _spawns 4_ ally marsupial rats next to you.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.blacksmith.name: troll blacksmith
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.blacksmith.intro_quest_: Hey Human! You look like a tough one.
Hey Human! You look like a smart one.
Hey Human! You look like a sneaky one.
Hey Human! You look like a quick one.
Hey Human! You look like a brave one.
Hey Human! You look like an important one.

Wanna be useful, eh? Yeah I got something you could do. I built dis workshop ontop of an old mine, it's just down dat ladder. Take dis pickaxe and mine me some _dark gold ore. 40 pieces_ should be enough. The rock down der is nice and soft so _you'll be able to mine through the walls with some effort._

What do you mean, how am I gonna pay? You greedy...

Ok, ok, I can do some smithin' for you. Consider yourself lucky, I'm the only blacksmith around.

Careful though, the mine's dangerous for a little human like you. It's been abandoned for a while, and bunch of crystals have started growing. They're shiny, but too fragile to be worth anythin', and they've got some magic things protecting 'em. They're pretty strong, so _be careful where you mine_ or you'll get their attention.

There's a _giant crystal_ somewhere too. It's a lot tougher, so be prepared for a fight if you start breakin' it. I'll bet smashing it will slow all the crystal growth down though, so I'll pay extra if you can do it.

Careful though, the mine's dangerous for a little human like you. Some gnolls want the gold too and now they're wreckin' the place. They're stupid things, so their mining has caused all sorts of collapses and cave-ins. You'll have to mine through it, so _look for recently disturbed rock._

I think one of the gnolls is causing most of the trouble, probably a _geomancer shaman_ or somethin'. I'll pay extra, if you can find and kill it, but I'm sure it'll fight back.

Careful though, the mine's dangerous for a little human like you. There's some sorta fungus monster that's been growing down there. It's got mushroom sentries that're really deadly if they see you, but they can't get up and chase you at least. _Keep out of sight_ if you want to stay alive.

I'll pay extra if you can manage to take down the _biggest mushrom,_ but it'll take some real effort. It's connected to a bunch of mycelium nodes that're hidden in the walls. You'll have to break most of 'em before you can really damage it.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.blacksmith.reminder: You done wastin' my time? The mine entrance is over there.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.blacksmith.reminder_cry: Bring me as much gold as you can, and try to break the big crystal too.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.blacksmith.reminder_gno: Bring me as much gold as you can, and try to kill the gnoll geomancer too.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.blacksmith.reminder_fun: Bring me as much gold as you can, and try to kill the giant mushroom too.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.blacksmith.lost_pick: Are you kiddin' me? Where is my pickaxe?!
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.blacksmith.quest_start_:
You ready to go down? Make sure you've got some free space for the gold.

_I'm only lettin' you down der once!_
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.blacksmith.exit_warn_no:
You done already? You've hardly got any gold at all! You should be able to get _40 pieces._

_Remember, I'm not lettin' you back in once you come up._
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.blacksmith.exit_warn_lo:
You done already? Doesn't look like you've got a lot of gold. You should be able to get _40 pieces._

_Remember, I'm not lettin' you back in once you come up._
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.blacksmith.exit_warn_me:
You done? You've got some gold at least, but there's definitely more in the mine. You should be able to get _40 pieces._

_Remember, I'm not lettin' you back in once you come up._
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.blacksmith.exit_warn_hi:
You done? Looks like you've got a good amount of gold, but I could use a bit more. You should be able to get _40 pieces._

_Remember, I'm not lettin' you back in once you come up._
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.blacksmith.exit_warn_fu:
You done? You've got lots of gold, but make sure you haven't left any of your gear behind.

_Remember, I'm not lettin' you back in once you come up._
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.blacksmith.exit_warn_cr: That giant crystal's still down there too. I'll pay extra if you destroy it.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.blacksmith.exit_warn_gn: That gnoll geomancer's still down there too. I'll pay extra if you kill it.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.blacksmith.exit_warn_fu: That giant mushroom's still down there too. I'll pay extra if you kill it.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.blacksmith.cant_enter_o: That area is not accessible on this run. Play a new game to try the new quest!
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.blacksmith.desc: This troll blacksmith looks like all trolls look: he is tall and lean, and his skin resembles stone in both color and texture. The troll blacksmith is tinkering with disproportionally small tools.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.ghost.name: sad ghost
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.ghost.rat_1:
Hello %s... Once I was like you - strong and confident... But I was slain by a foul beast... I can't leave this place... Not until I have my revenge... Slay the _fetid rat,_ that has taken my life...

It stalks this floor... Spreading filth everywhere... _Beware its cloud of stink and corrosive bite, the acid dissolves in water..._
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.ghost.rat_2:
Please... Help me... Slay the abomination...

_Fight it near water... Avoid the stench..._
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.ghost.gnoll_1:
Hello %s... Once I was like you - strong and confident... But I was slain by a devious foe... I can't leave this place... Not until I have my revenge... Slay the _gnoll trickster,_ that has taken my life...

It is not like the other gnolls... It hides and uses thrown weapons... _Beware its poisonous and incendiary darts, don't attack from a distance..._
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.ghost.gnoll_2:
Please... Help me... Slay the trickster...

_Don't let it hit you... Get near to it..._
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.ghost.crab_1:
Hello %s... Once I was like you - strong and confident... But I was slain by an ancient creature... I can't leave this place... Not until I have my revenge... Slay the _great crab,_ that has taken my life...

It is unnaturally old... With a massive single claw and a thick shell... _Beware its claw, you must surprise the crab or it will block with it..._
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.ghost.crab_2:
Please... Help me... Slay the Crustacean...

_It will always block... When it sees you coming..._
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.ghost.desc: The ghost is barely visible. It looks like a shapeless spot of faint light with a sorrowful face.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.imp.name: ambitious imp
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.imp.old_intro: Are you an adventurer? I love adventurers! You can always rely on them if something needs to be killed, am I right? For a bounty of course ;)
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.imp.old_golems_1: In my case it's _golems_ that need to be killed. You see, I'm going to start a little business here, but those stupid golems are bad for business! It's very hard to negotiate with wandering lumps of granite, damn them! So please kill... let's say _4 of them_ and a reward is yours.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.imp.old_monks_1: In my case it's _monks_ who need to be killed. You see, I'm going to start a little business here, but those lunatics don't buy anything themselves and will scare away other customers. So please kill... let's say _5 of them_ and a reward is yours.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.imp.old_golems_2: How is your golem safari going? Just don't forget to grab those tokens.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.imp.old_monks_2: Oh, you're still alive! I knew that your kung-fu would be stronger ;) Just don't forget to grab those tokens.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.imp.quest_intro_1:
Oh hello, are you an adventurer? I love adventurers! You can always rely on them when you need a hand. With an appropriate reward, of course ;).

There's a big dwarven vault in front of me that's got a bunch of rare artifacts inside of it. I'm a collector of sorts, and there's a statuette in that vault that I want very much.

The vault is full of guardians and traps though, so I could use a little help!
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.imp.quest_intro_2:
The vault's magically sealed. I can teleport you in with a spell I've been preparing, but _I can't teleport your gear with you._ There should be plenty of loot inside of the vault to help you along though! _You'll probably want to start out by avoiding enemies and looking for items that aren't as well protected._

I can recall you with two items from the vault. One will be my statuette, and the other can be _anything from the vault that you like!_

I've collected a bunch of valuables that you might be interested in too! If you help me here I'll _set up shop a little further down_ and we can trade.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.imp.quest_in_progress: Just step into the center of the vault entrance when you're ready to go and I'll teleport you inside.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.imp.enter_text:
Are you ready? I'll keep your items safe up here, _you'll get everything back when you return._

Take this _cloth armor_ and _teleport crystal_ with you though. Use the crystal when you have my statuette. ...I suppose _you can use it early too if you're in trouble_, but don't expect the full reward!

The vault hasn't been disturbed for a long time, so enemies in it should be more sluggish than usual. It should be easier than normal to avoid detection, especially if _you stay behind the direction enemies wander in._ If any enemy does see you they _shouldn't chase you if they only see you for a moment._ You'll probably also be able to _sense nearby footsteps_ if you pay attention.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.imp.quest_completed_bad:
Well, thanks for trying.

The spell I used to access the vault will take a very long time to prepare again, so you'd better be on your way.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.imp.quest_completed_goo:
Thanks for your help!

It'll take me some time to get my teleportation spell ready, and I'll need to plan things out based on the information you've given me as well.

I'll get packed up and see you a bit further into the dungeon. Afraid I do still need gold, so my wares won't be free ;).
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.imp.quest_completed_gre:
Great job down there, thanks so much!

I've got everything I need here, so I'll get packed up and see you a bit further into the dungeon. Afraid I do still need gold, so my wares won't be free ;).

What was so important about the statue? Nothing you might think, it's actually a pretty mundane object. It comes from a faraway land that no longer exists; it might be the last of its kind. If it weren't for these greedy dwarves it would have probably been destroyed along with everything else...
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.imp.desc:
This little red person look like an Imp. Imps are lesser demons, notable for their intelligence and not their strength.

You've only heard about demons in ancient folk tales though, which usually describe them as travelers from another world. You've never seen any evidence demons actually exist, but this Imp is clearly real and seems very happy to see you.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.impshopkeeper.name: ambitious imp
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.impshopkeeper.greetings: What did you do %s? Shop quickly, I've got to get out of here!
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.impshopkeeper.thief: I thought I could trust you!
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.impshopkeeper.buyback: The imp cheerily returns your item.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.impshopkeeper.desc: The imp has set up a little shop on the border of the inner halls. It's nice to see a friendly face, but his prices certainly don't seem friendly.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.mirrorimage.name: mirror image
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.mirrorimage.desc:
This illusion bears a close resemblance to you, even seeming to wield your current weapon and armor.

Mirror images will seek and attack enemies using their mimicked weapon, which behaves the same as yours, but deals less damage. They start out nearly invisible, but must take on a form that's more easily seen in order to attack.

While their offensive power can be potent, mirror images have no durability, and will fade the moment they take damage.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.mirrorimage.discover_hi: You can find this character with a specific scroll.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.npc.discover_hint: You can find this character in a specific region of the dungeon.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.prismaticimage.name: prismatic image
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.prismaticimage.desc:
This shimmering illusion bears a close resemblance to you, even seeming to wield your current weapon and armor.

Prismatic images will attempt to seek and draw focus from enemies, using their enhanced defense and health to protect you. While they do not have the same offensive power as mirror images, they have enhanced durability, including receiving benefits from your armor.

When reduced to 0 hp, prismatic images will fade over several turns, and can still be healed during this time. When no enemies are present, prismatic images will fade and rejoin their master.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.prismaticimage.discover: You can find this character with a specific scroll.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.ratking.name: rat king
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.ratking.what_is_it: What is it? I have no time for this nonsense. My kingdom won't rule itself!
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.ratking.confused: Wha... Where am I? My kingdom needs me!
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.ratking.crown_clothes: Put some clothes on! You're in no state to talk to royalty!
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.ratking.crown_desc:
Oooh, is that crown for me!? It looks much shinier than mine, so I graciously accept!

In fact, I think I can offer you something as a reward for this crown. A tremendous power befitting a hero such as yourself! Would you like that?
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.ratking.crown_thankyou: Hehehe, thank you! Now go and make your king proud!
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.ratking.crown_fine: Fine! It's not like I wanted it anyway...
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.ratking.crown_after: Enjoying your new armor? No take-backsies!
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.ratking.desc_crown: This rat is a little bigger than a regular marsupial rat. It's wearing dwarf king's crown on its head.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.ratking.desc_birthday: This rat is a little bigger than a regular marsupial rat. It's wearing a tiny green party hat instead of its usual crown. Happy birthday Rat King!
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.ratking.desc_winter: This rat is a little bigger than a regular marsupial rat. It's wearing a tiny festive hat instead of its usual crown. Happy Holidays!
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.ratking.desc: This rat is a little bigger than a regular marsupial rat. It's wearing a tiny crown on its head.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.ratking.discover_hint: You can find this character at the end of a specific region of the dungeon.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.sheep.name: sheep
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.sheep.desc: This is a magic sheep. What's so magical about it? You can't kill it. It will stand there until it magically fades away, all the while chewing cud with a blank stare.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.sheep.discover_hint: You can find this character with a specific item or trap.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.shopkeeper.name: shopkeeper
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.shopkeeper.warn: Watch it! I won't warn you again.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.shopkeeper.buyback: The shopkeeper reluctantly returns your item.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.shopkeeper.talk_prison_: I have everything you need for a successful adventure!
That's an interesting seal you've got there, they're usually in one piece. You a disgraced hero or something? Well whatever you've done is none of my business, your coins are still good.

Hehe, I think I've seen a wanted poster with your name on it somewhere in the city. On the run are we? Oh you're innocent are you? Of course, of course... Don't fret, I've got better things to do than report on you, but perhaps you should buy something to be sure?

Have you come from the thieves guild to clear the area? No, just shopping? Well kill a few monsters while you're here anyway. Don't expect a discount either, I pay good protection money to you people and you're barely keeping me safe down here.

You seem to be out of your element miss. Tight dungeon corridors aren't as spacious as grand halls or the forests surrounding the city are they? Hehe, oh don't mind my rambling, why not buy something?

Well if it isn't the travelling hero! If you're trying to save another town then good luck, the dangers here are much worse than petty bandit gangs. I'm sure you'll do better than anyone else could, just try to not die right outside my store.

Well hello there Your Highness, or is it Your Holiness now? Hehe, either way this is no place for you, a lot of people would be quite distraught if you wound up dead. Surely you have some coins though, why not buy something to help prevent that?
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.shopkeeper.talk_caves:
Spend money, live longer.

Oh and say hello to that Troll blacksmith for me if you see him. Remind the lug that he still owes me money for that hammer I sold him last week!
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.shopkeeper.talk_city:
My wares can keep you safe down here.

...And don't loiter if you please. It took forever to get the locals down here to leave me alone, I don't want you attracting any trouble!
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.shopkeeper.talk_halls:
Hey there, I've got special prices for demon hunters!

Oh and be careful down there! The demons below are even worse than what you saw in the vault, and there's no escape crystal to save you. You can't come back up and spend more money if you're dead! ;)

Are the demons like me? Hehe, not at all. I'm just a small fellow, not much of a fighter, and I've managed to keep my mind intact. The demons below are much stronger things, and they've all been enslaved by... well... just be careful down there.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.shopkeeper.talk_ascent: I don't know what you're planning to do with that amulet but I want no part of it. Buy something and move on, we both need to leave this place!
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.shopkeeper.desc: This stout guy looks more appropriate for a trade district in some large city than for a dungeon. His prices explain why he prefers to do business here.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.wandmaker.name: old wandmaker
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.wandmaker.intro_warrior: Oh, hello there! What a pleasant surprise to meet a warrior from the north in such a depressing place! You must have travelled quite far to get here. If you're looking for adventure, I may have a task for you.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.wandmaker.intro_rogue: Oh Goodness, you startled me! I haven't met a bandit from this place that still has his sanity, so you must be from the surface! If you're up to helping a stranger out, I may have a task for you.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.wandmaker.intro_mage: Oh, hello %s! I heard there was some ruckus regarding you and the wizards institute? Oh never mind, I never liked those stick-in-the-muds anyway. If you're willing, I may have a task for you.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.wandmaker.intro_huntres: Oh, hello miss! A friendly face is a pleasant surprise down here isn't it? In fact, I swear I've seen your face before, but I can't put my finger on it... Oh never mind, if you're here for adventure, I may have a task for you.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.wandmaker.intro_duelist: Oh, hello miss! What a pleasant surprise to meet a hero in such a depressing place! If you're up to helping an old man out, I may have a task for you.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.wandmaker.intro_cleric: Oh, hello Your Highness! What a pleasant surprise to meet you in such a depressing place! I hate to impose, but I may have a task for you.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.wandmaker.intro_1: I came here to find a rare ingredient for a wand, but I've gotten myself lost, and my magical shield is weakening. I'll need to leave soon, but can't bear to go without getting what I came for.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.wandmaker.intro_dust: I'm looking for some _corpse dust._ It's a special kind of cursed bone meal that usually shows up in places like this. There should be a barricaded room around here somewhere, I'm sure some dust will turn up there. Do be careful though, the curse the dust carries is quite potent, _get back to me as fast as you can_ and I'll cleanse it for you.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.wandmaker.intro_ember: I'm looking for some _fresh embers_ from a newborn fire elemental. Elementals usually pop up when a summoning ritual isn't controlled, so just find some candles and a ritual site and I'm sure you can get one to pop up. You'll want to _avoid boxing yourself in_ while fighting it though, or you could _keep some sort of freezing item handy._ Newborn Elementals are pretty powerful and chaotic, but they can't stand the cold.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.wandmaker.intro_berry: The old warden of this prison kept a _rotberry plant,_ and I'm after one of its seeds. The plant has probably gone wild by now though, so getting it to give up a seed might be tricky. Its garden should be somewhere around here. Try to _keep away from its vine lashers_ if you want to stay in one piece. Using fire might be tempting but please don't, you'll kill the plant and destroy its seeds.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.wandmaker.intro_2: If you can get that for me, I'll be happy to pay you with one of my finely crafted wands! I brought two with me, so you can take whichever one you prefer.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.wandmaker.reminder_dust: Any luck with corpse dust, %s? Look for some barricades.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.wandmaker.reminder_embe: Any luck with those embers, %s? You'll need to find four candles and the ritual site.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.wandmaker.reminder_berr: Any luck with a Rotberry seed, %s? Look for a room filled with vegetation.
messages.actors.mobs.npcs.wandmaker.desc: This old yet hale gentleman wears a slightly confused expression. He is protected by a magic shield.
messages.actors.mobs.quest.vault.vaultbosselement: You can find this enemy during a specific quest.

Representing the pinnacle of dwarven summoning magic, this massive elemental's unstable power seems to be regulated by the equally impressive circle that summoned it. This gives it the ability to _swap forms!_ Each form has unique attacks, resistances, and weaknesses.

The elemental is currently assuming a molten hot _fiery form_. In this form it can shoot fireballs and summon waves of flame that sweep across the arena. It will try to aim fireballs in the direction you are moving, and the fire waves always have a gap. If you're hit by either you'll be _ignited_.

In this form it is _resistant to magic_, which only serves to fuel the flames. Its vulnerable molten core could probably be easily hit with _ranged weapons_ however.
The flames grow as the elemental absorbs most of your magic attack!
Your thrown weapon strikes the elemental's core, dealing extra damage!

The elemental is currently assuming a frigid _frost form_. In this form it can shoot a sweeping cone of cold and summon a vortex of moving frigid air. Both of these attacks can be stepped around with good timing, but the cone is especially deadly at a distance. If you're hit by either you will _freeze solid_.

In this form it is also _resistant to thrown weapons_, which will just stick to its icy shell. The shell doesn't look especially durable though, so a hit with a _melee weapon_ should be especially damaging.
The thrown weapon sticks to the elemenental's frost shell!
Your melee strike shatters some of the frost shell, dealing extra damage!

The elemental is currently assuming an electric _shock form_. In this form it can fire a bolt of lightning at your location, or summon lines of sparks from the sides of the arena. These attacks are a bit easier to dodge, but it can do them more frequently. If you're hit by either you will be _momentarily stunned_.

In this form it is also _resistant to melee attacks_, which will cause a painful jolt. The energy surrounding it will be destabilized by _magic_ however, inflicting additional damage.
As you try to strike you receive a painful jolt!
The magic disrupts the elemental's electric field, dealing extra damage!
messages.actors.mobs.quest.vault.vaultdm100.name: modified DM-100
messages.actors.mobs.quest.vault.vaultdm100.disco: You can find this enemy during a specific quest.
messages.actors.mobs.quest.vault.vaultdm100.desc:
These DM-100s look almost identical to ones you'd find in the prison, but with a bright teal glow coming from their eye. Probably they have been retrofitted to use some more modern dwarven power source.

They act just like regular DM-100s. Their ability to arc lightning at a distance is still present despite the power source change, and their cleaner condition makes them a bit more durable.
