messages.scenes.supporterscene.title: Support the Game
messages.scenes.supporterscene.intro: I want Shattered Pixel Dungeon to be free of ads and invasive microtransactions, which ruin so many free games. Instead, I'd rather ask players to support the game directly!
messages.scenes.supporterscene.patreon_msg:
If you enjoy Shattered and want to help me keep making it, please consider supporting me on _Patreon!_ The Patreon has a bunch of exclusive benefits!:
_- Early Access_ to betas of future updates.
_- Weekly Mini-Blogs_ with info about what I'm working on.
_- Monthly Polls_ which directly affect content I'm developing.
_- Physical Reward Pins_ after 1, 2, and 3 years of patronage.
_- A Community Discord_ with a dev log and chat channels.

_And More!_ You can visit the Patreon page for more info. Thanks for your time, and happy dungeoneering!
messages.scenes.supporterscene.patreon_english: (Note that Patreon rewards are only available in English.)
messages.scenes.titlescene$changesbutton.title: An Update is Available!
messages.scenes.titlescene$changesbutton.desc:
Shattered Pixel Dungeon is regularly updated with overhauls to existing game content, or entirely new content!

Game balance is also frequently improved in game updates, so that specific items/heroes/enemies aren't too strong or too weak.

Updates also include fixes for bugs and other various stability improvements.
messages.scenes.titlescene.patreon_body:
Shattered Pixel Dungeon is a completely free game, which means that I depend on support from generous players in order to keep making it.

If you're interested in supporting me, the best way to do so is through Patreon. Patreon gives me a consistent income source, and allows me to give something back to those who support me!

Patrons get exclusive blog posts every week which let them know about what I'm working on before anyone else!

You can take a look at my Patreon page for the most up to date information about benefits, Thank you for your consideration!

(Patreon rewards are only available in English)
messages.scenes.welcomescene.update_intro: Shattered Pixel Dungeon has been updated!
messages.scenes.welcomescene.update_msg: v4.0 is arguably Shattered's biggest update yet! There's a massive new quest, a bunch of new in-game art, 6 new enchantments, and plenty smaller changes and adjustments.
messages.scenes.welcomescene.patch_intro: Shattered Pixel Dungeon has been patched!
messages.scenes.welcomescene.patch_balance: This patch contains tweaks to game balance.
messages.scenes.welcomescene.patch_msg: This patch also contains some small tweaks and performance improvements.
messages.scenes.welcomescene.what_msg:
It seems that your current saves are from a future version of Shattered Pixel Dungeon!

Tread with caution! Your saves may contain things which don't exist in this version, this could cause some very weird errors to occur.
messages.scenes.welcomescene.lang_warning_msg:
Some of the new content from this update has not yet been translated.

Some phrases may be written in English.

The translation teams are working to resolve this and a full translation should be patched in soon.

Thank you for your patience.
messages.scenes.welcomescene.save_warning:
Shattered Pixel Dungeon was interrupted while trying to save your game data recently. Shattered has built-in protections against this, so your game data should be fine.

This usually happens when your device suddenly loses power, or if it terminates Shattered without letting it close properly. Battery saver features can often cause this on mobile devices. Restarting your device may also help if you are seeing this error frequently.
messages.scenes.welcomescene.controller_body:
Playing on a controller? Use the right stick to control an on-screen cursor.

Press RT/R2 or the right stick to select with the cursor.
messages.levels.features.chasm.yes: Yes, I know what I'm doing
messages.levels.features.chasm.jump: Do you really want to jump into the chasm? A fall that far will be painful.
messages.levels.rooms.secret.ratkingroom$ratkingr: A statue in the likeness of Rat King. Who made this?
This puffy purple pillow would be too small of a bed for you, but it's the perfect size for the world's most important rat.
messages.levels.rooms.special.magicalfireroom$ete: A wall of dense bright green fire is here, seemingly caused by magic. It's so dense that you can't move through it, and it ignites anything that gets too close. It shows no signs of burning down naturally, you'll need to use something to extinguish it.
messages.levels.rooms.special.sentryroom$sentry.d:
This blood-red sentry seems to be positioned here to guard the treasure at the other end of this room. It will fire beams of disintegration magic at you if you step in the area it defends.

It's immune to all harmful effects and can see through invisibility, but seems to take a while to charge up before it starts firing.

Somehow the sentry only wants to fire on you, as if it knows that the denizens of the dungeon are no threat to the treasure.
You can find this enemy anywhere in the dungeon.
messages.levels.rooms.special.toxicgasroom$toxicv: A careless adventurer must have triggered this trap ages ago. Despite its inactive state, it's still spewing toxic gas into the room and shows no signs of stopping. You'll need some way to prevent damage from the gas if you want to explore this room.
messages.levels.rooms.special.weakfloorroom$hidde: You can just make out a well in the depths below, perhaps there is something down there?
messages.levels.rooms.quest.ambitiousimproom$ques: This ominous pit seems to be the entrance to some ancient dwarven vault. A magical barrier prevents entry, you can walk over top of it as if there was floor here.
messages.levels.rooms.quest.blacksmithroom$queste: This ladder leads to an old mine just below the blacksmith's workshop.
messages.levels.rooms.quest.blacksmithroom$smithy: A little smithy set up by the troll blacksmith, complete with a coal tray, a forge, and a water basin that looks absolutely filthy.
messages.levels.rooms.quest.ritualsiteroom$ritual: A painted marker for some dark ritual. Candles are usually placed on the four corners.
This heavy table looks like it was crudely modified into a sort of torture rack.
messages.levels.rooms.quest.massgraveroom$massgra: Bones litter the floor, what happened here?
messages.levels.rooms.quest.mineentrance$questexi: This ladder leads out of the mine, back into the blacksmith's workshop.
messages.levels.rooms.quest.vault.vaultentrancero: This large platform is same size as the pit above you. Probably this platform is involved in some kind of elevator mechanism when the vault is accessed normally.
As you step into the large room, time seems to slow and you hear the Imp's voice:

"I think you've entered the ultimate chamber of the vault, my statuette should be just beyond! I'm sure there's going to some sort of nasty trap or guardian though, so _you really should explore and prepare before going any further!_ I want you to actually get my prize, not die trying!"

As you step into the large room, time seems to slow and you hear the Imp's voice:

"Alright, I think you're in the ultimate chamber of the vault, my statuette should be just beyond! I'm sure there's going to some sort of nasty trap or guardian though, so _make sure you're all powered up and ready for a big fight!_ I want you to actually get my prize, not die trying."
You hear something charging up, one more step forward is going to trigger something!
messages.levels.rooms.quest.vault.vaultfinalroom$:
This pattern in the floor tiles looks like a gigantic version of a summoning marker from the prison.

The whole floor hums with energy, as if there's some great power just waiting to be unleashed.
Gold is piled on the floor here, it's a shame you can't take it back out of the vault with you.
messages.levels.traps.alarmtrap.name: alarm trap
messages.levels.traps.alarmtrap.alarm: The trap emits a piercing sound that echoes throughout the dungeon!
messages.levels.traps.alarmtrap.desc: This trap seems to be tied to a loud alarm mechanism. Triggering it will likely alert everything on the level.
messages.levels.traps.blazingtrap.name: blazing trap
messages.levels.traps.blazingtrap.desc: Stepping on this trap will ignite a powerful chemical mixture, setting a wide area ablaze.
messages.levels.traps.burningtrap.name: burning trap
messages.levels.traps.burningtrap.desc: Stepping on this trap will ignite a chemical mixture, setting the surrounding area aflame.
messages.levels.traps.chillingtrap.name: chilling trap
messages.levels.traps.chillingtrap.desc: When activated, chemicals in this trap will rapidly freeze the air around its location.
messages.levels.traps.confusiontrap.name: confusion gas trap
messages.levels.traps.confusiontrap.desc: Triggering this trap will set a cloud of confusion gas loose within the immediate area.
messages.levels.traps.cursingtrap.name: cursing trap
messages.levels.traps.cursingtrap.desc: This trap contains the same malevolent magic found in cursed equipment. Triggering it will curse some items in the immediate area.
messages.levels.traps.disarmingtrap.name: disarming trap
messages.levels.traps.disarmingtrap.desc: This trap contains very specific teleportation magic, which will warp the weapon of its victim to some other location.
messages.levels.traps.disintegrationtrap.name: disintegration trap
messages.levels.traps.disintegrationtrap.some: The trap disintegrates some of your %s!
messages.levels.traps.disintegrationtrap.ondeath: You were killed by the disintegration trap...
messages.levels.traps.disintegrationtrap.desc:
When triggered, this trap will lance the nearest target with beams of disintegration, dealing significant damage and destroying items.

Thankfully the trigger mechanism isn't hidden.
messages.levels.traps.distortiontrap.name: distortion trap
messages.levels.traps.distortiontrap.desc: Built from strange magic of unknown origin, this trap will summon all manner of creatures to this location.
messages.levels.traps.explosivetrap.name: explosive trap
messages.levels.traps.explosivetrap.desc: This trap contains some powdered explosive and a trigger mechanism. Activating it will cause an explosion in the immediate area.
messages.levels.traps.flashingtrap.name: flashing trap
messages.levels.traps.flashingtrap.desc:
On activation, this trap will ignite a potent flashing powder stored within, temporarily blinding, crippling, and injuring its victim.

The trap must have a large store of powder, as it can activate many times without breaking.
messages.levels.traps.flocktrap.name: flock trap
messages.levels.traps.flocktrap.desc: Perhaps a joke from some amateur mage, triggering this trap will create a flock of magical sheep.
messages.levels.traps.frosttrap.name: frost trap
messages.levels.traps.frosttrap.desc: When activated, chemicals in this trap will rapidly freeze the air in a wide range around its location.
messages.levels.traps.gatewaytrap.name: gateway trap
messages.levels.traps.gatewaytrap.desc: This special teleportation trap can activate an infinite numbers of times and always teleports to the same location.
messages.levels.traps.geysertrap.name: geyser trap
messages.levels.traps.geysertrap.desc: When triggered, this trap will cause a geyser of water to spew forth, damaging fiery enemies, knocking away all nearby characters, dousing fires, and converting the surrounding terrain to water.
messages.levels.traps.gnollrockfalltrap.name: gnoll rockfall trap
messages.levels.traps.gnollrockfalltrap.desc:
This rockfall trap is made with some form of magical assistance. When triggered, it will cause rocks to loosen and immediately fall from above in a 5x5 area around it. Due to the softer rocks in the area, it won't deal as much damage as a regular rockfall trap, but your armor also won't be effective against it. Rocks also won't fall in locations with an adjacent barricade, as they help hold the ceiling up.

_This trap can't tell friend from foe, and so is just as harmful to the gnolls as it is to you._
messages.levels.traps.grimtrap.name: grim trap
messages.levels.traps.grimtrap.ondeath: You were killed by the blast of a grim trap...
messages.levels.traps.grimtrap.desc:
Extremely powerful destructive magic is stored within this trap, enough to instantly kill all but the healthiest of heroes. Triggering it will send a ranged blast of lethal magic towards the nearest character.

Thankfully the trigger mechanism isn't hidden.
messages.levels.traps.grippingtrap.name: gripping trap
messages.levels.traps.grippingtrap.desc:
This trap latches onto the feet of whoever trigger it, damaging them and slowing their movement.

Due to its simple nature, this trap can activate many times without breaking.
messages.levels.traps.guardiantrap.name: guardian trap
messages.levels.traps.guardiantrap.alarm: The trap emits a piercing sound that echoes throughout the dungeon!
messages.levels.traps.guardiantrap.desc: This trap is tied to a strange magical mechanism, which will summon guardians and alert all enemies on the floor.
messages.levels.traps.guardiantrap$guardian.name: summoned guardian
messages.levels.traps.guardiantrap$guardian.desc: This blue apparition seems to be a summoned echo of one of the dungeon's stone guardians.
messages.levels.traps.guardiantrap$guardian.desc_: While the statue itself is almost incorporeal, the _%s_ it's wielding looks real.
messages.levels.traps.guardiantrap$guardian.disco: You can find this enemy with a specific trap.
messages.levels.traps.oozetrap.name: ooze trap
messages.levels.traps.oozetrap.desc: This trap will splash out caustic ooze when activated, which will burn until it is washed away.
messages.levels.traps.pitfalltrap.name: pitfall trap
messages.levels.traps.pitfalltrap.triggered_hero: The ground starts to give way around you!
messages.levels.traps.pitfalltrap.triggered: The ground starts to give way around the triggered trap!
messages.levels.traps.pitfalltrap.no_pit: the ground is too solid for a pitfall trap to work here.
messages.levels.traps.pitfalltrap.desc: This trap is connected to a large trapdoor mechanism, and shortly after it is triggered anything near it will slip right through the ground and fall! It won't work in areas with especially solid floors though.
messages.levels.traps.poisondarttrap.name: poison dart trap
messages.levels.traps.poisondarttrap.ondeath: You were killed by the poison dart trap...
messages.levels.traps.poisondarttrap.desc:
A small dart-blower must be hidden nearby, activating this trap will cause it to shoot a poisoned dart at the nearest target.

Thankfully the trigger mechanism isn't hidden.
messages.levels.traps.rockfalltrap.name: rockfall trap
messages.levels.traps.rockfalltrap.ondeath: You were crushed by the rockfall trap...
messages.levels.traps.rockfalltrap.desc:
This trap is connected to a series of loose rocks above, triggering it will cause them to come crashing down over the entire room! If the trap isn't in a specific room, rocks will fall in an area around the trap instead.

Thankfully the trigger mechanism isn't hidden.
messages.levels.traps.shockingtrap.name: shocking trap
messages.levels.traps.shockingtrap.desc: A mechanism with a large amount of energy stored into it. Triggering this trap will discharge that energy into a field around it.
messages.levels.traps.stormtrap.name: storm trap
messages.levels.traps.stormtrap.desc: A mechanism with a massive amount of energy stored into it. Triggering this trap will discharge that energy into a large electrical storm.
messages.levels.traps.summoningtrap.name: summoning trap
messages.levels.traps.summoningtrap.desc: Triggering this trap will summon a number of this area's monsters to this location.
messages.levels.traps.teleportationtrap.name: teleportation trap
messages.levels.traps.teleportationtrap.desc: Whenever this trap is triggered, everything around it will be teleported to random locations on this floor.
messages.levels.traps.tengudarttrap.desc:
Tengu has clearly been preparing for a fight. This trap will activate a hidden dart blower which will shoot a poison dart at the nearest thing that isn't Tengu.

The trap is so well made that the trigger mechanism is impossible to detect without magical aid. However the trap is visible for a moment when it is being set.
messages.levels.traps.toxictrap.name: toxic gas trap
messages.levels.traps.toxictrap.desc: Triggering this trap will set a cloud of toxic gas loose within the surrounding area.
messages.levels.traps.trap.discover_hint: You can find this trap randomly in the dungeon. Each region has different traps that may appear.
messages.levels.traps.corrosiontrap.name: corrosive gas trap
messages.levels.traps.corrosiontrap.desc: Triggering this trap will set a cloud of deadly acidic gas loose within the immediate area.
messages.levels.traps.warpingtrap.name: warping trap
messages.levels.traps.warpingtrap.desc: This trap is similar to a teleportation trap, but will also cause the hero to lose their knowledge of the floor's layout!
messages.levels.traps.weakeningtrap.name: weakening trap
messages.levels.traps.weakeningtrap.desc: Dark magic in this trap sucks the energy out of anything that comes into contact with it. Powerful enemies may resist the effect, however.
messages.levels.traps.worndarttrap.name: worn dart trap
messages.levels.traps.worndarttrap.ondeath: You were killed by the worn dart trap...
messages.levels.traps.worndarttrap.desc:
A small dart-blower must be hidden nearby, activating this trap will cause it to shoot at the nearest target.

Due to its age it's not very harmful though, it isn't even hidden...
messages.levels.cavesbosslevel.wires_desc:
The ground is partially dug up here, showing some large exposed wires. They must be connecting the various electrical machines together.

The wires must have some current running through them. If DM-300 steps here it may be able to draw power from them.
messages.levels.cavesbosslevel.energy_desc: The ground here is sparking with electricity, and is harmful to step on. _The sparks seem to be gravitating in a certain direction..._ perhaps they lead to the power source?
messages.levels.cavesbosslevel.gate_desc: A large metal gate that blocks the path into the dwarven metropolis. The metal box in the center is producing a loud humming noise, it must be connected to the circuitry and machines nearby. Perhaps destroying DM-300 will open the gate?
messages.levels.cavesbosslevel.gate_desc_broken: The gate must have been connected to DM-300 in some way, as it exploded when DM-300 was defeated. Now only broken pieces remain.
messages.levels.cavesbosslevel.water_desc: With all the electricity around here water might not always be safe...
messages.levels.citybosslevel.throne_desc:
This impressively large throne is the seat of the dwarven empire, now taken over by a power-mad necromancer.

There seems to be some magical or mechanical parts to the throne, Dwarf King may have additional power when sitting on it.
messages.levels.citybosslevel.summoning_desc:
This pedestal has a large opening in the center, which is practically radiating with dark energy.

Dwarf King uses these pedestals as focal points for his necromantic magic, and can summon minions to them. The pedestal must charge for a few turns before the minion appears, and the type of minion being summoned is telegraphed by the building magical power.
messages.levels.caveslevel.entrance_desc: The ladder leads up to the upper depth.
messages.levels.caveslevel.exit_desc: The ladder leads down to the lower depth.
messages.levels.caveslevel.wall_deco_desc: A vein of some ore is visible on the wall. Gold?
messages.levels.caveslevel.bookshelf_desc: Who would need a bookshelf in a cave?
messages.levels.caveslevel.region_deco_desc: A large all-metal structure, probably built by the dwarves when they used to mine this place. You think you can see long-unused minecart tracks running along the top.
messages.levels.citylevel.entrance_desc: A ramp leads up to the upper depth.
messages.levels.citylevel.exit_desc: A ramp leads down to the lower depth.
messages.levels.citylevel.statue_desc: The statue depicts some dwarf standing in a heroic stance.
messages.levels.citylevel.bookshelf_desc: The rows of books on different disciplines fill the bookshelf.
messages.levels.citylevel.region_deco_desc: A raised pedestal with a bright green magical flame atop. The flame is so dense it might as well be solid.
messages.levels.hallslevel.water_desc: It looks like lava, but it's cold and probably safe to touch.
messages.levels.hallslevel.statue_desc: The pillar is made of real humanoid skulls. Awesome.
messages.levels.hallslevel.bookshelf_desc: Books in ancient languages smoulder in the bookshelf.
messages.levels.hallslevel.region_deco_desc: A huge piece of stone that seems to have broken off from the ceiling or a nearby wall.
messages.levels.level.water_desc: In case of burning step into the water to extinguish the fire.
messages.levels.level.entrance_desc: Stairs lead up to the upper depth.
messages.levels.level.exit_desc: Stairs lead down to the lower depth.
messages.levels.level.locked_door_desc: This door is locked, you need a matching key to unlock it.
messages.levels.level.crystal_door_desc: This locked door is made of magical crystal. You can see through, but you'll need a crystal key to open it.
messages.levels.level.locked_exit_desc: Heavy bars block the stairs leading down.
messages.levels.level.barricade_desc: The wooden barricade is firmly set but has dried over the years. Might it burn?
messages.levels.level.inactive_trap_desc: The trap has been triggered before and it's not dangerous anymore.
messages.levels.level.statue_desc: Someone wanted to adorn this place, but failed, obviously.
messages.levels.level.alchemy_desc: This pot is filled with magical water. Items can be mixed into the pot to create something new!
messages.levels.level$feeling.chasm_desc: Your steps echo across the dungeon.
messages.levels.level$feeling.water_desc: You hear water splashing around you.
messages.levels.level$feeling.grass_desc: The smell of vegetation is thick in the air.
messages.levels.level$feeling.dark_desc: You can hear enemies moving in the darkness.
messages.levels.level$feeling.large_desc: This dungeon floor seems unusually large.
messages.levels.level$feeling.traps_desc: The ground seems especially treacherous here.
messages.levels.level$feeling.secrets_desc: The atmosphere hints that this floor hides many secrets.
messages.levels.mininglevel.wall_desc: A smooth rock wall that's a little softer than usual. You can mine through it with your pickaxe, but it'll take some effort and increase your hunger a bit.
messages.levels.mininglevel.gold_extra_desc: You can probably mine it out with your pickaxe.
messages.levels.mininglevel.crystal_desc: There is a large and colorful crystal outcropping here. These crystals are fragile and can easily be broken with a pickaxe, or will break if something is mined next to it.
messages.levels.mininglevel.boulder_desc: There is a large boulder blocking the way. It should be fairly easy to break with a pickaxe.
messages.levels.mininglevel.barricade_desc:
The wooden barricade is firmly set and acts as a support for the ceiling.

This was probably constructed by the gnolls to give some protection against falling rocks. _Any adjacent cells will be protected from rockfall traps and attacks._

It looks like it would burn just as well as any other barricade.
messages.levels.prisonlevel.empty_deco_desc: There are old blood stains on the floor.
messages.levels.prisonlevel.bookshelf_desc: This is probably a vestige of a prison library. Might it burn?
messages.levels.prisonlevel.region_deco_desc: A metal cage just large enough to hold a person. It seems to be locked to the ground in some way, you can't move it.
messages.levels.prisonlevel.region_deco_alt_desc: A metal cage just large enough to hold a person. It's hanging over a deep chasm, suspended by a chain.
messages.levels.sewerlevel.empty_deco_desc: Wet yellowish moss covers the floor.
messages.levels.sewerlevel.bookshelf_desc: The bookshelf is packed with cheap useless books. Might it burn?
messages.levels.sewerlevel.region_deco_desc: A stout barrel that's almost as big as you are. It must be full of something or another, it's too heavy to move.
messages.levels.vaultlevel$vaultflametrap.name: vault flame vent
messages.levels.vaultlevel$vaultflametrap.desc: This vent seems to be sending up bursts of green flame at regular intervals. You can see the flames starting to build just before it fires. The flames can usually be avoided, but _anything that lets you resist fire or area-bound effects_ is also effective.
messages.tiles.custom.carpet.name: Carpet
messages.tiles.custom.carpet.desc: Thick carpet covers the floor. It must be treated in some way, it isn't flammable.

messages.challenges.no_food_desc:
Food's already scarce, but you have to watch your portions as well!

- Food and the horn of plenty are one third as effective at satisfying hunger
- Other sources of satiety are unaffected
messages.challenges.no_armor_desc:
You'll need faith in yourself, as your armor won't do much!

- Base blocking power reduced for all armor except cloth
- All armor now gains very little blocking when upgraded
- Earthen guardian's defensive power is also significantly reduced
messages.challenges.no_healing_desc:
Healing potions sure are handy, unfortunately you're allergic!

- Potions of healing, items that use potions of healing in their recipe, and sunfruit will poison the hero instead of healing them
- Unstable brews cannot randomly poison or heal the hero
- These items still work normally for other characters.
messages.challenges.no_herbalism_desc:
There seems to be no clean water left in this accursed dungeon...

- Dew drops are removed
- Plants are removed
- Seeds still appear, but will not take root
messages.challenges.swarm_intelligence_desc:
Watch out, the dungeon monsters are getting smarter!

- While enemies see your or your allies, they will attract other nearby enemies to your position.
- The range for this starts out at just 2 tiles, but grows by 2 for every turn the enemy sees you, up to 12.
- Breaking vision resets the attracting range, even briefly such as with a door.
messages.challenges.darkness_desc:
It is a dungeon after all!

- Regular visible distance dramatically reduced
- A torch appears on each floor
- Other light sources are 1/5 as effective
messages.challenges.no_scrolls_desc:
A certain rune is harder to find. Unfortunately, it's always the most useful one.

- Half of the dungeon's upgrade scrolls are removed
messages.challenges.champion_enemies_desc:
You're not the only one who can level up!

Regular enemies have a 1/8 chance to spawn with a special champion buff on floor 1, scaling up to 1/6 on floor 21.

- Champions wake up if they spawn asleep
- The hero knows when a champion spawns
- Champions cannot be turned into allies

There are six types of champion enemy:
_Blazing (orange):_ +25% melee damage, ignites on hit, spreads flames on death, can't ignite water tiles
_Projecting (purple):_ +25% melee damage, +3 melee range
_Antimagic (green):_ -50% damage taken, immune to magical effects
_Giant (blue):_ -80% damage taken, +1 melee range, cannot move into tunnels
_Blessed (yellow):_ 4x accuracy and evasion
_Growing (red):_ +20% accuracy, evasion, damage, and effective HP. Increases by 1% every 4 turns.
messages.challenges.stronger_bosses_desc:
Bosses are much tougher with this challenge!

_Goo:_ +20% health
_-_ Healing in water ramps up, to 3/turn
_-_ Pumps up in 1 turn instead of 2
_Tengu:_ +25% health
_-_ Phase 1: traps are much deadlier
_-_ Phase 2: abilities are more frequent
_DM-300:_ +33% health
_-_ Pylons are tougher and 3 activate
_-_ Abilities are more powerful and frequent
_-_ DM-300 is faster when supercharged
_-_ Exposed wires are twice as common
_Dwarf King:_ +50% health
_-_ Minions are stronger in all phases
_-_ Phase 1: faster abilities and summons
_-_ Phase 2: 2 more minions per round
_-_ Phase 3: 2x health, faster summons
_Yog-Dzewa:_
_-_ Two fists are summoned at a time!
_-_ +60% laser damage
_-_ Stronger minions

AdrenalineDart.name: adrenaline dart
AdrenalineDart.description: These darts are tipped with a swiftthistle-based compound which will boost the movement and attack speed of allies, or briefly lower the movement speed of enemies. The dart itself is still harmful to enemies, but will not harm allies.
AdrenalineDart.zh_description: 这些飞镖上涂着一种由速行蓟制成的药物。当目标为友方时，其移动速度和攻击速度都会有所提升，若为敌方则会短暂降低其移动速度。这只飞镖仍能对敌人造成伤害，但不会伤及盟友。

AlchemistsToolkit.name: alchemist's toolkit
AlchemistsToolkit.description: This toolkit contains a number of reagents and herbs along with a small mixing vial, allowing for alchemy on-the-go. The vial contains what looks like alchemical energy crystals in liquid form.
AlchemistsToolkit.zh_description: 这套工具箱内存放着各式各样的试剂，草药和一个小混合瓶，让使用者能够随时随地进行炼金实验。这个混合瓶里貌似装载着液态的炼金能量晶体。

Alchemize.name: alchemize
Alchemize.description:
This spell contains transmutative powers similar to those found in an alchemy pot. Each cast allows the user to turn an item (or stack of items) into gold or alchemical energy. Turning potions or scrolls into energy will even identify them!

A few Alchemize uses are sold from shops, but many more can be made using alchemy by combining a seed, runestone, and a little alchemical energy.
Alchemize.zh_description:
这个菱晶包含的转化能力与炼金釜类似。允许使用者将一件物品(或一堆物品)转化为金币或炼金能量。将药剂、卷轴炼化为能量甚至可以鉴定它们！

你可以在商店中中买到少许炼金菱晶，但也可以通过炼金术用种子、符石与少量炼金能量合成更多的炼金菱晶。

AlchemyPage.name: torn alchemy book page
AlchemyPage.description:
A torn page from a guidebook on alchemy.

Most of the text is too small to read at a distance, but you can make out the title of the page:

_"%s"_
AlchemyPage.zh_description:
从一本炼金指南书上撕下来的一页。

在远处你只能看到一行行密密麻麻的小字，不过你仍然可以看清书页上的标题

_"%s"_

Amulet.name: amulet of yendor
Amulet.description: The Amulet of Yendor is the most powerful artifact known to human or dwarf kind. Its shimmering crystals contain incredible and wondrous power.
Amulet.zh_description: Yendor护符是人类与矮人所知的最强大的神器。其上镶嵌的晶石奇光辉映、气象非常，蕴含着不可思议的神奇力量。

Ankh.name: ankh
Ankh.description: This ancient symbol of immortality grants the ability to return to life after death. Most items will be dropped where you died, but can be reclaimed if you return to it. Using a full waterskin, the ankh can be blessed with extra strength.
Ankh.zh_description: 这枚象征不朽的古老饰物能使人起死回生。不过大部分物品将会被遗落在死亡的地点，等待你去拾回。装满的水袋可用于对重生十字架进行赐福，赋予它更强的力量。

AquaBrew.name: aqua brew
AquaBrew.description: When shattered, this brew will release a burst of pressurized water at its location. It's only forceful enough to damage fiery enemies, but it also spreads water to nearby terrain, disables traps, douses fires, and knocks back characters near the burst.
AquaBrew.zh_description: 当这瓶药剂破裂时，会在原地迸发高压水浪。水浪仅对火属性敌人造成有效伤害，但同时会让水流向附近的地形扩散，可浸湿陷阱使其失效、扑灭火焰，并击退水浪附近的角色。

ArcaneBomb.name: arcane bomb
ArcaneBomb.description: This bomb has been imbued with arcane properties. It will explode into a powerful blast similar to Goo's pumped up attack, dealing _%1$d-%2$d magical damage_ to anything within 2 tiles.
ArcaneBomb.zh_description: 这枚炸弹里灌注了奥术能量，当其爆炸时会释放出类似于粘咕蓄力攻击的强力冲击，在2格范围内对所有单位造成_%1$d~%2$d点魔法伤害_。

ArcaneResin.name: arcane resin
ArcaneResin.description:
This fine powder shimmers between shades of purple and white. It can act as an amplifier to magical energies, increasing the level of wands when it is applied to them!

Upgrading a wand costs 1, 2, or 3 resin depending on the wand's initial level. Resin can upgrade wands to a maximum of +3.

Resin upgrades are _overridden by other upgrade sources_ however (such as scrolls of upgrade), and do not apply when imbuing a wand into the Mage's staff.
ArcaneResin.zh_description:
这团细腻的粉末闪烁着紫与白的微光。奥术树脂可用于增强法杖魔能，提升法杖等级！

基于法杖初始等级，升级一根法杖分别需要消耗1、2、3个树脂。树脂最多可以升级法杖至+3。

然而，树脂的升级效果不但会_被其他升级来源覆盖_(例如升级卷轴)，而且无法通过灌注法杖转移到法师的魔杖。

AssassinsBlade.name: assassin's blade
AssassinsBlade.description: A small wavy blade made of obsidian, difficult to use despite being lightweight, but deadly if it finds the right mark.
AssassinsBlade.zh_description: 黑曜石制的波浪形短刃，虽轻便但不易用，如果能击中要害足以致命。

BattleAxe.name: battle axe
BattleAxe.description: The enormous steel head of this battle axe puts considerable heft behind each wide stroke.
BattleAxe.zh_description: 这把有着硕大钢制头部的战斧能将庞大的力量倾注在每次挥舞之中。

BeaconOfReturning.name: beacon of returning
BeaconOfReturning.description: This intricate spell grants the user the ability to return to a set location, regardless of distance. The spell will only be consumed by returning, it can be set as many times as you like, but it will only remember the most recent location it was set to.
BeaconOfReturning.zh_description: 这个复杂的晶柱给予了使用者无视距离返回到设定地点的能力。该晶柱只会在返回时消耗。你可以随时改变它的设定位置，但该晶柱只能记忆最近一次设置的位置。

Berry.name: dungeon berry
Berry.description: This small berry was found by the Huntress among the dungeon's vegetation. It can be eaten quickly, restores a small amount of satiety, and might contain a usable seed!
Berry.zh_description: 这颗小浆果是女猎手在地牢的植被里找到的，它可以被快速食用以获得少量饱腹感，还可能有实用的种子包含其中！

Blandfruit.name: blandfruit
Blandfruit.description: So dry and insubstantial, perhaps stewing it with another ingredient would improve it.
Blandfruit.zh_description: 干燥且脆弱，或许加点其他材料再煮能够增强它的效果。

BlindingDart.name: blinding dart
BlindingDart.description: These darts are tipped with a blindweed-based compound which will blind their target for a short time. They do not disorient however, so an enemy will still know where they last saw you.
BlindingDart.zh_description: 这些飞镖上涂着一种由致盲草制成的药物，能让目标失明一小段时间。药效比新鲜的致盲草弱，不会让目标迷失方向，所以目标会记住你之前在的位置。

BlizzardBrew.name: blizzard brew
BlizzardBrew.description: When shattered, this brew will unleash a swirling blizzard which quickly spreads like a gas.
BlizzardBrew.zh_description: 当瓶子破裂时，这瓶魔药会释放出一阵像气体一样扩散的旋流冰暴。

Bolas.name: bolas
Bolas.description: These unusual ranged weapons aren't very damaging, but do an excellent job of slowing their target.
Bolas.zh_description: 这种造型特殊的远程武器造成的伤害不高，但能够有效迟滞目标的移动。

Bomb.name: bomb
Bomb.description: A fairly hefty black powder bomb. An explosion from this bomb deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ to anything adjacent to it, and will destroy some adjacent terrain or items.
Bomb.zh_description: 一枚颇大的黑火药炸弹。爆炸时，这枚炸弹会对所有临近单位造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_并摧毁某些地形或物品。

BowFragment.name: bow fragment
BowFragment.description: This broken fragment of wood was once part of a lost Huntress' spirit bow. You can still feel a little nature energy left in the fragment, you can use the fragment to grow some high grass around you. Doing this will destroy the fragment however.
BowFragment.zh_description: 这块枯木曾经是一位殒落于此的女猎手所持灵能弓的一部分。你仍可以感受到枯木中残留的一点自然能量，你可以激发这最后的能量，令周身长出一片高草。但是当你这样做之后，这块枯木会由于自然能量耗尽而烟消云散。

BrokenHilt.name: broken hilt
BrokenHilt.description: This broken hilt looks like it came from a defeated Duelist's weapon. You can still feel a little martial power left in the hilt, you can use it to get a little bonus damage on your next two melee hits. Doing this will destroy the hilt however.
BrokenHilt.zh_description: 这把断折剑柄曾经应是一名败于此地的决斗者随身武器。即使如今你仍可感受到剑柄其上残留的武道气息，你可以运起这股气息，在接下来使用近战武器两次命中时造成些许额外伤害。但这意味着剑柄会随着武者气息的流失而烟消云散。

BrokenSeal.name: broken seal
BrokenSeal.description:
A wax seal, affixed to armor as a symbol of valor. It has a faded rune of protection engraved in the center, and is cracked in half across the middle.

A memento from his home, the seal helps the warrior persevere. While wearing the seal the warrior will instantly gain shielding when he is about to be damaged to half health or lower.

The seal can be _affixed to armor,_ and moved between armors. It can carry a single upgrade with it, so long as that upgrade was applied to the armor while the seal was attached to it.
BrokenSeal.zh_description:
一枚蜡制纹章，作为勇气的象征而贴附在护甲之上。纹章上刻有磨损的防御符咒，并从中碎裂为两半。

这是一件来自家乡的纪念物，在纹章的支持下战士会变得不屈不挠。佩戴着纹章，战士会在将要受伤至生命值半数以下时立即获得护盾。

纹章可以被_贴附在护甲上_并能在护甲间转移。它能够携带一次升级，前提是升级时纹章需已贴附在护甲上。

BrokenStaff.name: broken staff
BrokenStaff.description: This Mage's staff has been broken in half after its owner met their demise. You can still feel some magical energy left in the staff, you can use it to give your wands a little charge boost. Doing this will destroy the staff however.
BrokenStaff.zh_description: 这把法师魔杖在其主死后也断做两截。你仍可以感受到魔杖中残余的魔力波动，你可以用它来给你的法杖提供一些充能。但是，这样也会使得魔杖随着魔力的流失而烟消云散。

CapeOfThorns.name: cape of thorns
CapeOfThorns.description: These collapsed sheets of metal from the DM-300 have formed together into a rigid cape. It seems to store a deep energy, perhaps it has some of the DM-300's power?
CapeOfThorns.zh_description: 这些从DM-300崩解而出的金属碎片构成了一件坚硬的斗篷。它似乎能储存很多能量，也许它还残留有少量DM-300的能力？

CausticBrew.name: caustic brew
CausticBrew.description: This brew will spread corrosive ooze in a wide area around the location it shatters in. Anything caught by the ooze will slowly melt if it can't wash it off in water.
CausticBrew.zh_description: 这瓶魔药在打碎时会大范围地溅出腐蚀淤泥。被腐蚀淤泥影响的单位将会缓慢融化，除非他们能及时在水中冲洗掉淤泥。

CeremonialCandle.name: ceremonial candle
CeremonialCandle.description:
A set of candles, melted down and fused together through use.

Alone they are worthless, but used with other candles in a pattern, they can focus the energy for a summoning ritual.
CeremonialCandle.zh_description:
一套配套的蜡烛，在使用中融化在了一起。

单独看来它们毫无价值，但与其它蜡烛按特定排布共用时却能为召唤仪式聚集能量。

ChaliceOfBlood.name: chalice of blood
ChaliceOfBlood.description: This shining silver chalice is oddly adorned with sharp gems at the rim.
ChaliceOfBlood.zh_description: 这个闪闪发光的银质圣杯在边沿突兀地装饰着几颗造型尖锐的宝石。

ChaoticCenser.name: chaotic censer
ChaoticCenser.description: After some time in the alchemy pot this incense-burning censer appears to be producing smoke all on its own! These gasses build up and will spew forth from the censer toward enemies at semi-random intervals. It seems capable of producing all sorts of gasses, but you'll get a moment of warning just before the censer activates.
ChaoticCenser.zh_description: 在炼金釜内炼制一段时间后，这只香炉竟开始自行生烟！这些气体会在炉内不断积聚，并间歇性随机地向敌人喷去。香炉似乎能产生各类气体，但在气体释放前你会得到片刻的预警。

ChargrilledMeat.name: chargrilled meat
ChargrilledMeat.description: It looks like a decent steak.

ChillingDart.name: chilling dart
ChillingDart.description: These darts are tipped with an icecap-based compound which will significantly chill their target.
ChillingDart.zh_description: 这些飞镖上涂着一种由冰冠花制成的药物，能显著地冻伤目标。

CleansingDart.name: cleansing dart
CleansingDart.description: These darts are tipped with a mageroyal-based compound which will temporarily make allies immune to all negative effects, or will cleanse positive effects from enemies. Enemies may even briefly forget that they are attacking or fleeing from you. The dart itself is still harmful to enemies, but will not harm allies.
CleansingDart.zh_description: 这些飞镖上涂着一种由魔皇草制成的药物，能使友军暂时对所有负面效果免疫，也可以清除敌人身上的增益效果。敌人甚至会暂时忘记它正在攻击或逃离你。这只飞镖仍能对敌人造成伤害，但不会伤及盟友。

ClericArmor.name: hero's vestments
ClericArmor.description: While wearing this mixture of cloth and plate, the Cleric can perform a special ability.
ClericArmor.zh_description: 穿着这套内着重甲的祭服时，牧师能够施展一项特殊技能。

CloakOfShadows.name: cloak of shadows
CloakOfShadows.description:
A priceless magical cloak, stolen from the royal armory many years ago by the Rogue. When worn, it can be used to turn completely invisible for a short time.

The more the cloak is used, the stronger it will become, allowing the Rogue to become invisible more frequently and for longer durations.
CloakOfShadows.zh_description:
这是盗贼多年前从皇家军械库窃取的一件无价的魔法斗篷。穿上时，可令穿戴者在短时间完全隐形。

斗篷的使用次数越多，力量就会变得越强，使盗贼更频繁地隐形，且持续时间更长。

CloakScrap.name: scrap of fabric
CloakScrap.description: This scrap of translucent fabric looks like it came from a late Rogue's cloak of shadows. You can still feel a little mystical energy left in it, you can use it to give your artifacts a little charge boost. Doing this will destroy the fabric however.
CloakScrap.zh_description: 这块半透明的织物残片似是源于一位盗贼同行的暗影斗篷。你可以感受到一丝神秘的能量仍残留其中，你可以用它来给你的神器提供一些充能。但是如此残片也会随着神秘能量耗尽而烟消云散。

ClothArmor.name: cloth armor
ClothArmor.description: This lightweight armor offers basic protection.
ClothArmor.zh_description: 这件轻便的护甲能提供最基本的防御。

CorpseDust.name: corpse dust
CorpseDust.description:
The ball of corpse dust doesn't differ outwardly from a regular dust ball. But you can feel a malevolent energy lurking within it.

Getting rid of it as soon as possible would be a good idea.
CorpseDust.zh_description:
在外观上这团尸尘和普通灰尘差不多。而你却能够感受到其中潜伏着一股充满恶意的魔力。

尽快脱手为好。

CrackedSpyglass.name: cracked spyglass
CrackedSpyglass.description: This handheld telescope would be a demonstration of great and precise workmanship, if it weren't for the crack along its front lens. The spyglass seems to be helping you by revealing new items in the dungeon, but due to its flaw the revealed items are quite hard to see!
CrackedSpyglass.zh_description: 若是其前镜头完好无损，则这柄手持式望远镜可称得上一件能工巧匠的伟大之作了。望远镜似乎在为你揭示地牢中的新物品，但由于其本身的缺陷，这些被揭示的物品并不容易被看清。

Crossbow.name: crossbow
Crossbow.description: A fairly intricate weapon which shoots bolts at exceptional speeds. While it isn't designed for it, this crossbow's heft and sturdy construction make it a decent melee weapon as well.
Crossbow.zh_description: 这是一件看起来相当精密复杂的装置，能够将飞镖一样的小型箭矢以极高的速度射出。这把十字弩掂在手里沉甸甸的，比想象中结实很多，虽然完全违背了设计初衷，不过也能够在肉搏战中起到作用。

CrystalKey.name: Crystal key
CrystalKey.description: The cut surfaces of this crystalline key shimmer in the darkness. Perhaps it will open something made of crystal?
CrystalKey.zh_description: 这把水晶钥匙在黑暗中反射着光芒。或许可以用它来打开某样水晶制品？

Cudgel.name: cudgel
Cudgel.description: A small brass mace, made more as a self-defense tool for nobles than as an adventuring weapon.
Cudgel.zh_description: 一把小型黄铜锤，更多的作为贵族们的自卫工具而非冒险用武器使用。

CurseInfusion.name: curse infusion
CurseInfusion.description:
This spell infuses a piece of equipment with the same powerful malignant magic present within DM-300. The item it is used on will immediately be cursed, and any enchantment or glyph it may have had will be overridden.

In the case of weapons, armor, and wands, the item will gain upgrades in addition to being cursed. Curse infusion upgrades do not stack, and the upgrades are lost if the item becomes uncursed.

Multiple curse infusions can also be used to change the curse on a weapon or armor.
CurseInfusion.zh_description:
这个菱晶可以向一件装备注入和DM-300内部相同的的邪恶魔法。目标物品会立刻被诅咒，且原有的附魔与刻印会被覆盖。

对武器、护甲和法杖使用时，诅咒菱晶在诅咒的基础上还会升级目标物品。诅咒菱晶造成的升级不会叠加，而且去除诅咒后升级也随之消失。

对武器护甲的重复诅咒可以更换其上的诅咒种类。

Dagger.name: dagger
Dagger.description: A simple iron dagger with a worn wooden handle.
Dagger.zh_description: 木柄被磨损的简易铁质匕首。

DarkGold.name: dark gold ore
DarkGold.description: This metal is called dark not because of its color (it doesn't differ from the normal gold), but because it melts under the daylight, making it useless on the surface.
DarkGold.zh_description: 这种金属名中的暗并非源于其色泽(它看起来和普通黄金一样)，而是因为它会在阳光下熔化，令其在地表上毫无用处。

Dart.name: dart
Dart.description: These simple shafts of spike-tipped wood are weighted to fly true and sting their prey with a flick of the wrist. They can be tipped with seeds to gain bonus effects when thrown.
Dart.zh_description: 由短木杆和金属尖头简易制成，手腕轻抖就会精准地飞向目标。使用种子可以为飞镖涂药，使其对目标造成额外效果。

Dewdrop.name: dewdrop
Dewdrop.description:
A crystal clear dewdrop.

Due to the magic of this place, pure water has minor restorative properties.
Dewdrop.zh_description:
一颗晶莹剔透的露珠。

受这片区域的魔力影响，净水有着少量的治疗效果。

DimensionalSundial.name: dimensional sundial
DimensionalSundial.description: This small handheld sundial is somehow able to cast a shadow in the depths of the dungeon, even if you aren't holding it upright. Even more strangely, the shadow's position seems to have no relation to the sun in this world. When no shadow is cast, the sundial seems to attract danger.
DimensionalSundial.zh_description: 不知为何，这块小型手持式日晷能在地牢深处显影，甚至你不将其摆正也是如此。更奇怪的是，晷影的方位似乎与这个世界的太阳无关。当晷影不再显现时，日晷似乎会招致危险。

Dirk.name: dirk
Dirk.description: A longer thrusting dagger, gives a bit more steel to plunge into foes.
Dirk.zh_description: 一个长一些的刺击型匕首，可以往敌人身体里捅得更深一点。

DisplacingDart.name: displacing dart
DisplacingDart.description: These darts are tipped with a fadeleaf-based compound which will teleport their target a short distance away.
DisplacingDart.zh_description: 这些飞镖上涂着一种由消逝草制成的药物，能把目标传送走一小段距离。

DriedRose.name: dried rose
DriedRose.description: Is this the rose that the ghost mentioned before disappearing? It seems to hold some spiritual power, perhaps it can be used to channel the energy of that lost warrior.
DriedRose.zh_description: 这就是那朵在幽灵消失前被提及的玫瑰吗？它似乎拥有某种精神力量，也许能以此为媒介触及这位陨落战士的能量。

DuelistArmor.name: hero's breastplate
DuelistArmor.description: While wearing this plate armor and cape, the Duelist can perform a special ability.
DuelistArmor.zh_description: 装备这套护胸甲与披风时，决斗家能够施展一项特殊技能。

DwarfToken.name: dwarf token
DwarfToken.description: A strange shaped piece of metal that was being held by a denizen of the dwarven vault. Perhaps it is part of the magic that was binding it to the vault? Best to hold onto it, it might have some use.
DwarfToken.zh_description: 一块形状奇特的金属片，被宝库中的矮人守卫随身携带。或许这徽记也是将守卫禁锢于这座宝库的魔法的一部分？最好先带着它，或许还会有用。

ElixirOfAquaticRejuvenation.name: elixir of aquatic rejuvenation
ElixirOfAquaticRejuvenation.description: This elixir contains the remains of Goo enhanced with a healing potion. While it will not provide immediate healing, it will steadily restore a greater amount of health while you are standing in water.
ElixirOfAquaticRejuvenation.zh_description: 这瓶秘药中包含着被粘咕力量强化的治疗液体。它不会为你提供立即的治疗效果，而会当你站在水中时逐渐为你恢复总量更大的生命值。

ElixirOfArcaneArmor.name: elixir of arcane armor
ElixirOfArcaneArmor.description: This elixir will grant the drinker a long lasting resistance to magical damage.
ElixirOfArcaneArmor.zh_description: 这瓶秘药会赋予饮用者持续时间很长的魔法抗性。

ElixirOfDragonsBlood.name: elixir of dragon's blood
ElixirOfDragonsBlood.description: When consumed, this elixir will send fiery power coursing through the drinker's veins. This effect will make the drinker immune to fire, and allow them to set enemies aflame with physical attacks.
ElixirOfDragonsBlood.zh_description: 饮用后，这瓶秘药会使饮用者的血管里充斥着烈焰的力量。这个效果能让饮用者对火焰完全免疫，并且还能通过物理攻击点燃敌人。

ElixirOfFeatherFall.name: elixir of feather fall
ElixirOfFeatherFall.description: This elixir offers a weaker but more controlled levitation effect, allowing the drinker to fall great distances without harm for a little while.
ElixirOfFeatherFall.zh_description: 这瓶秘药可为你提供更弱但更可控的悬浮效果，在短时间内使你身轻如燕，即便跳下悬崖深渊也能毫发无损。饮用这瓶秘药可以为你提供短时间内免除坠落伤害的效果。

ElixirOfHoneyedHealing.name: elixir of honeyed healing
ElixirOfHoneyedHealing.description:
This elixir combines healing with the sweetness of honey. When drank, it will apply the same effect as a potion of healing and satisfy a small amount of hunger, but it can also be thrown to heal an ally.

Creatures with an affinity for honey might be pacified if this item is used on them.
ElixirOfHoneyedHealing.zh_description:
这瓶秘药不仅有着治愈效果，还混杂了蜂蜜的甜香。饮用后，它会触发与治疗药剂一样的效果并回复少量饥饿，它也能被丢出去用来治疗盟友。

对喜爱蜂蜜的生物使用此物也可能安抚住它们。

ElixirOfIcyTouch.name: elixir of icy touch
ElixirOfIcyTouch.description: When consumed, this elixir will allow the drinker to sap the heat from enemies they attack. This effect will make the drinker immune to the cold, and allow them to chill enemies with physical attacks.
ElixirOfIcyTouch.zh_description: 饮用后，这瓶秘药会使饮用者获得从敌人身上抽取热量的能力。这样的效果让使用者能够在药效持续期间免疫冻伤，同时他的物理攻击也能对敌人造成冻伤效果。

ElixirOfMight.name: elixir of might
ElixirOfMight.description: This powerful liquid will course through your muscles, permanently increasing your strength by one point and temporarily increasing maximum health by %d points. The health boost scales with your maximum health, but will slowly wear off as you gain levels.
ElixirOfMight.zh_description: 这种强力的液体会冲刷你的根骨，永久性增加1点力量值并在一段时间内增加%d点生命上限。增强的生命上限值取决于你当前的最大生命值，不过增强值会随着等级提升而逐渐消失。

ElixirOfToxicEssence.name: elixir of toxic essence
ElixirOfToxicEssence.description: When consumed, this elixir will imbue the drinker with toxic energy. The drinker will continuously spread toxic gas as they move, and will be immune to toxic gas and poison for slightly longer than the duration of the effect.
ElixirOfToxicEssence.zh_description: 这瓶秘药能够向使用者注入强大的毒素之力，饮用者在持续时间内将会在周身不断释放出致命的毒雾，此外还会在更长的一段时间内免疫毒气和毒素。

Embers.name: elemental embers
Embers.description: Special embers which can only be harvested from young fire elementals. They radiate thermal energy.
Embers.zh_description: 只能从新生火焰元素身上采集到的特殊余烬.。它们散发着温暖的能量。

EnergyCrystal.name: energy crystal
EnergyCrystal.description:
A collection of small magical crystals, filled with alchemical energy.

These crystals are the most common ingredient in alchemy recipes and can be produced at an alchemy pot by scrapping consumable items.
EnergyCrystal.zh_description:
一些小巧玲珑的能量晶体，充盈着炼金能量。

这些晶体是炼金配方中最常见的原料，可借助炼金釜从消耗品中提炼获得。

EscapeCrystal.name: escape crystal
EscapeCrystal.description: A thin magical spell crystal that seems to contain teleportation magic. You can use the crystal at any time to leave the dwarven vault, but if you leave early you won't get the full reward!
EscapeCrystal.zh_description: 一块似乎内含着传送魔法的细长棱晶。你随时都可以使用这块棱晶离开宝库，但若是提早离开的话可别想拿到最好的报酬！

EtherealChains.name: ethereal chains
EtherealChains.description: These large yet lightweight chains glow with spiritual energy. They can be used to pull you towards terrain, or pull enemies toward you. The ethereal nature of the chains even allows them to extend through walls!
EtherealChains.zh_description: 这些巨大但轻盈的锁链散发着灵魂能量。它们可以用来把你拉向一些地形，或将敌人拉向你。无实体的天然特质甚至可以允许其穿透墙壁！

ExoticCrystals.name: exotic crystals
ExoticCrystals.description: These small pink crystals have the same shape as crystals of alchemical energy. While they can't be used for energy directly, they seem to be somehow influencing the potions and scrolls you find.
ExoticCrystals.zh_description: 这些小型粉色晶体有着和炼金能量晶体一样的几何外形。尽管它们不能直接为炼金实验供能，但不知为何似乎能影响你找到的药剂和卷轴。

EyeOfNewt.name: eye of newt
EyeOfNewt.description: This golden and black newt's eye is a common ingredient, now enhanced into a trinket. The eye seems to be reducing your vision in exchange for letting you see things in other ways.
EyeOfNewt.zh_description: 这颗黑金色的蝾螈之眼是一种常见的炼金原料，而现在已被附魔强化为一件饰物。魔眼似乎降低了你的视力，以为你换取其他形式的视觉。

FerretTuft.name: ferret tuft
FerretTuft.description: A tuft of silky white ferret fur, held together by a Lime green ribbon tied into a bow. Ferrets are known for their agility, mischievousness, and lack of integrity. Some of that power seems to radiate from the trinket, enhancing the evasion of anything nearby.
FerretTuft.zh_description: 一簇银白色的雪貂丝绒，以黄绿色的蝴蝶结捆为一束。雪貂因其敏捷、顽皮与狡黠而闻名。这种力量似乎从这件饰物散发而出，加强了附近任何单位的闪避能力。

Firebomb.name: firebomb
Firebomb.description: This bomb has been modified to explode in a larger area, dealing _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and spreading sustained flame within 2 tiles.
Firebomb.zh_description: 这枚改造过的炸弹的爆炸范围更大，在2格范围内造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_并释放出持续燃烧的烈火。

FishingSpear.name: fishing spear
FishingSpear.description: Tiny throwing spears that work well as an improvised weapon despite being designed for fishing.
FishingSpear.zh_description: 本用于捕鱼，但作为武器也相当趁手的短投矛。

Flail.name: flail
Flail.description: A spiked ball attached to a handle by a length of chain. Very unwieldy, but devastating if it lands a solid hit.
Flail.zh_description: 铁链上附着的一个带刺的钢球。笨重难用，能命中的话威力极强。

FlashBangBomb.name: flashbang
FlashBangBomb.description: This customized bomb will erupt into a blast of light, sound, and electricity when it explodes. Anything within 2 tiles will take _%1$d-%2$d damage_ from the explosion, an additional 25%% damage from the electricity, and be stunned for 10 turns.
FlashBangBomb.zh_description: 这枚改造过的炸弹在爆炸时会爆发出一阵电闪雷鸣。在2格范围内的所有单位不仅会受到爆炸的_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_和电击的额外25%%伤害，还会被麻痹10回合。

Food.name: ration of food
Food.description: Nothing fancy here: dried meat, some biscuits - things like that.
Food.zh_description: 里面都是些寻常玩意：一片肉干，几块饼干——诸如此类。

ForceCube.name: force cube
ForceCube.description: These oddly-shaped magical cubes are small enough to hold in your hand, but are incredibly heavy.
ForceCube.zh_description: 这些奇形怪状的魔力方块小到可以握在你的手里，但出乎意料地非常重。

FrostBomb.name: frost bomb
FrostBomb.description: This bomb has been modified to explode in a larger area, dealing _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and spreading a sustained gust of freezing air within 2 tiles.
FrostBomb.zh_description: 这枚改造过的炸弹的爆炸范围更大，在2格范围内造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_并释放出持续冻结的冰霜。

FrozenCarpaccio.name: frozen carpaccio
FrozenCarpaccio.description: It's a piece of frozen raw meat. The only way to eat it is by cutting thin slices of it. And this way it's surprisingly good.
FrozenCarpaccio.zh_description: 这是份速冻生肉，只能切成薄片取食，而且意外的好吃。

Gauntlet.name: stone gauntlet
Gauntlet.description: This massive gauntlet is made of crimson fabric with heavy magical stone layered on top. The fabric tightens around you, making the thick stone plates almost like a second skin. Swinging such a heavy weapon requires strength, but adds tremendous force to your blows.
Gauntlet.zh_description: 这个巨大的拳套由一匹红布和层层覆盖在布上的魔法岩石交织而成。戴上后，布料紧紧裹住你的整个前臂，让厚重的岩板变得像一层坚硬的皮肤。要有足够的力量才能将如此沉重的武器自如挥舞，但正是这种力量和重量的结合让这件武器发挥出可怕的威力。

Glaive.name: glaive
Glaive.description: A massive polearm consisting of a sword blade on the end of a pole.
Glaive.zh_description: 一支在末端装有剑刃的重型长柄武器。

Gloves.name: studded gloves
Gloves.description: These studded gloves don't provide any real protection, but they act as a serviceable weapon while keeping the hands free.
Gloves.zh_description: 这双镶钉手套没有多少防护作用，但能在勉强当作武器使用的同时腾出双手。

Gold.name: gold
Gold.description: A pile of gold coins. Collect gold coins to spend them later in a shop.
Gold.zh_description: 一堆金币。收集金币以在随后的商店中消费。

GoldenKey.name: golden key
GoldenKey.description: The notches on this golden key are tiny and intricate. Perhaps it will open a locked chest?
GoldenKey.zh_description: 这把黄金钥匙的齿纹精妙而复杂。或许可以用它来打开某个上锁的宝箱？

GooBlob.name: blob of goo
GooBlob.description:
A jiggly blob of goop, split off from Goo as it died. It's almost like a big ball of jelly, though you wouldn't dare eat it.

It does nothing on its own, but it might be useful when combined with certain potions, or a bomb. At the very least it should convert into a decent amount of energy.
GooBlob.zh_description:
一团晃动着的黏糊糊球体，是从粘咕尸体上崩解下的一部分。看起来像是一个大果冻球，不过大概不能食用。

该物品自身并没有什么实际用途，不过它在与特定药剂或炸弹共炼后可能有妙用。再不济，它也能提供相当的炼金能量。

Greataxe.name: greataxe
Greataxe.description: Meant to be wielded over the shoulder, this titanic axe is as powerful as it is heavy.
Greataxe.zh_description: 这个巨型的战斧无坚不摧，重如泰山，举过肩才有空间挥舞。

Greatshield.name: greatshield
Greatshield.description: More like a mobile wall than a shield, this gigantic mass of metal aids defense, but doesn't leave much room for attacking.
Greatshield.zh_description: 与其说它是一面盾，不如说它是一堵能移动的墙。这一大块金属对于防御十分有效，但没有在攻击方面留下多少余地。

Greatsword.name: greatsword
Greatsword.description: This towering blade inflicts heavy damage by investing its heft into every swing.
Greatsword.zh_description: 这把大剑进行的每次沉重挥舞都能造成大量伤害。

Guidebook.name: tome of dungeon mastery
Guidebook.description:
An adventurer's guidebook, left here by someone who decided adventuring wasn't for them! This particular book is magical, and can prompt adventurers to read a page at the right moment.

Despite that functionality, the book is most popular because of the big words "Don't Panic!" written in large friendly letters on the cover.
Guidebook.zh_description:
一本静静躺在地上的地牢探索指南，不知被谁遗弃在此。看来冒险不是很适合它的旧主人！

这本精致而独特的书附有魔法，会在需要的时候主动提醒冒险家去翻阅它。

除去强大的功能，这本书走红的原因还有一点：它的封面上用友好而亲切的大字写着“不 要 恐 慌 ！”

GuidePage.name: torn guidebook page
GuidePage.description:
A torn page from an adventuring guidebook.

Most of the text is too small to read at a distance, but you can make out the title of the page:

_"%s"_
GuidePage.zh_description:
从一本冒险指南书上撕下来的一页。

在远处你只能看见一行行密密麻麻的小字，不过你可以看清书页上的标题：

_"%s"_

HandAxe.name: hand axe
HandAxe.description: A light axe, most commonly used for felling trees. The wide blade works well against foes as well.
HandAxe.zh_description: 一把轻斧头，通常用来砍树。当然，它的宽刃对敌人来说同样有效。

HealingDart.name: healing dart
HealingDart.description: These darts are tipped with a sungrass-based compound which grants a burst of healing to their target. The dart itself is still harmful to enemies, but will not harm allies.
HealingDart.zh_description: 这些飞镖上涂着一种由阳春草制成的药物，能强效治疗目标的伤势。这只飞镖仍能对敌人造成伤害，但不会伤及盟友 。

HeavyBoomerang.name: heavy boomerang
HeavyBoomerang.description: This large boomerang is difficult to wield effectively, but will deal considerable damage.
HeavyBoomerang.zh_description: 这把大号回旋镖笨重难用，但能造成可观的伤害。

HolyBomb.name: holy bomb
HolyBomb.description: This bomb has been modified to flash holy light in a larger area when it explodes. Anything within 2 tiles will take _%1$d-%2$d damage_ from the explosion, and undead or demonic enemies will take an additional 50%% damage from the holy light.
HolyBomb.zh_description: 这枚改造过的炸弹会在爆炸时在大范围内闪耀出圣光。在2格范围内的所有单位会受到爆炸的_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_，并且亡灵和恶魔敌人还会受到圣光的50%%额外伤害。

HolyDart.name: holy dart
HolyDart.description: These darts are tipped with a starflower-based compound which infuses holy energy into their target. Allies and regular enemies will become blessed, but undead or demonic enemies will take heavy damage. The dart itself is still harmful to enemies, but will not harm allies.
HolyDart.zh_description: 这些飞镖上涂着一种由星陨花制成的药物，能向目标体内注入神圣能量。友方或常规敌人将因此进入赐福状态，而亡灵或恶魔类敌人则会受到大量伤害。这只飞镖仍能对敌人造成伤害，但不会伤及盟友。

HolyTome.name: holy tome
HolyTome.description:
A holy tome that acts as a focus for the Cleric's divine magic. Using the tome lets the Cleric cast a variety of magical spells.

The tome will steadily get more powerful as the Cleric uses it, giving the Cleric more maximum charges and slightly increasing the recharging speed.
HolyTome.zh_description:
这本圣典能够帮助牧师引导、聚焦自身的神圣魔法，从而使牧师能够施放一系列的法术。

圣典会随着牧师的使用逐步变强，给予牧师更高的最大充能数并略微提升充能速度。

Honeypot.name: honeypot
Honeypot.description: This large honeypot is only really lined with honey, instead it houses a giant bee! These sorts of massive bees usually stay in their hives, perhaps the pot is some sort of specialized trapper's cage? The bee seems pretty content inside the pot with its honey, and buzzes at you warily when you look at it.
Honeypot.zh_description: 这个巨型蜜罐只是薄薄地涂了一圈蜂蜜，作为替代里头住着一只巨型蜜蜂！这种大型蜜蜂一般只待在蜂巢里，也许罐子本身就是某种特殊陷阱屋？蜜蜂看起来对罐子很满意，当你看向它时它非常警惕地对你回以嗡鸣。

HornOfPlenty.name: horn of plenty
HornOfPlenty.description: This horn can't be blown into, but instead seems to fill up with food as you adventure and gain experience. You can consume each charge individually as a snack, or eat until you're full.
HornOfPlenty.zh_description: 这个号角不能用于吹奏，不过会随着你深入地牢获得经验而逐渐填充食物。你可以一点点慢慢吃，也可以直接大快朵颐地吃到饱。

HuntressArmor.name: hero's cloak
HuntressArmor.description: While wearing this cloak, the Huntress can perform a special ability.
HuntressArmor.zh_description: 披着这件朴实无华的披风，女猎手能够使出一个华丽的招式。

ImpStatue.name: obsidian statuette
ImpStatue.description: A small jet-black statue carved out of obsidian. It resembles the Imp who sent you down here, it even has their glowing green eyes. There is an inscription on the base of the statue in a language you've never seen before.
ImpStatue.zh_description: 一块小小的漆黑雕塑，由黑曜石雕成。它的外表与委托你进入宝库的那位小恶魔神似，连那闪亮的绿眼睛也颇为相像。雕像的底座上用你没有见过的语言刻着一串铭文。

IncendiaryDart.name: incendiary dart
IncendiaryDart.description: These darts are tipped with a firebloom-based compound which will burst into brilliant flames on impact.
IncendiaryDart.zh_description: 这些飞镖上涂着一种由烈焰花制成的药物，命中后会燃起烈焰。

InfernalBrew.name: infernal brew
InfernalBrew.description: When shattered, this brew will unleash a raging inferno which quickly spreads like a gas.
InfernalBrew.zh_description: 当瓶子破裂时，这瓶魔药会释放出一阵像气体一样扩散的狂暴炼狱。

IronKey.name: iron key
IronKey.description: The notches on this ancient iron key are well worn; its leather lanyard is battered by age. What door might it open?
IronKey.zh_description: 这个铁钥匙的匙齿已经严重磨损；皮制系带也久经年岁摧残。它对应的是哪扇门呢?

Javelin.name: javelin
Javelin.description: These larger throwing spears are weighted to keep the spike at their tip foremost as they sail through the air.
Javelin.zh_description: 这些大号投掷用长枪上的配重保证它们会以尖端为首飞向目标。

Katana.name: katana
Katana.description: A slender sword with a large metal guard above the handle.
Katana.zh_description: 一把在握柄上方带有巨大金属护手的修长刀刃。

KingsCrown.name: Dwarf King's crown
KingsCrown.description:
The crown of the last dwarven king, it glows with tremendous magical energy.

When worn, the crown's magic will flow into the armor you're currently wearing, transforming it into a _unique epic armor with special abilities._ The new armor will keep all the properties of the original armor.
KingsCrown.zh_description:
末代矮人国王的皇冠，至强的魔法能量以光芒的形式从中辐射而出。

如果你有决心将其戴上，皇冠的魔力会涌入你正在装备的护甲，将其改造为_拥有特殊技能的独特英雄护甲_。新的护甲会保留原护甲的所有属性与刻印。

Kunai.name: kunai
Kunai.description: These small knives are very powerful in the hands of a skilled user.
Kunai.zh_description: 技巧高深者能用这种小刀造成可观的伤害。

LeatherArmor.name: leather armor
LeatherArmor.description: Armor made from tanned monster hide. Not as light as cloth armor but provides better protection.
LeatherArmor.zh_description: 用鞣制的兽皮制成的护甲。没有布甲轻，但提供更好的防御。

LiquidMetal.name: liquid metal
LiquidMetal.description:
This magical liquid can fill into the cracks and tears on a thrown weapon, restoring it to perfect condition! If a set of weapons is missing a weapon but otherwise fully repaired, then liquid metal can even be used to replace a missing weapon from the set!

A tier 1 weapon requires 10 liquid metal to be fully repaired, a tier 5 weapon requires 30. Each upgrade also increases the amount of metal needed by 35%.

Liquid metal cannot be used to repair the tips on tipped darts.
LiquidMetal.zh_description:
这种神奇的液体可以修补投掷武器的破损之处，使之焕然一新！若有一组武器完好无损但缺失其一，液金甚至可用于替换那件缺失的武器！

完全修复一件1阶武器需要10瓶液金，而一件5阶武器需要30瓶液金。武器的每级升级还会增加35%的液金需求量。

液金无法用于修复涂药飞镖的耐久度。

LloydsBeacon.name: lloyd's beacon
LloydsBeacon.description: Lloyd's beacon is an intricate magical device which grants the user control of teleportation magics. The beacon can be used to return to a set location, but can also expel bursts of random teleportation magic once it has charged from being equipped. This magic can be directed at a target or at the user themselves.
LloydsBeacon.zh_description: 时空道标是一个赋予使用者控制传送魔法能力的复杂魔法装置。该信标可以用来返回一个预定地点，但其在装备时的充能也可以用来对指定目标发射随机传送魔法。这个魔法可以针对某个目标或使用者自身。

Longsword.name: longsword
Longsword.description: This sword's long razor-sharp steel blade shines reassuringly, though its size does make it quite heavy.
Longsword.zh_description: 这柄剑的厚长利刃闪烁着令人宽心的寒光，不过这长度也确实让它非常沉重。

LostBackpack.name: lost backpack
LostBackpack.description: This is your lost inventory. Collect it to reclaim all the items you lost!
LostBackpack.zh_description: 你的遗物，包含你遗留在此的所有物品。快快重新拥有它们吧！

Mace.name: mace
Mace.description: The large iron head of this weapon inflicts substantial damage.
Mace.zh_description: 这把武器前端的大型铁头能够造成可观的伤害。

MageArmor.name: hero's robe
MageArmor.description: While wearing this gorgeous robe, the Mage can perform a special ability.
MageArmor.zh_description: 穿着这件华贵的法袍时，法师可以释放一项特殊的技能。

MagesStaff.name: mage's staff
MagesStaff.description: Crafted by the Mage himself, this staff is a unique magical weapon which can be imbued with a wand.
MagesStaff.zh_description: 这根魔杖是件独一无二的魔法武器，由法师亲自雕琢而成，能注入其它法杖的魔力以获取新的力量。

MagicalInfusion.name: magical infusion
MagicalInfusion.description:
This spell possesses the same magical power as a scroll of upgrade, but in a more stable form.

In addition to upgrading an item as normal it will never erase an enchantment, glyph, or curse.
MagicalInfusion.zh_description:
这个菱晶蕴含着和升级卷轴同样强大的魔力，不过这种魔力更为稳定。

这个菱晶在升级物品的同时不会消除上面的附魔、刻印或诅咒。

MailArmor.name: mail armor
MailArmor.description: Interlocking metal links make for a tough but flexible suit of armor.
MailArmor.zh_description: 由金属链环环相扣制成的一套结实又不失灵活的护甲。

MasterThievesArmband.name: master thieves' armband
MasterThievesArmband.description: This purple velvet armband bears the mark of a master thief. This doesn't belong to you, but it probably didn't belong to its last user either.
MasterThievesArmband.zh_description: 这个紫色的天鹅绒袖标是盗贼大师的标志。它不属于你，但它也不属于你拿到这个袖标时击败的人。

MeatPie.name: meat pie
MeatPie.description: A delicious pie filled with savoury meat. This will satiate you far more than any other meal.
MeatPie.zh_description: 一份填满了美味肉馅的诱人大饼。吃下它后你会获得远高于其他食物的饱足感。

MetalShard.name: cursed metal shard
MetalShard.description:
A shard of rusted cursed metal, which broke off DM-300 as it was destroyed. You can feel an inactive malevolent magic within it.

It does nothing on its own, but it might be useful when combined with certain scrolls, or a bomb. At the very least it should convert into a decent amount of energy.
MetalShard.zh_description:
一块被诅咒的金属锈片，它是DM-300的装甲外壳被击碎时分离出来的。你能感受到某种尚未激活的恶毒魔力潜藏其中。

该物品自身并没有什么实际用途，不过它在与特定卷轴或炸弹共炼时可能有妙用。再不济，它也能提供相当的炼金能量。

MimicTooth.name: mimic tooth
MimicTooth.description: This large sharp tooth must have been pulled from a very unhappy mimic. It seems to be influencing the mimics of the dungeon, making them more frequent and dangerous.
MimicTooth.zh_description: 这颗大尖牙肯定是强行从某个非常倒霉的宝箱怪口中拔下来的。它似乎能影响地牢中的宝箱怪，使它们更常见，也更危险。

MossyClump.name: mossy clump
MossyClump.description: This clump of wet moss seems to hold onto its moisture no matter how hard you squeeze it. It seems to be magically tied to the dungeon itself, making grass and water more likely to appear.
MossyClump.zh_description: 无论你如何用力挤压它，这团潮湿的苔藓似乎都能保持其水分。它似乎通过魔法与地牢本身形成链接，促使草木流水频繁出现。

Noisemaker.name: noisemaker
Noisemaker.description: This customized bomb will repeatedly make noise when its fuse runs out. When something touches the bomb, it will explode and deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_ to anything within 2 tiles!
Noisemaker.zh_description: 这枚改造过的炸弹会周而复始地发出噪音，直到其引信燃烧殆尽。当有什么东西碰到炸弹时，炸弹会爆炸并在2格范围内对所有单位造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_！

ParalyticDart.name: paralytic dart
ParalyticDart.description: These darts are tipped with an earthroot-based compound which will paralyze their target for a short time.
ParalyticDart.zh_description: 这些飞镖上涂着一种由地缚根制成的药物，能让目标无助地麻痹一小段时间。

ParchmentScrap.name: parchment scrap
ParchmentScrap.description: This little scrap of parchment looks like it came from a scroll. It has retained some of its magic, and it seems to be influencing weapons and armor found in the dungeon.
ParchmentScrap.zh_description: 这块小小的羊皮纸残片看起来来自一张卷轴。它仍附有一丝残存的魔力，并且似乎能影响在地牢中找到的武器和护甲。

Pasty.name: pasty
Pasty.description: An authentic Cornish pasty with a traditional filling of beef and potato. Delicious!
Pasty.zh_description: 这是份正宗康郡肉馅饼，内含牛肉加土豆的传统馅料。美味十足！

PetrifiedSeed.name: petrified seed
PetrifiedSeed.description: This seed has been fossilised, either by slow geological processes or by magic. The seed seems to be magically influencing the flora of the dungeon, occasionally replacing plant seeds with runestones.
PetrifiedSeed.zh_description: 这粒种子在缓慢的地质作用或法术作用的影响下石化了。它似乎通过魔法影响着地牢的植物群系，时不时使种子转化为符石。

PhantomMeat.name: phantom meat
PhantomMeat.description: A large glistening translucent steak, cut from a phantom piranha. This magical meat doesn't need to be cooked and grants a number of defensive benefits in addition to fully satiating you. When eaten it will grant invisibility, barkskin, some healing, and cures many harmful effects.
PhantomMeat.zh_description: 这块从幻影食人鱼身上切下的大块鱼肉呈半透明状，闪烁着奇光。这块充满魔力的肉无须烹饪即可食用，不但能完全填饱你的肚子，而且能赋予多种防御性增益。食用后，它会为你提供隐形、树肤和少量治疗，并净化大部分有害效果。

PhaseShift.name: phase shift
PhaseShift.description: This chaotic spell will teleport any character it is aimed at to a random location on the current floor, and stun them for a significant amount of time. Powerful foes will be able to resist the stunning effect. This spell can be directed at a target or at the user themselves.
PhaseShift.zh_description: 这个充满混沌能量的结晶会将目标单位传送到本层随机位置。被传送的角色会被麻痹相当长的一段时间，而足够强大的敌人则可抵抗该效果。这个结晶可以对目标单位或施法者自身使用。

Pickaxe.name: pickaxe
Pickaxe.description: This is a sturdy and heavy tool for breaking rocks. You don't need to equip the pickaxe to mine with it, but it can probably be equipped as a weapon in a pinch.
Pickaxe.zh_description: 这是一件笨重但十分耐用的凿岩工具。不需要装备上就能作为挖掘工具使用，但在紧要关头也能作为武器装备。

PlateArmor.name: plate armor
PlateArmor.description: Enormous plates of metal are joined together into a suit that provides unmatched protection to any adventurer strong enough to bear its staggering weight.
PlateArmor.zh_description: 厚重的金属板拼接到一起，为能承受其骇人重量的冒险家提供无与伦比的防御。

PoisonDart.name: poison dart
PoisonDart.description: These darts are tipped with a sorrowmoss-based compound which will poison their target.
PoisonDart.zh_description: 这些飞镖上涂着一种由断肠苔制成的药物，能使目标中毒。

PotionOfCleansing.name: potion of cleansing
PotionOfCleansing.description: Drinking immediately removes cleansable negative buffs and grants _5 turns of Cleansing_, preventing those buffs during that time. Throwing grants the same effect to the character at the impact tile. It does not heal, remove equipment curses or clear environmental fields. Corruption and Lost Inventory retain their original exceptions.
PotionOfCleansing.zh_description: 饮用后立即清除可净化的负面状态，并获得_5回合净化保护_，期间免疫可净化的负面状态。也可以投掷，为落点角色提供相同效果。不恢复生命、不移除装备诅咒，也不清除周围环境；腐化和遗失背包沿用原版特殊例外。

PotionOfCorrosiveGas.name: potion of corrosive gas
PotionOfCorrosiveGas.description: Uncorking or shattering the bottle releases spreading corrosive gas, applying _Corrosion whose damage increases each turn_. The gas also affects the thrower and ignores armor.
PotionOfCorrosiveGas.zh_description: 打开或摔碎药瓶会释放扩散的腐蚀酸雾，施加_伤害逐回合增长的腐蚀效果_。酸雾也会影响投掷者，无法用护甲抵挡。

PotionOfDivineInspiration.name: potion of divine inspiration
PotionOfDivineInspiration.description:
The power of holy energy reduced to liquid form, this draught will imbue the drinker with divine power, granting them two bonus talent points in a tier of their choosing.

This potion can only be used once for each talent tier.
PotionOfDivineInspiration.zh_description:
这股神圣的力量会化作液态，灌注进饮用者的身体，赋予其钟意的天赋两个额外天赋点。

这种药剂对每一层天赋只能生效一次。

PotionOfDragonsBreath.name: potion of dragon's breath
PotionOfDragonsBreath.description: Drink and choose a direction to breathe a _60-degree cone up to 6 tiles_, igniting targets and crippling them for _5 turns_. It deals no immediate direct damage. Burning lasts _8 base turns_ and uses the normal burning damage rules. Flames open doors and ignite their path, avoiding nonflammable tiles beside the caster. Cancelling targeting consumes nothing; throwing only splashes.
PotionOfDragonsBreath.zh_description: 饮用后选择方向，喷出最远_6格、60度_的火锥，点燃目标并施加_5回合残废_。不造成即时直接伤害；燃烧基础持续_8回合_，伤害沿用燃烧规则。火焰会打开门并引燃路径，紧邻自身的非可燃格不会直接起火。取消选取不消耗药剂；投掷仅产生普通泼洒。

PotionOfEarthenArmor.name: potion of earthen armor
PotionOfEarthenArmor.description: Drinking grants Barkskin that initially blocks a _fixed 8 extra physical attack damage_, stacking with equipped armor. Protection decreases by _1 point every 3 turns_ until it reaches zero. It does not block magic or damage over time. Drinking again refreshes protection to 8 without stacking.
PotionOfEarthenArmor.zh_description: 饮用后获得树肤，初始额外_固定抵挡8点物理攻击伤害_，与装备护甲共同生效。每过_3回合_抵挡值衰减_1点_，降至0时消失。不抵挡魔法或持续伤害；再次饮用刷新至8点，不叠加。

PotionOfExperience.name: potion of experience
PotionOfExperience.description: The storied experiences of multitudes of battles reduced to liquid form, this draught will instantly raise your experience level.
PotionOfExperience.zh_description: 众多战斗积累而来的经验被浓缩为液态，这种药剂能够瞬间提升你的等级。

PotionOfFrost.name: potion of frost
PotionOfFrost.description: When exposed to air, this chemical evaporates into a cloud of freezing mist.
PotionOfFrost.zh_description: 一旦暴露在空气里，这种化学药剂会挥发成为一片冰冷的气雾。

PotionOfHaste.name: potion of haste
PotionOfHaste.description: Drinking this strangely sweet liquid releases a surge of energy through your body, increasing your movement speed by 200% for 10 turns.
PotionOfHaste.zh_description: 喝下这甜到掉牙的奇怪液体后，体内会爆发一股巨大的能量，让你10回合内移动速度增加200%。

PotionOfHealing.name: potion of healing
PotionOfHealing.description:
Drinking this potion grants a healing effect for 20 turns, restoring 2 HP each turn. The effect ends immediately when you are hit by an attack or take effective damage.

Drinking a potion of healing also removes some basic negative effects.
PotionOfHealing.zh_description:
饮用后获得20回合治疗效果，每回合恢复2点生命。受到攻击命中或有效伤害时，治疗效果立即消失。

饮用治疗药剂还能消除一些基础的负面状态。

PotionOfInvisibility.name: potion of invisibility
PotionOfInvisibility.description: Drinking this potion makes you invisible for 10 turns. Enemies cannot see you while you are invisible. Physical attacks or magical effects, such as using scrolls or wands, immediately end invisibility.
PotionOfInvisibility.zh_description: 饮用这种药剂会使你隐形10回合。隐形期间，敌人将无法看见你。使用物理攻击或魔法效果(例如使用卷轴或法杖)，会立即解除隐形效果。

PotionOfLevitation.name: potion of levitation
PotionOfLevitation.description: Drinking this curious potion makes you float in the air, allowing you to cross traps and chasms with ease. Throwing it creates a cloud of unrefined gas that disorients all creatures within it.
PotionOfLevitation.zh_description: 饮用这种古怪的药剂能让你漂浮到空中，从而轻易地越过陷阱和深渊。扔出它会产生一片未被提纯的气体云雾，让其中的所有生物迷失方向。

PotionOfLiquidFlame.name: potion of liquid flame
PotionOfLiquidFlame.description: This bottle contains an unstable compound that bursts into fierce flames when exposed to air.
PotionOfLiquidFlame.zh_description: 该药瓶里装着一种不稳定的化合物，一旦暴露在空气中就会猛烈地燃烧起来。

PotionOfMagicalSight.name: potion of magical sight
PotionOfMagicalSight.description: Drinking grants _10 turns of Magical Sight_, revealing terrain and objects through walls within a _6-tile radius_, and removing and preventing blindness.
PotionOfMagicalSight.zh_description: 饮用后获得_10回合魔能透视_，能看穿_6格范围_内的墙壁与地形，洞察墙后的事物，并解除、免疫致盲。

PotionOfMastery.name: potion of mastery
PotionOfMastery.description:
Rather than granting raw strength, this potion will instead attune the muscles of the user to a particular item. This will make that item easier to use, as if the drinker had practised with it and built muscle memory.

The chosen weapon or armor will require 2 less strength to use. This potion can only be used once on each item.
PotionOfMastery.zh_description:
这个合剂不会直接增强你的力量，但却会为你建立使用特定物品的肌肉记忆。使你对其的运用更加得心应手，仿佛已经练习了千百遍。

所选武器或护甲所需要的力量减少2点。此合剂在每个物品上只能使用一次。

PotionOfMindVision.name: potion of mind vision
PotionOfMindVision.description: Drinking this potion attunes your mind to nearby creatures across a wide area, allowing you to sense their locations through walls for 5 turns. It also allows your vision to pass through nearby walls and doors.
PotionOfMindVision.zh_description: 喝下这个，你的心智将与大范围内的生物精神同调，让你在5回合内能感受到围墙背后的生物所在。该药剂还能够让你的视野无视身边门墙的阻挡。

PotionOfParalyticGas.name: potion of paralytic gas
PotionOfParalyticGas.description: When exposed to air, the liquid in this flask evaporates into a yellow cloud of incapacitating gas. Any creature that inhales it is immediately paralyzed for 5 turns, unable to act until some time after the gas disperses. Throw it at a distant group of enemies to engulf them in the cloud.
PotionOfParalyticGas.zh_description: 暴露于空气时，烧瓶里的液体会气化成一片令人失去知觉的黄色云雾。任何吸入气体的生物会被立即麻痹5回合，直到气体消散后一段时间才能行动。可以把该物件扔到远处的敌群中，让气体覆盖影响它们。

PotionOfPurity.name: potion of purity
PotionOfPurity.description: This magical reagent quickly neutralizes harmful environmental effects over a wide area. Drinking it grants immunity to these effects for 20 turns.
PotionOfPurity.zh_description: 这种魔法试剂能迅速中和掉大范围内的各种有害环境。饮用它将使你在20回合内暂时免疫这种环境。

PotionOfShielding.name: potion of shielding
PotionOfShielding.description: Drinking grants _20 points of Barrier_ to absorb damage. The shield gradually decays over time as in the original game. Drinking again restores ordinary shielding to at least 20 points without stacking; larger existing shields are preserved.
PotionOfShielding.zh_description: 饮用后获得_20点奥术护盾_，抵挡受到的伤害，并按原版规则随时间逐渐衰减。再次饮用会将普通护盾补至至少20点，不叠加；已有更高护盾会保留。

PotionOfShroudingFog.name: potion of shrouding fog
PotionOfShroudingFog.description: Throwing releases a spreading fog that _blocks both players' sight_, including the thrower's view of their opponent. Fog deals no damage and does not block movement or projectiles. It gradually dissipates over turns. Mind Vision can still sense characters through the fog.
PotionOfShroudingFog.zh_description: 投掷后释放一团持续扩散的浓雾，_遮挡双方视野_，投掷者也无法透过迷雾看见对手。迷雾不造成伤害，不阻挡移动或投射物，并随回合逐渐消散。灵视仍可感知迷雾中的角色。

PotionOfSnapFreeze.name: potion of snap freeze
PotionOfSnapFreeze.description: Once exposed to air, this mixture immediately freezes and roots targets on non-solid cells in a 3x3 area around the impact. Freezes for _5 turns_ on land or _10 turns_ in water, and roots for _5 turns_.
PotionOfSnapFreeze.zh_description: 一旦暴露在空气里，这种化学混合物会立即冻结并缠绕落点周围3×3范围内非墙格上的目标。地面冻结_5回合_，水中冻结_10回合_，缠绕_5回合_。

PotionOfStamina.name: potion of stamina
PotionOfStamina.description: Drinking grants _20 turns of Stamina_, increasing movement speed by _50%_ without changing attack or other action times. Drinking again refreshes the duration without stacking movement speed.
PotionOfStamina.zh_description: 饮用后获得_20回合体力充沛_，移动速度提升_50%_，不影响攻击或其他行动的耗时。再次饮用刷新持续时间，不叠加移动速度。

PotionOfStormClouds.name: potion of storm clouds
PotionOfStormClouds.description: Throwing releases spreading rain clouds. Rain floods suitable terrain into water, extinguishes fire and destroys traps. It deals _1 + floor(depth / 5)_ base damage per turn to _fiery targets_. Ordinary targets take no direct rain-cloud damage.
PotionOfStormClouds.zh_description: 投掷后释放持续扩散的雨云。降雨会将可淹没地形变成水潭，熄灭火焰并淹毁陷阱。对_火属性目标_每回合造成_1＋楼层深度÷5（向下取整）_点基础伤害；普通目标不会直接受到雨云伤害。

PotionOfStrength.name: potion of strength
PotionOfStrength.description: This powerful liquid will course through your muscles, permanently increasing your strength by one point.
PotionOfStrength.zh_description: 这种强力的液体会洗刷你的肌肉，永久性增加1点力量值。

PotionOfToxicGas.name: potion of toxic gas
PotionOfToxicGas.description: Opening or shattering this sealed bottle releases a cloud of highly toxic green gas. You should throw it at enemies from a distance rather than open it by hand.
PotionOfToxicGas.zh_description: 打开或摔碎这个密封的药瓶将导致内容物爆发成一团剧毒的绿色云雾。你应该选择从远处将这瓶药剂扔向敌人，而不是手动开封。

Quarterstaff.name: quarterstaff
Quarterstaff.description: A staff of hardwood, its ends are shod with iron.
Quarterstaff.zh_description: 这是两端以铁包覆的硬木棍。

Rapier.name: rapier
Rapier.description: A slim straight sword that offers some protection in exchange for less slashing power.
Rapier.zh_description: 一柄修长而笔直的利器，牺牲了部分劈砍能力而获得一定的保护效果。

RatSkull.name: rat skull
RatSkull.description: This macabre trinket isn't much larger than the skull of a normal rat, which is somehow a rarity down in this dungeon. The skull's magical influence seems to attract the more rare denizens of the dungeon, making them appear far more often.
RatSkull.zh_description: 这件可怕的饰物并不比正常老鼠的头骨大多少，但不知为何在这个地牢却很稀有。头骨的魔力似乎能吸引更多稀有的地牢住民，使它们更有可能出现。

ReclaimTrap.name: reclaim trap
ReclaimTrap.description:
This spell contains remnants of the mechanical energy of DM-300. When cast on an active trap, the power of the trap will become attached to you, allowing you to use the spell again to expel this power and trigger the trap's effect at any location you like.

However, some traps may not function in all places, and only one trap can be stored at a time.
ReclaimTrap.zh_description:
这个晶柱蕴含着DM-300残余的机械能量。当对一个未触发的陷阱使用时，陷阱的力量会附着在你身上，使你能再次使用晶柱以释放这股力量并在你指定的任何位置触发此陷阱的效果。

不过，有的陷阱并不能在任何位置都生效，而且晶柱一次只能储存一个陷阱。

Recycle.name: recycle
Recycle.description: This spell contains a lesser form of transmutation magic. While it won't work on equipment, this spell will transform a scroll, potion, seed, runestone, or tipped dart into a random item of the same type.
Recycle.zh_description: 这个菱晶蕴含着弱化的嬗变魔力。虽然不能对装备使用，但它能将卷轴、药剂、种子、符石或涂药飞镖转换为一个随机的同类物品。

RegrowthBomb.name: regrowth bomb
RegrowthBomb.description: This customized bomb will splash life-giving liquid everywhere within 3 tiles instead of exploding. The area caught in the blast will rapidly sprout grass and plants. Yourself and any allies caught in the blast will be healed as if they had drank a potion of healing.
RegrowthBomb.zh_description: 这枚改造过的炸弹不会爆炸，而会在3格范围内四处溅射再生药液。被药液影响的区域会迅速生长出草木与植物，而你自己和爆炸范围内的所有盟友都会受到如同饮用治疗药剂般的治疗效果。

RingOfAccuracy.name: ring of accuracy
RingOfAccuracy.description: This ring increases your focus, making it easier for your attacks to find their mark. A cursed ring will instead make it harder for your attacks to connect.
RingOfAccuracy.zh_description: 这枚戒指提高了你的专注力，使敌人难以躲闪你的攻击。被诅咒的戒指则会让你的攻击更易于被闪避。

RingOfArcana.name: ring of arcana
