RingOfArcana.description: This ring enhances magical enchantments on weapons and glyphs on armor, including curses! It first increases activation chance, and then increases the strength of the effect once activation chance is 100%. A cursed ring will instead weaken enchantments, glyphs, and curses.
RingOfArcana.zh_description: 这枚戒指增强了武器上的附魔和护甲上的刻印，也包括诅咒！戒指会先提高它们的触发概率，当触发概率达到100%时，会转而增加它们效果的强度。被诅咒的戒指则会反过来削弱附魔、刻印以及诅咒。

RingOfElements.name: ring of elements
RingOfElements.description: This ring provides resistance to most elemental and magical effects, decreasing damage and debuff duration. Naturally a cursed ring will instead worsen these effects.
RingOfElements.zh_description: 这枚戒指能为佩戴者提供抗性，降低大部分元素和魔法效果的伤害和持续时间。被诅咒的戒指自然会加重这些效果。

RingOfEnergy.name: ring of energy
RingOfEnergy.description: Your magical equipment will recharge more quickly in the arcane field that radiates from this ring. A cursed ring will instead slow recharge.
RingOfEnergy.zh_description: 在戒指的奥术领域笼罩下，你持有的所有魔法装备充能速度都会得到提升。被诅咒的戒指反而会减慢充能速度。

RingOfEvasion.name: ring of evasion
RingOfEvasion.description: This ring quickens the wearer's reactions, making it harder to land blows on them. A cursed ring will instead make the user easier to strike.
RingOfEvasion.zh_description: 这枚戒指会加快佩戴者的反应速度，令其更难被敌人击中。被诅咒的戒指反而会让佩戴者更容易被击中。

RingOfForce.name: ring of force
RingOfForce.description: This ring enhances the force of the wearer's melee blows. This extra power is fairly weak when wielding weapons, but an unarmed attack will be made much stronger. A cursed ring will instead weaken the wearer's blows.
RingOfForce.zh_description: 这枚戒指能够增强佩戴者的打击力度。这份额外的力量在挥舞武器时相当有限，而徒手攻击则会被大幅增强。被诅咒的戒指会导致佩戴者的攻击变得软弱无力。

RingOfFuror.name: ring of furor
RingOfFuror.description: This ring grants the wearer an inner fury, allowing them to attack more rapidly. A cursed ring will instead slow the wearer's speed of attack.
RingOfFuror.zh_description: 这枚戒指会激发佩戴者内心的怒火，使其能够更迅猛地攻击。被诅咒的戒指则会导致佩戴者攻击迟缓。

RingOfHaste.name: ring of haste
RingOfHaste.description: This ring reduces the stress of movement on the wearer, allowing them to run at superhuman speeds. A cursed ring will instead weigh the wearer down.
RingOfHaste.zh_description: 这枚戒指减轻了佩戴者在移动时的负担，使其能够飞速奔跑。被诅咒的戒指则会使佩戴者倍感沉重。

RingOfMight.name: ring of might
RingOfMight.description: This ring enhances the physical traits of the wearer, granting them greater physical strength and constitution. A cursed ring will weaken the wearer.
RingOfMight.zh_description: 这枚戒指会增强佩戴者的体质，使其拥有更强的力量与体格。被诅咒的戒指则会使人虚弱。

RingOfSharpshooting.name: ring of sharpshooting
RingOfSharpshooting.description: This ring enhances the wearer's precision and aim, which will make all projectile weapons more damaging and durable. A cursed ring will have the opposite effect.
RingOfSharpshooting.zh_description: 这枚戒指会加强佩戴者的瞄准能力，使投掷武器变得更加致命且耐用。被诅咒的戒指则会起反作用。

RingOfTenacity.name: ring of tenacity
RingOfTenacity.description: When worn, this ring will allow the wearer to resist normally mortal strikes. The more injured the user is, the more resistant they will be to damage. A cursed ring will instead make it easier for enemies to execute the wearer.
RingOfTenacity.zh_description: 这枚戒指使佩戴者能够抵御本应致命的打击。佩戴者受伤越重，对伤害的抗性就越高。被诅咒的戒指则会让敌人更容易杀死佩戴者。

RingOfWealth.name: ring of wealth
RingOfWealth.description: This ring acts like a magnet for treasure, increasing the likelihood that enemies and containers will be carrying valuable items. A cursed ring will instead reduce your chance of receiving loot.
RingOfWealth.zh_description: 这枚戒指有如磁石般的招财功效，佩戴者有更大的机率从敌人身上或各类宝箱中取得较有价值的道具。被诅咒的戒指反而会降低发现宝物的可能性。

RogueArmor.name: hero's garb
RogueArmor.description: While wearing this dark garb, the Rogue can perform a special ability.
RogueArmor.zh_description: 裹着这身与黑暗融为一体的斗篷时，盗贼能够施展一项特殊技能。

RotDart.name: rot dart
RotDart.description: These wicked darts are tipped with an acidic rotberry-based compound, which will aggressively eat through anything the dart comes into contact with. Powerful foes will resist most of the effect, but the corrosion is strong enough to easily kill most standard enemies. These last longer than other tipped darts, but their durability cannot be boosted.
RotDart.zh_description: 这种恶毒的飞镖上涂着一种由腐莓制成的酸蚀毒膏，能够蚀穿飞镖触及的任何事物。其上的蚀毒异常强大，寻常敌人触之即死，但强敌可消去其大半功效。相较于其他涂药飞镖，这类飞镖上的涂药药效更加耐用，但其耐用度无法被外力进一步提升。

RoundShield.name: round shield
RoundShield.description: This large shield effectively blocks attacks and makes a decent weapon in a pinch.
RoundShield.zh_description: 这个大盾可以有效格挡攻击，在危机时刻也可以作为不错的武器使用。

RunicBlade.name: runic blade
RunicBlade.description: A mysterious weapon from a distant land, with a bright blue blade.
RunicBlade.zh_description: 来自失落之地的神秘武器，有着明亮的蓝色刀刃。

Sai.name: sai
Sai.description: Two thin blades meant to be wielded in one hand each. Excellent for tearing down enemies with a flurry of cuts.
Sai.zh_description: 一对轻薄的铁刃，刚好一手一把。在快速斩击方面十分出色。

SaltCube.name: salt cube
SaltCube.description: This large salt crystal was cut into an almost perfect cube shape, and it somehow managed to drain half the water from the alchemy pot instead of dissolving. It seems to be magically dehydrating and preserving the food you eat, extending the satiety you get, but also lessening your health restoration when not starving.
SaltCube.zh_description: 这块巨大的盐晶被切割成近乎完美的立方体，而不知为何盐晶成功吸收了炼金釜中一半的水分而非溶解于其中。它似乎通过魔法脱水并保存了你所吃的食物，延长了你所得的饱腹感，但也减少了你不空腹时的生命回复。

SandalsOfNature.name: sandals of nature
SandalsOfNature.description: What initially seem like sandals made of twine are actually two plants! They seem very weak and pale, perhaps they need to be given nutrients?
SandalsOfNature.zh_description: 初看像是用麻绳编成的草履实际上是两株植物！它们看上去既虚弱又苍白，也许它们需要一点营养？

ScaleArmor.name: scale armor
ScaleArmor.description: The metal scales sewn onto a leather vest create a flexible, yet protective armor.
ScaleArmor.zh_description: 在厚实的皮背心中缝入金属鳞片，形成了灵活而高防御的护甲。

Scimitar.name: scimitar
Scimitar.description: A thick curved blade. Its shape allows for faster, yet less powerful attacks.
Scimitar.zh_description: 一把厚重的弯刀。它的形状能让它进行更快但不甚强力的攻击。

ScrollOfAntiMagic.name: scroll of anti-magic
ScrollOfAntiMagic.description: The incantation on this scroll will surround you with a magical aura that temporarily blocks all magical effects, harmful or helpful. This includes most magical item effects such as wands, scrolls, rings, artifacts, enchantments, and curses. Heroic armor abilities are strong enough to work regardless however.
ScrollOfAntiMagic.zh_description: 使用这张秘卷会让你被包裹在一个能够屏蔽所有魔法效果的魔力结界中，无论它是有利或是有害。屏蔽效果包括大多数魔法物品效果，例如法杖、卷轴、戒指、神器、附魔与诅咒。特别地，英雄护甲技能足够强大，因而能够不受该秘卷的限制。

ScrollOfChallenge.name: scroll of challenge
ScrollOfChallenge.description:
When read aloud, this scroll will unleash a great roar that draws enemies to the user while simultaneously creating a small arena around them.

As long as the reader stays in this arena they will take 33% less damage from all sources (this is applied before other forms of damage reduction), and they will not lose satiety.

The size of the arena will scale with the size of the area the reader is in. It will be particularly small in some boss areas.
ScrollOfChallenge.zh_description:
大声诵读此卷轴时，它将发出巨大的吼声，将敌人吸引到诵读者身边，同时在它们周围创建一个小型的竞技场。

只要使用者在这个竞技场里，就将获得33%的伤害减免(在其它所有伤害减免计算之前)，并且不会损失饱食度。

竞技场的大小将随着诵读者所在区域的大小而改变。在一些Boss战区域，竞技场会格外的小。

ScrollOfDivination.name: scroll of divination
ScrollOfDivination.description: This scroll will randomly identify four types of item that you don't currently know. The types identified can be a potion's color, a scroll's rune, or a ring's gem. The items identified won't necessarily be ones you're carrying.
ScrollOfDivination.zh_description: 这张秘卷会随机鉴定四种你尚未明确的道具。它可能帮你鉴定出某药剂的颜色，某卷轴的符文，或是某戒指的宝石。不过被鉴定的道具未必是你包裹中有的。

ScrollOfDread.name: scroll of dread
ScrollOfDread.description:
When read, this scroll will emit a flash of red light that will instill incredible terror in all enemies in your field of view. So great is this effect that they will rapidly try to flee from the entire dungeon, never to be seen again!

Just like with terror, this effect can expire with time, or if the enemy is attacked.

Strong-willed enemies, such as bosses, will be inflicted with regular terror instead.
ScrollOfDread.zh_description:
诵读的时候，梦魇秘卷会爆射出一道极度可怖的红色闪光，其中的杀气仿佛已经凝成实体。这足以令你视野中所有的敌人吓得魂飞魄散，不顾一切地想要逃离这座地牢，永远也不回来了！

与恐惧效果一样，逃命的敌人也会随着时间流逝逐渐冷静下来，来自外界的伤害更能加速这一过程。

意志坚定的敌人，比如Boss们，将能抵抗逃命的冲动，但仍会感到恐惧。

ScrollOfEnchantment.name: scroll of enchantment
ScrollOfEnchantment.description: This scroll will infuse a weapon or armor with powerful magical energy. The reader even has some degree of control over which magic is imbued.
ScrollOfEnchantment.zh_description: 这张秘卷可以为武器或护甲注入强大的魔力。使用者甚至可以在一定程度上选择注入哪种魔力。

ScrollOfForesight.name: scroll of foresight
ScrollOfForesight.description: After reading this scroll, the detail of nearby terrain will be constantly fed to the reader's mind in crystal clarity. This effect lasts for a considerable amount of time, and will reveal all hidden doors or traps, making searching unnecessary.
ScrollOfForesight.zh_description: 在阅读了这幅卷轴后，附近地形的细节将自发不断地映入阅读者的脑海。这种效果会持续相当长的一段时间，并且会揭示所有的隐藏门与陷阱，不再需要主动搜索。

ScrollOfIdentify.name: scroll of identify
ScrollOfIdentify.description: All items are already identified. Reading consumes one scroll and plays the original reading animation and effects.
ScrollOfIdentify.zh_description: 该卷轴能永久揭示一件物品的所有秘密。

ScrollOfLullaby.name: scroll of lullaby
ScrollOfLullaby.description: Reading this scroll releases a soothing melody that sends all creatures who hear it into magical sleep. While in magical sleep, players and allied creatures recover an additional 1 HP each turn.
ScrollOfLullaby.zh_description: 阅读这张卷轴会释放出一段舒缓的旋律，让所有听到它的生物深陷魔法睡眠。进入魔法睡眠会使玩家和友方生物每回合额外恢复1点生命值。

ScrollOfMagicMapping.name: scroll of magic mapping
ScrollOfMagicMapping.description: When this scroll is read, an image of crystal clarity will be etched into your memory, alerting you to the precise layout of the level and revealing all hidden secrets. The locations of items and creatures will remain unknown.
ScrollOfMagicMapping.zh_description: 阅读这张卷轴时，一副明晰的景象会刻入你的记忆中，告知你整个楼层的精确布局并揭开所有隐藏的秘密。不过道具位置和生物分布依旧是未知状态。

ScrollOfMetamorphosis.name: scroll of metamorphosis
ScrollOfMetamorphosis.description:
This scroll contains powerful transmutation magic, which will apply to the caster instead of to an item. The magic of this scroll will let you select one talent, and replace it with one of five talents of the same tier from different hero classes!

This effect can only apply to class talents, not talents gained from subclasses or armor abilities. Talents that you cannot use will not be given as options.
ScrollOfMetamorphosis.zh_description:
这张秘卷充满了嬗变的魔力，不过与一般的嬗变卷轴不同。这股魔力将作用于释放者本身而不是一个物品。秘卷的魔力将允许你蜕变一个自身的天赋，使其转化为来自其他英雄的五个同层天赋之一！

这个效果只适用于英雄自身的天赋，对专精天赋与护甲天赋无效。那些你无法使用的天赋将不会出现在蜕变选项里。

ScrollOfMirrorImage.name: scroll of mirror image
ScrollOfMirrorImage.description: The incantation on this scroll creates two mirror images of the user. These weaker clones pursue enemies, but are extremely fragile and vanish instantly upon taking damage. The images keep their equipped weapon synchronized with the user's.
ScrollOfMirrorImage.zh_description: 卷轴上的咒文会创造使用者的两个镜像。这些像使用者的弱化版克隆体的镜像会对敌人展开追杀。不过镜像非常脆弱，受到伤害就会瞬间消散。镜像会同步装备使用者的武器。

ScrollOfMysticalEnergy.name: scroll of mystical energy
ScrollOfMysticalEnergy.description: The raw magical power bound up in this parchment will, when released, charge a user's equipped artifacts over time.
ScrollOfMysticalEnergy.zh_description: 奇异的魔法能量被禁锢在秘卷羊皮纸内，当这股能量被释放时会在短时间内持续为阅读者的所有神器充能。

ScrollOfPassage.name: scroll of passage
ScrollOfPassage.description: The spell on this parchment instantly transports the reader to the nearest region first floor above them. Very handy for quickly getting to a shop.
ScrollOfPassage.zh_description: 这张羊皮纸上的咒语能瞬间将读者传送到楼上与之距离最近的区域首层。想去商店的话，用这张秘卷会非常方便。

ScrollOfPrismaticImage.name: scroll of prismatic image
ScrollOfPrismaticImage.description:
The incantation on this scroll will create a colorful illusory twin of the reader. This prismatic image acts as a weaker clone of the reader, with similar defence but lower hp and damage.

The prismatic image will show itself when enemies are present, and will attempt to defend the reader.

If a prismatic image already exists, using this scroll will fully heal it.
ScrollOfPrismaticImage.zh_description:
这张秘卷上的咒文会创造使用者的一个虹光守卫。这个像使用者的弱化版克隆体的幻像有着相同的防御，但生命值和造成的伤害更低。

虹光守卫将吸引敌人的火力从而保护使用者。

当虹光守卫存在时阅读这张秘卷将会为其恢复所有生命。

ScrollOfPsionicBlast.name: scroll of psionic blast
ScrollOfPsionicBlast.description:
This scroll contains incredible destructive energy that can be channeled to destroy the minds of all visible creatures.

There is significant feedback however, and the reader will also be damaged, blinded, and weakened. The more targets the scroll hits, the less self-damage will be taken.
ScrollOfPsionicBlast.zh_description:
这张秘卷封存着惊人的毁灭性能量，一旦被释放出来可摧毁视野内所有生物的心智。

然而，使用者也会遭受灵爆的严重反噬，使其身受重创，双目失明，力量虚弱。灵爆秘卷击中的目标越多，其对使用者造成的伤害越低。

ScrollOfRage.name: scroll of rage
ScrollOfRage.description: When read aloud, this scroll will unleash a great roar that draws all enemies to the reader, and enrages nearby ones.
ScrollOfRage.zh_description: 大声诵读内容时，卷轴将释放出一声轰响的咆哮，将所有敌人引向你并激怒附近的单位。

ScrollOfRecharging.name: scroll of recharging
ScrollOfRecharging.description: Pure magical energy is bound within this parchment. When released, it continuously recharges all of the reader's wands for a short time.
ScrollOfRecharging.zh_description: 纯正的魔法能量被禁锢在羊皮纸内，当这股能量被释放时会在短时间内持续为阅读者的所有法杖充能。

ScrollOfRemoveCurse.name: scroll of remove curse
ScrollOfRemoveCurse.description: The incantation on this scroll will instantly strip any curses from a single weapon, ring, wand, armor, or artifact.
ScrollOfRemoveCurse.zh_description: 卷轴上的咒语能够瞬间清除指定的一件武器、护甲、法杖、戒指或神器上的诅咒。

ScrollOfRetribution.name: scroll of retribution
ScrollOfRetribution.description: Reading applies blindness and paralysis to targets in your field of view. The base duration of both effects is _10 turns × missing-health fraction_, where the missing-health fraction is (maximum HP − current HP) ÷ maximum HP.
ScrollOfRetribution.zh_description: 阅读后，对视野内目标施加致盲和麻痹。两种效果的基础持续时间均为_10回合 × 已损失生命比例_，已损失生命比例为（最大生命－当前生命）÷最大生命。

ScrollOfSirensSong.name: scroll of siren's song
ScrollOfSirensSong.description:
Reading this scroll emits an alluring melody which will enthrall a targeted enemy, permanently turning them into an ally! Other enemies who hear it will be temporarily charmed.

Particularly strong enemies can resist the enthrall effect, and will be charmed instead.
ScrollOfSirensSong.zh_description:
阅读此卷轴将播放出摄人心魄的音律，令目标敌人沉沦于你，永久地变成盟友！听到这歌声的其它敌人则是暂时被魅惑。

特别强大的敌人可以抵抗沉沦效果，但同样会被魅惑。

ScrollOfTeleportation.name: scroll of teleportation
ScrollOfTeleportation.description: The spell on this parchment instantly teleports the reader to another location on the current floor.
ScrollOfTeleportation.zh_description: 羊皮纸上的咒语能立刻让阅读者传送到本层的另一处。

ScrollOfTerror.name: scroll of terror
ScrollOfTerror.description: Reading releases a terrifying red flash, forcing opponents in your field of view to drop their currently equipped weapon at their feet. Dropped weapons can be picked up again; unarmed opponents are unaffected.
ScrollOfTerror.zh_description: 阅读时释放可怖的红光，使视野内的对手将当前装备的武器掉落在其脚下。掉落的武器可被重新拾取；未装备武器的对手不受影响。

ScrollOfTransmutation.name: scroll of transmutation
ScrollOfTransmutation.description: This scroll contains powerful transmutation magic that transforms a suitable item into another item of the same type. Transmutation preserves the original item's upgrades, enchantments and glyphs. Scrolls and potions are converted into their exotic counterparts, and vice versa.
ScrollOfTransmutation.zh_description: 卷轴内存着强力的嬗变魔法，用在可行的物品上会将其转变成同类型的另一样物品。嬗变魔法还会保留原物品上的升级、附魔和刻印。卷轴或药剂将被转化为秘卷或合剂，反之亦然。

ScrollOfUpgrade.name: scroll of upgrade
ScrollOfUpgrade.description: This scroll can upgrade an item or a set of thrown weapons. Wands gain greater power and more charges; weapons, thrown weapons and armor gain stronger offensive or defensive properties; and rings become more effective.
ScrollOfUpgrade.zh_description: 这张卷轴可以升级一件物品或一组投掷武器。法杖可获得更高的效能与更多的充能，武器、投掷武器与护甲可获得更强的攻防属性，而戒指的效能可获得强化。

SealShard.name: seal shards
SealShard.description: These tiny shards of red wax look like they came from the seal of a fallen Warrior. You can still feel a bit of willpower clinging to the seal, you can use it to give yourself a bit of shielding. Doing this will destroy the seal shards however.
SealShard.zh_description: 这些细碎的红色蜡块似是源于一名葬身于此战士的纹章。你可以感受到其上仍残留的一缕执念，你可以用它来给自己提供一些护盾。但是，伴随着这缕执念转化为护盾，这些蜡块也会烟消云散。

ShardOfOblivion.name: shard of oblivion
ShardOfOblivion.description: After stewing in the alchemy pot, this small shard of cursed metal has changed to be made of... nothing? Light seems to bend around it, and it hovers in place when you aren't holding it. The shard seems to be magically drawing power from your ignorance, so it's probably best to not think about it too much.
ShardOfOblivion.zh_description: 经过炼金釜的烹煮，这一小块邪能碎片已经化为了...一片虚空？光线似乎在碎片边缘发生了弯曲，而只要你不握住它，它就会悬停在原地。碎片似乎通过魔法从你的无知中获得力量，所以对此最好不要想太多。

ShockingBrew.name: shocking brew
ShockingBrew.description: When shattered, this brew will unleash an electrical storm in a wide area around the location it breaks at.
ShockingBrew.zh_description: 当瓶子破裂时，这瓶魔药会向周围释放一阵闪电风暴。

ShockingDart.name: shocking dart
ShockingDart.description: These darts are tipped with a stormvine-based compound which will deliver a nasty shock to their target.
ShockingDart.zh_description: 这些飞镖上涂着一种由风暴藤制成的药物，能让目标受到强烈的电击。

Shortsword.name: shortsword
Shortsword.description: A quite short sword, only a few inches longer than a dagger.
Shortsword.zh_description: 它确实相当短，只比一把匕首长出几厘米。

ShrapnelBomb.name: shrapnel bomb
ShrapnelBomb.description: This bomb has been modified with scraps of DM-300's metal, which will fragment and fly everywhere when it explodes, dealing _%1$d-%2$d damage_ in a huge range around the bomb. You had better hide behind something when using it...
ShrapnelBomb.zh_description: 这枚改造过的炸弹的外壳由DM-300的金属残骸制成，当其爆炸时外壳会碎裂为破片并向四周迸发，在炸弹周围的巨大范围内造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_。使用时你最好躲在某处掩体后面...

Shuriken.name: shuriken
Shuriken.description: These star-shaped pieces of metal with razor-sharp blades can be quickly thrown while on the move.
Shuriken.zh_description: 一些轻便到可以在移动时快速掷出的锋利星形金属刃片。

Sickle.name: sickle
Sickle.description: A handheld farming tool that can double as a strong but unwieldy weapon.
Sickle.zh_description: 一种手持农具，也可被用作一把强大但笨重的武器。

SkeletonKey.name: skeleton key
SkeletonKey.description: An important-looking key with a head shaped like a skull. Its teeth seem to be different every time you look at them.
SkeletonKey.zh_description: 一把匙柄处塑有头骨，与众不同的钥匙。你每次观察匙齿时其外形似乎都有不同。

SmallRation.name: small food ration
SmallRation.description: It looks exactly like a standard ration of food but smaller.
SmallRation.zh_description: 它看起来和普通口粮一样，就是小了点。

SmokeBomb.name: smoke bomb
SmokeBomb.description: This bomb has been modified to spew a thick cloud of gas at the same time as exploding. It will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and spread shrouding fog within 2 tiles.
SmokeBomb.zh_description: 这枚改造过的炸弹会在爆炸时释放出一阵浓厚的气体烟云。炸弹会在2格范围内造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_并释放暗夜迷雾。

Spear.name: spear
Spear.description: A slender wooden rod tipped with sharpened iron.
Spear.zh_description: 这是一根装着锋锐铁刺的细长木杆。

SpiritBow.name: spirit bow
SpiritBow.description: A bow made out of ancient magical wood. The bow's string and etchings glow with a pale blue light. When the string is pulled this bow will conjure a magical arrow which can be fired at an enemy.
SpiritBow.zh_description: 一把由远古灵木制成的弓，弓弦和弓身的刻纹散发着苍蓝色的幽光。拉开弓弦时，一发魔法箭矢会生成在弓身一侧向目标飞去。

StewedMeat.name: stewed meat
StewedMeat.description: Stewing the meat has cleansed it of any disease or parasites. It should be safe to eat.
StewedMeat.zh_description: 烹煮的过程中杀死了肉上面可能携带的任何病菌或是寄生虫。现在应该可以安全的食用它了。

StoneOfAggression.name: stone of aggression
StoneOfAggression.description:
When this stone is thrown at an ally or enemy, all nearby enemies will prefer to attack that character for a short time.

Boss enemies cannot be targeted by this effect directly, but it does work on their minions.
StoneOfAggression.zh_description:
当把这颗符石丢向一个盟友或敌人时，附近所有敌人都会在短时间内优先攻击该单位。

敌意符石无法直接以boss为目标，但可对其随从正常发挥效果。

StoneOfAugmentation.name: stone of augmentation
StoneOfAugmentation.description:
This runestone possesses potent magic which can augment equipment to enhance one property at the cost of another.

Using on a weapon will allow you to enhance either speed or damage. Thrown weapons will also gain or lose durability in proportion with their speed.

Using on armor will allow you to enhance either defense or evasion.
StoneOfAugmentation.zh_description:
这颗符石内的强力魔法可以用于强化装备的一种属性，代价是会减弱另一种属性。

用于武器可以强化伤害或者速度。投掷武器的耐久度也会随着速度的增减而增减。

用于护甲可以强化防御或者闪避。

StoneOfBlast.name: stone of blast
StoneOfBlast.description: Explodes immediately at the landing tile, dealing _a fixed 15 base damage_ to creatures in range, without depth scaling or random base damage. Armor, shields and other defenses still apply. The blast still destroys flammable terrain and item heaps in its area.
StoneOfBlast.zh_description: 投掷后在落点立即爆炸，对范围内生物造成_固定15点基础伤害_，不受楼层和伤害随机浮动影响。护甲、护盾及其他防护照常生效；爆炸仍会破坏范围内的可燃地形与物品堆。

StoneOfBlink.name: stone of blink
StoneOfBlink.description: This runestone will teleport the user to the location it is thrown to.
StoneOfBlink.zh_description: 这颗符石被扔出后会把使用者传送到目的地。

StoneOfClairvoyance.name: stone of clairvoyance
StoneOfClairvoyance.description: This stone will instantly reveal all tiles in a very wide area around where it is thrown. Its effect will even reach through walls.
StoneOfClairvoyance.zh_description: 这颗符石被扔出后会瞬间搜索以目的地为中心的巨大范围内的所有地格。该搜索能力甚至不受墙壁的阻隔。

StoneOfDeepSleep.name: stone of deep sleep
StoneOfDeepSleep.description:
When this stone is thrown at an enemy, it will put them into a deep magical sleep. Magically slept enemies will sleep forever until disturbed.

As in the original game, this only affects monsters and summoned creatures, not player heroes.
StoneOfDeepSleep.zh_description:
当把这颗符石掷向一个敌人时，被命中的敌人会陷入魔法睡眠。陷入魔法睡眠的敌人会永远沉睡下去，除非受到外界打扰。

沿用原版，仅对怪物和召唤物生效，无法令玩家英雄入睡。

StoneOfDetectMagic.name: stone of detect magic
StoneOfDetectMagic.description:
This runestone is able to detect magic affecting an item. Using this stone on an unidentified item will tell you if it is affected by a malevolent curse and whether it is affected by positive magic such as an enchantment or upgrades.

All items in PvP are already identified. Select equipment to inspect its magic; this does not modify the item.
StoneOfDetectMagic.zh_description:
这颗符石能够侦测物品上的魔咒。对一件未鉴定物品使用此符石，可探测其是否附有诅咒，以及是否具有附魔或升级。

本 PvP 的物品均已鉴定；可选择装备查看魔力检测结果，不会改变物品。

StoneOfEnchantment.name: stone of enchantment
StoneOfEnchantment.description: This runestone possesses enchanting magic. Unlike a scroll of upgrade, it will not increase the direct power of an item, but will instead imbue a weapon or armor with an enchantment, granting it a new power.
StoneOfEnchantment.zh_description: 这颗符石拥有施加附魔的能力。和升级卷轴不同，它不会直接加强一个道具的能力，但能给武器或者护甲施加附魔，使其拥有新的特性。

StoneOfFear.name: stone of fear
StoneOfFear.description: When this stone is thrown onto a character they will be overwhelmed with terror, and will turn and flee. Attacking a fleeing character will shorten the effect.
StoneOfFear.zh_description: 当把这颗符石掷向一个盟友或敌人时，被命中的角色会陷入深深的恐惧中，无法克制地逃离。攻击会刺激其从恐惧中更快恢复。

StoneOfFlock.name: stone of flock
StoneOfFlock.description: This runestone summons magical sheep for a short time around the location it is thrown to.
StoneOfFlock.zh_description: 这颗符石被扔出后会在目的地召唤一群魔法绵羊。

StoneOfIntuition.name: stone of intuition
StoneOfIntuition.description:
This runestone holds a weaker version of the magic found in scrolls of identification. Rather than directly identifying an item, it will work on your intuition, allowing you to attempt to identify the type of a potion, scroll, or ring by guessing.

All items in PvP are already identified. Using this stone retains its animation and effects without identification guesses. Each stone can be used twice.
StoneOfIntuition.zh_description:
这块符石含有的魔法就像一个弱化版的鉴定卷轴。和鉴定卷轴那种直接识别物品的魔法不一样，它会加强你的直觉，让你通过猜测来试图鉴定一种药水、卷轴或者戒指的种类。

本 PvP 的所有物品均已鉴定。保留使用动作与特效，不进行猜测鉴定；每颗可使用两次。

StoneOfShock.name: stone of shock
StoneOfShock.description: This runestone unleashes a blast of electrical energy which briefly stuns all nearby targets, and grants the thrower wand charge for each target hit.
StoneOfShock.zh_description: 这颗符石被扔出后会爆出一阵电能量，短暂麻痹范围内所有目标并根据电到的目标数量恢复使用者的法杖充能。

Stylus.name: arcane stylus
Stylus.description: This arcane stylus is made of some dark, very hard stone. Using it you can inscribe a magical glyph on your armor, but you have no power over choosing what glyph it will be, the stylus will decide it for you.
Stylus.zh_description: 这支奥术刻笔由一种暗黑色的坚硬石料制成。你能用它在护甲上刻下魔法刻印，不过你无法自主选择，刻笔会替你做出决定。

SummonElemental.name: summon elemental
SummonElemental.description: This spell channels the energy of the elemental embers used to make it, and will allow you to summon a friendly elemental to fight with you! Only one elemental can be summoned at a time, but the spell can be re-cast to return the elemental to you at no cost.
SummonElemental.zh_description: 这个晶柱联系着用于制造它的元素余烬的能量，能够召唤出一个友好的元素助你战斗！同一时间只能召唤一个元素，但是重新释放该元素不需要消耗额外能量。

SupplyRation.name: supply ration
SupplyRation.description:
This ration was left in the dungeon by and for members of the thieves guild. It's specifically designed to be eaten on the go, and aid with general skullduggery.

While it doesn't fill you up as much as a regular ration, it can be eaten quickly, provides a little direct healing, and will restore a charge to the Rogue's cloak of shadows.
SupplyRation.zh_description:
这是一包由盗贼公会存放，供其成员取用的口粮。这包口粮专门被设计成可快速食用的样式，并且能为成员的隐秘行动提供诸多帮助。

尽管不能像正常口粮一样填饱你，它却能被快速食用，恢复少量生命，并且回复盗贼的暗影斗篷一点神器充能。

Sword.name: sword
Sword.description: A nicely balanced sword. Not too large, but still notably longer than a shortsword.
Sword.zh_description: 平衡性良好的剑。不算太大，但是依然比短剑长上不少。

TalismanOfForesight.name: talisman of foresight
TalismanOfForesight.description: A smooth stone with strange engravings on it. You feel like it's watching everything around you, keeping an eye out for anything hidden.
TalismanOfForesight.zh_description: 一块雕着奇怪刻纹的光滑石头。它好像是在观察着你周围的一切，留意任何不寻常的东西。

TelekineticGrab.name: telekinetic grab
TelekineticGrab.description:
This spell allows the caster to remotely grab all items at a location, or all thrown weapons stuck to an enemy!

It can't be used to grab items that someone else owns, or to grab containers like chests.
TelekineticGrab.zh_description:
这个结晶允许使用者远程抓取一格所有的物体，或从敌人身上取回卡住的投掷武器！

结晶无法用于抓取其他角色拥有的物品，也无法抓取诸如箱子这般的容器。

TengusMask.name: Tengu's mask
TengusMask.description:
This mask fell off Tengu's face as he died, you can feel great magical power emanating from it. Was the mask Tengu's source of strength?

When worn, the tremendous power of the mask will be transferred into you, enabling you to _choose a subclass for your hero._

Which subclass will you choose?
TengusMask.zh_description:
天狗死时，这幅面具像褪皮般从他的脸上失落地滑下。你能感受它在波动着一股神妙的魔力，仿佛在极力劝你成为它的新主人。难道天狗戴上它时也是被其力量吸引？

如果你有勇气将其戴上，面具的庞大力量会转嫁到你体内，供你为英雄_选择一种职业专精_。

你会选择哪条道路？

ThirteenLeafClover.name: thirteen leaf clover
ThirteenLeafClover.description: Somehow stewing in the alchemy pot has caused this clover to grow a bunch of extra leaves! It's not really clear if this trinket is lucky or unlucky, perhaps this trinket will make your luck more chaotic?
ThirteenLeafClover.zh_description: 不知为何，在炼金釜中烹煮竟让这株三叶草长出了许多额外的叶子！目前尚不清楚这件饰物会带来好运还是厄运，或许它会让你的运气变得更加混沌无常？

ThrowingClub.name: throwing club
ThrowingClub.description: A fairly simple but durable thrown weapon, essentially a large rock fastened to a stick.
ThrowingClub.zh_description: 简单粗暴但耐用的投掷武器，实际上就是一块插着根木棍的大石头。

ThrowingHammer.name: throwing hammer
ThrowingHammer.description: These hefty hammers are designed to be thrown at an enemy. Their smooth all-metal construction means they are quite durable.
ThrowingHammer.zh_description: 这些重锤是用来扔向敌人的。其光滑的全金属构造让它们非常耐用。

ThrowingKnife.name: throwing knife
ThrowingKnife.description: These lightweight knives are balanced to arc through the air right into their target.
ThrowingKnife.zh_description: 这些轻便的小刀不同于普通的匕首，平衡的配重使其能在飞行后准确地刺穿目标。

ThrowingSpear.name: throwing spear
ThrowingSpear.description: These lightweight spears have thin frames which are designed to be thrown, and not thrusted.
ThrowingSpear.zh_description: 这些有着非常纤细的木杆的轻便短矛是一种投掷武器，不适合用于近战。

ThrowingSpike.name: throwing spike
ThrowingSpike.description: These durable pointed shafts of metal are meant to be thrown into distant enemies.
ThrowingSpike.zh_description: 这些尖尖的金属箭是用来扔向远处的敌人的。

ThrowingStone.name: throwing stone
ThrowingStone.description: These stones are sanded down to make them able to be thrown with more power than a regular stone.
ThrowingStone.zh_description: 这些石头被人用砂纸打磨成趁手的形状，比普通石头更适合大力投向目标。

TimekeepersHourglass.name: timekeeper's hourglass
TimekeepersHourglass.description: This large ornate hourglass looks fairly unassuming, but you feel a great power in its finely carved frame. As you rotate the hourglass and watch the sand pour you can feel its magic tugging at you, surely using this magic would give you some control over time.
TimekeepersHourglass.zh_description: 这只大型的华贵沙漏看起来却并不怎么起眼，但你仍觉得它精雕细刻的框架内蕴含着某种强大的力量。在翻转沙漏、在看着沙子流下的同时，你能感受到一种魔法正在拉扯着你，使用这种魔法肯定能给你一些控制时间的方法。

Tomahawk.name: tomahawk
Tomahawk.description: These throwing axes have a serrated edge that tears as they stick to an enemy.
Tomahawk.zh_description: 这些飞斧的锯刃只要卡在敌人身上就能造成流血的撕裂伤口。

Torch.name: torch
Torch.description: An adventuring staple, when a dungeon goes dark, a torch can help lead the way.
Torch.zh_description: 冒险必备物品，每当地牢陷入黑暗之时，火把能让你走上正确的道路。

TornPage.name: torn page
TornPage.description: This page looks like it was ripped out of an expired Cleric's holy tome. There's still a little divine energy clinging to it, you can use it to regain a little bit of health. Doing this will destroy the torn page however.
TornPage.zh_description: 这片书页看起来是从一位已安息主怀的牧师的圣典上撕扯下来的。其上依旧残存有一丝神力，你可以使用它恢复少许生命值。但若如此书页也会随之烟消云散。

TrapMechanism.name: trap mechanism
TrapMechanism.description: The core mechanism of one of the dungeon's pitfall traps, carefully carved out of the floor so it can be carried. It seems to be magically tied to the dungeon itself, making hazardous terrain more common but also increasing your affinity towards it.
TrapMechanism.zh_description: 地牢中某个塌方陷阱的核心元件，被小心地从地面中挖掘而出以便携带。它似乎通过魔法与地牢本身形成链接，促使险恶地形频繁出现，并增强了你对陷阱的探查能力。

Trident.name: trident
Trident.description: Massive throwing spears with three deadly prongs on the end. They are powerful, but quite heavy.
Trident.zh_description: 一把尖端有着三根致命尖叉的特大号投掷用长枪。威力极大，但也很重。

TrinketCatalyst.name: magical catalyst
TrinketCatalyst.description:
This ball of magical golden dust glimmers in the darkness of the dungeon. This catalyst can be used at an alchemy pot with a little alchemical energy to produce a unique trinket item.

Trinkets provide various different effects that slightly alter the dungeon or its inhabitants. Trinkets can be upgraded with more energy to make their effect more powerful, or dropped to forego the effect entirely.
TrinketCatalyst.zh_description:
这团泛着微光的金色粉尘在暗无边际的地牢中熠熠生辉。魔能触媒可被置入炼金釜中，结合少许炼金能量制成一件独特饰物。

饰物提供各种小幅改变地牢环境或其住民的效果。通过消耗更多炼金能量升级饰物可以进一步增幅对应效果，丢掉饰物也可以完全摆脱其施加的影响。

UnstableBrew.name: unstable brew
UnstableBrew.description:
This magical brew glows with shifting colors of the rainbow.

When drank or thrown it will trigger the effect of a random potion. The potion effect will always be beneficial if it is drank, and will always be harmful if it is thrown.
UnstableBrew.zh_description:
这瓶魔药泛着不断流转变化的彩虹光芒。

饮用它将随机获得一种有益的药剂效果，而将其投掷出去则必定释放一种有害的药剂效果。

UnstableSpell.name: unstable spell
UnstableSpell.description:
This small black square crystal has shifting runic symbols on each of its surfaces.

When activated, it will trigger the effect of a random scroll. The scroll effect will always be combat focused if there are enemies in your field of view, and will always be non-combat focused otherwise.
UnstableSpell.zh_description:
这块黑色方形小水晶的每个面都浮动着变幻莫测的符文。

激活时，它将随机触发一种卷轴效果，若视野内存在敌人，则必定触发战斗类卷轴效果，反之则必定触发非战斗类卷轴效果。

UnstableSpellbook.name: unstable spellbook
UnstableSpellbook.description: This Tome is in surprising good condition given its age. It fizzes and crackles as you move the pages, surging with unstable energy. If you read from this book, there's no telling what spell you might cast.
UnstableSpellbook.zh_description: 这本魔典就其年岁而言被保养得异常好。当你翻动页面时它不断地噼啪作响并发出嘶嘶声，涌动着不稳定的能量。一旦诵读这本书，没人能笃定你会释放出什么咒语。

VaultBeacon.name: vault beacon
VaultBeacon.description:
This beacon of returning spell seems to already have a location set, probably to the entry room you found it in.

You could use it to save time while exploring, or as a way to escape if you're in danger.
VaultBeacon.zh_description:
这个信标内含的魔法似乎能带你回到一个特定的位置，目的地很可能就是你找到它的那个房间。

你可以用它节省一点探索的时间，若是身处险境也可以用它逃出生天。

VialOfBlood.name: vial of blood
VialOfBlood.description: This thin vial contains the blood of some denizen of the dungeon, it moves slowly as you rotate the vial. It seems to be magically enhancing stronger healing effects, but also delaying them.
VialOfBlood.zh_description: 这根细长的试管内装有一些地牢住民的血液，当你转动试管时其中的血液也会随之缓慢流动。它似乎通过魔法使治疗更为强效，但也更为缓效。

WandOfBlastWave.name: wand of blast wave
WandOfBlastWave.description: This wand is made of a sort of marbled stone, with gold trim and a round black gem at the tip. It feels very weighty in your hand.
WandOfBlastWave.zh_description: 这根法杖由一种大理石石材制成，嵌有金饰并在顶部镶着一个浑圆的黑宝石。它在你手中的感觉非常沉重。

WandOfCorrosion.name: wand of corrosion
WandOfCorrosion.description: This wand has an ashen body which opens to a brilliant orange gem.
WandOfCorrosion.zh_description: 这根法杖的灰色主干顶端镶嵌着一颗明亮的橙色宝石。

WandOfCorruption.name: wand of corruption
WandOfCorruption.description: This wand radiates chaotic dark energy, if that weren't already obvious from the small decorative skull shaped onto its tip.
WandOfCorruption.zh_description: 这根法杖能发射混乱的黑暗能量，法杖尖端的那个小头骨装饰很是应景。

WandOfDisintegration.name: wand of disintegration
WandOfDisintegration.description: This wand is made from a solid smooth chunk of obsidian, with a deep purple light running up its side, ending at the tip. It glows with destructive energy, waiting to shoot forward.
WandOfDisintegration.zh_description: 这根法杖由一整块光滑的黑曜石制成，深紫色的光自其边缘流向法杖顶端。它闪烁着破坏性能量，准备着向前迸射。

WandOfFireblast.name: wand of fireblast
WandOfFireblast.description: This wand is made from red-lacquered wood with golden leaf used liberally to make it look quite regal. It crackles and hisses at the tip, eager to unleash its powerful magic.
WandOfFireblast.zh_description: 这根法杖由红漆木制成，饰以金叶，这使它看起来相当庄严。它的顶端噼啪作响嘶嘶而鸣，渴望着释放其强大的魔法。

WandOfFrost.name: wand of frost
WandOfFrost.description: This wand seems to be made out of some kind of magical ice. It grows brighter towards its rounded tip. It feels very cold when held, but somehow your hand stays warm.
WandOfFrost.zh_description: 这根法杖似乎由某种魔法冰块制成。它的圆顶闪着亮光。握起来很冰，但不知为何你的手仍保持着温暖。

WandOfLightning.name: wand of lightning
WandOfLightning.description: This wand is made out of solid metal, making it surprisingly heavy. Two prongs curve together at the tip, and electricity arcs between them.
WandOfLightning.zh_description: 这根法杖由实心金属制成，这使它惊人地沉重。电弧在顶端两个内弯的叉齿间跳跃。

WandOfLivingEarth.name: wand of living earth
WandOfLivingEarth.description: This wand is made from a curious rock, with bands of glowing yellow energy. The rocks seem to shift slightly as you grip the wand, as if they can feel your hand.
WandOfLivingEarth.zh_description: 这根法杖由一种奇妙的石头组成，你能从几道微微发光的黄色条纹中感受到能量波动。握住法杖时石头好像会稍稍转动，仿佛在迎合你的手。

WandOfMagicMissile.name: wand of magic missile
WandOfMagicMissile.description: This fairly plain wand launches missiles of pure magical energy. While the wand itself lacks any special effects, it has more available charges and can briefly empower other wands when upgraded.
WandOfMagicMissile.zh_description: 这根十分普通的法杖能发射由纯魔法能量构成的飞弹。尽管法杖本身没有什么花哨的特效，但它有更多的充能数，而且在被升级后能暂时强化其他法杖。

WandOfPrismaticLight.name: wand of prismatic light
WandOfPrismaticLight.description: This wand is made of a solid piece of translucent crystal, like a long chunk of smooth glass. Small bits of colorful light dance around the tip of the wand, eager to burst forth.
WandOfPrismaticLight.zh_description: 这根法杖由一块实心半透明水晶构成，就像一块厚长光滑的玻璃。一粒粒彩色的光点在法杖顶端跳跃，随时准备迸射而出。

WandOfRegrowth.name: wand of regrowth
WandOfRegrowth.description: This wand is made from a thin shaft of expertly carved wood. Somehow it is still alive and vibrant, bright green like a young tree's core. "When life ceases new life always begins to grow... The eternal cycle always remains!"
WandOfRegrowth.zh_description: 这根法杖由一根细长木枝巧琢而成。不知为何，它还活着而且生机盎然，像一株树苗的嫩芽般艳绿。“春兰兮秋菊，长无绝兮终古！”

WandOfTransfusion.name: wand of transfusion
WandOfTransfusion.description: A fairly plainly shaped wand, it stands out due to its magenta hue and pitch black gem at the tip.
WandOfTransfusion.zh_description: 这根法杖形状很普通，是那暗红的色泽和镶在顶端的漆黑宝石让它显眼起来。

WandOfWarding.name: wand of warding
WandOfWarding.description: This short metal wand has a bright purple gem floating above its tip.
WandOfWarding.zh_description: 这根短小的金属法杖尖端上有一颗亮紫色宝石悬空浮动。

WarHammer.name: war hammer
WarHammer.description: Few creatures can withstand the crushing blow of this towering mass of lead and steel, but it takes great strength to use effectively.
WarHammer.zh_description: 很少有生物能抵挡这铅铁巨块的辗压，但也只有最强壮的冒险家才能有效使用它。

WarriorArmor.name: hero's plate mail
WarriorArmor.description: While wearing this heavy plated armor, the Warrior can perform a special ability.
WarriorArmor.zh_description: 装备这套重型板甲时，战士能够施展一项特殊技能。

WarScythe.name: war scythe
WarScythe.description: This large and unwieldy tool has been reinforced to make it better at cutting foes than crops.
WarScythe.zh_description: 这件巨大又笨重的农具被加固了。现在比起收割庄稼，它更适宜于收割敌人。

Waterskin.name: waterskin
Waterskin.description: A container for liquid, made from leather and string, sealed with a cork stopper.
Waterskin.zh_description: 牛皮缝制的液体容器，被软木塞牢牢密封着。在激烈的搏斗中也不会漏出一滴内容。

Whip.name: whip
Whip.description: While the barbed length of rope at the end of this weapon deals poor damage, its reach cannot be matched.
Whip.zh_description: 虽然这把武器另一端带倒刺的绳子伤害不高，但它的攻击范围是数一数二的。

WildEnergy.name: wild energy
WildEnergy.description: This spell contains some of the cursed energy which powered DM-300. When cast, it will recharge your wands and worn artifacts, while also triggering a random cursed wand effect. You are able to choose a direction for this cursed magic to shoot in, however.
WildEnergy.zh_description: 这个结晶中含有部分驱动DM-300的诅咒之力。当施放时，它会为你的法杖与佩戴着的神器充能，但同时也会随机触发一种诅咒法杖效果。幸运的是你可以指定这种诅咒魔法的施放方向。

WondrousResin.name: wondrous resin
WondrousResin.description: This shimmering blue resin appears to have the distilled essence of a cursed wand's magic. The magic from the alchemy pot has seemed to stabilize it somewhat, and it's now affecting your wands.
WondrousResin.zh_description: 这团泛着微光的蓝色树脂看起来附有某根诅咒法杖魔法的纯化精华。炼金釜中的魔力似乎在一定程度上稳定了树脂的诅咒魔法，而这种魔法现在正影响着你的法杖。

WoollyBomb.name: woolly bomb
WoollyBomb.description: This customized bomb will create a wide field of magical sheep after exploding. The explosion will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_ to anything within 2 tiles. The sheep will block movement and persist for a very long time! The sheep will not last as long in the presence of powerful enemies though, and can be manually dispelled sooner by interacting with them.
WoollyBomb.zh_description: 这枚改造过的炸弹会在爆炸后创造出魔法羊群。爆炸会对2格范围内的所有单位造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_。羊群会阻挡单位的移动，并会存在相当长一段时间！然而，羊群无法在强敌面前存在太久，而且羊群也可以通过与之互动被人为地提前消除。

WornKey.name: worn key
WornKey.description: This key is worn and discolored, but looks serious. Probably it can open some serious door nearby.
WornKey.zh_description: 这把磨损而褪色的钥匙看起来非同寻常。大概它可以打开附近某道非同寻常的门。

WornShortsword.name: worn shortsword
WornShortsword.description: A quite short sword, worn down through heavy use. It is both weaker and a bit lighter than a shortsword in better condition.
WornShortsword.zh_description: 一把十分短的剑，在大量使用后有一定的磨损。它比正常情况的短剑更轻，也更弱。

SEED_ROTBERRY.name: seed of rotberry
SEED_ROTBERRY.description:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

The berries of a young rotberry shrub taste like sweet, sweet death. Over a few years, this rotberry shrub will grow into another rot heart. When trampled, a young rotberry will produce a small puff of toxic gas.
SEED_ROTBERRY.zh_description:
把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。

未成熟的腐莓丛结出的莓果尝起来更像是甜蜜的死亡。经过成年累月的生长，这株腐莓丛终会成熟为另一棵腐莓核心。被踩踏后，这株未成熟的腐莓会释放少量毒气。

SEED_FIREBLOOM.name: seed of firebloom
SEED_FIREBLOOM.description:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

When something touches a firebloom, it bursts into flames.
SEED_FIREBLOOM.zh_description:
把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。

烈焰花被任何物品触碰到时，都会化为一团火焰。

SEED_SWIFTTHISTLE.name: seed of swiftthistle
SEED_SWIFTTHISTLE.description:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

When trampled, swiftthistle will briefly accelerate the flow of time around it, allowing the trampler to perform several actions instantly.
SEED_SWIFTTHISTLE.zh_description:
把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。

被踩踏后，速行蓟会加速周围的时间流动，让踩踏者可以瞬间行动数次

SEED_SUNGRASS.name: seed of sungrass
SEED_SUNGRASS.description:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Sungrass is renowned for its sap's slow but effective healing properties.
SEED_SUNGRASS.zh_description:
把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。

阳春草因其汁液缓慢但显著的疗伤效果而家喻户晓。

SEED_ICECAP.name: seed of icecap
SEED_ICECAP.description:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Upon being touched, an icecap lets out a puff of freezing pollen. The freezing effect is much stronger if the environment is wet.
SEED_ICECAP.zh_description:
把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。

冰冠花在被接触到时会喷射出一团能冻结周遭的花粉。冻结效果会在潮湿环境中大幅增强。

SEED_STORMVINE.name: seed of stormvine
SEED_STORMVINE.description:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Gravity affects the stormvine plant strangely, allowing its whispy blue tendrils to 'hang' on the air. Anything caught in the vine is affected by this, and becomes disoriented.
SEED_STORMVINE.zh_description:
把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。

引力似乎并不能正常地作用在风暴藤上，它蓝色的藤蔓能够"挂"在空中。任何被风暴藤缠到的生物也被这种奇怪的引力影响，并失去方向感。

SEED_SORROWMOSS.name: seed of sorrowmoss
SEED_SORROWMOSS.description:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

A sorrowmoss is a flower (not a moss) with razor-sharp petals, coated with a deadly venom.
SEED_SORROWMOSS.zh_description:
把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。

断肠苔（实为花卉而非苔藓）是一种花瓣利如刀片，表面覆有致命毒液的植物。

SEED_MAGEROYAL.name: seed of mageroyal
SEED_MAGEROYAL.description:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

The mageroyal's prickly flowers contain a chemical which is known for its properties as a strong neutralizing agent. Anything that steps in this plant will be cleansed of many negative effects.
SEED_MAGEROYAL.zh_description:
把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。

魔皇草的带刺花朵含有一种化学物质，因其强大的中和性质而闻名。任何踏入这株植物的东西将会被净化掉许多负面效果。

SEED_EARTHROOT.name: seed of earthroot
SEED_EARTHROOT.description:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

When a creature touches an earthroot, its roots create a kind of immobile natural armor around it.
SEED_EARTHROOT.zh_description:
把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。

碰到地缚根后，它的根系会在踩踏者周边形成某种无法移动的天然护甲。

SEED_STARFLOWER.name: seed of starflower
SEED_STARFLOWER.description:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

A rare plant, starflower is said to grant holy power to whomever touches it.
SEED_STARFLOWER.zh_description:
把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。

星陨花较为罕见，据说其能够为任何接触它的人赋予神圣之力。

SEED_FADELEAF.name: seed of fadeleaf
SEED_FADELEAF.description:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Touching a fadeleaf will teleport any creature to a random place on the current level.
SEED_FADELEAF.zh_description:
把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。

任何触碰到消逝草的生物都会被传送到当前层的一个随机地点。

SEED_BLINDWEED.name: seed of blindweed
SEED_BLINDWEED.description:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Upon being touched a blindweed perishes in a bright flash of light. The flash is strong enough to disorient for several seconds.
SEED_BLINDWEED.zh_description:
把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。

在被碰到后，致盲草会瞬间枯萎并释放一道强光。这道光足以刺伤受害者双眼，使其暂时失明。

aggression.name: targeted
aggression.description:
Manipulative magic is making all nearby enemies prefer to attack this character.

Turns remaining: %s.

block_shield.name: blocking
block_shield.description:
Your weapon's blocking enchantment has granted you a brief boost to your defensive power!

Shielding remaining: %d

Turns remaining: %s.

conserved_damage.name: conserved damage
conserved_damage.description:
Your weapon has stored the excess force from a previous killing blow, and will apply it as bonus damage to your next attack. The energy will slowly fade over time, however.

Conserved Damage: %d.

deferred_damage.name: deferred damage
deferred_damage.description:
Damage is being dealt slowly over time instead of immediately.

Deferred damage remaining: %d.

cleanse.name: cleansed
cleanse.description:
This character is temporarily immune to all harmful status effects!

Turns remaining: %s.

lightning_charge.name: Electrically charged
lightning_charge.description:
The Battlemage is currently charged with energy, granting him immunity to his staff of lightning and increasing the range that lightning can arc from it.

Turns Remaining: %s.

magic_charge.name: magic charge
magic_charge.description:
Your wand of magic missile has fed power back into your wands, boosting the effective level of the next zap they make.

Your wands are boosted to: +%d.

Turns of magic charge remaining: %s.

rock_armor.name: rock armor
rock_armor.description:
Magical rocks are surrounding your body, when you are attacked they will attempt to block for you, and will reduce the damage you take by 50%%. Each damage blocked scrapes away some of the rock however.

Remaining Armor: %1$d.

If enough rock is built around you, the next zap from your wand of living earth will cause the rocks to form up into a guardian which will fight with you.

Armor needed for Guardian: %2$d.

earthroot_armor.name: herbal armor
earthroot_armor.description:
A kind of natural, immobile armor made of bark and twine.

This herbal armor will block %d damage from any physical hit, until it eventually runs out of durability and collapses.

As the armor is immobile, moving will cause it to break apart and be lost.

Armor remaining: %d.

sungrass_heal.name: herbal healing
sungrass_heal.description:
Sungrass possesses excellent healing properties, though it is much slower than a potion of healing.

Moving off the plant will break the healing effect.

Healing remaining: %d.

time_bubble.name: time bubble
time_bubble.description:
A small bubble of accelerated time, allowing actions to be performed instantly. Attacking or using magic will break this effect however.

Turns remaining: %s.

shuriken_cooldown.name: Shuriken Cooldown
shuriken_cooldown.description:
You have recently thrown a shuriken instantly, and must wait before doing it again. Shurikens can still be thrown, but at normal weapon speed.

Turns Remaining: %s.

adrenaline.name: adrenaline
adrenaline.description:
A surge of physical power, adrenaline enhanced both attack and movement speed.

Adrenaline allows its target to run at 2x speed, and attack at 1.5x speed.

Turns remaining: %s.

amok.name: amok
amok.description:
Amok causes a state of great rage and confusion in its target.

When a creature is amoked, they will attack whatever is near them, whether they be friend or foe.

Turns of amok remaining: %s.

bleeding.name: bleeding
bleeding.description:
That wound is leaking a worrisome amount of blood.

Bleeding causes damage every turn. Each turn the damage decreases by a random amount, until the bleeding eventually stops.

Current bleed damage: %d.

bless.name: blessed
bless.description:
A great burst of focus, some say it is inspired by the gods.

Blessing increases accuracy and evasion by 25%%, making the blessed much more effective in combat.

Turns of bless remaining: %s.

blindness.name: blinded
blindness.description:
Blinding turns the surrounding world into a dark haze.

While blinded, a character's vision range is reduced to one tile, rendering ranged attacks useless and making it very easy to lose track of distant enemies. Additionally, a blinded hero is unable to read scrolls or books.

Turns of blindness remaining: %s.

blob_immunity.name: purification barrier
blob_immunity.description:
Some strange force is encasing you in a thin protective barrier, blocking out all harmful airborne effects.

You are immune to all area-bound effects while this barrier lasts.

Turns of immunity remaining: %s.

burning.name: burning
burning.description:
Few things are more distressing than being engulfed in flames.

Fire will deal damage every turn until it is put out by water or it expires. Fire can be extinguished by stepping into water, or from the splash of a shattering potion.

Additionally, the fire may ignite flammable terrain or items that it comes into contact with.

Turns of burning remaining: %s.

charm.name: charmed
charm.description:
A charm is manipulative magic that can make enemies temporarily adore each other.

Characters affected by charm are unable to directly attack the enemy they are charmed by. Attacking other targets is still possible however. The shock of pain will lessen the duration of charm.

Turns of charm remaining: %s.

chill.name: chilled
chill.description:
Not quite frozen, but still much too cold.

Chilled targets perform all actions more slowly, depending on how many turns are left in the effect. At its worst, this is equivalent to being slowed.

Turns of chill remaining: %1$s.
Speed is reduced by: %2$s%%

corrosion.name: corrosion
corrosion.description:
Powerful acid melts away flesh, metal, and bone at an alarming rate.

Corrosion damage increases over time, as the target continues to melt away.

Turns of corrosion remaining: %1$s.
Current corrosion damage: %2$d.

corruption.name: corrupted
corruption.description:
Corruption seeps into the essence of a being, twisting them against their former nature.

Corrupted creatures will attack their allies, and ignore their former enemies. Corruption is damaging as well, and will slowly cause its target to succumb.

Corruption is permanent, its effects only end in death.

cripple.name: crippled
cripple.description:
You're pretty sure legs aren't meant to bend that way.

Crippled halves movement speed, making moving a tile usually take two turns instead of one.

Turns of cripple remaining: %s.

daze.name: dazed
daze.description:
Ringing ears and blurred vision make it difficult to fight.

While dazed, accuracy and evasion are reduced by 50%%, making both landing and evading blows much harder.

Turns of daze remaining: %s.

degrade.name: degraded
degrade.description:
Powerful dark magic is sapping the strength that scrolls of upgrade have applied to your equipment!

While degraded, upgraded gear will be treated as if it is a lower level than it actually is. _Every upgrade after +3 becomes exponentially weaker than the last one._ The descriptions of your items will change to reflect their reduced power level.

Degradation does not affect wand charges, durability of thrown weapons, or artifacts.

Turns of degradation remaining: %s. Using a scroll of upgrade or remove curse will end degradation immediately.

doom.name: doomed
doom.description:
It's hard to keep going when it seems like the universe wants you dead.

Doomed characters will receive +67% damage from all sources.

Doom is permanent, its effects only end in death.

dread.name: dread
dread.description:
A terror so great that it will cause its target to flee the dungeon entirely!

Creatures affected by dread will run from their opponent at high speed, and will disappear from the dungeon entirely once they are out of sight. Enemies that are defeated this way award half experience and drop no items. The shock of pain will lessen the duration of dread.

Turns of dread remaining: %d.

drowsy.name: drowsy
drowsy.description:
A magical force is making it difficult to stay awake, after a few turns, the target will fall into a deep magical sleep.

The hero can resist drowsiness by taking damage or by being at full health.

Turns until sleep: %s.

enhanced_rings.name: enhanced rings
enhanced_rings.description:
The Rogue's recently used artifact is empowering his rings, granting them +1 level.

Turns remaining: %s.

frost.name: frozen
frost.description:
Not to be confused with freezing solid, this more benign freezing simply encases the target in ice.

Freezing acts similarly to paralysis, making it impossible for the target to act. Unlike paralysis, freezing is immediately cancelled if the target takes damage, as the ice will shatter.

Turns of freeze remaining: %s.

haste.name: haste
haste.description:
Energy courses through your muscles, allowing you to run at incredible speeds!

While under the effects of haste you will run at 3x speed, but will perform all other actions at normal speed.

Turns of haste remaining: %s.

healing.name: healing
healing.description:
Restores 2 HP each turn for 20 turns. Ends immediately on a landed attack or positive damage. Drinking another healing potion refreshes the duration.

Turns of healing remaining: %s.
healing.legacy_description:
A magical remedy is causing wounds to close and flesh to knit.

Every turn health will steadily regenerate until the healing effect expires. The amount of healing may fade over time.

Next heal: %d.

Healing remaining: %d.

hex.name: hexed
hex.description:
Dark magic which saps focus, making the target slightly disoriented.

Hexing reduces accuracy and evasion by 20%%, making the target less effective in combat.

Turns of hex remaining: %s.

invisibility.name: invisible
invisibility.description:
You are completely blended into the surrounding terrain, making you impossible to see.

While you are invisible enemies are unable to attack or follow you. Physical attacks and magical effects (such as scrolls and wands) will immediately cancel invisibility.

Turns of invisibility remaining: %s.

Invisibility does not prevent blind shots at your tile or area damage.

invulnerable.name: invulnerable
invulnerable.description:
This character is suffused with great protective power, granting them a brief period of invulnerability!

Turns remaining: %s.

levitation.name: levitating
levitation.description:
A magical force is levitating you over the ground, making you feel weightless.

Levitating characters move silently and ignore all ground-based effects. Traps won't trigger, water won't put out fire, plants won't be trampled, roots will miss, and pits will be hovered over. Be careful, as all these things can come into effect the second the levitation ends!

Turns of levitation remaining: %s.

light.name: illuminated
light.description:
Even in the Darkest Dungeon, a steady light at your side is always comforting.

Light helps keep darkness at bay, allowing you to see a reasonable distance despite the environment.

Turns of illumination remaining: %s.

magical_sleep.name: magical sleep
magical_sleep.description:
This character has fallen into a deep magical sleep which they will not wake from naturally.

Magical sleep is similar to regular sleep, except that only damage will cause the target to wake up.

For the hero and their allies, magical sleep has some restorative properties, allowing them to rapidly heal while resting.

magic_immune.name: immune to magic
magic_immune.description:
All magical effects have lost their hold on you, you are completely impervious to them.

While magic immune all harmful and helpful magical effects will not apply to you, including curses, enchants, wands, scrolls, rings, artifacts, etc. Heroic armor abilities are strong enough to work regardless of this effect.

Turns of magic immunity remaining: %s.

mind_vision.name: mind vision
mind_vision.description:
Somehow you are able to see all creatures on this floor through your mind. It's a weird feeling.

All characters on this floor are visible to you as long as you have mind vision. Seeing a creature through mind vision counts as it being seen or nearby for the purposes of many magical effects.

Turns of mind vision remaining: %s.

ooze.name: caustic ooze
ooze.description:
This sticky acid clings to flesh, slowly melting it away.

Ooze will deal consistent damage over time, but can be immediately washed off in water.

Turns of ooze remaining: %s.

paralysis.name: paralysed
paralysis.description:
Paralysis prevents actions. Each instance of positive damage reduces the remaining paralysis by 5 turns. Zero damage does not reduce it.

When paralysis ends, gain immunity to paralysis for 3 turns.

Turns of paralysis remaining: %s.

poison.name: poisoned
poison.description:
Poison works its way through the body, slowly impairing its internal functioning.

Poison deals damage each turn proportional to how long until it expires.

Turns of poison remaining: %s.

recharging.name: recharging
recharging.description:
Energy is coursing through you, improving the rate that your wands and staffs charge.

Each turn this buff will increase current charge by one quarter, in addition to regular recharge.

Turns of recharging remaining: %s.

roots.name: rooted
roots.description:
Roots (magical or natural) grab at the feet, forcing them down to the ground.

Roots lock a target in place, making movement and most movement abilities impossible. Other actions are not affected, including teleportation effects.

Turns of root remaining: %s.

slow.name: slowed
slow.description:
Slowing magic affects the target's rate of time, to them everything is moving super-fast.

A slowed character performs all actions in twice the amount of time they would normally take.

Turns of slow remaining: %s.

soul_mark.name: soul marked
soul_mark.description:
The warlock has tapped into the soul of this creature, allowing him to heal as it takes physical damage.

Turns of soul mark remaining: %s.

terror.name: terrified
terror.description:
Terror is manipulative magic which forces its target into an uncontrollable panic.

Terrified characters are forced to run away from their opponent, trying to put as many doors and walls between them as possible. The shock of pain will lessen the duration of terror, however.

Turns of terror remaining: %s.

vertigo.name: vertigo
vertigo.description:
Walking in a straight line can be difficult when the whole world is spinning.

While under the effects of vertigo, characters who attempt to move will go in a random direction, instead of the one they intended to go in.

Turns of vertigo remaining: %s.

vulnerable.name: vulnerable
vulnerable.description:
Vulnerability magic increases all physical damage that a character takes by 33%%, after that damage has been reduced by armor.

Turns of vulnerable remaining: %s.

weakness.name: weakened
weakness.description:
Everything suddenly seems much heavier.

Weakening magic reduces a character's physical strength, causing them to deal 33%% reduced damage.

Turns of weakness remaining: %s.

barrier.name: barrier
barrier.description:
A durable bubble of force which blocks all damage.

The barrier will take damage for whatever it is protecting so long as there is shielding left. The shielding will also slowly decay over time.

Shielding remaining: %d.

stamina.name: stamina
stamina.description:
You have unending stamina, allowing for faster movement!

While under the effects of stamina you will run at +50%% speed, but will perform all other actions at normal speed.

Turns of stamina remaining: %s.

barkskin.name: Barkskin
barkskin.description:
Barkskin blocks a _fixed %1$d extra physical attack damage_, stacking with equipped armor. It does not block magic or damage over time. Protection decreases by 1 point every 3 turns.

Turns until next decrease: %2$s.

paralysis_resist.name: Paralysis immunity
paralysis_resist.description:
Immune to paralysis. Paralysis cannot be applied or prolonged during this time.

Turns of paralysis immunity remaining: %s.

opening_protection.name: Opening protection
opening_protection.description:
Start the battle with a temporary shield equal to 33% of maximum health, rounded up. It lasts 2 turns for the first player and 3 turns for the second, measured in game time, without natural decay. Damage consumes this shield first; any remaining shield is removed on expiry.

Shield remaining: %1$d
Turns remaining: %2$s

magical_sight.name: magical sight
magical_sight.description:
You can see terrain and objects through walls within a 6-tile radius, and are immune to blindness.

Turns of magical sight remaining: %s

blazing.name: blazing %s
blazing.description: This enchantment causes flames to spit forth from a weapon, igniting enemies and dealing bonus damage to enemies that are already aflame.

chilling.name: chilling %s
chilling.description: Enemies struck with this enchantment are chilled, slowing their movement and attacks.

shocking.name: shocking %s
shocking.description: Electricity arcs from a shocking weapon, dealing extra damage to all nearby enemies.

venomous.name: venomous %s
venomous.description: Venomous weapons inflict a delayed but deadly poison, which becomes more severe each time it is applied.

blocking.name: blocking %s
blocking.description: Blocking weapons have a chance to briefly shield you after attacking with them.

blooming.name: blooming %s
blooming.description: Blooming weapons contain magic which will cause vegetation to sprout on or around those struck by them.

elastic.name: elastic %s
elastic.description: Elastic weapons have a chance to send enemies flying back short distances.

projecting.name: projecting %s
projecting.description: With this enchantment melee weapons will gain extra reach. Ranged weapons will penetrate walls when aimed at nearby targets.

vorpal.name: vorpal %s
vorpal.description: Vorpal weapons are especially deadly, they have a chance to strike so cleanly that they inflict bleed instead of damage to enemies that can bleed.

crystal.name: crystal %s
crystal.description: Crystal enchantment deals additional magic damage. Melee weapons shatter after 5 hits. Misses do not spend uses, and the weapon cannot repair itself. Thrown weapons have no additional crystal durability.

grim.name: grim %s
grim.description: This powerful enchantment possesses the power to instantly execute an enemy. The effect is more likely to occur the weaker the enemy is.

vampiric.name: vampiric %s
vampiric.description: This powerful enchantment leeches life force from enemies with each blow, funneling it back into the wearer. The effect is stronger the lower the wearer's health.

swiftness.name: %s of swiftness
swiftness.description: This glyph enhances the speed of the wearer whenever they aren't near to an enemy.

viscosity.name: %s of viscosity
viscosity.description: This glyph is able to store damage dealt to the wearer, dealing it to them slowly rather than all at once.

potential.name: %s of potential
potential.description: This glyph builds energy when struck, granting charge to the wearer's wand when it activates.

brimstone.name: %s of brimstone
brimstone.description: This glyph shields the wearer and their belongings from fire, completely nullifying its damage and negative effects.

stone.name: %s of stone
stone.description: This glyph surrounds the armor with heavy magical stone that makes dodging impossible, but blocks damage in proportion with evasion.

entanglement.name: %s of entanglement
entanglement.description: This glyph grows earthen armor around the wearer to absorb damage, but this armor will break if the wearer moves.

repulsion.name: %s of repulsion
repulsion.description: This glyph rebounds force against attackers, sending them flying back.

camouflage.name: %s of camouflage
camouflage.description: This glyph allows the wearer to blend into tall grass, granting them temporary invisibility.

flow.name: %s of flow
flow.description: This glyph manipulates the flow of water around the wearer, making them much faster when moving through it.

affection.name: %s of affection
affection.description: This powerful glyph manipulates the mind of attackers, charming them temporarily.

antimagic.name: %s of anti-magic
antimagic.description: This powerful glyph allows armor to defend its wearer against magical attacks as well as physical ones. This magical defence is not affected by the armor's tier.

thorns.name: %s of thorns
thorns.description: This powerful glyph harms attackers, causing them to slowly bleed when they attack the wearer.

items.wands.wandoflivingearth$earthguard.zh: 灵壤法杖发射的魔法泥石组成了一尊灵壤守卫！这个有棱有角的大块头会攻击附近的敌人，迫使他们去攻击守卫。当附近没有危险时，守卫会重组为你身边的灵壤护甲，等待你下次使用法杖召唤它。
items.wands.wandoflivingearth$earthguard.en: The rocks from your wand of living earth have formed into a protective earthen guardian! This rocky protector will attack nearby enemies, which will force them to attack the guardian instead of you. When all nearby threats are gone, the guardian will re-form around you, and will return when you next use your wand.

items.wands.wandoflivingearth$earthguard.zh: 守卫的防御力与你的法杖等级相关。它当前能抵挡_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_。
items.wands.wandoflivingearth$earthguard.en: The guardian's defensive power is tied to the level of your wand. It currently blocks _%1$d-%2$d damage._

items.wands.wandoflivingearth$earthguard.zh: 你可通过某根法杖遇到该单位。
items.wands.wandoflivingearth$earthguard.en: You can find this character with a specific wand.

items.wands.wandofregrowth$lotus.desc.zh: 黄金莲是一种只能被强大的再生法杖创造的神秘植物。它的光环会增强所有植物相关效果，但它不一会就会耗尽能量枯萎。
items.wands.wandofregrowth$lotus.desc.en: The golden lotus is a mystical plant that can only be conjured by a powerful wand of regrowth. Its aura enhances all plants and plant effects, but it burns through its energy and dies after a short time.

items.wands.wandofregrowth$lotus.wand_in.zh: 这株黄金莲由一根_%1$d级_的再生法杖产出。在其作用范围内，所有被种植到某单位上的植物都会_立即触发_其效果。植物还会有_%2$d%%的概率_掉落其种子，使用涂药飞镖的耐久度消耗也会减少_%3$d%%_。
items.wands.wandofregrowth$lotus.wand_in.en: This lotus was produced by a _+%1$d_ wand of regrowth. All plants in its effect will _instantly trigger_ if they are planted on a character. Plants will also have a _%2$d%% chance_ to drop their seed, and tipped darts will use _%3$d%% less durability_.

items.wands.wandofregrowth$lotus.discove.zh: 你可通过经数次升级后的某根法杖找到该植物。
items.wands.wandofregrowth$lotus.discove.en: You can find this plant with a specific wand, after upgrading it several times.

items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_gene.zh:
这个哨卫元素会自动攻击进入视野的目标。

使用哨卫法杖向该哨卫施法能使其升级。

哨卫能发动攻击的次数有限，次数耗尽后它们便会消散。
items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_gene.en:
This ward will automatically zap any enemy which comes into its range of vision.

Zapping this ward with your wand of warding will upgrade it.

Wards have a limited number of zaps before dissipating.

items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_gene.zh:
这个哨卫结晶攻击力与哨卫元素相同，但以生命值取代了有限的发动次数。它的样子有点像哨卫法杖顶端的宝石。

使用哨卫法杖向该哨卫施法能使其升级并治疗它。

这个哨卫每次发动攻击时会消耗一定的生命值，但你可以用哨卫法杖治疗它。
items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_gene.en:
This sentry has the same firepower as a ward, but has health instead of a set number of charges. It resembles the gem at the tip of your wand of warding.

Zapping this sentry with your wand of warding will upgrade and heal it.

This sentry will spend some health each time it zaps an enemy, but can be healed by using your wand of warding on it.

items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_1.zh:
这个最基本的哨卫元素会自动攻击进入视野的目标，造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害。_

使用哨卫法杖向该哨卫施法能使其升级。

这个哨卫在仅发动1次攻击之后就会消散。

你的哨卫法杖在使用_%3$d点能量_维持这个哨卫。
items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_1.en:
This basic ward will automatically zap any enemy which comes into its range of vision, dealing _%1$d-%2$d damage._

Zapping this ward with your wand of warding will upgrade it.

This ward will only zap a single time before dissipating.

Your wand of warding is using _%3$d energy_ to sustain this ward.

items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_2.zh:
这个升级过的哨卫元素结构更精致，而且在攻击数次后才会消散。它每次发动攻击能造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_。

使用哨卫法杖向该哨卫施法能使其升级。

这个哨卫在发动3次攻击之后才会消散。

你的哨卫法杖在使用_%3$d点能量_维持这个哨卫。
items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_2.en:
This upgraded ward has a more intricate pattern, and can attack multiple times. Each zap from this ward will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage._

Zapping this ward with your wand of warding will upgrade it.

This ward will zap three times before dissipating.

Your wand of warding is using _%3$d energy_ to sustain this ward.

items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_3.zh:
这个满级的哨卫元素能发动更多次攻击，而且攻击速度更快。它每次发动攻击能造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_。

使用哨卫法杖向该哨卫施法能使其进化。

这个哨卫在发动5次攻击之后才会消散。

你的哨卫法杖在使用_%3$d点能量_维持这个哨卫。
items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_3.en:
This fully upgraded ward is able to attack more times than its predecessors. Each zap from this ward will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage._

Zapping this ward with your wand of warding will upgrade it.

This ward will zap five times before dissipating.

Your wand of warding is using _%3$d energy_ to sustain this ward.

items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_4.zh:
这个小小的哨卫结晶攻击力与大哨卫元素相同，但以生命值取代了有限的发动次数。它的样子有点像哨卫法杖顶端的宝石。它每次发动攻击能造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_。

使用哨卫法杖向该哨卫施法能使其升级并治疗它。

这个哨卫每次发动攻击时会消耗一定的生命值，但你可以用哨卫法杖治疗它。

你的哨卫法杖在使用_%3$d点能量_维持这个哨卫。
items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_4.en:
This smaller sentry has the same firepower as a greater ward, but has health instead of a set number of charges. It resembles the gem at the tip of your wand of warding. Each zap from this sentry will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage._

Zapping this sentry with your wand of warding will upgrade and heal it.

This sentry will spend some health each time it zaps an enemy, but can be healed by using your wand of warding on it.

Your wand of warding is using _%3$d energy_ to sustain this sentry.

items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_5.zh:
这个升级过的哨卫结晶比小哨卫结晶体积更大，形体也更结实。它每次发动攻击能造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_。

使用哨卫法杖向该哨卫施法能使其升级并治疗它。

这个哨卫每次发动攻击时会消耗一定的生命值，但你可以用哨卫法杖治疗它。

你的哨卫法杖在使用_%3$d点能量_维持这个哨卫。
items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_5.en:
This upgraded sentry is larger and more durable than a lesser sentry. Each zap from this sentry will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage._

Zapping this sentry with your wand of warding will upgrade and heal it.

This sentry will spend some health each time it zaps an enemy, but can be healed by using your wand of warding on it.

Your wand of warding is using _%3$d energy_ to sustain this sentry.

items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_6.zh:
这个满级的哨卫结晶比之前的坚固了不少。它每次发动攻击能造成_%1$d~%2$d点伤害_。

使用哨卫法杖向该哨卫施法能治疗它。

这个哨卫每次发动攻击时会消耗一定的生命值，但你可以用哨卫法杖治疗它。

你的哨卫法杖在使用_%3$d点能量_维持这个哨卫。
items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.desc_6.en:
This fully upgraded sentry is significantly more durable than its predecessors. Each zap from this sentry will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage._

Zapping this sentry with your wand of warding will heal it.

This sentry will spend some health each time it zaps an enemy, but can be healed by using your wand of warding on it.

Your wand of warding is using _%3$d energy_ to sustain this sentry.

items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.discover_.zh: 你可通过某根法杖遇到该单位。
items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.discover_.en: You can find this character with a specific wand.

items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.dismiss_b.zh:
不想让法杖继续维持这个哨卫的话，你可以选择驱散它立即将其破坏移除。

要驱散这个哨卫吗？
items.wands.wandofwarding$ward.dismiss_b.en:
You can dispel this ward if you no longer want your wand to maintain it. Doing so immediately destroys the ward.

Dismiss this ward?

actors.blobs.blizzard.desc.zh: 这里刮起了一阵暴风雪。

actors.blobs.confusiongas.desc.zh: 这里盘绕着一片致眩气体。
actors.blobs.confusiongas.desc.en: A cloud of confusion gas is swirling here.

actors.blobs.electricity.desc.zh: 火花在这片电场中不断闪烁着。
actors.blobs.electricity.desc.en: A field of electricity is sparking brightly here.

actors.blobs.fire.desc.zh: 一团火焰正在这里肆虐。

actors.blobs.foliage.desc.zh: 光柱刺破了地下花园中的黑暗。
actors.blobs.foliage.desc.en: Shafts of light pierce the gloom of the underground garden.

actors.blobs.freezing.desc.zh: 这里的空气寒冷刺骨，很不寻常。
actors.blobs.freezing.desc.en: The air is unnaturally frigid here.

actors.blobs.goowarn.desc.zh: 黑暗能量正在这里涌动！
actors.blobs.goowarn.desc.en: Specks of dark energy are swarming here!

actors.blobs.inferno.desc.zh: 一阵狱火正在这里肆虐。

actors.blobs.paralyticgas.desc.zh: 这里盘绕着一片麻痹气体。
actors.blobs.paralyticgas.desc.en: A cloud of paralytic gas is swirling here.

actors.blobs.sacrificialfire.desc.zh:
这是一个承载着献祭之火的祭坛。在此殒命的生物都将成为献给地牢幽魂的祭品。

或许献祭够多，就能得到回报？
actors.blobs.sacrificialfire.desc.en:
There is an altar here with a sacrificial fire burning atop it. Any creature that's killed here will be consumed as an offering to the spirits of the dungeon.

Perhaps a reward will be given if enough sacrifices are made?

actors.blobs.sacrificialfire.worthy.zh: 火焰吞噬了你的祭品，燃烧得愈加旺盛。
actors.blobs.sacrificialfire.worthy.en: The fire consumes your offering and grows stronger.

actors.blobs.sacrificialfire.unworthy.zh: 火焰吞噬了你的祭品，然而没有任何变化。
actors.blobs.sacrificialfire.unworthy.en: The fire consumes your offering, but doesn't change.

actors.blobs.sacrificialfire.reward.zh: 火焰骤然升腾，继而消散，并留下一份奖励！
actors.blobs.sacrificialfire.reward.en: The fire flares and then dissipates, leaving a reward behind!

actors.blobs.smokescreen.desc.zh: 这里翻腾着一团浓密的黑烟。
actors.blobs.smokescreen.desc.en: A cloud of thick black smoke is swirling here.

actors.blobs.stenchgas.desc.zh: 这里盘绕着一片腐烂的臭气。
actors.blobs.stenchgas.desc.en: A cloud of fetid stench is swirling here.

actors.blobs.stormcloud.desc.zh: 这里盘绕着一片翻腾的水汽。
actors.blobs.stormcloud.desc.en: A cloud of billowing water vapor is swirling here.

actors.blobs.toxicgas.desc.zh: 这里盘绕着一片发绿的毒气。
actors.blobs.toxicgas.desc.en: A greenish cloud of toxic gas is swirling here.

actors.blobs.toxicgas.ondeath.en: You died from the toxic gas...

actors.blobs.corrosivegas.desc.zh: 这里盘绕着一片致命的腐蚀酸雾。
actors.blobs.corrosivegas.desc.en: A cloud of deadly caustic gas is swirling here.

actors.blobs.waterofawareness.procced.zh: 在你小酌一口时，你感觉到知识涌入了你的头脑。
actors.blobs.waterofawareness.procced.en: As you take a sip, you feel knowledge pour into your mind.

actors.blobs.waterofawareness.desc.zh: 知识的力量正在从这口井的水里涌出。饮下井中的水将会鉴定所有已装备的物品、探测背包中所有物品的诅咒并揭示本层所有物品的位置。
actors.blobs.waterofawareness.desc.en: Power of knowledge radiates from the water of this well. Drinking from the well will fully identify all equipped items, identify curses on all items in your inventory, and reveal all items on the current floor.

actors.blobs.waterofhealth.procced.zh: 你小酌一口后，立刻感到所有伤口都痊愈了。
actors.blobs.waterofhealth.procced.en: As you take a sip, you feel your wounds heal completely.

actors.blobs.waterofhealth.desc.zh: 生命的力量正在从这口井的水里涌出。饮下井中的水可以治疗伤口、解除饥饿并净化所有已装备物品的诅咒。
actors.blobs.waterofhealth.desc.en: Power of health radiates from the water of this well. Drinking from this well will heal your wounds, satisfy hunger, and cleanse curses on any worn items.

actors.blobs.web.desc.zh: 这里所有东西都被厚厚的蜘蛛网覆盖着。任何接触或丢向蛛网的东西都会打破它，但也都会被固定在原地。
actors.blobs.web.desc.en: A thick web is covering everything here. Anything that touches or is thrown through the web will break it, but will also be stuck in place.

actors.mobs.npcs.mirrorimage.desc.zh:
这个幻像和你非常相似，甚至还装备着你当前的武器和护甲。

镜像会猎寻敌人，并用它们的镜像武器对其发动攻击。镜像武器的使用方式与特性和你手中的一样，但造成的伤害会低些。镜像刚生成时几乎是隐形的，但攻击后会显形。

镜像有一定的攻击能力，但本身非常脆弱，受到伤害就会瞬间消散。
actors.mobs.npcs.mirrorimage.desc.en:
This illusion bears a close resemblance to you, even seeming to wield your current weapon and armor.

Mirror images will seek and attack enemies using their mimicked weapon, which behaves the same as yours, but deals less damage. They start out nearly invisible, but must take on a form that's more easily seen in order to attack.

While their offensive power can be potent, mirror images have no durability, and will fade the moment they take damage.

actors.mobs.npcs.mirrorimage.discover_hi.zh: 你可通过某张卷轴遇到该单位。
actors.mobs.npcs.mirrorimage.discover_hi.en: You can find this character with a specific scroll.

actors.mobs.npcs.sheep.desc.zh: 这是一只魔法绵羊。为什么叫它魔法绵羊？因为你杀不死它。它只会站在那里直到它消失，它会做的事情只有边反刍边对你翻白眼。
actors.mobs.npcs.sheep.desc.en: This is a magic sheep. What's so magical about it? You can't kill it. It will stand there until it magically fades away, all the while chewing cud with a blank stare.

actors.mobs.npcs.sheep.discover_hint.zh: 你可通过某个物品或陷阱遇到该单位。
actors.mobs.npcs.sheep.discover_hint.en: You can find this character with a specific item or trap.

plants.blandfruitbush.desc.zh: 腐莓的远亲，来自无味果树丛的梨状产物，尝起来犹如一团泥巴。果实粗糙且松软，但并没有毒性。也许可以煮食。
plants.blandfruitbush.desc.en: Distant cousin of the rotberry, the pear-shaped produce of the blandfruit bush tastes like caked dust. The fruit is gross and unsubstantial but isn't poisonous. Perhaps it could be cooked.

plants.blandfruitbush.discover_hint.zh: 你可在地牢各处找到该植物。
plants.blandfruitbush.discover_hint.en: You can find this plant randomly in the dungeon.

plants.blindweed.desc.zh: 在被碰到后，致盲草会瞬间枯萎并释放一道强光。这道光足以刺伤受害者双眼，使其暂时失明。
plants.blindweed.desc.en: Upon being touched a blindweed perishes in a bright flash of light. The flash is strong enough to disorient for several seconds.

plants.blindweed.warden_desc.zh: _守望者_能将致盲草的能量化为一层短时间的隐形迷雾，而不会被致盲。
plants.blindweed.warden_desc.en: _The Warden_ will channel a blindweed's energy into a temporary shroud of invisibility, instead of being disoriented.

plants.mageroyal.desc.zh: 魔皇草的带刺花朵含有一种化学物质，因其强大的中和性质而闻名。任何踏入这株植物的东西将会被净化掉许多负面效果。
plants.mageroyal.desc.en: The mageroyal's prickly flowers contain a chemical which is known for its properties as a strong neutralizing agent. Anything that steps in this plant will be cleansed of many negative effects.

plants.mageroyal.warden_desc.zh: 当踩踏一株魔皇草时，_守望者_在获得中和效果以外，还能短暂地对所有环境影响免疫。
plants.mageroyal.warden_desc.en: In addition to the neutralizing effect, _the Warden_ will become temporarily immune to all area-bound effects when stepping on mageroyal.

plants.earthroot.desc.zh: 碰到地缚根后，它的根系会在踩踏者周边形成某种无法移动的天然护甲。
plants.earthroot.desc.en: When a creature touches an earthroot, its roots create a kind of immobile natural armor around it.

plants.earthroot.warden_desc.zh: _守望者_能将这种护甲转化为可移动的树肤护甲。
plants.earthroot.warden_desc.en: The roots of an earthroot plant will move with _the Warden_, providing her mobile barkskin armor.

plants.earthroot$armor.desc.zh:
这是一种由层层树皮和藤蔓盘结而成的，不可移动的天然护甲。

每当你受到物理攻击时，植被护甲都会吸收%d点伤害，直到其耐久被耗尽并瓦解。

该护甲是不可移动的，所以一旦你离开原位护甲便会被破坏，消失不见。

剩余护甲量：%d点
plants.earthroot$armor.desc.en:
A kind of natural, immobile armor made of bark and twine.

This herbal armor will block %d damage from any physical hit, until it eventually runs out of durability and collapses.

As the armor is immobile, moving will cause it to break apart and be lost.

Armor remaining: %d.

plants.fadeleaf.desc.zh: 任何触碰到消逝草的生物都会被传送到当前层的一个随机地点。
plants.fadeleaf.desc.en: Touching a fadeleaf will teleport any creature to a random place on the current level.

plants.fadeleaf.warden_desc.zh: _守望者_能进一步发挥消逝草的空间魔力，直接回到上一层的下楼梯处。
plants.fadeleaf.warden_desc.en: The teleportation effect of fadeleaf is more potent for _the Warden_, teleporting her back to the end of the previous dungeon level.

plants.firebloom.desc.zh: 烈焰花被任何物品触碰到时，都会化为一团火焰。
plants.firebloom.desc.en: When something touches a firebloom, it bursts into flames.

plants.firebloom.warden_desc.zh: _守望者_能将有害的火焰转化为短时的烈焰之力。
plants.firebloom.warden_desc.en: When she tramples a firebloom, _the Warden_ will be briefly imbued with flame instead of being harmed.

plants.icecap.desc.zh: 冰冠花在被接触到时会喷射出一团能冻结周遭的花粉。冻结效果会在潮湿环境中大幅增强。
plants.icecap.desc.en: Upon being touched, an icecap lets out a puff of freezing pollen. The freezing effect is much stronger if the environment is wet.

plants.icecap.warden_desc.zh: _守望者_能将有害的冰冻转化为短时的寒霜之力。
plants.icecap.warden_desc.en: When she tramples an icecap, _the Warden_ will be briefly imbued with frost instead of being harmed.

plants.plant.warden_desc.zh: 守望者踩踏这株植物不会获得额外效果。
plants.plant.warden_desc.en: This plant has no special effect when used by the Warden.

plants.plant.discover_hint.zh: 你可在地牢各处直接找到该植物，使用对应的种子进行种植亦可。
plants.plant.discover_hint.en: You can find this plant randomly in the dungeon, or grow it from its associated seed.

plants.plant$seed.info.zh:
把这粒种子丢到你想长出一株植物的地方。

%s
plants.plant$seed.info.en:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

%s
