plants.rotberry.desc.zh: 未成熟的腐莓丛结出的莓果尝起来更像是甜蜜的死亡。经过成年累月的生长，这株腐莓丛终会成熟为另一棵腐莓核心。被踩踏后，这株未成熟的腐莓会释放少量毒气。
plants.rotberry.desc.en: The berries of a young rotberry shrub taste like sweet, sweet death. Over a few years, this rotberry shrub will grow into another rot heart. When trampled, a young rotberry will produce a small puff of toxic gas.

plants.rotberry.warden_desc.zh: 遭到践踏时腐莓丛通常只会喷出一小股毒气，但_守望者_却能联结其中的魔力，在短时间内提升力量！
plants.rotberry.warden_desc.en: Normally a rotberry bush only produces a little gas when trampled, but _the Warden_ is able to harness energy from it to temporarily boost her strength!

plants.rotberry.discover_hint.zh: 你可在某个任务中使用其种子种植该植物。
plants.rotberry.discover_hint.en: You can grow this plant from its associated seed during a specific quest.

plants.rotberry$seed.discover_hint.zh: 你可在某个任务中找到该物品。
plants.rotberry$seed.discover_hint.en: You can find this item during a specific quest.

plants.sorrowmoss.desc.zh: 断肠苔（实为花卉而非苔藓）是一种花瓣利如刀片，表面覆有致命毒液的植物。
plants.sorrowmoss.desc.en: A sorrowmoss is a flower (not a moss) with razor-sharp petals, coated with a deadly venom.

plants.sorrowmoss.warden_desc.zh: _守望者_能将有害的毒素转化为短时的毒素之力。
plants.sorrowmoss.warden_desc.en: When she tramples a sorrowmoss, _the Warden_ will be briefly imbued with toxin instead of being harmed.

plants.starflower.desc.zh: 星陨花较为罕见，据说其能够为任何接触它的人赋予神圣之力。
plants.starflower.desc.en: A rare plant, starflower is said to grant holy power to whomever touches it.

plants.starflower.warden_desc.zh: _守望者_在踩踏星陨花时不仅能受到祝福，还能获得较长时间的法杖充能。
plants.starflower.warden_desc.en: In addition to being blessed, _the Warden_ will gain a significant amount of wand recharging when she tramples a starflower.

plants.stormvine.desc.zh: 引力似乎并不能正常地作用在风暴藤上，它蓝色的藤蔓能够"挂"在空中。任何被风暴藤缠到的生物也被这种奇怪的引力影响，并失去方向感。
plants.stormvine.desc.en: Gravity affects the stormvine plant strangely, allowing its whispy blue tendrils to 'hang' on the air. Anything caught in the vine is affected by this, and becomes disoriented.

plants.stormvine.warden_desc.zh: 守望者能够操纵风暴藤的魔力，因而在踩踏之后可以获得短暂飘浮的能力。
plants.stormvine.warden_desc.en: _The Warden_ is able to control the gravitational effect of stormvine, and will briefly levitate when she tramples one.

plants.sungrass.desc.zh: 阳春草因其汁液缓慢但显著的疗伤效果而家喻户晓。
plants.sungrass.desc.en: Sungrass is renowned for its sap's slow but effective healing properties.

plants.sungrass.warden_desc.zh: _守望者_能将阳春草的治疗魔力随身携带。
plants.sungrass.warden_desc.en: _The Warden_ can receive healing from trampled sungrass even if she moves away from it.

plants.sungrass$health.desc.zh:
阳春草拥有优秀的治疗能力，尽管治疗速率比治疗药剂慢很多。

脱离植株将会打断治疗效果。

剩余治疗量：%d
plants.sungrass$health.desc.en:
Sungrass possesses excellent healing properties, though it is much slower than a potion of healing.

Moving off the plant will break the healing effect.

Healing remaining: %d.

plants.swiftthistle.desc.zh: 被踩踏后，速行蓟会加速周围的时间流动，让踩踏者可以瞬间行动数次
plants.swiftthistle.desc.en: When trampled, swiftthistle will briefly accelerate the flow of time around it, allowing the trampler to perform several actions instantly.

plants.swiftthistle.warden_desc.zh: _守望者_踩踏速行蓟不仅能获得瞬时行动的机会，还能在短时间内极速奔跑。
plants.swiftthistle.warden_desc.en: In addition to gaining instantaneous actions, _the Warden_ will also get a brief haste boost when trampling swiftthistle.

plants.swiftthistle$timebubble.desc.zh:
这是一个加速时间运行的气泡。

你可以在气泡中瞬间进行多次行动，但是攻击或施法都会打断这个效果。

剩余时长：%s回合
plants.swiftthistle$timebubble.desc.en:
A small bubble of accelerated time, allowing actions to be performed instantly. Attacking or using magic will break this effect however.

Turns remaining: %s.

windows.wndinfocell.nothing.zh: 这里没什么有趣的东西。

scenes.gamescene.multiple_examine.zh: 这里引人注意的东西不止一件，你想检查哪个？
scenes.gamescene.multiple_examine.en: There are multiple things of interest here, which one do you want to examine?

levels.level.water_desc.zh: 进入水潭中可熄灭身上的火焰。
levels.level.water_desc.en: In case of burning step into the water to extinguish the fire.

levels.level.entrance_desc.en: Stairs lead up to the upper depth.

levels.level.exit_desc.en: Stairs lead down to the lower depth.

levels.level.high_grass_desc.zh: 茂密的植被遮挡了你的视线。

levels.level.locked_door_desc.zh: 这扇门锁着，而你需要匹配的钥匙才能打开它。
levels.level.locked_door_desc.en: This door is locked, you need a matching key to unlock it.

levels.level.crystal_door_desc.zh: 这扇锁着的门由魔力水晶铸造而成。你的视线可以穿过它，但你的身体不能，还是找找对应的水晶钥匙吧。
levels.level.crystal_door_desc.en: This locked door is made of magical crystal. You can see through, but you'll need a crystal key to open it.

levels.level.locked_exit_desc.zh: 沉重的铁栏杆封锁住了通往下一层的楼梯。
levels.level.locked_exit_desc.en: Heavy bars block the stairs leading down.

levels.level.barricade_desc.zh: 木栅栏依然坚固，但早已风干多年。或许可以点燃烧掉？
levels.level.barricade_desc.en: The wooden barricade is firmly set but has dried over the years. Might it burn?

levels.level.inactive_trap_desc.zh: 这个陷阱已经被触发过了，现在一点也不危险。
levels.level.inactive_trap_desc.en: The trap has been triggered before and it's not dangerous anymore.

levels.level.statue_desc.zh: 有人想装饰一下这里，很显然，它没能成功...
levels.level.statue_desc.en: Someone wanted to adorn this place, but failed, obviously.

levels.level.alchemy_desc.zh: 这口炼金釜中充满了魔力之水。物品可以在里面共炼以制造新的物品。
levels.level.alchemy_desc.en: This pot is filled with magical water. Items can be mixed into the pot to create something new!

dynamic_keys: 这件_%d阶_护甲能抵挡_%d点伤害_。
魔晶附魔：命中时追加魔法伤害。武器在命中5次后碎裂，剩余_%d_次；未命中不消耗，不会自行修复。
这件_%d阶_近战武器可以造成_%d点伤害_。
轮到你购买 · 第 %d 手
等待对方购买 · 第 %d 手

正在恢复连接…
剩余等待时间：%d秒
思考时间仍会继续计算。
对手暂时离线，等待重连：%d秒
物资分发完成，双方基础生命 %d，战斗开始。
对方行动了，消耗 %.3f 回合。
地图边缘已塌陷，剩余安全区域为 %d×%d。
服务器启动失败：端口可能已被占用 (%d)

狂乱会使生物不分敌我地攻击。

PvP 玩家仍由本人控制行动，召唤物沿用狂乱的敌我判断。

剩余时长：%s回合

受伤会减少5回合的持续时间。PvP 玩家仍由本人控制行动，不会因离开视野被移出对局。

剩余时长：%s回合
从法杖中发出的魔法飞弹会对单个目标造成_%d点伤害_，如果被升级则会暂时强化其他法杖。
这根法杖能向任何瞄准的地方射出强大的电弧，造成_%d点伤害_。这道闪电能在附近多个目标间跳跃，在水里会更强力。要是太接近，同样可能电到你自己，却不会波及到你的同伴。
这根法杖射出的光束能穿透任何障碍物，并将随着法杖等级的提升而射得更远。光束会造成_%d点伤害_，并且会根据穿透的地形和敌人数量造成额外伤害。
